reviews.text: I loved the food here, came here at 1pm on a holiday and got seated with no wait. The jumbo prawns with the spaghetti was the most delicious meal I’ve had. There were four prawns and the meat inside was a big portion and very juicy. I’d definitely come back here. My table mates got the beef and fish rice and curry and it was delicious as well. The mocha leaves something to be desired because it’s mostly foam but the fruit juice is incredible!

First night in Sri Lanka, and Galle truly set the tone with its beautiful views and relaxed atmosphere. After wandering through the streets of Galle, we decided to dine here, and it turned out to be a great choice. We ordered sandwiches, pizza, and the chicken curry on the chef’s recommendation. The food did take a while to arrive, but the taste more than made up for the wait. They welcomed us with complimentary coconut water, which was a nice touch and instantly refreshing. The ambience was pleasant, the dishes were well presented, and everything tasted fresh and flavourful. The pizza, in particular, was so good that we still remembered its taste on our last day. If I ever visit Galle again, I would definitely come back here.

As a first-time visitor to Sri Lanka, with Galle being only the second city I’ve explored, The Peddlar’s Inn in Galle Fort completely stole my heart. The moment I stepped in, I was wrapped in a classic theme with irresistible colonial vibes—charming, timeless, and full of character. The seating was wonderfully comfortable and cosy, making it easy to linger longer than planned (I totally did 😌).

What truly elevated the experience was the staff—pleasant, attentive, and warm, striking up easy small talks that made me feel genuinely welcome rather than just another tourist. The menu offered an impressive variety, with plenty of choices to suit different moods and cravings. And the food? Absolutely delicious—flavours that made me pause, smile, and appreciate every bite.

If Galle was already winning me over, The Peddlar’s Inn sealed the deal. A perfect little gem in the Fort that I’d happily return to, again and again. 💕

I ordered the clay pot seafood rice, and it was really delicious, well cooked, flavorful, and very satisfying. Definitely a must-try dish.

The interior is beautifully designed with a cozy, charming atmosphere. The overall vibe is calm and romantic, making it a great place for a romantic date or a relaxed evening inside Galle Fort.

We had fish curry and chicken curry. Both were great in terms of presentation and taste. However, it took very long until the food was served. It seemed the restaurant was understaffed that day as several people left without ordering food since it took too long. We tried to get the waiter's attention to order some more drinks and it took quite long until we finally were able to order.
If you are not in a rush, go there and enjoy the delicious food.

formatted_address: 50 Leyn Baan St, Galle 80000, Sri Lanka
name: Fort Fifty Inn Guest House & Restaurant

reviews.text:
This little guesthouse in Galle advertised itself as having luxury rooms with balconies.
When I arrived I was shown to a small airless room not only without a balcony but with no proper window. The shower room was poorly decorated with no shelf or proper fittings. Although I was staying two nights the room was not cleaned during my stay.
On the plus, side the double bed was comfortable and there was good air con. The breakfast had reason able choice and quality.
T he location is very good near the  lighthouse and ramparts walk.
The owner does not take cards and is somewhat reluctant to give a receipt for cash.

We have stayed one night last August. Unfortunately, this was the bad experience ever.

Not recommended for anyone to stay. Because, Bathroom smells bad and very small. No carpets. Bed sheets and pillows are not clean. Towels are old.

They were provide us the wrong wifi password and poor signal level in room No. U2 & U3.

Breakfast is good, but not enough.

We felt that they treat locals and foreigners to different ways.

We were on the search for good Curry - and Found it here! The young guys serving us really DO know how to cook. Even now, couple days later, we found only one place better than this.
Mention: can‘t rate the hotel, just the Restaurant. Good prices for galle fort!

The price was pretty good. Stayed there last night with my husband Kyle.
The manager is super sweet and friendly.
The room was clean, the A/C works perfectly, the washroom is clean too.
I recommend this place.
Breakfast was really good!!
5 stars!!

A nice place at a convenient location. Worth for the price.
The manager was really friendly and the service was excellent.

However, the place needs a face-lift. Everything looks old and tends to break, even the fittings in the bathroom.
The room was not the same as we booked. There are no real balcony rooms here. Yet, it's worth for the price.

Awful Food, Poor Hygiene & Rude Service at KFC Galle

I dined at KFC Galle last Thursday and had a terrible experience. Ordered 6 pcs Hot & Crispy, and even with no customers, they had cooked a large batch already. Three pieces were dark brown, tasted refried and stale, nothing like fresh KFC chicken. The food made me fall sick with stomach pain and loose motion, requiring medication.

Plates were oily and greasy, even after replacement. The hand wash area was filthy, smelling of urine with water and foot marks everywhere. When I complained, the duty in-charge said there was no cleaning staff. Shockingly, they had “No Photography” stickers everywhere — likely to hide such issues.

When I contacted head office, the operations manager was rude, defensive, and never apologized. This outlet has completely lost the KFC quality and hygiene standards. I’m posting this with pictures so others are aware. Customers deserve better.

About 10 years ago, while visiting Galle with friends, we stopped by KFC. The food quality was satisfactory, and although we had to wait a little, the service was acceptable. Seating space was decent and the overall experience felt better at that time. Compared to those days, the recent standards and experience don’t feel as good or consistent.

I ordered a burger from KFC Galle, and it was extremely disappointing. The burger was delivered without lettuce, even though it included onion.

We also paid extra for delivery, but the delivery person initially refused to come to the exact location and asked us to come to the main road to collect the food. Only after we informed him that we had paid for delivery did he come to the location.

We placed the order at around 3:00 PM, but the delivery was received at 4:15 PM. However, the bill incorrectly mentioned the delivery time as 30 minutes and showed 3:23 PM, which is not accurate.

I usually order from other KFC outlets and have received very good service, but this experience with KFC Galle was extremely disappointing and reflects poor service quality.
Food and services provided was reasonably alright. Bit the place were hot and humid, not really clean including the toilet. Zinger burger was the smallest that I have ever eaten.

Chrispy strips are like pop corn...
By weight both pieces are less than 40g /Rs 750
Taste ok..

A decent spot to have an incredible dinner. Open kitchen. Exceptionally delectable food and I love the spot. The staff were amicable and they treated us so well. In reality we didn't needed to stand by long. Wanting to visit there once more.

It’s a good place to get food around Galle fort. Fair prices considering other places. Bought a mixed fried rice. Good quality food. Think I tasted stock powder though, not overwhelming taste of it though.

This is a simple place, situated next to Fort on Rampart Street. They do arrange seating next to road. The place does not provide WiFi. The staff was extremely friendly and one of the person knew Hindi too. The prices on the menu were reasonable (when compared to other places in the vicinity). We had ordered Tomato and cheese sandwich, chicken burger and Egg and cheese macaroni. The items were prepared pretty quickly and they tasted damn delicious. It is possible to take-out (parcel) food here. It is kind of open kitchen and one can see food being cooked. Definitely a decent hang-out place for someone who wants to spend time close to beach with nice tasting food.

Hasitha was a grate host and food was delicious.  I tried chicken fried rice and hot butter cuttlefish.  Both were very freshly prepared and served while hot n steaming.  I would definitely recommend.

Their seafood pasta and the chicken pasta are amazing. Prices are reasonable and the portion is very generous compared to the other places inside the galle fort. Cozy place and the owner is very polite. Loved it and will be soon visiting again.

formatted_address: Fort Bazaar, 26 පල්ලිය පාර, ගාල්ල 80000, Sri Lanka
name: Fort Bazaar

reviews.text: We came for the restaurant, looks luxury and beautiful. Choose to sit inside, outside was still a bit hot. Service was excellent, food fresh and tasty. A little bit overpriced. But not too much. Perfect for the dinner or romantic date. But even for the kids is good, pizza was good. I was impressed with the butter, how it was served and smallest bread that I ever saw.

This was our fifth stop on our honeymoon, and we chose to stay in Galle Fort a little longer than our other locations. In hindsight I’m still not entirely sure that was the right call for us. There are plenty of quirky little shops and interesting cafés tucked away in the fort’s streets, but you can easily explore the whole area in a day — so the hotel really needed to feel like a sanctuary from the heat, the tuktuks, and the constant bustle.

Fort Bazaar is certainly a nice hotel, but we couldn’t help noticing an “upstairs/downstairs” divide in the rooms. The first-floor rooms looked genuinely luxurious, while the courtyard rooms (where we stayed) felt more pared-back and basic. After being thoroughly spoilt at the previous stops on our honeymoon, it brought us back to earth rather abruptly.

If you’re considering staying here, it might be worth comparing it with their sister property 42 Lighthouse Street, just around the corner. Surprisingly, it’s considerably cheaper, the rooms are far nicer, and you still get access to Fort Bazaar’s restaurant and bar.

All that said, the staff at Fort Bazaar were absolutely lovely, and the hotel’s bar — The Church Street Social — is a brilliant spot to sit, relax, and watch the world go by. Whatever you do, be there at 5pm. They take their happy hour extremely seriously and make it their mission to have everyone suitably merry by 6pm. Special shout-out to Shanta, the superb barman who kept spirits high in every sense.

A pleasant hotel in a great location — just make sure you choose the right room for the experience you want.

On recommendation from Inoka at Cape Welligama, we went here for lunch. Beautiful place. Apparently rooms are lovely according to a lady I chatted to from the UK staying there. I thoroughly enjoyed my superfood bowl & Bazaar Special cocktail! Great!

We had a great time at fort bazaar. Quality is consistent across the tear drops i have visited. Very well located near all the restaurants and shops on pedlar street. Rooms are really cosy.  The whole hotel is really cosy. Lovely pool and spa experience was super relaxing. The food was yummy and plentiful. Couldnt finish portions. The cocktails were lovely and they have a nice happy hour. The staff are so friendly and helpful. We really enjoyed our time and would go again. Take advantage of the offers

We went to the restaurant for breakfast not to stay. So I can’t comment about the rooms. Absolutely loved the interior though. We tried the cafe mocha, pineapple juice, papaya juice, css full breakfast and eggs Benedict. The food was ridiculously expensive and not worth the price. May be because the place is inside the Galle Fort. I was excited for the cafe mocha and I was let down. It was cold when it was served. The food was okay. If you are looking for aesthetic photos, go for it. If you are looking for a hearty meal, can skip.

Church Street Social is an excellent spot with amazing food and warm, friendly staff. While the prices are a bit on the higher side, the quality and generous portions more than make up for it. Every dish was flavorful and satisfying. Definitely coming back again—and highly recommend it to anyone looking for a great dining experience in Galle!

The vibe in the evening was super amazing, right from the overhanging lights outside, to the walls and flooring and even the powder room had so many stories to tell. The food was superb and the service was top notch, will definitely visit again.
Great food, wonderful service and lovely cocktails! We had black pork and chicken curries which came with many delicious accompaniments, lovely local flavours! Recommend highly!

The waitstaff was very attentive. The food was delicious. Portions were very generous. Some dishes had a starter or main size selection, and the starter version was almost a meal. We had happy hour drinks which was great. The only thing was that the fish curry was too spicey. We asked for medium, and it was blazing HOT for our western palate.

I had an incredible dining experience at Church Street Social!

The seafood bisque was hands down the best I’ve ever had—the spice level was spot on, adding a wonderful kick without being overwhelming. The Sri Lankan fish curry was a spicy delight! While I loved every bite, I’d recommend it only for those who can handle a fiery dish.

The pumpkin salad was a refreshing highlight; it had just the right amount of dressing, letting the flavours shine through without being overpowered. For dessert, the vanilla bean cheesecake stole the show—paired with lime sorbet, it struck the perfect balance of sweetness and tartness, making it a memorable end to the meal.

The ambiance is clean and modern, with a vibe that invites you to wander around and take it all in. Definitely a place worth visiting!

As a first-time visitor to Galle, stepping into The Heritage Cafe & Bistro @ Galle Fort felt like discovering a little treasure tucked inside history. The vintage décor instantly drew me in — charming, warm, and full of old-world character — while the comfortable seating made it so easy to relax and linger a little longer (and trust me, I wanted to).

The staff truly deserve a special mention. They were patient, polite, and genuinely welcoming, always ready with a smile and happy to help without ever making things feel rushed. It added such a lovely, personal touch to the experience.

What really impressed me was the wide variety of food choices. There’s something for everyone, and every dish we tried was absolutely delicious — flavorful, well-prepared, and clearly made with care. Knowing that the café is 100% Muslim-friendly with Halal-certified food made the experience even more reassuring and enjoyable.

All in all, The Heritage Cafe & Bistro is a perfect spot to unwind in Galle Fort — great food, beautiful ambiance, and warm hospitality. Honestly… it’s the kind of place that makes you want to come back and steal a few more moments together 💕

Ate (and drank) here twice. Once for lunch (vegan Tofu Burger) and once for dinner (vegan pizza). I also drank a cinnamon lemonade and king coconut during my lunch visit. And a pot of chai for my evening meal.

The food is fantastic and the staff are great and very friendly.

I would 100% recommend a visit when in Galle area.

At first, it seemed like a decent restaurant. Nice interior, not the lowest prices… the dish even seemed tasty — until the moment I found a hair in it. A black, long one!!!

Fine, the dish was supposedly replaced with a new one, but there was no apology, no compliment from the restaurant, and no discount. I believe reputation matters more than anything — this time, you failed.

Incredibly delicious grilled chicken sandwich on quality homemade bread with pesto and cheese, yum. Nice relaxed ambiance with indoor and outdoor seating for a refreshing break from strolling Galle Fort. 5 stars.

This place is absolutely stunning!
Beautiful decorations line the walls and the interior pieces all got together nicely!
They have a great breakfast selection with options and combinations that are out of the norm…
I had the ox cheek Benedict and it was very good… not great
It was one of those dishes that’s nearly perfect but something is missing (this being said I’m a chef and to me when you try something new you have to fix all its quirks… it needed something sharp to contradict all the sweetness) their normal eggs Benedict were fantastic!

Bit more on the expensive side but definitely worth it!

This is a family run guest house and the family were extremely friendly, polite and helpful. The rooms here were basic but perfect for what we required and very reasonably priced. The breakfast was very good and the family couldn't do enough to help us. We had drinks in the bar in evening and it was a pleasant place to sit and watch world go by. I really enjoyed my stay here and would definitely stay again, fully recommend it.

We came here for dinner and ordered a vegan burger, a shrimp wrap, one cocktail, two beers, and a bottle of water. The vegan burger was not very good, but the shrimp wrap was better. The staff were attentive and very curious — they chatted with us and even tried to learn some Turkish words, which was a nice touch. However, in terms of price, this was one of the most expensive meals we had in Sri Lanka. Because of that, it felt a bit weak in terms of value for money.

Had a wonderful dinner here: roti chicken. Very nice, tasty, not too spicy. Loved the dog named ‘Chicken Lady’. Easy going dog (not a stray dog), named after her habit to chase chickens. Very friendly staff. Know how to say ‘thank you’ in about 30 languages.

We ate at the restaurant here, they charge high prices but the food is extremely low quality, I could barely get through it. I ordered a chili fish and chips and it was so saucy that my stomach felt really weird afterwards. It also came with chips that looked like scraps. They were extremely thin and tiny.
We also ordered a club sandwich which claimed to have bacon but had cheap chicken ham and was completely dry. The fish with sweet and sour sauce was no better. All of the food was LKR  2000+. Nothing tasted fresh. It tasted old and frozen. Would not reccomend going here.
They also charge LKR 500+ for a mini sprite.
They didnt really react at all when we told them the food was bad.

Small hotel with restaurant in the middle of Galle Fort. Great location. Staff were very helpful and friendly. Food was good. The room was not exactly large but clean and comfortable bed and the ac was effective.

name: Lucky Fort Restaurant And Cooking Class And Boat Rides

reviews.text: The rice and curry tasting platter is incredible! Some of the best curry I’ve had in Sri Lanka. A huge portion, lots of variety of curries I hadn’t tried yet, and flavours to die for. Super friendly service, beautiful small courtyard setting in an old heritage building, it doesn’t look like much from the outside but I wouldnt hesitate to come back. Both the mango and passion fruit lassie were also some of the best I’ve tried.

Holesome family run restaurant, some of the kindest people we have met! The food was great we tried the 10 curry (2 persons) and were very satisfied. A great way to try a lot of different tasting currys, mix them in different parings (as recommended by our lovely hosts, thank you, game changer!) would definitely recommend.
It was a lovely place to eat, great chill vibes and honest good food.🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟
All the best from Denmark😋
Amazing 10 piece curry (although there was actually 12!) I would even say it was probably the best we've had in our 2 week trip! Noodles were lush too, nice and spicy. Thank you

We took the rice+10 curry for 2 people. We enjoyed having the different curry tastes. The quantity was ok. The staff was nice and we didn't wait to much. The place looks local but general cleaning could be improved.

Stumbled across this place and it was amazing! We were looking for something affordable and this place was reasonably priced but also amazing food. We had the 10 curries and every single one was delicious.

We visited this place on our first night and it was phenomenal! We sat in the garden section and watched people walk by. We ordered the Calamari and rice and the flavour was delicious and fresh. We had such a great time that we came back on our last night so that we could have a whole fish (we’d seen them cooking them on the bbq on our first night and were hooked). You pick your fish and then the spices that you want on it, and then they cook it. We chose a butterfish with lime and chilli and garlic rice 🤤 The fish was incredible!! So fleshy and fresh and the lime chilli topping so good!! Would visit this place again and would recommend to others to visit! The food, the drinks, the people, the atmosphere - it’s a great vibe ☺️

This restaraunt was very close to the hotel we were staying at and is at a convenient location.

We ordered the Yellow Prawn Curry, mixed seafood rice, mixed seafood noodles, Blue lagoon and Lion beer.

All dishes tasted really nice, but the prawn curry was a bit too watery and less thick, and the cocktails and drinks were also great.

A great restaurant made for foreigners and at a convenient location.

Excellent meal and terrific value. We enjoyed a plate of devilled prawns then each of us had a whole curried fish (which we selected from the ice tray). Dessert of vanilla ice cream with pineapple. Would thoroughly recommend. Waiters attentive and polite.

Elita may look small from the outside, but it opens up into a surprisingly large and cosy space. Lovely ambience, friendly faces and — most importantly — really good food.

We went with the waiter’s recommendation: crabs in a buttery sauce. Brilliant choice. They even give you all the crack-and-cut tools so you’re not wrestling with the shell like a cartoon character. The spicy prawns were excellent too, though I should’ve asked them to clean and serve — that one’s on me.

The only miss for us was the fried chicken for the kid. It was literally half a bird, deep-fried straight, and ended up a bit dry and bland. He happily switched to the rice from my prawn dish, so crisis avoided.

Prices are on the higher side and portions lean towards “one dish per person,” but the flavour makes it worth it. If you’re in Galle and craving local seafood, this place won’t disappoint.
I had a lovely meal here, it was quiet when I arrived but filled up. Great fresh fish...I even got your pick my own fish.  Really nicely cooked.  Super value.
Omg I just had here the best Ice-tea of my life! You gotta try it out, definitely recommend!🙌

Nice spot for dinner. Well priced tasty food. Lime juice drink was amazing and would suggest.

Staff were friendly and food was served swiftly.
Could not find the place. Please someone post details how to find it.
Perfect food with a great atmosphere.
Closed on Friday night.

Great local sri lankan buffet. Around 8 dishes available, all cooked in a clay pot.

The tuna curry was especially good as was the cabbage curry. Eggplant one was too sweet. Nice rice options available. Costs around 3000

Drinks are extra and the ginger juice was fantastic.

Nice to people watch on the terrace. Friendly service, although they kept pushing me to eat more

They serve halal food. The place is little pricy. We had their beef with parata & chicken kottu. The kottu was good but the beef was too good. In our 10 days stay we only tried beef here and it was worth trying. The served a mango-honey chanti with both items. I loved the chatni. We also tried their home made ginger beer which was too good & mango juice which was below average. The mango wasn't that sweet.
The staffs were supper friendly.

Food is served in earthen ware in a clean and neat manner. Majority of the fate is vegetarian with 2-3 dishes to serve the seafood lovers. The home made ginger beer is a great cooler and the staff is friendly. Perfect casual dining spot in midst of a busy shopping street in Galle. Sweet and authentic Sri Lankan vibe!

We had a meal here and the food and service was superb - the buffet looked great but we decided to go for the seafood platter which comes with prawns, cuttlefish, lobster and so much more, and it was amazing! Our waiter Ifu also brought us a small taster of one of the curries from the buffet just so we could try it - thank you Ifu for your wonderful service!

Couldn’t think of a better place to eat a traditional Sri Lankan buffet than here. The staff were so kind and helpful. I would most definitely go back. That tuna curry was phenomenal! Great value for money.

The place is a pretty lowdown place which has that local ambience. The owner is pretty friendly and really helpful when it comes to figuring out the menu. The food on offer is pretty cheap for the area the restaurant is.

We had a ton of dishes there from bread kothu to curry and chicken.  The curry and chicken was pretty delicious and Dal was the highlight of the dish.

The oldest café in Galle Fort, this is a gem of a place tucked away into a lane, close to the city’s complex. Mixed with old charm curios and a blend of touristy vibes, it gives a cosy and homely feeling, with tasty, hearty meals. Breakfast options were exceptional. Be sure to check their bicycles for hire, and tours on offer.

This little gem was started in 1932 for the locals to eat- breakfast, lunch, dinner, tea, snacks & still continues to cater to mostly locals. During my 5 days  visit to Galle I've eaten here almost everyday- breakfast, lunch, & afternoon tea. The food is delicious & authentic  local food.  If you are willing to ignore the looks from the outside & go in to eat some home cooked food you'll love it. You will see a lot of locals eating here. Food is served on a clay plate 😄 eat with your hands so lick your fingers.. it's finger licking good. Most breakfast and lunch dishes are cooked & ready to be served. I don't think you can customise the spice levels.. another good thing for local immersion experience 😁

Amazing ambience, good food and a must visit in Fort.
This is not my first time here. The ambience and decor has always been great and upgraded every time I come here. The place is special because this is the oldest tea room in the fort and is currently run by the owner/founder's 3rd generation. The shops deco is vintage with historical memorabilia of galle and Volkswagen (because it's the owners favourite brand)
The food has always tasted good and as i remember it throughout the years. The portions are big but the pocket stays the same size, because the food does not cost much. They have a buch fo short eats, meals and beverage options.
They even have the classic Highland "kal kiri" glass bottle milk and multiple flavoured ice packets.
since most people walk inside the galle parking won't be a concern but there is indeed parking near the place.

We totally loved this small restaurant / Tea Rooms. 💙 This place is the oldest in Galle Fort and founded in 1932. The second generation is running the restaurant. Here you'll find local food and different coffees and teas. They also offer pastries and delicious lunch. We dined at this place for several times and we always asked the owner what to eat today. 😊 We had the chance to experience new culinaristic journey to food culture of Sri Lanka! The price range is moderate/cheap. At this small and lovely place the locals and tourists enjoy themselves. It has lovely "rustic" decoration, heartful owner-family and specially good food! 😋
In addition you can rent bikes and book a guide for a tour at the fort. 🚲👌

The kitchen, Galle fort. A really nice restaurant in Galle area. Food quality is really good. The fresh juice also was really good. Srilankan food we tried here was really tasty. The restaurant is little expensive but it's worth the quality. Service also at the restaurant is good.

One of those places where you can have a good cup of coffee. Nicely done. The Lavazza variety they use has more robust hence tad bit bitter. A different variety with more Arabica would have given a better taste. But overall I love the place and can recommend to anyone.
Very nice restaurant, enjoyed our meal there. Great place to watch the world go by. Service was so, so
Great food, good variety, excellent atmosphere. Portions may seem smaller. Has a good assortment of alcoholic beverages
Nice cocktails (happy hour) but very very very slow service - waited 15 minutes for one order and that was after a remind. Not worth the discount.

Cute little traditional Lankan home offering home made ice creams served in their courtyard.  Menu is simple but with ample variety. I ordered a hot fudge ice cream with a scoop of dark chocolate and vanilla though i replaced the latter with cinnamon flavour. The portion was huge and the ice cream felt soft and creamy without any commercial made additives. Cost me 1300 LKR and truly worth the treat in the searing Galle heat.

We asked Google Gemini and it advised us to try the ice cream at this place. We were not disappointed with the taste at all. It was excellent. Thank you ☺️

I'm not a good enough photographer for ice cream, sorry 😞

We couldn't get enough of this place!! During our month-long stay in the area, we found ourselves making the trek to Galle every weekend to get more of the most delicious ice cream we've ever had. The owners would laugh and warmly welcome us back each time (even when it was our second visit of the day). The homemade quality and lovely staff made it a great experience every time. The wide variety of vegan flavors was greatly appreciated and every one was amazing. If forced to pick a favorite, the rich dark chocolate served as affogato with an espresso shot would have to be it!
If you're in town, stop by! I bet you'll be back
Family owned place with home made ice cream. Coffees and milkshake were especially good too. If your are in Galle, this place is worth the visit.

One of our go-to spots whenever we’re in Galle. We honestly never miss this place without having ice cream.

The handmade ice cream is genuinely good. You can taste the difference compared to mass-produced stuff. The flavors we tried were fresh, rich, and well-balanced, not overly sweet.

The place itself is welcoming, and the people are super friendly and easy to talk to, which makes the whole experience better. Service is quick, and they’re always happy to explain flavors or recommend something new.

If you’re visiting Galle and want proper, authentic ice cream, this place is a must-stop. Simple, consistent, and worth coming back to every time.

formatted_address: Shop # U-12, Old Dutch Hospita, Hospital St, Galle 80000, Sri Lanka
name: A Minute by Tuk Tuk Restaurant

reviews.text:
Minute by Tuc Tuc – Galle’s Polished Pit Stop

Walked into Minute by Tuc Tuc because it looked like the kind of place that sells you “local flavor” with a Wi-Fi password and a splash of aioli. You know the type — walls painted just right, menu written in a font someone workshopped for three weeks.

I got a wrap. Some fusion thing. Western enough to make a tourist feel brave, Eastern enough to keep the Instagram caption authentic. It was good — really — but good in that safe, engineered-for-air-conditioning kind of way. A little crispy, a little spicy, no real commitment either way.

This place isn’t trying to blow your mind. It’s trying to give you a decent bite before you wander off to buy overpriced linen shirts or take selfies by the lighthouse. And that’s fine. Not every meal has to be a story. Sometimes it’s just fuel, dressed up in a paper wrap.

It’s a decent stop. Not a destination. Don’t expect soul. But if you need a break, and you’re okay paying a little extra for comfort disguised as culture — Minute by Tuc Tuc will do just fine.

Overall, I had a good experience at this restaurant. The atmosphere is rustic and casual, with a relaxed, informal, and natural vibe. It's an ideal spot for a meal, offering a clear view of the Galle sea.

For food, the prawn curry with roast paan was a definite highlight—an absolute win! However, the seafood fried rice was only average. The mocktail was also average and could have had a more elevated flavor. There service is efficient and supportive.

This place has a great vibe with beautiful ocean views. They also serve beer and other liquors, and card payments are accepted. The staff are friendly, and a designated smoking area is available.

The food was tasty and the portion sizes were generous. However, the menu books are quite old and damaged from frequent use, so it would be better to replace or renew them.

My partner (also Sri Lankan) said this was the best crab curry she has ever had…thats a ringing endorsement! Barely allowed me to try some 🤨🤣
Friendly service and uninterrupted views of the sea made this a very pleasant experience

Food was good. But didn’t like the beef submarine. They had a nice dish including bread it was amazing. Specially the curry we got for that dish. Also pasta is also nice. Ambience is also beautiful for both day and night. 💯
But the Service was a little late for us than the foreigners I felt. But it was a good restaurant overall

I am a recent customer who visited this Perera & Sons outlet. As always, the food quality was good and consistent with other outlets.
However, the customer service was extremely disappointing. Even when the outlet was not crowded, the staff were often on their phones or joking around with their manager while customers were waiting to be served. I noticed this behavior multiple times during my visit.
Unfortunately, the manager also seemed to be part of the situation rather than addressing it. The staff working at the front counter spoke very casually and unprofessionally, showing little respect toward customers.
This outlet seriously needs attention from higher management to improve its service standards. Until there is a clear improvement in professionalism and customer care, I would not recommend this outlet to others for a pleasant service experience.

I recently visited Perera and Sons, and I must say – it’s one of the most convenient and well-organized food spots around! From the moment you walk in, the environment is clean, calm, and well-maintained. There are plenty of tables available for dine-in, so you never feel cramped even during busy hours. If you’re looking for a place to sit, relax, and enjoy a good meal, this is the spot! 🎉👌✨️

They have air-conditioned dining areas which make it a super comfortable place, especially during hot days. There’s also a wash area available, which is very useful if you’re dining in or just want to freshen up. Everything is thoughtfully set up for customer convenience.

Now coming to the food – the variety is impressive. From buns, pastries, hot short eats, and all your favorite bakery items, to proper meals like fried rice and other rice-based dishes, they’ve got you fully covered. If you’re craving something sweet, there’s a great selection of cakes and desserts too. On top of that, they offer a wide range of beverages – hot and cold – so whether you’re in the mood for a coffee, a fresh juice, or a quick bottle of water, it’s all right there.✨️👌🎉

Pricing is very reasonable, especially considering the quality, variety, and the comfortable dine-in facilities. It’s the kind of place that works well whether you’re grabbing a quick bite, taking your lunch break, or even picking up food for home.🎉👌✨️

All in all, Perera and Sons continues to be a trusted name when it comes to consistent quality, good food, and a pleasant dining environment. Highly recommended if you're looking for both variety and comfort under one roof! 👌✨️🎉

The place is very convenient. Plenty of seating available and even though busy you can easily and conveniently have your lunch here. They have soup, fried rice and lump rice options available for lunch and short eats are also available. Overall a great experience

There’s service is really good and staff is very friendly. Foods are very delicious.

formatted_address: No.70A Galle - Colombo Rd, Galle 80000, Sri Lanka
name: Pizza Hut

reviews.text: They were friendly, prepared the order quickly, and the pizzas were really delicious. We ordered five different pizzas, and all of them were tasty.

Delicious food and great service!
I had a fantastic experience at Pizza Hut Galle. The pizzas were fresh, hot, and packed with flavor — exactly what you'd hope for. The staff was friendly and efficient, and the atmosphere was clean and comfortable. We didn’t have to wait long, and everything was well-organized. Highly recommend if you're in Galle and craving some good pizza!

Horrendous cashier who focused on the cricket match behind me, while I was making my order, kept not getting what I said and I had to keep repeating it, wasn't even apologetic at all. Loud music (dubstep, seriously?) kept playing in the background on loop, very annoying. Food is subpar, while the strawberry milkshake tasted so fake.

We recently visited the Pizza Hut outlet in Galle and had an overall pleasant experience. As expected from this popular chain, the service and quality remained consistent with their well-known standards. The staff handled orders efficiently, and the food was served in a timely manner.

Parking was available in the usual capacity, which is manageable but not overly spacious. We were able to find a spot without much difficulty, although it could be a challenge during peak hours or weekends.

The restaurant maintained a clean and tidy environment throughout our visit. Tables were promptly cleared and sanitized, and the dine-in area was well-organized, contributing to a comfortable dining atmosphere.

As for the food, Pizza Hut’s signature flavors and presentation were all in place. The pizzas tasted fresh and well-prepared, and the overall menu selection gave us enough options to enjoy a good meal. It’s exactly what you’d expect from the brand—no surprises, just consistent taste and satisfaction.

This outlet does well in maintaining the Pizza Hut standards in both service and food quality. While nothing stood out as extraordinary, there were no major letdowns either. If you're in the Galle area and craving familiar comfort food, this Pizza Hut is a reliable choice.
Not your typical Pizza Hut for the average American- they have a chicken tikka pizza, halal pepperoni pizza and more! Pizza tastes much more fresher than back home as well.

A chain of Restaurants in Galle district. Little Lanka is famous for Bakery products and Birthday cake etc. They have outlets near almost all important places in the city of Galle. However,  the floor and interior cleanliness must be improved. Staff should be given at least a little training regarding importance of customer care.

We had a lovely stay at Loveshack Beach Galle. The location is absolutely beautiful — right on the beach, making it perfect for anyone who loves waking up to the sound of the waves. The beach here is especially great for surfing, so it’s ideal if you’re looking to catch some waves or just enjoy the ocean views.

There’s an in-house café, The Shack Beach Cafe, which adds so much charm to the stay. The food was delicious, the music was good, and the overall vibe was super chill. The sunsets from here are just perfect.

We stayed in a first-floor room that was huge, with a lovely living area filled with books and board games — such a cozy touch. The room itself was comfortable and clean. The only downside was that the bathroom felt slightly old and could definitely use a renovation.

That said, the staff were wonderful and incredibly kind, which made the experience even better. Overall, a beautiful beachfront stay with relaxed vibes, great food, and warm hospitality. Would definitely recommend! 🌊✨

Clearly a tourist bar, but there was a wide variety of food and drink. The Sri Lankan curry was the only local dish, but it was excellent. It cost 2,300 LKR.

The bar menu was extensive but adorable, and one if the few menus to include Pimms, that I've ever seen outside the UK.

What a beautiful place literally with the waves crashing in front of you.  I was here early in the day but it feels like this would be a good place to hang out at night time also. The sushi was just ok. But the Korean sticky wings were amazing.  I recommend for the beach vibes and relax environment

Best beach bar in dewata! The staff are so welcoming and always on top of service. The drinks are well priced and the surfboards are really good quality. Went here over 10 times during my stay in Galle, so good!

Located right on Dewata beach, the Shal beach cafe has amazing food options.
Loved the wraps, hoppers, salad here.
The staff is very attentive and you will get amazing service.
You can learn surfing here and the music is awesome.

We had the best stay at hasara. Friendly staff and food was really nice. The room was very spacious and clean. Convenient location.
Good food and service. Rooms are worth the price. Meals are also very worth the price and tasty

The food was okay, but not up to the standard I expected based on previous years. The chicken fried rice, rice and curry were below expectations in terms of flavor and quality. However, the set menu and nasi goreng rice were quite good. Even though I'm giving 4 stars, I’m not fully satisfied as the overall experience didn’t match what I’ve enjoyed here in the past. Hoping to see the consistency return.

name: La Mer Beach Restaurant & Lounge Bar

reviews.text: Tasty food, amazing view. I love the fish and seafood here. Big portions, they work till late and every time I feel here very welcomed. You can sit on the beachfront or inside. A lot of promotional offers or romantic offers for couples.
Beautiful outlook, warm and friendly service and delicious food  - highly recommend.

Wow. Just wow, the experience was just amazing. To begin with, just by entering the place you know your in good hands. Everything felt professional. The food was hands down the best, especially the seafood. We were able to try a variety of their cuisines. Everything was perfect with a bit of jazz music in the background just sets the mood . Highly recommend it.
Great restaurant. Service is very good, great people and perfect location. Seafood dishes were amazing. Good bread and even pasta/pizza dishes were delicious. We came back a couple of times.

Wow .what a view ..im sure it be a super super place to be in the evening ,to have dinner with a date romantic indeed., Food also good, and friendly professional staff .., dont know the room conditions , because i was there just for lunch. ,
Really nice place .. i felt so relaxed after a tired day

Food is really good, I feel like what ever you order it won't disappoint you. Basically good place for a meal with your family. Order prep time was too long tho

Visited few times and would say the food and the service was excellent each time we visited. The fried rice and the hot butter cuttlefish were the best.

The prices were very reasonable and the portions were generous. Would recommend the seating in upperstairs as it has some views of the indian ocean and also much more calmer.

formatted_address: 29 Upper Dickson Rd, Galle 80000, Sri Lanka
name: The Lady Hill Hotel

reviews.text: We booked 3 nights at The Lady Hill Hotel and were delighted with our choice.  The hotel has great views over Galle and countryside.  The rooftop restaurant catches the breezes and has a delicious breakfast.  We also had a good light lunch and dinner during our stay.  The pool is welcome too for a relaxing dip.  There is a therapy spa though we did not use it.  The staff were wonderful.  It takes about 20 minutes to walk to Galle Fort - and a quick tuk tuk ride back up the hill!

Loved our stay here. The staff are extremely friendly and accommodating. The pool is very clean and the restaurant is amazing aswell with a great view.

The only issue we had was with the A/C leaking in the first room we got; once I raised the issue to the front desk they swiftly changed out rooms, but that room had low water pressure and the A/C swing don’t work, which wasn’t a big issue for us, which is why I gave 4 starts instead of 5. The bathrooms are quite small and the ceilings are pretty low aswell, but still clean. Other than that everything was great. Would definitely come back again.

We had a family of 5 stay for one night on return from Yala/Udawalawe park safaris. The hotel is a charming former residence built in 1790 at the top location overlooking Galle and the sea. The rooms were comfortable but compact. The restaurant at the top  floor had superb views over the city and sea. Breakfast was made to order rather than buffet. The staff were excellent, polite and responsive, especially Sanjana and Chamishka at reception, Thushara as duty manager, Enoka and Manduranga on service at the restaurant. There was a pool at the front of the property, which was clean and provided a refreshing swim for hot days.

A nice place to stay in Galle. The staff were very friendly and accomodating. Room was clean and comes with balcony where you can enjoy the city view. While the location is at the top of a hill, walking up to the hotel can be tiring. Nevertheless, a pleasant and comfortable place to stay. Btw breakfast was good at dining area located at the 4th level that provides a panoramic view.

Staying at The Lady Hill @ Galle as a first-time visitor to Sri Lanka felt like a soft landing in a new country—and honestly, it set the bar pretty high for my second stop 💛

I stayed two nights and really enjoyed the experience. All the amenities worked smoothly, which made the stay easy and stress-free. While the furniture and décor lean toward the dated side, everything is well maintained and fully functional, giving the place a slightly old-school charm rather than feeling worn out. The room was clean, comfortable, and oh… that view 😍 Waking up to it felt like a quiet little reward every morning.

The staff truly stood out—pleasant, polite, and genuinely friendly, always ready with a smile that made me feel welcome. Breakfast isn’t a buffet, but served à la carte instead, and honestly, I didn’t miss the buffet at all. The food was freshly prepared and tasted delicious, with real care put into it.

All in all, The Lady Hill @ Galle made my time in Galle feel relaxed, warm, and memorable—a lovely place to pause, breathe, and fall a little more in love with Sri Lanka ✨

formatted_address: 22 Sri Sudharmalaya Road, Galle 80000, Sri Lanka
name: Fort Dew Guest House and Restaurant

reviews.text: Very overpriced restaurant. Waited nearly an hour in an empty place for a quesadilla and a chickenbreast. And what restaurant doesn't serve any greens or salad with a main dish? The food we got served was decent but boring, making the whole experience far below expectations.
Lovely Dutch colonial guest house. Perfect for walking in the old town. Hosts very helpful. Roof top restaurant and bar excellent.
Thoroughly enjoyed our stay in this guest house. A small boutique family run place. They were so welcoming. Great location. Would stay here again.

The staff is very welcoming and has been attentive to our requests — they kindly kept our luggage until the afternoon after we missed our train.

The room is simple but spotlessly clean, with a large bed equipped with a mosquito net, some storage space for clothes, and a safe.

The traditional Sri Lankan breakfast is delicious, and it’s very convenient to enjoy it on the terrace with a view of the sea.

This guesthouse is well located within the fort, close to shops and amenities.

A beautiful old house. Though the building is very old but so well maintained that it seems a newly built house on old model. The interior is well decorated with old fashioned furniture but everything is sparkling like brand new. The entire house, rooms and bathroom are very clean. There is a beautiful decorated balcony with swing, chairs and tables, where you can sit and have a coffee with a view of the street in front. Nice restaurant on the top floor of the hotel. Breakfast is provided there. The breakfast has a fixed menu but there are various options to choose from.
If you wish to stay overnight in Galle, I would say it is better to stay inside the fort. The atmosphere of Galle Fort is completely different from any other city. But for those who prefer a very quiet and peaceful environment, the environment of the fort will not suit them and most of the hotels in the fort are in very crowded places, inside small alleys, in a slightly dark environment. Compared to that, this hotel is in a very empty environment. Big open space in front. Very close to the main gate of the fort. Street view from the balcony is nice. I liked it.

reviews.author_name: SUE HUNT Riad Lunetoile Essaouira Morocco
reviews.text: What an exquisite  'old Grande Dame' of a place... Elegant Art Deco building, beautifully restored and taken to another level 👍🏼👏🏼 Riku Kai is the restaurant of the yet-to-be opened Padmaraga Hotel in Lighthouse street in Galle. Iced Pomegranite and ginger juice was perfect, as was their Crab Bisque.. 👍🏼👏🏼 Thank you Very much and wish you well with your complete opening 🏆

Lovely place to be! We came in at the last minute to celebrate my girlfriend’s birthday, and the service was absolutely great. They even made a custom fruit platter for us, even though they were almost closing. The cocktails were very distinctive and delicious. I would definitely give it a 5/5. We will come back when the sushi chef is back in town! Much love Collin/Marvin/Chloé

This is the best place to dine in galle fort. Service is very helpful and food is very tasty.
Highly reccomend

Riku Kai offers an exceptional Japanese dining experience paired with a creative signature cocktail bar. The food is fresh & delicious, beautifully presented, and full of authentic flavors. The cocktails are expertly crafted and perfectly balanced.
Elegant ambiance, attentive service by friendlystaff, and great attention to detail make it a must-visit for anyone looking for a refined diningexperience.  Highly recommended.

Really enjoyed the food — well balanced and thoughtfully done. Service was warm and attentive without being overbearing. Set in a beautiful, special building in Galle Fort full of art and character. Will happily return.

formatted_address: 05 Church Cross St, Galle 80000, Sri Lanka
name: Flavours Restaurant

reviews.text: This seafood restaurant exceeded all expectations with its fresh, flavorful dishes and exceptional service. The seafood platzer with the lagoon crab was a highlight, perfectly prepared and rich in flavor. What truly made the experience unforgettable was Sachee, whose warm, attentive service and spot-on recommendations elevated the evening. His genuine care and expertise made this a dining experience to remember—I can’t wait to return!

We visited Flavours at the Dutch Bungalow in Galle this past September as a group of 12 friends for lunch, and we loved the experience. The restaurant has a cozy atmosphere that beautifully preserves the heritage charm of the place, making dining here feel extra special. We tried both traditional dishes and other options from the menu, all of which were perfectly cooked, with authentic flavors and thoughtful presentation. The service was quick, and the staff incredibly attentive; even the chef came out to check if we were enjoying our meal, a detail that made us feel very welcome. Definitely a must-visit spot in Galle—I highly recommend it.

Avoid at all cost! We ordered a seafood platter which was not fresh and tasteless, it was borderline not edible and we left much of the food untouched ( see photo) We gave constructive feedback but they were not interested at all. Very disappointed :(

This place was a fab find. We ordered the Lagoon Crab with paratha roti, it was delicious and spicy. The chef prepared it very well and greeted us. Friendly staff and good atmosphere. Highly recommend!

Such a special spot, food was tasty, the service was above and beyond! The chef came out to greet us, showed us his recommended specials for the evening - fresh crab, which was beautifully prepared. My husband requested peanut butter - strange I know, but it’s his thing - and the chef prepared a fresh batch, even roasting his own peanuts. We loved our evening! All 16 of us!

formatted_address: NO 40/A Lighthouse St, Galle 80000, Sri Lanka
name: DJ Fort Kitchen

reviews.text:
Very disappointing and discriminatory experience

We walked into “DJ Fort Rest” while on our honeymoon, hoping to buy a few souvenirs to remember our trip to Galle Fort. As we were browsing, the salesperson stood behind us. When another foreign couple glanced into the shop, he invited them in, but they chose not to enter and walked away.

Immediately after that, the salesperson came up to us and bluntly asked whether we were actually going to buy anything — even though we had already selected two items and were about to pay. When we replied yes, he then said, “When foreigners see local people inside shops, they don’t come in.”

That comment was shocking and deeply offensive. Without hesitation, we put the items back and walked out.

It’s extremely disappointing to encounter such backward thinking, especially in a tourist area. Local customers were treated as a disadvantage, while foreigners were clearly placed on a pedestal. No business should make anyone feel unwelcome or inferior because of who they are.

We will not be returning and would not recommend this shop to anyone who values basic respect and equality.
Foods are very delicious..very friendly staff.
Looking forward to the official opening and a great experience! Mainly because the boss is great.
Nice place, good food
Good place to vist and superb service

formatted_address: 3 Church Cross St, Galle 80212, Sri Lanka
name: The Bungalow Galle Fort - Restaurant & Cocktail Bar.

reviews.text:
some feedback about our recent dining experience at your restaurant.

Firstly, the atmosphere was absolutely amazing! We started our meal with the tuna tartare and crispy calamari, both of which were outstanding. The combination of flavors in the tuna was remarkable, and the calamari was the crunchiest and most flavorful we’ve ever had. Truly impressive!

For the main course, I ordered the fish curry, and I must say, it was incredibly flavorful—one of the best I’ve ever had. The chicken dish was also soft and crispy, just excellent. We even ordered a chicken burger on the side, which did not disappoint either. Though we were quite full, we simply had to try the churros, which were delightful!

While we thoroughly enjoyed our meal, I did want to note that the service felt a bit rushed at times. We noticed that attention could be improved to make guests feel more valued. After all, as loyal customers, we appreciate that personal touch!

Thank you once again for a memorable dinner—we truly enjoyed it and will be back soon!

Bungalow restaurant in Galle Fort, which was truly delightful. The atmosphere was beautiful, contributing to an enjoyable evening. Given that the place is quite busy, it's advisable to arrive early to secure a table.

We started our meal with cocktails—Jungle Folly and Fresco, both of which were superb. For starters, we had the tuna tata and crispy calamari. The tuna was incredibly fresh with a lovely combination of flavors, while the calamari was a standout dish—unlike anything we had tried before.

As for the main course, we enjoyed the butter chicken and crispy chicken, both of which were tender and flavorful, paired nicely with salsa that added a wonderful touch.

Overall, our dinner at the Bungalow restaurant was a fantastic experience. The food and drinks were exceptional and definitely worth the money spent. However, I noticed that the staff appeared very busy managing multiple tables, which led to some delays in service. There was one gentleman, who I believe is the manager, working without an apron; improving communication with guests could enhance the experience, as we value interaction during our dining.

Despite this, everything else was perfect, and I wouldn't hesitate to recommend this restaurant to others.

I recently dined at Bucy's restaurant in Galle Fort and wanted to share my experience with you.

The atmosphere was lovely, making it a perfect setting for dinner. We started our evening with a nice white wine that complemented the food beautifully. For starters, we ordered calamari and tempura prawns, both of which were delicious. On the recommendation of our waiter, we decided to try the wonton as well, and it did not disappoint!

For our main courses, we enjoyed butter chicken and tuna steak. The butter chicken had a wonderful, authentic Indian taste that we really loved.

Overall, we had an enjoyable dining experience. The service was okay, but the quality of the food truly made it worth the money spent.

I highly recommend trying out Bucy's if you’re looking for a great place to eat!

We have been to the restaurant. In one word: immaculate. Everything (service, quality and atmosphere) was just perfect. We had a great waiter, Thushara. He topped our experience to a next level by delivering top-tier service. He showed genuine interest, knowledge of the menu and was just too kind overall. Give this man a well deserved raise! Operation went smoothly and the waiters all spoke English comprehensively. Price-quality ratio was perfect.  Although you most commonly have to wait 5-30 minutes to get in, this is a must visit and definitely worth it!

Very pleasant restaurant and a good place to escape the heat of the city. The interior is beautiful and calm, which makes it feel like a small oasis away from the busy, hot streets.

The service was professional, friendly and spoke excellent English. Everything was smooth and comfortable.

The food was very good. We especially enjoyed the steak, paneer curry and a really nice cappuccino with coconut milk.

Overall a very enjoyable experience. I would recommend visiting if you are looking for a quiet place with good food and a pleasant atmosphere.

The food here was outstanding from start to finish. Every dish was beautifully presented and full of flavor, clearly made with fresh, high-quality ingredients. The seasoning was perfectly balanced, and it was obvious that real care went into each plate. Portions were generous, and everything arrived hot and perfectly cooked.

On top of that, the service was excellent. The staff were friendly, attentive, and genuinely welcoming without being intrusive. Orders were taken promptly, and everything was delivered with a smile, which made the whole experience even more enjoyable. Overall, it was a fantastic dining experience, and I’ll definitely be coming back and recommending this place to others.

I was looking for a good place to eat, filtered restaurants by the rating and found this cute cozy place. That was a good chose! The food and drinks are delicious! Nice assistance. 5 stars! I recommend it for sure!

Calm and quiet vibe inside this well-planned and beautifully interior-decorated café. The atmosphere is very relaxing and perfect for spending peaceful time. However, there isn’t much variety in the main course options for lunch. The cheesecake was absolutely delicious and definitely a highlight of the visit.

An absolute gem in Galle fort. Super friendly and kind staff, affordable prices, delicious food. We enjoyed our time there. Each dish we ordered felt like a warm welcome and my photos will show you why  🫶

I don’t know how this cafe got high reviews. Unfortunately, our food was so terrible that we couldn’t eat even half of portions. We ordered pancakes that were too chewy and hard, soaked in chocolate sauce. Avocado toast - bread wasn’t toasted and had some kind of carrot salad on top under avocado. It made it really soggy. Eggs looked like they were fried on refried oil. Kids couldn’t eat their food. Chef special waffle pizza was soggy with chicken that tasted like it was off. Wrap was crumbed and deep fried, a really strange choice. Coffee was ok. Staff were really nice and friendly but the food we paid 12,000 LKR for wasn’t worth it at all. We had stomach aches for the rest of the day

formatted_address: Galle Dutch Fort, Galle 80000, Sri Lanka
name: AR H

formatted_address: 01 A Church Cross St, Galle 80000, Sri Lanka
name: The Arch Restaurant - Galle Fort

reviews.text:
We ordered several appetizers and main courses. For the main dish, we had the red snapper, and everything was absolutely delicious. The food was fresh and very well prepared. For dessert, we had the crème brûlée-  it was incredibly tasty, delicate, and perfectly balanced.

We especially want to highlight the staff- they were very friendly, attentive, and happy to explain and recommend dishes. Great experience overall!

I booked about 4 weeks in advance and wanted to change the time. I was told it was fully booked but when I arrived it wasn't.

I was going to be given a table at the back but the manager let me chose where I wanted to sit,  thank you

I like when menus are cute as it means the quality of the food can be focused on.

Really nice black prawn curry with bread followed by the best creme brulee!

Thank you for making my first New Year's Eve in Sri Lanka 🇱🇰

They even invited me to their staff meal to try some foods woth them.

Very nice place and would highly recommend 👌🏾

Had an excellent meal here. Airy quiet space on a quieter street inside the UNESCO Heritage site of Galle Fort. Started with excellent crisp calamari in a picante sauce then whole grilledfish of the day, which happened to be mullet and finished with a creamy crème brulée. Service attentive but not intrusive. Highly recommended.

Lovely restaurant with very friendly staff. We had prawns and octopus for a starter and shared a fish for our main, all delicious. We had a bottle of white wine which was also lovely. The staff gave us a large bottle of water and a Crème Brûlée on the house which was very kind and delicious.
The only down side was we were sitting outside near the road and it smelt a bit drainy, but it's hot and we're in Sri Lanka!

We stumbled upon this restaurant and then realized it was one we had put on our saved list. The service was very friendly and the food was very good. I had the octopus which although a starter was sufficient and my boyfriend had the MF chicken. Boneless with crispy skin and sizzling. The white wine was not good so we stuck to the refreshing beer.they also have good cocktails. I would just recommend the owner to take out 1-2 tables inside and put in some plants instead to improve the sterile atmosphere. We sat on the terrace as this was lovely

formatted_address: No 36 Y.M.B.A.Building Lighthouse street fort, Galle 80000, Sri Lanka
name: Fort Rotti Restaurant

reviews.text: Stopped here for a quick lunch and the Kottu in particular was great. We like food spicy and it had a perfect level of heat. The owner was very friendly, and the prices were also very reasonable. Very large portion sizes too! We shared 4 dishes between 5.

We wanted to eat a good rotti tonight at a decent price. It was a bit hard to find through the different address of Galle Fort but we finally found out Fort Rotti. A good surprise ! The rottis were really good, and people there were really kind. They really deserve a 5 star mark !
Excellent dining. EVERYTHING IS DELICIOUS AND PERFECT. I highly recommend dining in Fort Rotti to everybody. The food, ambience and service staff were all amazing and accommodating...😊

great place. food is very tasty and very reasonably priced with large portions. the dry fish curry is excellent, very tasty. the staff are friendly and very helpful. Bobbie the owner greets everyone as his best friend and can help with your travel plans. Iwill be back.

Food is ok, not a large menu but good quality. In my 2 experiences there, only problem was the long time takes for prepare your order. So l cancel my dessert and payed bill after more than half hour waiting with only 2 tables to serve
Great food, upscale, good attention from Irishon our waiter , Highly recommend . Good selection.

Great local Sri Lankan food spot in Galle Fort!
While exploring Galle, we were craving authentic local food and stumbled upon Amma Nissa – highly recommend if you're in the area!

What we tried:
Beef samosa → Excellent starter, really tasty.
Beef curry → Good flavour, but the meat was a bit tough (could have simmered a little longer).
Kiri coss → Very delicious!
Fried chicken → Tasty seasoning, but unfortunately a bit dry.
Tamarind & chilli prawn red curry → Outstanding – spice level was perfect, really enjoyed it.

The food overall captures true Sri Lankan flavours and is worth trying.

Pro tip: Eat upstairs! It's air-conditioned and the ambience is much nicer than downstairs.
If you're in Galle and want proper local eats, definitely check it out. 🌶️🍛

It was my first time trying polos lumprais, and I had such a great experience! The food was delicious and beautifully served on a banana leaf, which made it feel very authentic. The flavors were rich and comforting – a really memorable local dish to try.

Shashina was incredibly nice and welcoming. She made sure everything was perfect and explained the dish patiently since it was my first time. Her kindness really made the experience special.

Highly recommend this place if you want to try authentic Sri Lankan food with warm hospitality!

Amma Nissa in Galle Fort is one of those places that doesn’t just serve Sri Lankan food, it gives you the full experience of it.

The restaurant is set inside a stunning old house in the fort, and everything about it feels intentional. The space is simple, raw, and full of character, which matches the food perfectly.

We ordered - the polos cutlets, chicken kidu shooru, watalappam. I’m still dreaming about how yum everything was.

The Polos Cutlets were crisp on the outside, soft inside, and packed with warm, earthy jackfruit flavour.

The Kidu Shooru was the highlight, fragrant ghee rice with slow-cooked chicken, red dal, eggplant curry, and a sweet Malay pickle, beautifully served in a coconut leaf basket.

And the Watalappam was unreal, rich, coconutty, caramel-like sweetness with gentle spice.

If you want something beyond the typical tourist spots, go here. This is the kind of food that connects you to the culture.

Amma Nissa is a lovely place to experience authentic Sri Lankan cuisine. The food is full of traditional flavors and beautifully presented, making each dish a pleasure to try. The service is excellent - very polite, attentive, and welcoming. The cozy, charming interior adds to the atmosphere. A great spot in Galle if you are looking for a genuine local dining experience.

The moor mutton biryani was incredibly flavorful and fresh, and the mozzarella roti was so crispy and soft at the same time. I just loved it, and the staff was so friendly they let us borrow a phone charger to charge our phones. Just a really nice experience, especially to top it all off, was the consistent jazz music that was humming and establishing just a very great calming vibe throughout the night.

Loved this place. We reserved to make sure we got a table. Rasam to start - got us ready! Then a mango salad to share - the mango was not too sweet, just right. Then for mains: I had coconut roti and dhal, my partner had devilled seafood with rice. Both were spiced just right for us, we do like spicy food.

The service was with a big smile. I would highly recommend this place for lunch or dinner. Good value and authentic Sri Lankan food.

I forgot to take a photo until I was half way through my main!

Food was amazing! Super authentic, delicious, not too spicy (because I asked for less spicy). Slightly longer wait because it can take time to make the dishes but more than happy to wait as it was worth it! Highly recommend !

WOW! Don’t miss this place if you’re in Galle Fort! We had one of the best fish curries of our trip, served with roti, and also tried the seafood fried rice. Everything was absolutely amazing. The flavors are incredibly authentic.

Tip: sit outside if possible, as it gets very hot inside.

Thank you so much 😊

The Wambatu Moju (eggplant pickle) served with rice was amazing. So good I had to come back to eat here again. Today I had the prawn salad Thank you for a fresh and delicious food. We also had the Rasam which is a broth with spices, lime, mint and curry leaves) - so nourishing and cleansing. Thank you Imal for great food and service.

Wow! We’re so happy we came here, it was absolutely delicious. We had the fish curry, the chicken curry, and the Kottu. All were amazing. The fish curry was the best I’ve ever eaten. Staff were lovely, food took a little bit of time but they were full and it’s all made totally fresh. Would highly recommend!

We had dinner yesterday this place and it was a superb delicious 😋 dishes of mutton with smash potatoes and garlic rice. The presentation was fantastic too. The cocktail 🍹 was also perfect and it gives a different vibe for candlelight dinner. The service is also highly recommended and you must enjoy their meals with a fantastic musical vibe. Highly recommended this place…

The best food you will ever eat!
We had the seafood croquettes and deep fried squid for starters. For mains we had chicken biriyani and a beef curry thali.
The food was all exceptional and the staff were extremely friendly and welcoming. The restaurant was also modern and very clean.

The mango juice and mango lassi were also a bit hit.
I would definitely recommend eating at 1710 if you’re visiting Galle.

Unfortunately not the best experience and I'll make the review as constructive as possible as the waiters were super nice and the space itself is absolutely amazing.

We ordered Signature Curry which is actually one of the worst I've tried in Sri Lanka. Absolutely no magic. Water with curry powder and 4 small pieces of chicken. Also ordered the octopus which the waiter told us is the most famous dish and it came completely burnt and badly cooked (you can see on the photographs).

But what really disappointed me the most was the fact that when we still had more then 1/3 of the bottle of wine the waiter came and wanted to take the ice bucket to another table. I said no, we still have wine and we are still half way eating our food. He went away not vonvinced of my answer. 2 minutes later another waiter comes, fills our glasses to the top to end the bottle of wine and rakes the bucket. You don't do this when serving a 40€ plus bottle of wine here or anywhere else jn the world. It is very hot and the wine easily heats on the glass in a matter of few minutes.

So overall we were in love with the space and the waiters were nice but everything else is a no return. More, the day before we had dinner at The Bungalow a restaurant 2 minutes walking away and everything was superb. This places is miles away from  that unfortunately.

Improving makes part of life and I hope this place does because the space and environment of the restaurant are beautiful.

I truly believe that everyone giving this place 5 starts have not been before to the Bungalow restaurant next door. It is impossible

We had a truly exceptional experience at The Merchant, Galle Fort. From the moment we arrived, the warm hospitality and welcoming atmosphere set the tone for our stay. The food was outstanding beautifully presented, full of flavor, and clearly crafted with great care.

The staff were consistently attentive, courteous, and professional, making us feel genuinely valued as guests. A special commendation goes to Manager Samith, whose support and attention to detail during our dining experience were remarkable. His dedication ensured that everything ran smoothly and that we were well taken care of throughout our visit.

The combination of excellent cuisine, thoughtful service, and the charming ambiance of the property made our stay truly memorable. We would highly recommend The Merchant to anyone visiting Galle Fort and look forward to returning.

An outstanding eating experience with beautifully prepared and elegantly presented dishes. Every plate is visually impressive. The staff are highly professional, attentive, and genuinely kind. The restaurant offers a calm, refined atmosphere, providing a peaceful escape from the busy streets of Galle and a perfect setting to enjoy high-quality food!
Very nice local foods, cheap and friendly. A little hot if you want AC style to avoid the hit, this is not for you.
It is a local canteen, don t expect luxury enviroment or big choice but you can taste local flavors. many local peoples are here for breakfast and lunch, afternoon close
This has closed unfortunately :(  no sign of it, and a shop owner said the canteen had closed.
That's were the Sri Lankan go. Really good Hoppers!
The right place to taste the local breakfast
Eggs with salad took around an hour to prepare. Not the place if you value your time. Quality is mediocre - avocado with black spots

I’m upset to see so many negative reviews for this place. So far I’ve been there twice and will go again. The food and drinks are delicious and the service is on a high level.

Since other reviewers mentioned the delivery time, I’ll say that everything came super fast. Maybe it’s because of the fact that not that many tourists are in the town. Or they did improve based on the previous negative feedback.

Separate thing to mention: they have good WiFi and a generator so it’s been my savior place during the power outages (I work online so it’s quite critical for me).

Hope the place will gradually improve their Google rating. I sincerely wish them this😉
The interior had a comfortable aura and the food was amazing. I even had a mango smoothie take out and it was delicious.
I like it for breakfast/brunch and service very friendly.

This was the most disapointing restaurant I have been to. The portion size were big enough for a doll's house. Absolutely disgraceful! I would not recommen this restaurant to nobody. We have eatern in many Sri Lankan resturants which we would recommend and go back. This resturant which is situated in the Galle fort will rip you off with thier food and tiniest portion sizes. You will be left starving and disapointed after leaving this so called restaurant.

We ate at the restaurant here, they charge high prices but the food is extremely low quality, I could barely get through it. I ordered a chili fish and chips and it was so saucy that my stomach felt really weird afterwards. It also came with chips that looked like scraps. They were extremely thin and tiny.
We also ordered a club sandwich which claimed to have bacon but had cheap chicken ham and was completely dry. The fish with sweet and sour sauce was no better. All of the food was LKR  2000+. Nothing tasted fresh. It tasted old and frozen. Would not reccomend going here.
They also charge LKR 500+ for a mini sprite.
They didnt really react at all when we told them the food was bad.
the prices are high and the quality and quantity is disastrous. Asked if I can have a slice of bread for my soup, that was not included in the price. The photo is the original portion for 1100 LKR

Tasty, great value food in a relaxed setting.
We had a crispy tofu salad and a chicken kottu and both were generous portions.
Nice sri lankan food and nice people.

Tofu bowl was beyond dry. Kottu was good. “Home made” fries for a starter was served with a tiny amount of dipping. After three weeks in Sri Lanka we were charged service fee for the first time. It was not informed verbally nor on the menu before ordering. Experience was definitely not worth the price

Went here with a group for lunch and while some of the food was good, the service was very slow. It took about 30+ minutes for the first round of drinks and about 45 minutes for the next. If you are time poor on a day tour of Galle, be prepared for your lunch to take about 1.5 hours.

The hot buttered cuttle fish was really great and the island fries were a nice side. My partners gnocchi was overcooked so we would not recommend that dish. Our friends thought the tacos and mezzo dips platter was good. Note that the food comes out at different times so if you want it all at once you might need to ask.

They play music which is nice as a lot of restaurants don’t seem to do that and it’s in a funky spot with heritage elements.

They also let us split the bill by what we ordered which is key when you’re in a group. Note there’s no alcohol offered here.

A last minute walk in but very worth while.

Upon arrival, the waiters advised they do not serve alcohol at the restaurant which wasn’t a problem (it’s better they mention it before being seated and it being an issue)!

The service was really good with no waiting around.

The wait time for the food was ideal between courses and the food itself was great.

Highly recommend!
I wish I could give this zero stars. This was the most disgusting and tasteless pizza I’ve ever eaten. Everything about it was awful, from the sauce to the toppings. Complete waste of money.

We recently dined at Sugar Bistro, and I have to say the food was fantastic. The flavors were vibrant, and every dish was thoughtfully prepared with fresh ingredients. We got the Crab Kottu, Batticaloa Prawn Curry and the Bistro Club and all the meals were super delicious and well presented 😍
If you're in Galle Fort, it's definitely worth a visit for a satisfying meal! ❤️

Very cute cafe/restaurant with great food and really good coffee. Brunch in the patio is just lovely. To highlight my favourite dish:
Ox Benedict -this is beyond delicious and is everything you need to go through the day.
Special thanks to Danuka for making the experience even better.
Will definitely come back when in Galle next time!

A small place within the fort. It is family run and the food is just delicious. It might be a bit hard to find, but it is worth it. We went for dinner and took the chicken curry - it tasted amazing. Especially the Sri Lankan spicy version of it. Do yourself a favor and visit this restaurant.
Absolutely lovely little place where you get a proper local meal. Great for vegetarians as there are still 7 or so dishes to enjoy that come as a set together with delicious lime juice.

If you’re looking for a cute little spot for a delicious dinner, you found your place. Apart from the endlessly friendly owners who cook and serve personally for you, you will enjoy the most delicious curry with a variety of add ons. Go there and enjoy a local experience, trust me. And thank me later! Greetings from germany, we will definitely come back.
Very good food, affordable, very sweet people. You can go here instead of some unnecessarily expensive restaurants near by. 1000-2000 LKR per person will fill you up.

This place was honestly amazing! Felt like a proper family home cooked meal, cooked fresh on order and full of flavour and love!
Couldn’t recommend highly enough

The place looks good and was not crowded when I visited. Menu is limited, but has a concept and there were some options. The prices are reasonable matching the portions. We ordered roti and veg curry. The rotis were chewy and rather under cooked. Had to ask the the chef to reheat the rotis and that made them crispy but eatable.
