The place is clean and the location is good. Just for the food the rating would have been just two stars. I gave a three for the decent location, little friendly service place ambience.

Fantastic quality food, one of the best tasting curries we had in Sri Lanka. However the service is slow as there is only one waiter doing his best, but running around trying to keep everyone happy. If they employed one more person to serve then the experience would be better. Having said that, would 100% go back.
Great value for money. Choice of curry, type of rotti and an accompaniment. They served cold beer and cider too.

Yummy and reasonably priced food!

I have to disagree with some of the negative reviews here as the food was delicious, the portion sizes were more than reasonable and the food was not overpriced. The bowl the curry comes in may be small but it goes a long way. I had the Kottu with vegetable curry and it was beautiful (and only 450 LKR). My family ordered some different dishes that they were equally as pleased with.

You must eat here if you’re in Galle Fort - it’s one of the better places I’ve tried so far.

Got here really excited to eat some local food at 7pm as they close at 8.30pm only to find they had close to no food at all. We only ate here because of the veg curry (my mother is a vegetarian and has struggled a lot in Sri Lanka) I order the beef curry as our server said it was worth it.  What a lie, thick refined white flower parathas with some rubber beef curry. Perhaps we caught them on an off day but I would not recommend it.

Absolutely loved Isle of Gelato!
A perfect stop when you’re walking around Galle Fort. The gelato is smooth, rich, and clearly made with quality ingredients, not overly sweet, just really well balanced.

The upstairs seating is a big plus. It’s calm, comfortable, and a nice place to sit down and enjoy your dessert away from the crowds. Great spot to cool off after walking around in the heat.

Friendly staff, quick service, and a clean, well-kept space. Good variety of flavors, and you can tell a lot of care goes into what they serve. Whether you’re a gelato lover or just craving something refreshing, this place is definitely worth a visit. Highly recommended 👍

If you visit Galle Fort, make sure to stop by Isle of Gelato. It is one of the best places to enjoy gelato and definitely worth a visit. The gelato is really good and the service is friendly and welcoming.

They also serve coffee, which is a nice option if you want to relax for a bit. There is a wide range of flavors to choose from, making it a perfect spot to cool down while exploring Galle Fort.

The flavors are inventive. The shop has a bright, cozy vibe and friendly staff who make you feel welcome. Prices are a bit on the higher side, but the quality and taste easily make it worth it. A must-visit for dessert and coffee lovers!

I visited the Kandy branch previously and didn’t know there was another branch in Galle Fort! Oh man, this place never fails it always delivers top tier quality ice cream. I absolutely love it. The portions and prices are great, and overall it’s easily a 10/10. The stores are aesthetically pleasing with beautiful interior design.

Good view at outdoor seats upstairs. Not worth for money if you're not a huge fan of ice creams cause one scoop has a lot of ice cream.
Need to do some maintenance at the outside of upstairs. AC water leaking out on to the customer directly as the seats were positioned.
Anyway a good place. 8/10

This restaurant was disappointing on so many fronts but judging by the reviews it obviously has a clientele base
The interior is soulless notwithstanding its sombre tones.The table layout is like a school canteen with minuscule tables not practical if you plan a mezze.
Yes the hummus and aubergine were OK but this is standard fare for a restaurant advertising Middle Eastern cuisine.
We had a prawn dish - when the prawns are fresh the shell is easy to peel and not the case here  - they were without flavour.It did not help that the salad was limpid and not freshly prepared.Prawns salad and rice are par for the course in Sri Lanka and this was hardly a standout dish
We were provided with miniscule one ply paper napkins not ideal for this type of food.To cap it off the toilet roll was empty with no additional supply and the  same napkins were provided to dry hands and just disintegrated in your hands hardly hygienic
The service was haphazard with no one appearing in a managerial type role

An amazing meal!! Easily in our top 3 meals had after 20 days in Sri Lanka. We were three people sharing a mezze platter and a kebab platter (half) and it was perfect if you don’t want to get too stuffed. Everything was delicious and the service was perfect. GO HERE!

After two weeks of some amazing Sri Lankan food, it was honestly so nice to have a bit of a change. Chambers was exactly what we were looking for. The baba ganoush and tagines were beautiful, and the staff couldn't have been nicer. It’s really well priced for the area, too. Definitely worth a look if you're nearby, especially if you’re vegan.

Delicious dinner. We mixed it up from our usual Sri Lankan dinners and tried something different. The seafood platter was great but the standout were the mezzes, especially the potatoes and various dips and sides. Staff were polite and helpful with how much to order for 2 people.

We wanted something different for dinner after weeks of kottu and roti.

Chambers hit the spot with a falafel wrap, baba ganoush and fresh breads. All delicious.

No alcohol served here so pick your favourite juice.

Recommended.

formatted_address: fort, 56 Lighthouse St, Galle 80000, Sri Lanka
name: 56 by Deco

reviews.text:
STAY AWAY FROM THIS HOTEL...
... unless you want to sleep in a moldy room (it was actually hard to breathe after a few hours) with bug infestation (the insects were likely of the mold-eating kind, so at least no direct harm from them). We were asked to pay for the room already upon check-in, in hindsight we know why. And of course there was no (partial) refund - we could have asked for a chemical spray after all, that would have solved the problem immediately!
The really good reviews mostly seem to be from a few years ago, when this place actually lived up to its 3-star hotel reputation. The more recent reviews seem to reflect the current state a bit better...

Two stars for the good location (right in the middle of Fort Galle), the nice shower (this was actually very clean and had the best water pressure we have had so far in Sri Lanka) and the friendly staff, who also reacted very kindly when told about the insects (although I do have some questions about the hotel management, which - based on our conversation with the staff - obviously knows about this mold/bug situation... So, for 50-70$ you get the lovely choice between breathing in spores and/or chemicals for the night.
Based on our experience (we hope other travellers have a different one), one either pays at least 150$ per night to stay in a decent hotel in Fort Galle, or one only comes for a day trip. Very different value for money here compared to other places in this country!

Pay attention!!! The photos they show online are only for the private rooms, but you actually book a bunk bed in a mixed dormitory (4 beds crammed in 10 sqm). They probably do that intentionally because on the phone the writing is small but the photo of the double bed is bigger, but you actually book a a bunk bed in a dormitory. When you ask them if you can upgrade to private room, they say everything is booked, so you are just trapped because the booking is non refundable.

I stayed in a dorm room and while the bed was comfortable there was a constant smell of mildew! It was very damp and nearly made it hard to breathe!
When I asked if there were any lockers or keys to the room the man simply said no and left…
The room is accessible from the street which ment I had to take all of my valuables with me everywhere I went which included a laptop as I work and travel…this made it kind of unpleasant to travel around Galle Fort…
And working in my room was impossible as the WiFi did not reach it… but there are a hundred cute cafes in Galle so that was theleast of my issues…
The location is great but otherwise I would not recommend
From arrival, it felt like home. calming atmosphere, and kind staff made the stay very special. Truly memorable ❤️

56 by Deco is a lovely spot with a warm, cozy interior and stylish vibes. The service is outstanding — friendly, attentive, and professional. Everything from the ambience to the cleanliness is top-notch. A perfect place to relax and enjoy quality time. Highly recommended!

Some cafés are for caffeine.
Some are for atmosphere.
This one is for both.

I came here twice for breakfast — which is usually the best sign.

Granola with fruit both mornings, and thoroughly enjoyed it. Fresh, simple, well-balanced, not trying too hard. The kind of breakfast that feels light but satisfying.

Coffee? Very good. My usual Americano with coconut milk was smooth and well-rounded. On the first visit, I tried their cardamom Americano — surprisingly lovely, if you’re a fan of subtle spice. Not overpowering, just enough warmth to make it interesting.

But the real highlight is the setting.

A rustic courtyard with a fish pond quietly anchoring the space. Soft light filtering in. A mix of retro-style posters and gallery elements toward the front. It feels like England wandered into Sri Lanka and decided to loosen its collar. Relaxed, creative, unpretentious.

It’s one of those places where you order breakfast and somehow stay longer than planned. The music hums gently in the background. People come and go. You sit, observe, and feel slightly like a columnist in an old newspaper café — present, but not rushed.

Pleasant staff, easy atmosphere, good coffee.

The kind of place you return to without overthinking it.

And I did.

Not much choices for breakfast. We were mostly attracted by the array of postcards at the entrance and the nice ambiance.

Avocado Toast with eggs (Sourdough / Avocado/ Cherry tomato / Coriander / Passion fruit / Your choice of egg) was good but nothing special. Same goes for the Matcha latte.

It was buzzing with people. I would go again to buy a postcard might not be for the food.

Amazing coffee brunch spot in Galle!
Delicious coffee and freshly made juices, and the bruschetta was absolutely outstanding – full of flavor and perfectly prepared. The place has a unique, cozy and very atmospheric vibe that makes you want to stay longer. A truly special spot that you must visit when you’re in Galle. Highly recommended! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

The best breakfast we’ve had so far in Sri Lanka. Coffee was superb. We had avocado toast and French toast and they were incredible. Staff are super friendly. Facilities are kept up and clean. Amazing place.

Absolutely incredible brunch spot inside the Galle Fort. It was a peaceful outdoor ambience with kind service and fresh food. We enjoyed some locally brewed coffee, avocado, toast, and French toast. Could not recommend this place enough!

formatted_address: Leyn Baan, Cross Street, Galle 80000, Sri Lanka
name: The Pasta Factory

reviews.text:
We came to Galle a year ago and absolutely loved this restaurant. Now we’re back in town for two days and made sure to return for both lunch and dinner.
The food quality is outstanding. The ingredients are excellent, and everything we ordered was delicious. You can really taste the care in each dish.
The service was just as impressive. We were served by a guy named Nipuna, who truly knows how to provide great service, friendly, attentive, and with a great sense of humor.
It honestly felt like dining at a restaurant in Italy. Such a fantastic place, highly recommended! We would definitely come back without hesitation.

Full 5 star experience. Great atmosphere, really nice staff and the best is yet to come!

We loved to food! I love puttanesca pasta and it was superb here. Starter salad was so fresh and tasty too. Kids loved their pastas as well.

Don’t forget to BYOB! They hadn’t the licenses to sell any alcohol but you can bring your own if you want to.

Food and drinks are delicious. But for the spaghetti they didn’t have the handmade spaghetti so we had the gluten free option. The handmade option would have been nicer.
The atmosphere is so nice and the staff is friendly. I think the options we selected are not the most delicious I will try few more dishes here and see. The experience was pleasant and had a nice lunch.

Unbelievable pasta. Best Italian meal I’ve had in a while! Bruschetta also really good. I’m allergic to dairy and they accommodated me really well, I had the puttanesca. You can also bring your own bottle of wine!

Delicious homemade tagliatelle with authentic carbonara sauce. So many choices of sauces and pasta. Most of them so tasty. Avoid the GF pasta and the zonzana (sausage one) not very flavoursome  or fresh. Great little restaurant - a real Italian feel - music as well.

formatted_address: No:67 Pedlar St, Galle 80000, Sri Lanka
name: TrEATS @ FORT GALLE

reviews.text: Tried Sri Lanka breakfast with string hoppers and fish/chicken carry. It was the first time we tried string hoppers and that was an awesome experience. Coffee is of light taste, more looked like a tea but it is nice for us to be not strong. Additionally we were served a rotti and a plate of fruits that was a surprise for us.

Went here looking for some lunch nice and quaint place, staff were friendly however once I'd ordered the chicken biryani, it took over 45mins for the food to arrive (despite me being the only customer there) and then when it turned up the chicken was completely raw on the inside, thankfully I'd cut into it rather than gone straight in for a bite. To wait that long to get chicken that hadn't even been cooked.

The sauce and rice were nice but tough to look past raw chicken

i give this place 10/10. Here you are welcomed and served with love and care! Lovely chef will advise you on the menu which is btw very affordable. Juice and main course was 2300 and very very tasty. If u r tired of overpriced food in the area, this is a hidden gem of galle fort! Best wishes to the business

I had the best experience at Treats. The owner / chef is the nicest person I have met. The food was perfect and he went out of his way to make a sorbet for my girlfriend as they did not have it on the menu. It was perfect. Also, the music and atmosphere was amazing. Thanks for an awesome dinner 🍽
It served raw fish and the owner ridiculously argued that it was like sashimi. Don't eat here.

Super coffee and hot chocolate brownie in the courtyard of this newly opened boutique hotel just off Pedlar St in the centre of Galle fort.  Best coffee I have had in the fort and one of the best hot brownies I have eaten anywhere.
Thank you Sumith and your team for the excellent service you gave me.

A very nice place with delicious food..
love the vibe. A best place to have a coffee. Love it❤️

A perfect chill spot in galle fort ,very calm and relaxing place ,the food and drinks are very good ,in the heart of galle fort ,the service was top its was the perfect way for our galle holiday .highly recommended 👍
Thank you very much for an exceptional mango smoothie and coffee! Beautiful setting
The place is really nice and food is very delicious. Best place in the Galle fort with really nice atmosphere

name: Double Happy Chinese restaurant (双喜中餐厅）

reviews.text: Just made a reservation with a short hair Sri Lankan guy. He was very smiley. Found the table reserved when arrived. The food was amazing. I really enjoyed all the dishes I ordered. From the prawn dumpling soup, fried cabbage, the garlic boiled greens, eggplant dish. It is a must-visit place if you like Chinese, crave Chinese when visiting Galle in Sri Lanka.

We ordered some dumplings Andrew beef noodles which came with some egg drop soup!
The dumplings were fine but relatively bland and the egg drop soup was okay but the beef noodles were truly disappointing!
There was no taste other than oil!
Really disappointing after the great reviews of „authentic food“ after having lived in china I would say that is not the truth…
The man working there was very nice though

Come in for a quick lunch. And was pleasantly surprised with the food and service. Will definitely pop in again when I’m in Galle! Keep up the great work! (Sorry didn’t take too many photos . Was too hungry)

Highly recommend Double Happy Chinese Restaurant! We enjoyed delicious Chinese dishes that were served within seconds of ordering. 🤤

The staff were incredibly helpful and lovely, ❤️and the calm atmosphere with soft background music made the experience even better. A perfect spot for a tasty and relaxing meal!🥰

Delicious and authentic. After travelling around the UAE, Oman and Maldives, we were craving East Asian food. From several attempts to try it in these places, we found that each one was lacking. Yet, arriving to Galle, Sri Lanka, our fears were allayed and our cravings satisfied as we found some home comforts here. We ordered the morning glory, wonton soup, pork noodle soup and spicy beef noodle soup. The food tastes like how it should and how we remember it. Deeply impressive. The only letdown was the ginger iced tea which tasted predominantly of water with a hint of ginger. Nevertheless, let the drinks not overshadow the excellent food.

Service-wise, it’s as expected with them being prompt in taking your order and the food being cooked quickly.

The restaurant itself is well-decorated with  cute illustrations on the wall and a picture wall of the restaurant’s dishes, staff and past customers. It enhances the homely sense of place that exists here.

Today we found a great restaurant in Galle Fort!!!
After our sightseeing we drank a cup of coffee and a Mangolassi with a very tasty chocolate brownie and decided to come here for our Dinner again.
It was the best decision to come here again!!!
We ate the Tuna steak and king prawns,which were brought from the market the same day in the morning and it was so fine, tasty and deliceous🤤!!!!
The ambiente is very very cool and elegant and the personal is very attented, helpful, professional and want's to make you happy!
It's highly recommended !!
Keep it up👍

Thank you very much for a great dinner!
Ronnie & Sabine

Was not expecting that this place would be so good from the outside. Just a nice VOC Dutch East India fun restaurant... But the food was OUTSTANDING!!! best food in all of Galle we had! So tasty and best fries! Best curries, the rotti soft and tasty! We came back a couple of times it was so good!
We had a quick lunch today - Nasi Goreng. Really good as well as the Lassi and Soda & Lime drink. Service was also top. With the next door Archive restaurant this is becoming our frequent spot.

Tried VOC for a change on Pedlar's Street. Nice ambience, very much the same old architecture. Food was delicious, service not so much (not the most attentive or helpful but responsive once you get their attention). Perhaps more suited for the foreign patrons.

Overall good food if a little pricey but common given Galle Fort rates.

We had and dinner at this place. Place is lovly, spacious. Menu has a lot of options to choose from, the see food, clasic european things like burgers, pizzas and pastas. We had an wok and fish and chips. Food was okay, beutiful, fresh, but nothing special. Service was fast and polite. Would recomend this place.

Some dinners are planned. Some are discovered.
This one was a very happy discovery.

I stumbled across 39 Bistro at The Fort Printers and was immediately drawn in by the atmosphere — elegant, softly lit, refined without being stiff. It feels upmarket in the right way. The kind of place where you expect five-star service and polished cuisine.

And it delivered.

I arrived early for dinner, with only a couple of tables occupied. Within a short time, the restaurant filled up — always a reassuring sign.

As a solo traveller, I was looked after beautifully. The staff were attentive, warm, and discreetly professional. Service felt natural, not forced.

I ordered the Sri Lankan-style lobster curry and a glass of wine. The curry was excellent — balanced, flavourful, elevated without losing its authenticity. A dish that feels thoughtful rather than heavy-handed.

The evening was made even more pleasant by a spontaneous conversation with the couple at the table next to me — one of those small travel moments you don’t plan but remember.

I didn’t stay for dessert, but I left feeling very satisfied.

If you’re looking for refined cuisine, attentive service, and a more sophisticated dining atmosphere in Galle Fort, 39 Bistro is a strong choice.

I would absolutely return.
Great service, shady and cool on the front verandah.

A wonderful architecture and interior design little butik hotel inside the Dutch Fort. We enjoyed it very much and the location is great with small restaurants, cafes, shops and historical buildings around the corner. The room was really nice an spacious , one thing though- it has no windows ( locked window shutters)  since the building is one stored and faces the little street outside. There are a few rooms facing the tranquil area with the pool with windows.

Even though we couldn’t get a room last minute (fully booked), we still had one of the best evenings in Galle here.

We walked in spontaneously for drinks + dinner and everything was absolutely excellent — beautifully presented, full of flavor + clearly made with care. The interior is a dream for design lovers: thoughtful, stylish + done with real attention to detail.

Most importantly: the hospitality. Pasan and the team (including the manager on duty) were genuinely kind, welcoming + solution-oriented. They even stayed in touch with us afterwards to see if any last-minute availability might open up — sadly it didn’t work out this time, but the way they handled it was first-class.

Thank you for such a lovely experience. Next time we’re in Galle, this is at the top of our list — and hopefully we’ll finally get to stay.

Just spent 4 luxurious days at Fort Printers and wish we could have stayed longer. The fit out is exquisite, comfy bed, food was so yummy and cocktails even better. Delicious coffee too (this is high praise coming from 2 Melburnians). Staff were so helpful and accommodating. They thought of everything and made sure we were very well looked after. Great spot in the center of the fort, easy to walk everywhere. Can’t wait to return!

Staff were nice but a lot standing around. The place is very old with a lot of history. We stayed in the highest ranked room and it didn’t have a toilet roll holder. Just used rolls from others checked out sitting behind the toilet. Very average. No coffee in room. While a nice old hotel it wasn’t my cup of tea. 2 pool lounges only. Sat by the pool for 2 hours and staff never asked if we wanted a drink. Breakfast was nice. Had to ask twice for pool towels while there were 6 staff loitering.

We stayed at Fort Printers Hotel in Galle for one night and absolutely loved it. The staff were incredibly friendly, the food was excellent, and the interior design is stunning.

During my stay, I unfortunately had a small accident, and the team immediately stepped in to help. They arranged transportation to the hospital, made all the necessary phone calls, and even accompanied me to make sure everything went smoothly. Their care and attention went far beyond what you normally expect from a hotel.

I deeply appreciate their efforts, and if you’re looking for a beautiful boutique hotel with exceptional service in Galle, this is the place to be.

A quiet oasis with seaview! Pearl Nest is located in prime location in one of the few peaceful streets in Galle Fort  a mere 100 m from the Ocean. I stayed in the single room that has a balcony and a seaview and loved every minute. There are plenty of nice areas to relax or work and balconies on both sides of the building. It's very clean and the host is attentative, warm and helpful. Highly recommended.

Beautiful place, very clean, and equipped with everything you might need! The host is extremely kind and helpful. I was traveling alone, and whenever I ordered a tuk-tuk or cab, he would step out with me so I felt safe knowing someone was there. I truly felt taken care of. Highly recommended!

A delightful place to stay in Galle Fort, located in a quiet street, but central to everything. Wifi, A/C, clean room, great airy verandahs to relax on. Views also from the hotel. The owner is extremely helpful and knowledgeable. 💯 percent recommend to stay here.
Great location,owner is very care taking and honest,clean room,humble people
Perfect place to stay in Galle! I’ll be back soon ❤️

formatted_address: No:52 Pedlar St, Galle 80000, Sri Lanka
name: The Ivy by Frangipani

reviews.text:
We had pizza and French fries from your restaurant and honestly, we loved it! 🍕 The pizza was fresh, cheesy, and full of flavor, and the fries came out hot and perfectly crispy — we couldn’t stop eating them.
The customer service made it even better. The staff were so friendly and welcoming, and they really made us feel comfortable.
It was truly worth it, and we’ll definitely be coming back again 😊

We visited again and this time we ordered takeaway, but we stayed and enjoyed the atmosphere while they prepared our pizza 🍕
It was such a nice experience — there was a solo singer performing, and we got to relax, listen to the music, and enjoy the lovely vibe while waiting. The place felt warm and welcoming, just like before.
The pizza and fries were just as delicious — fresh, flavorful, and totally worth it. Even a simple takeaway felt special because of the great food, friendly service, and beautiful ambiance 😊

I had a really great time there ❤️ I was traveling solo and stopped by to have a drink. Atmosphere and food are amazing. I had a coffee and shehan made an amazing lattee for me. Service is top notch. I went on weekend so there was live music. Chill vibe and i really enjoyed. Recommend 100% if you walk around galle fort sri lanka 🤍🩵 Good job guys ❤️

The food was really nice, both the black pepper crab and the tuna steak. I would highly recommend eating here as it did not disappoint. They had live music and sports on the TV, which created a nice atmosphere. The service was really slow though and some tables/chairs are just blocks of cement, which makes them uncomfortable to sit on for a long time. The beer on tap was unavailable or nonexistent, which was against how they were advertising themselves, but they served canned beer nonetheless.

Had a great time 2 nights in a row here after our dinner! Brilliant live music, great atmosphere and very friendly and prompt staff. Would highly recommend to anyone looking for an easy place for a drink. Haven’t had the food but have seen others eat and looks good! Particular shout out to Minal (might have got the spelling wrong) who sang both nights we were there; lovely voice, incredibly friendly (we enjoyed a drink with him after his set) and very patient with drunk song requests!

The food was nice but it only contained about half the ingredients listed and the tacos were tiny (€2 /each single taco we expected a bit more)
It just had meat, cabbage and chipotle sauce.
There was no pomegranate/pineapple salsa, avocado cream or even tomato salsa. There was also no beef or chicken tacos at all.
Portions were really small and massively over priced.
Great tacos at a reasonable price. Good portion size.

Very poor service at 12:10 there were only 3 tables occupied, we ordered a salad with shrimps and waited for a drama of 30 minutes.  I will add that no one served us, in other words, they didn't even approach us with the menu. I had to get in and order the dish myself.  The best thing is that after 30 minutes I went to the staff and asked about my order, it turned out that no one even started doing it, what a scandal.  I am embarrassed by the behavior and customer service.  I wasted over 1 hour sitting and waiting and looking at nothing.  Overall, a place without charisma, no music, silence, sad.

I had a great experience at this restaurant. The food was fantastic& incredible
the service was also excellent.
They have a free co-working space also.
“This restaurant is a must-go for anyone visiting the area., The outstanding performance from Mr Asanka who was trying to build “world best Sri Lankan coffee brand .
Thanks for your honesty again!
I will be back”🙏

Eat here for breakfast after collection our laundry. Lovely coffee.. I got banana pancakes which were lovely
My husband got the sri lankan breakfast which tasted amazing just too much for me in the morning. Service was lovely
Excellent place to relax in Galle. Highly recommend for genuine coffee lovers.

We ordered traditional curries (Jan 5th, 2024). Spicy fish and Dahl. They made to order from scratch, so it does take a little longer…I would only expect this. Anyone complaining about this needs to stick to chain restaurants in their home country. Most happily, the prices were not crazy. We only spent two days in Galle and Unawatuna and were exhausted by the overpriced structure of everything…beers as expensive as our home in Rome. Seafood more expensive… Anyway. Great food here at a reasonable price. Sweet staff. Hard working chef (and owner? I think so). Best wishes to Brio.

The worse restaurant in planet earth. If i could give it negative stars, i would in a heart beat. Service was  slow and dragging. Menu photos are extremely bad representation of the actual dish. We know it may not be the same exact thing as the pictures, but in reality it was not even a fraction of the picture. The large prawns were cooked to oblivion. The calamari was not properly. Everything was covered in sweet chili sauce. The wait for the food was extremely long for what it is. The best part if the meal was the fresh king coconut water, which was overpriced. Will never ever come back again. Definitely recommend walking the other way if you come across this place.

Worst restaurant experience in Sri Lanka. Food took forever to come and people left the restaurant since their order never came. Seafood platter was drenched in sweet chili sauce and the dry chunk of tuna was barely eatable. Pasta carbonara contained unannounced mushrooms (which meant one of the kids would not eat) and was cold upon serving. Terrible disappointment and pricey too.

The worst place in Galle. These guys are liars. They have in the menu “tiger prawns”, however it is just the ordinary ones. They are aware about it, but no regret, no excuses to us... please, do not make an error like we, just go to another place.
We didn’t get what we ordered, instead of red tuna we got regular white soft tuna steak, instead of tiger prawns regular size prawns. Don’t recommend this place =|

Love this coffee cafe!☕️Huge shoutout to Brother Deneth for the BEST customer service and brewing up the most epic coffees☺️
Highly recommended this spot!!

Denith was such an amazing host and barista. We loved his enthusiasm- not only about coffee but also, photography and life! He prides himself on his coffee art and does a fantastic job. Well worth a visit if you love your coffee!

A cozy little café inside Galle Fort with really good coffee and a relaxed vibe. The staff are friendly, the brews are smooth, and it’s a great place to take a break while exploring the fort. Definitely worth a stop for coffee lovers!
Love the Brew bar! Very good coffee!
Best coffee in town can’t wait to try again when I’m back in galle

The Barista at Galle Fort was like a dream. The atmosphere was very calm and cozy. It was like an old post office renovated into a barista outlet. The drinks and food were amazing as always and the service was also perfect. The only issue was the space.

Great coffee and food, but limited space! > The food is high quality and the coffee is excellent. It’s a very calm and chill place. However, there is no parking here; you have to park on the street in Galle Fort. If you have a large group (15-20 people) or need easy parking, I recommend their other location near the Navy Camp. Outside smoking area available.

Barista at Galle Fort was superb as always. You get to enjoy their signature beverages and sweet treats in a lovely atmosphere, right in the heart of the Fort’s iconic streets. The vibe was just as great as any other outlet, and the staff provided excellent service too.

Had a coffee in Barista in an evening. The location is beautiful and made with many antique looking furniture. Looks so historical. This shares the location with the next door restaurant. Coffee was average. Pay and order service is practiced but I had to remind the staff once to get my coffee after ordering it.

Easily the best value coffee in Galle Fort. Found the flat white here stronger and better than others I had tried, but not quite perfect...
The Turkish simits were great, this quickly became my go to for breakfast. Lots of indoor seats but the outside colonade patio area gets busy, but its a perfect spot for spending some time.
Definitely my winner for affordable and quality coffee inside the fort.

formatted_address: no 62, 2 Pedlar St, Galle 80000, Sri Lanka
name: Hideout Juice Bar

reviews.text: Lovely spot for a fresh juice! Takeaway or sit in, the owner is super friendly
Brilliant family restaurant/cafe. Best value in fort galle, for food and drinks!
Hidden little juice spot with very fresh juices!

Great find. Delicious fish curry with three veggie side dishes, coconut sambal and a poppadom for r1500 - decent for Galle Fort - washed down with a fresh pineapple juice. Set inside what looks like a clothes shop. Lovely owners.
Just had delicious rice and curries here with fresh juices, all served with such warmth and smiles by the owners.
Cool spot hidden in the shop. Only had cold drinks, which were great. Lemon iced tea and mango lassi in the photo!

We stopped here for some iced coffees & a snack. The bruschetta was so fresh & tasty, the coffees were perfect & the owners were so friendly and lovely!
A perfect stop for a break between wandering the walls & shopping!
The chocolate & walnut tart was incredible too!

A nice, unexpected find. Enter from Stick No Bills poster shop, the cafe is located at the back of the store. Bright, airy outdoor space with friendly staff, ice cold drinks, free wifi and clean toilet… what else do you need!

I had their iced tea (LKR 700) which is the perfect light drink you need on a melting hot day. It is sweetened with honey and there are slices of lime which added to the freshness.

A nice rest stop after exploring Galle fort.
What a wonderful little find. Honestly, absolutely delicious and fresh food. The man running it is so helpful and kind. If I was staying in Galle, I’d be there every day!

Beautiful hidden gem in the middle of the Fort, serving very tasty Italian food and great coffee
To get there walk through the shop Stick no Bills (also a good place to shop some cool posters and postcards)

formatted_address: no 47, 1 Pedlar St, Galle 80000, Sri Lanka
name: ArtNEST Gallery Cafe & Stay - Galle Fort

reviews.text:
This place was perfect for visiting Galle. Sandeepa was so helpful and friendly, the location was perfect, the rooms are lovely with everything you need for a comfortable stay. The rooms are behind Sandeepa's fabulous art gallery, a great place to pick up a souvenir and absolutely worth a browse even if you don't stay in the rooms.
As an added bonus, there's an excellent ice cream shop directly opposite too!

So much heart to this amazing place. It’s in the heart of the city, the wonderful Sandeepa puts his heart into making this place a beautiful welcoming home and the staff are beyond kind and caring - nothing is too much for them.

The welcome we received topped even our incredible host the day before! From showing where to park our Tuk Tuk, to inviting us on a free architecture tour of the fort, Sandeepa and his team were simply wonderful. We loved the artistic setting and learnt so much about the city and its history.

The location is perfect and you cannot get any more central, yet our stay was cosy and quiet from the upstairs cafe and accommodation. We enjoyed being able to return and chill on the balcony and even have a go at creating some art of our own in our spare time. Thank you for everything Sandeepa and your team - we look forward to our next visit!

Artnest was a unique and enjoyable stay in the beautiful Fort area. It was very well located.
The room was small but fine for us. The amenities were well thought out for the space.
Everything was clean and the linen smelled fresh. His team were lovely and made us a beautiful fresh mango juice when we arrived.
Sandeep was great to communicate with before our stay and during. His artworks created a beautiful atmosphere to stay amongst. We recommend staying here.

ArtNEST is one of those rare places that feels truly special. It’s not just a hotel, it’s an art exhibition you get to live in. The room was bright and comfortable, with a great bed and good aircon, but the artwork is what really makes the experience unique. Pieces by Sandeepa are everywhere, from local scenes to re-imagined historical moments and works inspired by his travels through Sri Lanka and Nepal and many other countries.

The location is superb, right on Peddlers Street, yet the atmosphere inside is calm, quiet and welcoming. Sandeepa himself is a true gentleman, kind, helpful, and passionate about his craft. His hospitality adds so much to the experience.

He also took us on a guided tour of the fort town, seeing the architecture and learning of the history through his eyes was an amazing experience.

If you want a stay with personality, creativity, and genuine warmth, ArtNEST is the perfect choice.

Comfy stay insight a beautiful gallery! Sandeepa is very welcoming and gave us a tour around Galle, highlighting its history from an architects point of view. The whole gallery team supported us throughout the stay with information and umbrellas ;)
Perfect location to explore the Fort and come home to relax and read at the cafe during the hot afternoon hours.
Watching the sunset and coming home after exploring Galle and walk past the art is a truly special feeling!
We also stayed at the new Gallery Stay in Colombo (Luna Mews) afterwards, which was a perfect end for our vacation.

This is a wonderful place where the artist has created an amazing space for us to browse his body of work, which actually moved me emotionally because the paintings are so glorious. So creative, the artist has expressed a deep knowledge of Galle colonial history to produce this wonderfully imaginative exhibition. So beautiful. Some great books here to purchase too. You can also sit and relax with a mango smoothie, even stay in the accommodation here. What a fabulous place 🥰😍🥰😍
Very cute cafe with gorgeous artwork & a nice view. Definitely come here if you have kids, or love to draw! Super friendly service & partners with a charity for children with Downs Syndrome.

A perfect blend of art and coffee, this cozy gallery-café offers a warm, inspiring atmosphere. Beautiful local artworks line the walls, and the coffee is rich and flavorful. It’s an ideal spot to relax, reflect, and enjoy creative energy. Highly recommended!

Great low key spot for a toasted sandwich. Highly recommend the egg version. Simple and satisfying. And the location - on a balcony overlooking the main street of historical Galle fort - makes it a perfect choice place to recharge.

A hidden gem in Galle must visit                                 I recently discovered Rams Cafe on Pedlar Street just a short stroll from Galle Fort, and it's quickly become my new favorite café! The warm, inviting atmosphere,combining cozy indoor seating with a charming garden corner makes it the perfect spot to unwind.

formatted_address: Sri Sudharmalaya Street 3A, Galle 80002, Sri Lanka
name: Prince of Galle

reviews.text: The hotel is rustic and authentic. It is no generic international standard hotel by any stretch but it is classy, arty and boutique. In a quiet backstreet but an easy walk anywhere around the fort.  Breakfast is delicious and very good but can become a bit repetitive if staying more than a day so a couple of other options to select would be good. Service is very good and friendly from staff.

This is a beautiful colonial style hotel on a quiet side street within the fort itself. We were lucky enough to stay in the Kings Residence on the top floor. The style of the property is Sri Lankan colonial but with western comforts like air conditioning. The top floor suite includes an open plan sitting area with chairs and access to a small terrace to view the sunset.
The staff are so welcoming and pandered to our every need. The breakfast justifies its billing as superb and is a lovely combination of Sri Lankan flavours served in a western style.

Recently visited here and absolutely loved every minute of my stay. From the moment I arrived, the hotel felt special, a perfect blend of historic charm and refined modern luxury, set in a truly serene atmosphere. The rooms were exceptionally comfortable, immaculately maintained, and offered breathtaking views that made the morning memorable. What truly stood out, however, was the staff. They were warm, attentive, and sincerely welcoming, making me feel valued throughout my stay. Every detail felt thoughtfully curated, from the ambience to the service. Prince of Galle is an ideal retreat for anyone seeking relaxation, elegance, and an unforgettable experience in Galle. I would highly recommend it and would return without hesitation.

We had the best stay at Prince of Galle. Such a lovely location, with beautiful interior design and thoughtful attention to detail. A real highlight for us was the friendly and genuinely caring service from Rukman, Kapila, and Sarengh, who made sure we were well looked after throughout our stay. The breakfast was also fantastic. Truly a little gem in Galle, we would definitely come back. Thank you to the whole team for making our stay so special.

Don’t think twice about staying here, Prince of Galle is a real gem. Effortlessly stylish with classic colonial charm, perfectly located inside Galle Fort with everything within easy walking distance. The staff are exceptional and genuinely go above and beyond. Rooms are small but beautifully done and completely in keeping with the building’s character. The iced tea really is the best, and breakfast is on another level. Highly recommended.

The name only partly gives it away, but yes the dumplings are divine. Think of ordering a mixed plate - two each of beef, prawn, chicken and vegetable. Succulent fried (boiled also an option) dumplings of perfect texture, well stuffed and accompanied by a chili dip. Yet the menu goes well beyond dumplings to noodle and rice dishes, clay pot and siu mai and baozi snacks. Excellent choice of cold brew and hot coffee and a lesser known cafe and shop above the main space, a cool garden zen zone set back from Church Street at the heart of Galle Fort. Sanju is a highly professional, smiling presence with excellent English, front of house to advise on the extensive menu and ensure a joyful experience. Yes!

Quality of the food has gone down to me compared to last time I visited close to year ago. Drinks are not worthy at all and not even tasty. We ordered some passion fruit drink, chocolate drink and ice tea. Ice tea was good .. rest was not tasty as all. Spring rolls were good crispy and tasty. Dumplings are avarage. Mango rice used to be very tasty here.. this time it wasn't unfortunately.

Great experience at This Cute Caffe The food was fresh
especially the claypot rice noodle which were absolutely amazing. Perfectly cooked with delicious fillings, they really stole the show.

The atmosphere was cozy and welcoming, making it a great spot to relax and enjoy a meal. I also tried the their special drinks wich was Yellow and green and it was a refreshing surprise and a perfect pairing with the food.

Service was friendly and kindfull they are the best.

A cute cafe with quite a few option.

They had vibrant drinks.
Matcha late was good
Ye’p (Chinese tea, passion fruit, local honey,king coconut water) more watery
Pol (coconut Milk, espresso, sugar syrup, coconut flakes) looks good I couldn’t try
Yellow and Green (mango, fresh milk, coconut milk, matcha)looks good couldn’t try

Had the option to get boiled or fried dumplings in beef/chicken/prawn/veg. Had beef/prawns and the fried is ofcourse tastier than the boiled.
Prawn wontons was also nice.
Siu Mai beef had more rice filling and was dry.
Bao buns prawns was tastier than the chicken.

Hot and sour chicken soup noodles (minced chicken, Chinese pickles, peanuts, cabbage, sweet potatoes noodles) it was a glass noodle bit hard to eat but otherwise tasty and spicy
Congee chicken (Mushrooms / green vegetables / carrot/Chinese pickles / chicken / peanut butter) not my favorite dish to eat but was ok.

Been here twice this week itself, being a vegetarian not used to having different oils I was worried that I may not be able to enjoy their dishes, but they use neutral (avacado) oil in their dishes making even their claypot rice noodles absolutely delicious! Their dumplings are so well made and the passionfruit pulp served on the side is an absolute delight!
Their spring rolls are also amazing. Our favourite part of this place was their steaming burn you if your not careful food served with a warm smile!
🍜
They also have chilled zero coke served a health ydash of lime that perfectly pairs with their food!
The servic where is so warm and comfortable you'd want to bring your friends and try their food again and again!
This is a small shop in fort. But it has evening you need at the fort.Specialty they have sigarats around 10PM. Dont get Juices from there.not worth it. But evening else is ok
Today I had a papaya juice It was 150LKR and it was just water and sugar. Waste of your money so dont try fresh juice from here.
Good Place

formatted_address: Ground Floor, 58 Church St, Galle 80000, Sri Lanka
name: Eats & Treats

reviews.text: Cinnamon Coffee & Yummy Coconut Cake. First time I have heard and tasted the Cinnamon Coffee.. Its very good along with the coconut cake.

formatted_address: 10 Leyn Baan St, Galle 80000, Sri Lanka
name: Kaffi Galle Fort

reviews.text:
Beautiful café in the heart of Galle Fort. The atmosphere is calm and stylish, with a lovely courtyard that makes it a perfect place to slow down for a bit. The coffee was excellent - smooth, well balanced, and clearly made with care.

A great spot to escape the heat, enjoy a really good coffee, and take in the relaxed vibe of Galle Fort. Definitely one of the nicest cafés in the area!

What a great place! We were looking for some cakes and something nice for an afternoon snack when we found this spot by chance. After being disappointed by several other places, this one completely turned things around for us.
The service was good, the place was clean, and the coffee was excellent. I honestly loved it and would come back without hesitation. The apple crumble was delicious, and the tea had an amazing fragrant flavor.

Really cute cafe, absolutely love the design. The garden area is soo pretty. Coffee is good too and they also have almond milk available. We stayed a few hours with the laptop and the team was friendly. WiFi is good (around 30/35mbps) upload a bit slower but it’s okay. You can pay by card and there are few sockets available.

A wonderful coffee shop with a warm and relaxing ambiance. The staff are friendly, attentive, and make you feel welcome from the moment you walk in. The food and drinks are excellent—fresh, well-prepared, and full of flavor. It’s a perfect place to unwind, catch up with friends, or enjoy a peaceful cup of coffee. Highly recommended!

There is something deeply satisfying about finding a place that opens at 8am — especially after a sunrise walk around Galle Fort with coffee very much on the mind.

KĀFFI was open. Welcoming. And quietly confident.

The space feels curated without trying too hard — weathered doors, soft light, a serene courtyard framed by old walls and greenery. It’s the kind of place where you instinctively slow down.

I ordered a long black with warm coconut milk on the side (my small Asian ritual). Before adding the milk, the coffee stood confidently on its own: medium roast, low acidity, beautifully rounded and smooth. Balanced without being sharp.

Then came the coconut milk — and yes, it softened it into something even more indulgent.

The ceramic cups deserve a mention: textured, weighty, stamped with their name. The kind of cup that makes you pause before your first sip.

A very pleasant surprise: mineral water served in a glass bottle. Proper mineral water, not distilled, not plastic. Small details, but they matter.

Breakfast was homemade granola with fruit and Greek yogurt, served in a wooden bowl — simple, fresh, thoughtfully presented.

There’s also a small shop attached (closed at 8am when I visited), showcasing local crafts. I couldn’t resist and picked up a little handmade soap upcycled from coffee grounds — a lovely, sustainable touch that ties beautifully into the whole concept.

Now, one thing to note: the courtyard is stunning… and the mosquitoes know it. If you plan to sit outside, bring repellent or come prepared. I wasn’t fully equipped and became slightly too popular. It didn’t spoil the experience — just a practical tip.

Minor housekeeping detail: the toilets could have used a quick tidy before opening (bin was overflowing). Easily fixable.

Overall? A gem. Excellent coffee, strong design aesthetic, thoughtful sustainability touches, and a calm atmosphere.

Would I return? Absolutely! …with a mosquito spray.

formatted_address: 26G9+VF7, Leyn Baan St, Galle 80000, Sri Lanka
name: New Riyadh Cafe

formatted_address: 33 Leyn Baan St, Galle 80000, Sri Lanka
name: Island Tea Co.& Ceylon Coffee Club - Galle fort

reviews.text: Excellent bubble tea and outstanding customer services! I appreciate you being in our area!🥤🍫🍮🩵

A lovely coffee shop with a warm and relaxing atmosphere. The coffee is rich, smooth, and clearly made with quality beans. Their tea selection is equally impressive, offering well-brewed, aromatic options that are perfect for any time of day. The food menu complements the drinks beautifully — fresh, flavorful, and well presented. From light snacks to satisfying meals, everything tastes thoughtfully prepared. Friendly staff and prompt service make the experience even better. A great place to unwind, catch up with friends, or simply enjoy a quiet cup of coffee or tea.

really craved bubble tea, chose this place, didn’t regret it! loved my Apple tea with tapioca very much. often fruit teas are weak and chemical but this one was strong and natural

the guy over the counter was super nice and friendly! recommended some options, gave me some tea samples to smell
Chai bubble tea was amazing!! 100% recommend here if your craving some and a quiet place to rest

Perfect hospitality & service from the staff… appreciated all time.
Great coffee blends in Sri Lanka..

After walking along the galle fort under the burning sun, we found this shop and entered to have an awesome atmosphere with refreshing beverages. All were tasty and large in portion. Ample amount were served. Very friendly staff.
A calm place to get refreshed after a long tour around Galle Fort. Beverages are available at affordable price range. Appertizers were also available.
Great coffee (lattes and mocha) at decent prices with friendly staff. Excellent place to sit outside and people watch.
A Coffee shop near Triton di Slvar Bastion, Coffee and Beverage are also good.  Air-conditioner shop also.
Delicious coffee & right by the fort walls - very picturesque!

100% fantastic point for coffee drinkers and others.
The barista are amazing, coffee strong, aromatic, tasty.
Great atmosphere.
Highly recommend.
Stopped for coffee at this cozy little spot.Also the adorable coffee art made our drinks unforgettable, and the cappuccino I had tasted amazing!!! 🤍
In the heart ❤️ of Galle Fort 🏰, this new coffee house feels like a gentle pause in time ⏳ – serving brews ☕ that awaken the senses ✨ and an atmosphere 🌿 that soothes the soul 🤍

Eesha and Wageesha are the sweetest, and the tea slaps.  Fresh, delicious, and super cute.  Stop here!

I prefer tea with less sugar, and they squeeze fresh like into the iced tea.  So it's just a fresh, herbal, and delicious tea.  They also have tons of other drinks, alcohol, and the street it's on is very quiet and cute.  Prices are also good.
I stopped by this coffee shop and tried the mocha it was amazing. Probably the best I’ve had. Definitely worth a visit ☕️😍

I recently visited Coco and Dates in Galle and absolutely loved it. The place is incredibly cute and welcoming, with a beautiful atmosphere and excellent service. Their breakfast and brunch dishes are very well prepared and nicely presented.
I always ordered the Creamy Egg Sandwich because it was simply delicious — perfectly creamy and full of flavor, served with slightly spicy seasoned potatoes that made the dish even better.
Highly recommended if you're in Galle and looking for a cozy spot with great food and friendly service.

**We even asked for the potatoes to take away on the day we were leaving, because they were that good!

By chance, we met the owner, Fatima, and she truly made the experience special. She is a wonderful soul. The drinks were refreshing, but what stayed with us most was her genuine care and affection for the little kitties outside her door. That kindness made our day unforgettable. Somewhere in our photos there’s a picture of the drink—but the real memory is how full both our hearts and bellies felt. Absolutely worth a visit.

Amazing place! The fusion of Bahraini and Sri Lankan flavors are unique and delicious. You can truly feel the love and heritage behind each dish — everything is made with fresh, high-quality ingredients and thoughtful care.

The stuff and atmosphere is warm and welcoming, just like the message from the founder, Fatema Janahi. The story behind the café adds a personal touch that makes the experience even more special.

If you're in Galle Fort and looking for a cozy, meaningful dining experience with great food and heartwarming hospitality — Coco & Date is a must-visit!

A visit to Galle isn't complete without a stop at Coco and Date! Honestly, this is one of the best spots in all of Sri Lanka.

The coffee variety is impressive, ranging from classic Arabic coffee to a perfect flat white, and all are made to perfection.

Their desserts have a fantastic Arabic fusion element. But seriously, the sago is a game-changer! You must try it, as it's the ultimate refreshing treat after walking around in the Galle heat.

This place is a must go if your in Galle fort! Super cute and great food, ambience and service. Super friendly staff and we had some really good breakfast here, and they also look after the street cats outside and feed them daily. Do not miss to stop here for a drink or the granola was super tasty and the best breakfast we’ve had

The perfect Italian cafe set in Galle Fort! The food was amazing, with a good variety of beverages and the service was excellent.

The set up is very rustic, giving colonial cafe vibe.

Perfect location to grab a coffee and a bite after taking a early morning stroll around the lighthouse.

PS: We missed taking photos of our drinks as we were Damm thirsty!

Charming location overlooking the rooftops, excellent friendly service. However not much bang for your buck with food. Small portion and even though its only 1000, that goes a long way in Sri Lanka.

Coffee was excellent, eggs needed seasoning
Food was great! Quick and super tasty. Had the chicken in ciabatta and the bolognese crepe. Have never tried a bolognese crepe but will definitely be getting another! The decor is super cute also!

Great view, very cozy, tasty fresh warm croissants, pistachio ice cream. I’d only suggest to offer larger portions of drinks - just a small cup of tea is not enough to get enough water. Better to have more / stronger air fans to make atmosphere outside cooler

Nice cafe to enjoy brunch or breakfast!
I had as take away the chocolate croissant and Nutella brioche.
The brioche was average, as it was lacking chocolate , but the croissant ( it was actually chocolate swirl) was tasty!
Coffee was good.
Nice ambience.
A bit overpriced!
Good

formatted_address: 50 Leyn Baan St, Galle 80000, Sri Lanka
name: Moi Galle Fort by DBI

reviews.text:
We came here for drinks one evening & brunch the next day. The location is fantastic- in the centre of Galle & the service is even better. Our smilers were happy & so friendly. The food was fresh and gorgeous. The fresh mango juice was a highlight.
We are looking at staying here during our next visit!

We were looking for a spot for brunch in Galle Fort and came across Moi, and it turned out to be a lovely find. The atmosphere was really nice, the food was good, and the staff were friendly and welcoming. A great place to relax and enjoy a brunch while exploring Galle Fort.

A hidden gem in Galle Fort!
Moi by DBI is an absolute delight—from the moment you walk in, you’re greeted with warm hospitality and a beautifully curated space that blends modern elegance with coastal charm. The food is exceptional: fresh ingredients, bold flavors, and thoughtful presentation. Whether you’re indulging in seafood or savoring their signature dishes, every bite feels crafted with care. Service is attentive without being intrusive, and the ambiance makes it perfect for a relaxed lunch or a romantic dinner. Highly recommend to anyone visiting Galle Fort—this place truly stands out.

Our stay at Moi was simply wonderful! The staff were amazing from start to finish, always checking in and making us feel completely at ease. A big thank you to Dinesha and Niroshan for their warm hospitality – they really made us feel at home.

Special appreciation also goes to Chef Pasindu, who kindly prepared us a tasty breakfast even though we were late – such a thoughtful gesture that we truly appreciated.

Moi has such a cozy and welcoming vibe, and the team there really makes the difference. Can’t wait to come back again!

I stayed in the female dorm and there was an unbelievable amount of mold in the room. This can be normal of a tropical climate such as this, but there was fungi growing in the corners of the room (photos attached).
There is no lock for the room and no locker to put all of your belongings in, only a small one for a passport. Additionally, I had to ask for a top sheet because they did not provide one to me.
Location is good, but if you’re sensitive to mold it’s best to stay elsewhere.

formatted_address: 52 Leyn Baan St, Galle 80000, Sri Lanka
name: PUPPETS RESTAURANT & CAFE

reviews.text: This is a fabulous cafe to sit, chill, eat/drink while watching the world wander by in Galle.  Steps from the main walkways it provides a nice respite from all the other travellers. The staff are all warm, inviting and accommodating.  The service is relaxed and the food freshly prepared.  As special shoutout to the sangria as it is light and delicious.  I particularly enjoyed the long spoon to scoop-out the fresh fruit to eat as opposed to tipping the glass back and risk splashing it all over your face.  The salad was fresh and light.  The ambiance is chill with good music.  Whether you sit outside/inside the entire experience is exemplary.

I absolutely love this place for its location, it's authentic originality, and it's staff that make you feel a special guest but at home at the same time. The menu is very big, I tried a bit of everything because I came back many times, and everything is very good and healthy ! I think the quality of the food, the ingredients they put, is very high, which was rare during the rest of my trip. My heart goes for the croissants, the best I had abroad, the Thai chicken, the eggs with curd and cucumber, the kotu, the fruits.... Andddd the chocolate mousse ! You can also try the pizzas, the base is very crusty ! Thanks a lot to the friendly waiters and to the cocktail makers (if you are a cocktail fan, this is also your place ! I had the best Pina colada...!!!)

This cafe is located near the  Galle Lighthouse. The food is very good. We especially liked the tea. The menu has western as well as Sri Lankan dishes. The ambience is cozy. Overall a nice restaurant serving good food.

We had the most delicious and beautifully served meal. We had cocktails that were just perfect. We sat outside looking onto the street and we found the food, drinks and the service to be absolutely great. Cannot recommend highly enough. Biggest heartfelt thanks to the waiting staff who did an excellent job, thank you Ashen & Chads for looking after us. Would definitely return to this restaurant if visiting again.

It is nice small boutique cafe and restaurant in the Galle Fort Area. The ambience is great, food was awesome. We tried chicken nuggets, fried rice and burger. All were nice, except the sesame chicken burger, which had more chicken than we wanted and it does not really stack up as a sandwich.  Staff was nice, the interiors were nice.  Must visit, if you like western food.

formatted_address: 52 Leyn Baan St, Galle 80000, Sri Lanka
name: Le Jardin du Fort - A Romantic Hotel de Charme in Galle Fort, Sri Lanka

reviews.text: Lovely one night stay in Le Jardín du Fort. The location is absolutely incredible and the staff working here are all so lovely and welcoming. They made sure we had everything we needed and provided us with the best service. Would recommend this place to anyone. Rooms are lovely and clean with hot showers and working air con. The vibe of the place is also very nice. The breakfast was excellent.

Le Jardin du Fort is a charming and beautifully located spot in the heart of Galle Fort. The garden setting creates a peaceful, relaxed atmosphere that instantly makes you slow down and enjoy the moment.
The food is fresh, well-prepared, and thoughtfully presented, with a lovely mix of local flavors and international touches. Everything feels light, clean, and made with care. The service is friendly and attentive, adding to the overall comfort of the experience.
Whether you’re visiting for breakfast, lunch, or a quiet coffee break, Le Jardin du Fort offers a calm escape from the busy streets of the fort. A truly delightful place and highly recommended for anyone visiting Galle Fort.

A cute Hotel in the streets of Galle! Very spacious with well maintained rooms.
Nicely arranged bed with decors.
Clean towels and well hygine washrooms.
We have book deluxe room during the stay.
Inhouse restaurant serves good food.
The staff is kind and very helpful, they greet with a smile and happiness.

Highly recommend to all as this is very close to the fort and light house. Surrounded with cute resturant and cafes along.

A beautiful, small hotel in a quiet street in Galle. The room was very spacious with a well designed bathroom as well as provisions for a cup of tea in the heat of the day! A very comfortable bed, a delicious breakfast every morning, both French and Sri Lankan were excellent. Filtered water available and very little plastic used- great to see such concern for the environment. The staff were great - friendly, kind and helpful, all with a smile! We loved our stay in this quirky French haven in a very interesting area. The sunset walks on the ramparts were most enjoyable with a cool breeze at the end of quite hot days.
I will be recommending this hotel to our friends and relatives!
Thanks all for a lovely stay in Galle!

Very nice boutique hotel. We stayed in mezzanine room, it was quite interesting 😊 room was spacious, beds were comfortable.

Staff was great, very helpful. They sent very detailed email regarding room’s condition so we knew what to expect exactly.

Location was awesome you could walk to fort in less than 5 minutes!

formatted_address: 50 Leyn Baan St, Galle 80000, Sri Lanka
name: Moi Galle Fort Restaurant, Bar & Cafe.

reviews.text: We came here for breakfast and had an amazing experience. The food was wonderful, we ordered Eggs Benedict and Shakshuka and they were well presented and flavoursome. Highly recommend Sumithra the lady serving us was very friendly. Will be back

Empty when we arrived on a recommendation but I'm sure it has atmosphere when busy as lovely little venue. I'm sure the middle east situation has affected business bady with few tourists around.  We wanted a curry which wasn't on the menu but they quickly russeled us up an amazing Sri Lankan curry. Lovely friendly staff. Highly recommend !

Moi was such a lovely find.
I had the catch of the day
The grilled sea snapper
and it was honestly delicious.
Simple, fresh, perfectly cooked, and flavorful.

A special mention for the chef, Pasindu, who clearly knows what he’s doing!

We were recommended to come and it didn’t disappoint. Although the menu is okay we wanted to eat traditional Srilankan food. This was no problem for the chef as he made us a Srilankan Chicken curry, potato curry, Sambal, rice and salad and the cocktails are pretty good too. I don’t know how often the chef makes food to order but his Srilankan food is great. I would recommend this place. Haven’t got the bill yet but I’m sure it’s excellent value for your money.

I had such a lovely experience at Moi Restaurant in Galle Fort The cocktails were absolutely amazing, so refreshing and beautifully presented. The food was delicious, full of flavor, and perfectly balanced with every bite. The atmosphere was cozy and stylish, and the staff were super friendly and attentive. Definitely one of the best spots in Galle Fort to chill, sip, and enjoy good food and vibes!

formatted_address: 16 New Lane I, Galle 80000, Sri Lanka
name: Cafe Yesara gallefort

reviews.text:
We had breakfast and coffee at cafe yesara.
We really enjoyed everything. The service was really friendly and attentive and I really appreciate the Freddo espresso that made for me ☺️ Since we are Greek isn’t something that we found anywhere else in our journey through Sri Lanka.
Really cute place with tasty food.
Totally recommended 🙏

Called in on a hot day in Galle.

Cooled down with a delicious mango smoothie. My lunch was the chicken curry with paratha. It was one of the tastiest curries I've had in Sri Lanka.

Mrs C devoured a beautiful chicken kottu.

Highly recommended.

I loved the food and being able to customise it for my quirky requirements. Freshly made curry and ginger tea at the best price in Galle Fort! The staff agreed quickly to prepare a curry with ingredients suitable for my diet and I was pleasantly surprised how efficient they were in preparing a fresh dish and how tasty it was. Café Yesara is on my list for next time I’m in Galle.

We were very excited to eat here after reading reviews. Unfortunately, two of three curries were served cold and quite bland (both rice and curry cold). Returned and served again. I did not eat my food - left hungry. Three members of staff gathered around me when I was alone requesting for me not to leave a review which I found quite intimidating. I agreed but changed my mind seeing that my friend has suffered an awful night of food poisoning from her chicken curry here yesterday. Cannot recommend - very poor experience.

This is one of my favorite coffee shops in Galle fort. Outstanding quality, excellent customer service, tasty food, warm welcome & polite staff!

This place is beautifully decorated with plants and unique artwork. Next to the coffee shop they have an art gallery also which gives more vibrant to the shop.

The menu has the usual breakfast options including avocado smash, poached eggs , smoothie bowls, omelettes and English breakfast. For lunch there are breakfast options plus salads, fish and chips, soups, burgers and sandwiches. On top of this there is a selection of Srilankan foods and waffles/pancakes etc.. so it’s a place that easily suits a breakfast, a lunch or a coffee date.

Drinks are good too – the coffee is good quality (freshly grounded) and there’s a selection of nice juices. Consistently good and worth a try if you haven’t been before.

A common pattern I've seen of franchise restaurants branching out here in Galle is the substandard service. The 2 servicemen at the counter stood idly without even talking to us about our seating arrangements. We walked out of frustration. Please train your staff to be attentive and pleasant.

UPDATE: visited again with a bunch of my friends. It's a great place to have a discussion, people are quiet either dining or busy with some work on their laptops. Food is okay nothing to write home about. The burgers are good but they're more like a sandwich. The portions are not worth what you spend on, and you have to pay extra to add cheese? Milkshakes and their teas are quite good. Service is average.

This is one of my favorite cafes in Galle, perfect for catching up with friends ,family outings or finding a quiet, peaceful spot to work. The menu offers a great variety of food and drinks, and everything is served quickly with excellent customer service. The sea view from the back wall is absolutely stunning!

If you're looking for a restaurant that offers more than just a meal, the Relaxed Food Experience in Galle is worth a visit. The prices may be a bit higher than other local options, but the atmosphere and service are top-notch. The cozy and inviting environment makes it a great place to relax and unwind, whether you're on a solo date or hanging out with friends. While there isn't a dedicated parking lot, there is the option to park along the road. All in all, the Relaxed Food Experience is a great choice for anyone looking to enjoy a unique and enjoyable dining experience.

You can have a relaxed food experience here. Prices are bit high compared to other restaurants around Galle. But they are adding value to food by offering a different experience. Don’t visit here if you are in a hurry. This is ideal for a solo date. Environment inside is very unique and mind relaxing. Just take your time and enjoy the food. As far as I know they don’t have a separate parking available but you can park your vehicle beside the Galle road.

Had an overall good experience here. The service was good. The peach iced tea and blue lagoon were good.  But the crispy chicken burger is not worth the price. The tomato pasta can be recommended and had a good portion as well. Also, the cheese cake is too much high price compared to other cheese cake providers and also does not match that quality.

We visited Kixi Galle Fort Outlet on a Saturday (2026-Feb) around 2 pm for lunch. Due to heavy rain, we couldn’t use the outdoor seating and were given an indoor table. By the time we arrived, only the all-day dining menu was available and most of the main menu items we asked for were not in stock, so we ordered a chicken burger, grilled cheese sandwich, Cadbury hot chocolate, hazelnut frappe, and French toast (total bill around LKR 9,000).

The drinks were good and tasted as expected, and both the chicken burger and grilled cheese sandwich were served with potato wedges. The chicken burger was decent, but we were disappointed with the grilled cheese sandwich as it was made with pol sambol and cheese 🧀 the sambol tasted slightly spoiled and the bread was over-grilled. The French toast was also a bit over-grilled, but it was manageable with the honey and toppings. Overall, the sandwiches didn’t feel worth the price (around LKR 2,200 each), and the preparation time was quite long, about 30–40 minutes, especially for the grilled sandwich.

The staff did check on us, but since the outlet was crowded and we were hungry after waiting, we didn’t raise a complaint at the moment. While the place has a nice vibe, our experience didn’t fully match the hype. Still, giving 3 stars for the drinks and the other items we enjoyed.

One of the best breakfast places I’ve been to! The shakshuka was honestly the best I’ve ever had — incredibly tasty and perfectly cooked. The waffle breakfast was ok, but I wouldn’t recommend. We also tried the waffle with banana and Nutella, and it was delicious. The place is cozy, beautiful, and has a really nice atmosphere. Definitely worth visiting if you’re in Galle)

We live in Galle, and KiXi Cafe in Galle Fort is our absolute favourite spot for brunch and evening coffee.

From the day they opened, we’ve been regulars and every single visit has been consistently amazing. The food is not only delicious but also beautifully presented. The flavours are always perfectly balanced, and their menu offers a wonderful variety of choices, whether you’re in the mood for something light or indulgent.

The staff are extremely friendly and welcoming, which makes the whole experience even better. Honestly, every dish or drink we’ve ordered deserves a 10/10. You can never go wrong here!

Highly recommended for anyone visiting Galle Fort or looking for a quality café experience. ☕✨

KiXi is a quaint little cafe, with both indoor and outdoor seating. It operates using ground floor, 1st floor & 2nd floor terrace. The table seating is indoors and roadside whilst bar stools are available for outdoor seating on upper floors balcony & terrace.
The arrangement of seating may feel cramped at a time when there's many customers.
We enjoyed the latte which was good and was served with a complimentary cookie. The lime & sugar crepe with strawberry filling tasted good, however the crepe could have been improved. It was more like a pancake.
The staff were attentive and friendly. The order was taken promptly and food & drinks were served fast. Vidushan waited on our table efficiently and inquired whether we enjoyed our meal.
We gave some feedback on addressing certain areas for improvement and it was well received. We were even offered complimentary fresh juice and dessert, which was a sweet gesture.
Highly recommended as a cafe to spend your time leisurely enjoying your coffee. Will surely be back for more!

I highly recommend starting your morning in Galle at this café. The food is delicious, and the ice coffee is served with adorable bear-shaped ice cubes, which makes it even more charming.
The French toast is a must-try! the portion is impressively generous and perfect for a relaxed breakfast.

formatted_address: 26G9+5CP, New Lane I, Galle 80000, Sri Lanka
name: Ameen hotel
National Tea Rooms - Oldest Cafe in Galle Fort

reviews.text: We have been here twice, for breakfast and lunch, trying the smoothie bowl, string hoppers, egg hoppers, dhal curry as well as the rice and curry. All meals were authentic, freshly prepared and tasty. The owner is super friendly and it’s popular among locals. One of the few places within the Fort with reasonable prices. Definitely recommend to visit when being in Galle.

One of the best and oldest restaurant you could find in Galle Fort which serves you a delicious breakfast. Though the room is with limited space for seating still you can enjoy the antique vibe. Customer service was friendly and helpful. Food were worth the price and delicious. Even they have bicycle rent out service with a reasonable price.

The most gorgeous little cafe with absolutely delicious food and really friendly staff! A hidden gem for sure and a must visit for authentic and amazing Sri Lankan food. We had the egg hoppers and coconut roti which was amazing - 100% would recommend to anyone visiting Galle.

Stopped here for a quick lunch and had a toasted cheese sandwich, a coke and a water for a really cheap price. Staff were lovely and it was nice sitting outside watching the world go by. Appreciated the garnish effort on the plate.

Nice atmosphere, cute cat and I love the interior. When it comes to service, waitresses looked very desoriented. A 450LRK 'espresso' is actually just a brown water 'nespresso' instant coffee, which was a huge disappointment. I mean. I don't know why but for the price I hoped for proper italian-ish espresso from a proper coffee machine.

A lovely place with a truly unique and beautiful atmosphere. The space is very clean, well-designed, and feels fresh and welcoming. The ice creams are incredibly delicious, rich in flavor, and clearly made with great quality ingredients. Definitely a great spot to relax, enjoy the vibe, and treat yourself to amazing ice cream. Highly recommended!

Simple breakfasr options, it feels like hotel breakfast, if you look for Sri Lankan breakfast this is not the place. Ambience nice, beautiful set up, very quiet in the morning, friendly staff. The morning we went there was military training opposite the street, it was interesting to sneak on them from the restaurant. Breakfast comes with egg and meat as the heart, besides, you get started with small cup of juice of the day, a plate of fruit, toast and sweet, tea or coffee.

The atmosphere is great, but the drinks were pretty disappointing.
The pineapple juice tasted mostly like water with very little actual juice, and the mango smoothie wasn’t good either.

We were really disappointed with this café. They had only three very similar options for breakfast — nothing special or worth the price. What made it worse was that they didn’t allow us to sit outside, even though the place was practically empty and there was plenty of space in the front. Strangely, only two foreigners were seated there, which made us feel like locals weren’t welcome to sit outside. That’s really unfair — we pay the same money too. Definitely not coming back.
Really had a great lunch (vegetarian curry)! The staff is super friendly and was more than willing to answer all our questions about the exquisite food! Would definitely recommend!

Le Bella 1912 Caffè is a lovely place with a great atmosphere. The staff are extremely friendly, welcoming, and always ready to help with a smile. Their warm service really makes the experience special. Highly recommended for anyone looking to relax and enjoy quality time at a cozy café.

Stumbled across this place after stopping for a beer. Liked Galle Fort and this location so cancelled our original Airbnb a few km away to stay here. Lovely staff and rooms, perfect location, we chose the room with front balcony where we could watch the world go by. Really good Coffee and cocktails all reasonably priced. So happy we stayed and would highly recommend to others. Beach super close, cricket ground a few minutes walk and not forgetting try Hot hot Roti shop just down the street.

My partner and I absolutely loved Le Bella1912!
They have best staff and great rooms. They were also very accomodating for us with a late check out. The location is amazing. Highly recommend!

reviews.author_name: R O S H A N
reviews.text:
Great place for backpacking.. We stayed over for a night on B’nB. We were offered a welcome drink. Room was spacious and was decent. Bathroom was clean and the AC was working fine. Would’ve loved if the breakfast had a couple more sausages, but I guess I can’t ask more for the price they offered us everything. Staff were friendly and accommodating.
I’d definitely recommend to anyone who are looking for a budget friendly, clean place.
