Such a wonderful place to stay for a few nights when exploring Galle and surrounding areas. Kind staff, peaceful and calm athmosphere, and a bar for a coffee in the morning and wine in the evening. Definitely highly recommend staying here.

The first thing that stood out was their friendly and very welcoming customer service. Since we are not tourists, they treated us in a very warm manner. We actually went there to experience the architectural vibe, and the place was lovely. If you’re photogenic, you can take beautiful photos with nice backgrounds.
The cafe is attached with a shop that sells Korean beauty products. The food wasn’t exceptional, but it was healthy and tasty. I was a little worried that I should have tried the fluffy pancakes instead of the club sandwiches. If you’re looking for a cafe to enjoy tea flavors or you are a Matcha lover, I think this is an ideal spot.

Amazing food and drinks. The poke bowls are very good. If you’re looking for some AC to break from the midday heat this is one of the few places in Galle Fort with great AC. Perfect place to doomscroll. Good vibes.

I recently visited Celestial Tea Co., and it quickly became one of my favourite spots. Their pancakes are exceptional, I tried both the strawberry and grilled banana varieties, and each one was incredibly fluffy and practically melted in my mouth.

For something savoury, the spicy club sandwich, served with a mini soup pot, is absolutely to die for. The poke bowls were another highlight, packed with fresh ingredients and rich, vibrant flavours.

The ambiance is warm and welcoming, making it a perfect place to relax. The staff are genuinely friendly, adding to the overall pleasant experience. I also sampled some of their cakes, including the crepe cakes, and they were delightful.

The affogato, though smaller than expected, was still delicious. And if you're in the mood for something indulgent, the strawberry cheesecake shake is my top recommendation, just be warned, it's so rich and satisfying that you might not be able to eat much afterward!

Overall, Celestial Tea Co. offers a wonderful mix of flavours, great service, and an inviting atmosphere. Highly recommended.

Hands down the best matcha latte in Galle (down south)! 🍵 Perfectly balanced, creamy, and full of real matcha flavor. The café is located inside Galle Fort, making it even more special—you can enjoy your matcha latte with a beautiful view while soaking in the charm of the fort. A must-visit spot for matcha lovers in Sri Lanka!

Food was really nice and tasty. Atmosphere is calm and service is good as well. The crepe cakes are superb so don't miss out on them. Japanese pancakes were just right as well. The prawn poke bowl was fresh and delicious.

formatted_address: Sipnara Building, Baladaksha Mawatha, Galle 80000, Sri Lanka
name: Cafe Fort Nook

reviews.text: Hello,Fort lovers… This is a small corner cafe at mansion building near commercial bank at galle fort.. You can enjoy the breakfast and evening snacks at hear… They have bubble tea,mojitos,fresh fruit juices and hot chocolate… Enjoy and try this cute place within your galle fort journey…
It’s a small place but the staff is super friendly. I ordered string hoppers with curry and a black tea for breakfast and it was delicious 😍 very reasonable priced

Small and cute cafe right on the street with delicious juices and great iced coffee. Highly recommended!

Attention. The current point is not in the right place. The café is directly opposite the Commerical bank

Highly Recommended ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Best Place to eat... So Yummy 🥰🥰🥰🥰🥰🥰
&
Thank you sooo much for helping Us 😉☺️

We had an iced lemon tea (coz it was so hot today) and a bubble tea (because we just love those little bubbles!). The place is cute and neat; not hard to find...also very peaceful. The order was ready quickly and of course really good as well. Hope to go back there soon!

formatted_address: 65 Leyn Baan St, Galle 80000, Sri Lanka
name: FASHION FRUIT

reviews.text: Cute juice bar overlooking the ocean in the shade of the Threes. Amazing place to cool down
The "chiller" and "coco cream" juices were both extremely delicious! Very refreshing and reasonably priced.

Nice food even ambiance also good. The service was great and they papered fresh and give the good. The quality and quantity of food is good. I really loved it mouthwatering food. I really recommend this to go if you’re in Galle fort. Must try here

We quenched our thirst for coffee in beautiful glass tumblers. Whilst the rich coffee aroma filled the room we knew we had come to the right place. As we expected they were made to perfection and served with a friendly smile. The place was tastefully adorned by green luscious plants and minimal furniture. Also loved the environmentally friendly steel straws. We didn’t have any food as all we wanted at the time was coffee. Will definitely come again for a bite.

I recently had the pleasure of visiting this charming coffee shop inside the historic Galle Fort. The atmosphere is incredibly cozy, The coffee here is exceptional – rich, aromatic, and perfectly brewed it was an absolute treat. They also offer a variety of delicious food that pair perfectly with the drinks.

Drinks were okayish, iced tea was quite bland to my taste. I also ordered some fries, it took about 20 minutes and they were still soggy and soft. I think they depleted a whole salt mine on the fries itself so it left me quite thirsty. Probably good place for a coffee but not for me.

The worst breakfast I had in my whole month in Sri Lanka.

You don’t get a tuna sandwich, you get a sandwich with the “smell” of tuna only.

The service is super slow.

name: Simply Strawberries by Jagro - Galle Fort

reviews.text:
Simply Strawberries by Jagro in Galle Fort is a wonderful place to stop for something fresh and sweet. The quality of the strawberries and desserts is really good, and everything tastes fresh and well made. You can clearly feel that they care about what they serve.

The staff are one of the best parts of the experience very friendly, polite, and always ready to help with a smile. They patiently explain the menu and give good suggestions if you are not sure what to choose. The service is fast and smooth, even when the place is busy.

The shop itself is clean, cozy, and nicely located inside Galle Fort, making it a perfect place to relax for a few minutes after walking around in the heat. Overall, it was a very pleasant experience with tasty food and great service. I would definitely visit again and recommend it to anyone visiting Galle Fort

Simply Strawberries by Jagro at Galle Fort is a delightful dessert and coffee bar, especially for strawberry lovers. The place is well known for its fresh, high-quality strawberries used in a variety of creative and delicious desserts. From strawberry-based sweets to refreshing treats, everything tastes fresh and beautifully prepared.
The coffee selection pairs perfectly with the desserts, making it a great spot to relax and enjoy a sweet break while exploring Galle Fort. The atmosphere is pleasant and cozy, ideal for sitting down, unwinding, and enjoying a treat.
If you love desserts and strawberries in particular, Simply Strawberries by Jagro is a must-visit place in Galle Fort. It’s highly recommended for both locals and tourists looking for a unique and tasty dessert experience. 🍓☕

Jagro Galle Fort is situated inside the Maru restaurant. Have all the strawberry dishes as in other branches. Portion sizes seems to have become smaller than I remember from last time. But that's kind of good. Food is great and full of strawberries.
Had a really good time at simply strawberries by Jagro at Galle fort. Visited with my friends and had cheesecake which we all loved. They were delicious 😍Good and friendly service too.

The cheesecake wasn’t as soft as expected, and the Swiss roll didn’t quite meet my expectations. However, I really liked the atmosphere, though the place isn’t very spacious. The service was good and pleasant overall.

formatted_address: 72 Leyn Baan St, Galle 80000, Sri Lanka
name: Royal Dutch Cafe

reviews.text: We had a lovely coffee and tea at this place. The owner is very lovely, we had some fun with him. It was a lovely experience and we felt very welcome! Cake and fruit bowle were nice too. I can recommend going there.

I ordered a Tuna Salad on the proviso that they were serving fresh tuna, which he assured me it was. The salad was quite a weird mix of veg & the tuna was shredded as if it had come straight from a can. There was nothing satisfying about the meal except the milk tea at the end.
If you are tempted to go, just have tea & eat somewhere else (try Church Street).

Charming little cafe steeped in history and old world charm. Like stepping back in time. Great staff and beautiful food and tea. I had the chai which was really good and the chicken tikka masala was outstanding.

This authentic family run cafe has a brilliant menu including tasty cakes & the best tea. It's a great spot to sit on the terrace & watch life go by. There is also a shop in the main building with jewellery, clothes & souvenirs. Fazal offers really insightful walking tours around Galle, 7 generations of his family have lived in his house and in much of Galle so every street you turn will be another tale of his families life.

I ordered Naan Roti from the menu but it seemed more like a reheated frozen tortilla. The flavour and texture were not what I expected. Extremely disappointed with the food. I think it’s very overpriced and overhyped

formatted_address: Dutch Hospital, Galle Dutch Fort, Hospital St, Galle 80000, Sri Lanka
name: Ocean Bistro by Starbeans

reviews.text: We really enjoyed this place! It was definitely one of the best restaurants we found during our road trip around Sri Lanka. The food was absolutely delicious and it was made with really high-quality ingredients. The prices were reasonably priced for a tourist spot, plus the service fee was already included in the final bill, which was a nice touch.

I’ve tried their pizza variety called Ayubowan ( black chicken curry + coconut sambal) it was a spicy dish and tasted as i expected. Hot butter prawn tempura , Blueberry cheesecake and virgin passion mojito was so good as well. Customer service and the cleanliness was perfect. Specially thanks to Arj for his hospitality and kindness.

We visited the restaurant for a light snack. First, we ordered a lime mojito and Los Angeles Chili Cheese Fries since we weren’t very hungry at the beginning. However, the fries were literally heavenly!!!! it felt like a full meal. The drink was also very tasty.

After that, we ordered ice cream with lava cake for dessert, and it was like wowww! Then we ordered another round of drinks, a passion fruit and strawberry mojito, which was also very good.

Special thanks to Mr. ARJ, who served us and greatly enhanced our dining experience. He has excellent knowledge of the menu; whenever we asked questions, he explained very well how the meals and drinks are prepared, and much more.

My husband and I had a great experience there. Highly recommended, and we will definitely visit again

Wonderful service and so caring and truly nice staff, explained every food and how to eat it. Food also amazing, full of taste and beautifuly served. 10/10 expierence. In menu is a lot of options - pizzas, pastas, local dishes and so on and on. Also a lot of dessert options. Definetly recomend to visit and try those amazing dishes when in Galle fort.

This place is located inside Galle Fort. The restaurant is large. It has indoor seating. The food is very good. Do try out sea food here. The drinks are okay. The service is great. The balcony has sea view. Overall a great place for lunch or dinner if you are visiting the Galle Fort.

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Visited the Army-run restaurant at Galle Fort, and it was excellent! 💚 I tried a vadai and a chicken soup, and both were super tasty. 🍲 The prices are very reasonable, and the quality is amazing. Everything was fresh, clean, and full of flavor. Highly recommend it if you visit Galle Fort! 🇱🇰✨

One of few local restaurants not targeting tourists but local people.

The chicken curry soup& vegetable soup, and juices at this food stand are simple but offer great value for the price. Tourists should be aware that the juice ingredients and hygiene standards may not match those of tourist-focused restaurants. However, the prices here are significantly lower, often a quarter or less of what you’d pay elsewhere.

Authentic Sri Lankan food at local prices. Freshly made plain hoppers cost just LKR 10; egg hoppers cost LKR 30.

We ate hoppers at Cafe Punto in the touristy area and they charged us LKR 700 for two plain and one egg hopper with daal, tea, and fresh fruits.
Best local snacks in super cheap prices!!! Love it! Everything was very good :)
The veggie bun could be the best thing i’ve eaten in Sri Lanka. Cheap clean good street food. End of.

name: Bubbluscious Bubble Tea - Galle Fort Outlet

reviews.text:
Small shop with only takeaway service — no dine-in available.
Photography of the menu is not allowed. Prices have increased by around 30% compared to the old menu pictures circulating online.
No dedicated parking space, but you can manage to park by the roadside.
The prices feel a bit expensive considering the limited customer facilities.
Still, I just wanted to taste the bubble tea at least once — and I'm glad I did!

Great place to have Bubble tea. The Milk ones are really good. I tried choco cookie monster with strawberry flavour bubbles and mango bubble tea it was really good 🥰 Staffs are very knowledge about what they sell, they helps when you ask for suggestions as which will go better with what etc. Highly Recommend ❤

We tried two bubble teas at the Galle Fort outlet—Aqua Mint and Pomegranate. They were advertised as fruit bubble teas, but they used fruit syrup rather than fresh fruit. The flavors were okay, but nothing extraordinary. Overall, a decent experience, but not quite what we expected.

Visited on 2025/04/26

01.Shop atmosphere rating👇
*️⃣Very small tiny looking shop situated in “THE MINISTRY OF TEA” building ground floor in Galle Fort..You can’t really enjoy your drinks there because there is no chairs and space to  sit there..

02.About the customer service and friendliness of the people working there👇
*️⃣The customer service was good it was ready in like 5 mins but I did not like the way they talk to there customers it was a bit harsh  and rude of them to talk like that..Like I was about to take the photo of the menu for your good and for the shops good so that everyone can view what is in the menu but the worker said not to take pictures of the menu because they said they were jot going to share there menu with the Internet.Extremely sorry because I couldn’t take a picture of the menu…
Here taking pictures of the menu is prohibited…

03.About the tastiness of  the drinks here and more information about the drinks👇
*️⃣The drinks were actually tasty but without the bubbles...

The bubbles = Rubber Balls🤣🤣

No jokes the above ⬆️  sentence that I have written was funny and it is true.The bubbles in the drinks were like hard rubber(very hard like rock)..The only Bubbles that was fun to drink was in the drink called “GREEN APPLE SMOOTHIE(REGULAR)+PEECH POPPING BUBBLES”but they pop on your mouth that was the only fun it had but that one is also not very tasty….

The things we ordered were,👇

1️⃣Nutella supreme(regular) [Rs.1,100] + Tapioca / Chewy bubbles[Rs.330]  = [Rs.1,430]

2️⃣Nutella tea with ice cream(regular) [Rs.1,030] + Tapioca / Chewy  bubbles[Rs.330]      = [Rs.1,360]

3️⃣Green apple smoothie(regular) [Rs.650] + Peach popping bubbles[Rs.330] = [Rs.980]

4️⃣ Mango smoothie(regular) = [Rs.600]

The Nutella options and the other chocolate options are very tasty(but without the bubbles) .The other flavors like the fruits.I have the experience because we ordered the mango smoothie and it was much much savor than the mango juice we drink at other restaurants.We asked the main employee(Seneth) what the fruit smoothies were made of and the employee(Seneth) replied saying that it was made from a artificial flavor which was sent from there main headquarters so the fruit smoothies there are very savor and there taste is not actually not the taste of The fruit that we ordered and also it is not good for our health because it is a artificial flavor and who knows how that artificial chemical is made…

*️⃣(Important point) The price is not reasonable because for that much of a price you don’t even have a place to sit and enjoy the drink you have to take the drink and walk away so for that much of a price they must even give us a place to sit..

So I recommend y’all to never go or visit this place because the price is too high for that drink drinking the bubble tea from a other place around Galle is even good they have a place to sit and it is not much expensive in the other shops which have bubble tea and even if the price is same as this in the other shop they give us a place to enjoy our drink freely while sitting.So I’m not visiting this place again and I    really don’t recommend this place for you to go and have a bubble tea….
Good bubble tea here, take your favorite bubble tea from there. I loved this bubble tea drinks. ❤️

formatted_address: Galle Police Residential Building, Church St, Galle 80000, Sri Lanka
name: Galle Heritage Emporium

reviews.text: Located inside the World Heritage site of Old Dutch Fort in Galle, Sri Lanka.
Really great coffee, taste like a specialty coffe brew. Local brew from Colombo Coffee company. Kind service and big range of differente domestic juices.
Nice cafe with live music located in Galle Fort area. We had coffee. Recommended.

Absolutely recommend this place. Staff is super friendly and very nice. I was looking for a place to work while having a snack and a coffee. Luckily I found this place. I informed the staff I have to work for sometime and they were super nice. they arranged the upstairs. Both food and Coffee was absolutely top notch.

Such a cute spot with the friendliest staff! I had one of the best fresh watermelon juices here, and I love that you can adjust the sugar level to your taste. They’ve definitely got the boba fix you need, and the pastries are to die for—the chocolate brownie literally melted in my mouth. Highly recommend!
Nice small restaurant inside galle dutch fort. Good for have great coffee, bubble tea, cakes, fresh juices, smoothies. Potions are worth for prices.

Strangely enough, my entire Galle trip had one sole purpose—finding a luxury little café or boutique spot inside Galle Fort for a perfect solo lunch or dinner. I even saved up 5000, knowing that food inside the fort is pricey since they mainly cater to foreigners.

I decided to go at night, strolling through the charming streets in search of the perfect solo date spot. I wanted a fine dining experience but wasn’t about to drop 20,000 on a tiny appetizer—I just wanted to relax and enjoy myself.

I actually stopped by the place next to this one first, but the vibe was off. The owner’s tone (or maybe their choice of words) didn’t sit right with me. Now, I’m not a Karen, but if you speak to me nicely, I’ll listen.

Then, I found this place—and it was absolutely wonderful.

Food & Price
✅ Super reasonable—way better than I expected!
✅ It’s a café, but I had dinner there, and it worked perfectly.
✅ I ordered a chicken sandwich, French fries, and a strawberry banana milkshake.

Oh, and the sandwich? PEAK. 🔥 They should’ve told me it already came with fries, though—because I ended up with way too many fries after ordering an extra plate. But hey, no regrets.

Service
Here’s the catch—I waited In the cafe for two hours and no one bother to tell me anything I was enjoying my life because those people were realy kind.
I also wanted more sugar in my milkshake, and they provided me with sugar syrup, which was a nice touch.

Ambience & Extras
✅ Beautiful spot to sit back, enjoy the food, and soak in the Galle Fort atmosphere.
✅ There’s a plug point—a lifesaver if you need to charge your phone.
✅ You get a view of the Galle Fort walls, which adds to the experience.

Historical building with the VOC logo. Felt dreamy sitting inside, can just imagine what people were talking about 400 years ago in the same spot I was sitting.

It's too bad the resto doesnt serve Dutch food. Closest thing was patat, but when I ordered a side of mayo, it didnt taste good at all. Would've loved to see bitterballen, frikandellen, kroketjes, broodje kaas and souffles.

Instead, had the avocado toast, beef burger, chicken wrap, and mixed green salad with avocado smoothies.

It wasn't.... great.

Nice visit, but wont come back here again.
Tasty food & drink options, friendly staff, comparable prices and good service. Washrooms in adjoining building.

2 coffees and 2 desserts cost 5.3K LKR. The coffee was ok, but for dessert, I received warm cheesecake. Awful taste, don’t recommend trying it, and definitely not for the price they charge for it. The only positive part is the location and the good interior.

The best atmosphere I've ever seen in a café. Sea breeze plus evening vibe is making things more elegant. The place is vast. You can dine in inside the café or out side. I prefer out side is more romantic. Prices are average. I had an avocado juice and my wife had a cappuccino. Delicious taste made our day more sweet. The place has great vibrant. The evening is the best time to have a chat sitting there looking at the sea breeze. Plenty of space inside but only two ✌ tables available out side. Free parking available for your vehicles so no worries at all. The crew is friendly. They welcome their guests with a smile. Keep up lads. I'd definitely come back
Absolutely beautiful and comfortable clothes.  The service in the store is great.  Thank you

An absolute gem in Galle, don’t miss out! High quality clothes designed by the owner, it’s lovely to see different items than everywhere else. And on top of that, coffee and company are lovely👌 thank you!
One of the best V60 coffees I have had in my life. Kavishka is an amazing barista and a very very lovely women to talk too. This is a must visit in Galle!

Amazing!
Very good quality clothes!
Fabulous shop! Really nice clothing design and quality. Friendly and helpful customer service

The fried beef dumplings were delicious, and the café is in a convenient location. There’s both indoor and outdoor seating, though the indoor area can get noisy at times, and the outdoor seating faces a busy road, unlike the quieter streets inside Galle Fort.
Sandali was so lovely and helpful. The food was 10/10. We had the beef pancake noodles and the beef bao buns and would definitely recommend
One of the best cuisine in the fort. really awesome. we had group of three, we really enjoyed the food, and also staff is very friendly.highly recommended. and thanku for the service.

Bad service and mediocre food.
After a successful card payment (verifiable debit from my account), I was lied to, told I hadn't paid. They persistently tried to rob me, demanding I pay again. Out of courtesy, I left my mobile number to clarify the issue with the company if necessary. Since then, I've been subjected to harassing phone calls. They still continue to lie.
Avoid that restaurant at all costs
Ordered braised beef noodles. It was loaded with mushrooms. Only had one small piece of beef

I stayed there for two nights right on Unawatuna Beach. It’s a superb location for beach lovers. The rooms were very clean and extremely spacious. The food was exceptional. I’m not usually a big seafood fan, but the seafood I had here completely blew my mind.

The staff were extremely friendly, helpful, and caring. There was absolutely nothing to complain about. I would highly recommend this place to anyone who loves the beach and wants a relaxing holiday.

One of the best places to stay in Unawatuna. The hotel is located right in front of the beach, making it a perfect spot to relax and enjoy the ocean. The beach here is great for swimming and spending a peaceful day by the sea.

The food was incredible, especially the seafood — definitely some of the best in Unawatuna. Even if you’re not staying at the hotel, it’s worth visiting their restaurant to try the fresh seafood dishes.

The staff were extremely friendly, welcoming, and always ready to help. Their service really made the stay even more enjoyable. Overall, it was a wonderful experience and I would highly recommend this place to anyone visiting Unawatuna.

The hotel is really in the city center and has a private access to the beach!
There there is a lovely bar and also sun beds.
The rooms are absolutely perfect!
Cozy, clean and very pretty!
The staff is gentle and polite!
I suggest to have the breakfast included.
They have continental breakfast and Sri Lankan once!
I recommend the exquisite Sri Lankan one.

We recommend vividly to stay here!

Although we did not stay at this hotel and therefore cannot comment on the rooms or accommodation facilities, we had the opportunity to dine at the restaurant during our visit, and the experience was truly excellent from start to finish. We were staying nearby and decided to try this place for dinner, and it turned out to be one of the best dining experiences we have had in the area.

From the moment we arrived, the atmosphere of the restaurant was warm and welcoming. The staff greeted us with friendly smiles and made us feel comfortable right away. The service throughout the evening was attentive, professional, and very efficient. The staff were also happy to recommend some of the popular dishes on the menu, which helped us choose what to try.

One of the highlights of our visit was definitely the seafood. We ordered squid, prawns, and the tuna steak that was recommended by the staff, and every dish was absolutely delicious. The seafood tasted incredibly fresh, which is something that really stands out when you are dining near the coast. It was clear that the ingredients were of very high quality and prepared with care.

The squid was perfectly cooked—tender, flavorful, and seasoned just right. It had a great texture and was neither overcooked nor chewy, which can sometimes happen with squid dishes. The prawns were equally impressive. They were juicy, fresh, and grilled beautifully, with a wonderful natural flavor that did not need heavy seasoning to shine.

However, the real star of the meal was the tuna steak. It was cooked fresh on the grill and served perfectly. The tuna was tender, juicy, and full of flavor. You could immediately tell that it was very fresh, and the grilling brought out the best taste of the fish. It was one of the best tuna steaks we have had in a long time. If you visit this restaurant, the tuna steak is definitely something we would recommend trying.

Another thing we appreciated was how well everything was prepared and presented. The dishes arrived in a timely manner, and the presentation was simple but appealing. The portion sizes were also very satisfying and offered good value for the quality of the food.

The overall dining environment was also very enjoyable. The restaurant had a relaxed and pleasant atmosphere, making it a great place to sit back, enjoy a good meal, and spend time with friends or family. It felt comfortable and not overly crowded, which allowed us to fully enjoy the experience.

What made our experience even more special was that we enjoyed the food so much that we decided to return the next evening. It is not very often that we visit the same restaurant two nights in a row while traveling, but in this case it was an easy decision. Our second visit was just as good as the first, with the same great service and delicious food.

Consistency is very important for any restaurant, and this place definitely delivered. The staff remained friendly and attentive, and the food quality was just as high as the night before. That consistency is something that really leaves a positive impression.

Overall, even though we cannot comment on the hotel rooms, the restaurant itself deserves high praise. The food is fresh, flavorful, and clearly prepared with care. The seafood in particular is outstanding, and the service is excellent. The staff are welcoming, helpful, and professional, which makes the whole dining experience even better.

If you are in the area and looking for a place to enjoy fresh seafood and a pleasant dining atmosphere, this restaurant is definitely worth visiting. We had a wonderful experience and will certainly return again in the future. Highly recommended for anyone who appreciates good food, fresh ingredients, and friendly service.

We stayed 3 nights at Thaproban Beach House on a half-board basis (breakfast and dinner), and it was truly one of the best decisions we made in Sri Lanka. The location is unbeatable — the hotel is right on the beach, with free sunbeds and beach towels provided, making it super easy to relax and enjoy the ocean.

The food was absolutely delicious, especially dinner, which is served right on the beach under the stars.

The staff are wonderful — always kind, attentive, and ready to help with anything. A special thanks to the reception and restaurant teams for making our stay so comfortable and memorable.

Highly recommend this place to anyone visiting Unawatuna — perfect for relaxing, enjoying great food, and being just steps away from the sea!

Nice location on a wide sandy beach.  We stayed in the Casa Tartaruga building which is brand new and the rooms are lovely - spacious, large balcony, much better standard of construction and fitout than is typical in Sri Lanka.  Lovely hot, strong shower and effective air conditioning.  Comfortable bed.  We didn’t experience the standard rooms in the other buildings but Casa was very nice, best room we’ve stayed in in our 18 days in Sri Lanka.

Downsides are the surrounding facilities in the hotel are old and tired.  We looked down onto crappy old roofs of adjacent buildings.

Pool is small, shallow and tucked up next to reception with nowhere to sit and as a consequence we didn’t use it and we didn’t see anyone else in the pool.

Lots of dogs on the beach but they are not aggressive so no issue except we had one barking early hours of the morning.  That combined with random fireworks each night kept us awake.

Great location, beach front, off the main road and heaps of cafes and restaurants a short walk either side of the hotel.

Overall a nice stay.

Lovely hotel -  right on the beach - you sleep to the sound of waves. Staff very attentive and cheerful. Everything kept very clean. Breakfast delicious. Hotel restuarant and bar serves a wide range of lovely food. Enough sunbeds and food/drinks served to you on the beach.  Just a lovely place BUT there are two types of rooms.  One modern and lovely the other VERY tired, damp and frankly disappointing. I did not want to spend any more time than I absolutely had to in my room. We had heavy rain and damp was flaking the paint of one of walls, the washbasin was cracked, fittings in the bathroom old and worn.  Go if you have a guarantee of a modern new room!

Tartaruga Beach Hotel Unawatuna is a lovely and relaxing place to stay right on the beach.
The hotel is divided into two separate buildings an older section and a newer one.
We stayed in the new building and it was very well designed modern and clearly built with a lot of thought and investment.
Every room in the new building has a full sea view which creates an amazing atmosphere from the moment you wake up.
The level of privacy in the rooms is excellent and makes the stay feel calm and intimate.
The service at the hotel is great friendly attentive and always available when needed.
The location is one of the hotel’s biggest advantages right on a beautiful beach and close enough to everything yet still quiet.
The beach itself is fun clean and perfect for swimming walking or just sitting and watching the ocean.
This is the kind of place where you truly disconnect from daily life slow down and relax.
It is ideal for travelers who are looking for peace comfort and a genuine beach holiday experience.

Hands down one of the best places with food. We dined by the sea and enjoyed our time very much. Food was extraordinary, really delicious and generous portions. Service was excellent. Highly recommended ♥️

Ugh! The view from our balcony every morning is everything! The clean room and the morning breakfast buffet alone is worth the stay. The hotel is just few steps to the beach. The stuff was all friendly, very accommodating and attentive. We would definitely love to go back and stay at the same hotel again. HIGHLY RECOMMENDED.😊👌🏻⭐️

name: Nature Trails Boutique Hotel & Fish Market Restaurant

reviews.text:
I truly had an amazing time at Nature Trails. The key highlight of our stay, was the amazing food.Hands down one of best places in Sri Lanka where I had flavor packed good seafood !

I would highly recommend their spice infused crab curry, crispy hot butter cuttlefish and jumbo prawns that just coats your taste buds.

Not to mention their reasonably priced drinks.

The ambience of the place, hospitable staff, and attention to detail made the experience a memorable one .

Nature Trails is must go boutique hotel if you are visiting Sri Lanka. We make sure to visit every time we travel to Sri Lanka. You can find the best Sea food here and the taste is exceptional. One of my favorite dishes is the hot butter cuttlefish. The manager and staff are excellent and very friendly. Alcohol and drinks are well priced and pretty reasonable compared with other hotels. Thank you very much and we looking forward to visiting again in the near future.

Visited this place for the first time and the experience was really good. The cafe itself has a nice ambiance, with the look and feel.  The food is just great. I liked everything I tried here. Fantastic seafood 🦞❤️🦀🦐🔥
I recommend it to everyone 👌🏼

An ideal place for a vacation. Everything was calm and peaceful. The food was Amazing, don't bother to go out looking for places to eat, because their food is yummy (unless you want to see what other have to offer). If you want a place to stay, don't think twice about this place, it's clean and has a beautiful view of the mountain and their pool. It's a thumbs up from me.

I am so happy I chose to stay at this truly unique hotel. From the delicious food, to the service and entire stay, our experience was wonderful. We had a 11 month old baby with us as well and I have to say staff and the manager were extremely accommodating making sure she was comfortable as well.

Rooms: We stayed in double and triple rooms which were spacious and clean. I particularly loved how all the room accents & colors, the view from the room facing the Rumassala hill and the hotel surroundings matched with their whole “nature trails” theme. Very calm and relaxing. We didn’t get a chance to use their pool but saw quite a few guests it enjoying it as well.

Food and drinks:The food was the highlight- fresh and full of flavour. Don’t forget to have their amazing fried rice with the famous sri lankan hot butter cuttle fish and juicy prawns, truly amazing. I also had a craving for authentic sri lankan cuisine of rice and curry/ string hoppers and even this lived up to my expectations with the taste and freshness. There was also a Thai prawn curry that we had ordered which I enjoyed most of all. Drinks were quite reasonably priced as well.

Service: Very attentive, friendly and hospitable staff. I also appreciated how the staff went to great lengths to keep the place tidy and clean especially with pandemic concerns these days. There are sanitizer dispensers wherever needed and the common washrooms for the dining rooms were cleaned a few times. The manager and staff were ever ready if we had any questions or concerns to help out

Overall, a great place to stay with family and definitely will be our first choice on our next visit to Sri Lanka!

Read the latest reviews that seem to be low… but I can whole heartedly say this is a gorgeous bar in the heart of unawatuna. We’re currently sat in with a bottle of white wine. I can’t comment on food, but service from Shan is exceptional, vibe is brilliant with upbeat music, sat over the balcony people watching. 5 stars from us. Don’t listen to the negatives if you’re coming for a drink. It’s brilliant here⭐️thank you again!

Love Bar Restaurant:
We had the best cocktails made by Shan and Haruni, not only for Sri Lanka but in general. They love what they are doing and you can taste it! Very well balanced and for reasonable price.
Also the food we had was really tasty and good quickly.

We'd come again :)

Absolutely loved my visit to Love Bar Unawatuna. The cocktails are next-level, especially their signature creation a must-try.

The food was equally delicious, with fantastic flavors. The place is spotlessly clean, and the staff are incredibly friendly and welcoming. A perfect spot for a great time. Highly recommended.

Absolutely amazing service, food and drink. The cocktails are insane and. Shan❤️chathura is  incredibly helpful and friendly. The love bar is the place to be in Unatiwarna   We absolutely loved it and will definitely be coming back tomor ! Thank you for such an awesome time xx

Have been there with small squad in 5 people, got amazing service, tasty food and individual approach. This place is growing, wish you the best business

Stuff Shan awesome person, but some stuff tried to get our pack of cigarettes like "accidentally". It's not good even if you're friendly

formatted_address: 266W+36X, Wallaye Deywala Rd, Unawatuna, Sri Lanka
name: Cafe Cinema

reviews.text: A good press that every barista in the place will appreciate😉

Great food with excellent service we had the 3 course set menu which was great value for money. It's only 100m from the Unawatuna beach seafood restaurants. All Jewelry have highest standards of quality and value for money
Really enjoyed our stay. The owner was very helpful and gave us info on where to go and arranged a scooter for us. Definitely stay again.
good
Our friends were on holiday here and we went to visit them, and we really liked it.
Everything looks beautiful in the photo, but in real life everything is different.

Our group of 14 booked a full board package at Dilena Beach Resort, Unawatuna, with seasonal discounts and some customized changes arranged directly with the owner. Unfortunately, these customizations were not communicated to the staff, leading to confusion and inconvenience throughout our stay. Although we inquired about pool access and were told it was available at a neighboring hotel only if we paid and used it, we were still charged for the pool despite not using it at all. When questioned, the owner claimed it had already been “booked” and was dismissive and unprofessional in handling the issue. Rooms and washrooms were not properly cleaned, air conditioning was ineffective, and essential items like bed sheets were not provided. Overall, the experience did not meet basic hospitality standards, and we cannot recommend this resort to others.

If anyone gonna book this hotel keep proof. Beacause they  have plenty of hiden chargers. I have booked the hotel for 9500 but at the end cost went up to 16500.
1. Rooms are very Basic
2. Food was horrible and discusting.
3. Staff is not helpful at all
4. Ownwer was ignoring issues qere rasied

Just might be the worst hotel I’ve stayed at..
checked in for three nights with my partner.

Hotel has no water
AC doesn’t work, no blanket or bedsheet, when we requested they said it’s sent for laundry and gave us on the third day! Imagine not having extra bed sheets for the whole hotel??
It is a good place to access the beach. We just use the room as a changing room after we played in the beach.
Dilena was an affordable place, food was suberb. Only down fall was, AC did not work propely

formatted_address: parangaya wataa unawatuna beach, Unawatuna 80600, Sri Lanka
name: SUPer Juice Bar & Super SUP Unawatuna Sri Lanka

reviews.text: Best service and relax atmosphere on beach, owners are very friendly European people. Big choice of healthy fresh cocktails. Also you can rent a SUP board and take a lessons as well.

We popped in there looking for snorkel gear and ended up meeting one of the awesome owners- Deb. She was super helpful about where to snorkel and really great about letting us return the gear the next day as it was close to sundown. We brought it back that evening anyways and had a great time chatting with her and the team. They are super eco-conscious and have done a huge part to encourage other businesses on Unawatuna beach to do the same. For me, these are the best places to support because they bring positive change and honesty to tourism in the area! Keep up the great work and thanks for an awesome evening :) Your friends from Belgium, Alex and Simon

I’ve walked the beach for days looking at every menu, the Juice Bar is the only locations that has a selection of authentically crafted juices, and food.
The owners are wonderful.
The location has great energy, 30 min snack will turn to 3 hours lounging, listen to the ocean or ambient background music.

If you want to SUP on the south coast make sure to drop in - several different models available to rent, or you can do the sunset trip. Plus they have delicious and varied fruit juices / smoothies. The owners are taking a lead on environmental responsibility too, from arranging SUP litter collection trips to use of recycled wood in the furniture.

SUPer Juice Bar & Super SUP is a must do in Unawatuna. The menu has so many healthy and really tasty options. They also have many SUP trips to choose from or board rentals. Its a great operation and I would highly recommend them.

We had a fantastic time at this hotel. It's directly on the beach, so swimming is super convenient and the kids loved it. The restaurant is good, and having breakfast in the sand was a lovely experience. The staff was very friendly; we ordered an airport transfer via the hotel as well as a number of trips to Sharjah, Ella, and Udawalawe. The hotel organised everything, which was super convenient.

It's a nice spot, especially later in the afternoon. I wasn't too impressed with the food, I had the rice and curry, it wasn't bad but I didn't find it super tasty, especially considering the price. Portion was huge though, it can feed 2 (but I was only one so prefer to get a bit less for less money).

We had some food here, the burger didnt have much taste but the following day we got some fish and it was very good. I give a 4 stars bc location is nice and at least 1 day I was stisfied with the food
Don’t know for the quality of other dishes, but Seafood burger and Passion fruit Mohito are absolute best!!! Also the view is great and waiters are nice! Had a lovely evening
Amazing experience in this hotel. The personal is completely friendly, you feel like in home. Thank you so much for all ☺️
Great little comfortable rooms, clean and great proprietors, staff and the best curries ever had in Sri Lanka, and we've been 5 times!! Unbeatable prices for food.

It's actually a hotel and a restaurant. We have stayed in the hotel. It has some comfortable rooms with a high ceiling. Also a very spacious bathroom. The owner is very friendly and we have really enjoyed our stay. Wifi was working in the restaurant but unfortunately the wifi access point near our room wasn't working properly. Nevertheless, a great stay!
Nice staff, good value breakfasts (non-guests welcome). The breads are delicious and homemade, along with good strong coffee.
Very good place to stay! We had a great time during our 3 day-stay! Perfect stuff and tasty food! Good ubication (near beach and everyday-life). Highly recomended!
Adorable place; very hospitable owners and helper; clean room no trouble, nice hot water; excellent breakfast 👍🏻perfect location

This place has been around forever & a gem of Unawatuna.

It was after a very long time we came here for dinner & oh my god we loved it!

We had the rice & curry as that's what they are known for & it was DELICIOUS!

Super impressed with the menu overall.

And what an ice cream menu! Wow!

We were super full but just had to try the homemade blueberry ice cream. It wasn't as creamy but tasted good! Will most definitely be back!

Spent 4 nights here as a family and never wanted to leave.
Beautiful location right on the beach, modern clean and excellent rooms, great top quality food but the beat bit is the staff.
They are so kind and helpful.
4 days is not enough.
You will not be disappointed!

We had an incredible dining experience at Sun Sea Hotel Restaurant. While the atmosphere and service were wonderful, the absolute highlight of our visit was the food.
The Best Woodfired Pizza
I don’t say this lightly: the woodfired oven pizzas here are the best we’ve ever tasted. You can tell they use high-quality, fresh ingredients, and that authentic wood-fired crust provides the perfect crunch and smoky finish. It’s clearly the star of the show!

I spent 3 nights here in December 2025. This small hotel has a rich history and great charm. The owner, Kasy Wickeamasuriya, is a passionate hotelier. Always checking with us and staff to make sure that we were happy with the service.
This was our first hotel stay in our month long trip. I must say that the staff set the bar very high for our expectations for the rest of the tour.
Thanks to all for giving us a memorable time at your boutique hotel.

Our granddaughter on holiday with two friends visiting Sri lanka had booked this hotel for me and my wife. It was a very pleasant experience for us and our granddaughter and friends. Ideal safe location for sea bathing.The staff was very friendly and accommodating.

We had a very unpleasant experience at Unawatuna Guest. As locals, we were treated with clear disrespect from the moment we arrived. The owner was incredibly rude and made us feel unwelcome, going so far as to ask us to pack up our things without any reasonable explanation. It was disheartening to be treated so poorly in our own country, especially at a place that claims to offer hospitality. I would not recommend this place to anyone, especially local travelers looking for a friendly and respectful environment.

The room is perfect for the price. Spacious enough, cozy, and with all the amenities that you might need for a few days (fridge, AC, shower, hot water, clothes hanger to dry out clothes, balcony, etc.)

The owner is super friendly and he owns a Cafe shop just underneath the guest house. Perfect for grabbing breakfast and coffee right before you go to the beach.

Speaking of going to the beach, it's only about a 10 minute walk away from Unawatuna Guest. And on the way, you can find many small shops, food places, ice cream vendors, and so on.

I would have loved to stay here for more days, but we had to leave to visit other cities.

Highly recommend. Have fun!

Really lovely stay in the middle of Unawatuna. The room was spacious and the balcony was massive! Great shower with hot water and air con worked perfectly in the room. They also had a space right out the front where we could park our tuktuk, which was really convenient.

Centrally located to cafes, restaurants and a short walk to the beach. Recommend the coffee at the downstairs cafe too 😊
I didn’t stay here, Because I bargained before I went, the boss's reply after he agreed made me feel uncomfortable. Girls, please consider it on your own. The conversation is as shown in the picture.

Located right next to the road that leads towards the beach and all the restaurants. But it also located next to the main road which means a lot of noise. Especially the bathroom which seems to have no sound proofing at all because when standing in the bathroom it is just as if you are standing next to the road. The bathroom also houses his own ant colony which get into the apartment's bathroom even if you close the window. Don't leave your food in the room!! Put it in the fridge because otherwise you will have ants crawling over your bed at night.

Besides the noise and the ants, the room is perfect. It is spacious, has a shared balcony, a ceiling fan, air conditioner, mosquito net, mini fridge, hot shower and even a little table and some chairs. The WiFi also worked great besides the scheduled power outages. The mattress could use an upgrade though since it's very hard. I had no contact with the host whatsoever, only when giving me the key during check-in so I can't comment on his hospitality.

Really good seafood, fresh and well cooked, and the location is hard to beat, right on the beach with easy beach access, which makes the whole experience even better.

The staff were super friendly and welcoming, service was relaxed but attentive. Portion sizes are generous, especially for the price, and overall the pricing is very reasonable compared to similar beachfront places.

Perfect spot for a chilled meal by the sea, whether it’s lunch or dinner. Good food, good vibes, and great value. Would definitely come back again.

I had a wonderful experience at this restaurant in Unawatuna. The food was fresh, full of flavor, and beautifully presented. The staff were very friendly, attentive, and made us feel truly welcome. The atmosphere was relaxing with a lovely coastal vibe—perfect for enjoying a meal by the beach. Definitely one of the best places to eat in Unawatuna. Highly recommended!

Lovely staff. Good prices. Had cold beers with frozen glasses, followed by some really lovely cocktails. There is even a happy hour for cocktails, making them even better value. Food menu looks reasonable, although didn't eat on this occasion.

Nice café on the beach! They offer free sunbeds and towels if you take something to eat. The food was delicious, we really enjoyed it! However, the washroom and the the changing room were in poor condition.

We had an amazing meal here! The fried rice was full of flavor and perfectly cooked, and the prawn noodles were fresh, juicy, and delicious. The fried calamari was crispy on the outside and tender inside – definitely a must-try. I also had a coconut
mojito, and it was super refreshing, the perfect balance of king coconut, mint and lime. Great food, friendly service, and a nice atmosphere. Highly recommend!

Great place--the superior and deluxe rooms are lovely, the staff friendly and helpful, and the breakfast truly good. VW is up atop a little hill, surrounded by greenery--has. a beautiful Bali vibe. Beds are great--the only recommendation I have for them is to get fluffier pillows! Great place, great value!!
Good rooms. All personal hospitable and friendly. Very tasty food in restaurant
Amazing service and attention to detail, very helpful organizing trips to visit sites and tours. I highly recommend you stay here if you like to relax and enjoy!
Good size room . Good breakfast. Location is perfect just a few minutes walk to the beach.

It was our second time staying in the villa. This year we stayed for a month. The villa is only 5 minutes away from the beautiful beach, at the same time it is away from busy roads, it was very quiet. We watched monkeys jumping on the trees from the balcony and listened to the tropical birds. Rooms are equipped with air conditioners, some have kitchen. Our room was cleaned with love every day. But the main germ was family like caring atmosphere in the villa. Many guests had breakfasts together in the common area, sometimes even dinners. We met people from the last year and made some new friends. We truly felt ourselves like being at home. We would like to thank the owner and the host for always being there for us, all our needs and requests. It was very relaxing and stress free vacation. We are looking forward coming here again.

formatted_address: 147/A, Yakdehi Mulla Road, Unawatuna, Sri Lanka
name: Chili Cafe Guest House

reviews.text: This place has the best food we've experienced in Unawatuna and Dalawella! If you want Rice and Curry it's good to order it one hour before you come, grilled tuna is also great and deviled meal as well. Cool, cozy, very nice AND all at great price!!

The best place where you can eat very tasty food, have a drink and find new best friends from whole world!!!
Respect to owner and all guys that are working there.
Real Buddhist company!
Sube petum, yalua and majan)

Most realaxing cafe in.unawatuna absolut a visit word . The realaxing style is something that you have to se for your self. Best regards Henrik and Kicki from Denmark. Looking forward to meet you Again Jaminja. Please say hello to all your friends😊😎😘 see you soon..
Amazing bar! Great cocktails for very good price. Great music. Clean and serves food, as well.
The workers beat a dog and threw it into the ocean in front of all the guests. When asked why they beat the dog the workers just laughed. Do not eat here or support these low life's.

We had a fabulous meal here tonight! The grilled chicken with rosemary potatoes and mushrooms was perfect and the grilled pumpkin was excellent. The cakes here are to die for and we can really recommend the lemon meringue tart, chocolate eclairs and also the coconut ones... The coffee is also very good. We will definitely return here as it was easily the best food we have had in Unawatuna and we would urge you to visit and try the cakes and food...

top top top(not enough words to describe how happy i am with h this place !!!they have the best best coffee makers in sri lanka no doubt and their food and drinks are also full of flavour and freshness..but what really stands out is their people and their service full of plenty goodvibes smiles and humour i really had fun with the.thank you guys i sincerely apprreciate it🙏🏻🫶🇱🇰🇵🇹 and have to mention all of them but specially:the names on the photo on case wrong spelling 😇 ***** Hasara/Thashara/Dhamith/Chamoth

We stopped by because of good reviews and we were surprised by how good it was. We also ordered Matcha iced latte which was also great. We definitely will stop by again. If you are considering your visit, give it a try, you will not regret😁

We ordered the salmon egg Benedict and the Nicosia Egg Benedict, both of which were really tasty, the food wasn’t late, however I asked initially for my eggs to be well done and it wasn’t when it came, so I had to wait for the new one for some time, but at the end they gave me a new plate where everything was fresh and hot. We also had their ice latte and ice flat white which were both nice 👍🏻

Excellent Good , clean ,safe food!
Good vibes and atmosphere.
Wifi mediocre. Cell  service poor.
They have take away coffee cups!

Clean loo! Also extra sinks near tables  to wash hands prior to eating.
Will return.

Best place to have a rest on the Unawatuna Beach, perfect service, one of waitress was really helpful and caring. We ordered jumbo prawns, calamari and sea food soups. Everything was delicious. Thank you guys for good time!😁
Good beer and location not sadly very disappointing food. 😔

В ресторане все вкусно. Шеф готовит свой фирменный соус, подходит почти под любые блюда. Приготовит что угодно. Рыбу словленную на рыбалке, или кусок мяса за небольшую плату. Чего нибудь добавит в блюдо, или уберёт по вашему желантю. Профессионал! Разогреет если остыло. Днем обслуживают официанты, молодые симпатичные девченки, вечером после 9-10 на столики, к заседевшимся гостям, выносят подсвечники, зажигают свечи и тушат основное освещение. Романтично очень! В баре работает бармен Паси, всегда приветливый, отзывчивый, делает разнообразные коктейли, включает современную не навязчивую музыку.

The wait time for my order was two hours. They forgot to bring one dish, so I waited another hour.
They brought the wrong soup.
The lounge chairs are spaced 10 cm apart, with no room to walk through.
There are a lot of wait staff, but that doesn't solve anything.
Avoid here.

A decent beach cafe, the food is acceptable. The pizza isn't worth it, but everything else is good. The negative reviews are probably old. We've been here three times and everything is fine, no one got food poisoning. The cafe has showers, a changing room, decent sun loungers, and overall, the service is decent. There's Wi-Fi.

formatted_address: Welle Dewalaya Rd, Unawatuna 80600, Sri Lanka
name: Seaview Deepal Villa

reviews.text:
The location is really good just few meters away from the Unawatuna beach. Rooms also good for the price. We went there 4 of our friends.

But the service is really bad. When we called them they said 10k per one night for a family room. Once we got there they said 12k. But finally they gave it for 10k.

Receptionist girl was really helpful but the Manager or the owner or some guy who was there like the owner, seems like don’t care about their customers. Not even a smile. May be his doesn’t care mood only for the local customers as some of these hotel people are expecting only foreigners. We felt like they don’t care about locals.

Moreover they didn’t even gave us a single water bottle even if we asked from him. They should learn what is customer services specifically the guy who was there like an owner and respect the local customers.

Spent a well earned vacation with Friends.
Simply loved the location! Doesn't get much better than sipping a chilled beer watching the sunset in the Indian ocean with good food and good conversation!
They have a breakfast buffet, which is pretty good. Lunch and dinner can be ordered from the restaurant on the beach. It's a simple menu, but yummy!
Rooms were quite big (which was surprising) and comfortable. The staff were very friendly and helpful.
Overall, a good place to stay with easy access to the lovely unawatuna beach!
In my opinion, this place is worth the money you pay.

We stayed there for 3 nights in the beginning of September. The room was spacious and the location was great - only few metres away from the beach and near by many restaurants and bars. The staff was very friendly as well. But the bathroom/toilet was terrible. Everything was rusty and the toilet was broken, we literally had to ask for a bucket to use during our stay. Also the shower was in one corner of the bathroom, so after showering the bathroom was full of water that wouldn't go away. Totally unacceptable.

The photos and reality are 2 different things. We booked 2 bedroom bungalow but didnt stayed there because the condition is under every level. Everything is old and rusty.
We asked to change rooms and they offered little bit better room but still it was far from good condition.
The breakfast is something terrible here. I do not recommend this hotel.

Stay 2 nights at this hotel located near the beach. The hotel/resort was at my time under construction and had maintenance. My stay was off season in this period. The resort was good and the room I slept was good and nice for me. I had an good view and breakfast was good. I think after the maintenance this resort is looking very good. There is plenty to do in the surrounding. Nice place to visit is White Jungle Beach and of course Galle. I enjoyed my time here and can recommend it to other travelers. Micheal from The Netherlands

formatted_address: Guruge Watta, Yaddehimulla Rd,, Unawatuna 80600, Sri Lanka
name: La Villa Unawatuna

reviews.text:
Disrespectful hypocritical owners. When you move in they are all smiling and nice. They have a car and the husband is like, you are my best friend, imagine that you have a car, just tell me where to drop you off and stuff like that. His English is bad , so he speaks sinhala to google translate and then makes you listen it back in English or Russian, and often it doesn't make sense at all.
We didn't book online, we came on foot and asked to stay over for 9 nights (we originally had a package tour, but the hotel was awful  so we had to move). The landlady agreed, we confirmed the price 52 thousand Roupies, gave her 2000 as a deposit.
We moved in next day. Our agent managed to solve our problems with the package hotel and we had to move again. When we told them, that we had to cancel the booking and leave after one night, our "best friend" became almost a gangster. He shouted in my face, pointed his fingers into my face, came very close, hit his fist on the table next to me, saying I was damaging his  business and it was against the law. How could this be when we never signed an official agreement and he didn't take our passport details. I wonder if he pays taxes at all. And like he has all these loans he has to pay back, as if it were my problem.
We were ready to stay one night, and maybe give a little compensation for the inconvenience, but they wanted all the 52000! Though we would not be staying in their hotel at all. And like in all the countries it would be like this. I said, that in Normal countries  the customer is always right.
So we didn't stay there even one night and paid 7000 Roupies (about 8$), but it was the worst experience in my life. Actually the price per night is 6000, but we agreed on a little discount,  5700 per  night. When paying all agreements were forgotten and the owners not only didn't give us the discount but also we never got 1000 change either.  Never was I so screamed at and insulted in service.

The room was rather small and the matrass was too soft, probably got the cheapest available. If you have back aches probably not the best option.

We loved our stay here. Friendly and helpful hosts, clean and comfy room with good AC and in a peaceful location set one road back from the busy beach street surrounded by lush trees and birds. We loved the terrace area and the home cooked dinner too!

We thought it was a good place to stay, very quiet and well presented. Although having to pay upfront on arrival for the 2 nights stay made us feel untrustworthy , obviously the owner has had a bad experience with people walking out without paying. The owner could be seen as overly helpful.
But we thought for the money it was well worth it . I had the best night sleep there.

beautiful terrace and welcoming hosts at first. i wanted to take a shower and i cleaned the floors of the bathroom a bit (dead insects and some other dirt - cleanliness should be ensured before guests arrive), and then this is what i saw. i left the place because the one room i was staying in had all these insects, and in the other room the fan didn’t work. the host did want to show me another room but i was really disgusted and just wanted to leave at that point. also, i didn’t get any of my money back (8.50USD), the owner explaining that “i’m not buying the place so i could just spend the night and leave tomorrow”. also, they asked for me to pay the room as soon as i got there, which didn’t happen at any other accomodation.

*aircon was not even an option, when i asked the host said that there is a fan that can be used and it’s “not that hot” (31°C)

i do not recommend this place and i can now understand the bad reviews. i really didn’t want to write this at first but this is really not ok. unfortunately, i disagree with “you get what you paid for” because i’ve stayed at other well-placed accomodations (same price) in sri lanka and they were impeccable. i’m hoping that this review will motivate them to improve the conditions.

The rooms were very very bad. No proper step to get into the room, they had placed stones to be used as a step. The view was washing machines and dirty cothes on arrival. Won't recommend this place to anyone. Bathroom was terrible.

We went there 3 or 4 times during our vacation, even if the place was located pretty far from us. Cheapest price for a beer on a beach, food is all fresh and cooked in front of you, a lot of seafood in the meals. Also there are monkeys living around the cafe and the stuff gives you bananas to feed them, and it’s a very cute entertainment too. The stuff also advices you to take a look at the viewpoint and it’s very spectacular and free. Amazing place, we have been a company of 4 people and we always enjoyed food and drinks there. Very friendly stuff also.

I had my lunch during my last visit to Unawatuna. Nice restaurant, calm environment, good people. Meal prices were really reasonable and had large portion sizes. I had a grilled tuna fish and chips along with a salad side. Also tried Calamari dish with a fried rice. They take card and cash both. Staff is friendly and supportive.

Excellent place with delicious food, reasonable prices, and friendly staff. We have visited this place several times for dinner and we always enjoy it. It's worth walking here from the main street with all the beach cafés. Last time we took 1kg of shrimps for 2 and we barely could stand up from the table.

Nice place, welcoming people work there.
Prices're good, food's tasty, portions are pretty big, one dish is enough to be full.
Waiting time is approximately 10-15 minutes.
Recommended
P.S. they always gave us small sweet bananas as a gift, so cute :3

Love this place! Food is as good as anywhere in the area - very reasonably priced with good portion sizes!

There are also a few monkeys that play in the trees above the restaurant and the staff will kindly give you a banana to feed them 😅

formatted_address: Dalawella, Matara Rd, Unawatuna, Sri Lanka
name: Sevonra Beach Resort

reviews.text:
My wife and I stayed at the Sevonra Beach Resort in Delawella for 2 weeks in February.
The location of the hotel is conveniently within walking distance for the local beaches and restaurants.

We found the hotel food and drinks menu catered for a wide range of tastes at lunch and dinner and we were greeted a friendly service at the Restaurant throughout our stay at the hotel.  They also  provided us with much needed breakfast bags when we started off early on our day trips.

The rooms in the hotel were all modern, bright, clean and spacious with air conditioning. We stayed in 3 different rooms during our fortnightly stay and by far the best was our room with a balcony facing the ocean.

I would especially like to thank all the staff in the restaurant and especially Sharukh on the reception desk for looking after us during our stay.

“An exceptional experience! The food was absolutely outstanding, and the service provided by Aammond was warm, attentive, and highly professional. HK Dilan ensured that all arrangements were flawlessly organised. My sincere thanks to Sevonra and the entire team for creating such a truly memorable experience. Highly recommended!” ❤️👌

We had a wonderful stay at the Sevonra Beach Resort, Unawatuna. The hotel was exceptionally clean and well maintained throughout our stay. The staff were extremely friendly, helpful, and always ready to assist, which made our experience even more pleasant.

The breakfast buffet was excellent, with a great variety of delicious options to start the day. One of the best features of this resort is the direct access to the beach, which was absolutely beautiful and very convenient.

The roadside access to the hotel was also very easy, making travel hassle-free. The swimming pool was another big plus and was well maintained. We booked a family room with sea view, and the view was stunning and perfect for a relaxing stay.

Overall, a fantastic place to stay in Unawatuna. Highly recommended for anyone looking for a comfortable beachside getaway!

We had a wonderful experience! The service from Ahamad was excellent — very friendly and attentive. The food was really good, full of flavour, and the pool area was great too. Overall, a fantastic place to relax and enjoy. Highly recommend!

A heartfelt thank you to Mr. Praneeth Dodallage, Manager at Sevonra Beach Hotel, for the warm hospitality and excellent service. Your support and attention to detail truly made our stay memorable. We appreciate the effort you and your team put in to ensure everything was perfect. 🌸

This cooking class was an absolutely incredible experience! It wasn't just a lesson; it was a warm welcome into a beautiful family home. The setting was stunning, peaceful, and felt so authentic.
​Our teacher was the kindest and most talented person—she made everything so easy to understand and shared all her secrets for the perfect curry. Without a doubt, it was the best food I’ve had in Sri Lanka! If you want to learn how to cook with love and experience true Sri Lankan hospitality, you cannot miss this. Highly, highly recommended!

Nice cooking class by the friendly and knowledgeable Susanthi. We met at the market with another couple to receive information about different products and went on to choose our own veggies and fish for the class, which was lovely. The tuktuk from the market in Galle to the class location was arranged and included in the price.

The cooking itself felt a little bit more like assisting Susanthi (mostly cutting and adding spices to the pan) with the collective dishes than being in charge of our own meal but it was fun regardless.

Since I cannot eat spicy foods, it was nice that some portions were taken apart for me before chillies were added to the pan so the others could still enjoy some spiciness, and we all had what we liked.

One thing we did found quite disappointing was that we were not offered to take the leftovers home. We cooked a lot of food and enjoyed our lunch but then never saw the big amount of leftovers again. When we informed about this, Susanthi said we should've asked earlier because the staff had already cleared everything (but had no doggy bags anyway). But we assumed that they were packing it up for the two couples to take home. She offered to see if she could still find some food and containers but at that point we felt too surprised and obliged.  Maybe this was a wrong assumption but I personally found it very strange since we've been offered doggy bags everywhere in Sri Lanka and did collectively spent 44.000 rupees on the class as well as the food.

Overall, it was a fun activity and we enjoyed the company.

The cooking class was the best I’ve ever had! We went by Tuk Tuk to the fish market and also bought some vegetables and fruits. Everything was explained very good and every question was answerd:) After we cooked 5 different currys with the vegetables and the tuna we choose. On request we could even make Coconut Sambol by ourselves:) The food tasted amazing! The people were absolute lovely! Would recommend this experience everyone!

Amazing experience! We started the morning with a fun visit to the local markets to buy fresh ingredients, which was already a great experience on its own. After that, we learned how to prepare delicious Sri Lankan dishes step by step. The host was fantastic, the location beautiful, and the family incredibly warm and welcoming. Highly recommended for anyone visiting Sri Lanka!

Such a lovely cooking class! We went to the veg and fish market to choose our ingredients which was so fun. Sushanthi is truly a beautiful person and I loved hearing her stories and having her share her cooking knowledge. The food was absolutely delicious and if I’d have spent more time in Unawatuna I would have gone back to eat a number of times! I did this class on a rainy day which was perfect and the kitchen was on a higher floor which a view of beautiful greenery. Definitely recommend!

formatted_address: Meepegewatta, Maharamba Rd, Unawatuna 80600, Sri Lanka
name: SP Unawatuna Lodge Guest House

reviews.text: Lovely place. Not far from  unawatuna beach..
the best restoran and "aurvedha massage place.
This is not a guest house. It's our company staff house. 😂
Good place

formatted_address: Dalawella, unawatuna, 2735+763, A2, Unawatuna 80600, Sri Lanka
name: Villa Pinthaliya

reviews.text:
The location offers breathtaking views, and the rooms are spacious and comfortable. You’ll be captivated the moment Sunil and his wonderful staff welcome you—they truly make you feel at home.

Every morning began with an amazing breakfast, and on request, Sunil prepares an unbelievable dinner that you simply must try. I cannot recommend this place enough. As a family, we made unforgettable memories here, and I’m already looking forward to coming back again.

Lovely location right next to beach. Great service and amazing breakfast. The entire place has 3 rooms which are comfortable. The pool is nice for a dip. The best part of closeness to the beach which makes it easy for you to enjoy the waves or go for a walk on the sand. Sunil and team are helpful. Breakfast is very good and Sunil asks your preferences and makes tasty food!

Wonderful place right by the ocean. When we first arrived, the smell of cinnamon oil was overpowering. We had to open all doors to air the rooms. (the smell wore off eventually and you could smell the musty air after that). The rooms itself were well made, decor was pleasant and the bathroom was huge. There was a huge ceiling fan which made a really loud noise like a banging drum at night so we could not use it haha. Breakfast was delicious, we had freshly made pol roti, sambol, eggs any way you want, tea and coffee, fresh fruits and loads of toast and jam. The caretakers were friendly and always have a big smile on their faces. The small pool was really excellent for dipping, it was under the shade of a beautiful tree where you could see squirrels running around. The best part was sleeping at night and waking up to the sound of the crashing waves of the ocean. Would definitely come here again 😊
Nice place! Waterfront property with less popular part of the beach. Bugs were a little out of control at night. Staff made food or coffee daily. They were excellent.
Wonderful villa! The staff is amazing and so helpful! Perfect location between Unawatuna and all the great surfspots. Will stay here again!

name: Dalawella Beach Resort in Unawatuna, Galle

reviews.text:
From the moment we arrived, Dalawella Beach Resort felt peaceful and welcoming. The sound of the ocean and the fresh sea breeze made it such a calming place to spend time. It’s in a beautiful spot, perfect for quiet walks along the beach and enjoying the sunsets.

The staff were thoughtful and made our stay very comfortable. A genuinely relaxing break in a lovely part of Sri Lanka.

We had a great stay at Dalawella Beach Resort over New Year’s. The traditional Sri Lankan food and oil candle ceremony on January 1st were a beautiful experience.
The staff was incredibly kind, but Rumesh deserves a special mention — he is our favorite person we met in Sri Lanka. He was extremely attentive to our needs, especially regarding my dietary restrictions, and went above and beyond to make sure I felt comfortable. He even served me several dishes prepared by his own family, which made the experience feel very personal and heartfelt.
On our last night, we were incredibly lucky to witness turtles laying their eggs on the beach. Even though it was after 11 PM, the hotel staff knocked on our door to invite us to the beach to see this spectacular and unforgettable moment.
We felt truly welcomed and would highly recommend this place.

Been travelling around Sri Lanka for the last 2 weeks staying at 6 different beach resorts.
The rooms at Dalawalla beach resort are the best I've had in that whole time. Very spacious, spotlessly clean and lovely balcony overlooking the beach.
Great location with a great beach right outside the restaurant.
Can't recommend enough and would happily come back here again.
Beautiful beachfront stay in a peaceful part of Unawatuna. Amazing ocean views, friendly staff, and great food right by the sea. Perfect for relaxing and switching off. Would happily stay again!

We stayed at Dalawella Beach Resort for one day and one night and had a very pleasant experience. The service was very good, the rooms were clean and comfortable, and the atmosphere was relaxing. The sea-view restaurant is a highlight, offering a great view and a peaceful vibe. Overall, a nice place to stay by the beach.

One of the nicest beach restaurants in Unawatuna. The food is very good and delicious. The beach here is safe for swimming, as the water is shallow.
The best part is that there are turtles in this area, and you can see them up close. Beach boys sell sea leaves, which you can use to feed the turtles. There are also some corals, making it a good place for snorkeling.
Please be careful and do not harm the turtles or corals.

Beautiful Beach place to have a sunset view with food and drinks. They have the turtles by the Beach , It is nice but if you hear this place because of It , don't expect that they are free, some people can be  unrespectful  the turtles and It was sad to see. Still, I know this place is not about turtles, I just went to Wijaya Beach Restaurant because I heard they have the turtles by the Beach and pizza. Therefore, the service was great.

Went there because the location and someone here mentioned about the pizzas.

Location is amazing with a view on the upper level. The food isn’t anything special, but okay if you are not expecting too much. Eat, drink and enjoy the beautiful calm beach.

One of our favorite restaurants in Unawatuna, and this was our second visit. Simply sitting on the open rooftop is a pleasure in itself, and the staff are incredibly friendly and professional.

When it comes to the food, our first visit delighted us with the tuna pizza and the chicken mushroom pasta. On our second visit, we truly enjoyed the seafood pizza and happily repeated the pasta experience, which amazed us once again.

We will definitely be coming back

Wijaya Beach is hands down one of our favorite restaurants whenever we visit the south! The atmosphere is laid-back and beautiful, right by the beach, making it the perfect spot to relax and enjoy a great meal. Their pizza is absolutely delicious — fresh, wood-fired, and full of flavor. In fact, it’s one of the best we’ve had in the area.

Apart from the pizza, they also offer a great variety of seafood and other dishes that are equally impressive. The service is friendly and efficient, and the overall vibe of the place is warm and welcoming. Whether you're stopping by for lunch, dinner, or just a drink by the beach, Wijaya Beach never disappoints. Definitely a must-visit every time you’re in the south!

We enjoyed a delicious rice and curry buffet here, with plenty of varieties and tasty vegetable curries for reasonable price. The staff were very friendly, and the food had great flavor. The place also has a beautiful large garden surrounded by greenery.

If you’re in Thalpe or Unawatuna, this is one of the best buffets to try.😋🍽️

I had both lunch and dinner at The Garden Hotel in Unawatuna, and the food was super delicious 🤤🍽️ Everything tasted fresh and full of flavor. I really enjoyed my meals and had a great dining experience. Definitely a place I’d recommend if you’re in Unawatuna! 🌞🌊✨

I had such a great experience at this hotel! The lunch buffet was absolutely delicious with a wide variety of dishes to choose from—everything from fresh salads and soups to flavorful mains and perfectly made desserts. The food was well-prepared, beautifully presented, and kept replenished throughout. I especially loved how there were options for both local flavors and international favorites, so everyone could find something they enjoyed. The staff were attentive and friendly, making the whole dining experience even better. Definitely one of the highlights of my stay✨

Not recommended.
