The coconut sambol was spoiled when we visited around 1:30 PM. We noticed it only after it had already been placed on our plate from the buffet. When we informed the staff, the person in charge said it was because it had been prepared in the morning. 😂👍

Had my best lunch buffet at Garden Hotel, Unawatuna 🌿✨
So many tasty dishes and everything was super fresh 😋 The place has a nice, relaxing vibe and the staff were really friendly 👍😊 Totally enjoyed the experience and would 100% recommend it for a great lunch buffet! 🍛🥗🍰

formatted_address: N.788, 788 Matara Rd, Talpe, Sri Lanka
name: Owl and the Pussycat Hotel & Restaurant

reviews.text:
My mother and I stayed at the Owl & The Pussycat for three nights and were totally blown away by this hotel.
He
It is absolutely beautiful - the decor of the whole place is stunning and is probably the nicest boutique hotel we have ever stayed in. The location is superb - right on the coast and you wake up to the sound of the waves every morning. The rooms are so quaintly decorated and the beds are enormous!

We stayed in one room for our first night but were very kindly moved to a sea view room by the manager for the other two nights. It was a lovely surprise as we didn’t request this! It really felt that the staff here went above and beyond for us. Every staff member working here was so helpful, friendly and warm.

Breakfast at the hotel was lovely - a little limited but we never mind this. We had lunch one day and dinner another and both times food and drink was delicious.

My mother had an early morning flight and the management made her a packed breakfast/ lunch which was a really lovely touch.

I honestly couldn’t recommend this hotel enough. It was a very special place to spend the last few days of our trip together and we would love to come back one day.

My wife and I have just spent 3 wonderful evenings at the Owl and the Pussycat. We stayed in Bong Tree room which was really nice and spacious, with everything provided to make your stay memorable! The veranda with its swing chair was a treat. Every member of staff were friendly, helpful and just super lovely. Food was really nice too and the cocktails hit the spot. Can’t speak more highly of this hotel and would strongly recommend it.

Despite other reviews, the food was horrendously inedible. None of my friends were able to enjoy their meals. Everything was overcooked, hard, and seemingly from a can or frozen. The iced tea had no ice. They strongly advertise on their website that they cater to vegans, yet after several conversations with different confused staff, my friends were served a “vegan” burger (just potatoes) with cheese + mayo and a sad gazpacho. Service was inattentive and slow (almost 2 hours for lunch! and the place was empty). We were brought 1 menu for 4 people and they didn’t bring a drink menu until we asked. DO NOT waste your money here until management overhauls the restaurant. Until then, it’s fake and flashy advertising of the worst food in the area.

We had one of the best stays of our Sri Lanka trip at Owl and the Pussycat. The staff went above and beyond to make my husband’s birthday unforgettable they upgraded our room, surprised us with a beautiful cake, and made us feel truly cared for. The hotel itself is very artistic, filled with books to read, and unique arts and crafts that give it such a warm, creative charm. The surroundings are stunning, with Turtle Beach just a few steps away and a peaceful atmosphere all around. Everything from the hospitality to the setting made our stay so special. Highly recommend this hotel for anyone looking for comfort, character, and unforgettable memories.

This is an overrated hotel. It has a shallow swimming pool, a beach that does not exist, rooms that are substandard and a leaking roof. No telephone in the room, a fridge and kettle that are outside in the corridor, shared with another room. The decor is interesting, but that is where the curiosity ends.

Fantastic stay at Nooit Gedacht Heritage Hotel Unawatuna. I visited recently with my family and we were fortunate enough to stay at the Governer's Room - complete with some antique furniture and a stunning bathroom with a claw foot bathtub. The room felt a bit dated and we initially had some issues with the plumbing and air conditioning but these were promptly fixed by the team. Breakfasts were good, with decent variety and the chef prepared special breakfast as per our requirements one morning. Again, where we had feedback, this was looked at and fixed promptly. The facility is very big and beautiful - the pool is very nice and there is a lovely walking trail that leads to the beach. Overall, nice location, feels quiet despite being at the main road and is quite close to Unawatuna beach and the main street with eateries and activities.

The room was an ok size.  There was a TV and small fridge. The ac was a little old but effective.  There's also a ceiling fan for added comfort.
The bathroom was OK but needs more ventilation as it gets very humid and remains so for quite sometime.  There's plenty of condensation build up and it shows on the condition of the walls.
For some reason the sink is very small and quite low down.
The service was great.  Reception and breakfast staff are nice, as are most people in Sri Lanka.
The buffet breakfast was very good.
The hotel is in the main A2 road going along the coast. It's set back from this main road meaning you don't here too much traffic from within the hotel.
The local "strip" is a minute away and just near there is access to the beach.
The hotel has a lovely 25m pool. It's kept clean regularly.  I didn't have a chance to try the spa.

The greatest surprise in terms of accomodation in Sri Lanka 🇱🇰 the property is surreal, dating from the 18th century. Couldn’t recommend it high enough because this is a peaceful heritage gem in Unawatuna. We simply loved our stay at Nooit Gedacht Heritage Hotel. The colonial architecture and lush gardens create a serene, old-world charm that’s hard to find.

Our room was spacious and clean, with a lovely balcony view and AC + a fan. The pool was a great bonus and the staff were incredibly warm and helpful. Highly recommend for anyone looking to relax in a historic setting with modern comfort.

We had an incredible stay in the hotel, we couldn't it enjoy it more. The hotel have an amazing swimming pool, it was the antique residence of the Dutch governor hundreds years ago. You can see many monkeys, squirrels on their property. The staff is extremely helpful, the breakfast buffet was delicious. It has all facilities and we enjoyed our stay a lot. Great value for money, a few minutes walking from the Unawatuna beach and next to all restaurants. 100% recommended.

Very well-located with easy access to the Unawatuna beach. Lots of restaurants, bars, shops and currency exchange bureaucracies along the way.
Rooms are nice and clean.
Bar and restaurant services are great. They offer a quite decent menu with variety of local and regional cuisine.
Pool is cleaned daily after use.

We loved Black Beauty Guesthouse! The room we booked was very comfortable and the toilet was clean too with running hot water. The room we selected was with the garden view. Britta, the owner, was very friendly and courteous.

The pool was marvelous! You can use it till 7 pm because afterward they treat it.

Black Beauty Guesthouse is a pet friendly place. We had the company of Britta's two Labradors; Bella and Sudu. They kept us company by running around the pool.

I would recommend this place if you are staying in Unawatuna and it's very close to popular restaurants such as Wijaya Beach. It's  great value for money, secure and clean.

Just got here. Very peaceful place a few hundred meters off the beach. There`s a pool and rooftop resturant. Best to tell them early if you want dinner. Everything is very well maintained and staff very helpful and kind. Only complaint is the wifi on the third floor is very weak. Paying 3000rupees a night, lovely view and each room has an outside sitting area.
Update: Been here three days now staff have been great, very genuine guys. September is a quiet time in Unawatuna, which I find very relaxing.

Old Guesthouse... Need  a good renovation.

Service Staff. Friendly

Bedroom. Bed with Mosquitoes net

Bathroom not really clean. Saw few ass hairs on the floor
Provided with towels.

Poor WiFi, always disconecting, good for Chat not for Youtube.

Quiet place. Free car park.

Such a beautiful place to stay! Clean, not expensive, good location. Beach is right after crossing the road. Supermarket n wine shop r near. Good that it's not in the centre so it makes this place quiet n comfortable! Obviously will suggest to everyone!

Good value for money.
Very friendly people.
Good service and atmosphere.
Nice pool.
Clean room (2nd floor with sea view).
Only minus is the busy road but you can hardly hear it.

I had a great experience at this hotel. The staff were incredibly friendly and welcoming, which made my stay even more enjoyable. The room had a beautiful sea view and was clean and comfortable. I also loved the big pool — perfect for relaxing and enjoying the sunny weather. Overall, a fantastic stay and I would definitely come back again

I recently stayed at Sanmira Renaissance Hotel with my friends, and we really enjoyed the experience. The environment was clean and relaxing, the staff was very helpful, and the facilities were impressive. It’s a perfect place for a getaway, and I would happily visit again. Highly recommended for anyone looking for comfort and a peaceful stay!

We went just for lunch. It was a wonderful place—excellent seafood preparation, a beautiful view with warm sandy beach access across the road, and above all, very welcoming and attentive staff.
Thank you
Lal Mendis

Good location. Staff is friendly.
Room is clean, but very basic.
No daily housekeeping unless you ask for it.
Food is not bad but very basic (at least the breakfast and board menu dinner).
Staff were all super friendly and professional, except one day a young restaurant worker at the dinner directly asked for money while serving you dinner, explaining his salary is small and if we can help him, very awkward!
Swimming pool area is cute! Just cross the road and you can swim at the beach 🏖️ cool.
Amazing place to stay at, staff are kind and let me checkout late and upgraded to a better room with no charge

formatted_address: parangiya waththe 274/5 pillagoda, Unawatuna Beach, Unawatuna 80600, Sri Lanka
name: Black & White Restaurant

reviews.text: We stopped there for lunch and it was better than anything I had expected. We were able to select the seafood and fish we wanted to have on our platter and it was deliciously prepared with fries, salad and rice. The lobster was perfectly cooked. All the staff was so kind, friendly and smiling. The view was amazing. 100% recommend and would definitely come back, the fresh food speaks for itself. Thank you!!

We spent the afternoon at this restaurant / bar and enjoyed the atmosphere and ocean views. In a great location to people watch and enjoy some food and drinks. Beers come in ice cold glasses too - bonus!! Staff very nice and friendly. We had some calamari and dip - both very nice. Will definitely return and recommend to others.

When we dined at Black & Cafe Restaurant, the food was of good quality and the service was satisfactory. The restaurant offers a clean and calm atmosphere with a pleasant beach view. Overall, the experience was worth the money and is recommended for those visiting the Unawatuna area.

We had breakfast at Black and White in Unawatuna and it was absolutely fantastic! The bagel was super fresh and delicious, and the iced latte was the perfect match — really, really good. The staff was incredibly friendly and welcoming, which made the whole experience even better. The atmosphere is great and very relaxing.
Highly recommended — we’ll definitely be back!

Food was mediocre. Went because of the reviews. However, the fish was bland and just loads of garlic. We didn’t order from the fresh catch, we ordered off the menu, which shouldn’t matter. The food was more room temp than warm. Plenty of places to choose from.

formatted_address: Unawatuna Beach parangiya waththa, pillagoda, 265X+VR9, Unawatuna 80600, Sri Lanka
name: Fire Cafe & Restaurant Unawatuna

reviews.text:
The food was very small for the price.
My sandwich (as shown in pictures) was full of bones. You can only use the sunbed if you consume (very normal) but if this food is what you get i would rather not go there again

We eat here pizza they were advertizing at beach signs.

i have to say this was worst food i have ever tasted. it must have been frozen pizza just warmed in owen but still, it did not taste. there is only few chairs on restaurant beach side and i think we were only customers. i just cant beliewe how high rewiews this place have got.

After this 'meal' we visited Social that was full of people and waiters did actually run to serve us. it was like night and day, sorry but i need to be honest..
Amazing food
One of the most wonderful place for a destination. You can enjoy with many kinds of delicious food and drinks. Have an excellent staff service...👌

Awesome place, excellent stuff good food. And water......
just fell in love with it👌🏻💕🙏🏻

formatted_address: Paraugiya, waththa peellagoda, Unawatuna, Sri Lanka
name: Korean Food Beach Restaurant

reviews.text: It’s different from Korean-style jjamppong, but honestly it’s better than most jjamppong in Korea. I just wish the noodles weren’t rice noodles.

Awsome food so authentic and tasty. Also very healthy.
A must try in Unawatuna!

Wonderful cafe with very friendly staff. The owner personally came over to ask how spicy I wanted my food. The kimchi jjigae was amazing — spicy, full of flavor, and the portion was so big and generous with meat that I couldn’t even finish it. I’ll definitely come back again!

awesome place for all Korean food lovers ♡
Friendly staff and a very kind owner! they make food for us when we were late and it was sooo cute

friendly reminder: to full for experience you need to order before 21:00
Amazing Korean food. Fair prices for seafood dishes. May take some time till food is ready, but also you can enjoy sunbeds and the beach. Owner is Korean ❤️

It's a cozy family restaurant on the Unawatuna main beach. We tried chicken sizzle / brownie - it was very delicious . Dish serving is very nice - hot dish still sizzle right on your table! The prices are a bit cheaper than other places on the beach.

Lolo Sizzle Spot is a brand new restaurant direct at the beach in Unawatuna. We had for lunch the tuna and what should I say: that was the best tuna steak I ever had. The fish was so fresh. Price is also very good, the people are very friendly, food is fantastic. What else you need :-) go there and take your lunch and dinner on the sizzle way.
Very nice and pleasant service, excellent food. Definitely come and visit, we are very satisfied
Best restaurant in Unawatuna....

Every day we had lunch or dinner in this restaurant. The meals were big and tasty. We tried all kinds of soup, mango salad, fish , mango lassy. All the waiters are friendly and helpful but we particularly liked Ruwan and Harshana. They both speak good English and Ruwan also speaks good Russian. He gave us a lot of useful advice about the area. The cafe has a very nice location on the beach

We had lunch at Sea Secret in Unawatuna and absolutely loved it! We ordered the Bolognese and the Carbonara – both were super fresh, perfectly seasoned, and honestly some of the best pasta we’ve had during our trip. 🍝

The Bolognese was rich and flavorful with a great tomato base, and the Carbonara was creamy and well balanced without being too heavy. You can really taste the quality of the ingredients.

The atmosphere is relaxed and cozy, the staff is very friendly and attentive, and the location near the beach makes it even more special.

Highly recommended if you’re in Unawatuna and craving good Italian food! We would definitely come back. 😊

“Great experience at this beach café! Comfortable sunbeds, a diverse menu, and very low prices for the quality you get. The curry was tasty and hit the spot. Big thanks to our waiter, Ruan, for being so attentive and friendly. Highly recommended!”

This was the best experience in Unawatuna. You could have a great dining experience with the scenetic view of the beach ⛱️ 👌. I truly admire the well established service and staff as well as the cleanliness of the restaurant. This was  truly the best experience I've had in galle.

I spent the day here on the beach in Unawatuna. The sun lounger had no charge as I ate and had a couple of drinks. The chicken Kottu was very tasty and the service was great. Very friendly and kind waiters. Especially John. Thanks for the excellent conversation. If you’re staying on the beach then come here and grab a sun bed and food.

Had dinner here. Ordered tiger prawns with fries and salad, but the salad was missing at first. Eventually the waiter brought it, but there was a misunderstanding. Nasi goreng came with sausages. Garlic bread was just one slice. Average place – you can find better. Only Russian music playing.

We've been 10m from the water. It's a beautiful ambience with very nice and dedicated service. We had a beautiful evening here. Would recommend it for those who like Bali vibes and music at the beach!!

On our way back from Jungle Beach, our tuk tuk broke down and a local man kindly stopped to help us. He stayed until everything was fixed and didn’t accept anything in return. He just gave us his hotel business card, and we promised to visit his restaurant.

We’re so glad we did. The place is beautiful, the service was excellent, and the food was absolutely delicious. It was also our anniversary, so it turned out to be the perfect place to celebrate.

Don’t let rude and arrogant reviews discourage you; clearly, some people from certain countries think being on holiday gives them a PhD in complaining.

Thank you again for your kindness, for helping us with the tuk tuk, and for the amazing hospitality.
Amazing BBQ fish by the beach and great service! First picture is tuna with prawns and butterfish. Second picture is the octopus - all were delicious.
Great place, delicious food. The best service at Unawatuna Beach! The Rasilca waiter was very attentive. The best in the business!

formatted_address: Matara Road, Peellagoda, Unawatuna, Sri Lanka
name: Peacock Beach Hotel

reviews.text:
We had a very disappointing and upsetting experience from the moment we arrived. Our check-in time was around 1:00 PM, but we reached the hotel at approximately 3:00 PM. Even then, we were asked to wait for about 30 minutes because the room was not ready due to a previous guest’s late checkout. While delays can happen and we were initially understanding, what followed completely ruined the experience.

While we were waiting, the hotel owner openly shouted at the staff in front of guests, complaining about accepting bookings from local travelers. This was extremely uncomfortable and humiliating to witness, especially since we had made our reservation properly through Booking.com. Being made to feel unwelcome purely because we are locals was deeply hurtful and unacceptable. The tone, behavior, and attitude of the owner were shocking and left us feeling disrespected before we had even stepped into our room.

Ironically, the staff—who were being treated so poorly—were the only positive part of this stay. They remained calm, polite, and genuinely supportive despite the owner’s aggressive and disgusting behavior. Their professionalism deserves appreciation, as they did their best to make us feel comfortable in a very unpleasant situation.

The room itself was clean and fairly okay, and the breakfast was simple but acceptable. However, no level of cleanliness or basic comfort can make up for the emotional distress and discrimination we experienced at check-in.

As a local traveler, I strongly and honestly do not recommend this place. Hospitality should make guests feel welcome and respected, not judged or humiliated. Unfortunately, the racism we faced here completely overshadowed any positive aspects of the stay.

Pros Room 15 deluxe double room with sea view and balcony . Fantastic balcony with sun on all day and watch sunsets at night with nice table and chairs . Big comfy bed , fridge , kettle , great powerful Aircon. lovely staff , great cabanas and sunbeds free directly in front of hotel , free beach towels .  Food nice and freshly made . The staff are friendly.
Cons
Stayed 4 nights , had no cleaning, had to keep asking for toilet rolls and dry towels at reception but they never came . Bins overflowing , floor needed a sweep from sand . Coffee and  daily water not refilled because nobody came in to clean. Curtains should be blackout due to the bright lights off the beach if your in bed earlier than 12 . Also if your a light sleeper and early to bed (before midnight) you can hear the speaker from the beach . The light for our balcony which was bright was outside our room on the next balcony which you can get to but if they want the lights on and you want yours off ??? !!
The service is slow . It can take half hour for them to fetch a beer . Often we ordered stuff while on the beach and they’d forget and it would never arrive .Read reviews about manager telling off staff in front of people and we saw a few incidents and I asked is that your boss , and was told he was just another worker but he pulled someone away from us while he was helping us with a situation .
Conclusion .
We paid £180 for 4 nights . If we had housekeeping snd better service it would have been given 5 stars for its mega location and our great view and balcony of room 15  would be worth the money . Because of the issues I think the price is a little over

Had a room on the top floor and it was amazing. Balcony over looked the beach. The room looked and felt clean.
The cabanas on the beach were comfortable. The staff was very friendly and the food was delicious. We loved staying here and would come back here anytime.

The beach is very good, the ocean is usually calm and peaceful. You can find free sunbeds (for a drink or meal) or paid ones (1500 r), there’s a washroom. But they have to do something with the dogs, they pee and poo on the beach, where kids play. It’s very unhygienic (((

I am in pleasure to direct the hotel, a glamorous place of comfort and the sun kissed beach view not only, very calm and quiet environment, but also, very friendly and hospitable service by the hotel staff as well.
The rates are also very reasonable and foods are delicious.

"Wish the chairman and the hotel staff all the success."

Good place with reasonable prices and tasty food. Very low prices for drinks, which are pretty good.
Vanilla milkshake ~1.3$
Passion juice ~1.1$
Fish with chips and salad ~ 5.8$
Sea plate - 11.7$
Nice service, relatively low prices. Fresh juice about 200; cuttlefish, prawns, fish about 1000; sea food platter 2500
It's a small Restaurant but the food is great, tasty and spicy if you like! I think you cannot get better in other places on the beach. My recommendation Rice&Curry and a very cold Beer!

Awful service! We came here several days ago, ate food, drank juices.
Today we came and ordered juices, the host started arguing and crying at me. He said: “no food go away!”.
I felt terrible, don’t want to have such attitude towards me!
After such an attitude I would not recommend this place to anyone!
Best vegetable curry/dahl so far in Sri Lanka. Prices, for a Beach Front Restaurant, absolutely fair! Friendly Service guy.

This is a hidden gem! We had dinner here for 4 nights during our Unawatuna trip, as it’s just so good! The place is hidden and small but a lovely family run restaurant with authentic Sri Lanka food.
Food is delicious and a good price.
Service is excellent - friendly and lovely staff.
Good music and on the beach.

This place is a true hidden gem. A very small, family-run restaurant where you can feel the love that goes into the food. The mother cooks, and the son takes care of the guests – both incredibly kind and welcoming.

We ordered a vegetarian/vegan curry, and it was absolutely amazing. Everything tasted super fresh, full of flavor, and very authentic. Honestly some of the best food we’ve had for this price.

The location right by the beach is lovely, very local and cozy, with a beautiful, simple atmosphere. We left feeling genuinely happy and grateful.

Highly recommended – I really hope this place keeps its quality and wish only the best for this sweet family. 🧡
Exactly what I was looking for: a simple and family run restaurant on the beach! Tasty and affordable. They had a selection of fresh fishes, for example red snapper for 5000!

A beautiful hidden gem right on the beach, run by a family who does everything themselves. You can truly feel the love and care in every detail. The hosts are incredibly kind and welcoming, and the food is absolutely delicious — homemade, fresh, and cooked with so much love by Malik's mother. The atmosphere is relaxed, authentic, and far from crowded tourist places. I would highly recommend this restaurant to anyone traveling through Sri Lanka who wants to experience genuine local hospitality and amazing home-style food.

Best rice and curry I had in Sri Lanka. Homemade by a mama it was made with love and it tasted like heaven. It's a really nice place not far from the beach and there is not a lot a people. If you like a good diner without lots of noises and loud music it's the perfect place!🙏🏼 Bohoma istuti.

The restaurant is on second floor with sea view and homely vibes. As you enter through living room, you can pick indoors or outdoors. Food is delicious and served beautifully. Also, big thumbs up from us for having board games

Liked this place, definitely will visit once more

What a wonderful place! We stumbled upon it by pure chance while walking by, and from the very first moment we stepped inside, it felt just like home. A warm welcome with kind, friendly, and genuinely polite smiles that make you feel truly invited. Calm, harmonious décor and perfectly soft lighting.

Then the food arrived (seafood salad and cosmos special fried rice) and confirmed that feeling—food you only ever taste in warm, loving homes.
I’ll definitely be coming back again and again as long as I’m in Unawatuna.

This restaurant is beautifully designed and tucked away in a quant family home in Unawatuna. I was immediately greeted by warm and friendly staff. They have an elaborate menu spanning western and Sri Lankan cuisine. Highly recommend their egg hoppers with chicken curry and coconut pancakes! And kudos to Sachin for his hospitality. Moreover, if you’re looking for halal friendly options around this is a good start as Sachin mentioned that their meat supplier is Muslim. :)

The restaurant is really beautifully decorated and the family is very, very nice and accommodating. The service was excellent. The food was incredibly delicious! I had a seafood burger, but I asked them to leave out the calamari. They offered me the alternative of adding chicken to the burger instead of prawns, and it was fantastic. The prawns tasted very fresh and the chicken was very tender. The dressing on the salad was incredibly delicious and refreshing. Everything was really tasty, very good and high quality.
The mojito also tasted incredibly good.
The only minor drawback is that the restaurant is located directly on the main road, so it can be a bit noisy. Nevertheless, it was a really good holiday feeling.

Enjoyable dinner in a unique setting. A new, very much family restaurant - you enter via the living room but the restaurant setup is beautiful on the balcony on the 3rd floor. Only a dozen or so seats, primarily local meals.

Only comment would be indicate if you want spicy - found it a bit mild for me but the fam loved it.

Prices are very reasonable - circa 1300 for rice and curry.

Highly recommended.
Very clean and neat taste food.
Fair price.
No tourists price.
Wow excellent.
Amazing small place for a very reasonable price. Very asty food as well. I would recommend to everyone.
Highly recommended.

Best food.
Biriyani is next level.
Good place
not worth what we paid for, we ordered prawn spaghetti and seafood rice and they had everything but seafood and prawns and also spaghetti had nothing to do with spaghetti

Perfect place! They work late at night, have delicious food: tuna, prawns, omelette, etc. Not spicy(!!!), so, you may come with your children.
Beach is in a few meters.
Only had drinks nice place food looks good, free wifi
Not there anymore

The restaurant now operates under the name "Calaton," but the owner says you can leave reviews under "Yellow Cabin." This likely has something to do with the Russian takeover and adapting to the Russian-speaking clientele. The food is delicious, home-cooked. The kottu is delicious, freshly prepared before our eyes. The rice and curry is a bit different than the one on the menu, and there's only one curry, a bit like a soup (not reduced), but it was truly delicious, home-cooked. The portions are large, enough to keep you full. The prices are reasonable for seaside street food, and reasonable.

formatted_address: 266X+8V3 Le Onde una peellagoda, road, Unawatuna, Sri Lanka
name: Le onde una

formatted_address: Le onde una Peellagoda, road, Unawatuna 80600, Sri Lanka
name: Le Onde Una

reviews.text: Nice little place. I ordered sliders thinking it would be small but it was pretty decent portion, fries were super nice however it was lacking some vegetable and meat was bit too salty. Avocado salad was good. We also ordered mocktails like mojito was tasty and Margherita with mango which tasted like a juice. If you wanna pay by card they charge 3% fee. Enjoy!

Beautiful cozy place serving authentic Italian and best coffee in area.
Good hospitality and having rooms for guests
Must visit place

e Onde is an absolute gem! The atmosphere is warm and inviting, with a charming blend of elegance and comfort. The food is outstanding—each dish is clearly made with fresh, high-quality ingredients and expertly prepared. The flavors are authentic and delicious, making it a perfect spot for anyone who appreciates great cuisine.

The service was exceptional as well! The staff was friendly, attentive, and knowledgeable, ensuring a fantastic dining experience from start to finish. Whether you’re stopping by for a casual meal or a special occasion, Le Onde is a must-visit. Highly recommend!

"A Taste of Italy in Unawatuna!"

From the moment you step into this charming Italian restaurant, you're transported straight to Italy. The warm ambiance, rustic decor, and the aroma of fresh basil and garlic set the perfect mood for an unforgettable dining experience.

The menu offers an impressive selection of authentic Italian dishes.The ingredients are fresh, and you can truly taste the passion in every bite. The seafood pasta is a must-try, packed with the flavors of the ocean, —light, creamy, and the perfect way to end the meal.

The service is exceptional, with friendly and attentive staff who make sure you feel right at home. Whether you're enjoying a romantic dinner, a family meal, or just a glass of wine with friends, this restaurant delivers an authentic Italian experience in the heart of Sri Lanka.

Highly recommended for anyone craving real Italian flavors in Unawatuna! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
Hey guys, one of the best places in Unawatuna 😍 Just try the food once ❤️ Friendly staff and amazing food with a cozy vibe.
We have aten here a few times already and love to come back. Very good food and kind people
There is nothing to say...... The food is very delicious... 😋 friendly service as well.. Highly Recommend Divams Restaurant... ❤️💪
delicious food and the people working here are very nice! highly recommend!!
the food is very good, very cheap and really authentic. The people working here are also very friendly and honest :)
very yummy food, cheap, and the people are very kind :) recommended

Amazing!! It was so good food, the prices are really good and reasonable unlike many other restaurants we’ve seen in the area. The owner was so lovely and warm. We had Kottu and Fried noodles with chicken and it was soooo tasty!! And as authentic as it can get

We had dinner. Ordered kottu and tuna steak.
The food was super, tasty, fresh.
Really calm atmosphere, no street noises.
We really enjoyed it
Very valuable food place! The food is amazing we tried the kottu and fried rice. The staff was kind and welcoming and the restaurant had a cozy atmosphere!

Absolute hidden gem! Excellent, friendly service. We shared a delicious chicken kottu which was a hearty portion and well seasoned. We also had banana lassis that were nicely chilled and artfully presented. The atmosphere was relaxing with teal wooden tables, music, incense, and lots of greenery. Very well presented, clean, and reasonably priced! Would definitely recommend.

This was the best food we have had during our whole trip. The food was really good, authentic and served hot. The service was amazing and to finish it off we had pancakes which were just the best! Really would recommend, such a good value for money 🙂

formatted_address: 268/1 Matara Road, Peellagoda, Unawatuna 80600, Sri Lanka
name: Mama San

reviews.text: People - come here! Honestly, we’ve had an absolutely amazing evening with fantastic service - attentive, friendly, open, respectful and warm. The food was OUTSTANDING. It’s an absolute gem of a restaurant and I would eat here every day of my life if I could. Food is on point, served hot and fresh and the flavours are absolutely fantastic. Thank you for an unforgettable food experience! ♥️

My boyfriend and I had a delicious meal here. Very friendly waiter, cocktails were 10/10, nice ambience and very flavourful food. We ordered veggie dumplings, bao buns, Vietnamese crepe, and beef bibimbap, all dishes had lots of flavour and nice presentation. Our cocktails were very good, you could tell the waiter didn’t rush this as they were beautifully garnished and tasted delicious.

What a wonderful place.

We visited here on Sunday afternoon around 5pm, and were warmly greeted when we arrived.

The music, lighting, decor and ambience were all spot on (similar places, locally rarely seem to get all these 4 factors right).

The menu is varied and exciting and we tried lots of different dishes, we also ordered fruit juices, beer, and an aback based cocktail.

The drinks arrived first, freshly made pineapple juice which was delicious, ice cold lion beer in a chilled glass and the arack cocktail was beautiful, served inequally exquisite glassware.

The food was fantastic, we all fought over the chicken and prawns dumplings (gyoza) with soy dipping sauce.

The buttermilk chicken was spicy and crispy and really moreish.

We shared the mixed bao bun platter, with big chicken/pork/prawn and veggie buns, stuffed full of fillings.

The spring rolls and fresh summer rolls were equally excellent, as were the accompanying dipping sauces.

But the best part of the meal was the Korean beef BimBimBap (rice bowl).
Beautifully marinated slow cooked spicy beef served on sticky rice with kimchi. Utterly fantastic.

We loved our visit and were amazed at how good value it was, we paid 22,000 LKR (£60) for the above.

I went to Mama San and it was amazing! The atmosphere was incredible with great music and quick service. And most importantly the food was very very delicious.

We ordered everything on the menu!! (Not quite everything)

Starters
- Spring rolls were good (not outstanding but good)
- Tuna on Rice Cake was really delicious
- Chicken and prawn gyoza (pan fried) were very good
- BBQ bao bun was fantastic
- Panko chicken boa was very good but could have used a bit more of the delicious sauce
- The Prawn Bao was surprisingly good with a delicious mayo
Mains
- Pepper crusted green curry tuna was out of this world delicious
- My children said The pad thai was as good (better?) than in in Thailand, the best they ever had, one chicken one prawn, both delicious
- My wife ordered the Bimbibap which had really tasty beef with a delicious marinade
Dessert
- The mango coconut sticky rice was very tasty and as good as we had in Thailand
- The Bounty Cake (like a Bounty chocolate bar in a cake) was also very good but you need to like coconut!

Lion beers to drink with bottled water

Really nice staff and awesome playlist

32K Rupee was a good price for all that food.  Cash only.

By far, the best meal I’ve had in Sri Lanka. This place is not to be missed! The set-up is spacious and very cool, the staff was extremely friendly and the food was beyond delicious. We ordered the bibimbap with marinated beef (HIGHLY recommended), prawns wonton soup with vermicelli, prawns bao bun, and chicken and prawns gyoza. Everything was cooked to an absolute perfection with an authentic flavors like no other. It is a complete waste if you ever visit Unawatuna area and not stop by Mama San — This is a meal that I will remember for a very very long time! 🙌🏼😍

formatted_address: Matara road, Peellagoda, Unawatuna 80600, Sri Lanka
name: Banana Beach

reviews.text: Knowing the mixed reviews, we decided to give Banana Beach a try for a relaxing day on Unuwatuna. We were looking for a place to chill on sunbeds, and since they don't charge extra for them, we were happy to spend on drinks and food. We were pleasantly surprised! Everything worked out perfectly. The burger wasn't gourmet, but it was decent. The lady serving us was friendly and kind. Plus, they have a toilet and shower, which was a huge plus. We had a great day there, enjoying the beach.

They seduce you saying its free to stay in their beach beds as long as you make a consumption. Requested two beds and asked for some coconuts and spent no more than a couple of hours. By the time we asked for the bill, they charged us heavilly saying they didn't consider our drinks enough. Just important to mention that there is no minimum consumption mentioned anywhere and that the price for the beds is also not stated or fixed. So basically they charge whatever the manager feels she wants to charge.
Almost two weeks and Sri Lanka and first time being scammed, quite sad considering how respectful and polite the population is.

Avoid this place!
We were walking on Unawatuna Beach and two nice men from the place approached and said we could use the sun beds if we consumed something but didn’t told us about any minimum consumption.

We were 4 people but only used 2 sun beds since we were in the sea most of the time. In the meanwhile we ordered 2 coconuts (which were very overpriced - 800 rupees each - and not listed in the menu). We ended up using the table close to our sun-beds while drinking the coconuts, around 5 minutes.

When paying, they said we didn’t consume enough… and we should order a fruit juice otherwise we would need to pay for the sun beds, 1000 rupees for 2 sun beds for around 2.5 hours, which was not explicit anywhere in the menu.

We complained and the manager came to talk with us. She was very rude when talking with us and said it was common sense to consume more even after we explained that their colleagues didn’t mention that in the beginning.

We ended up giving up and paying it since we had other plans for the afternoon.

Don’t go there…
Beds were moldy, owner was rude and indifferent about our complaints and would not offer a refund. I cannot recommend this place to anyone.

The food was tasteless. Staff didn’t pay attention and rather tell us to not be a bad guest. We told them there are insects in food and they said it happens on beach. Not recommended. There are better options on that beachside

formatted_address: 268/1 Matara Road, Godagewatta, Pellagoda, Unawatuna 80600, Sri Lanka
name: La Boheme

reviews.text:
Just wow !
The pizza is incredible, and the dough… so fresh ! I don’t really know how to describe it, but it must come from the quality of the flour from Italy. I had never eaten a pizza like this before, there’s a different taste, and that’s definitely a good thing.

Absolutely excellent. I also recommend the shrimp tortellini : you can really taste the shrimp.

A bohemian place, just like its name suggests, with a very friendly staff. 100% good vibes & petfriendly !!

Solid wooden oven pizza! Also the arancini was great, all round great meal. Good ingredients but I feel like the atmosphere and deco could do some work slightly felt like a garage and patio with chairs…
We ate as a family at Boheme. Tried 3 pizzas from the menu and all were amazing. The cocktails were super good. The place as nice atmosphere and the servers were friendly and welcoming.

This place offers delicious pizza and a warm, welcoming staff who serve with genuine care and hospitality. It’s the second best pizza spot I’ve found in the Unawatuna area, making it a great choice for a satisfying meal 👊🏽

Beautiful pizza, proper oven blistering!

Went there twice for the pizza - consistently good stuff 👌  One time, there was live music which also added to the overall chill ambience

formatted_address: Wallaye Deywala Road, Unawatuna, Sri Lanka
name: Happy Banana

reviews.text:
Very disappointing experience. The location right on the beach is nice, but unfortunately that’s about the only good thing. The service was extremely slow, even though the restaurant wasn’t busy. We waited a long time for drinks and even longer for the food to arrive.
When the food finally came, it was below average and not worth the price at all. Some dishes were bland or poorly prepared, and the portions didn’t match the high prices. Several reviewers have also complained about slow service, wrong orders, and overpriced food, which sadly matched our experience.
The staff also didn’t seem very attentive or interested in helping customers. Overall, it felt very unprofessional and not welcoming. There are many much better restaurants along the Unawatuna beach strip, so I wouldn’t recommend this place.

The worst customer service I have ever received in my life. I have the waiter 5 times and he just look at me with okay head shake and left me hanging. I have been there more than three time and I have left quiet a generous tip (20% on the top of the 10% service charge) for the poor service I received thinking that they will treat me well when I come another time. But it has gotten worse, I was invited on Friday night they are hosting party but the place looks good but not enough seats so I decided to sit by the bar. I have had the first hand experience of how they function and I would like to let you know not to order any cocktails. I saw a waiter dive his hands in to someone’s cocktail to fetch ice cube. That is just unsanitary. Here is a pro tip- ask them to open a beer in front of you. I have noticed the bartender collecting leftover beers. Horrible service, they will always ask you where are you from at the gate. It’s not for security reasons. It’s to racially profile you. As a black person this place is not good.

The beach is beautiful, the place is big and comfy, really nice!
Food is average. Service is good, waiters are nice.
They hold parties on fridays!

Guys, I was extremely disappointed with my experience this time.

One year ago this place was full of good energies and surrounded by good workers with excellent service !!! I spent so much good time with my girlfriend and friends !!!!

What’s happened with your business !!! Boss !!! I’m from the same industry in Hong Kong and I’m also driving my own bars (and restaurants) and really today's experience was dramatic !!!

A real mess: No one on the team was smiling; 30 minutes to receive a Mango juice (and I received a mixed juice); an hour to receive a Wrap + a Salad; and finally receive a false bill and higher than what I should have initially paid... SHAME !!!
On the other hand and fortunately the food was fresh and good.

The toilets ( women and men ) in the bar were very very very dirty and when I told the waiter I felt like I was cutting off his leg!!!

Bonus: I still said goodbye and thank you, and the same server gave me a dirty look.
I repeat,...something needs to be done about this beautiful place, and fast.

Waited 1 hour to get 2 cocktails.
Bad arranged and very expensive.
The very unfriendly service man wanted to charge us even more as on the price list at the end.
Will not come back for sure. 👎🏻

name: Sun Set Colony Rooms And Restaurant

reviews.text:
What a fantastic stay we had this place. An old house with just 5 rooms located right on the beach front. Antique furniture all around. Old staircase that leads to the rooms on first and second floor; rustic rooms with large balcony offering unhindered sea view.

Right across the road is a convenience store and a furlong ahead is a wine store. All needs taken care.

The front yard with huge trees and lots of green cover is a lazy place to relax and do nothing. Nice, ever helpful staff. Good food - simple breakfast and had lovely tuna steak for dinner.

Not an expensive place.

I stayed in this hotel with my husband for 3 nights. The rooms are spacious, air conditioned with 24/7 hot water. Water pressure is great too. This hotel is humble but has everything you need for a comfortable stay in front of the beach at extremely affordable rates. We were particularly moved by the hospitality of the staff. Mame, Angela were all such sweethearts, so so kind. Mame gifted me a ripe mango to eat as a gift during my checkout. I was thoroughly moved by their kindness.

The owner however should employ more staff to take care of this beautiful property. During our stay we met only 3 staff who were bearing unmanageable load of this hotel and guests. They are doing as best as they could but everything can be so much better if the owner brings in some extra hands.

Was absolutely perfect, sun going down, while sitting under the palm trees, lovely breeze.
Food was excellent and the drinks were cold. Not expensive at all.
Highly recommend.
We had dinner there: the curry seafood plate was delicious, flavorful and very generous portion. Lovely location on the beach, perfect for sunset

This beach restaurant in Unawatuna, Galle, Sri Lanka, is fantastic! The food is delicious, and you get to enjoy it right by the beach. The people who work there are nice, and the view is really, really great. It's a perfect place for a tasty meal with a seaside vibe. I totally recommend it for a great time by the beach with tasty food.
It's a great place to relax and enjoy delicious food and uncoman fruit juice in place
the house accommodations best and staff great

What a delightful chilled place .
Excellent cappuccino, had 2 lol.
Italian coffee machine LOVE IT !!

Even came with glass bottled water without having to ask and a cheeky little date ball . Yum
Love the coffee art .

Order the avocado with eggs delicious.
The attention to detail in this place is just incredible.
Chef came out and spoke with me aswell , truly lovely staff.

They don’t have social media at the moment so let’s get the word out through here and make this business thrive.

Drop in , you will not regret it

Great place, great food/coffee and even better staff! Everyone must try this place. Staff were so friendly and the owner was very accommodating for a custom breakfast order. This place is a must try. Thank you Casa Lanka!
2 x Very happy Australian customers 🇦🇺

This café makes an excellent cappuccino, easily one of the best I’ve had. Prices are a bit higher than usual, but you truly get top quality and outstanding service in return. I was always offered a complimentary bottle of cold water, which was a lovely touch. The cheese and bacon sandwich I tried was absolutely delicious, perfectly balanced, and far from a standard sandwich – it felt special and thoughtfully crafted.

Beautiful place, delicious and beautiful presented food and coffee! Every details are figured out with extra care from the wallpainting to the plates and mugs. The staff is super friendly! Higly recommended to visit this super place and I wish you good luck for the future!

Our first breakfast here in Galle!   A local told us this is a great place to have breakfast.   Very close to our hotel so that’s a plus.
Of course we had coffee, tea and my double espresso.    Ordered a couple of omelettes (1 wirh prawns and 2 with chicken.   And a plate of waffles with Nutella.    Everything was delicious!   The service was EXCELLENT!!!!!   Very nice and friendly staff!!!!!
The restaurant was clean and had a Greek /Mediterranean feel.  Very lovely!
Would I go back???  ABSOLUTELY!!!!!

formatted_address: 311 Peellagoda, Matara Rd, Unawatuna, Sri Lanka
name: Wild and the Sage

reviews.text: We had the best time at this bookshop/restaurant. We came in to check out the books and I was impressed by their selection of literature and Srilankan focused books. The food and atmosphere was wonderful, quiet, relaxing and tasteful. We ate the jackfruit papadam tacos, cassava and black pepper pork. The staff were so nice! One man worrying there even remembered one of us from last year when he visited. I will be recommending this place to all my friends!

A cosy cafe that offers book lovers a warm and comfy time to browse and enjoy a meal in a relaxed atmosphere. The garden cafe at the back is truelly refreshing, surrounded by lush greenery. Good coffee and tasty food. A calm, relaxing atmosphere, what more could you want?! Will be back for more!

Absolutely incredible space with such a cozy concept - having a meal surrounded by books doesn’t get better. Dinner was incredible with a tapas style system - speaking to the owner about it, it was clear how much intention went into crafting a fresh and unique menu whilst using local ingredients. Honestly, one of the best meals I had on my long trip in Sri Lanka (and also incredibly well-priced for that quality).  Not to mention, the service was so warm and thoughtful; despite having a full dinner party on their hands, I still felt very well attended to. The Mahi Mahi Florentine and the Chicken Wing with Ash Plantain and Cumin Crust were divine.

Loved the atmosphere of this bookshop cafe - it was nice to sit and read for a couple of hours. They also had a bunch of vegan options including chocolate cake and cookies! Wouldn’t really recommend the coffee though as it was not very strong, but definitely do go for everything else they have to offer

Fantastic spot to stop for brunch and a read. I've come here twice and both times I found something delicious on the menu and books to take home. The outdoor area is stunning and the staff are so welcoming.

The vegan burger is excellent and the food in general super good! Harana is really really nice and friendly. It’s a lovely place to have some vegan food and spend some quality time. The prices are affordable, especially compared to other places with vegan food.

Honestly the best chocolate croissant and breakfast. We were a very big fan of the brown bread with scrambled eggs. We also tried the pancakes which were very tasty. But I think we were most surprised by how good the bread and pastries are. I say with a lot of confidence that you don’t want to miss this place for breakfast when you’re in the area. We’re going to miss it.
Excellent breakfast  spread by a ex mariott chef!! Great good and amazing service . We became a regular here!!!

Very nice cafe! I ordered vegan “meatballs” baguette but instead of meatballs it was just rice in a sauce. Even though I expected something a bit different it was really good! The prices are also good on a touristic place like this and the workers are super friendly! I definitely recommend :)
We loved the continental breakfast and omelette and can definitely recommend this place. Really good croissant too.

formatted_address: 266W+2XX, Welle Dewalaya Rd, Unawatuna, Sri Lanka
name: Koha Surf Lounge

reviews.text: Came here for lunch with friends. The first thing you experience is the chill vibe,  with great music and cushioned seating areas to relax and drink cocktails, or the dining area and more formal seating. There’s a buzz about the place and the waiters are super attentive. My friends have been many times and it was worth the trip from Mirissa to have the ‘melt in the mouth’ tuna steak. Quite simply…delicious. KOHA means cuckoo!

One of the best burgers I’ve ever eaten. Well-fried, intense flavour. The atmosphere of the place, very positive, Service 👌, serves customers and sings to music in your free time. Vibe 🔝You have to visit this place 😉

The food was definitely amazing but what stuck with me was the hospitality and consideration of the staff. We dined there two nights in a row, first it was a hummus platter, some starters. The next night we were craving something spicy but we got there at 9:35 and their kitchen was almost closed. The guy who served us a night before remembered us and asked us how our activities of the day went which was really very sweet. On our request and the chef’s courtesy he fixed us a with a great plate of spicy Shrimps which was hitting the taste buds right on the spot. Loved it!

We absolutely loved our visit to Koha Surf Lounge in Unawatuna! The smash burgers were insane – perfectly crispy on the outside, super juicy inside, and packed with flavor. Definitely some of the best burgers we’ve had in Sri Lanka!

The vibe is super relaxed with a cool surf atmosphere and a beautiful beach setting. Great music, friendly staff, and just the perfect spot to chill after a day in the sun.

Highly recommend if you’re in Unawatuna – we would 100% come back!

The burger exceeded all expectations absolutely delicious! The cold pressed juices were fresh and full of flavor, and the Butterfly cocktail was incredibly good. Every dish and drink we tried was not only tasty but also felt healthy and thoughtfully prepared.

The place itself has a lovely atmosphere, and the staff were all so friendly and welcoming! always smiling! They even have the sweetest dog named Chinese! 😄

We also met the owner a young German lady who was genuinely kind and respectful with her team, great vibes all around!

If you’re in the area this spot is a must visit. You won’t regret it!

Absolutely loved this spot! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

This little café is a gem — the live coconut ice cream experience is super unique and so satisfying. They make it right in front of you using fresh coconut, and the flavor is rich, creamy, and not overly sweet. Perfectly balanced! The staff are incredibly friendly and welcoming, and the whole place has a cozy, warm vibe that makes you want to stay longer. Prices are very reasonable for the quality you get. If you’re in Unawatuna, this is a must-visit — one of the best treats I’ve had on my trip! Will definitely come back. 🙌🌴🍨
Amazing variety, great quality, and beautiful presentation. You can really taste the freshness. Definitely a must-visit for ice cream lovers
Very tasty coffee and very nice barista!! Recommend ❤️
Great coffee at great prices and staff really friendly!
The most delicious ice cream ever ! Highly recommended  👌🏽

Came here fully expecting to eat bang average pizza but I was WRONG! I ordered the Ciao Bella and my partner, the Diavola Piccante, and they were so delicious! The Ciao Bella was the standout for both of us and I was genuinely sad that I ended up so stuffed that I couldn’t polish the whole lot off! 100% recommend if you’re in the area and are craving a delicious and well crafted pizza.

What a wonderful place! And what lovely people who welcome you so warmly and prepare a truly world-class lunch for you.
The Kankun pizza and the Magic Mushroom pasta are absolute must-tries. These guys are on a whole different level! 🍕✨

Best sourdough pizza dough, very fluffy and yummy, big enough to share if you are not too hungry. Juices were tasty, beer nice and cold. We enjoyed the friendly service.
We did feel like something was still missing in terms of vibe, but they only opened a year ago so they may still be adding atmosphere and accessories to the interior, and we arrived pretty late so may have missed buzzier, lively vibes earlier that evening. Perfect place for GOOD pizza.

Wow! We discovered this place while walking one night when my husband and I were both craving pizza — and it did not disappoint! Hands down the best pizza we’ve ever eaten. The service was quick, and the pizzas came out fast and were huge — we couldn’t even finish them and took the leftovers home. Seriously, don’t miss this place when you’re in Unawatuna!

Wow! The most amazing food I've had in a while. The portions are generous and full of flavour. They have the best view in Unawatuna with a roof top that makes for the best sunset sessions. Looking forward to be back soon!

formatted_address: Jayakotuwa, Yaddehimulla Rd, Unawatuna 80600, Sri Lanka
name: Cafe night mate

formatted_address: 35, Koswatthage Wattha, Yaddehimulla Rd, Unawatuna 80600, Sri Lanka
name: RELAX Food Art Restaurant

reviews.text: We really loved the beautiful design and effort made on every presentation of the food. It was not only beautiful but extremely tasty! We even went back for a second time to enjoy the food again! Ana is really great and wants to make sure everyone has a good time. Also out waiter Raj, was really great.

Lovely place with delicious east European dishes. Specially I liked Tom Yum, and the kid enjoyed his Nutella pancakes.
Tuna steak was also a blast.
Definitely recommend.

Thanks to the creators of this place! Food is unique and delicious. The atmosphere is the one that makes you wish to come back. We’ve tried desserts and cocktails. And also breakfasts. All was tasty and satisfying. The service is polite and unobtrusive, no deposits.  I should also mention white clean comfortable toilet room. The best of all on the shoe! The place to come back for sure 🙏

Had such a lovely experience here! The owner, Anna, was so warm and friendly. I had been eyeing this place every time I walked past the little street menu board and I’m so glad I finally went in.

The setting is so serene, right on the beachfront with plenty of comfortable spots to sit and relax. It’s the perfect place to enjoy a nourishing meal and unwind.

After 3 weeks of white rice and dhal, this meal was an absolute dream come true 😂 Healthy, nutritious, delicious, bright and colourful, and all presented so beautifully. I had the vegetable bowl and a watermelon & mint juice, both absolutely fresh and full of flavour. I also tried a fresh herbal tea blend and the vegan chocolate brownie (YUM).

I’ll definitely be back to try a couple of the breakfasts, and I’ve already got my eye on the lime & cashew cake next time. Highly recommend for anyone visiting Unawatuna, it’s a gem of a spot.

Enjoyed an evening dessert. LOVED the food art. I ordered the beautiful, delicious, healthy brownie. Option to sit out by the beach or inside. We even got a complimentary herbal tea to prep us for bedtime 😃 Anna the owner shared about tips of things to do in Unawatuna which was very kind and helpful. Thank you!
Very nice place to have good cocktails, food and drinks on the beach. The waiters are very friendly and nice. Highly recommended!!!
Chamidu and his guys are the best, always look after you. Food is fresh and amazing. Good job guys.

The worst place ever. The waiter didn’t understand any English and brought the wrong food even after we explained at least 20 times what we wanted. The shisha wasn’t prepared properly, and they also forgot to bring half of our order. Very disappointing experience. The location is nice though

Our order didn't go through at first, they came to ask again after 25 minutes. The food arrived in parts, the first in 40 minutes, the last part in more than an hour. (and it was only a burger arriving first, a toast with fiench fries and a mango lasse an hour later) The French fries was so overcooked, it was more like dry potato sticks. And all of this in a quiet day, with a few tourist on the sunbeds. The staff seems very nice but highly incompetent. It's hard to feel the good vibe the reviews talk about with such a poor service.

We have been here about four times. We only saw monkeys once, but the place still feels calm and a bit like being in the jungle. The food is delicious, the staff are very friendly, and the prices are affordable. Highly recommended.

formatted_address: Thalpawila Gedra Waththa Villa prime time, Matara Rd, Unawatuna 80600, Sri Lanka
name: THE BRUNCH by Prime Time

reviews.text: Food was very over priced and average. Vegan scramble was tasteless and portion size was small. Service charge is additional and then they didn’t have change. Disappointing
Absolutely the best place to chill and eat great food in Unawatuna. The avocado toast was totally delicious and the staff is cool and relaxed 😎👍🥑
Great breakfast
A very cozy cafe, delicious food and drinks. The staff are polite, friendly, and open. While I was in Unawatuna, I spent every evening there.
Dessert was delicious and hookah was amazing, just the way I like. Definitely I'll come back.
Very tasty chicken wrap, tom yum and we also enjoyed shisha. So I can definitely recommend this place!

We went for shisha and it was so good and relatively cheap comparing to other shisha places in srilanka which are already rare, also the atmosphere is very good, we ordered 3 drinks though non of them were good unfortunately. I would go again for shisha but not for drinks. Shisha charged like 3k as i remember

A Little Plate with Reis & vegetables for 1400. (Bad)
In the Board stands 1200!
A Frozen Pizza from the Supermarkt 2400.(very Bad)

Water 300. (highest in town)

Cola 500(Bad)

Hot Water 300 (disgusting)

Never again .

So many good restaurants in town, but this one doesn’t deserve to exist!

I told the waiter that the prices were way too high, but he did nothing to make me feel better.

No one from the service team asked if the food was good, so I couldn’t even share my disappointment!

No ‘Thank you for coming’ or even a simple goodbye. Nothing!

A response from your side without having to get out of trouble or turn the customer away would be desirable.
Lonely place, one of the beast shisha lounge in Unawatuna. Food and service are good as well

First time they refused to cook any breakfast, only juices.
We tried once more, and they made us rotti with sambol, but price was quite different from menu.
Can't say anything about their juices, pretty standard.

The most delicious curry rice we had in Sri Lanka! Large portions, everything fresh, and very reasonable prices! We loved it so much that we went there every day. They also make great fresh juices. The owners are very kind. The cafe is right across from the fruit store, and the owners are the same.
Sometimes you have to wait for your order; the cafe is small, and they don't always prepare it in advance. Ask beforehand.

formatted_address: Welle Dewalaya Rd, Unawatuna, Sri Lanka
name: Tea Time by BLUEFIELD

reviews.text:
One of the best Ceylon tea shop in Sri Lanka
Visit this place 😊 good service, Good advise perfect  seller @Mohammad mufaris 💪
Quality Ceylon Tea for Very reasonable price. And variety of natural flavours. Simply the best place to buy tea
Truly amazing local food and super kind staff, kept coming back during my stay here.

We bought some moldy tea. I highly recommend against buying this tea. So, I have some questions for the store that sells this tea.

Be careful, the tea has mold inside. The smell is bad 😞
A good store with official prices. We bought tea as gifts, at the same prices as at the Bluefield factory.

formatted_address: Unawatuna pellagoda, Sarantuge watta.pellagoda . unawatuna, Galle, Matara Rd, Unawatuna, Sri Lanka
name: Le Café Français Bakery & Boutique

reviews.text:
For a taste of France in the heart of Unawatuna, look no further than this charming cafe.
Whether you’re a tourist exploring the area or a local seeking a culinary escape, this place comes highly recommended.
Craving for a fresh croissant, delightful pastries, or a rich cup of coffee?
This cafe has you covered.
They even offer a vegan menu.
But it’s not just the food that shines here; it’s the warm hospitality of the staff that truly elevates the experience.
Their friendly and attentive service make you feel right at home, adding an extra layer of comfort to your visit.
Bon appétit! 🥐☕

Absolutely the best coffe in the whole city! I came here everyday and was kindly greeted and could stay and read a book. The seats are comfortable and the little terrace is cozy. I recommend this place from my heart ☺️

I came here 3 years back and liked coffee.  I was hoping to repeat my experience but the recent visit was not so pleasant.

I saw waitress combing her hair in food preparation area and handling food with unwashed hands after her public grooming act.

Having lost my appetite I finished my coffee quickly and went to next place for a refill. I hope management takes notice of it and train their staff.

Coffee was good by the way.

Dropped in for breakfast.  They have a good selection. I elected 1500r special. 3 types of bread, croissant, tea, jam, and butter. Plus a bowl of fresh fruits. Came in good time, tea good, bread and croissant fresh.
Super nice cafe, amazing and plentiful food. We had the continental breakfast which was so nice. Would definitely recommend if staying in Unawatuna.

formatted_address: Welle Dewalaya Rd, Unawatuna, Sri Lanka
name: Happy Coconut Cafe

reviews.text:
Based on the reviews, we went for the tuna steak.
From what I understand, this place is new. Surprisingly tasty and inexpensive.
They made us titan tiger fish with salad and potatoes for 1,000 rupees.
When ordering fish, negotiate. They'll give you a discount.
Photos of the menu are attached.
I give it a 5 for not spoiling my expectations.
Clean, delicious food, Russian-speaking waiter. Menu in Russian.

A cafe with a Russian-language menu is a plus. The menu is varied, but I couldn't really taste everything. I was very disappointed with the shawarma.
I recommend going to Lemongrass Cafe; they make amazing hookahs.
You can order hookahs through Instagram and Telegram:
@piratehookah
Great food, drinks, and very friendly service.  Gorgeous setting / vibe and live music. Reasonably priced for the quality of restaurant. Highly recommend!

Perfect dinner spot to wind down in the evening  the food was great with a lovely view even at night.
The owner and staff were very sweet and attentive as well!

We were looking for a shisha and we came to the perfect place here!
Alex, the owner, and the entire staff are really welcoming and caring.
The food was also really delicious. We ordered udon, tomatoes, potatoes and pawns.
Really beautiful location. Very clean and well set up.

A complete recommendation for everyone who wants to have a relaxing finish for the day.

Thank you! Will definitely come again on our next vacation to Sri Lanka.

Anna & Hans
A wonderful hidden gem with stunning scenery. The shisha here is by far the best I’ve ever had, crafted with great expertise. I would definitely recommend this place!
The food was absolutely delicious! We had a tuna shake and curry and it was incredible. The venue and atmosphere were amazing as well! We will come back!!

We had breakfast at Steam Yard today and absolutely loved it! 🤍

The food was not only beautifully presented but also incredibly delicious. The avocado toast with poached eggs was perfect – super fresh, creamy avocado, great seasoning, and the pomegranate seeds were such a nice touch. The burger with fries was also really good and juicy, and the sauce was amazing.

The coffee was excellent too – finally a really good cappuccino in the area ☕️

The atmosphere is relaxed and cozy, stylishly decorated, and just a lovely place to spend some time. The staff were friendly and attentive.

Highly recommended if you’re in Unawatuna and looking for a great breakfast or brunch spot. 😊

Our favorite cafe in Unuwatuna for dinner and breakfast. The team always goes above and beyond, the coffee is beautiful and the food delicious and wonderful creations. So much love and passion goes into everything they do and create. They serve cocktails and delicious food in the nighttime and sometimes even live music. We love the vibe, the place and the people. ❤️ THANK YOU!

Lovely staff and amazing food. We came for breakfast and I got the Nutella and banana on toast, it was so nice and my iced caramel latte was great as well. So reasonably priced and the manager is so friendly. Definitely recommended to come for breakfast if you’re in the area. So chilled out and good vibes

We came here for breakfast on our first day and the food and service were both amazing! The staff are super friendly and we enjoyed the food so much that we came back here for our tea! I recommend the chicken shawarma it was so good that I dug straight in and forgot to take a picture! We will definitely be returning over the next few days that we are in unawatuna!
We had a lovely late breakfast here. The bacon was crispy and the eggs were cooked perfectly. The team working were so kind and made sure we had a comfortable meal. Thank you and we will come back!
The guy who makes the coffee is actually SO nice he let me choose the music. Really nice place!

formatted_address: no.140 Matara Rd, අකුරැස්ස, Sri Lanka
name: Wickrama Cafe

reviews.text: This not halal food Restaurant

formatted_address: No.202 Matara Rd, Unawatuna 80600, Sri Lanka
name: Cafe Aroma Unawatuna

reviews.text:
We found our favorite restaurant in Sri Lanka! From the very first visit, we were welcomed so warmly - it felt like visiting old friends. Now we come here every day for lunch and dinner.
The food is absolutely delicious: generous breakfasts served all day, amazing pasta, great coffee, wonderful desserts, and unbelievably fresh juice!
The staff are incredibly kind, friendly, and always smiling. The place is clean, cozy, and beautifully maintained.
Thank you for all the lovely moments we’ve had here 💛
Highly recommended to everyone visiting the area!

Good shakes. The Nutella coffee shake was absolutely delicious. The blueberry shake was okay, but a little too sweet for me. Cakes were a mixed vibe. The chocolate cheesecake tasted good, but the naming should’ve been more consistent as it was a cheesecake stuffed chocolate cake. The red velvet cake was good but wasn’t fresh, gave off a bit of a frozen vibe. All the items were well presented and the staff was friendly as well.

The service from the staff was great. Lots of smiles and a friendly, helpful vibe.

However the food was just terrible. The chicken burger is a processed chicken patty that tasted like dog food (my girlfriend didnt eat the patty) but you’re still paying the same prices as other, nicer burgers in the area.

The smoked “chicken” ciabatta sandwich, I’m not sure if it was even chicken. The bread is most likely frozen, chicken serving was tiny I may as well have paid for a vegetarian sandwich.

Overall quite flavourless, cheap meat,

I would give a 1star, but the service was great and they deserve another chance. This is a managers issue, ordering the cheapest frozen Ingredients and not caring about taste.

Our favorite cafe in Unawatuna due to it's convinient location close to the main road and tasty meal. It's about 10 minutes walk from the Unawatuna beach. The cafe is beautifully decorated. One of the rare places where you can grab a cup of the real coffee with a tasty cake. You can find an AC, music and realxing atmosphere inside. It's possible rent a room with a spacious terrace and a view for a reasonable price. All facilities like hot water, modern design and AC are also included.

Dropped in for late lunch. What a stylish cafe. It's been done with taste, not your typical sri lankan design. Ordered a cheese and egg burger. Fresh and tasty with side order of fries. Plus a lemon drink. Lemon was real tangy.
Service was good. Food came quickly. Very impressed.

Travelling Sri Lanka with coeliac disease has been challenging but I had breakfast here and they substituted the granola for mango so I had a safe option! I would definitely recommend coming here, the berry bowl was lovely and so was the coffee. Whilst there aren’t many options (if you have coeliac) I really appreciated my dietary requirements being accommodated!

I absolutely loved my visits here! They offer a great variety of vegetarian and vegan options, all made with fresh ingredients and great flavor. The breakfast was delicious and beautifully presented. The team is very attentive, warm, and helpful, which makes the whole experience even better. I would come back here anytime.

Really delicious food and such a cozy place! I tried the waffle, which was amazing. I didn’t try the lunch options, but they also looked great. Definitely recommend!
They have 2-3 gluten free options ☺️

It's a cute cafe food is good but there were a lot of issues with the visit. Firstly the carrot waffle we ordered the ice-cream had an ant. Assume it was from the syrup bottle which they used as topping on the ice-cream. Half way thru the waffle there was a hair piece in the food. It's surprising none of the staff are wearing hair nets while making the food or gloves. We were too tired to bother cause it was hot and the place has only one small ac which is not sufficient to cool the entire place. The other issue was the staff were shouting in the kitchen loudly which we found absurd, since we were still there at the cafe.i
It's sad to see the restaurants in lanka seem to lack the professionalism standards which are needed. The coconut drink which was ordered was served in a platter , the platter had water in it and was wet. These are things which need to be.chekced before serving. I am not trying to ruin a business, but I hope for the sake of customers you all improve and wish you all the best.
Went to Kaaia for lunch today for the first time. Food was excellent tasting and super healthy. Decor is cute and cosy. Loved the all-female staff. This place is a gem!!!

Walked past on the way to the beach and had to stop. The music was chilled, the staff were super friendly and inviting. We ordered a Tuna bowl and chicken burger. The tuna bowl was super healthy and made with fresh fish caught that day. The burger was delicious with crispy potatoes.

Drinks options were wicked too, we had a strawberry lemonade that we could see the bar man make fresh. The flat white was delicious and had oat milk which is a struggle to find in Sri Lanka.

Will come back again.

Great spot in Unawatuna close to the beach . Best tuna tataki and tuna bowl in Sri Lanka. And amazing drinks.

Nice vibe, easygoing place, and friendly staff. Would definitely come back.

I am simply obsessed with this place! Have been coming here every day in the past week.
The food ,the atmosphere and the staff are fantastic!!
Happy hour from 12-4pm which a perfect time for those looking for a little break from the heat with cool tunes 🩵🩵

Had a beautifully presented and tasty avocado on toast on lovely brown toast. The staff are very welcoming and accommodated our request to sit near a plug to charge devices. The coffee is nice and strong. Good range of items on menu and plenty of iced drinks and smoothie options. Highly recommend!

We tried tuna steak and tempura shrimp here. It's very delicious.
And the smoothies here are incredible!
The place itself is very atmosphere-proof and beautiful.

formatted_address: 45/a Welle Dewalaya Rd, Unawatuna, Sri Lanka
name: Blue Caffeine

reviews.text: “Fantastic little café on the corner of the main road. We had a smoothie bowl, avocado and poached eggs on toast, and an omelette — everything was absolutely delicious. Super chilled, relaxed vibe. Highly recommend!”
Nice small coffee place, great options for breakfast. Had the smoothie bowl and the avocado toast and they were tasty. Prices to the higher range but still reasonable. Friendly staff. Recommended.

The people were really polite.
The place was cute and nice.
The smoothie bows were really delicious and a little cheaper than other places! Also the cappuccino has had an amazing creamy taste made with coconut milk!
It's just one of the coziest cafes I have ever been! And one of the best smoothie bowls ever! Thank you for this delicious moment 🤍

tasty food, good coffee, cute spot with a terrace on the 1st floor, friendly staff.
we had the avocado toast with poached eggs and spinach, super tasty

formatted_address: 184, Welledewala Junction, Galle, Matara Rd, Unawatuna 80600, Sri Lanka
name: Barista Unawatuna

reviews.text:
Such a positive vibe from the moment I walked in! The place has a beautiful interior — cozy, modern, and perfectly blends with the beach atmosphere of Unawatuna. The warm lighting, comfy seating, and chilled background music make it an ideal spot to relax, work, or just enjoy a coffee with friends.

The staff were incredibly friendly and welcoming — they truly make you feel at home. Service was quick, and every drink came out perfectly made. The coffee was rich and smooth, and their desserts were just as impressive.

Whether you’re a local or a traveler, this Barista outlet is a must-visit in Unawatuna.
❤️ Great coffee, great people, and a perfect vibe all around!

Barista Coffee Unawatuna is truly an amazing spot. The outlet has a beautiful and cozy atmosphere, perfect for relaxing after a beach walk or meeting friends. The coffee is top quality rich, smooth, and perfectly brewed every time. The staff are friendly, professional, and always make you feel welcome.

Their snacks and desserts are delicious, and the service is fast even during busy hours. The cleanliness and attention to detail really stand out. One of the best coffee experiences in the South. Highly recommend this place to anyone visiting Unawatuna.

An exceptional coffee experience at Barista Unawatuna!

I recently visited this outlet and was genuinely impressed by the service, quality, and atmosphere. The staff were professional, courteous, and attentive, ensuring every customer felt welcome. The coffee was brewed to perfection consistent with Barista’s well
known standards and the food was fresh and well presented.

It’s unfortunate to see a few misleading low ratings that don’t reflect the true experience here. As someone who appreciates good coffee and genuine hospitality, I can confidently say this outlet maintains the high quality and service expected from Barista Sri Lanka.

A wonderful place to relax, meet friends, or enjoy a quiet moment by the beach highly recommended for anyone visiting Unawatuna.

Need more staff on the 1st day of the year! Who manages this place? Who arranges the rota? If you are reading this and you are the owner, hire more people! This coffee shop is a classic copy paste Starbucks like but the coffee here is definitely better. The Turkish like bagel was tasty but the cheese was the standard “plastic” like supermarket slice.

This coffee shop interior, designed with warm and inviting atmosphere through the creative use of  matt finish gold color elements to give a premium feel to the coffee  . The gold metal bars and hanging  gold installation in the double height space combine the two floors other than the stair case.
The design  enabling light to the building from every side.  The layout balances social and semi-private seating zones effectively. Large sofas and arrangements for individuals or pairs. This zoning allows the café to accommodate diverse customer needs — from casual meetups to solo work sessions.
