The use of leather or leatherette sofas in light  tones gives the space a rich, grounded feel. Warm wood flooring and Burma teak -stained timber tables enhance the cozy, upscale atmosphere while remaining durable for commercial use. Orange fabric chairs and ottomans add a soft contrast, harmonizing with the café’s warm theme without overpowering it.

This café interior & exterior  successfully merges comfort, brand identity, and industrial-chic design principles. thoughtfully executed space that caters to both functionality and mood. integration of warm materials, light, greenery, and art creates a memorable and user-friendly environment .
Feeling and food is great, also the staff is very friendly.

formatted_address: Ganahena Temple Rd, Unawatuna, Sri Lanka
name: Nalini

reviews.text:
I came here every day during my stay (I didn't stay in their rooms) and everything I had was delicious!

Great coffee, delicious brownie 🤤
And the Thai dishes were super tasty and authentic and good portion size. Friendly staff and nice to sit in the quiet garden. Highly recommended!

We just stopped for coffee and breakfast...it was phenomenal! You can sit at the bar or lounge in the garden, depending which mode you are in. The servers are nice and helpful, the mood is relaxing. We had a wonderful espresso and a great french toast and a local curry plate. Would return for sure.

Had a wonderful experience at Olu Café! The Thai food was absolutely delicious—fresh, flavourful, and perfectly balanced. The ambience was warm and relaxing, making the whole meal even more enjoyable.

A special shout-out to Akash, whose service was exceptional. He was attentive, genuinely kind, and made sure everything was perfect from start to finish. Truly elevated the dining experience!

Highly recommend this place for anyone craving great Thai food paired with amazing service.

Unfortunately, I can't give any stars for the rooms, as I stayed elsewhere. However, I had the best cappuccino ever here every morning, and also enjoyed delicious breakfasts and lunches. The café is beautifully quiet, located in a courtyard, away from the hustle and bustle. The service was incredibly friendly and welcoming. Highly recommended!

The garden is beautiful and the food was amazing. We order different food from the cafe and the Thai place next door. Som-Tum salad, the Green Thai curry and chicken satay and it was really good. We also had the French toast and the homemade granola bowl. And the crispy fried chicken. All family loved the food from the baby to grandpa. You should definitely come here. The team was really nice and 5 star service.

I’m also a coffee lover and I got the coffee tonic 🤩 pure perfection.

I couldn’t took more photos because everyone was so happy and excited with the food

name: Sky Breeze | breakfast | brunch | dinner | gastrobar

reviews.text:
Had an amazing experience at Sky Breeze in Unawatuna! The beachfront location is absolutely beautiful…
I tried their beef burger — it was absolutely delicious! The patty was juicy, well-seasoned, and cooked perfectly. The bun was soft and fresh, and the portion size was satisfying. It came with crispy fries that complemented the burger really well.
The staff were friendly and attentive, making sure everything was perfect.
Highly recommended

Great vibe! Pretty cool place right by the ocean. Staff were friendly and energetic. Had the  Margherita pizza and pancakes which were both delicious! Iced Latte & Caramel matcha were also yummy!
We didn’t go swimming but the beach looked lovely and we could see people snorkelling.
Will definitely go back before we leave.

Sky Breeze is exactly the kind of place you hope to discover when travelling – and rarely do. Located right on the beach of Unawatuna, everything here just clicks: the staff is warm, attentive and genuinely caring – you feel looked after from the very first moment, not just like another guest passing through. The place is spotlessly clean, the vibe relaxed and enjoyable, with a stunning view straight out to the Indian Ocean.

The food is simply outstanding – fresh, flavourful, and every wish is fulfilled with real dedication. A place you'll want to come back to.

If you're visiting Unawatuna, this is an absolute must.

We were recommended this place on a chance encounter and so grateful for it! This is a jewel in Unawatuna. The location, Devore, food and cocktails are fantastic. But the real pearls are the staff. What a fantastic team of people working there. Big friendly smiles and go out of their way too make sure you have everything you need. Big thank you to Barry for taking such wonderful care of us. Can’t wait to come back 😊

We had breakfast here and I have to say it is a lovely place! Beautiful view and a really amazing coffee!!! Food was nice too.

We came a bit too early but they let us have a seat while they where still preparing for the day. In general very nice and lovely place.

It is a hipster surf place, so are the prices - but for us it was worth it today 😊

I had an amazing massage treatment with so much tender and love! Recommend to relax and to feel yourself in paradise. Also they have a great cuisine with tasty vegan food and very good variety for good price. Love this place!

Beautiful place and space, excellent service and fantastic massage.
You're being taken care of with love and kindness.
I have been coming to the Spa Una for years and am always leaving 100% happy relaxed and satisfied.
Highly recommend!
🪷☺️❤️

If you’re vegan, this is a must-visit place. They have many great vegan options, and I loved the food so much. The environment is cozy and surrounded by a bit of nature, which makes it extra relaxing. The staff were really friendly. Highly recommended for vegans in the area!🌮😋

This place is a real paradise escape for vegans in Unawatuna! My friends and I enjoyed every moment spent at this eco-friendly sun-sheltered space with perfect vegan food and massage service. The team is very amiable, we liked their quick and unobtrusive service very much. All dishes that we tried there were perfect! Especially the potato & leeks soup - it was so surprisingly  delicious that I asked the cook to share it’s recipe with me! And also you will love their perfect brownie with a gentle hint of coffee, yummy vegan cookies and non-dairy ice-cream. All dishes are decorated with different flowers from their garden - even simple cup of tea is amazingly accompanied by flowers. I also recommend to try traditional curry set - it’s a big fancy boat-plate with different types of dips, sautéed vegs, souses and rice. And you may also have good massage at calm and restful atmosphere. I highly recommend you this cafe with my proud and pleasure and special thanks to the Chef cook 🤗❤️🙏💐

For me this is the most beautiful restaurant and bar in unawatuna. I didn’t have food here . But they made me a fresh drink and it’s not on the menu yet. I love this place. Quite and calm. Def gonna comeback for dinner.
I loved it, such a amazing vibe there and the coffee is soo good😍 I‘ll definitly come back again

I recently visited this newly opened café and I’m honestly so impressed. From the moment you walk in, you can feel the warm and welcoming atmosphere. The interior is beautifully designed modern, cozy, and perfect whether you want to relax or get some work done.

The coffee is absolutely amazing you can tell that a lot of care goes into every cup. Everything tastes fresh and high quality. The menu has great options, and there’s something for everyone.

What really makes this place special is the service. The owner is incredibly friendly, attentive, and makes you feel right at home.

You can really see the passion behind this café, and it makes the whole experience even better. I’ll definitely be coming back regularly and recommending it to all my friends! 😍

Ahhh I had good time here
And the owner is super friendly !

Just a beautiful place and the drinks are so nice. The owner puts a lot of love into and creates his own drinks and mixes.
If you haven‘t been there - right now is the time to go :)

I had been looking for a really good coffee in Sri Lanka for a long time, and this place is a gem. The coffee is absolutely exceptional — honestly one of the best I’ve had in ages. If you’re not into coffee, their homemade iced teas are just as amazing. And the owner is truly lovely. Highly recommend!

Lovely family run place, really friendly service and good price! Had a good coffee, mango / banana / coconut milshake and a roti with egg, tofu, and vegetable. Good for vegetarian & vegan.

Really lovely and welcome vibes, books & magazines to read

This is a place you will walk by but you really shouldn't. This is run by Lanka and Sharma and they produce some really tasty food. My wife and I have had breakfast here many times the Shakshouka is very good as are the fresh juices.
We also had the best curry and rice we've eaten in Sri Lanka. Served with spiced potatoes, dhal, curried beetroot and a coconut Sambal, (they don't serve alcohol but you can take your own). Lanka and Sharma are the very best of people and will welcome you always with a smile.
A lovely family-run café with an authentic atmosphere. The owners are genuinely welcoming and kind, and the food is absolutely delicious — every bite was amazing. Highly recommended!

Absolutely lovely place with lovely people, me and my friends came back here every day while travelling in Unawatuna. The food is made fresh with a smile each time. We can highly recommend the ciabatta and choco banana pancakes! A firm favourite.

I had a wonderful dinner here! The food was super tasty, i had one veggie and one banana roti, both were fantastic. And the mango lassi was so delicious as well!
The owners of the restaurant are so nice, welcoming and attentive :)
Definitely eat here if you are looking for a local experience!!
Try it in this forthcoming season.delicious food and excelent service..and you will be looked after by  friendly staff ..

Amazing food all over the menu, lovely and friendly staff also. Easy to find and definitely worth going to after a day at the beach as it’s only a short 5 minute walk up the road.

Best place to eat in Unawatuna, highly recommend!!
Lovely little cafe with a calming ambiance and hamack. We had 2 soups and they were proper well made delicious soups. The soups were perfect for a light meal or starter.
Great place! Good atmosphere! It's much better than cafes on the beach!
Very nice place with high quality dishes, one of the best restaurant in Unawatuna

I ate the most delicious fish in my life. It was so delicious that we came to eat same fish for dinner. It’s not just fish! They brought side dishes such as chips/mashed potatoes, salad and roti and it cost 3500 rp. The sauce they prepared for fish was amazing. It was sweet and sour.The workers are always smiling and I think this is the most great restaurant in Mirissa!

Visited as a family of 4 to enjoy slavic food and “As at home” vibes.

Food was there. No vibes at all. Well, tourists from CIS will understand.

We ordered Borsch, Dumplings, Okroshka and Fried potatoes with mushrooms. Food was good, however you should be ready that some of ingredients simply not available here, thus they replace it or don’t add it to the dish.

We expected to feel the vibe of Slavic place far away from home, however it was not there. You are served with the order and that’s it. No “hello” in Slavic languages, no ladies who cook in an authentic way, no interior that reminds you of “Home”.

We ordered delivery from this place and couldn’t be happier with the experience. Our order included two portions of dumplings and two beef burgers. Everything arrived warm within an hour.

The dumplings were a generous size, served with sour cream, and tasted fantastic — a perfect 50/50 mix of beef and pork. The beef burgers were juicy and flavorful, with perfectly cooked patties. On top of that, we got free delivery and even a complimentary apple charlotte as part of their promotion.

This spot is definitely one of the best places for authentic Russian cuisine in the southwest of Sri Lanka. Highly recommend!
We went to their another branch at Galle Fort next to Southland. Very delicious food with best customer service. Highly recommended 👏

We arrived for dinner and Nishan was very nice. He paid attention to all details including Spanish music, and we decided to come back for breakfast.
For breakfast he made egg hoppers for us, which was amazing! Thank you for the service ❤️

formatted_address: Kuruduwathudeniya, Yaddehimulla Rd, Unawatuna 80600, Sri Lanka
name: Grind Time Unawatuna

reviews.text: Great place with a very nice owner. You will get here perfect European service and tasty food and drinks. Highly recommend this place. It is hidden from a loud touristic area which makes it cozy and quiet. I’m a regular customer and even have loyalty card :)

I could sit here all day, drink my cappuccino and watch the art in my cup change after every sip!
One of the best places we visited during our coastal trip. not only the coffee but also the food is extraordinary tasty!
Nicest coffee and service I r had since I’ve started travelling. Amazing smoothie bowl and really filling. Make sure to say hello to Pablo as well!

Huge recommendation! The food and the drinks are so delicious, the service is super kind an the ambience is beautiful. They even handed us games to play during our stay. Would love to come here again!

The espresso coffee was outstanding. The  best I’ve had on my trip to Sri Lanka and as a trained barista I know about coffee. The key is the locally sourced Arabica beans and a person who knows how to operate their machine. We also had an omelette and smoothie bowl to eat which were both delicious. It’s a short walk up the hill from the beach but well worth it. Thank you for a lovely breakfast.

Beautiful place hidden in the jungle. Stylish, cosy and modern interior with a very vibey atmosphere. The service is friendly, the music is soft, and everything is neat and well thought out. The food is excellent, the brunch was delicious, and the coffee was tasty. The place is very clean and overall just super stylish and enjoyable!

Beautiful place. Calm, peaceful, space and food made with love and an eye for details. We really appreciate our brunch here. Thank you for making us feel home here away from the buzz down the beach🙏🏼 🌺
Beautiful café with great food and amazing coffee :) I am a huge fan of soy milk and glad I could find it here! Greatly enjoyed the cappuccino. I would highly recommend!

It's a vibe! Staff's lovely (hell yeah to the 2 female chefs 🤙), the menu is so adventurous and neat. If you're staying in Unawatuna i think it's worth visiting this brand new (!!!) café in the middle of a jungle. And oh the gallery on the top floor is just beautifully curated. Well done guys & see you soon 🫂

amy 🌞

Great food, beautiful place and friendly staff. Definitely recommend visiting this place. We visited twice with our two kids and everything we ordered was very tasty. From burrito's and sandwiches to waffles and soup.

We had breakfast and dinner at this cafe. The breakfasts were delicious, varied, and hearty, with plenty of fresh fruit and handmade tea (which we took home with us). The cafe also served lunches and dinners, where you could order gourmet Sri Lankan cuisine or purchase seafood that the owners would prepare to your liking. We purchased shrimp and fish, and they created unforgettable dishes with the perfect blend of spices. The cafe always had water and fresh fruit available, so you could enjoy a juice or take it with you to the beach. In the villa's store, you can find handmade spices and teas that are not commonly available in tourist areas. We have acquired rare varieties of tea and aromatic black pepper that are rarely found in stores in our country. These products are handmade in small quantities and are not exported to other countries.

After climbing up from Unawatuna beach, down to Jungle Beach, and visiting the Peace Pagoda, we took a chance on the restaurant for a rice curry for lunch. It was a lucky choice. She whipped us up a delicious curry: whole rice, dal, curried mangoes, curried bananas and some spicy coconut thing. All delicious. With bottled water, it came to 2900 LKR. My wife bought some fresh peppercorns to bring home. Pleasant, gracious ladies.

We ate delicious food here. They waited for us especially, and stayed open past their usual time. The curries, dal and salads were all so tasty. I hadn't found these specific aubergine or plantain curries anywhere else in Sri Lanka so it was nice to try something new. The owners/staff were extremely friendly and kind. Thank you so much, we will be back 🙏
Absolutely the best place to have local food. The family is super sweet, everything is homemade. Thank you!

We are staying at Jungle Joy & decided to have dinner at this delightful restaurant. It’s completely family run, & the Sri Lankan home cooking was superb & very reasonable. All of the family came to say hello & welcome us.
We will certainly return. Thank you Dinesh & Family.🙏🏽

name: Tropical Aroma juice bar & coffee shop

reviews.text:
Love this spot! Very clean,staff is nice,food & juices delicious and great prices. If you tired of Sri Lanka’s food and you wanna have some snack,come here.
I had chicken burger,2x pancakes,papaya juice and water for 900lkrs

Hidden gem in Unawatuna!!

Delicious food and amazing staff — we had a large group (7) and all ordered multiple things: chicken sandwiches, wraps, pancakes, milkshakes, ice cream. They were very accommodating for our vegan/vegetarians; Im gluten free so I can’t vouch for the sandwiches/food (I didn’t ask for gluten free substitutions but am tempted to see if they can do GF shawarma next time) but I personally ordered the passion fruit milkshake for lunch and ended up ordering a second banana milkshake because it was THAT good.

I’ll be back to try more - the strawberry milkshake and latte are next :) Thank you!
Amazing place, coffee is sooooo good 😍 they ask half the price for better coffee then other places in the area , and you get kindness and good energy , very unique lovely place☺️
So a friendly small team. It doesn't matter what time of day you go there start with a milkshake, then something else and finish with one of their ice creams. Well lush and excellent value
I’ve been to this café a few times, it’s perfect for breakfast. Very good food/drinks and the owners are extremely kind! Definitely would recommend!

The Lavender Coffee and the pomodoro pasta was amazing, the honey butter toast was decadent. The environment was so peaceful and the staff even spoke some Hindi! One of the few places were the service was warm and sweet!
Would absolutely recommend this place for travellers looking for some respite and lots of peace. They do close early so definitely look at the timings before you go in.

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ The Garden House – Unawatuna

Absolutely amazing place! The Garden House is a true hidden gem in Unawatuna. Beautiful tropical garden, very relaxing atmosphere and the perfect spot to unwind. The food is fresh, delicious and beautifully presented — the breakfast and coffee are among the best I had in Sri Lanka.

The staff is extremely friendly, professional and always helpful. Everything is clean, well organized and you can really feel the attention to detail. It’s clear that the owners truly care about quality and guest experience.

Highly recommended to everyone visiting Unawatuna. I would definitely come back again!

Probably the best place in Unawatuna for breakfast.
They have real sourdough, which is not very common. Sometimes places write “sourdough” but bring low-quality bread instead.

I’m not sure about the desserts, but the breakfast dishes are good.
I don’t agree that they are overpriced — the prices are just standard for this area.

The most beautiful cafe. Wonderful food, amazing tea, great service. Served very quickly and with a smile. Offered extra hot water to top up tea. Avo toast was DELICIOUS. A great spot to spend a quiet afternoon with a book or just to grab a quick bite or coffee. Lovely atmosphere and beautiful natural surroundings, very chill vibe.

Just off the fume-rich hubbub of the main road lies a tranquil, cool oasis of calm. The Garden House serves a wide range of great coffee, as well as fresh healthy food and juices. Wonderful service. A real Galle treasure!
Great place to coffee lovers. They have variety of coffees hot & cold. Highly recommend! ☕🧋
Great place to have a quick refreshment. Staff is really friendly!
Great space for a meeting, strong AC and good service
Everything from the food to the service to the atmosphere was perfect.
Nice and cozy place. Good coffee, fresh food, and friendly staff. Overall, a great place to hangout ❤️
Delicious food and coffee, super friendly staff and very good atmosphere. 10/10
Love the atmosphere and i asked a protein bowl, it was amazing😍 will come back for sure
Everything was super and delicious, the service was absolutely perfect💗🔥🔥❤️‍🔥

Great brunch!
Food is delicius, service is kind🥰
Best brunch in Unawatuna, staff is so kind, excellent!
Parking space for peace pagoda temple.parking charges are not high and the parking attendants are very helpful and kind

formatted_address: නො.84 Matara Rd, Unawatuna 80600, Sri Lanka
name: Bun talk bakery

reviews.text: Try the egg roll and veggie roti they are great both have a bit of spice

One of the best places to get shorteats and other bakery goods....There are so many choices to choose from and the food is tasty too....There are some unique items like Fried fish buns and chicken n cheese buns. Most of all the prices are so FAIR for the current economy.......On average one can get normal bakery items for LKR100👍🏻✨
Great place to have cheap and tasty buns and pastries theres a small parking area and you can dine in here aswell
Bakery items for affordable prices. Good portion sizes. Price tags are available for each item
Small bakery, but great food! Recommend...

formatted_address: no 64 Matara Rd, Unawatuna, Sri Lanka
name: Ceilão Tea Corner & Cafe

reviews.text: Highly recommend not to eat here. 3cof our family have ended up getting mild food poisoning from eating a pizza!! The kitchen is not clean and it was only afterwards that my niece told me they were preparing fish near our pizzas. Now we have lost some of our holiday. Thank you Tropical Kitchen

Do not recommend for solo females… or anyone ?

I didn’t even eat, just sat on a sunbed and had a water. But from the moment I arrived I felt unsafe, the men were staring at me and only after I left did I check these reviews.

Feel like I’m lucky I got away without anything worse happening

A lot has already been said so I won’t pile on too much. Initially our group liked the atmosphere, the setting really is beautiful. But things soon devolved as some junior staff members were aggressive with unwanted physical contact. Several members of our group had to quite assertively defend themselves. Management either didn’t notice or didn’t care. I wanted to enjoy the experience but did not.

Ordered a tuna, didn't get tuna, but they told us it was tuna. Gogot to serve my beer (not usually a problem but in context)
Beautiful view.

Extremely Unsafe and Disturbing Experience

I am still shocked by what happened last night at this place. What started as a seemingly normal visit quickly turned into a frightening and completely unacceptable situation.

Shortly after we arrived, one staff member began invading our personal space and repeatedly touching us. His behavior was highly inappropriate, and he appeared to be under the influence of drugs. Even after we clearly told him to stop, he continued and escalated the situation by taking photos and videos of us without consent. We were forced to take his phone and delete the images ourselves.

Things got even worse when more staff members joined in, also appearing to be under the influence, and they began touching us as well. When I firmly rejected one employee’s physical contact, he became aggressive. At the same time, a snake suddenly appeared. The man who had been taking photos ran over to it, singing and filming.

Then, in an absolutely terrifying moment, the aggressive employee grabbed the snake (Sri Lanka Krait which is extremely venomous) by its tail and tried to bring it toward us. We had to use a chair to keep him away and fled the place in fear for our safety.

As if that wasn’t enough, when we were trying to leave, they demanded more money from us than what we actually owed for our drinks.

This was one of the most unsafe, disturbing, and unprofessional experiences I have ever had in any establishment. There was a complete lack of boundaries, consent, and basic safety. I strongly warn anyone against visiting this place. No one should ever be put in a situation like this.

formatted_address: Mihiripenna Meegahawaththa Rd, Unawatuna, Sri Lanka
name: Green Lanka plant nursery & B N H Food & Bimsara art

reviews.text: Excellent place to find beautiful plants.It really worth to visit this place and won't regret the amount of money you spend in this place
Beautiful selection and lots of bonsai!
So yummy! The gentleman attending the business greeted me with a huge smile that made me feel so welcomed. The food is so good, I got a fish and veggie roll and they were so crispy and delicious

Genuine Sri Lanka culinary experience. Local food, local taste, local prices. We tried fresh-from-the-pan coconut pancakes and they were ever so delicious! 50 rupees per one. Vegetable rolls and egg bun were also great.

reviews.author_name: Home visit massage therapist Island wide
reviews.text: Super place for shorteats.. I do love this place and I do go there often.. specially they offer best foods with reasonable price.. so I do highly recommend this place
Very good food, clean and staff very friendly

I highly recommend it! The pancakes and rolls are fresh and well-priced, without the tourist markup. And the coconut pancakes are absolutely fantastic, only 50 rupees. They're 500 rupees on the tourist street. The owners are lovely.

we arrived with synched-up periods on the night of a full moon and were seated right under a glowing full-moon lamp 🌝 and what an evening of lunar lunacy and laughter we had !

between fake plants and framed certificates, i had my very first veggie kottu and it was flavorful, comforting and ridiculously affordable – i can only join the choir of certificates and attest: outstanding.

even though this place is called 'coffee beans ceylon', the coffee itself was a bit underwhelming. BUT it was served in a fabulous gucci cup, which carried the experience on aesthetics alone.

throughout the evening, fun songs floated through the air. the music had us howling along like two wolves raised by bruno mars and playing imaginary instruments all night.

you can write on the walls like it’s one giant guestbook and naturally, i could not resist contributing. i won’t reveal which cheeky little 12-year-old-boy scribbles are mine, but you’re welcome to go looking for it. greetings go out to maria, who tells naughty stories and remains a devoted fan of topless summer.

extra love for a place that offers free food for pregnant moms (and hopefully any other pregnant person too) ♡ this place has good energy, you can taste it.

Came here for the breakfast, all was excellent except that Sri Lankan breakfast wasn’t available at 09:30….which was a shame. Pineapple juices and coffees were good. Would recommend to stop by, especially if you are around Turtle Beach.

This is a nice little café on the road side. The owner is extremely hospitable and kind. Prices are average for the area. The breakfast was OK. Too bad there were no vegetables like a tomato, but there was a tomato on the menu image. The owner opened the shop for me 7:30 and I’m very thankful for him for that. The brownie cake was amazing with the tea. I would definitely return to this place again. You can also write your City on the wall with a marker.

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Cozy spot in Unawatuna

Coffee Beans Ceylon Restaurant & Café has a warm and cozy environment that makes it a pleasant place to relax. The food tastes good, though the portion sizes are average. Prices are also reasonable and in line with what you’d expect in the area. Overall, it’s a nice café to enjoy a calm meal or coffee break while in Unawatuna.

Good food, good service. I came to this local restaurant recently and ordered Chicken Katto and Fried Nuddle. The food is nice and great for dinner. The chef is Humble and asking how was our dinner. :)
Will come again when visiting Unawatuna - Galle.

formatted_address: Lane 3 Field View Road Nalagasdeniya, Baddegama Rd, Hikkaduwa 80240, Sri Lanka
name: Asian Jewel Boutique Hotel & Restaurant

reviews.text:
The Asian Jewel Hotel & Restaurant, beautifully located by the lagoon, is a true hidden gem. The stunning view over the water as well as the idyllic place there, creates a relaxed and special atmosphere, making every visit a pleasure, whether during the day or in the evening.

The menu offers a wide variety of dishes, ranging from authentic specialties to classic English cuisine, so there is something to suit every taste. The food is outstanding, prepared with great care and using only fresh ingredients.

The exceptionally friendly staff truly set this place apart. The service is warm, attentive, and very personal, making guests feel genuinely welcome. You don’t feel like just another customer — rather, you feel at home from the moment you arrive.

Overall, this restaurant combines excellent food, very good value for money, a beautiful location and heartfelt hospitality. A wonderful place to relax, enjoy great cuisine, and feel completely at ease.
Highly recommended!

We attended the Xmas dinner and it was everything you could hope for. As someone that lives in Asia, I know how hard and expensive it can be to get simple UK products like English Mustard, brusselsprouts and parsnips! But it didn't stop there. What a fantastic lunch and a beautiful setting. Thank you Asian Jewel!

We didn't stay but I would expect the same level to detail would be given to staying guests as well.

A bit remote, but a beautiful setting overlooking the huge lake.
Perfect Sunday dinners and well kept drinks. Highly recommend.

Stunning food ,great views and location . Very friendly and accommodating.
Would definitely recommend a visit even if its to just sample the atmosphere and the food .
We went for Christmas dinner and were not disappointed. Great food, great service and nice atmosphere in a very picturesque setting.

Had a horrible experience with one of the servers at this place. Very creepy guy who made me feel extremely uncomfortable and unsafe.

Wouldn't let me sit on the beach and enjoy the sunset in peace because he wanted to make conversation. Even after asking him to leave me alone, he kept disturbing me and asking me to go for a party at night or come and eat something.

Management really needs to get and run background checks on who they're hiring.
Very bad experience. Very dirty and customer services are very very bad. Also taken money fro us, beyond which are mention in the  menu. Very bad hygine. Don't go to that restaurant.🤢

"I had a very disappointing experience at this restaurant. The hygiene was concerning—tables were dirty, and the overall cleanliness was lacking. The food was even worse: the taste was bland and unappetizing, clearly not prepared with care. To top it off, the service was rude and unprofessional. The staff seemed uninterested in providing a pleasant dining experience. I won’t be returning and wouldn’t recommend this place to anyone looking for quality food or service."
Worst restaurant I have ever been to. Charge me double the price. Charge triple the price for a tea. Very poor customer service

Athula beach is more of an eatery but located in the central Hikkaduwa . The dining area is facing the beach and to your right you could see the Hikkaduwa fishing port. The food  quality is satisfactory and the service was good. Koththu is my recommended food. I would also recommend trying out the dinner menu more than the lunch menu.

Isuru (not sure if the spelling is correct) made our stay worth it, very kind and helpful, he also found a cheap tour for us.

However, there was sand underneath the sheets, it seemed like they weren’t changed since the previous guests. The room had mold fungus both visible on the walls and in the air. Otherwise, the location is super!

I think this is the best budget hotel in Hikkaduwa. We booked 5 air-conditioned rooms and had a great time with my cousins. The service team was amazing and very helpful throughout our stay. The rooms were better compared to other budget hotels we’ve stayed at.

Just a few small suggestions:
It would be nice to have basic amenities like tea mugs, a kettle, and bed sheets provided in the rooms.

"A wonderful place with a very friendly staff. The cleanliness is exceptionally high. The staff are truly welcoming. It’s a beautiful spot located right by the sea — very peaceful and calm. For the price you pay, the value you receive is excellent. It’s definitely worth it and affordable for us as well."
Location was great..Just next to Hikka tranz.Easily go to the beach and get the experience  of turtles,Corals and snorkling.Isuru was really helpfull.

We got stuck in hikkaduwa with the cyclone and we needed somewhere to stay.
This place was way better than expected!
The staff are amazing and the location is awesome!
Highly recommend!!

Popped in for a drink, service a setting and view was so good we returned with friends for an evening meal. Lovely lighting sets the scene for a wonderful seaside meal. With the waves and gentle music working in partnership.

Food wow two dishes stood out the seafood curry and the squid. Both some of the best food we have had. If you find it drop in and give it a go.

If you’re in Hikkaduwa and looking for a true beachfront dining experience, Mama’s Beach Restaurant is a must-visit spot.
🌅 Location & Atmosphere
Right on the beach, you can literally sit with your feet in the sand while enjoying your meal. The sunset view here is beautiful — golden sky, ocean breeze, and the sound of waves create the perfect relaxed vibe. Ideal for couples, friends, or even solo travelers who just want to unwind.
🦐 Food Quality
The seafood is fresh and well prepared. The seafood platter (prawns, calamari, grilled fish) is flavorful, nicely seasoned, and not overly oily. They also offer Sri Lankan-style curries if you prefer local flavors. Portions are generous and satisfying.
🍹 Drinks
Fresh juices and cocktails are refreshing. A cold beer while watching the sunset here feels like the perfect holiday moment.
👨‍🍳 Service
Friendly and welcoming staff. During peak hours, you may need to wait a little, but the quality of the food makes it worth it.
💰 Pricing
For a beachfront restaurant in a popular tourist area like Hikkaduwa, prices are reasonable and offer good value for the overall experience.
📌 Local Guide Tips:
• Best time to visit: 5:30 PM – 6:30 PM for sunset views
• Reserve a beachside table in advance during busy seasons
• Seafood platter is perfect to share between two people
Overall, Mama’s Beach Restaurant offers a relaxed, authentic beach dining experience in Hikkaduwa. Highly recommended for seafood lovers and sunset seekers.

Great food
Great location
Generous portions
Visited for a quick lunch and the experience was amazing. Friendly staff and the service was super fast. Not the best place for cocktails but fantastic food.
High value for what u spend.
Would highly recommend

This morning, we visited this amazing restaurant, and it was really fantastic. We had the cheese, tomato, egg, bacon sandwich so, so delicious, highly recommend ! We loved the place, especially because it’s close to the ocean with a perfect ocean view.

The staff was still cleaning when we arrived, which was fine, but what really concerned us was that when the person finished sweeping, they threw all the trash straight into the ocean. That’s just not okay. We really need to keep our ocean clean and care for our environment

The place is nice. However we were expecting to have a calm outdoor dinner near in the beach. But there was no sitting option available in the beach. The Ocean is directly next to the restaurant.
The food was really good. Highly recommend their specials. Overall the vibe was nice. Music was good. Enjoyed the dinner.

We stayed forc3 nights in Feb of 2026 and LOVED it. We came here to do some serious snorkeling and the room was perfect for us. We had an ocean-side room on the top floor with a balcony that looked over the Bay and had amazing sunsets with waves crashing all night for a peaceful sleep. The balcony was really nice to have, but the best part was the huge bathroom and shower whete we could easily change out of our snorkeling stuff with getting sand all over the room

The owner is super nice and helpful, as was the entire staff. One nice thing was that the outlets in our room worked with US 2-prong, European 2 prong, round 3 prong and vertical 3-prong. Super nice not to need a bunch of new adapters.

The building and rooms were older but very clean, and we loved the bed with mosquito netting even though bugs weren't an issue. The rooms are very reasonably priced and the ocean view is WAY better than you will get at the Hikka Tranz for 8x the price. The turtles are about 150 meters south at the Hikka Tranz, but the best snorkeling was about 600 meters north of our place, just north of the Coral Sands Hotel. Some ofbthe best snorkeling we've ever done. Easy walk. And a bonus is that our favorite restaurants were literally 20 m across the road (Salty Beer and Rustic Roots).

Fantastic place to spend a few days!

The hotel and restaurant are in a perfect location in Hikkaduwa. The rooms are clean and comfortable, have everything you need, and the view from the terraces is fascinating. It is close to the beautiful turtles beach. The food is very delicious, and the hosts are exceptional people - very kind and helpful. We were at a very difficult time for us with them and they helped us a lot!

This is a very pleasant place with some really nice sea views.
The workers were welcoming and efficient.
They have a good range of Sri Lankan and European dishes.
I had the chicken and vegetable soup which was  satisfactory, but like the current US President, lacked substance and taste. The accompanying ultra-processed bread was likewise lack-lustre.
Lovely views.

We are a family of four and had a great time. The local dishes tasted very good and you get a lot for your money. The staff is very kind and try their best to understand us and had amazing service. We received all the dishes at the same time which we haven’t experienced any were else. We recommend this restaurant to whoever is looking for a local restaurant in Sri Lanka Hikkaduwa!

Lovely rooms with amazing views. It has everything what you need, including kettle, hairdryer, etc. BTW.. Shower is really good as well. The restaurant downstairs has very good quality food and view to die for.

formatted_address: Lane 3, Field View, Baddegama road, Nalagasdeniya, Hikkaduwa, Sri Lanka
name: Kalla Bongo Lake Resort

reviews.text: A very good location. Nice view of the lake.. calm place. Food is fine but needs little improvements. Recommended for family and friends. Good staff and service. Yet they need to repair the pool immediately.

Super relaxed. Beautiful views from first floor rooms, but no TV, that's not much loss. Showers have little pressure. Rooms very clean. Beds have soft mattress, unusual for Sri Lanka. Nice pool. Restaurant is good, reasonable price, amazing view. Kayaks can be used for free. Nice staff.
Addendum: Apparently one of the guests left the tap on and used up the water supply. The water problem was efficiently dealt with over dinner. Thank you Melvin.

Great view from the resort! The staff also is helpful and courteous. The rooms are average, and the room services (water supply, etc.) Needs urgent repair. I think they are about to renovate so that should make things better. The overall experience can be great but I feel the rooms are a bit overpriced vs the lie condition. Do check if they have renovated the rooms before deciding to book.

Had a relaxing 2 nights at Kalla Bongo. Nice location over looking the lake & away from the touristy beach side.
Rooms are clean and spacious with very good service. Will be back very soon when we are ready for a holiday.

One of the best Lagoon view place located in Hikkaduwa. Lagoon view rooms are very clean and tidy. swimming pool, bar restaurant added additional value to the resort. They have wonderful staff. Really enjoyed their espresso ☕️ and Juices. Also, can experience the canoe ride 😍

formatted_address: dhananji, walawuwaththa, walauwwaththa road, Hikkaduwa 80240, Sri Lanka
name: Hikka BOBA

reviews.text:
Nice family restaurant with a beautiful garden which reminds me of those in Thailand.
We visited it for breakfast as we stayed in a hotel nearby.
Low prices for local dishes.

I had to meals here both were delicious.
And prepared by a very friendly owner great value for money
I can highly recommend eating area set in a beautiful garden.

formatted_address: 932 Galle - Colombo Rd, Hikkaduwa, Dodanduwa 80250, Sri Lanka
name: Villa Kusum

reviews.text: We have had a cooking class for typical sri lankan veggie curries with the owner of villa kusum. The host was very welcoming and the curry was so good! Definitely can highly recommend it.

Excellent small family hotel in an old colonial building, complete with original fixtures and fittings. Bags of character. Half hour walk along the beach or short tuktuk ride from Hikkaduwa  town/beach. The owner Dinesh and staff Dana made our stay an absolute pleasure, really lovely and warm people. We initially intended to stay two nights but ended up staying two weeks. Right on the beach but has a pool in case you want to swim during monsoon season....Great value off season. Highly recommended. We were sad to leave.
I only stayed for a few hours here and had the most incredible breakfast on the beach around 2pm very clean very friendly beautiful building and beach settings i will stay here when I come back

If you are into antique style you are in for a treat. It has access to its own beach as well as one short Tuk ride from the Hikka coral reef and the turtle beach.

We were fortunate to have the whole place to ourselves due to visiting it during off season. Dinesh is one of the best hosts I've met, and Dananjaya made our stay fantastic!
Wonderful restaurant by the beach. Friendly staff and excellent food.

Best place to get Delicious food experience in Hikkaduwa.Perfect place to dine in and stay.Our family had a great time by the service provided. The staff was so friendly and warm specially the chef who cooked the food for us. Thank you for providing such a good food experience for us. We will visit again soon when we visit  Srilanka again.
Both hotel and restaurant are perfect! We quite enjoyed the stay and delicious foods. Staff are very attentive and quick. Recommended to everyone.

Delicious food, nice vibe, perfect place to dine in and stay. Me and my husband are extremely pleased by the service provided. The staff was so friendly and warm. Thank you for providing such a pleasant experience. Will visit again soon.

My wife and I stayed at this hotel in February. We all liked it very much. The owner of the hotel Peter and his wife Martina were very kind and always helped us if we had any questions. Sometimes Peter personally brought fresh barracuda and they made steaks, it was very tasty. The rooms are large and clean. And we also played chess and drank beer.) The staff is super, and the hotel is good for little money! We are very satisfied.
Alexey and Lyuba from Ukraine.

Nice place, burger restaurant on the first floor. The walls in the rooms are rather thin, we heard both the neighbors and the road nearby. In addition, the construction of a new hotel was very close, so more noise(( In general, a comfortable place for its price, but you need to be able to sleep deeply

formatted_address: 384, Galle Road, A2, Hikkaduwa, Sri Lanka
name: Refresh Beach Restaurant

reviews.text:
The food very low quality, waiters are not able to deliver 100% what was ordered. High prices, almost the same as in Italy, Germany or Poland.
The sea food noodles gives with 12 pieces of pork. Horrible experience.  Fantastic location close to the beach. Fresh lobsters, very nice plants.
The food not recommended, the place absolutely yes!
General opinion very low,

Right next to Indian Ocean, great place to unwind for good food. They have live Lobsters and mussels- you can pick them for your dish. Pasta had too much cream - didn't like it.
Sea food was tasty.
Lunch cost for 3 of us was LKR 17,963 and the bill has 10% Service Charge.

Amazing. Not just a great spot... easily the best seafood I have ever had in my life, anywhere in the world, and I'm Australian so we know about seafood! Maybe it depends on what you order but I had a bit of everything and it was fresh and sensational. My advice is, don't be cheap and fork out for the good stuff, it's worth it. And the staff are impeccable.

Took a break for lunch at this place on our way to Galle. It is an interesting place, beach side, with live crabs/lobsters to select for the meal. We were a group of 9 folks including three kids. They did have a baby high chair available. The seating wasn't very comfortable. The sofa side was a bit high for the table while the chairs a bit low.

We ordered grilled lobster, crab curry rice, srilankan fish curry rice, chicken fried rice, barracuda fish fillet, grilled octopus and a couple of vegetarian dishes. The seafood taste was quite good, the srilankan fish curry being a standout. The crab curry was quite spicy, it almost felt like red chilli powder had been sprinkled on top. Grilled octopus and lobster were good. The chicken fried rice was just so so. The portions of the dishes were large.

The service however was lacking. The place was crowded and the service really suffered. The barracuda fish fillet never came. It took forever to get our orders and it was difficult to give follow-up orders. The hot weather and lack of sufficient fans made it worse. We had planned to get dessert but skipped it because it took forever to even place the order. It took almost 2 hrs to complete our meal which disrupted our plans for the day.

The kids did enjoy picking the crab and lobster and getting them weighed. However, it took quite some time as the person who was to help us select went missing.

Overall, while the seafood is great and the location right on the beach is excellent as well, the service really let down our experience.
Amazing food and service, located on a beautiful beach, would highly recommend it.

formatted_address: Hikkaduwa - Baddegama Road, Pathana,, 44QF+R24, Hikkaduwa, Sri Lanka
name: Green Shadow Wedding Hall

reviews.text:
Budget friendly wedding venue and friendly staff.
Foods: average
Washroom: old

Place is good but not recently renovated visible wall patches and not working lights
Broken toilet taps and there are much flies in the hall
Food is below average level,not sevoury not much tasty.
Garden is good
Parking is good
Delicious food & very friendly staff. The manager is also very friendly and accommodating. The banquet hall and other facilities are also good. Can recommend!
Spacious wedding hall and a garden, good for a night outdoor function...delesious food with lot of vegetarian dishes...
Had a good experience. One of my cousins had his wedding function here. Food was ok.

We ate here last night ~ great value, polite staff and really special Sri Lankan curry....chicken or fish with rice, popadoms and 3 vegetable dishes....850 rupees....gin and whole tonic 350....prawn curry 500. 😋 yummy.

You can't call it seafood pasta! And this pasta looks terrible, it tastes like porridge. There is no seafood, only fish and vegetables. And the pizza is very small, but it costs like pizza in a restaurant. It's terrible, I don't recommend this cafe.

I had a fantastic experience at Pizza Hut Hikkaduwa! The pizzas were fresh, flavorful, and perfectly cooked — the crust was soft yet crispy, and the toppings were generous and delicious. The staff were friendly, attentive, and made sure everything was perfect. The restaurant is clean, comfortable, and has a great ambiance, making it ideal for family outings or a casual meal with friends. Located conveniently near the beach, it’s a great spot to relax and enjoy some quality food. Highly recommend it to anyone looking for a tasty pizza experience in Hikkaduwa! 🍕✨

Terrible pizza we got delivered , totally dry and overcooked.
Really not worth the price and doesn’t match the standard of pizza worldwide .
Customer service not better , in stead of admitting the bad quality they rejected the responsibility on the driver .
So no refund or no gesture .
DONT ORDER PIZZA FROM THERE ! Really not worth the price .
Superb Pizza Hut Hikkaduwa outlet 💜️🫂😚👑 yummy 🤤 Pizza 🍕
Friendly staff. Food is in the standard.But vehicle parking is bit far from the outlet .Inside of the outlet is really nice. Love this place.Highly recommend .

formatted_address: 6 Sarath Goonawardana Mawatha, Hikkaduwa, Sri Lanka
name: Isira Coffee Shop & Restaurant

reviews.text:
We ate here yesterday and today we had the rice and curry and the khottu. The currys dishes I  believe vary each day.

The food was amazing and every dish was full of flavour.

One of the best places we have been in Sri Lanka for rice and curry

Amazing! Such delicious food. So delicious we came back 4 times! We tried lots of different things but the Sri Lankan breakfast was our favourite. Sooo delicious and authentic with lovely staff and relaxed atmosphere. 10/10 would definitely recommend!

It is always the best place to eat local style food while in Hikkaduwa!
Rice and curry surprise every day, different and very tasy currys :)
For breakfast, there are always great local style string hoppers, or maybe something more european if you prefer.
Owner and employees are very friendly.
We eat here every day with our kids, and they simply fall in love with Sri Lankan food thanks to the great people who work there.

Very local and lovely restaurant which we were very happy to find as it opens early unlike most other restaurants in the area!! Very lovely staff and owner who was very grateful for our custom! Had a very big and tasty Sri Lankan breakfast! Even gave us complimentary pancakes with coconut and honey when we left!

I go here every morning for a Sri Lankan breakfast - my favourite place to have breakfast. The food is delicious, the coffee is strong and the people are so friendly and kind. It’s perfect location - away from the main road so it’s very peaceful. I will continue coming for breakfast every day that o am here. Thank you ❤️

formatted_address: 289 Tamara Motels Rd, Hikkaduwa 80240, Sri Lanka
name: Tamara Motels

reviews.text:
Good location - 5 minutes walk from the beach - and really kind and warm service.
This was our first hotel on our first trip to Sri Lanka, and it left a very warm impression. A modest small room for two, a tiny window behind bars and strange bed linen were not its strong point, but we found this place very atmospheric and cozy, with delicious breakfasts and everything we need, close to the beach, but at the same time surrounded by the jungle. On the third floor there is a large veranda and lines for drying clothes, on the first floor there is a shower to rinse off after the sea. The room had a safe, refrigerator, hairdryer and kettle. When it rained, the hosts thoughtfully provided us with umbrellas.
A five minute walk away is a beautiful beach with turtles. Shops, cafes and restaurants are also nearby, especially Red Lobster.
One of the inconveniences may be the railway running under the walls of the hotel, and the walls shake at night and several times a day from passing trains. But for a few days it seemed even romantic to us.
We would return to this hotel again.

We had a very large family room on the top floor.  It was cool and spacious with very comfy beds, a safe for valuables, kettle cups, glasses and cutlery.   Very useful!
It had a large and very effective fan as well as excellent aircon.
Everything was spotlessly clean.
The bathroom was amazing with hot and cold showers, great lighting and beautiful plants!
we had a private balcony with a sea view on the oneside and a shared balcony overlooking the railway tracks on the other.   There were lots of fireflies!
the trains to go right past, and are noisy, briefly, but they were no problem to us! we enjoyed watching them!
All the shared areas were covered in plants and beautifully maintained.
Our hosts were really friendly and helpful.
it's 2 -3 minutes walk to one of the little beaches suitable for swimming!

Nice room and good location hotel. The room was clean enough but not perfect. The window overlooked a shared balcony, so for privacy, it had to be kept curtained most of the time. But there is a refrigerator.
There is a train track right next to the hotel and the train can be heard loud enough several times a day.
The hotel has an area with a beach shower, which was great and allowed you not to carry sand from the beach to your room. The breakfasts were good, but not very filling. You could choose what kind of breakfast you will cook the next morning from several options. The hotel also provides clean bottled water for a fee.

The perfect accommodation for a relaxing stay in Hikkaduwa!

The staff is very friendly and helpful. The location of the hotel is close to the beautiful beach and centrally located. Restaurants, bars and supermarkets are in the immediate vicinity.

We enjoyed our stay and can highly recommend the hotel.

We had a fantastic stay here. The location is excellent, it's across the street from the beach but far enough from the main road that it's nice and quiet. The breakfast was really good too. The room was clean, spacious, and comfortable. Also the manager is really nice and can arrange anything from tours to taxis. Overall we had a great stay.

We had a great dining experience at Red Lobster Restaurant in Hikkaduwa.
We ordered chicken fried rice, and it was amazing. The portion was very generous and enough for three people. The price was reasonable, and it felt like a proper, original chicken fried rice full of chicken.
We also ordered prawn fried noodles. It was good and full of prawns, with a reasonable price for locals. However, it was a bit salty for our taste maybe due to salt or MSG but still enjoyable.
The restaurant environment is pleasant and comfortable. The hospitality was amazing, and the staff took great care of us.
Great food. Menu different to most others but still had many local and popular meals. Seafood was great. Very busy. And large serving sizes. Enjoyed our dinner

Terrific spot! Enjoy to visit it every time we are in Sri Lanka. We order grilled lobster, Dorado fish, Tom Yam and seafood noodles. The portions are big, but the stuff help you to take everything away. Also they are so kind and help you to choose the most outstanding dish. Really enjoy every bite! Will visit later

My husband and I visited twice. First time we had the shared seafood platter. It was a huge portion, enough for three. Very delicious.
Second time we had the seafood rice and devilled prawns, again, another huge portion and so tasty. We highly recommend anyone come to this restaurant

We had some dishes overall is good. But the fried rice is need to more fresh and feel little bit dryness.

The prawns burger is superb and it was 10/10

formatted_address: no a 337 A2, Hikkaduwa, Sri Lanka
name: Moon Light

reviews.text:
A nice family restaurant just of the main road on the land side.
Pleasant, welcoming staff and good WiFi.
I came here for a Cappuccino late morning. I did not order food as I’d just had breakfast.
The freshly ground Italian coffee was very good quality and strong, but minute in quantity (see photo taken before consumption) considering its R750 price tag. However, this price includes taxes, etc which makes it quite good value and in line or better than with other places in the area.

This place was just opposite to where we were staying at Hikkaduwa. I went through all the reviews of the nearby restaurants and finally decided to go there. Initially I went there alone and ordered chicken steak meal. Later my friends joined and they went gaga while ordering. Our table looked like a grand feast as their portions are too huge. All the dishes are seasoned and cooked properly. The ambience is good. Staffs are amiable enough. I would say this is a good place to try for food if you eat heavy. The prices are expensive here but It’s still okay considering the portion size.

The food here is absolutely superb! We tried the fried prawns, fish fingers with chips and salad, and a tasty rice dish—everything was fresh, crispy, and full of flavor. Portions are generous, presentation is great, and prices are very reasonable. Plus, it's easy to access with a relaxed vibe. Highly recommended if you're in Hikkaduwa!

The waiter Gayan, was the loveliest man, made jokes and really added to the experience. We had pizzas which were good and would definitely recommend hot butter calamari, the dish isn’t a looker but tastes amazing!! Fruit juice fresh too!

This is hands down the most popular seafood restaurant in town—and for good reason. The taste and quality are consistently exceptional, with standards kept at the highest level. Mr. Priyantha, the owner, personally oversees the daily seafood purchases, ensuring freshness and authenticity. It’s my go-to spot every time I’m in Hikkaduwa. Highly recommend trying the grilled crab—absolutely top-notch—and don’t miss the live lobster tank where you can handpick your catch.

Probably one of the best coffees I’ve had in Sri Lanka. It was so good that I ended up chatting with the owner to ask him his secret. He told me he’s been making coffee for over 20 years, and you can taste that experience in every sip.
This coffee is the perfect balance of skill, technique, and high-quality beans.
Absolutely worth a visit.

My visit to the coffee shop was a delightful experience. The coffee was superb, and I indulged in a delicious coconut cake, though the exact name escapes me. The charming atmosphere, overseen by a friendly older gentleman who runs the place, added to the overall ambiance.

Although my initial intention was to work, I ended up engrossed in conversation with an American gentleman I met there, spending a pleasant four hours exchanging stories and enjoying the company.

Overall, the coffee shop provided a warm and inviting environment, perfect for both productivity and socializing. I look forward to returning for another enjoyable visit.
Really good coffee and sweet owners! We came back three days in a row for the coffee🙏🏼 I loved the iced latte, with coconut milk or normal milk, either way it was good👏🏼👏🏼🎺🎺🕺🏼🕺🏼🧚🏽‍♀️🧚🏽‍♀️‼️❤️‍🔥😍

This is a pretty basic coffee shop you can visit. We tried two burgers and only positive thing about that was the price. Taste was so bad and it was obvious that the oil used for frying french fries were pre used oil. So the taste was not that good. Definitely not going back..

Great spinach omlette with Butter toast for a great breakfast.
Also amazing homemade cakes with a good Ceylon Black tea as a Snack or at tea time!! 🥥🍌
Close to beach, u can watch and try surfing. 🏄🏼☕️🫖🍽

We spent two wonderful nights at The Beach Heaven in Hikkaduwa. The hotel is perfectly situated in the heart of the tourist area, right next to a stunning beach that is safe for swimming. The on-site restaurant and bar create a warm, inviting atmosphere—especially in the evenings—making it one of the best spots in town to enjoy the sunset.

In addition, there are plenty of restaurants and a supermarket within walking distance, adding to the convenience. Our room was spacious, with fresh bed linen, and the bathroom was spotless and dry. The staff were exceptionally friendly and always eager to help, which made our stay even more enjoyable.

Overall, The Beach Heaven is a fantastic place to stay in Hikkaduwa. We would gladly return and highly recommend it to anyone visiting the area.

Hands down the best meal we’ve had in Sri Lanka — everything was next level! Our waiter was a legend — topping up our drinks like we were on a date with royalty. 👑 Didn’t catch his name, but whoever he is deserves a pay rise and a holiday. 😂 Amazing food, great value, and we left slightly too full but very, very happy. 🍹🍛

We had a wonderful lunch at Moon Beam The Beach Heaven. The seafood pizza was delicious, and the cocktails were perfectly made. The interior is beautiful, and the view is absolutely breathtaking and calming – I even fell asleep in the chair to the sound of the waves. The service was excellent, and the atmosphere makes you want to stay all day: you can have lunch, go for a swim, and come back for another meal. A perfect beachside escape!

Beachfront Hotel with Pool and Breakfast. Perfect location for surfing during the season! Nice and helpful staff during the whole stay!

Food could be better: more choices for breakfast and bigger Portions! Might be due to low season.

Chocolate Banana Rotti was awesome :D
Excellent grill fish platter & great service specially by Hemant. Best seafront restaurant in Hikkaduwa.

formatted_address: Baddegama Road, Punchi Pathana, Maragaha Hena, Hikkaduwa., Hikkaduwa 80240, Sri Lanka
name: Villa Birdlake Hikkaduwa

reviews.text:
I had an amazing stay at this hotel, one that genuinely exceeded my expectations in every way. From the moment I arrived, the hospitality was absolutely wonderful. The staff welcomed me with warm smiles and handled every request with genuine care, making me feel instantly comfortable and valued. Throughout my stay, their friendliness and helpfulness continued, adding a personal touch that made the whole experience even more memorable.

The hotel’s atmosphere is incredibly nature-friendly, surrounded by greenery, fresh air, and a peaceful environment that instantly relaxes your mind. Whether it was the gentle sounds of birds in the morning or the cool breeze drifting through the pathways, everything created a calm and soothing vibe. It truly feels like a little escape from the busy world outside.

The food was another highlight of my stay. Every meal was delicious, full of authentic flavors, and clearly made with attention and passion. Whether it was breakfast, lunch, or dinner, the dishes always felt fresh and thoughtfully prepared.

My room was spotless, beautifully arranged, and surprisingly cozy. The cleanliness, combined with the charming décor, made it feel like my own comfortable little space. It was the perfect place to unwind after a long day.

Overall, my entire experience at this hotel was nothing short of wonderful. It offers the perfect combination of comfort, nature, great service, and delicious food. I would happily recommend it to anyone looking for peace, relaxation, and a memorable stay. I’m already looking forward to returning!

A lovely boutique hotel with a cozy, homey feel and a peaceful lake view.
Mr. Trevor and the team are incredibly kind and helpful, always happy to assist with tuktuks or car rides.
The food is really good too.
Just note it’s about a 10-minute ride through the jungle and PickMe isn’t available, but the team can easily help arrange pick.

Just missing a mini fridge.

It was a peaceful and relaxing place to stay. The food was absolutely delicious, and the staff were friendly and attentive while serving. The pool was lovely, and the rooms were exceptionally clean and well-maintained. Truly the perfect spot for a peaceful getaway.

We had a great time for two days at Villa Birdlake Hikkaduwa.
It was wonderful place and great atmosphere. Villa was situated at great location with cool breeze from the river, that creates scenic view and great comfort.
Owner, Mr.Perera was very cooperative and friendly with great hospitality mind.
Staff was very friendly and helpful. They were very disciplined and well trained.
Food was awesome, tasty and well balanced menu.
We had unmatched experience with Villa Birdlake. Must visit again.
We can highly recommend this place to anyone, both local and foreigners.
Thanks a lot for Villa Birdlake team!

Our stay at this boutique hotel was very pleasant.All I can say this place is loved by its owners, so everything is well taken care of.The garden and the pool is nicely kept. The rooms are clean, neat and tidy and the morning view of the rooms was very relaxing..The food was delicious.  The staff was friendly too and very accommodating of our 7 months old.However, we did wish they had a baby cott , but we are sure they will consider it in future 😊
Great hotel, superb location, amazing owner and staff. Rooms are spacious and clean.

We discovered the Yula guesthouse from the beach and loved the glassfront that the ocean view rooms had, so we asked for the rate, got a good rate and moved out of our old hotel into this one. The Hotel doesn’t look like on the Google pictures, it has been renovated during the Pandemic and has a great new look.
Great room, spacious, good equipped with safe, sofa and minibar. A very nicely spacious bathroom. All in all a super price performance.
Breakfast was always a bit different but very good.
Staff was very nice.
Very very good.best beachfront hotel in hikkaduwa.good for surfing.pretty good vide and highly  recommend

Great little hotel with the sweetest staff. The good is good and there is a nice view from the restaurant. I recommend the seaview rooms. It was a delightful stay and the breakfast is really good. I had mu best experience with a full fish here. If I have to say something bad, it is only that the WiFi didn't work in the rooms, but it does work ind the lobby and restaurant.

This owner of the hotel is freaking cheater! We’ve booked 2 rooms for 2 months before the date of vacations, but for 5 days before reservation day he cancelled our reservation. Booking.com approved, but he said - no rooms available.
When I called him from different phone number, he politely says - “you can book through booking.com, that come here and through cancellations reservation I give you 15% discount.
What’s was very very nasty. Loose money and time

Honestly!!! An incredible place …I ordered the Jagerschnitzel (crispy chicken fillet with Parmesan, mushroom gravy, and mashed potato) while the others had fried rice and the seafood platter. Everything was super delicious!

They also have two big golden retrievers so loving and adorable and a tiny baby pup who made the whole experience even better. Since it’s right on the beach, you can literally take a dip and then enjoy a wonderful meal after.

They even had a live guitarist! So soothing so nice ..
The staff were super nice, the hospitality was amazing, and the vibe was perfect. For three people, the bill was around 18,000 LKR, and honestly, it was worth every penny.

They even have a spot in Arugambay during the season, so that’s definitely on my list next.
The fried prawns were to die for!

Mambos Hikkaduwa …..highly recommend to anyone visiting the Hikka side.
Can’t wait to come back for their weekend live parties!

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Amazing place right on the beach! We came here for dinner and ended up staying the whole evening. The atmosphere is very relaxed, with beautiful ocean views and great music. The food was fresh and delicious — especially the seafood and cocktails.

The staff were friendly and welcoming, and the whole vibe of the place is perfect for enjoying the sunset and a chill evening with friends.

Definitely one of the nicest beach restaurants in Hikkaduwa. Highly recommend if you want good food, drinks, and a great beach atmosphere!

We had a fantastic dinner at Mambo’s in Hikkaduwa. We ordered the Paraw fish and a tuna steak, and both dishes were absolutely excellent.

The quality of the food was outstanding. The fish was cooked perfectly — tender, fresh, and right on point. You could really taste how fresh it was and how carefully it was prepared.

The service was just as impressive: friendly, attentive, and professional throughout the evening. We felt very welcome and well taken care of.

We've been going to this place since 2022, and every time it gets better and better. You can see that the guys are developing and taking care of their establishment.
The food is always fresh and delicious, the staff is friendly and polite, there's often live music, guitar or just great tracks playing. We love this place, 5+ and up.

Really nice evening at Mambo's. First time in years we've been here, really nice beach side restaurant. Good food arrived quickly and was very nice, good value.
Lovely singer and live music when we were there. Much better than we thought it might be and we'll be back.

Cool vibe and stylish interior. The pool table added an extra touch of fun to the atmosphere. There were many seating options available. I had a great time here and would definitely recommend it. The ambiance, friendly staff, and delicious food make it a must-visit spot for anyone looking for a memorable dining experience in HIkka

During the day, when walking up and down the beach in Hikkadua, you are spoiled for choice where to eat. The beach is over two miles long from the southern part up to the bridge where the turtles swim in the shallows. The adjacent main road can be very busy, the often chaotic Galle-Colombo road. Today’s choice is Top Secret, ironically named as it’s near a relatively busy part of the beach.

They’re not playing music that loud. I find dance music too intrusive during the daytime when eating. Unfortunately a lot of places do this as a way to create a certain ‘vibe’. Flags from several countries are at the entrance. I promptly locate the manager and ask why my country is not there?

After glancing at them he looks at me and says ‘from where?’ I replied I’m from the U.K then as I presumed, he pointed to the English flag. After a quick geography lesson, he tells me the Welsh and Scottish flags were stolen last year! Anyway I took a seat in the deserted restaurant as most were outside on sun loungers.

Lunchtime I very rarely order a curry or kottu. I usually order a fruit salad or omelette of some sort. I’ll often go for a swim, so curry is not really sensible. Today is the Sri Lankan omelette and I’m over familiar with it by now. I have a fresh mango juice also and a bottle of water. All staff are in uniform, polite, courteous and welcoming.

An elderly woman who has walked up and down the beach I’m told for over forty years makes her way to the restaurant area. She has to be over 80 years old bless her. She is always in a white & purple dress. She carries bags of souvenirs. I’ve seen her several times. I offer to buy her food, she declines but likes an orange Fanta. I gave her a 1,000 rupees and took no gifts. She smiles, enjoys the rest before carrying on.

Nice location at the beach and delicious food, but service is quite slow.
The „Devilled Vegetables with Rice“ are vegan (as far as we understood) and „spaghetti with fresh tomatoes“ is also vegan without the cheese.

I just love this place. The staff are really cool and welcoming people. Its a beach bar and you can find nice sun chairs, volleyball and outdoor showers. The vibe is welcoming and chill and they serve amazing drinks! Hope to be back one day 🎉🍹

Came here a few times in July/August with a large group of friends and the atmosphere was brilliant and as you would expect a beach restaurant to feel, with comfortable seating and a good amount of sun loungers. Friendly service and great food, ask for the bacon and cheese jaffies (toasties) and you can eat your lunch on the beach.

formatted_address: 712,Galle road, Narigama, Hikkaduwa, A2, Hikkaduwa, Sri Lanka
name: Joint in Southwind

reviews.text:
Honestly is there anything better than eating some delicious local juice, washed down by a banana peanut butter milkshake and then lay back and relax on the super comfy sofas under the thatched roof as the waves come crashing in…

This place gives all that. What a dreamy place. Will be back

It’s two stars mostly for fruits juices, that was the best. Food looks better then taste.
We tried two soups and both of them not worth price (seafood soup and tomyam- extremely sour, never tried something like this taste before even in Thailand)
Additionally we 10% service charge- no information about it in card. „Service” you get is: take order, give you food- no more. So I think is a joke. Plus extra 3% if you want to pay by card( this make sense but it would be nice to be also informed about it when we was asking about card payment before we make orders.)

Chill place on the beach. Went there several times and last visit was on 31st Dec NYE

Good food and super cocktails. However can’t recommend the chicken burger as I found it’s not value for money and there are other good places which has way better burgers. Cocktails are best

This is on the beach a toes in the sand chill restaurant for afternoon drinks, lunch or dinner.  There are Sun beds, chill out areas and tables.  The Food was nice, the prices were very cheap.  The staff were friendly and helpful.  We are here twice and both times we were happy with the food.

There is a couple of cats and a dog kicking around which is a little annoying when your trying to eat.

IF MY REVIEW HAS HELPED PLEASE GIVE IT A LIKE ...
Super chilled place, entertains both lankans and foreigner. In the evenings you get an unplugged artist playing... sea, sand, sunset and live music now that's the place to be.

The manager of this place is racist. He heard my Russian accent and started kicking me out of his guesthouse, which is located directly on the beach. He wouldn't let me into the restaurant and was also categorically against me using the restroom on the beach. When I asked why I couldn't use the restroom on the beach, he shrugged and repeated that it was a private beach and I had no right to use it. I'm a woman, and I repeatedly told him not to touch me. I didn't understand his reason for such behavior. When I asked what country he was from, he didn't answer. The guesthouse manager is a white man with long gray hair. I felt very bad after this conversation, as he was aggressive towards me simply because I spoke Russian. I don't recommend this place to anyone, as racism is frowned upon in society these days.

We enjoyed our stay at this accommodation so much that we ended up extending it. Even though there’s no air conditioning, the occasional cold shower worked wonders and made the warm weather completely manageable.

The food was absolutely outstanding – everything prepared by the host was more than delicious. We did try a few restaurants in the area, but we quickly regretted it and returned to the meals lovingly cooked by our host. Honestly, there wasn’t a single dish that didn’t exceed our expectations.

The location was perfect – a clean, quiet beach just a short walk away, without the usual crowds, which made it feel like our own private paradise. To top it off, New Year’s Eve was magical, with a spectacular firework display and an incredible buffet prepared for all the guests.

The owner was incredibly friendly and accommodating, always ready to help with anything we needed. He even helped me when I was struggling with heartburn, which was a small gesture that meant a lot and showed his care for the guests.

The hospitality, the quality of the food, the beautiful setting, and the attention to detail made this stay unforgettable. We wholeheartedly recommend this place and would love to return in the future!

This is a great place to stay that's right on the beach. It's easy to walk to nearby restaurants either along the beach or along the road. We stayed in the 1 bedroom apartment, which was spacious and had a nice sitting area and a balcony with some sea views. We used the kitchen in the apartment for since basic meals. This only suggestion that I made to the owner was that there should be Toaster as well in the kitchen and another frypan.
We loved the place the food, staff and location are all great and we would definitely stay here again.
Is great value for money.

We stayed at Palm beach for 3 nights and it was the most calm, nice and comfortable time on Sri Lanka 🇱🇰 Big and clean rooms, tasty breakfast, comfortable beach place and breathtaking ocean view are waiting for you here. Many thanks to the guesthouse owner Nilanta.

Quiet part of the beach away from the general buzz. Shaded sund beds, friendly owner, simple rooms that have everything you need.

Great to stay directly at the beach

formatted_address: Lake School, 44RG+97F, Junction, Pathana, Hikkaduwa, Sri Lanka
name: Hotel Green Garden

reviews.text: We went to wedding function..service was verry bad..we have to asked wellcome drink...otherwise we dont have wellcome drinks..food was tasteless ..we dont have cutlery on the table..  so pls keep this point in your mind to serve good service to customers .

While the accommodations were decent, the overall experience fell short. Some ACs were off on a hot day, making the stay uncomfortable. The front yard is clean, but unfortunately, the back yard is not well-maintained. The car park is well-spaced, ensuring convenience for guests with vehicles. Overall, the staff is not particularly friendly, which detracts from the overall experience. Budget-friendly option for basic needs.
Can feel natural environment. There have quality foods. A suitable palce for spend free times. No any bothers. Have a parking. They always protect customers' private.
The main hall is opened type and not air-conditioned but fans. The food is good as well as the service. Recommend for budget weddings and other functions. They have rooms as well.

Dont book the reception hall here for your  functions. No air conditioning.  Stuffy place food is  not that good either. Avoid at all costs. Only plus would be easy access to E1 expressway via Hikkaduwa Baddegama road.
The place is wonderful...but the people...the owners son (I suppose) is one of the greatest person I have recently met...go there and ensure your self
Not all the kitchen appliances worked, but it was peaceful without all the busyness of a hotel.
really quite calm place, highly recomended

This hotel opened about a week ago, so I was one of the first visitors. A very nice hotel consisting of four separate bungalows. Each bungalow has everything you need, the dining room is shared. The food, as everywhere in Sri Lanka, is excellent. The staff is very nice and helpful. The hotel also has a beautiful pool with water up to your neck. The only drawback (not the hotel's) is the very poor access road.
Ideal location geographically from Kikkaduwa beach. Prices are very democratic. The staff is responsive.

An Absolute Must-Visit!
This place is simply fantastic and exceeded all our expectations.
From the moment you arrive, the cool service and friendly staff make you feel welcome. Finding a spot is never a worry—there's always a great table or a comfy sunbed available to soak up the sun and the stunning view.
The BBQ service is great!We booked it twice during our stay, and it was absolutely incredible both times.
