The variety of dishes was impressive, everything was served all at once (so everyone eats together—no waiting!), and most importantly, everything was delicious! The focus on fresh, local products, especially the fish and seafood, homemade beverages!
The personal care about their guests having a great time.
(They even have guest rooms)
This cafe is the full package: amazing food, brilliant service, and a wonderfully relaxed vibe. We can't wait to come back! Highly, highly recommended))

This was a beautiful meal served by beautiful people! I saw this place recommended on a social media post so headed up the beach to be greeted by the lovely staff and delicious food.

The food was presented great and you could taste the local herbs and spices coming through in every bite. One waitress explained that all their produce is locally sourced some even from her local village and you could taste it! Every bite was FULL of flavour.

The waitress was extra kind with teaching us some basic Sri Lankan greetings and noted them down for us.

Would say this is a must stop restaurant if you are staying near by!

Thank you for having us!

I spent a full day at Thambili Café with a group of friends and it turned out to be the perfect beach spot. We were hanging out there from morning till evening, drinking beers, having lunch and renting boards to go play in the waves – everything was easy, relaxed and well organised.
What stood out the most was how incredibly kind and attentive the staff were. In the evening they prepared a private barbecue on the beach for our group of more than 10 people, with great food and a really fun atmosphere. At one point one of our friends got a bit hurt by the strong waves, and the lady from the café immediately brought ice and aloe vera and checked if everything was okay, which we really appreciated.
Thambili Café is exactly the kind of place you want to find on the beach: friendly people, good food, cold drinks, surf boards and genuine hospitality. I would happily recommend it to anyone visiting the area.

We enjoyed wonderful service here, probably the friendliest and most efficient of all the places we’ve been to in Sri Lanka. The cocktails were also excellent. We pre ordered fish and prawns at noon and returned to enjoy happy hour (5.30-6.30pm) and then dinner at 7pm watching the waves and enjoying the beautifully decorated restaurant and company of “Sunny” their gorgeous black cocker spaniel

We stayed in Tiranagama for 2 weeks, close to Thambili cafe where we’d spend every day when coming to the beach! The staff are incredibly friendly, honest and helpful. They go above and beyond to ensure we had the best time. We’ve also tried the fish barbecue evening and boy oh boy, that was some seriously delicious meal! We have really enjoyed ourselves and will definitely return in the future!

Amazing Location with best food, fresh fish, sea-food and delicious original Italian Coffee.
We are very satisfied and like this place. Also the Burger are great. Thusi is the best host and has a great hospitality.

Such a lovely café in Hikkaduwa! The atmosphere is great, and the food is absolutely delicious. The coffee was also top-notch. The owner, Thusitha, is a wonderful person—we had a great chat, and he even gave me some great recommendations on where to go. A must-visit if you’re in the area!

It is a fantastic guesthouse with a very good restaurant. The Food is delicious. We had Beef-Burger, Tuna-Fish -Filets with potatoes and grilled sea food. Thusy has lot of  experience because he is working off Season in Italy at the Gastronomie. The guesthouse is surrounded by a nice Green Garden and only 50 m from the nice Beach away. The distance to the Bus Stop is only 20 m from Thusys. I can recommend this beautiful Place.

The burgers are what heaven tastes like! The burgers came quickly, hot and fresh. Generous size and delicious toppings. The burger itself is spiced well and the bun was nice and soft. The ice tea (lemon and peach flavours) was also quite tasty. Highly recommend!
Great burger, a truly homemade feel with high quality ingredients. The grilled veg was excellent too. Nice calm place to sit apart from the crazy bus drivers flying by every so often

formatted_address: Hotel Ocean View Cottage, Galle Main Road, Thiranagama, Hikkaduwa 80244, Sri Lanka
name: Hotel Ocean View Cottage

reviews.text: We stayed here on a B&B basis with our baby. It’s a very relaxing place with beautiful beach-facing rooms. The rooms are a bit old, but they are clean. There is no TV in the room, which was fine for us. The ubreakfast was simple but worth the price. The staff were very friendly and helpful. Overall, a pleasant stay, especially for families looking for a calm beachside experience.

Good quality hotel. is clean The staff is also very nice. Although the prices of food and drinks are a bit high, he is very tasty. A great place to spend free time for the whole family.
Thank you.

Have not stayed in the hotel, so can't comment on that part.
The restaurant,
Service is diabolihal, one lady walked out after waiting for a very long time.
Ordered sweet and sour chicken, first bite full of bones, chicken not in batter as you would expect, the whole plate was bulked up with various vegetables.
Absolutely not what I ordered, don't put it on the menu if the chef does not know how to cook it.
Came to pay, no card, cash only???
Asked where dose it say anywhere cash only??? Tells me nowhere local accepts card, used two adjoining restaurant the previous evenings, no problem with card payment.
Then tried to intimidate me in a threatening manner.
I leave you to draw your own conclusions.

Good family hotel with friendly staff. We enjoyed our stay and magnificent ocean view. We had some issues with conditioner but that was fixed very quickly. The meals were tasty, portions were big. The beach is clean and not crowded at all, but beware of the waves.

The Pool cost 1000/- per person. But very disappointed with the food. They mentioned that a single portion could satisfy more than two people, but in reality, the portions cost 1900/- each and were too small, leaving us hungry and dissatisfied.

This little restaurant owned by a family is the best one we had in the whole town! Delicious food prepared with a lot of love and detail. I said that I was vegetarian and they prepared a special meal for me. The family was so kind and they make you feel very well.
It’s delicious chicken rice and friendly staff , no waiting time .highly recommend 🤍
Tasty, fast n cheaaap
Excelent food, best place, friendly servies 💯
17 years

formatted_address: 8, 152 Hikkaduwa - Baddegama Rd, Hikkaduwa, Sri Lanka
name: Local rice & curry lunch

reviews.text: Very tasty chicken rice!
The food here is delicious. The portions are huge! I think this is the best rice I've had in Hikkaduwa. There's so much toppings and vegetables, it's hard to stop eating 🙏🏼 🤤

formatted_address: Mendila Heights, L L LL John de Silva Mawatha, Hikkaduwa 80240, Sri Lanka
name: The Heights Bistro

formatted_address: 44, Canal Road, Wadugoda, Hikkaduwa 80240, Sri Lanka
name: Canal view

reviews.text: We ate the the Corn Soup and a salad as a starter. The rice curry and cashew curry as the main. Fir dessert we had the fruits with ice and Fulada. Everything was very good we can really recommend this place. Especially the atmosphere is just amazing here, a very pretty and clean garden. Also the service is outstanding.

This restaurant offers a wonderful dining experience with a truly warm and inviting atmosphere. The mango juice was absolutely delicious and refreshing, and the appetizers were just as impressive. The real highlight of the evening was the Sri Lankan curry, full of rich flavors and perfectly balanced spices. To finish the meal, the banana fritters with ice cream were the perfect sweet ending and made the evening unforgettable.

Very delicious food served in an place with nice & calm atmosphere away from all the buzz in town.

Went there twice because it was so good.

Their rice&curry (long beans, beetroot, mango, dahl and chicken) and Chilli & Garlic butter prawns were both amazing.

Some patience is needed for the freshly prepared food. And you need to be lucky to get a table.

100% the best local food I tasted during my trip to Sri Lanka and India. The best service - felt a bit like in Japan. Wish could be back there with teleportation. This place should be packed all the time !

Delicious authentic Sri Lankan dinner! Need to book in advance. Big portion sizes! Yummiest flavours, definitely worth a visit! The onion bhaji starter was really yum! We had the authentic Sri Lankan curry. Highly recommend!

formatted_address: Kirahandigoda, Baddegama Rd, Hikkaduwa 80240, Sri Lanka
name: Ayubowan Seafood Restaurant

reviews.text: Today, I visited Ayubowan Seafood Restaurant with a few of my guests. The food there was truly excellent. This is the meal I enjoyed. The restaurant is very clean, and the staff are extremely friendly and welcoming. I highly recommend this restaurant to anyone visiting the area.

The food is amazing and arrived very quickly. The staff are incredibly friendly, and the presentation is a solid 10/10. The taste is excellent, and the atmosphere is very pleasant—overall a fantastic experience.
Lobster dish was fantastic..highly recommended restaurant in hikkaduwa
Great restaurant. Delicious food, everything is clean. Special thanks to the chef 🙏 I recommend this place 5⭐
Best food found in Sri Lanka! Especially seafood!

formatted_address: Kanda uda road, Wavulagoda, Hikkaduwa 80240, Sri Lanka
name: LACSCEIAN

reviews.text: We was there for the dinner. It was incredible with fresh sea food with local spices cook on stone fire. Super good tasty with home made sauce with garlic rice. Also there had fresh juices. It was marvelous.. we highly recommend Lacsceian sea food  😋😀👌
I really enjoyed eating at this restaurant  It actually was the best meal we have had here in Sri Linka. My wife enjoyed the fried rice seafood. We will return for another meal later this week.

We were there for dinner. They have really good seafood to eat at this restaurant. Very quiet place with music. We ordered seafood noodles and seafood soup. Every ingredient with local flavors was the same as our food. We also got the dessert of curd with homemade syrup. Thank you very much and I appreciate everything.

name: PCB cafe LUNCH & DINNER - RESERVATIONS REQUIRED Whatsapp +94776056064(BYOB bring your own bottle)

reviews.text: MUST VISIT! We spent a week in Hikkaduwa and came twice. The chef does a one man show with 3 tables only. He is super friendly and his preparation and presentation are REALLY ambitious. The second visit we pre-ordered Sushi and got 2*4 rolls (California and smoked salmon cream cheese) and 2*4 Nigiri (tuna and shrimp) plus some tuna Sashimi. For desert we asked for white chocolate and got a white mousse, sponge cake, mango and passion fruit sauce and gold leaf as decoration (see pics). All for a reasonable price, that the beach places charge for a good breakfast. Highly recommended!

I can only echo all the rave reviews that are already on here. This place offers extremely delicious food in perfect presentation at a somewhat unconventional location. If you are in the area, make sure to make a reservation and go there, so worth it!

Must visit this spot if you are a true lover of food! This place will only serve you the most authentic tasting flavors no matter what dish you order and it is beautifully presented and cooked with a lot of care. After having our first dinner here, we have arranged to come back and requested sushi where the chef orders the fish in on the day and prepares it fresh for us! We recommend getting in touch with him on WhatsApp to make reservations and discuss any preferences for your food, he is very kind and accommodating! Also very reasonable pricing! Looking forward to our next meal here already 🙏😎 Mia & Louis

I lived in Sri Lanka for one month and this is the best place I ate!!! The food is amazing, and the owner of the cafe (who is also the chef) is the kindest and friendliest person in the world with a huge talent for cooking! 🧑‍🍳

I ate chicken pasta, shrimp pasta, carbonara pasta, chicken burger, chicken sub - and all of the food was great! 👍🏻

I advise you to come here if you are in Hikkaduwa!!! 100% the best food! 🥘

The meals here are truly amazing, with such an incredible depth & complexity in flavours. Akalanka’s unwavering hospitality is outstanding—always going above and beyond to ensure the experience is unforgettable. The food is genuinely authentic, and without question, the curries are the best I’ve ever eaten (and I’ve eaten a lot of curries). I honestly can’t speak highly enough of this place—you’d be crazy not to eat here. I've been in Sri Lanka for 4 months & without question, this has been the best experience.

formatted_address: Sarath Goonawardana Mawatha, Hikkaduwa, Sri Lanka
name: Muthu's kitchen

reviews.text:
Look no further because this is the best place in the city. First of all they have very nice food and the cheapest in the city, no tax on the bill.
Our favorite food :
Breakfast: srilanka eggs with a juice (fresh mango or passion fruits with no sugar)
Lunch / Dinner : Srilanka rice curry with calamari or chicken or shrimps. Keep in mind It takes time for the curry because they make it fresh and it is the best.
Family business, nice atmosphere, no mosquitoes or flies, lots vegetarian options.
In srilanka in general if the food takes time they’ll say: we don’t have it, but if you ask for it and say “i don’t mind to wait for it”, then they will make it for you. That is our experience only with the Srilanka rice & curry and my wife and i loved it. We literally waited for it every time and enjoyed it so much.
Thank you for this Amazing experience God bless you and protect your family in Jesus name Amen.🙏❤️

Have eaten here for the past 2 nights and likely to eat here again tomorrow which will be our last night in Hikkaduwa. This lovely family run business is only a short walk from town and located up a small side street surrounded by a number of guesthouses. The staff are attentive and speak good English. The menu is extensive and the food appearing from the kitchen looks amazing. The setting and ambience is welcoming
The pricing is spot on and the toilet is immaculately clean, which is a rarity in Sri Lanka and a sign of good hygiene. Highly recommend.
Great family owned restaurant! The kottu is delicious and the portions are very big. This place is truly a gem in Hikkaduwa.
Amazing food ! Such a nice place we had curry and deviled chicken! Very delicious!

Fish on the menu is supposedly tuna, but didn't taste like tuna at all. Supposedly in the tuna family, but definitely not the one we ate before in Sri Lanka (or elsewhere for that matter).
Even though I explicitly asked for a mango juice without sugar and not much water, my juice was forgotten (ok, it happens) and when it finally came it was almost like water with color.
Fries were too expensive (1200 rps)
Furthermore, I asked beforehand what exactly would be with the vegetable curry, I was shown a picture. When the dish came, only 50% of the picture was accurate, that would be the rice, dhal and the green star-shaped vegetable (and the papadam).
Big positive surprise was a slice of pineapple under the papadam. Really enjoyed that!
Staff (probably owner) was friendly though.

We had such a wonderful learning experience at Kumaries Cookery Class in Hikkaduwa. It was an amazing opportunity to learn how to cook a variety of authentic Sri Lankan dishes, many of which were made using fresh ingredients sourced directly from the garden.

The class is family-run, with Suren and Kumarie hosting us throughout the session and making us feel incredibly welcome. We were especially grateful for the level of detail they shared about every ingredient, cooking method, and utensil used, which made the experience both educational and enjoyable.

I would highly recommend this cookery class to anyone visiting Sri Lanka. The food was absolutely delicious, and the experience was truly memorable.

This is a fantastic opportunity to learn about authentic Sri Lankan cooking techniques, ideal for anyone who enjoys developing their culinary knowledge. The farm setting is beautiful and almost all the ingredients used in the cooking class are grown within the farm itself. Such an experience really made us appreciate the versatility of the land here and the great variety of flavours it can yield. We also gained a great appreciation for the complexity of Sri Lankan cooking, where the combination of flavours is attended to with great care and precision. We were guided through this meticulous cooking process in a patient and engaging manner by the farm's proprietors and came away with not only full stomachs but also with fresh culinary ideas that we look forward to making use of once we return home.

I had such a wonderful time at Kumari's cookery class I highly recommend this if you want to learn some delicious traditional Sri Lankan cooking. Our hosts Suren and Kumari are so welcoming and beautiful. A lot of the produce they grow themselves in their wonderful garden I was so full by the end of our meal thank you for an amazing experience 🙏

My wife, her sister and I came here for a cooking lesson on how to make a typical Sri Lankan meal.  Our wonderful hosts Suren and Kamari guided us around their beautiful garden showing us all of the plants that provide ingredients we would use later.  Then we enjoyed preparing and cooking a meal which we ate at the end.  We had a great time and learnt a lot about the ingredients, how much to use, and how to cook them. The meal was fabulous and we were sent the recipes afterwards.  Highly recommended both for the knowledge and the charm of this couple imparting their knowledge.  If you enjoy cooking don't miss a trip here.

We had such a wonderful experience at this cooking class! The family who hosted us were incredibly friendly and welcoming from the moment we arrived. They made us feel right at home and were very patient and helpful throughout the entire class, explaining each step clearly and answering all of our questions.

The food we prepared was absolutely delicious — one of the best meals we had during our trip! It was such a fun and hands-on experience, and we learned so much.

They also kindly picked us up from our hostel and dropped us off afterward, which made everything so easy and convenient.

Highly recommend this cooking class to anyone looking for an authentic, enjoyable, and delicious experience!
Great place to stay in hikkaduwa! Right outside the main area so perfect if you want to stay in a calm place. Near some nice cafes and bars! Beach is 5 min walk away with private beds!

Stayed at the Happy tuna hotel for 1 night with my wife and daughter. The location was very close to the hikkadua railway station and close to the beach also. It's like a 1 big room with lots of amenities in it includes kitchen with gas and stove also. Very spacious room with extra bed for kids also.
Wonderful hotel. Friendly staff and warm athmosphere.

No electrcity all night
Bad service
No responsible person for guest

If we are honest we didn't like this place at ALL. At first we booked a 9 dollar room that was literally disgusting (nothing alike with the pictures in Booking), near the kitchen with all de noise and a bed to small to fit two people. So they took advantage of our disappointment and give us another room obviously for a more expensive price, the room was kind of ok, but a little bit dirty, specially the toilet. After all we decided to leave just after one night, at the end when we were about to pay they try to charge us more for the room, saying that the price of dollar was 215 instead of 202 as the google rate says. In conclusion this is not a nice place to stay, we have been in many places and this is one of the only ones that our review is negative, the owners simply don't care at all if you are there or not. Sad Tuna.

formatted_address: Sri Lanka, Hikkaduwa, Urban Council, Niwahal, Baddegama Rd, Nalagasdeniya, Hikkaduwa
name: Han-guk Chef 한국 체프

reviews.text: Best Korean authentic restaurant in sri Lanka.Best of luck
Delicious Korean dishes with rich flavor and fresh ingredients. The place is clean, service is friendly, and the vibe is really nice. Highly recommend! 😍
Great Korean food with authentic flavors and a cozy atmosphere. Friendly staff and quick service made the experience even better. Definitely worth a visit! 👍💖

Newly opened restaurant off the main street's hustle and bustle. Local, plentiful and delicious food served by friendly and kind people.🤍 Vegetarian and not spicy foods available. Everything made fresh from the scratch. On the top of that they have excellent music on speaker. Will come again.
i was totally shocked by the quality of the food for the price for 400 rupees i got really excellent food
Great food. Large portion. Nice people !

Thank you for the delicious, authentic curry! Local food in a small, simple restaurant run by young people. You eat in the quiet, cool courtyard with relaxing music. Highly, highly recommended! The price is right, too; it's not overpriced like on the "touristy street." Delicious!

A truly excellent little restaurant run by competent people. Authentic, serious, and local cuisine (not something you'd expect in a touristy place). The service is also quick and very efficient! Congratulations and thanks to the Trio guys! Amuemu 🙏🙏

formatted_address: 44Q2+XJ9, No,44 Amarasena Mawatha, Hikkaduwa, Sri Lanka
name: White lotus restaurant

reviews.text: Unfortunately I had a stomach problems all night after the prawns, and this was the only mean I had during the day, except store ice cream and bottled water and crackers . I'm not 100% sure, maybe it's my problem with prawns.

Beautiful little local place, the owner and his family are truly beautiful people and the food is really good priced in the area ( probably the cheapest) and is homemade with love and therefore delicious, ingredients are fresh and everything is cooked in the moment.. we ate here for our entire stay in hikka. I really love to dive deeper in the culture and foods that locals provide, so much deliciousness people are missing when going to eat pizza and burger when on holiday , thank you for bringing authentic Sri Lankan food!
Delicious food ! We love the food ! Cheap and super yummy ! Really good portions ! We definately will come back here !

good two-star cafe. They brought 2 kottu, first 1 portion for my wife, the second portion after 5 minutes. They gave us ketchup sauce. We wanted to pour it all over the dish at once, but it's good that we didn't. Because the sauce was sour. Family cafe

After checking with them in the afternoon about the menu, when we arrived we were told there was no curry, only rice and noodles,they had to go to the shop for a coke zero and when we asked for ice cream they said they only had vanilla but could get chocolate from the shop, overall a big let down.

formatted_address: 48 Pannamgoda Meda Para Road, Hikkaduwa, Sri Lanka
name: Магазин «Домашние пельмени»

reviews.text: Love it
Excellent dumplings, carefully made, delicious, good meat. Easy to find by the sign 👌 thanks!

You can only buy takeout here. You can eat their pelmeni at the nearby Red Lobster restaurant. But I don't recommend it. The pelmeni are all crooked, like they were made by a one-armed child. The dough is terrible, there's zero salt in it, and the filling is a 4 out of 10. Even Ostankino Beach pelmeni are better. Don't waste your time or money.

The concept is baffling to me. The food is incredibly bland. The dumplings fell apart within 10 seconds of being submerged in water. The taste is nothing special. The cutlets are weird; the kids refused to eat them. But the main thing is the wonderful service. We initially saw this dumpling shop on Google Maps and assumed it was a cafe or restaurant. It actually says "Pelmennaya," which I assumed means a place that serves ready-made dumplings. It turns out it's just a house where Sri Lankans live. These Sri Lankans gave me a phone number and connected me to the owner of this dumpling shop. She explained that there's no cafe here, they just make pre-cooked or ready-made food. "OK," I said, "we'll order delivery." We ordered it the next day. Everything arrived an hour later than we'd agreed upon. And the quality is well below average. Overall, my recommendation is to avoid this service.

Pelmeni are one of the best dishes I've had in Hikkaduwa recently.
They have a perfect ratio of ground meat to thin dough, giving them a unique flavor. They're very juicy and soft, yet don't fall apart when cooked.😋

formatted_address: 44P2+FQX, Sarath Goonawardana Mawatha, Hikkaduwa 80240, Sri Lanka
name: Mango Breeze Cafe

reviews.text: Wonderful hostess, delicious pastries, villa for rent
This is the most authentic restaurant in Hikkaduwa, delicious rice & curry for a reasonable price! Sri Lankan coffee and cold drinks.

Excellent cafe. Best prices for good quality (by local standards). Locals usually eat here, but tourists also stop by occasionally. We've been eating here every day for a month now. They have all the local dishes, and the portions are huge—you can order a whole portion or half. If you can't handle it, they'll pack it for you. The owner is very responsive. If they don't have something, he'll run to the store and get it. They cook while you're there, and everything is fresh. It's like a local cafeteria; it's not like the beach cafes. The price list from the previous review is current as of April 5, 2022. We tried the kotta, the dewald, the curry, the soup, and the omelette—we loved everything.

It was very delicious Srilankan rice and vegetable curry
Also amazing price just only RS 200
Definitely I’ll be regular customer
Very tasty breakfast and lunch !

formatted_address: JAYASIRI,MEDA MAWATHA, Villa Wismar Hikkaduwa, Milla Hill Rd, Hikkaduwa 80240, Sri Lanka
name: Vito Juice Bar & Restaurant Hikkaduwa

reviews.text: Offer Season Start 20 %

Amazing little family run restaurant with amazing curry and rice. I went for the vegetarian option and loved every single dish. The ceylon tea was also amazing and the family who own the business are such lovely people. If you're in Hikkaduwa and want some authentic food in a lovely environement, you need to visit Shen Food.

Not a good experience. Extremely overpriced and tiny portions in a dingy backyard. Prices were not clear on the menu. Left feeling hungry and scammed, 2490 for a small portion of veggie curry is unacceptable.  They overcharged us on the bill and tried to charge 1290 for a lime juice  and then changed it again to add another 20% service charge on top of already outrageous prices. It took around 20 minutes for our bill to be sorted out correctly and to receive change. Save yourself the effort and go somewhere on the beachfront for half the price. The food wasn’t bad, but should have been atleast a quarter of the price for the environment

🍛✨ Shen Food – Hikkaduwa 🇱🇰
The Chicken Fried Rice, Sri Lankan Veg Fried Rice, and Vegetable Salad are absolutely delicious! 😍 Fresh, flavorful, and made with love 👩‍🍳💖 Friendly service and great taste every time — highly recommend Shen Food for the best food experience in town! 🌿🥰

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

ShenFood – A Must-Try Culinary Gem in Hikkaduwa!

I highly recommend ShenFood, a fantastic place run by a passionate young entrepreneur. The chef is truly dedicated to his craft—focusing on quality, generous portions, beautiful presentation, and rich flavors in every dish.

The seafood is especially outstanding—fresh, perfectly cooked, and absolutely delicious. I was even offered free delivery, which made the experience even more convenient and welcoming.

If you're visiting the beautiful town of Hikkaduwa, ShenFood is a must-try spot. Great food, great service, and great heart behind it all. 🧑‍🍳 🌟🙌
Got a huge portion of kottu! The food was good and I had an amazing time talking to the owner and his family, very friendly and welcoming :)

formatted_address: No. 20, Wawulagoda 1st Cross Road, Sarath Goonawardana Mawatha, Hikkaduwa 80240, Sri Lanka
name: Cafe de Paris Hikkaduwa

reviews.text: Exceptional food with a great ambiance! The chef was super friendly and attentive to detail. One of the few places down south SL where you could experience authentic French cuisine 🇫🇷 Highly recommended!!
Excellent!  We had two delicious fish dishes and two juices (we paid 8750 LKR). The owner is very sympathetic and we had an additional nice talk with him. Worth the visit!
Delicious french food at Hikkaduwa. We loved the calm ambience, restaurant decor and tasty food. Thanks to Mr. Vimal for good reception and best food at Hikkaduwa.
So far the best restaurant on Sri Lanka! We had barracuda and tuna, awesome experience. Sweet team also. Thank you

Recommend!!
Amazing, quality food, perfect service and very kind staff!

If you want to order anything specific (from the French kitchen), you can reserve in advance, the cook has a lot of experience
As renowned for its range of finest brew coffee this time was also great.  Just stopped by for a quick cup of cappuccino.

Best coffee in Hikkaduwa for sure. The barista knows  his art and served up a superb cappucino (minus the exsessivse milk most people seem to add these days).  The food served was average but would definitely go back for the coffee and the warm smiles.

Good coffee (for Sri Lanka) but they don't know what eggs benedict is... They served us a poached egg with lemony oil, a slice of processed cheese, beans and sausage. It was tasteless and we refused it. The staff was kind and apologetic about it, they deducted it from our bill.

I cannot even rate it. According to me it doesn't come under any rating. Its an horrible place. I ordered 4 sandwiches, 3 were chicken with black pepper. The chicken pieces were like stone, if i hit someone with that piece he/she will bleed. How can they serve this kinda sandwiches; especially when they see I had 2 kids along with me.
When i went to complain about chicken, the guy at the counter expressions were as if it is very normal. Waste of money and time. I would suggest to not go such kinda horrible places where they call themselves "Brand".
They should be ashamed to serve tourists this kinda stuff. Horrible place for tourists who are not given choice of food like KFC,Pizza Hut,McDonald's.
Even the cold coffee was bitter. Despite the waiter asked me whether i need it strong or soft, to which my choice was "soft". They have no idea on how to deal with tourists or guests.
HORRIBLE PLACE.

The only reason why this place is not getting 1 Star is because the had a decent coffee. We ordered a very simple breakfast of the menu and even being the only table waiting for food we did not get our breakfast before after 45 minutes!! The food we received was tasteless and bland and some of it was not even what we ordered. Stay away if you want an OK breakfast and not have to wait until lunch time.

Best place to go for hoppers and coffee in the morning in Hikkaduwa! Stop here before you head out to surf for great egg hoppers and a strong cup of black coffee. Super cheap compared to other options in the area. The little coconut cakes are amazing dipped in coffee or tea.
New modern clean rooms and a really good place to go for Sri Lankan breakfast and rice and curry!!

formatted_address: 44P5+XFP Kandauda para, wawlagoda, Hikkaduwa, Sri Lanka
name: Niranjalee homes

reviews.text: We stayed in Roshan's guest house from 3rd to 4th Feb 2019 and the owner is really friendly, and very clean accomodation and it is very close to the beach just a 2-3 minutes walk. And right near railway station and bus stand. A good place for a stay. ❤

The location is great. It's close to the beach and the train station and bus stop, so it's convenient for going to Galle. There's a lot of restaurants in the area, but it's not that loud. It's right next to the car park, so it's really noisy.

A lovely and very welcoming place. The atmosphere is spot on, with a well-chosen music selection at a volume that perfectly suits the space. Food and drinks are delicious and come at reasonable prices, and the service is friendly and attentive throughout.

I had a nice chat with one of the owners, who genuinely asked for suggestions on how to improve—an excellent, humble attitude that clearly shows in the thoughtful corner they’ve created in Hikkaduwa.

There’s nothing negative to point out. One of the place’s charming quirks is that it sits next to the train tracks, so when a train passes you’ll feel a brief vibration—nothing uncomfortable, and very much part of the character.

Overall, a beautifully run spot with great energy, good taste, and a team that truly cares.

I’ve known this place for about two years now and I always enjoy coming back.
The food is consistently very good, fresh, and full of flavor. Sometimes the service can take a little longer, but honestly, that’s perfectly fine — the atmosphere is so relaxed and inviting that you don’t even mind waiting. It’s the kind of place where you naturally want to slow down, stay longer, and enjoy the moment.

The ambience is one of the highlights: warm, cozy, and very comfortable. It’s ideal for spending time with friends, working a bit, or simply enjoying a calm meal.

Everyone working here is extremely friendly and welcoming, which makes the whole experience even better. You always feel genuinely appreciated as a guest.

Highly recommended — this is one of those places you keep coming back to.
The food was absolutely delicious. That's why I went there three times. I can highly recommend the burgers and the homemade iced tea as well.
Great food and lovely staff. We have been there a few times now and every time the meal is lovely. Great atmosphere and very chilled.

gorgeous place!! not far from the beach, yet not on a noisy road. I really liked the service and the atmosphere of the place.
they have great vegan and vegetarian options. their papadam is very crunchy and I really loved the tofu curry, which is so hard to find in Sri Lanka.
they do have a 10% service but I think the food was worth it.
would definitely visit again!

No 01 And Best Protein Bar In Hikkaduwa
with Stylish GYM

Recommend Highly quality Protein Bar with Storage
Very friendly staff, Very good service, All Protein shakes are available and quick responses. Highly recommended
Excellent 🤝
The service was really friendly, with a comfortable environment. The food was phenomenal my girlfriend finished hers within 2minuets 100%recommend 😊
Had a fresh juice at Cafe Ora Hikka and it was really good! The staff were also very friendly and welcoming. Loved the vibe will definitely visit again.

Lovely café with a welcoming atmosphere! The staff is very friendly, the prices are excellent, and everything is beautifully presented. On top of that, the taste of everything is absolutely fantastic. Highly recommended

Service was great, fantastic coffee which is important coming from Melbourne. Very clean with a nice terrace looking out over the town hearing the morning sounds.  Quick service too, the woman Romi there was very friendly

CAFE ORA is the most wonderful cafe in Hikkaduwa Sri Lanka.it has Very Good coffe.The cheesecake Was Very delicious. I really enjoied eating here.it is a drink Combining mangó And passion it is the best drink in the world. You should come And enjoy it.The staff are Very friendly.cafe is Very close to everything.beach ,Bus station ,train station are Very close.😍🥰👌🦐🥭🥐🍔🍰🧋☕️

Experienced a wonderful cheesy chicken Burger after very long time for a reasonable price. Very good customer service. I think you'll love the way they dealing with the customers. I noticed that their cleaned kitchen area as well. Waiting for the next time. Cheers ♥️♥️♥️🍔🌭👌
Had burgers for dinner.  Delicious food. Great frendly service. Clean kitchen and tables.  Lovely experience  ❤️❤️❤️
Newly opened Burger & bites shop in Hikkaduwa. Fresh experience. Tasty foods.
Yeah my friend!
Nice place and owner! The food is delicious and juicy! I'm happy!

A small café on the main road in Hikkaduwa, run by two local brothers who clearly put a lot of care into what they do. The coffee is excellent, and the iced tea was delicious, both at very fair prices.

Unfortunately, I didn’t get the chance to try the food, but it looked really appetizing, and I overheard other customers complimenting the owners directly on how good their meals were. Since they are the ones who both cook and serve, the place feels very personal and genuine.

If I come back to Hikkaduwa, I’ll definitely stop by again without hesitation. A simple, honest café with great drinks and a very good vibe.

A highly recommended restaurant. All the food was delicious and very reasonably priced. You can really tell everything is made with care. The owners are incredibly friendly and helpful, always making sure you feel welcome and well looked after. On top of that, it’s a very beautiful place. Definitely a place to come back to.
First of all I never leave reviews and I felt obliged to leave a good review for this place the iced lattes and bacon and egg omelette were 10/10 best we have had in 3 weeks in Sri Lanka

During my recent short trip to Sri Lanka, I revisited one of my favorite beaches, Hikkaduwa. It was my first time back in Hikka since the pandemic, and while the surroundings had changed slightly, the familiar vibe from 20 years ago was still alive, thanks to the wonderful company of friends who live nearby.
I stopped by Bohoma cafe for a quick bite and ordered a beef burger, which was incredibly juicy—it reminded me of the burgers I’ve had in Europe! The potatoes were equally delicious. To top it off, the coffee was a perfect blend of Sri Lankan and European flavors, satisfying my coffee cravings completely.
If you’re visiting Hikkaduwa from Europe, I highly recommend this cafe for a taste of home with a local twist!

This café is on a busy main road, which doesn’t make for the most relaxing atmosphere.
The food and coffee are average at best—especially the avocado toast, which could use a lot more avocado.
Prices are on the expensive side, and for the same cost, you can find places with much better food and a more pleasant location.

We’re so happy we found this place! 👌 The espresso here is hands down the best we had in Hikkaduwa. We tried espresso in 5–6 different spots, and none of them came close in terms of quality. They’re open from 7 AM, which is perfect if you want a takeaway coffee for an early, peaceful morning at the beach. If you truly appreciate good coffee, this is the place to go. We ended up coming back every single day for dose of double shot. 🫡

My girlfriend and I used to drink coffee here every morning, I have tried many places in Hikkaduwa coffee and I can tell you that it is not even close to what Coffee Bunny has, if you do your research then you will see that this is true.
Thanks a lot to the guy who works, go ahead and see you again next year!
As a coffee lover, it has been somewhat difficult to find good coffee in Hikkaduwa. This place had a decent cappuccino and very friendly service. We'll definitely come again.
Best coffee in the town, and friendly service 👌☕️
Best Coffee at the Beach. Available with Almond and Oat Milk :)

formatted_address: A2, 43RX+XWG, Hikkaduwa - Baddegama Rd, Hikkaduwa, Sri Lanka
name: Sampath Restaurant and Cafe

reviews.text: Closed. People say almost over 6 months.

As the owner said, "It's a small place, but they cook big!"
It's truly delicious and the prices aren't inflated.
Sweetest little family run food stall. Everything was made fresh and we had a lovely time talking.
The best hoppers in Hikkadua Thank you 😊
lovely traditional wooden vibe cafe in srilanka.the owner is so innocent
I'm Japanese. I visited this restaurant twice during my stay in Sri Lanka. They serve delicious roti. The local atmosphere is great. I'd love to go again.
Best product to enjoy your favourite drink.
Good product  ❤️ high recommend

Very cozy place to have a breakfast or lunch. We had two chicken burgers, americano coffee and watermelon juice. Everything tasted amazing and the staff was super friendly.
Highly recommend!😌
I have visited the cafe today. Ambience is so good and the staff is very friendly. Had a very tasteful coffee and an avocado toast. Highly Recommend the place

🍔☕ Charlie’s Heaven Cafe – Truly a Little Slice of Heaven!

Tried their burger and signature drink today, and both were absolutely amazing!
The burger had a soft, fresh bun, a crispy and flavorful patty, and perfectly balanced fresh toppings. Every bite was satisfying. 🍔✨
The seasoned potato wedges on the side were crispy and delicious – a great match!

The drink was creamy, refreshing, and beautifully finished with a touch of chocolate on top. One sip and it instantly lifted the mood. 🥤🍫

The cafe has a cozy, calm atmosphere that’s perfect for hanging out with friends, a casual date, or just relaxing on your own. 🌿

📍 Highly recommended!
I had a very delicious breakfast here at a reasonable price. Just look at this plate! Highly recommended.
Great tasting food. Try their avocado toast and grilled chicken with potatoes. The people here are very pleasant.

formatted_address: Godagamagewaththa, Milla Hill Rd, Hikkaduwa, Sri Lanka
name: Ceylons House Hikkaduwa, Sri Lanka

reviews.text:
Ceylons House in Hikkaduwa was unfortunately not the experience we hoped for. The place is quite difficult to reach, as you have to drive up a steep mountain path without proper road conditions. The hotel itself wasn’t terrible, but the overall vibe felt a bit strange. The owner was often hovering around, which made the stay feel less relaxed.

The air conditioning sounded like a tuktuk driving nonstop, the room was extremely small, and the shower was a complete disappointment. Based on our experience, we wouldn’t stay here again.

The hotel left a very unpleasant impression. Instead of the promised comfort, we faced indifferent staff, dirty facilities, no hot water, and a non-functioning Wi-Fi. Breakfast took more than an hour to prepare, and the staff ate before serving guests. Nights and early mornings were noisy, making it impossible to rest properly.

What felt especially uncomfortable was the staff’s behavior toward women — they greeted and spoke only to men with “Hello, sir,” “Thank you, sir,” completely ignoring women even when I greeted them first and smiled. It created a sense of awkwardness and disrespect. Overall, the place feels neglected and unwelcoming, with little genuine care for guests.

Not recommended

We stayed four nights in this magnificent guest house.
The staff are very friendly and helped us find a solution for our broken scooter.
The location is very pleasant with a magnificent view.
Beautiful hotel in a natural environment with amazing views from your private Terrace or the deck! Very comfortable rooms and super friendly and helpful owner & staff. Definitely recommend!!

Couldn't recommend this place enough. We loved absolutely everything about our stay. The family who run's this hotel are some of the most accommodating people we have ever met. They ensured our stay was memorable by arranging and providing activities such as surfing! The house itself and the scenery were wonderful, and a short walk to the beach. The food was some of the best we had during our time in Sri-Lanka. We wish the owners success and hope to return one day!

Lovely Coffee shop of the top floor of a lovely gallery. The coffee shop has two tables on the balcony with nice view as per my pictures. They use lavazza coffee. The coffee is about 50% more pricey then other locations however was nice coffee. I had a coffee at over 5 places in the area and would say they have one of the best.
Lovely hidden rooftop for coffee and a gorgeous gallery beneath it! 100% recommend for an afternoon coffee break 😍🛺

BEST COFFEE!
A whole building to do a window shopping with all craft and art. Highly recommend!
First place in hikkaduwa where i found really tasty real coffee. Small cozy cafe on the roof with sea view
Awesome place to drink coffee and have a rest after swimming in the ocean

formatted_address: Tamara Motels Road, Muddillagaha Wattha,Wowlagoda, Hikkaduwa 80240, Sri Lanka
name: HIKKA RU

reviews.text: The food was really delicious and it arrived at the table very quickly. The service was fast and everything tasted fresh. I especially loved the iced coffee, it was very refreshing and had a great flavor with a little bit of chocolate. Definitely a nice and calm place to enjoy a good meal! 😊☕🍽️

What a lucky found! Coffee Cube is a cute little Cafe a bit off the main road - so it’s peacefully quiet and not overcrowded. The staff is super nice and helpful. There’s card games and a top floor. The coffee and the snacks are SUPERB!!
Can definitely recommend!!

☕

“Had a really great experience at The Coffee Cube. We had two iced caramel macchiatos, one cheese omelet toast, and one crunchy bowl, and everything was fresh and delicious. A special thanks to Tharusha Nethmika and another staff member named Tharusha (sorry, I couldn’t remember his surname) — both were extremely kind, friendly, and welcoming, which made our visit even more enjoyable. The atmosphere was calm and cozy, perfect for breakfast or a coffee break. Highly recommend this place when visiting Hikkaduwa.”

We liked the setup. The coffee was OK. Of all the cakes on the menu they only had cheesecake and brownie, brownie was good though. Omelette a bit dry. By the looks of all the other pictures they seem to serve nicely decorated shakes but guess we came on the wrong day…
Spent 3days in Hikkaduwa, and was delighted to find this place at the beginning. Excellent coffee, cakes and breakfasts. After nearly a month in Sri Lanka, finding coffees we liked was fabulous.

Great Food! We had tom yum, fried rice and grilled prawn (the star of the meal) , the food is delicious, the  ambience is very nice , we loved the low seatings , very relaxing, the staff is very welcoming and nice, they accommodated all of our requests. Definitely going back to try more on the menu

Absolutely loved this place! We were looked after every time by Podi and the boys. All so friendly!! Best vibes, on the beach. Perfect spot for a great meal with beautiful scenery. The guys here are great

One of my favourite place in hikkaduwa..Since the 1st time we visited this place we felt the chill vibe from the place and we keep coming back to this place frequently..
Wonderful place on the beach with great atmosphere with chill music a perfect place to enjoy nice cocktail or meal.. Staffs are professional and very friendly..
So far one of the best place in hikkaduwa..)))

Coco Loco is such a chill place to hang out in Hikkaduwa. I stopped by for one beer and ended up staying longer just to enjoy the vibe. The guy running the place is amazing! super kind, always smiling, and genuinely great to talk to.
I had a few beers while relaxing right in front of the beach, and ordered some toast with chicken and cheese which were simple but really nice. It’s the kind of place where you feel welcome straight away.
Awesome cocktails with a gorgeous sea/sunset view! You have HAVE to pop by this place! 😍🍹

formatted_address: No.358C,Wawlagoda, Galle Rd, Hikkaduwa 80240, Sri Lanka
name: Raja Cafe And Gallery Hikkaduwa

reviews.text: Fantastic espresso And cappuccino, Its hard to find good coffee in Srí Lanka, but over here Is the place, And the view, top👍
The shisha and cocktails were great, I highly recommend the place; the sea view is incredible.
Very cute shop with lovely clothes. Staff are really friendly, really recommend this shop.
Friendly customer service and tasty foods 😋
Great place to have a coffee and buy a nice dress. Open and kind, friendly people ❤️

formatted_address: 358c Galle - Colombo Rd, Hikkaduwa, Sri Lanka
name: Ocean Drop Hikkaduwa

reviews.text: Super cool little spot. Right on the beach. There are just few tables so better come at an off peak time. The fish platter was delicious. It takes 40 minutes to make but it’s worth the wait and the view will entertain you in the meantime. I got a prawn curry too with coconut roti and it was delicious. Overall paid just £20 for two people. Lovely staff. Highly recommend.

We had the most incredible dinner here. It’s only our second day in Sri Lanka and this little restaurant has set the bar so high for the rest of our trip. We arrived for an early dinner and scored the best seat in the house, right on the water. The chicken poke bowl was phenomenal with incredible flavour, and the chicken kottu was also delicious. The staff were very friendly, we’d recommend this place to everyone! Thanks guys!

Tiny spot right on the water. We sat at the bench overlooking the beach with the waves washing underneath. Atmosphere was nice but not suitable for a big group.
We had the chicken and shrimp burrito bowls. The chicken burrito bowl was amazing, each component in the dish beautifully flavoured. The prawn one was also good but not as excellent.

We had the best lunch here today! The servers were all lovely and so friendly, we went in to have a coffee in the morning and the food looked so good that we came back later for lunch. The view of the sea gives the best atmosphere and the presentation of the drinks is outstanding, as well as the flavour! Thank you.

Amazing little space located right on the beach front. We had the best seats in the house facing directly out to sea. The service was quick, high quality food and cocktails! The cocktails made with fresh ingredients, not artificially sweet at all.
My fried rice was lovely and the taste was complimented by the cocktail I had too. Both mine and my partners portion size was a generous amount at a very fair price!

Excellent!!! Such good vibes and food is on point. If you're lucky you can get front row seats with the best sea view. Being a srilankan who knows asian cuisine, this is by far one of the best meals I've had. Very versatile to accommodate plenty of palettes. Would definitely recommend 🙌🏾👌🏾

Small bar/restaurant with a fantastic feel. Super friendly guys running it. Beers are cold, food is freshly prepared and fab. Service is chilled.

Not a lot not to like, love this place

best locally ownd Retsaurant! Amazing View
The owner is so nice and cooks fresh!
The toast breakfast with coffee and eggs is delicious! so many veggies as well and quite a lot.
Support local businesses🫶🏻come eat here
This place is amazing. You literally sit right on the ocean watching waves. Food is delicious, specially roti with bananas and chocolate.
Amazing seating put over the sea. We had omelettes for breakfast and both were delicious. Lovely fast service and overall great vibe and good prices

formatted_address: 358c Galle - Colombo Rd, Hikkaduwa, Sri Lanka
name: Sun&Sea Café and eatery

reviews.text: Great place for breakfast fantastic veiw right by the sea.

Great view of the water, seafood, delicious food. Fresh mango juice is an acquired taste... They'll definitely give you a couple of fruits when you leave. They're lovely people, they really try their best.
Complete chancer.  Most expensive beer I have purchased in Sri Lanka in 3 weeks.
Liked the food (chicken kottu), juice and the ambience. Friendly owner. Good service. Beautiful view at night, sitting on the beach,  with lit lamps and the ocean at your feet.
Clean place, food is okay but portions are quite small for the price. Nothing special, but if you hungry it’s fine to go there

A great place. The hosts speak Russian, having studied it. They're always ready to help and advise you on any questions. In the evening before sunset, they light torches on the beach, creating a cozy and peaceful atmosphere. They're very polite, attentive, and kind. You can take affordable surfing lessons, and they can help you rent boards. Food and drinks are priced the same as anywhere else on the beach. I definitely recommend it!

We didn't check the reviews. The prices are inflated, maybe because it's just a small place. The portions are small. I'm comparing it to what we ate during two weeks in Sri Lanka. It's unlikely to be incredibly rich or sophisticated. But the prices are as high as in a good restaurant at an expensive hotel.

formatted_address: 358e Galle - Colombo Rd, Hikkaduwa, Sri Lanka
name: Ocean Vibe Cafe

reviews.text: I visited this beachside cafe briefly this lunchtime. I had a mango milkshake and smoothie bowl. The music was so loud, you could hardly hear yourself think. Twice I turned it down myself and staff were not impressed that I did that! The narrow entrance and beachside view is pleasant. The shake was nice, smoothie bowl which was mango, avocado and muesli was bland.
We ordered the whole fish, Sri Lankan salad, and Avocado salad. All we're phenomenal!! Will definitely be back for a second meal while I'm here!

Close to Turtle beach this cafe is cozy cool.  With a charming and helpful staff and owner.  The water is inviting and you can shower right on the Bach at the Vibe.  Fantastic coffee smoothie and fruit drinks.  It's a hangout for sure
The poke bowl was amazing, also the avocado toast! Totally recommend this place✨✨🤌🏼

This is by far the best bar/cafe in town. It's our second visit to Hikkaduwa and Chama and his team made it special. Great fresh food, coffee and sunsets! The freshest avocado smoothie ever and the best burger with handmade chips. These guys will do anything for you, just ask. We also had a great tour with Chama to Yala safari and Ella, he knows his stuff!

Fresh seafood (delicious!), lobster, fish, squid, Sri Lankan pizza, Lavazza coffee—everything with a European twist. I personally love the vegetable chops and curry (I love spicy!). The rice and local pasta are amazing! If you have time for a delicious break from the hustle and bustle, it's a great option. The owner, Ajith, spent half his life working in Milan and welcomes any advice or suggestions!

The portions are large, and the food is fresh and delicious. The fried rice with vegetables and seafood is delicious and very filling; I highly recommend it. My wife loved the chicken curry. The only downsides were the holes in the tablecloth and the chips in the plates. The staff was welcoming and friendly. Everything was prepared quickly. The prices are the same as other cafes, and the bill is without any extras (everything is as on the menu). If there are no cars in the parking lot across the street, you can see the ocean. We didn't regret stopping in.
A regular pizza, underbaked, a bit raw inside. We ordered a large one, but it was only 30 cm. 900 rupees. The coffee was delicious. Sea view.

Unexpectedly delicious and pleasant.
We stopped in completely by chance.
First of all, I want to note the clean tablecloths and dishes (surprisingly for Sri Lanka).
The chef cooks excellently; he worked as a cook in Italy for many years. He and his wife work together, so sometimes the cooking takes a long time, but it's worth it.
I'm a picky eater, but this place had excellent pasta and chicken breast in sauce.
And the price is very reasonable. Pasta 🍝, chicken, beer, and ice cream came to 6,500 rupees.
Highly recommended!!!

We were there yesterday for the June 3rd holiday. We ordered Fusilli with seafood, a seafood pizza (which was huge), and beer. The pasta came with feathers instead of fusilli, but they put a lot of shrimp and even some squid. As for the pizza, they have billboards with fluffy pizzas with tons of toppings, but in reality, we get 30 cm of fried bread, and that's considered big. The beer menu lists Carlsberg and Lyon for 750 ml for 850 and 800 rupees, respectively, while in reality it's 625 ml, and they sold it for 1,000. When I asked why, they said it's a police holiday, alcohol is banned, and all that. There's no atmosphere, just a cafeteria with pretty pictures, but in reality, it's crap.

This is amazing place. Beautiful and delicious food. Nice atmosphere. We were here just 2 times and enjoyed everything we ordered. Of course, we're going to visit this place almost every day while we here. Also, there are lots of beautiful paintings, which we made by the owners of this place.

What a wonderful place! The food was incredible, so fresh and flavourful. Highly recommend the avocado toast or banana toast, and the iced matcha! The girls were so lovely too, always smiling and helpful. Just make sure you look up so you don’t miss it! :)

What can I say? We were looking for coffee but found a great place where you can not only drink coffee but also have a delicious meal. It's a very atmospheric place. No loud music but still place quite artistic. There are lots of paintings around, which, by the way, you can buy; they'll unframe and package them for you.

Thank you! Fantastic coffee and ice cream (a rarity around here) and a beautiful smile to greet us. Thank you soo much for looking after my family this afternoon. My wife especially as you went above and beyond to help. X Love 🙏
Lovely upstairs coffee place just opposite Cinnamon Hotel. Gorgeous staff and an excellent coffee especially for the latte drinker. I enjoyed my espresso double!

formatted_address: 64A GALLE ROAD, Pannamgoda Meda Para Road, Hikkaduwa 80240, Sri Lanka
name: THE BAY

reviews.text: It doesn’t have ice cream. Nice shop.
They sell excellent essential oils here.

formatted_address: 7 Galle - Colombo Rd, Hikkaduwa 80240, Sri Lanka
name: Hikka Bridge Café & Restaurant

reviews.text: One of the best cafés in Hikkaduwa, with excellent scenery and a wonderful ambience. The location is truly unique—you can enjoy views of the railway line alongside the riverside, making it a perfect spot to relax. They offer a wide variety of drinks, mocktails, and fresh juices. The coconut pancakes are an absolute must-try! Sip your coffee while watching trains pass by—it’s a lovely experience. If you’re in Hikkaduwa, do visit at least once. ☕🌴🚆

Delicious fresh food and beautiful ambiance!  The river view and the unexpected surprise of the train going by was the perfect setting to enjoy our meal. Our family of 7 enjoyed real milkshakes, burgers, curry, fried rice and salads, and everyone loved their meal.

amazing🤩🤩🤩🤩
The food was outstanding! fresh, flavorful, and beautifully prepared. Hats off to the chef! A wide variety of dishes, from European cuisine to traditional local specialties, were cooked to perfection. The service was excellent, very attentive, and they went out of their way to accommodate our special requests. They were also incredibly warm and welcoming towards the children. The atmosphere was wonderful. Truly the best restaurant in the area!

Fantastic restaurant with great food and staff.

We came back twice during our stay in Hikkaduwa. The kottu was amazing and came with plenty of food for a really great price.

They even put music on for the kids both times so they could dance around and enjoy themselves whilst it was quiet. It was really thoughtful of them 👌

We visited this place with our family and had a wonderful time. Our kids really enjoyed playing in the river, while my wife and I relaxed with a drink. The team was very efficient and provided excellent service throughout our visit.

Special thanks to Ramesh, who served us, he was very down-to-earth, pleasant, kind, and extremely helpful.

I highly recommend this place for families, especially during off-peak hours. A great spot to relax and enjoy quality time together.

Location is superb right at the beach, so is the view and the sunsets. The rooms are clean and spacious, even with AC. Staff is super nice, they do everything to make the best out of your stay. The food is really great, especially the guy who cooked breakfast for us deserves a Michelin star!! We had breakfast included with the stay and could choose something else for breakfast every day wich was remarkable. The vibe was laid back and we were welcomed like friends. Would definitely come back!

We stayed at this hotel for 5 nights in November, with a group of 6 people, and we booked 3 rooms. We were all delighted with the experience! The location was 10/10, the staff was 10/10, and the atmosphere was 10/10. We highly recommend this hotel! We will definitely return to this hotel in the future!

Passing through the south coast we stayed two nights in Hikkaduwa and we're so glad we chose Sapphire Blue. Easy parking in their backyard, direct access to the beach to see the flood and tide coming in.
I bumped into this place with an ocean view. Great food but rice for poke bowl should be bit stickier I suggest, bit expensive but still worth it considering the view. Recommended!! 🩷🩷
Thank you so much for your welcoming! The food was tasty! Perfect service! Wonderful view!

formatted_address: NO 408 Galle road Wewala, Hikkaduwa 80240, Sri Lanka
name: Sunny Side Up

reviews.text:
My brunch at Sunny Side Up was absolutely delightful! 🤩 The food was incredibly delicious, and the service was attentive and friendly. 💖 I loved the vibrant atmosphere – it really made for a perfect meal. We tried the Mushroom Burger, Chia pudding Smoothie, Matcha Latte and they were all perfect! Enjoyed the food! Best part being it's an only vegetarian place, so you have lots of options to pick from.
Definitely coming back for more! 😋✨

Wonderful cafè for breakfast and brunch!! The team has a great vibe, they are efficient, kind and professional! We came here almost every morning during our one week in Hikkaduwa! We always had the banana pancakes and the chia pudding! Can’t recommend enough!

Such an aesthetic restaurant with delicious food and drinks! The food presentation is a whole different story, everything is so bright, juicy, and tropical, decorated with flowers... just beautiful! Ordering food here makes you realize: this is exactly that tropical island summer vibe you dream of when vacationing in Sri Lanka 😍 The food is not only stunning but also tasty, with very generous portions. Plus, the staff is incredibly sweet and positive!
My mom and I tried the Chocolate Dream smoothie bowl, the avocado toast with scrambled eggs and hollandaise sauce, and the banana, tropical and mango chia puddings. Everything was delicious and looked like a work of art!
As for drinks, we had the caramel latte, cappuccino, and caramel matcha latte. Not a single drink disappointed. Everything was perfect! The coffee here is incredibly good 😍 You absolutely must try it!!!
And for dessert I had the brownie (it was my birthday 😆) and it was honestly the best brownie of my life! I don’t even know how to describe the taste, but you HAVE to try it. My mom is a restaurateur, so I’ve tried many brownies in my life, but this one was special!
Overall, I highly recommend this place!!! It’s a 10/10!

We came here for breakfast and it was absolutely incredible. The food was served quickly and it was the best breakfast that I have had in Sri Lanka. I had the white toast with poached eggs, spinach, tomato and hollandaise. We also got a side of potatoes to share. I couldn’t believe the presentation and how great everything tasted. The staff are really efficient and friendly too!
I also had a delicious iced vanilla matcha. Highly recommend

You won’t be disappointed going here for brunch. Some of the best brunch plates we had in Sri Lanka. Avocado toast was up there and check out the chocolate banana pancakes - so good. Great spot for brunch in Hikkaduwa!

Just okay, I’ve had better in Hikkaduwa. Atmosphere is good, service is slow and communication is an issue. Came here after checking the vegan and vegetarian options which were quite many.

Chocolate smoothie bowl was very mid. Wouldn’t order it again here.

Avocado Hummus Toast was BAD. The hummus tastes bad and we were served on a Sandwich bread instead of actual Toast 🤦🏽‍♂️

Cashew Pesto Pasta was only dish above average and good in taste. The portion size was also decent. Still, I would’ve liked cashew cheese instead of whole cashews sprinkled on the Pasta.

Chocolate Banana Coffee Smoothie was as it is supposed to taste.

Poached Eggs were plain, no spices nothing. Small quantity.

Banana Pancakes were mid, could’ve been so much better.

Overall this café at this location and ambiance can do so much better, but it is mediocre at max.

The food is below average. Service is really slow - even getting a spoon takes 5 minutes.
Taste is below average. Portion size for coffee is just one third of average portion size else where in Sri Lanka.
Ambience is good.. but getting food to your table can take an hour or so.

A lovely little café serving the best avocado toast I’ve ever had — I actually came back two days in a row just for those sandwiches!

I also tried two of their smoothie bowls, the Tropical Pink and the Tropical Mango — both were absolutely delicious. It’s also the only place where I found truly great coffee, so don’t miss this spot if you’re in the area!

The place has very tasteful interior and the guys working there are super friendly too, which made the whole experience even better.

Calm and cozy space. Tables are big enough, so you can even take your laptop and do some creative stuff, while drinking your oat latte.

Strongly recommend v60, it's good, not decent, not breathtaking, but very very good.

Local lads are very welcome in here and will make your experience even more pleasent.

Breakfasts, coffee, even lunch. Jumbo prawns deserve michelin star for this place.

Excellent! One of the best breakfasts I've ever had in my entire life, a must-visit place when you're in Hikladuwa, I had savory dish and something sweet, both were delicious! I worked there half day on my laptop, young staff was very nice, employee immediately gave me wifi password without me asking and showed me a place with contact to plug my laptop!

formatted_address: Wewala, 430 Galle Rd, Hikkaduwa 80240, Sri Lanka
name: Kbingsu hikkaduwa - korean snow flakes dessert shop

reviews.text: A must try Korean dessert. A surprise delight which was refreshing after a warm afternoon in Sri Lanka. We tried the strawberry and chocolate Oreo & they were both delicious. Friendly staff. A lot of places in town pressure to do reviews & this place did not even ask - a testament to authentic reviews & a great product. Highly recommend this lovely business K-Bingsu 🙌🏻😍

This is a great hidden gem in Hikkaduwa. There are dozens of Italian restaurants, bars, and Western-style hangouts, and, of course, delicious Sri Lankan eateries, but only one Kbingsu. The owner lived in Korea for 15 years and brought back a bingsu machine that he uses to make a one of a kind frozen ice cream-like dessert! I have had the real thing in Korea, and this was just as good! I had the mango+cheese flavor after a long morning of scuba diving and it was absolutely divine. Highly recommend! Moreover, the owner was friendly and wonderful to talk to.

This place is lovely. The owner is very friendly and the food tasty. We had vegetable noodle that came with a Korean chilli sauce and mango cheese bingsu which was very refreshing and tasted great. Highly recommend and will come again when in Hikkaduwa
Place is lovely. The bingsu was very delicious and looked amazing. Place looks amazing and the owner is very friendly. We’re definitely coming back!

The owner is so kind and the food is just amazing!
I had so many things like rotti(handmade!!) and kottu but the best is the mango bingsu, the mango pieces are so fresh and the mango ice cream is so tasty!! Totally recommended

Lovely place in Hikkaduwa. If you’re looking for tasty and healthy food, this is the place to go. The tuna poke was absolutely amazing — the best I’ve ever had. Highly recommended! Karel, Czech Republic.

Super cute place to eat and drink really tasty! Kind staff, clean tables, good music, great atmosphere, and the last but not least — the quality of food. You can choose any position, and it will be tasty. Thank you guys for this, all the best to you ❤️
One of 3 our favorite cafes in Hikka! Absolutely gorgeous food! And prices are really very affordable
Great experience, delicious food and very welcoming, local service. Highly recommended👌

Perfect place in Hikkaduwa! The food was amazing — everything fresh and full of flavor. The owner is super friendly and welcoming, it was a pleasure to visit. We'll definitely come back!

Tip: Ask for a frappe — it’s not on the menu, but they’ll make it for you :)

formatted_address: Cafe Zero, Wewala, Hikkaduwa 80240, Sri Lanka
name: Cafe Zero

reviews.text:
CAFE ZERO  I loved the cozy, intimate setting of this place. The prices were very reasonable for the quality of food and service. The flavors in each dish were perfectly balanced & Delicious , and the ingredients tasted incredibly fresh.
The dim lighting and soft music set the perfect mood with amazing Sea view , Seating areas are charm & comfortable.

I recently dined at Cafe Zero, and it was an outstanding experience! The food was absolutely delicious, with a diverse menu that caters to every palate. Each dish was beautifully presented and bursting with flavor. The staff were friendly and attentive, making the atmosphere warm and welcoming. I highly recommend Cafe Zero to anyone looking for a fantastic meal. Can't wait to return!
Best prawns I’ve had here, lovely place and friendly staff. Dilan is an excellent host, helpful and kind.

I took dinner just because I was promissed that masseur above will be free in half hour, the fish was ok, but rather small and bones not removed as I asked before. at the end masseur was not free and from half hout it became more than 2 hour of waiting (in between I saw another foreigner comming upstairs). So for dishonest starements and wasting guests valuable time I must give only 2 stars :(

Amazing food, impeccable service, and cozy ambiance! Cafe zero exceeded expectations. Try the [Crab Grilled ] - flavors were incredible! Reasonably priced too. Will definitely return! Highly recommended.

The first time I had dinner here, the pizza was ordinary and delicious.

But today I decided to try breakfast here, and it was terrible 😞
I ordered pancakes, but they brought me crepes. It's a big difference. They tasted as if they had just been thawed and warmed in the microwave. And the latte consisted of 90% milk, and there was almost no taste of coffee.

This is probably the best place in Hikkaduwa. They serve high-quality dishes that are not available anywhere else in the area. The cheese pancakes are delicious, and they serve them with a divine mango and passion fruit sauce. The Neapolitan pizza, cooked in a wood-fired oven, is a must-try. The owner, Arthur, is very friendly and welcoming, and the staff is courteous and helpful. Additionally, they offer the best hookahs on the island, which are comparable to those in Russia. The best place in terms of price and quality, where you won't be fed slop but will be served genuine works of art prepared by a renowned chef in Russia and abroad

We had dinner here. The pizza is delicious and all the food we tried.
The shisha is amazing. We highly recommend this place in Hikkaduwa.

I had the avo toast.
Pros: it came with three eggs and was filling. Nice deck overlooking the sea.

Cons: it's not toast, but a flatbread, like pita. Eggs were overcooked, like hard boiled eggs, despite being "poached" on the menu. Avocado was absent or very difficult to find, perhaps mixed in with the thin "shakshuka sauce" under the lettuce.
The best place in Hikkaduwa! You won't find such delicious desserts anywhere else. The chocolate fondant stole my heart💔 The view is simply stunning, the staff is polite and attentive

formatted_address: A2, 44G4+JQC, Hikkaduwa - Baddegama Rd, Hikkaduwa, Sri Lanka
name: Happy Place

reviews.text: Nice place, pleasant summer lounge. The food is excellent. Delicious curry rice, chicken shawarma, and amazing chocolate pancakes, served with ice cream, mind you! It's mind-blowing! We went there about six times in two weeks. Sometimes they forget to bring cutlery, but that's forgivable 😅

formatted_address: Wawela, 542 Galle Rd, Hikkaduwa, Sri Lanka
name: Salty Swamis

reviews.text:
Obsessed with this place! First of all, in a country with some of the slowest restaurant service I’ve ever experienced, getting your food in 10–15 minutes feels like a mirage.
The coffee is great, with a really good milk-to-coffee balance (which is rare). The breakfast burrito was insane (hence the 2 pictures), I had to get another one the next day. The banana bread was so good, and they serve two massive slices, which we loved.
The staff were sooo sweet and lovely. Recommend, recommend, recommend!! We will definitely be back!

Great atmosphere music playing. Airconditioning seating, shady outside seating and seating right next to the beach. Service is great staff is very nice. Presentation of the food is insta worthy and the food was amazing. We had late lunch and I still wanted everything on the menu. Good selection and coffee is really good with option to choose the local beans. Gallery and shop also available and very interesting. Would definitely come back as I almost wanted two meals because I couldn’t choose!!!

Most favorite breakfast place. Their food is super yummy, and they take coffee very seriously! High quality beans, and professional attitude to brewing it as well.
Their staff is super sweet and caring.
There is really nothing bad to say.
Once we found it we came here every morning until we left 🙌🌟

Salty Swamis is hands down the best coffee I’ve ever had in the south of Sri Lanka. Hikkaduwa is already a great spot, but this place truly stands out—exceptional coffee and very good food to match.

The staff is genuinely cool and welcoming, the place is well organized, and the vibe is spot on. There’s a beach entrance as well as a small shop on the main street, where they sell beautifully curated designer pieces, local artists’ work, and surfer essentials.

If you’re a real coffee lover like me, with a taste shaped by Australian coffee culture, this is an absolute must-visit. ☕🌊

The pictures don’t do the food justice. The pesto sandwich was so tasty and the most delicious peanut butter Nutella shake! The peanut energy ball was also very good! The setting is beautiful and the staff are so friendly. Definitely must go while visiting Hikkaduwa!

You can try Russian authentic cuisine here. Pasta carbonara is also good. The tables are outside the veranda next to the pond which gives a nice chilling atmosphere. The staff is very friendly and helpful.
Now you can hire electric bikes here!! Never before in Sri Lanka.
Super food

The prices are fantastic. The local cuisine is divided into Sri Lankan, Russian, and European. You can ask for Sri Lankan with less spices. Everything is at least 1.5 times cheaper than on the beach. The portions are huge, you can order one for two. Fresh pineapple juice is 200 rupees, or $1.30. The staff is smiling, they're great!

Совершенно тухлое место и очень небольшим меню и средними ценами.
Заказали суп с курицей - обычны, как и во многих других местах, только порция меньше. При заказе пива, они едут на байке до ближайшего Вайн стора, покупают там и продают в 2 раза дороже тебе. Так как рядом самодельный пруд, то вечером несметное количество комаров, против которых не помогает даже подожженные вонючки. В общем не стоит оно того.

formatted_address: Kakunagaha watta Narigama, Hikkaduwa 80240, Sri Lanka
name: LULU & The Willow Retreat 💛🌿🌾

reviews.text:
Recommendation✨
We ate breakfast and dinner at Lulu‘s and it was simply delicious! Both times we ordered in advance - i would recommend to do that, because they cook everything fresh and it takes time. Lulu was really responsive, answered fast and took all our wishes into account.
We could even modify the breakfast menu to our liking and she prepared our favourite mango curry for dinner (huge dinner portion, we left with a full belly)💜 thank you so much for the nice food and talks!

I asked the hostess to make a sugar-free cheesecake, and she created an incredibly aromatic, fresh dessert. You can truly feel it was made with love. The mango and chocolate combination is pure creativity. Highly recommended  and the price will pleasantly surprise you. ❤️

We had the best meals of our holiday here. Both the food, the people and the location are fantastic, and you get to escape the more touristy restaurants and cafés of Hikkaduwa; and instead you can have the most well seasoned and best tasting traditional food, along with amazing fresh juices. We even got brownie for free at one time, as we were doing our shopping in the small store below the restaurant. They have my highest recommendation!🌞

This is a wonderful restaurant.
The staff were very friendly.
If you're looking for healthy Sri Lankan curry, this is a must-visit.
Thank you for your wonderful hospitality!
We'll be back 😋

Lulu juice bar is more than a juice bar. It's a family owned small restaurant that really shows you the traditional Sri Lankan vibe.

Lulu is really kind and hospitable.

We came from the beach, ordered and was told how long it will take to prepare the food. We went home to take a shower and changed, and by the time we returned the food was ready. You can also take Lulu's number and order breakfast ahead in the morning.

An the prices are really cheap. Surly will eat several times while we are here.
It's a laundry room now.
One of the best rice and curry meals I have had in Sri Lanka. This is a family run beachfront restaurant with a great atmosphere. Prices are very reasonable. Thank you :-)

Best place I ate in Sri Lanka, directly on the beach and possibility to use the deckchairs.
I recommend the prawns.
Friendly and kind staff.
Super recommended!!
Thank you!!🙏🏻

Simple beach shack. Service was good enough but the owner is charging higher price for western tourists. The same people run a travel agency with same name. Be aware and agree on the price before ordering anything.

Oke best music bar on the beach. PATTI SMITH, Lou Reed, stones, nick cave nirvana clash, herman brood and nina hagen. Just Sk him to play the music I send him Frans from Holland. I love this place. Hope you fo too, And all prices are writing in the menu. S
Great place to enjoy with your family ❤️

What a place! If you are looking for a place with well cooked fresh food with an extra touch this is the place! The drinks were more pricy for Sri Lanka but really good so worth it! We had the beef tacos and a tuna pokebowl and both were delicious with good flavors! Was a lot of people here since it seems to be popular, but we sat at the bar and got a table after a few minutes. Worth a visit for sure ig you are in the area!

Food was delicious. Good menu with lots of choice. We had breakfast and dinner here and wished we had the time to come back more often. French fries were very good. The brownie was so delicious we couldn’t resist getting another one. Portions were very good. Drinks were also good, love that they have Aperol Spritz.
Good vibes, nice music and very friendly staff.

We visited this place for dinner after seeing it the night before, full of people laughing and having a great time. That convinced us to try it, and we weren’t disappointed. The jackfruit bowl was a highlight, the service was fast and professional, and the atmosphere was lovely. Definitely recommend!
I loved the atmosphere and the prawn curry was super yummy and creamy. Probably one of the best beef burgers I’ve had in a while. Definitely gonna stop here again when I drive through here !
