One of the things I will miss after my trip to Sri Lanka is the delicious meals at the "Friends Indeed" restaurant in Hikaduwa. If you are in this city, I definitely recommend it, the food is high quality, fresh, delicious and the place is so atmospheric that you don't want to leave it.

formatted_address: 44G5+65 Narigama, Galle Rd, Hikkaduwa 80240, Sri Lanka
name: The Island Curry Hub Restaurant & Cafe

reviews.text:
Delicious kottu and rice & curry! We came for dinner because we saw all the great reviews on google and despite not seeing anyone in the store (perhaps because it’s off peak season), we decided to give it a go.

We had a hibiscus tea which went great with honey, chicken kottu had a nice chewiness and the fish curry and rice was really flavoursome. The head chef explained why everything took so long - as with most Sri Lankan restaurants, nothing is pre-made or batch cooked. They start preparing once you make the order so that the ingredients are fresh. Great chill ambience, friendly service and delicious food.

I had three meals here due to the proximity to my hotel. The food was flavorful  and good filling portion sizes. However, lacked meat in all dishes I had - chicken quesadillas,  seafood fried rice and seafood noodles. If they could keep the meat present in the options as the name suggest they'd be alot more favoured by the customers.

We came here both of our 2 nights in Hikkaduwa because the curry was SO delicious & the man who runs it is so friendly. We ordered vegetable curries and all the accompanying dishes and it was so yummy that we barely spoke a word to each other our whole meal. Also, I am gluten intolerant and he was really helpful in explaining the ingredients. Highly highly recommend!

Rice and Curry was delicious!! Pumpkin, Okra, beetroot and some chunky fresh Tuna. This is the SPOT if you are looking for some tasty Srilankan food. The owner and everyone working in the island curry hub was super friendly and accommodating! Food came super fast and was super fresh!

If you are craving some home cooked Srilankan food - do not miss this spot!

Came here a few times after the beach for breakfast and was never disappointed
The food is really good, delicious juices too, big cappuccino, nice staff ❤️
My favs are avocado toast and cheese omelette (served with sourdough bread and guacamole 🥑)
Great new spot in Hikkaduwa!! Ramen and drinks were really good! Cute spot, small but well ventilated. Staff are very nice and helpful.

Delicious breakfast ! I had the smoothie bowl and an ice Tea !
One of the best food I had so far !
I highly recomand !
Would go back for sure 😀

Ordered the coconut broth and avo toast. Both were really tasty dishes and well done. More reasonably priced than other places in the area. It’s a small cafe but the counter seating is great. Nice vibe and friendly team.
Excellent food and great value for money! The chef was great
Very good matcha and ramen🍜🍵

formatted_address: Kowilawatta, Narigama, Galle Rd, Hikkaduwa 80240, Sri Lanka
name: Island Tea Co & Ceylon Coffee

reviews.text: Love that cafe. Always delicious drinks and friendly staff. My choice here is Perfect Ceylon Milk Tea (30% sugar). Tried it more about 10 times and every time was great. We also tried different teas and freezes everything was perfect.

Went with my girlfriend and we had a great time. The place is quiet and good place for hangouts. The coffee was really good and had barbecue chicken sandwitch which was really good. 🤤✨️
Try it out bcz its one of the best places for coffee in hikkaduwa.

Such a lovely coffee shop. The place has a really nice vibe, great coffee, and friendly staff. I also noticed how thoughtful they are a person came in a wheelchair, and the staff immediately helped and made sure he could come in easily. Really nice to see that kind of care and kindness. Highly recommend this place!
Nice place with air conditioning when the heat gets too much. They offer coffee, tea and some lighter dishes like sausages and sandwiches at affordable prices
The best tast bubble tea we ever had. I really recommend this place in hikkaduwa. ❤️🥰

I love this places and wade is an amazing
Family business and all of them are nice and feel want to come back again here !!
Highly recommend some local snacks 🦐
Very nice and very good food. Nice location. very very good people working . I think no 1  location in hikkaduwa.
Good place an good food
Superb ❤️👍
Stumbled upon this place while walking the streets. Decided to have breakfast. Very glad we did. Delicious food, friendly staff.

Western breakfast & light breakfast.
We shared both breakfasts and loved them; everything was delicious.
The prices are a bit high, but it's worth it.
Plus, they're very friendly and relatively quick to serve.
For me, one of the best places in the area.

We have had dinner here both times we have been to Hikkaduwa. The food is very good, the prices are not the most local but they are not bad. The hoopers are the best! The kottu plate is quite big, you can share it well.
A very small, simple cafe, a super delicious breakfast, and the owner is very friendly. We were there in 2019 and again this year. Simply wonderful.
I can only agree with the previous speaker. Cozy, nice, fresh, delicious, and affordable.

formatted_address: Sri Lanka, Hikkaduwa, Galle Rd, Narigama
name: Long Beach Japanese Restaurant

reviews.text:
A great place with and for great people. Nice atmosphere right on the beach, friendly and courteous staff. Beach loungers with food & drink service right by the sea 🌊
The Japanese cuisine with its delicacies is unique in the region and invites you to try it🥰 Definitely 5 stars ⭐️ ⭐️ ⭐️ ⭐️ ⭐️

We used two sunbeds from this restaurant on the beach and ordered three beers and a portion of French fries. The sunbeds were perfectly fine and the beers were cold, so no complaints there.
Unfortunately, the food was a big disappointment. The French fries were honestly a joke — so bad that we actually laughed when they arrived 😅. If you can’t make decent fries, maybe food shouldn’t be on the menu.
Good spot for sunbeds and drinks, but I definitely wouldn’t recommend eating here.
The place is lovely, owned by a Japanese family. Food is great, we loved the sashimi and mango lassi especially. A good restaurant to have diner 🥰

We visited as a family on our trip. Our children are still quite young, so we were worried because they can’t eat spicy local food, but the Japanese dishes here were gently flavored and safe for them to enjoy. The teriyaki chicken and miso soup were especially popular with the whole family, and it was the most comforting meal we had during our travels. The staff were also very kind to our children, and the atmosphere was warm and welcoming throughout. It became a wonderful memory of our trip to Sri Lanka.

Long Beach Hikkaduwa is a great spot with a wide selection of delicious Japanese dishes. Everything is prepared by authentic Japanese chefs, so you get the real traditional taste.

It’s definitely the best Japanese restaurant in Hikkaduwa. The customer service is also excellent .. very friendly and attentive.

I highly recommend this place!  🍝🫕

formatted_address: Homemade Cake and Coffee, Narigama, Galle Rd, Hikkaduwa 80240, Sri Lanka
name: Homemade Cake and Coffee Hikkaduwa

reviews.text:
We used to come here with our toddler regularly during our stay in Hikkaduwa, and it quickly became one of our favorite spots. The coffee is very good quality, and the cakes are tasty.
It’s comfortable inside with AC, which is a big plus in Hikkaduwa’s heat. The service is friendly and attentive.
A lovely place to relax with a coffee and dessert! ☕🍰
The place is super well run. Really reminds you of some European coffee houses but with a nice Asian fusion. Coffees and cakes were exceptional. The service was top notch! Thank you all.

One of the very few coffee shops I found in Hikkaduwa beach that serves decaf! Five stars for their variety of menu and a super relaxed ambience. Would definitely recommend for a relaxed lunch or a quick grab of coffee. Their cake varieties are brilliant as well. Do give it a try when you stop here !
One of the best places in Hikkaduwa to get coffee and cake. Great selection of food and drinks. Everything we tried was excellent. The staff is very friendly and child-friendly too. Do not miss!

ambience is refreshing, peaceful, and perfect for hanging out or even bringing your laptop to get some work done. The food is absolutely delicious — definitely a solid 10/10 with generous portions. The service is excellent, and the staff are super friendly and welcoming. Highly recommended for both relaxing and working! 💻☕🍰

formatted_address: Narigama, 04 A Galle Rd, Hikkaduwa 80240, Sri Lanka
name: Salty Vibes Cafe Hikkaduwa

reviews.text: Amazing place with a great vibe! Very nice, beautiful boho style, super cozy. Delicious fresh food. Amazing staff. Just loved this place! Highly recommended👌🏼

The best place in town! For great food and presentation, the staff is so happy working there - you feel the vibe! Not a hipster trap, definitely recommend. Also they have a proper coffee machine and make a very good espresso ☕️

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
Salty Vibe Café is a lovely little bistro-style spot close to the beach and well worth the short walk from the main town. Relaxed atmosphere, nicely set up, and a great place for an easygoing meal.

The menu is excellent. I had the fish soup and it was outstanding — packed with flavour and generously filled with fresh fish, calamari, and prawns, served with warm brown bread and butter. Absolutely delicious. Prices are very reasonable and the service was fantastic, with Balu taking great care of us throughout the evening.

I didn’t try breakfast this time, but the breakfast menu looks great and is definitely on the list for next visit. A really enjoyable evening and somewhere I’d happily return to.
Perfect place to relax after spending time on the beach. Nice atmosphere, friendly and helpful staff, amazing food. I highly recommend.
This place is awesome! Good high quality food served by an amazingly kind person in one of the coolest open kitchen restaurants ive seen in Hikkaduwa. Good, Honest and fresh food.

formatted_address: Narigama, 653 Galle Rd, Hikkaduwa 80240, Sri Lanka
name: Nordic Burger & Cafe Restaurant

reviews.text: Definitely a top contender for best burger place in Hikkaduwa. They really shine on their creative burger menu. Lots of good stuff to choose from. My only complaint is the bun didn't have as enough structural integrity, not sure how to fix that, maybe ferment the dough? Even so it wasn't a big issue and the burger was delicious. Definitely recommend if you want a break from the curries and sea food.

Very tasty food, we had a cheeseburger and a lava cake. Both were delicious.
The owners are very warm and welcoming. Here you can experience true Sri Lankan hospitality.
Nordic Burger & Cafe Restaurant is a great place for good food! The seafood Kotu is delicious and a very generous portion. The staff are very friendly and attentive. Can definitely recommend.

Best kotu I had in Sri Lanka
Was an egg kotu.
So delicious, huge portion.
Really nice staff and you can see the ocean from upstairs, beach super close by :)

We came here for pizza. All of our 5 pizzas seemed that they were ready-made frozen pizzas. No particular taste. Two burger meals were good. So we would suggest to have other than pizza. Very nice and attentive service! Cosy restaurant near the road.

formatted_address: X8QC+PQ4 Beach Hotel, Matara Rd, Koggala 80000, Sri Lanka
name: Koggala Beach Hotel

reviews.text:
Twenty years ago, I stayed at Koggala
Beach Resort and created some beautiful memories. This time, I returned with my wife hoping to relive that nostalgic feeling and share it with her.

The location still has its charm, and the atmosphere feels very similar to how I remember it. However, unfortunately, it seems like many things have not been updated in those 20 years. The furniture appears unchanged and quite worn out. The floors were not properly clean, and the bathroom condition was below the standard we expected.

We paid ₹26,000 for a double room on a half-board basis. While dinner and breakfast (including tea) were part of the package and the food quality was not bad, we felt the lunch was quite expensive — ₹8,000 for what we ordered felt excessive.

On a positive note, the reception staff gave us a warm welcome, and one of the waiters was genuinely kind and smiling, which we truly appreciated. However, some of the other staff members looked very tired and unhappy, which slightly affected the overall experience.

For the price we paid, our expectations were higher. This place has great potential because of its location and history, but it would truly benefit from renovations and improved cleanliness standards.

I sincerely hope the management takes this feedback positively and works on upgrading the facilities, as this resort holds wonderful memories and could once again offer a truly special experience.

Avoid this place. Seriously.

Koggala Beach Hotel / Long Beach Resort are basically the same property – and both are an embarrassment. The price they charge is completely disconnected from reality.

The entire hotel feels neglected and decaying. The rooms are dirty, bathrooms are revolting, and the smell in the corridors suggests years of poor maintenance. Mold on the walls, stained surfaces, and drains that regularly bring insects into the room. The showers look like something out of a prison facility.

Cleaning standards are unacceptable. Floors are “mopped” in a way that leaves a greasy film and a sour smell rather than cleanliness. It feels unhygienic, not just old.

Wi-Fi barely works, if at all.

Security is another serious concern. Personal items disappeared from our room during the stay. Whether due to negligence or something worse, the result is the same: you cannot feel safe leaving anything unattended.

The only reason this hotel still operates seems to be large tourist groups delivered by agencies. Without that pipeline, it’s difficult to imagine it surviving on genuine reviews.

There are far better places along the Sri Lankan coast for the same money. Do not waste your time, your comfort, or your trust here.

Overall, it was a wonderful place to visit and truly worth the money. The staff were extremely customer-friendly, and the hotel offered a pleasant, relaxing environment throughout our stay. The food was excellent and of high quality. I enjoyed breakfast, lunch, and dinner, and every meal was consistently good.

One of the highlights was the beach, which was exceptionally well-maintained, with no pollution or garbage. The water was crystal clear, making the experience even more enjoyable. We visited last December, and it was a memorable and satisfying stay overall.

The hotel is located directly on the beach with a charming view of the sea. However, swimming is usually not possible due to high waves. The hotel is spacious, quite worn, but with all the necessary amenities. The hotel pools are clean, the staff is easily accessible, and the rooms are cleaned every day. Excellent food, wide selection of local cuisine in the buffet. Friendly and smiling staff.

Large two story hotel along long and beautiful Koggala beach. Access to this hotel is very convinient with public transport available just across the road. This is adjucent beautul Koggala beach. its not crowded. Sea is bit rough with no life guards around.
Their food is good and has both Sri Lankan and western varieties. Buffet was worth the price. Staff is very welcoming. Two negatives U saw was hotel need refurbishment as furniture belong to 1980s. Other odd thing I was I had to wear a wrist band during my stay.

formatted_address: X8R9+6Q2 The Long Beach Resort, මාතර පාර, කොග්ගල 80000, Sri Lanka
name: The Long Beach Resort

reviews.text:
Avoid this place. Seriously.

Koggala Beach Hotel / Long Beach Resort are basically the same property – and both are an embarrassment. The price they charge is completely disconnected from reality.

The entire hotel feels neglected and decaying. The rooms are dirty, bathrooms are revolting, and the smell in the corridors suggests years of poor maintenance. Mold on the walls, stained surfaces, and drains that regularly bring insects into the room. The showers look like something out of a prison facility.

Cleaning standards are unacceptable. Floors are “mopped” in a way that leaves a greasy film and a sour smell rather than cleanliness. It feels unhygienic, not just old.

Wi-Fi barely works, if at all.

Security is another serious concern. Personal items disappeared from our room during the stay. Whether due to negligence or something worse, the result is the same: you cannot feel safe leaving anything unattended.

The only reason this hotel still operates seems to be large tourist groups delivered by agencies. Without that pipeline, it’s difficult to imagine it surviving on genuine reviews.

There are far better places along the Sri Lankan coast for the same money. Do not waste your time, your comfort, or your trust here.

We stayed at Long Beach Hotel, Koggala, and had a really pleasant experience. The service was good and the staff were friendly. The food was tasty and well prepared. The hotel has two swimming pools, which was a nice bonus.
It’s a calm and quiet place, perfect for relaxing and unwinding. Overall, a great stay and a peaceful location. Would recommend it for anyone looking for a relaxing getaway.

We were very disappointed – this was by far the worst hotel we stayed at during our trip to Sri Lanka.

The shower had almost no water pressure, so taking a proper shower was basically impossible. The service was terrible: at the dinner buffet we weren’t even offered drinks, let alone served any. Later at the bar, we wanted to have a drink but were left waiting forever without being served – even though we were the only guests there.

The website advertises multiple bars and various facilities that simply don’t exist in reality. It also claims there is an à la carte restaurant, but it was closed – and we were there during peak season, not the off-season.

The pool was dirty and not inviting at all. The hotel also claims to have a pool bar – there was none.

What made it even more disappointing is how different the service felt compared to everywhere else we visited. Throughout Sri Lanka we met incredibly kind, warm and welcoming people – but this place was nothing like that at all.

Overall, a complete disaster. We would definitely not recommend this hotel.

I would start with positive feedbacks first... Staff was friendly and relatively inexperienced new staff.. But I saw they were working at their maximum effort to get the hotel running.. And food was tasty even though there were limited options compared to the parelle 4 star hotels... Location was really nice, a wide open large beach even some of 5 star hotels in down South would dream to have..
The negative feedbacks.. This hotel almost looks like a abandoned  hotel from beach side if there were no people... Rooms were extremely worned off, no hot water through out our entire stay.. Seems like management has no interest in renovation this property.. Its a shame.. Having a Such a nice beach and not utilising it.. I wish at least some investor will buy this and turned this in to a great resort.. Otherwise i have no intention to visit back..

I recently stayed at Long Beach Resort, and overall, the experience was average.

Food (⭐☆☆☆☆)
One of the biggest drawbacks was the lack of variety in food options. Meals felt repetitive and didn’t offer many choices, especially for longer stays.

Location (⭐⭐⭐⭐☆)
The location is the highlight of the resort. It’s right by the beach, peaceful, and ideal for relaxing. The surroundings are beautiful and easily accessible.

Hospitality (⭐☆☆☆☆)
Unfortunately, the hospitality was disappointing. Staff interactions lacked warmth and attentiveness, which affected the overall experience.

Overall:
Great location, but the resort needs significant improvement in food variety and service quality. Would recommend only if you prioritize the beach setting over dining and hospitality.

formatted_address: Kathaluwa Thiththagalla Rd, Ahangama 80650, Sri Lanka
name: Waterfront Bar & Grill

reviews.text: Great ambience, food and cocktails. love the extended happy hours with discounts on drinks from 12 noon to 7pm and a nice snack menu as well. A must if in the area.  They have very high quality rooms too.

The restaurant was part of a group tour and was located in a scenic area. The food was delicious and plentiful, and the staff were warm and friendly. The soup tasted like corn chowder without corn. The chicken was flavorful but a bit dry. Drinks were available for an extra charge. The indoor air conditioning was very comfortable, and there was a swimming pool visible from the outside.
A hotel near the sea, with a quiet and elegant environment, a swimming pool and a restaurant, and a limited number of rooms.
In Galle, there are a few air-conditioned indoor dining options where you can dine comfortably, and they also offer the local specialty, red crab.
Good place to eat. Hearty food, polite staff.

We had a truly great weekend at South Beach. The food was delicious, the place itself was beautiful and relaxing, and the service provided by the staff was excellent.
A special thank you to Niroshan and Nethsara for their service. Also, Mr. Jude was extremely friendly and helpful, which made our experience even more pleasant.
Overall, it was a lovely and memorable stay. Highly recommended! 😇

I really enjoyed the food — it was very delicious. I visited with my Australian guests, and they also enjoyed the meal very much. They were happy to experience such tasty and authentic food in Sri Lanka and said it was extremely flavorful and delicious.

The environment is very pleasant and relaxed, a perfect place to enjoy a meal freely. The staff are friendly and welcoming, which made the experience even better.

Anyone looking for good food in the area, I highly recommend Water Front Restaurant.

A Wonderful Stay – Truly Felt Like Home

We absolutely loved our stay at The South Beach Hotel. From the moment we arrived, we felt genuinely welcomed and cared for.

The girls at reception were always smiling and incredibly friendly. Their warmth made every day start beautifully. A special thank you to the Residence Manager, Jude, who truly went the extra mile to help us in every possible way. His attention, professionalism and willingness to assist made a real difference to our experience.

All the staff deserve appreciation — housekeeping, the bar team and everyone working behind the scenes.

And especially Tharindu at breakfast at the Waterfront. He made us feel comfortable and served us with kindness, efficiency and a big smile. At breakfast Hirushan prepared each morning our omelettes. With his big smile and you could see he really wanted to make us feel good.

Today is our last full day and night here, and we leave with wonderful memories. We truly enjoyed every moment of our stay.

We highly recommend The South Beach Hotel to everybody looking for a warm, friendly and relaxing experience in Ahangama. ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Excellent service with a friendly staff. Specially Niroshan and Nipun at the restaurant are very supportive giving their best. The Executive Chef Chamara is very keen to make sure arrangements at the restaurant and foods are at their best. A special mention about Chamuditha, F&B  Executive and Thilan, Front Office Executive, for their attentive approach. The hotel is a calm and serene place. Better for relaxing. I had a good time with my family

Great location with across the road beach access. It can be a great base for visiting all the beaches aroond and Galle forte. Rooms are nice and spacious. House keeping needs a little improvement but that’s it, all other aspects are excellent. Food was amazing. Being Jains we had difficulty in finding jain food elsewhere but here the chef ( Mr Madushan) was more than willing to help us customise and made homely delicious food for us. Pool was clean and train sound from nearby tracks was not at all an issue unless you are a really light sleep person. Kuddos to the team and will highly recommend others to choose this resort

This is the best school with great staff! They help beginners and share their precious experience with surfers who already know something. Obviously, if you want to immerse yourself in the atmosphere of surfing, then you should not lose sight of this place.

Best in business! Most cozy school i ever saw. Good gear, absolutely transparent and clear information on every lesson and it feels like instructor empathizes all the time! Thank you very much for feeling so much safe and fun on shore and in ocean)

Let me tell you friend.  GOOOD STORY is one of the best things that happened to me on the paradise island of Ceylon.  The best vibes.  Friendly staff.  There is all the necessary equipment.  And the most important thing is cool instructors who will teach you how to surf and love it 👌

Good story Surf is an amazing place for spending your dream vacation. Get rest in all the best surf traditions : incredibly hospitable and friendly guys running the hotel and spending time with their guests, really professional surf coaches, nice rooms, and unforgettable atmosphere of Sri Lanka which you will never feel in one of the fashionable hotels that are always alike. I spent 2 weeks there and it was so perfect that I had strong desire to stay there forever which is not typical for me! All in all, choose this place and let your dream vacation started))

Was looking for a good surf teacher/guide around Weligama. I didn't want to deal with local teachers that were just pushing beginners in white water saying "paddle-paddle-popup-areyouOK?"

Good Story have ISA certified instructors who help students in becoming confident surfers, understanding culture and etiquette, knowing history and other useful (or just interesting) things.

Lessons consider student skills and weather conditions, I always felt well-protected even on my first riff spot.

These guys are dedicated and friendly, most of them are Russian speakers.
If you're addicted to longboarding - ask Max Timukhin, who helped me to progress on my first green waves with many relevant advices/corrections.

We stumbled upon Wiener Dschungel by accident, after the other place we went to for lobster was out of lobster! What a great find... Grateful our driver knew the place! The atmosphere is so laid back with great music playing. The owner came and greeted us and spoke with us for about ten minutes. The food was fantastic and the lobster was worth every dollar! He also owns a villa style hotel next door which we might check out the next time we visit.

Only good thing is the location. Food and drinks are quite substandard and there are a lot of better places to choose from. But its location on the beach is its biggest asset. If you’re looking for a spot to just chill and sip on a drink or coffee then it’s a great place.
The food was good, we had tuna and cuttlefish and we can’t fault it. The service was excellent, and we enjoyed the Michael Jackson playlist.

Wiener Dschungel Restaurant offers excellent food and very friendly service. The schnitzels were especially good – perfectly prepared, crispy, and full of flavor.

The atmosphere is relaxed and welcoming, and the staff is attentive without being intrusive. Everything felt well organized, and the quality of the food matched the expectations.

A great place for classic Austrian dishes. Highly recommended!

Lovely spot right on the beach. The food was delicious and the service was great.
So lovely to hear the waves while eating lunch!
Very lovely staff. Beautiful beach. Nice for a morning run. Delicious breakfast.
We waited almost 2hrs for food. Some beers what we got was not chilled. The staff got ingredients from a nearby store. Finally when the foods came, I got rice with only 3 chicken pieces.

I recently had the pleasure of dining at Beach House restaurant and staying at their hotel in Habaraduwa, and it was a delightful experience.

The restaurant offers an array of very good soups that were not only flavorful but also beautifully presented. The menu was diverse, and the quality of the food was evident. The ambiance was serene, with a soothing view of the beach, making it a perfect spot for a relaxing meal.

The hotel, with its clean and original rooms, exceeded my expectations. Each room had a unique and charming design that provided a cozy atmosphere. The best part was the easy access to the private beach, allowing guests to unwind in a peaceful setting.

Came here with my family. Waited over 30 mins for gin and tonics  and just the tonics turned up. Told they didn’t have any gin and would I like rum or wine. Gin turned up 15 mins later.  Food took an hour and a quarter to arrive. The food was awful but by that point it was too late in the evening to go elsewhere.
We still had our main courses on the table when a desert turned up???
The bill also turned up without us asking, clearly wanted to close.  They added a tip, knowing full well the service and food was poor.
What a mistake, will definitely not be returning.

Great budget hotel, next to the beach, the beach for swimming with big waves or surfing… Restaurant with delicious food, breakfast with the room was a great suprise. Nice and helpful staff and owner treats guests as good as friend… highly recommended, 23.1 Dad & son

formatted_address: Lake Pearl Restuarant, Koggala 80630, Sri Lanka
name: Lake Pearl Restuarant And Madolduwa Boat Safari

reviews.text: Gorgeous setting and lovely staff. Really enjoyed our meal, after a short while in Sri Lanka we have realised the portions are huge! So we shared a veg fried rice and a curry, enough to fill 4! Very reasonable prices, would recommend 👍
Very delicious and homey food, I was so surprised no one else was there! Kaveeshaa was very sweet and attentive
The food was amazing and the price was fair.  The service was really good, I asked for a non spicy fish curry and there wasn’t any spice in my food so I was really happy. I recommend !
Hidden gem!! I recommend to everyone to be here

I really enjoyed the place. Great food, cozy atmosphere, friendly staff and amazing service! A top pick for delicious meals in a comfy setting. I would definitely recommend this place and visit it again!
Lord Pavlik was here
Good ❤️❤️👍👌
Excellent service 👌

Rayon car food

Rayon Car Food, located opposite the Koggala Free Trade Zone on the Matara-Colombo road, is open from 6 pm to 9.30 pm.

👉🏻Chicken Drumstick Fried Rice with Chilli Paste.
👉🏻Diet Pack.
👉🏻Chicken Curry with Coconut Roti.
👉🏻Roast Chicken Brazilian.

And you can get other dishes from this car for different days.

The diet pack for fat people instead of heavy meals at night is a very healthy meal prepared with several types of vegetables and an egg.
The food is very tasty because it is home-cooked.

If you are also traveling on the Matara road, you can enjoy roti or rasa from Rayon Car Food at the free beach.

You can also order rice packs for someone around Ahangama Koggala.
Great.Good luck👍
Expensive due to fisherman across the road . That is not correct for a local restaurant along the road in a small village.
Good cuisine, reasonable prices.

A standard local cafe with local flavor.
The food is very edible, the prices are reasonable, and the service is good.

name: Stick Fishermen View Sea Food Restaurant

reviews.text: Hands down the best meal I have whilst visiting Sri Lanka. I cannot recommend the prawn curry and rice enough. Simple and delicious. This place clearly puts tike and thought into their food
Very good restaurant. We came with some tourists. They were happy with the food. Fresh sea food.

This restaurant is outstanding!!
We came here four times whilst staying at the nearby Fortress hotel. Stick’s food is absolutely delicious, brilliant value for money, all run by a delightful family. We love this place!!

We were recommended to dine here and had a great meal. The staff were friendly, even going as far as to bring out the lobster to show us before we ordered. The food was so fresh and the staff even gave our driver a complimentary ginger beer. Would definitely come back.

We came here for light lunch and ordered the seafood platter. It was very flavorful. The dish came with fries and salad we requested for extra fries instead of salad. Our server was Wishwa who was very friendly and told it's his family's business.
Excellent fresh fish cooked over charcoal to order.

formatted_address: Beach Park Restaurant, Koggala, Sri Lanka
name: The Fishers Sunset Bar

reviews.text:
We only found this incredible spot on the day before our last day otherwise we would have been there every day !
The food was absolutely amazing - fresh fish and seafood cooked to perfection with really interesting and fresh flavors. The salad was SUCH a pleasant surprise, very tangy with pineapple, leek, and red onion.
Gorgeous views and beautiful service- I would recommend this as a must to anyone in the area !

We had a wonderful time at this restaurant! We ordered the seafood platter with octopus and shrimp, served with rice and a cabbage salad with pineapple — everything was incredibly flavorful and perfectly seasoned. The price was also more than fair for the quality and portion size.

The service was exceptionally friendly and attentive, and the place was very clean. We spent a really lovely afternoon here, and to top it off, we were even treated to some passionfruit at the end, which was such a sweet gesture.

Very authentic and amazing value for money — we would definitely recommend it to everyone! 😊

This place is fantastic, been dining here four nights in a row. Beautiful view, the staff is lovely and helpful, food and drinks are fresh and tasty, prices are fair. No scam, highly recommend. Hope I can visit again soon.

The location is beautiful and service staff very friendly but I am sorry to say the food was not good. The fried rice was fine but we waited ages for something so simple. Our sodas were all flat and the „grilled“ calamari was not fresh but chewy and cooked in a strange sauce, not bbq. We each had a bite and couldn’t it, it tasted so bad.
The view is nice but it Seems like a tourist trap next to the fisher men…

What a superb lunch and service that we had. Our host was so kind and attentive. Gave ua thw best experience that we could have aksed. And the food, really something special. He showed us fresh fiah and we could choose what we want. And for departure he gave as an ice cream as such a nice sweat surprise. Really recommend to all, this place ia really worth taking a tuk tuk from further ahead. We loved it

Nice place!! had a great experience at this restaurant. Mix rice was absolutely delicious n full of natural flavor and perfectly balanced spices. can really tell it’s prepared fresh without any artificial taste. Highly recommended if you enjoy clean, flavorful food.

Two Waters is an amazing restaurant. I went to this newly opened restaurant to try a mixed rice. The food is delicious without any artificial flavors.
They also have Korean noodles, hot dogs, burgers, etc. Their prices are very reasonable.
I must say that the service is at a very high level and the owner is very friendly to every customer.
Also, this is very attractive because it is located in front of Koggala beach.🏊
I recommend it 100% without any shortcomings.💪

Nice place to stop near Koggala beach.
Simple and clean place with tasty food. We ordered burgers and hot dogs, and they were really good. The milkshakes we ordered were amazing. A perfect place to eat after the beach or while travelling. Parking is available. Will definitely come again.
We stopped here while travelling on the Colombo Matara road.  We tried the Korean ramen  and milkshakes. The food was really good. Friendly service and nice location.

Everything here was honestly 10/10. We tried a few different items , the burger was juicy, the hot dog was perfectly grilled, and the Korean ramen had just the right level of spice. We ended with a thick, delicious milkshake, which was the perfect finish.
Service was super friendly, there was plenty of free parking, and we didn’t have to wait long (around 10 minutes). Overall a great experience . highly recommended
Pulled over at this restaurant while driving past, easy parking & lovely food . Great price's too 👍
Good food, large portions. Finally where the vegetables are perfectly cooked. Nice staff who keep the restaurant tidy. I would recommend this restaurant.
Best meal we’ve had in the week we’ve been here. Don’t judge the book by its cover.
Tasty food nice place nice staff
Sri lankan & chinese food

formatted_address: Koggala, Habaraduwa, Galle 80000, Galle 80630, Sri Lanka
name: ITAMESHI

reviews.text:
The restaurant was advertised to us as a fine dining establishment, so our expectations were quite high.

First, we couldn't even find the restaurant – it's essentially a restaurant within a restaurant, just with a different menu, but okay, why not?

The Italian and Asian offerings were unexpected, but since it wasn't fusion cuisine, again: why not?

I wanted something special, so I wanted to order Japanese, but there was only one vegetarian option for the main course. I asked for a vegetarian version of the ramen, which they kindly provided.

Unfortunately, the result was tasteless and sad to look at. A small, overcooked, limp cabbage leaf with an overcooked, dry egg, the broth bland... The appetizer didn't impress me either. The price-performance ratio is simply not right, and the stars are mainly for the ambiance and service.

The restaurant is simply part of the regular hotel restaurant, just with a different menu. There's no fusion of Italian and Japanese cuisine (which is fine), just Italian and Japanese dishes. But unfortunately, the food didn't have much to do with Japanese food. (You could have guessed that.)

The price/performance ratio isn't right.

Lovely hotel with pool and beach facing restaurant! We visited for lunch and were very happy with the service and the ambience. The food was delicious, especially the pakoras. Chef Khan was kind enough to come and check on us to make sure everything was ok. The price is obviously a bit on the high side being a 5-star restaurant but we felt it was worth it!

An incredibly delicious place; we've never had such incredible tuna anywhere. The price is a bit high, but the gastronomic pleasure, excellent service, and attentive attitude made it worth it. We love not just the food, but the overall atmosphere, cleanliness, aesthetics, and taste, and here we had it all!

formatted_address: Madol Duwa Rd, Ahangama 80650, Sri Lanka
name: Ko Lake

reviews.text:
At Ko Lake Villa, our group of 18 people had a wonderful stay. We are very happy we chose this villa. The rooms are spacious and very tidy, and the staff are exceptionally helpful and friendly, often going above and beyond our expectations.

We also booked the meal preparation service, which was an excellent decision — it saved us time and allowed us to enjoy delicious food right at the villa.

The location is beautiful, with beaches nearby, and the villa’s garden borders the lake. The only downsides were that a few pool tiles were chipped and quite sharp, and the outdoor terrace boards needed replacement. Since we were traveling with small children, we were concerned they might trip and get hurt.

Overall, we are very grateful for our time at Ko Lake Villa. Thank you and good luck!

Our stay was truly wonderful. The property is beautifully maintained, and Amir along with the rest of the staff took excellent care of us. The rooms and bathrooms are incredibly spacious with plenty of charging points, and the pool is spotless. The food was fresh and delicious as well. I’d highly recommend this place to anyone visiting it’s perfectly tucked away from the hustle and bustle of the main city, yet still conveniently close. Ahangama Beach is just a short distance from the property, making the location even better.

Great stay at Ko Lake Villa !
We were a group of 14 friends and had a lovely time. The location is beautiful, the villa was clean and spacious, and the staff were super friendly and flexible. Everything was smooth and comfortable — would definitely recommend!

Very nice property. Amazing rooms, best staff the lake view and walking distance to the beach. Makes this 7 bedroom villa with such a huge pool truly an amazing holiday experience. Will definitely come back. Mr rsj the owner is an amazing host.

My first taste of Ko Lake came on an unforgettable trip where we stayed near the stunning Koggala lakeside.  We rented a super SUV for that adventure, setting off on an upcountry tour that took us through breathtaking central highlands and ended with the wild wonders of Yala and the surf vibes of Ahangama. Yala’s elephants and leopards were a thrill, and Ahangama’s waves were a blast.  During that trip, I also visited Ko Lake House and fell for its charm—the tranquil lake views and cool breeze hooked me.  So, I knew I had to stay there for my second trip, and it was the perfect call.

The second visit was slower-paced, a chance to unwind after an epic celebration in Colombo. Ko Lake House became my sanctuary, just 300 yards from South Beach, and I felt entirely at ease wandering on my own. It’s a haven—the staff live in on-site quarters and were attentive and available whenever I needed them, which made all the difference. It was great having Dewaka as the villa manager, he helped to organise all of our bookings and gave us great local recommendations we never would have found ourselves. The serene lakeside views and cool air were a daily treat, and the spacious, classic rooms stole the show—those incredible four-poster beds with comfy mattresses and AC that actually cools were pure luxury. The silence of the lake was mesmerising, broken only by occasional lightning shows that lit up the sky – a natural spectacle I couldn’t get enough of.

There were national power cuts during my stay, but Ko Lake had a generator that powered up seamlessly, keeping everything running smoothly. The quality of the home-cooked food was a standout – every meal was a delicious, hearty taste of Sri Lanka that left me raving. I loved starting my days with lakeside yoga, that same wonderful silence wrapping around me, and dining poolside felt like a little slice of paradise.

The super-fast internet was fabulous, keeping me connected when I wanted to be, though honestly, I was too busy soaking in the vibe to care much about screens.  Everything felt effortless, whether chilling by the pool or strolling to the beach. Ko Lake House is a gem—highly recommended for couples or family groups looking for a blend of relaxation and easy adventure. I can’t wait to return!
Lovely family-run restaurant. The owners have been very friendly and the food was delicious.

A wonderful place with lovely people❤️ I truly enjoyed my visit to this newly opened family run restaurant. The food was amazing, and the conversations with the family and their friends made the experience even more memorable. For anyone seeking an authentic Sri Lankan food experience, this is a place I would highly recommend!
Delicious food, nice family, good value for money, the water was even for free. Highly recommended!
The food was very delicious, especially the rice and curry. The place is also very lovely, and the service is excellent.😍

Nice local restuarant very quiet welcoming & relaxing. The daughter was so happy to see us walk in as they must not get many customers.
Wait can be a bit long so brace yourself.

formatted_address: Hamalanka nahimi road, kathaluwa, ahangama, Galle 80650, Sri Lanka
name: « У Рукшана» village restaurant

reviews.text: The most delicious food we've had on the island is here! Everything is fresh and delicious. The drinks are top-notch!
It doesn't work!(((

This beach restaurant is an hidden gem between two huge and expensive resorts. The food is fresh, perfectly cooked (the fish in particular) and nicely served by a young and friendly staff. Don’t miss it when you pass by, you will not regret it.
Nice place to relax on a sunbed. Very friendly and helpful staff. We had some fresh juices and lunch. Very delicious food and drinks. Highly recommended as the beach is also quite empty.
Tasty food, yet the fish was a bit raw in the middle..
beautiful beach restaurant with good service and really nice atmosphere. You are sitting directly on the beach. The food was really great!
Delicious food! Nice and relaxing place by the beach. Owners are really nice ! Will be back !

formatted_address: South Beach Resort, Kathaluwa, Poloyamodara Waththa, Ahangama 80650, Sri Lanka
name: The South Beach

reviews.text:
A wonderful beach hotel in a superb location. We truly enjoyed our stay. Special thanks to Mr Rasindu for handling our reservation so efficiently and professionally.

Hats off to the housekeeping team as well. The rooms were spotless, beautifully maintained and very comfortable. We will visit again.
Highly recommended!

This is such a nice place! We are here for the second time now because the first time was really nice. Now it is even better. The rooms are really beautiful, all with sea view and super clean. Also the people working here are very friendly, especially the manager. We recommend this place to everyone who is looking for a quite and relaxing place right at the beach.

I had a wonderful experience at this hotel. The rooms were exceptionally clean, comfortable, and well-maintained. The staff was very friendly, professional, and always ready to assist with a smile.

The location is perfect and convenient, making it easy to access nearby attractions and facilities. The food was delicious with a great variety of options.

Overall, the service exceeded my expectations, and I truly enjoyed my stay. I highly recommend this hotel to anyone looking for comfort, quality, and excellent hospitality. I will definitely visit again!

Amazing stay at South Beach Hotel, Ahangama

South Beach Hotel is a great place to stay. Located right in front of the ocean, the views from the rooms are absolutely breathtaking. Waking up to the sound of the waves was truly special.

The rooms are super clean, spacious, and very well maintained. The entire property is kept in excellent condition, which made our stay very comfortable.

The food was amazing, fresh, flavorful, and beautifully prepared.

What really stood out was the staff. Everyone was incredibly polite, caring, and attentive. A special mention to Jude, the hotel manager, who treated us exceptionally well. He surprised us with complimentary refreshing drinks when we returned from the sun and invited us to the most amazing Christmas dinner, which made our stay even more memorable.

Highly recommended. We would definitely love to come back!

This hotel is nice with a great view of the sea however the morning breakfast was not upto par for the price you pay hence the rating as a 4... we had so e sandwiches on the ala carte menu which were really nice... Staff we very pleasant and helpful

formatted_address: South Beach Surf Resort, Matara Road, Kathaluwa 80650, Sri Lanka
name: Koroburuwa Restaurant and Beach Bar by South Beach Surf Resort

reviews.text: Prawn avocado salad without avocado! Time of waiting 50 min. prawns are ridiculous, like freshly thawed out of the freezer. And that on the Indian Ocean!
What a fantastic place. They have wonderful service, food and drinks and are located right on the beach. It's the perfect place to relax and chill to some great music and vibes
45 min for preparing 1x Sandwich and 1x Salad. We were only 2 customers in restaurant
The so called "bar" ONLY had beer(and soft drinks), nothing else and that's very disappointing.
Wow, nice palce to rest dining
Me and my family came here for lunch. The atmosphere was lovely. its beach front. The food was great as well. The staffs were really kind too. Loved the experience
Nice place to chill but the food was not very good. Pizza was okay. The mussles did not taste good and the salade niçoise was just sad. How can you call that a salad? Would not recommend to eat here.

The pasta is handmade and it is perfect. The best we’ve had in our Sri Lanka holiday. So lucky to stumble into this cafe. It’s worth a visit just for their food.the view is nice, the ambience is nice to chill out and the service is very good. Forgot to take a photo of the pasta but here’s the pizza.
Great coffee with a fantastic view of the surfers at the South Beach surfspot. Also excellent cocktails! Can access the surf beach directly from the cafe. Very friendly staff.

Back again for something new. Had the seafood risotto and it was great! Perfect balance of the risotto, taste was great!
Definitely one of the best so far I had in the country.
Kitchen staff do their utmost best with what they have at their disposal!
Passion always shows on a plate 🍽️

Amazing experience!! The beat for trying typical srilankan breakfast but they have also other variety for everyone. The owner was very welcoming and thoughtful. Perfect waffles and the best view directly to the waves, good music and more than fair prices. Definitely worth visiting!

Such a cute little restaurant! Perfect place to enjoy the sea breeze and lovely views. The food was delicious, and the staff were incredibly welcoming and friendly. Ideal spot to unwind and grab a bite.
The food, location and service was beyond amazing. They were so attentive and kind, and the food was absolutely amazing. Will come back!

Came here after reading the positive reviews and we were not disappointed. The food was amazing, flavours I hadn't come across before and great value. The owner was really helpful in explaining the dishes we ordered and the service was really friendly and efficient couldn't have been made to feel more welcome, highly recommended.

We came here in the evening for dinner and the view over the ocean. Not a lot of food on the menu was in stock (the place is mostly brunch oriented, it seems), so we were considering eating somewhere else. Eventually we decided to get surprised by what they did have in stock. Best decision ever made. Only reason we did not go back for dinner was because we were too far away. We did go back for the iced coffees, which were also sublime.
10/10 would recommend

formatted_address: Matara Rd Dassana, Koggala, Sri Lanka
name: Surf 'n' Turf - Koggala

reviews.text:
We recently visited Surf ‘n’ Turf in Koggala, and it was an excellent experience from start to finish. The food was both delicious and beautifully presented. We ordered the crab and the chicken burger, along with chocolate and vanilla milkshakes everything was full of flavour and perfectly prepared.

The atmosphere was calm and relaxing, and the interior had a beautiful, inviting vibe that made the meal even more enjoyable. The staff were friendly, attentive, and made us feel very welcome.

Overall, Surf ‘n’ Turf is a great spot if you’re looking for tasty food, a peaceful setting, and warm hospitality. Highly recommended! 🌟

Amazing place! Very attentive service, good food. We’ve returned to this place several times during our stay. Food is quickly delivered to the table. Clean tables, smart menu, reasonable prices. Loved this place.

A hidden gem in Habaraduwa/Koggala stretch. Beautifully done up place, very cozy atmosphere I would say. Made us feel very comfortable to dine & chill with friends. Delicious fresh food "non frozen" food served very attractively & very generous portions.
The two brothers who run this cozy & charming restaurant are very friendly and serve everything with a smile.
I would definitely come again!

It’s definitely a secret perl. We chose this restaurant also because of the review, however it overwhelmed our expectations. The food is incredible , fresh and well prepared. I would recommend the seared yellowfin tuna and our other dishes it is absolutely amazing.

one of the best places to eat in Koggala!! we loved it so much we drove their for 2-3 times a week from Talpe

tuna steak portion is huge, jumbo prawns are the biggest ones we saw, and all of this for a very fair price plus without service charge

also the menu is quite wide, they have both seafood and pasta and sandwiches and salads and burgers and all comes in a good portion

workers are very nice and overall recommend to visit!
good food,beautiful atmosphere
Recommend 🙌🤗
This place isn't on the map—we arrived and there it is. There's an avocado tree growing, and there's no cafe.

Tried everything on the menu!
Food is excellent!👌

Mahi Mahi was my favourite dish, but honestly - everything else was also really tasty!
Watch out for the shrimp tacos - the shrimp in mine were NOT cleaned. I expected the shrimp to be cleaned given this is a boutique establishment.

Me and my family came here for dinner. The restaurant is located in a wonderful hotel with very beautiful surroundings and an amazing interior. The food is delicious, the service excellent and there’s such a cosy vibe! Also the staff was so, so kind, we enjoyed our dinner the fullest.
Absolutely the best! So cosy and delicious!
Food was amazing, especially the raw tina dishes and the butter chicken.

🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟 ගමේ තාලෙට රසට කාලා තැඹිලි ගෙඩියක් බොන්න
A Hidden Gem by the Ocean – Must Visit!

Wageesha Tea Room truly exceeded my expectations! The food is clean, delicious, and incredibly affordable — perfect for a quick bite or a relaxing meal. Their breakfast was the highlight: fresh, flavorful, and served with a stunning oceanfront view that makes your morning feel extra special. The place is simple yet charming, and the staff are warm and welcoming. Whether you're a local or a traveler, don’t miss this spot. Highly recommended!

name: HIDDEN Kabalana

reviews.text:
Amazing food, a beautiful place, and a great atmosphere.
Everything is super fresh and incredibly tasty.
There are plenty of options including many great choices for vegetarians.
And you must try their chocolate croissant - it’s absolutely outstanding.

Fantastic dining experience! The food was absolutely delicious, with fresh ingredients. The atmosphere was warm and inviting, and the service was exceptional—friendly and attentive staff made sure we had everything we needed. Great variety on the menu, with options for everyone. Highly recommended for anyone looking to enjoy a great meal in Sri Lanka!”

The dishes were tasty, with good portion sizes. The atmosphere is also nice, and the drinks menu is amazing - but the food variety is quite limited especially for vegans, and the service was extremely slow.
Tuna bowl was a bit tasteless but fish and chips quite unusual vision👌
Food was so good! Especially the avocado toast

Food is SO good, big portions.

I tried every Schnitzel plate on the menu and they were all so amazing I couldn’t pick a favorite.

Although, the star of the show goes to the french toast, I ordered one to share with my partner and regretted it instantly because I wanted it all for myself! 😂

The owners are the nicest as well, overall amazing vibes and service ✨

Went here today for a drink and a Pilates class. The cafe area is nice, staff are all friendly enough. The Pilates class wasn’t bad, probably good for beginners. Not the cheapest of classes. It started late too but the teacher was pleasant
Had such a lovely time at Terra Resort! We did their Ashtanga yoga class, that was amazing, then sat by their pool. The food and drinks were incredible! Would really recommend a visit!

I truly loved my stay. The room was beautiful, spotless, and very comfortable. The facilities are outstanding, with a wide variety of classes available, including yoga and pilates. The owners and staff were incredibly kind, professional, and always ready to help with anything I needed. I will definitely be coming back!

We came for a sushi night and we were amazed at the quality of the food and the service and love we received!
This is not my first time here, but each time I am amazed.
The atmosphere is amazing cozy and friendly!
Guy is a great host that makes sure everything goes smoothly and perfect.
Will come back again!

formatted_address: Koggala Lake Aladuwa Watte, Pelassa, Thittha, Ahangama 80650, Sri Lanka
name: Tri - Ahangama

reviews.text: This might be one of my favorite hotels in the world. This was the highlight of our trip to Sri Lanka. Room was so spacious, lovely and comfortable, with an incredible view. The service was top tier, we were attended to with everything down to the little details. The food was the best culinary experience we’ve had here. (I even asked to learn a dish from the chef who, by the way, is not only talented but also super kind, and was welcomed into the kitchen to learn!!) we took a boat safari with amile & had an awesome, joyous time. The wait staff was incredibly attentive & kind, and I cannot recommend this hotel enough. This is the quiet luxury of our dreams.

We celebrated our first anniversary here and couldn’t have chosen a better place.
The property is extremely peaceful and relaxing. The hosts went out of their way to arrange an eggless cake for us and provided delicious vegetarian food as per our preferences.
Exceptional hospitality—would definitely recommend staying here if you’re visiting Sri Lanka.

Beautiful property! The pool overlooking the lake is warm and refreshing. Definitely insta worthy. Overall the stay was amazing. Well maintained with great staff. Very quiet compared to the busy streets of Ahangama. We stayed in the water tower and it still had amazing sunset views. The villas looked incredible. Perfect place to get away.

Wow!! What a place! We stayed here for 2 nights to have some chills downtime on our journey around Sri Lanka. This is one of the best places I have ever stayed!! The location is stunning, the whole place is an absolute dream if you want to get away from it all and relax for a while. We stayed in one of the villas with a lake view, which was absolutely gorgeous. The staff are lovely, the onsite restaurant is fab, and really reasonably priced considering this is a high end hotel. I can’t recommend Tri Koggala enough, you should definitely stay here!!

TRI is a beautiful hotel, and we will absolutely be returning. The staff were consistently fantastic - very approachable and always happy to chat. The food was outstanding.. we could quite easily have eaten there every evening. Rooms were clean, spacious, and comfortable. A wonderful stay from start to finish
