formatted_address: Matara road, Kabalana Rd, Ahangama 80650, Sri Lanka
name: Thai Charm

reviews.text:
Thai Charm in Sri Lanka is a fantastic place for authentic Thai food.
Everything we tried was very tasty and true to the original Thai flavors, with well balanced seasoning and a clear focus on freshness.
You can really feel that the ingredients are fresh and carefully prepared, and every dish arrives hot and full of flavor.

The service is very good and efficient, and the food arrives quickly without long waiting times.
The staff is friendly, attentive, and makes you feel welcome from the moment you sit down.
It is also worth mentioning that the prices are very reasonable, especially considering the quality of the food and the generous portions.

Overall, Thai Charm offers a great combination of delicious authentic food, balanced flavors, fresh ingredients, fast service, and fair prices.
Highly recommended for anyone craving real Thai cuisine while traveling in Sri Lanka.

THE BEST THAI food ever. Please try we tried the Tom yum with white rice spring rolls satay chicken green curry chicken! Trust me it’s amazing as most often I am very picky about Thai food, plus the green tea was a suprise one of a kind dark green tea, comes with a side of milk and suger! I was afraid but wow amazing! I would like to have it every morning! It was a new discovery!!!!!

Lovely place with delicious Tom yum. We ate there several times during our stay and each time it was delicious. Stuff is nice and helpful. Tom yum, Tom kha, spring rolls and mango sticky rice are the best, we tried these in other places around the southern area and this diner offered the most authentic taste of Thai.

Genuinely some of the best thai food ive had. Was not expecting to get such authentic flavours, and less expected dishes and greens! We had the labb salad which was incredibly fragrant, tom yum noodle soup, penang and mango sticky rice. Couldn’t fault it.

Food was so delicious and service was quick! Would definitely return!!

Got the pad Thai, chicken cashew, egg fried rice, chicken satay and the mango coconut rice (AMAZING)!!

Fantastic place! The food is amazing and the staff and owner are so friendly and welcoming ☺️
We'd quite often bring our laptops with us to get some work done and just hang out eating great food and chatting! 10/10 recommend!

Outstanding food and unbelievable hospitality. Ravi is a lovely man who helped us so much with tips about travelling in Sri Lanka. Super kind man and fantastic food. I had the Chicken bowl about a million times I loved it so much.
The environment was very cozy, but all they had for food was rice bowls from the entire menu.

We were for a late small dinner and some drinks. We had the chicken pizza, which was amazing! Also the cocktails were very nice. The gin fizz was delicious! The staff is so friendly, we came back the next morning for some coffee and juice!

We booked Casa Tikiri as our luxury spot at the end of our two week trip to Sri Lanka after reading the good reviews. While we had a lovely time, it didn’t fully reach our expectations.

For this price point, we expected perfection, but we experienced a few issues with the service which should be addressed.

The best compliment I can give is the interior design, we stayed in the most high end room (Deka) and the design was beautiful, bed was comfy and the outdoor shower was fantastic. Only negative I can give on the room is the sharp corners of the bed were a hazard. I walked into it once and it broke skin and left me with a nasty bruise. This can easily be filed down.

The same can be said for the communal areas, the pool and outdoor area in general was a great place to chill out and relax. Although, even with so few rooms, we did run into issues with other guests reserving sunbeds before breakfast with their towels and barely using them. Some of these guests were checking out that day too. This felt very selfish and typical of European resorts so we think banning this could easily be implemented so the sunbeds can be used on a first come-first serve basis.

The breakfast was fantastic and one of the best we had in Sri Lanka. However, I wish I could say the same about the lunch/dinner menu. On our first evening, we elected to eat at the hotel and felt a bit ripped off. It ended up being one of our most expensive meals of the trip but the portions were so small we were still hungry after. Other guests definitely got the same idea and chose to eat out every other evening because the restaurant was always quiet.

As I said earlier, we were expecting top tier service given the price but we experienced multiple problems with it. The main manager was lovely when around but the other staff members felt especially cold and not talkative which didn’t make us feel welcome. My companion went to the Paddy lodge for a class one morning and the staff said they’d pick her up after in the tuk tuk, but they didn’t show up. It’s only a 7 minute walk so wasn’t a huge issue but it’s an example of a false promise.

The most frustrating example was during check out. When our taxi arrived, none of the staff came to open the gate and assist with our bags, despite one of the owners being in the shop and doing nothing to help. Important to note that the owners hadn’t introduced themselves to us once during our 3 night stay, and we only realised that was the owner upon looking at the website after. This left a bad taste in our mouth at the end of our stay.

Overall, Casa Tikiri is an absolutely beautiful place to chill out at the end of your trip. It has so much potential, but improvements need to be made with the service. We were blown away by the service we received at more affordable accommodations in Sri Lanka and this was the only one that disappointed, which is telling for the most expensive hotel of the trip. Also it would be great to stop letting guests reserve sunbeds, increase the lunch/dinner portions (or drop prices) and maybe more guests will stay for dinner.

Casa Tikiri is one of a kind. I was so much looking forward to my stay here and it’s been the highlight of my Sri Lanka trip. They exceeded my expectations. It’s an absolute gem for design lovers - everything is built with so much love and a delicate eye for details. I stayed in Room 7 (Hatha) which has an outdoor bathroom and the cutest pink bed where I slept like a stone. A free tuktuk brings you from the hotel to paddy lodge where I enjoyed a very good yoga and Pilates session. It’s in the middle of the rice fields - super peaceful! The staff was amazing as well - everyone is really friendly and takes good care of you. The owners Alice and Stefano are always around and are very kind and welcoming always trying to fulfil any kind of wishes. I am truly grateful for this special experience I will never forget. Thank you for sharing your beautiful home with me! I hope to come back one day.

We absolutely loved everything about Casa Tikiri. Whilst we stayed in the nearby Paddy Lodge, we spent a lot of wonderful time in the boutique hotel, relaxing time by the pool, for breakfast and also dinner one evening (highly recommend, they have an Italian chef and amazing dishes). The attention to detail in the rooms and the comfort is one of the best we have encountered during our extended trip throughout Sri Lanka.

We will definitely return and won’t hesitate to recommend Casa Tikiri to our friends.

We stayed three nights with my girlfriend and absolutely loved it.

Stefano and Alice are the best hosts one can hope for. The care and attention they poured into this project is evident in every aspect of the stay from the well-designed accommodation through the impeccable service of the staff up to the tasty f&b experience.

Casa Tikiri has the warmth of a home with the comfort and attention of a boutique hotel. It is an oasis of fine taste and relaxation.

Keep up the great work - we will definitely return with enthusiasm.

The hotel is absolutely beautiful, and the food was excellent. The setting is lovely and clearly well maintained.

Unfortunately, the overall service and communication were not smooth at all, especially considering the price. When we arrived to check in after leaving our luggage earlier, the staff seemed confused and repeatedly asked for our room number, which we obviously did not have yet. This set the tone for the stay.

Throughout our visit, most interactions felt difficult and awkward, with frequent misunderstandings. Even very simple requests did not feel natural: for example, asking for a tea during dinner felt as if we were requesting something unusual or complicated.
The service was very minimal and not proactive. Basic things, such as offering water or assistance, were never anticipated.

Although the owners were present, they never came to greet us, which felt disappointing for a hotel of this standard.

At check-out, no one offered to help with our luggage despite the heat, and once again the interaction felt unnecessarily confusing.

A beautiful hotel with great food, but a lack of fluidity and hospitality that clearly impacted the experience.

They are so Nice!!! They come to deliver the food at your house. We order a fish curry, it was really good, not too spicy. Good local food. So kind that you can only feel is family cooking for you!!! Amazing value for money.
Delicious home made Sri Lankan food made by a great chef. Super tasty fried fish, pork curry, dhal fry and amberella chutney. Will eat here again.
Sepalika cooks the best food, I love her coconut roti’s with Dahl curry 🥰 my favourite local place!
One of the best Kottu ever tried during my trip in SL. Hosts are nice and enjoyable.
Best local food!

formatted_address: Galagawage watta Katukurundage watta Kataluwa Ahangama, X8RX+G6M, Ahangama, Sri Lanka
name: Sushi Town

reviews.text: This was simply one of the best sushi experiences me and my gf have had in our travels. The place is very hard to find and still under construction, the road is rough and small, but our order was to go and most orders are to go or delivered. I have to say my gf and I were frustrated from trying to find the place and all, but when we got there we were greeted very warmly and the prices seemed very low compared to the usual sushi places. We ordered about Rs. 14000/= worth of our favorite sushi which came to about 40 pieces total! The taste I must say exceeded our expectations through the roof. It was amazingly delicious. Great portions, great price, great service, quick and fast, and amazing taste. If you in and around ahangama or even further away, this should be your go to sushi spot.

Excellent rolls, large portions, really liked the Philadelphia and baked ones! Fast delivery. I took a photo when we were almost all finished.
I'll be ordering again and recommending them to everyone.

Horrible rolls and soup. Tuna roll was tasteless! Baked tuna rolls were okay. But the kimchi soup, the ly brought something between miso soup and soy sauce, literally. Either they mixed my order or their kimchi soup does not have kimchi and has miso paste instead. Over salted over sauced , iick

AMAZING!!!!! Had the miso soup with salmon for my starter....perfection! then moved onto some incredibly delicious sushi rolls! Service was quick and attentive, prices are very reasonable considering high quality ingredients are hard to source on the island. You can choose to sit indoors and outdoors, the indoor seating area is very well air conditioned...much needed when trying to escape the heat from the street. My only problem is that I now want to eat there every day :)

Don’t eat here - it’s not a restaurant it’s a kitchen in a building site.

I came to collect the food and saw them defrosting prawns in water to put straight into the sushi rolls.

Order at your own risk, try find the restaurant if you like it’s in the middle of nowhere.

name: CASA TIKIRI - Italian Dinner Restaurant | Adults-Only

reviews.text:
The atmosphere is beautiful, very chic and calm. Service is great and very fast and friendly.
The food was awesome too, but unfortunately, the portions are relatively small. We had starter and a pasta dish each and were still hungry after we left. The prices are fairly high, therefore bigger portions would be great. Would still recommend this place but keep the smaller portions in mind!

A true taste of Italy in Sri Lanka, with a delightful hint of the island’s vibrant spice. The Italian chef brings authenticity and passion to every dish, including thoughtful vegetarian options. The roasted pumpkin with ricotta was absolutely delicious😋😋The environment is elegant and carefully designed, and the service by the staff is especially kind and attentive. Highly recommended

Amazing place! You can eat in a garden next to the pool and enjoy amazing Italian food with a twist of Sri Lankan spices.

Chef Tito knows what he is doing and you will not be disappointed if you want to treat yourself with a nice dinner.

Highly recommended!

We had a wonderful experience at the restaurant of Casa Tikiri. The setting is incredibly peaceful, surrounded by beautiful nature, with stunning design details in absolutely every corner.

Chef Maurizio creates truly delicious dishes. Combined with the warm and friendly service, it’s a perfect place to relax and enjoy an exceptional meal. Highly recommended, and we will definitely be back again

A place that exceeded all expectations.
Casa Tikiri was one of the most special experiences of our trip to Sri Lanka. As soon as we arrived, we sensed a unique atmosphere: the setting is meticulously designed, elegant yet never overbearing, and full of warmth. It's one of those places where you immediately feel at home, yet with all the attention to detail of a high-end boutique hotel.

The restaurant deserves a special mention: the dishes are prepared with fresh ingredients and a surprising balance of local flavors and Mediterranean influences. From the homemade pasta to the fish, everything was impeccable, tastefully presented with rare attention to detail. You can sense the passion and love for cooking behind every dish.

The staff is extraordinary: professional, kind, and always smiling, they manage to create a family-like yet refined atmosphere. Every detail of the service is taken care of—from the welcome to the menu recommendations—and this truly makes the difference.

The outdoor spaces are enchanting: a tropical garden, a beautiful pool, and evening lighting that makes everything even more magical. It's the perfect place to relax, unwind, and enjoy moments of pure tranquility.

Casa Tikiri is much more than a restaurant or a hotel: it's an experience that lasts.
We'll definitely return, with a smile and a desire to relive every moment.

Rating 10/10 — absolutely recommended

formatted_address: X8HW+P58, Matara Road, Kabalana, Ahangama, ගාල්ල, Ahangama 80650, Sri Lanka
name: Fishy Fishy

reviews.text: We really enjoyed our night at Fishy Fishy! The communal table experience helped us meet some great new people and the food and drinks were all absolutely delicious. The fish was perfect, and I especially enjoyed the salsa verde. Plus it was a treat to have a really tasty glass of wine! My only quibble is that with food of this quality I was disappointed that the water served to drink came in a single use plastic bottle (and only one round of water was provided).
This place is absolutely wonderful. We met many new friends, the specialty tea cocktail was outstanding, the ambiance, the fresh food. It was perfect in every way ….
We had a wonderful evening at fishy fishy. I can only recommend it. Both the fish and the side dishes were excellent.

Phenomenal! My friends and I shared an incredible feast, with a table of other wonderful people.
Having lived here for a while, I’ve been craving good sea food. This is some of the best fish I’ve ever eaten. And to be hosted in such a way, only added to the entire experience.
We all left happy and full. I cannot wait to come back.
Thank you for as very special evening.

Great experience in the South. Finally someone does honest and true food with locally sourced fish. If you like fresh fish in a barbecue this is where you need to go. Cooked to perfection with generous amount of sides. Don’t expect the fancy set up but the authentic and produce focused dinner.
Their wine options are also exceptional, you won’t find them in the regular wine stores and expect to find are very passionate host that will also share with you their experience in the country.
Thank you Aiofe & Julien! Can’t wait to be back!

formatted_address: Matara Road, Kabalana, Ahangama, X8HW+P58, ගාල්ල, Sri Lanka
name: Lean@83

reviews.text: Disappointing. I never leave negative reviews but just want to give people the heads up. We came here in the evening and the meal was very underwhelming. We had the chicken curry where the rice was cold, and the onion and tomato’s weren’t cooked at all. They also forgot his drink and just the overall service didn’t wow us. Maybe it’s nicer during the day, but wouldn’t recommend coming in the evening
Locally-owned restaurant with a great seafront view. We had a delicious buffet lunch - Sri Lankan claypot curry and rice - and it was very reasonably priced
Had a great dinner with Sri Lankan curries and rice. Definitely my top meal in southern Sri lanka. Super friendly staff, who were extremely kind .

One of the best rice and curries we had - the jackfruit and the pumpkin was especially tasty!

Insane prices. Don’t forget to tip them on top of the bill.
It's a nice cafe with a great view. Lots of seats. The menu does not say about 10% interest for the service.

100% 5* reviews from 46 separate reviewers is quite the achievement; but after 3x breakfasts and a cooking class with Nilma at Cafe Green, we can confidently say this record undersells how amazing this place is.

Her breakfasts are a perfect representation of traditional Sri Lankan fare - a fantastic mix of savoury and sweets, all very reasonably priced.

The cooking class was a wonderful few hours learning from the master herself. Nilma was warm, incredibly knowledgeable, and an efficient teacher, teaching us how to cook 6 separate dishes alongside rice in the space of a few hours. It was wonderful being able to use ingredients plucked fresh from her garden. The ensuing feast was one of the best meals we had in our time in Sri Lanka.

If you find yourself in Ahangama at any point make sure you do not miss out a visit!

Went to visit Nilmas cooking class. She is so sweet and runs the place. She is an amazing chef and held a great cooking class for us four visiting. Cafe is in their garden where she grows some of spices used. It was the best Sri Lankan authentic rice and curry we’ve had after visiting Sri Lanka for 5 weeks in total! Wonderful experience. Definitely coming back to try her breakfast and lunch!

Nilma is a very kind and talented lady. At her cooking workshop, we made incredibly delicious rice and curry. The shared cooking experience had a wonderful atmosphere, and we learned many interesting things. We also had breakfast at her place, which was none other than the Egg Hopper.
I warmly recommend this place to anyone who is curious about the local culture and gastronomy.

Nilma is a true magican in the kitchen. She makes everything taste amazing. We've tasted a lot of good sri lankan food on our trip but hers is by far the best. We enjoyed breakfast and lunch so much that we took the cooking class with her and she did not disappoint. She cooked up a feast showing us how to prepare her amazing spicy chicken curry with lots of delicious vegetable and side dishes as well. Food heaven!! She is also a very kind and fun person to be around. Thank you so much!

The kindest and sweetest staff I’ve met! They have a big family dog who acts like a puppy and we always play with him while waiting for our favorite breakfast. I recommend you try egg hoppers and coconut pancakes because they’re absolutely amazing. This is a place that cares about the cleanliness of the kitchen, has a beautiful backyard which feels like home and they make your food very tasty. It’s also very cheap! We love this place and go almost every day to grab some breakfast 🍀

formatted_address: X8R8+MCC ආසියානු මහාමාර්ගය 43, Koggala, Sri Lanka
name: Catalina Grill Restaurant

reviews.text: Complete heart break if you step on this place expecting the quick services, military hospitality, polite mannerisms and ready to serve staff. Everything you find here is mediocre EXCEPT the view. The white sandy beach and endless blue sea is a treat to the eye while you wait for your "just OK" meal. Children definitely enjoy the plane, trains & ample space to play in the ground as well as around the mangroves. The prices  & portion sizes are reasonable. The staff only visit your table with a menu when they feel like it. Otherwise you have to go to the cashier to order the meals & pay the bill.

I recently ate at Air Force Koggala Restaurant and unfortunately had a very disappointing experience. The food quality was poor and did not meet expectations at all. The taste, freshness, and overall preparation were not satisfactory. I hope the management takes customer feedback seriously and improves the food standards.

This restaurant manage by Srilanka airforce.good service providing the staff and they are friendly.better location to take rest with sea wind.same time can see five way point.food quality is average and prices are average level.im not satisfied with fresh juice and it consist more water only.large parking space.main benefit is you can get on the aircraft which locate in this place. Ticket price 50 rupees and it is nice and rear experience.there are large beach located back side and you can go there and possible to take nice pictures .

While the surrounding restaurants are selling local rice and curry in dollars, Sri Lanka airforce restaurant came in to our rescue.  Beach front restaurant with good local food, local beer and milkshakes all reasonably priced.
simple tasty meals for good price, clean place, nice plane, cool beach, thanks :)

formatted_address: 38, Kabalana Road, Kathaluwa Thiththagalla Rd, Ahangama 80650, Sri Lanka
name: LankanTaste Boutique & Restaurant

reviews.text: Just go here! We had a delicious chicken curry and veggie kottu, it was amazing freshly cooked food and plentiful! The curry would have been enough for us both really! It comes with 4 different curries and lots of rice. It was the most delicious curry we had in Sri Lanka! Lovely setting and service. Highly highly reccomended going here for dinner! It was so reasonably priced much much better and authentic than the touristy places! Thank you very much.

Hidden gem in Kabalana! Walked past this place earlier so decided to check it out. The menu is very good with lots of options for breakfast, lunch and dinner! I got the daal with paratha which was nice with a cinnamon tea. The garden is super peaceful and beautifully done. In the evening it is all lit up! It’s tucked away from the busy road so it’s a relaxed, lowkey atmosphere. The family who own it were super welcoming and friendly!  Everything is so reasonably priced! Will be back again!
LankanTaste is a great restaurant! The food is super tasty and the menu offers lots of different dishes. The personnel is very kind and the atmosphere is cosy and authentic!
Good food, big plates.. i couldnt finish mine, people is so kind. Chill place perfect to enjoy a good meal
Best Dahl we’ve eating in Sri Lanka so far! Lovely restaurant and personnel!

formatted_address: X8JW+QW4, Kabalana Rd, Ahangama 80650, Sri Lanka
name: Jini Hut Restaurant

reviews.text: Very good family restaurant and beautiful place. Good taste.
Perfect calm place, perfect food 😎
Instead of the promised 20-minute wait, the first course was brought after 45 minutes, although they were told that we were in a hurry. The food was average, and so was the atmosphere.

name: Green Jack Restaurant

reviews.text: Delicious food....and service
Really cute place, room was really good. Peaceful but center placed ! Welcomed super well, good wifi.

Thank you for the wonderful service and we had a comfortable stay. We would highly recommend The Garden House to anyone who is looking for a safe, comfortable stay with a friendly service in a calm environment. Thank you for the homely treat and we will be back...
The fruit juices are absolutely delicious and so refreshing. The owners are very welcoming, friendly, and attentive.
So goooood mango juice! Friendly people and beautiful garden to chill in the shade! :)
Soso good  food

Pretty good local curry buffet at a good price and really nice family. The curry’s tend to change day to day which is nice. The pumpkin curry is great and the okra. Definitely worth a visit if you’re close. Only reason it’s not 5 star as sometimes there’s not enough in the pots so when there’s a few people you end up with small portions. Understand it’s just opened and it’s not too busy but more would be great!
A friendly, kind family run restaurant. Nice decoration. Best curry we've had in Sri Lanka, lots of tasty bits and nice vibe.
Beautiful local place with amazing local food!
Super nice local restaurant, small but nice. Very friendly family that offers one of the best rice and curries at very fair prices. I can highly recommend a visit

Really underwhelming ordered chicken curry, vegetable curry  buffet and deviled chicken. Chicken curry was watery, deviled chicken had undercooked vegetables and veg curry buffet had few options considering it was a buffet and it was bland. Definitely my least favorite meal in sri lanka. Gave two stars because the family seem sweet.

formatted_address: Muwamulla watta, Kataluwa, Kabalana Rd, Ahangama 80650, Sri Lanka
name: Teya Beach Hotel & Restaurant, Ahangama

reviews.text:
We had such a memorable stay here. We came to celebrate my wife’s birthday, and it was truly special.
Before our arrival, I contacted Mr. Shanker, and he arranged everything perfectly. The birthday surprise was beautiful and well organized. It made my wife so happy and created unforgettable memories for us.
A big thank you to the Housekeeping department for the lovely room decoration — it was done with great care and attention to detail.
The food was also amazing, and we really enjoyed every meal during our stay.
Thank you so much to the entire team for making this celebration so special. Highly recommended!

We had a wonderful experience at this hotel. The room was very clean, comfortable, and well maintained. The entire property was neat and relaxing.
A special thanks to Shanker for his outstanding hospitality. He always takes great care of the guests and is available anytime we need help — even early in the morning. He is a very kind, helpful, and valuable person who truly makes guests feel welcome and comfortable.
The place itself is beautiful, with a nice swimming pool where we really enjoyed our time. The food was amazing — compliments to the chef for the delicious meals!
The location is perfect. The beach is only 150 meters away, and restaurants, bars, and the city center are all very close.
We originally came for 2 nights, but because we loved it so much, we decided to extend our stay to 7 days.
It’s a perfect place for a vacation. Highly recommended!

Our stay at Teya was wonderful. The rooms were clean, comfortable, and cozy. The staff - especially Shanker, were very responsive and helpful and went above and beyond to make sure we had a pleasant stay. The food was excellent as well —fresh, tasty, and a lovely addition. The location was great, and the availability of scooters to rent also made it easy to get around.

Wonderful place good location - close to the beach but quiet! The hotela on the beach are noisy.
Nice and clean rooms.
Shanker and the team always ask if need something and help in any problem.
Very good breakfast.
10/10 value for money.

We had a very nice stay at Teya beach hotel. The owner really made the place. Pool was nice and clean and the Hotelrooms are clean. Food was really tasty. Location was good, walking distance to beach and padel court. Some feedback: sometimes the food took a bit longer, and a drink was forgotten. Other than that, it was very delicious and a great stay.

We had a fantastic dinner at YAYA. The atmosphere was great, and we truly enjoyed the whole evening.

The deviled fish was absolutely delicious — perfectly cooked, full of flavor, and nicely balanced with spices. One of the best we’ve had!

We would definitely come back for another dinner. Highly recommended!

We went here many times and always had a good time. The food always tasted great, the deserts and sweet breakfast options are amazing, and the coffee and other drinks were fantastic. Of course, the service was excellent and the staff are very friendly. Bhawantha, our server for many visits, was especially friendly and accommodating. The atmosphere is very chill, with tables, bars, couches, and lounges. We’ll be going again.
I will definitely come back! :) food is great, staff is very friendly & I loved the vibe since it’s quite chill, not like most cafes in Ahangama. So big recommendation!

I visited the Yaya Restaurant twice, and both times the food was outstanding – fresh, flavorful and beautifully prepared. The service was consistently very friendly and attentive. The restaurant itself is beautifully designed, creating a lovely atmosphere. I especially recommend sitting upstairs, where you can enjoy a wonderful view of the jungle. Definitely worth a visit!
Super good baguette and a big portion. For the juice I order a mix juice of paissonfruit and mango, such an amazing combo!

formatted_address: Gulugaha juntion, Kabalana Rd, Ahangama 80650, Sri Lanka
name: La Cata Restaurant

reviews.text: I took a cooking class here and it was such an amazing experience. Chef Kumari was incredibly sweet and welcoming, and I really enjoyed making curry together. I learned the basics in a fun and relaxed way, and the whole experience felt very authentic. Thank you again 🫶

Everything we tried was incredibly delicious, fresh, and full of flavor. The service was fantastic.
This lovely Sri Lankan family runs the place with so much love, and you can truly feel it in both the food and the atmosphere. Highly recommend to everyone a real gem that you shouldn’t miss!

One of the best meals I’ve had in Sri Lanka. Simple, honest food full of flavour. The curry was incredible!! rich, well-balanced, and clearly cooked with care. Really good local food made properly.

Relaxed atmosphere, and very kind people. This is the kind of place you come back to because it feels real. Highly recommend if you want an authentic meal done right.
Hidden gem if you want real local food. We came here by suggestion and food was excellent. Quiet and cozy place. We tried the rice and curry + chicken and fried rice.
Amazing food and beautiful staff. Must try if you want some authentic Sri Lankan food

formatted_address: X8JP+VQ7, Matara Rd, Ahangama 80650, Sri Lanka
name: Sunset Beach

reviews.text: Stayed here for 2 nights. Hotel rooms were lovely and well cleaned every day, with great views of the ocean. The food at the hotel was delicious with huge portions!

Feedback on a Wedding Function at South Lake Resort

Dear Ownership,

I hope this message finds you well. I am writing to provide feedback on a recent wedding function (29-02-2024) that was held at your esteemed venue. While I appreciate the effort put into ensuring timely meal service during the event, I feel compelled to address other concerns that impacted our overall experience.

Firstly, I must acknowledge the promptness with which the meals were served during the function. However, despite this aspect running smoothly, there were notable issues in other areas that detracted from our enjoyment of the occasion.

One significant concern was the lack of support and responsiveness from the hotel duty manager when issues were raised. Despite attempts to address the concerns encountered during the event, there was a noticeable absence of proactive efforts to resolve them in a satisfactory manner. It is possible that the service given by the manager would have been much better if the event planners were organized from his end?

It is important to note that while the meal service was satisfactory, it is only one aspect of the overall guest experience. The success of such events relies on the seamless coordination of various elements, including service quality, attentiveness, and guest satisfaction.

I kindly request that you review the feedback provided and take necessary steps to address the concerns raised. As patrons of South Lake Resort, we value the reputation and standards upheld by your establishment and hope to see improvements in areas where there is room for enhancement.

Thank you for your attention to this matter. I look forward to hearing from you regarding the actions that will be taken to address these concerns and ensure a more satisfactory experience for future events of another party.

We spent 5 hours for a group lunch at the cafeteria buffet lunch. Location is nice and attractive, staff are friendly except black suited Supervisor. They did not disclosed the Lunch menu until we presented  there. Only about 8 items were provided in main menu for us . Although there are plenty of local fish, they provided only some batters fish peaces.  My experience with Other places le Grand , Marino hotel and Gall face hotels , south Ahangame buffet meal was very poor and limited supply.
Also I noted AC s turned off time to time , seems to be a power saving effort
Stayed 3 nights in South Lake Resort so used the Sunset Beach twice.  Nice views, decent loungers and a good coffee the first day.  No electricity second day, so no food or hot drinks 😕

It was a soo lovely calm and simple place to relax, recommend to every one who is busy..my first long weekend in 2025 was spent there with a very caring staff, it was a very good start to all of us 😊 you can have tasty meals too, and enjoy the beach and the koggala river both at once, and a very good pool to enjoy with small babies..

We've been to this restaurant for 3 days; the prices are reasonable and the seafood is fresh. We were apprehensive the first time, but after trying the food, we were pleasantly surprised. It's a bit wild, but at least it's right by the ocean.

formatted_address: X8JV+HFR, Weli Para, Ahangama, Sri Lanka
name: “Shambala” local family cafe

reviews.text:
Nuga house has been our home away from home for the past 3 weeks. The rooms and surroundings are everything you need.

The staff are amazing and have made the experience even more special. They work so incredibly hard to keep the place clean, to feed us incredible food and do so with a smile on their face.

Location is great, 5 mins tuk tuk from shops and 5 mins walk to closest beach. Great coffee, great food, great people.

Nuse and the rest of the team thank you so much! Xxx

We just had the best time at Nuga House. Staff was super friendly, food and drinks were also amazing. Neus the manager helped us with sorting out a scooter and Kumar the night guard was also super sweet. we‘d definitely come again.

I was here for 12 days - and it was amazing! I wanted to do 12 days Yoga in a row and thought this is the best place. For me - it was :-) everything's very professional and all are very friendly. The Yoga sessions (with Itzie, Ana and all the other professional teachers) have been amazing too. I will miss this place for sure.

I stayed at Nuga House for two weeks with two friends, and we really enjoyed our time there. The service was great, the atmosphere was chill and welcoming, and the food was consistently good. Neus was especially helpful and shared lots of useful tips.

I spent three weeks at Nuga House with my husband for a Yoga Teacher Training. We always felt wellcome and our requests would be answered as soon as possible. We‘d definitely come back to stay at Nuga House. Maybe for some more surf?! Thank you all Nuga House team!

formatted_address: DENIYAWATTA, Kabalana Rd, Ahangama 80650, Sri Lanka
name: CASA TIKIRI - PADDY LODGE Adults-Only

reviews.text:
Can’t say enough good words about Casa Tikiri! We were lucky enough to spend days in both their properties (located only a few hundred meters away from each other) and both had their own unique atmosphere. But that absolute quietness and paddy view from the room… unbeatable. In the morning, opening the windows, enjoying all the birds, seeing why monkeys and peacocks! And then, the interior design, i am taking this as inspiration for our own home 😂♥️

Both properties are located on a walkable road, away from the busy main road. 🙌

We cannot wait to return the Casa Tikiri in the future!

Also try their restaurant, the Italian pastas were the best we had in our 3 weeks in Sri Lanka!

We had an absolutely wonderful stay at Casa Tikiri Paddy Lodge and are incredibly happy that we chose to book this unique place. Our room at the Paddy Lodge was truly one of a kind. I honestly don’t think I have ever experienced such a breathtaking view over the rice fields from a hotel room — it was simply incredible.

The bed, placed beautifully in the middle of the room, was extremely comfortable, and waking up with the sunrise each morning was magical. At night, the natural jungle soundscape created such a peaceful atmosphere. We rarely sleep this well while traveling. The entire room design was stunning, including the gorgeous bathroom and the private little pool on the lower floor. Everything was clean and clearly designed with so much love and attention to detail. It truly felt grand and very special.

We also really appreciated how pleasantly quiet the location is. The Paddy Lodge is only about five minutes by tuk-tuk or scooter from the beach and the main street in Ahangama, which gave us the perfect balance between tranquility and accessibility.

Another great advantage was the possibility to use the Casa Tikiri Boutique Hotel, located about 500 meters away. It was easy to walk there, and there is also a tuk-tuk shuttle available. We loved that breakfast could be enjoyed either at the Paddy Lodge café or at the restaurant in the boutique hotel. Both offered very high-quality and delicious options.

The staff were friendly, attentive, and always happy to help, whether arranging a tuk-tuk or assisting with scooter rental. The entire Casa Tikiri property felt exceptional, like a small oasis, almost surreal at times.

Another highlight was the beautiful rooftop yoga shala, where daily yoga and Pilates sessions were offered (for 3000 LKR, which is fair). This added up to the overall positive experience.

A beautifully designed hotel with exceptional attention to detail. Everything is spotless, carefully curated, and finished to the highest standard.

The owners are incredibly helpful. They supported us not only with transfers but also with medical assistance when needed, which truly made a difference.

The location is absolutely breathtaking. Stunning views over rice fields, surrounded by nature, peaceful and inspiring. Truly one of the most unique places I’ve ever stayed in and absolutely worth a visit.

Wonderful stay next to the paddy fields overlooking cows and peacocks! Our loft had a spacious living room, we woke up with the sunrise, and started each day with a beautiful yoga session on the shala. Such a special time , thank you to the lovely team for your kindness!

An incredibly beautiful and tranquil stay at Casa Tikiri’s new hotel. Coming back for the second year in a row and once again blown away. The room design is impeccable and very big with a stunning view on the rice paddy, the facilities are excellent, and the service is attentive. Breakfast was outstanding! Everything about this place feels calm, refined, and thoughtfully done ✨

We rented the whole 3br villa and had a wonderful stay!

A special thank you to Bathma, who was absolutely lovely. He brought us breakfasts every morning, always asked whether we need something, helped with everything. He was very caring and attentive, which made our stay feel extra comfortable ☺️

The villa itself is spotless, with no issues with insects, and the pool area is amazing – we spent a lot of time there and really enjoyed it.

A few things to keep in mind before booking:
- There is no proper kitchen. It’s very small and outdoor, so cooking is basically not possible (insects tend to gather quite quickly). There is a stove, but no microwave and no proper fridge, only a small wine cooler. We stored our food there and it was totally fine for basic needs. The good part is that there is a microwave in the main kitchen, and you can always ask the staff to heat something up for you, they’re happy to help.
- There is no shared living room – it’s more like three bedrooms with direct access to the pool. We didn’t expect this setup, so it’s just something to be aware of in advance.
- The Wi-Fi is very poor. Unfortunately, it’s not suitable for working at all. So be ready to use your hotspot🤪

The location is excellent: about an 8–10 minute walk to Kabalana Beach, which was almost always empty compared to other beaches we visited. It was very comfortable for swimming with kids. There are also many restaurants within walking distance.

Overall, we really loved this place, had great memories here, and would definitely recommend it!

Stop scrolling and book Mana!

Such a beautiful property which has been well thought out. The staff are super helpful and booked Tuk Tuks, restaurants and a driver to the airport for us. Huge shout out the Bathma and Charlotte who made our stay so memorable. Every venue needs a Bathma!

We loved the delicious breakfasts and coffees. They even gave us a yummy take away breakfast and coffee for our early morning journey to the airport. Cold beers and wine were appreciated too.

The villa and rooms are stunning and the pool and relaxing areas are great.

10mins walk to Kabalana because which was great for surfing. Also walking distance to Citra - fantastic food and cocktails.

Highly recommend staying at Mana.

Absolutely loved our stay at Mana. The room was clean and quiet with one of the most comfortable beds I’ve stayed in. The staff were incredible and always accomodating. We arrived around 1am and had no trouble checking in and had staff greet us on arrival.

This place is perfect if you want to spend the whole time at the villa relaxing or if you’re keen to get out and explore as it is so central with great restaurants and cafes nearby.

What really made our stay was the hospitality of the hosts. Would 100% recommend Mana to anyone. Thank you for an unforgettable stay!

This is the place that made us rebook our tickets and extend our stay in Sri Lanka. It is truly such an amazing place you won’t regret booking.

The rooms, pools and outdoor areas are so beautiful, stylish and clean. We had our best sleep at Mãna and woke up to amazing coffee and breakfast.  The freshly baked banana bread is definitely a must try! We also joined an ice bath and sauna session which was so refreshing.

Danny, Lisa, Charlotte (and other staff) were so friendly and warm, and all of their recommendations around Kabalana/Ahangama were great. Everything with the booking, check-in/out went so smooth and we could definitely recommend the rooms with a pool view.

A 10/10 stay and we can’t wait to come back!

Exactly as described, clean, cozy, and really quiet. Charlotte and the team were genuinely warm, and helpful. Their recommendations around Kabalana/Ahangama were spot on, and Kabalana Beach is just a 2 min tuk-tuk ride away.

We also tried their ice bath (never thought I’d say this, but it was actually so much fun), and the Sri Lankan breakfast they organized was delicious. We’d happily come back and recommend Māna Villa to anyone.

Stumbled upon this spot in Ahangama and was instantly blown away by how insanely good the food was. Since then, I’ve been back maybe 3–4 times, and honestly… it somehow keeps getting better every single visit.
The Catch & Crunch — their take on a fried fish fillet sandwich with curry mayo — is next level. Perfectly crispy, packed with flavour, and super generous with the portion. Massive value for money.
The fried chicken sandwich with hot honey is pure comfort food heaven, and the hot dogs are melt-in-your-mouth goodness.
And the drinks? Just as impressive. The coconut frappe and matcha latte are hands down some of the best drinks in Ahangama — no exaggeration.
What makes it even better is that it’s locally owned and run with an all-female kitchen crew, which is seriously awesome to see.
If you’re anywhere near Ahangama, do yourself a favour and visit. You won’t regret it — this place is an absolute gem. 🌴✨
I had the most amazing hotdog here!! Their matcha is also one the best around! Nice environment, just right beside the pickleball court.
Food is super delicious and the drinks are refreshing. Super friendly staff. Convenient location.

Absolutely loved Catch & Crunch!!!
Fresh and delicious, amazing balance of flavours.

Came here to play pickleball and was delightfully surprised by the amazing quality of the food. Every dish was packed with wonderful flavor, and we can’t wait to come back and try all their sandwiches!”

formatted_address: Matara Road, Kabalana, Ahangama 80650, Sri Lanka
name: Café Ceylon Ahangama

reviews.text:
Cafe Ceylon… I honestly love this place and I’m genuinely sad that we’re leaving.
The atmosphere here is incredibly calm, warm, and welcoming.

The staff is amazing – always smiling, kind, and natural, making you feel comfortable from the very first moment. There is a swimming pool and a clean, beautiful courtyard with sunbeds, perfect for relaxing. What I really appreciate is that there is no minimum spend and no pressure to order anything, which is quite rare and makes the place feel very free and relaxed.

There is also a coworking area, so if you need to work in peace, this is a perfect spot.
And the pinsa… absolutely incredible 🤍 I highly recommend Emilia and Famia – real highlights.

If you are in Ahangama and need a bit of peace away from the noise and crowds, this is exactly the place you want to be.
Great energy, great people, great food.
Highly recommended – I will definitely come back 🫶

We were staying there between 15 and 29 January 2026. Amazing location, with very high quality restaurant and cafe. Good quality of beds and sanitary devices, though bear in mind that it's Sri Lanka, so think smaller Greek islands 10 years ago when you imagine the rooms. We stayed in the Villa, which is best to rent as a group, so you benefit from the rooms and the common space, which is exclusive to the guests of the villa.  The owner is a great person,with a fascinatingt life story and contagious positive energy. We will surely return.

My absolute favorite place! This spot truly has it all. Whether you need to focus on work or simply unwind, the atmosphere is ideal. The highlight is the large, immaculately clean, and well-maintained pool – it's simply fantastic. The place is wonderfully family-friendly and always peaceful.

Adding to the charm is the delightful owner – she is incredibly kind, welcoming, and a pleasure to talk to.

The evenings are magical with movie nights on the projector! The food is delicious, and the whole place radiates comfort.

I highly recommend it to everyone!

Café Ceylon is one of those places that quietly turns a normal day into a memory you keep replaying. We were there for the most recent market day and had an absolute blast from start to finish. The vibe was buzzing but relaxed, the kind of energy that makes you want to stay longer than planned.

What really stood out was how welcoming it was for families. Our four-year-old was in heaven. Kids activities, face painting, splashing in the pool, and happily demolishing the food with zero complaints, which is the highest possible review from a small human. Daddy was equally happy, for the record.

Great food, a joyful crowd, and a space where kids can be kids while adults actually get to relax and enjoy themselves. Café Ceylon absolutely nailed it. We will be back for the next market day without a doubt.

This is our 2nd time going there. The place is lovely, the atmosphere is nice. The servers are very friendly.
We got a few pizzas, salad, burger, prawns bowl and sandwiches and we fairly enjoyed it. The food was very tasty, fresh. The only problem is that it takes some time to get the food, but otherwise it was very nice.
Very fun and laid back. Enjoyed very much. Loved the dogs

I had the most incredible week at Sion Surf! I was on a 5 month travel trip around the world at the time and this was without a doubt one of my favourite weeks. I was a beginner surfer and the surf instructors were brilliant, patient and kind. The food, hosts and staff are all amazing. So much fun,  I can't wait to go back!!!
Great place to surf. Nice accommodation. Friendly staff. Great surf Instructors. Yoga classes. Entertaining live music on Fridays. Really enjoyed my week spent there.

Food is good and the spot is nice on seaside.  Service is ok, some guys are super cool and some guys are very ordinary but overall it's nice.  Place is usually occupied by surfers.  Chill place!  We went many times, especially for breakfast.

Definitely one for the books!!! They were very accommodating and friendly, including the owners, Lee and Anji. God knows how troublesome we were back at the camp, but the owners and their staff still managed to get out of their way just to make it a great experience. They offer a 1-week retreat which is actually very worth it especially for people (aka me and my friend) who are not experts in making itineraries. Not to worry cos unlike the others, they are flexible and very considerate, meaning they also accept guests on a mini-vacation. We stayed there for 3 nights and left Wednesday evening. I've never tried surfing before but I really had so much fun learning how to do it. All thanks to the instructors' undying support and patience. Haha! My personal favorite would be the very relaxing yoga sesh at the lagoon, near our cozy room. Plus the dinner out at a newly-opened place before we fly back home. Yummy food! :) We were not able to experience the much awaited parties scheduled on weekends though. Clearly, we shall return! Haha. Hello Evan & Arlo!

name: The Shire | Floating Café & Restaurant | Boat Safari

reviews.text: Really cozy place! Even if they just opened up a few days before our visit we were so impressed and had a great cake and coffee 😍 The hosts were super nice and told us about all the amazing plans that they have for this place! Looking forward to follow their journey and I can really recommend a visit!

What a beautiful place! We had great coffee and delicious cakes, and the owners and staff are lovely! The whole setting is amazing, you are directly looking over the lake, and the atmosphere is so relaxed and calm. Highly recommend. Thanks for such a great time!

Absolutely stunning place!! 😍 Fantastic view and vibe -  right next to the lake and surrounded by lush jungle. The owners Gigi and Mark are also super lovely! Can’t wait to see how this place evolves in the next few years 🌴
Beautiful place by the lake with incredible views and close to Ahangama. The owners are very friendly and attentive. Cold drinks, delicious food and cute dogs. There is also fast wifi.

Incredible hidden gem right at the side of the lake. A perfect getaway from the noise and pollution of the busy Ahangama.

We came for coffee, and were gladly surprised with delicious chocolate cake and banana bread. Several hours later, we were still there, so it was time for some cold drinks qnd some burgers.

Their 3 dogs, calm and cuddly, totally fitting the atmosphere give the extra bit of cosiness.

Most recommended!

We really enjoyed our stay. The accommodation is very beautiful and clean. The staff were also very friendly and welcoming. Can definitely recommend the place! Walking distance to Kabalana Beach with many surf options.

Our family of four, including two teenagers, spent 6 wonderful days at Residence LUM and we truly enjoyed every moment of our stay.

The residence is within walking distance of the ocean, yet peacefully tucked away from the busy main road, which makes it both convenient and quiet. The pool is a great size, the room is spacious, and everything is kept spotlessly clean. The staff are exceptionally attentive and friendly.

We especially appreciated the thoughtful service: they happily cut up the fruit we brought ourselves, and filtered drinking water is provided, helping to reduce plastic waste. There is also a ping-pong table and table football, which our teenagers loved. Tuk-tuks are always available, and there are many small restaurants and cafés nearby.

Another nice detail is that the rooms are equipped with mosquito diffusers in the sockets, and both air conditioning and fans are available if it gets too warm. We had a truly fantastic time and will definitely come back. A special thank you to Vera for making our stay even more memorable!

Hier ist eine stilvolle, authentische 5-Sterne-Google-Bewertung für euch als Familie:

⸻

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

We had the most wonderful stay at Lum Residence in Ahangama as a family of four (2 adults, 2 kids) in the family room – and it was simply perfect.

From the moment we arrived, Vera and her entire team made us feel completely at home. They took such genuine care of us throughout our stay – always attentive, warm, and incredibly kind with the kids.

The atmosphere is calm and relaxed, with other lovely families around, which made it even more enjoyable. It’s peaceful, beautifully designed, and perfectly located to unwind while still being close to everything in Ahangama.

The family room was spacious and comfortable, ideal for traveling with children. Everything felt thoughtful and easy.

If you are traveling as a family and looking for a place where you feel truly looked after – this is it.

Thank you Vera and team for an unforgettable stay. We will definitely be back 💛

I had a beautiful stay and I would definitely come back!😊

Lum Residence is a beautiful place to stay. The room was big, clean, modern design and had a very comfortable bed. The pool is a real highlight — well maintained, and perfect for relaxing. The staff were extremely friendly and helpful, and the manager was also very customer-oriented and kind. Late check-out was possible, which we really appreciated.

I really enjoyed my stay at this hotel. The location is excellent, everything was very clean, and the service was outstanding. Overall, it is truly a great place to stay.
A special mention goes to Baba - he has everything and everyone under control and really makes the place run smoothly. Many thanks to Lum and Baba for making my stay so enjoyable.

formatted_address: Kabalana Beach, Matara - Galle Road, Welhengoda, Ahangama 80650, Sri Lanka
name: Sisters Kabalana

reviews.text:
A lovely surprise in Ahangama!
The place is beautifully designed and very well curated, and the quality of the food is excellent. I had the sourdough with scrambled eggs and a fruit bowl, both were really good.
The coffee is also amazing — I highly recommend the iced latte with coconut milk, it was incredible!
The café itself is very aesthetic and nicely designed, definitely worth a visit if you’re in Ahangama.
Highly recommended!

A wonderful breakfast experience in a beautifully arranged garden, where Turkish breakfast classics are given a lovely Sri Lankan twist. A perfect way to start the day. The kitchen is spotlessly clean, the team is friendly and attentive, and the service is excellent. Everything is fresh and full of flavour, and the coffee is absolutely superb. Highly recommended for anyone looking for a quality, relaxed and enjoyable breakfast spot.🌺

Just an ordinary place; it does not have any visually or culturally designed indoor/outside area for the Turkish experience. Just a cute garden with a few tables. We tried Turkish breakfast; the taste is good for Sri Lankan standards, but the quantity and portions are very small (4 olives, 1 cm of butter, seriously?). The staff should have been better trained to show real Turkish hospitality. Prices are high; therefore, don't go with big expectations. It is fine but overall it is not a must-go spot.

What we loved the most was how they added a touch of Sri Lankan flavor to their Turkish breakfast. Everything was fresh, delicious, and “more than enough”. We truly enjoyed it, can’t wait to come back, and highly recommend it.🌸
Hidden gem - try the turkish egg topped with yoghurt paired with a Simit (it comes warm and fresh!). Also the flat white is stunning. Very sweet ladies at service!

formatted_address: Matara - Galle Road, Kabalana Beach, Welhengoda, Ahangama, Sri Lanka
name: Saga Espresso Bar

reviews.text: Coffee was really just great! Amazing service and the first place I've found in Sri Lanka that has seitan (a type of vegan "meat") burger that was perfectly filling and delicious! Can recommend :)

Some of the best coffee on the south coast of Sri Lanka, great music and chilled vibes. If you´re a remote worker, this is a great place to post up and work. Oh and if you´re into bagels, Saga has the best :)

Although the place is ideal for brunch as the board stated, my experience was bitter. It took ages for the food to come (almost an hour wait) as an understaff issue was very clear. The restaurant didn’t feel as welcoming, because the attitude of some staff was cold. It almost felt like the atmosphere in SL during d lockdown period; how d locals helped local businesses, has been forgotten and on top of everything NO health guidelines were followed by the staff. They probably they think they are "supermen". It’s amazing to see that we have so many locals who are actually not bothered about this existing pandemic (most tourists think they R in their country as most R not bothered anyway) which is not good as we need to sustain the business somehow as we R slowly raising our heads. Finally, the food was nothing much at all, but d coffee can be given a 👍
Great coffee (especially as a vegan because it can be hard to find!!). Cute roadside location, nice owner / staff 😊 Would absolutely go again.

We came in twice, but we didn't manage to drink coffee, we waited for 20 minutes, went to the counter to order coffee, the bartender said he was busy (although it was obvious that he wasn't particularly busy with anything), there were almost no people. Terrible service

formatted_address: Wewilihena, Duwa Watta, Ahangama 80630, Sri Lanka
name: Black Honey cafe

reviews.text:
I recently visited Black Honey and had such a great experience. The food was absolutely delicious, full of flavor, and beautifully presented. Every dish tasted fresh and well-prepared.
The view is the best part, it’s stunning. The whole atmosphere is calm, stylish, and perfect for relaxing while enjoying good food.
This place is especially great for foreigners and tourists because of the amazing view, ambiance, and overall experience.

A lovely spot, overlooking beautiful paddy fields — calm, quiet, and just really nice to be in. The coffee is great, and the menu is interesting with creative yet approachable dishes. The place is beautifully designed, with a warm, welcoming atmosphere. Super hospitable owners and staff who make you want to stay longer. One of my all time favorite places in town🫶

Black Honey is a beautiful spot where you can enjoy a decent coffee, take in the views, and get a couple of hours of focused work done — they share Wi-Fi vouchers, which is a nice touch. The atmosphere is calm and perfect for both work and slow moments.

It’s better to come here already full if you’re not a fan of slightly browned avocado for breakfast.

If you’re really hungry, I wouldn’t recommend going there because the portions are quite small compared to the price. That said, I really loved the place — the decor and atmosphere are amazing. It’s a great spot overall, just not the best choice if you’re going mainly for the food.”

I loved this place! It is very western but the atmosphere and aesthetic are so beautiful. Also, the mushroom toast was the best brunch I had in Sri Lanka, so delicious! Coffee is great as well! Service is slow though.

formatted_address: Welhengoda, Gane Arambawatta, Ahangama 80650, Sri Lanka
name: The Cinnamon Trail

reviews.text: I visited this place twice during my time in Sri Lanka and had a great experience both times. The food is excellent, and the people are very warm and welcoming. I would love to visit again. It is truly a must-visit place in Sri Lanka.

Went here for our last meal in Sri Lanka and was totally worth it! Best curry we had the entire trip! Staff were so sweet and invited us to play a gam of carrom with them. The garden is beautiful and they have the cutest pet bunny coco!
10/10 Recommend!
Thanks for making our last meal so special.

We went spontaneously yesterday and were lucky to be there for a special event (DJ + drummer). Beautiful place, big garden, nicely decorated with fairy lights, modern yet comfy style, very relaxed vibe. A cute white rabbit was hopping around. Staff very attentive, food and drinks were delicious!

Chicken sandwich was great and if you don’t have a large appetite, good enough for two! Loved the fries on the side, crispy & fresh!

Great ambiance, quick & friendly service.

The restaurant has a big enough space, would have been great to have a separate women’s loo. (The restaurant was empty when we went so hard to judge how clean it would usually be.
Such a nice place to get food, or drinks and chill out. They have a lovely garden in the back, with a house rabbit! The white wine was great, as well as the shrimps.

formatted_address: Welhengoda, Sri Premarathana Mawatha, Ahangama 80650, Sri Lanka
name: Jungle Villa cafe & rooms

reviews.text: This villa was very cozy, just like home. Isuru, the host, was great and always ready to help with any questions. The villa is in a quiet street but still close to the ocean, just a 10-minute walk. The breakfasts every morning were very good and a nice start to the day. The room was simple but had everything | needed. l also met lots of nice people there. It's a good place to stay for both quiet and being near the ocean.

We were a group of 5. We had a lovely stay here. We used both the AC and the Non AC rooms. They were perfect and clean . Beds were comfy. The breakfast in the morning was amazing. Loads of fruit and eggs. They are a lovely family running this villa. Would definitely recommend and stay again.

A homestay unlike any other

Jungle Villa & Eden Villa, run by Isuru and his family, is the perfect place to experience Sri Lankan hospitality at its finest. From the moment we arrived, we were welcomed with open arms and made to feel like part of the family. Isuru and his family went above and beyond to make sure our stay was comfortable and enjoyable.

The room themselves are beautifully appointed and spotlessly clean. The villa is spacious and well-equipped with everything we needed for a comfortable stay.

The location of the villas is perfect. They are situated in a quiet and peaceful area, just a short walk from the beach.

Isuru and his family are truly wonderful hosts. They shared their culture and traditions with us, and even invited us to join them for their celebrations. They also cooked us delicious Sri Lankan meals, which we loved. Nothing was too much trouble for them, and they always went out of their way to make sure we were happy.

We cannot recommend Jungle Villa & Eden Villa highly enough. If you are looking for a truly authentic Sri Lankan homestay experience, then this is the place for you. We will definitely be staying here again on our next trip to Sri Lanka.

It’s one of the sweetest places I have stayed in Ahangama! The host is super nice! The rooms are Sri Lankan style with a good AC, hot water shower and a good bed! Perfect for surfers or people who want to relax and chill after surf! I will definitely come back!

Isuru and his family are very welcoming and helpful.
The villa has a garden and is surrounded by lush green trees, it's located not far from the main road and all the surf spots, but it's quiet and peaceful. The accomodation is super clean and cozy.
The breakfast is very good with toast, butter, jam and fresh fruit and coffee. The cafe also offers delicious panini's, waffles and cappuccino's.
That all for a very reasonable price.
I highly recommend!
Sweet little family cafe on the lake, used by locals and serving cold drinks, egg and noodle dishes.

formatted_address: Welhengoda, Wimalasara mawatha, Ahangama 80650, Sri Lanka
name: Petals

reviews.text: Best breakfast in town. The family is so lovely, cute little homey spot with some tables in the garden and inside. Flavours were great on the avo toast and shashuka. Definitely coming back here and would recommend to everyone! Also great proper latte.

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ 6/5 Best in South Sri Lanka!

We had an amazing meals at the Petals! The type of restaurant you think about returning for every meal!

The food was absolutely delicious and beautifully presented. The bagel sandwich was perfectly my personal favorite, packed with fresh ingredients, and the side salad was crisp, vibrant, and full of flavor. The pancakes were also next-level with fresh tropical fruits, coconut, and syrup, making it a perfect balance of sweet and refreshing.

You can really feel the attention to detail in every dish, from the quality of the ingredients to the presentation. Everything tasted fresh, healthy, and thoughtfully prepared.

On top of that, the service was outstanding being friendly, attentive, and genuinely welcoming. And honestly, it’s one of the best service/quality/quantity/price ratios we’ve found in South Sri Lanka. You get generous portions, high-quality food, and great service without overpaying, which is rare in the area.

The atmosphere is relaxed and welcoming, making it a great spot to start your day.

Highly recommend this place, we’d continue come back everyday! 🌿🍍🥞

The best place for breakfast or lunch! You get a combo deal which includes a drink and side. The price is amazing for what you get, everything is really fresh and the guys are the best. Came back here almost every day and will definitely keep coming ❤️.
Show some support to these hard working Sri Lankan guys! Highly recommended!

Lovely quiet atmosphere just off the Galle Road. We stayed a 25min walk away but it was so good we came back two days in a row. Amazing value with the breakfast combo and really generous portion sizes. Would definitely recommend the banana bread. Also, the first place we have found bacon like back home!

My favourite breakfast spot in Ahangama. I came here for breakfast every morning and sometimes also for lunch. Everything I tried was so delicious and the value for the price is unbeatable. The service is outstanding and the owners so lovely. Will definitely come back here one day! 🫶🏼
Lovely quiet place with excellent coffee and crepes (best crepes we’ve had locally). We enjoyed the calm and relaxed atmosphere with a lovely view of the ocean. Friendly & pleasant service.
If you’re looking for a cozy place to work or chill, with good coffee and lovely crepes, this is the perfect spot. Nice ambiance and friendly service.

Great crepes, tasty coffees and refreshing cold drinks. the service is impeccable the view is great the atmosphere is relaxed and chill. Went with friends for brunch , we enjoyed our selves.  Went back again with a book to enjoy a calm breakfast and the sea brease. Both times were great

Wow! Coziest place in Habaraduwa.

Good coffee. Tasty crepes.
AC place that’s good for coworking.
Beach is just in front of the cafe, sunbathing is also possible.

Literally you can spend all day there ❤️

Ah! And yes it’s 1000% instagamable. Although so chilled that we forgot to make these cute photos)))
Cozy, quiet, beautiful little spot by the beach😍 The sweet and savory crepes are delicious, the coffee’s great, and the staff is lovely. One of my favorites❤️

formatted_address: Galle, X8V5+99V, Matara Rd, Habaraduwa 80630, Sri Lanka
name: Pala cafe

formatted_address: X8V5+P3V, Habaraduwa Dikkumbura Rd, Ahangama, Sri Lanka
name: Tea center

reviews.text: We found this absolute gem of a cafe! Highly recommend. All the food was fresh, healthy and very tasty. Excellent selection of juices and smoothies. Great service with friendly, family vibe. Not to be missed when you’re down south.

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

I had been looking for a truly healthy juice place for a while, so I was really excited when I found Eats Shoots and Leaves. I decided to try their 3-day juice cleanse, and it exceeded my expectations.

Already on the first day I could feel my body soaking up all the nutrients and I felt incredibly hydrated and energized. The juices were not only nourishing but also genuinely delicious, which made the cleanse very enjoyable.

The delivery process was smooth and easy, and the owners were incredibly kind and supportive. They checked in daily and provided all the information I needed, which made the whole experience feel very personal and well guided.

I’m already looking forward to my next cleanse, next time I’ll definitely go for the 5-day program! Highly recommend if you’re looking for fresh, healthy, and thoughtfully prepared juices. 🌿🥤

So excited to have a new and exciting place in Habaraduwa. Its right on the main road, so very handy to pop in and grab a healthy treat. Delicious fruit juices and snacks. Love the quirky decor and attention to detail. Staff are super friendly and the place has a very homely feel! I will definitely be a regular customer.

We just stumbled across this lovely little cafe whilst trying to find somewhere to have a coffee. The juices are incredible. The owners are very passionate and the staff are lovely too. Do not visit the area anslet this place pass you by.
Very calm & nice place. Also the natural juices are great.

formatted_address: Sri Wijaya Mawatha, Meliyagoda, Puwakwaththa, Ahangama, Sri Lanka
name: Oqura Cafe & Restaurant

reviews.text: Love this little place! I always cycle past and one evening I was craving daal & coconut roti so I decided to stop by. The coconut roti & daal was delicious! So was the cinnamon tea (one of the best i’ve had). Super clean and cosy environment… super affordable and the owner is so warm & welcoming!

Cute little cafe that newly opened! The family is very sweet and serves great coffee and also offers breakfast. We tried some savory and sweet dishes. They also serve homemade cake!
We can recommend this place for sure!

We spent three weeks in Ahangama a few weeks after the café opened, and it was by far our favorite place. The most wonderful family we met in Ahangama. They are very valuable people, and Imali is an excellent pastry chef and cook. The beautiful café is an island of calm in bustling Ahangama. It's worth going up in the evening too, because there are lots of fireflies on the cute little road.
Amazing new discovery for us! Delicious food, lovely people, very cozy atmosphere. Highly recommended! And, if you have a kid - they serve an amazing babiccino☺️👌
The owners put a lot of love in this place😍Very nice Café with food as well. Highly recommended!

formatted_address: Sri Wijaya Mawatha, Meliyagoda, Ahangama 80650, Sri Lanka
name: The Bubble Dock

reviews.text: Best way to release your stress. Best fish therapy ever had. Come again and again. Frindly staff. My new drug

I recently visited a restaurant that provided a truly relaxing and enjoyable dining experience. The ambiance was calm and soothing, creating a perfect environment to unwind and enjoy a meal.

One unique feature of this restaurant was the fish therapy offered. It was a delightful experience to have small fish gently nibbling at the feet, providing a soothing and rejuvenating sensation. This added touch made the visit even more memorable and added to the overall relaxing atmosphere.

The food served at the restaurant was of good quality.

Overall, my experience at this restaurant was positive. The relaxing environment, combined with the unique fish therapy and delicious food, created a memorable dining experience. If you are looking for a place to unwind, enjoy good food, and appreciate a chilled-out atmosphere, I would recommend giving this restaurant a try.
The best place for relaxing your body, mind and the soul.. the best ever fish therapy spa that i ever found ♥️♥️ good luck!
Wow .....wonderful experience, nice and clean place

Wonderful experience,
Best fish spa in SL.

formatted_address: Delgaswatta Junction, Midigama, Midigama 81700, Sri Lanka
name: Drifter - Rooms & Food

reviews.text: Very nice place where you can easily meet a couple new faces and hang about. Make sure to buy your mangos just outside of the joint on the right, she’s a real treat. Close to the beach, probably best street to be in in Sri Lanka. We joined the people for a nice party for NYE. Overall good place. Toilet flush wasn’t working half the time, shower wasn’t hot but that did not make it any less good. It’s also a lot more quiet than you would imagine. The people are all respecting eachothers sleep.

Had breakfast at Drifter and it was amazing! The Turkish eggs were super tasty and fresh, with just the right amount of spice. The coffee was perfect too 😍 definitely the best I’ve had in Midigama so far. Loved the relaxed vibe, great music and friendly people. You can tell the owner and staff really care about giving everyone a great experience. Highly recommend! 🌿☕️

Very disappointing management from the hotel. I am currently staying here, and there was extremely loud music coming from the café Birty Chooty across the street until around midnight. The noise could clearly be heard inside the rooms, making it very difficult to rest.

What is most concerning is that the hotel staff did not take any action to address the situation. Guests had to deal with the problem themselves and speak to the café directly.

When running a hotel in a residential area, ensuring that guests can rest comfortably should be a basic priority. Unfortunately, the lack of response and support from the hotel in this situation was very disappointing.

Review will be deleted after you fix the issue.

Super friendly vibe, very inviting. I find this my go to place for coffee and to sit back and relax, so you will always see me here! The food was very good last season, I’m sure it’s the same. I did have a chia pudding which was very nice!

Waited 45 minutes for a brownie. Of course, by then my coffee was cold.

Besides this, the place is clean, offers high quality food and drinks with free water at the bar, powersockets for guests and good background music.

formatted_address: Goviyapana Beach Hotel, Matara Rd, Ahangama, Sri Lanka
name: Goviyapana Beach Hotel

reviews.text: Location is great, rooms are good but here it comes we booked accommodation for 3 days…one day there was no water and we were asked to wait for water. The other day there was no electricity from morning 10 to evening 6 and also no water and we were forced to stay outside in cafes for entire day. Apparently, there is no generator in hotel.

My room smelled strongly of toluene. They had clearly just painted the place, and since the rooms had no windows you could open, I had migraines every day. The owner gave me a scented air freshener, which only made it worse. The hotel felt abandoned, but they had just painted everything white. There was even paint on the outdoor furniture, which got on our clothes.
The rooms had a strange, almost fever-dream layout, with raised floors and random steps everywhere. Behind the toilet there was a lit mini-hallway that led nowhere except to a mirror. Otherwise decent bed and air-condition, no daily-based cleaning, some cockroaches.
Poor value for money.

I do not recommend staying here even though i could see the high potential of the place.

We have arrived around 1 PM , water was not working, they promised to fix it as soon as possible within the hour. Obviously nothing happened. Around 8:30 PM., and after not only not having water, but being cut off from electricity, we left the hotel.
I strongly advise nobody to stay in the hotel. It was a terrible experience, and we were misled by fake reviews.
So that you know
It's a beautiful place with a beautiful view of the beach from the room. The staff is friendly. The room is also beautiful and clean. A great place to spend a vacation.

⭐️
We had a terrible experience at this hotel, despite booking it through Booking.com. From the moment we arrived, we were disgusted by the state of the property. The place was dirty and clearly hadn’t been swept properly. Many areas were damaged and left unrepaired, and it was obvious the walls hadn’t been painted in a long time.

The bathroom fittings were filthy, the rooms had a strong unpleasant odor, and to make matters worse, there was no water in the washrooms. The staff lacked experience and professionalism, and despite informing them of our arrival in advance, no preparations had been made.

We were so disappointed that we canceled our booking immediately. My advice: do not trust photos online. Always check reviews first. A place like this not only wastes travelers' time and money but also tarnishes the reputation of the country.

To add to the disappointment, as we were leaving, we saw a foreigner facing the same problems we had. It’s truly heartbreaking to see visitors endure such inconvenience.

formatted_address: Surfers paradise, midigama, weligama 81700, Sri Lanka
name: Surfers Paradise

reviews.text: Do not rent a board from here. They give out bad quality China surfboards and charge you extra if they break.

Location is right across the road from the surf. The views were some of the best we had in Sri Lanka overlooking the ocean. The manager and owner were so kind and welcoming, it was sad to leave them. We loved our stay and hope to be back soon!

The location of the hotel is absolutely Perfect! The view from the top balcony is priceless and the staff is so welcoming and friendly that we didn’t want to leave! We firstly booked only 4 days but eventually staid the whole 2 weeks 😃
The best value for price ever

Absolutely amazing hotel with terrific views of Midigama bay. If budget accommodation is your thing I feel Surfers Paradise is for you and it has everything you require. I initially booked for 1 night then ended up staying for 2 weeks. Close to Midigama square

We had a great experience at Surfers Paradise! It’s perfectly located and the view from the rooftop is unmatched. The staff is incredibly welcoming and accommodating, and a delicious home-made breakfast is served every morning. I could not recommend this place more if you’re looking for a great vibe, amazing location and the kindest staff!

Amazing experience at Surfing Wombats!

We went for the ping-pong tournament and ended up having one of the best meals as well. The pizzas were excellent. Tartufina and Cottina were both spot on, and the tiramisu and Nutella calzone were absolutely perfect.

Great vibe, fun crowd, and a really cool atmosphere. The tournament was well organized and super fun, which made the whole night even better.

Definitely a place to come back to in Ahangama highly recommended.

I first visited Surfing Wombats 8h ago and coming back this year was special in many ways. Not only has the place grown beautifully, but the sense of community around it is what truly makes it stand out.
