It’s no longer just a surf hostel but a hub of connection, creativity and good vibes. From unforgettable open mic nights to lively ping-pong competitions that draw people from far and wide - there’s always something bringing everyone together. The atmosphere feels welcoming, vibrant and effortlessly fun.

The accommodation is just as impressive - big, comfortable beds with fresh sheets that always feel crisp and clean. After a long day in the water, it’s exactly what you want to come back to.

And the food! The restaurant serves dishes made with the freshest ingredients and everything I tried was absolutely delicious.

Coming back after eight years and seeing how much heart and intention has gone into building this place was truly inspiring. Surfing Wombats isn’t just somewhere to stay, it’s somewhere you feel part of something. I already can’t wait to return again.

This is hands down one of the best Italian restaurants I’ve been to. From the moment you walk in, you feel genuinely welcomed. The owner is incredibly warm and kind, and you can really feel the passion and love they put into the place. It’s not just a restaurant, it feels like being invited into someone’s home.

Amazing place with such good vibes! The pizza is honestly the best you can find in Sri Lanka. The staff are incredibly friendly and work so hard to give you the best possible experience. You really feel welcomed and well taken care of. Highly recommend!

We had an excellent experience at Wombats Pizzeria in Midigama. The pizza was truly delicious — fresh, flavorful, so far the best we’ve had in Sri Lanka. We did wait a bit longer than expected because the place was quite busy, but the staff handled it with kindness and even surprised us with free ice cream and brownies as a gesture of goodwill.

The whole place has a relaxed, laid-back vibe. The music creates a really nice atmosphere, perfect for an easy evening. The staff were genuinely friendly throughout our visit.

Definitely a spot worth stopping by if you’re in the area.

formatted_address: Indhana Road (Near Midigama Railway Station Road 150m), Matara Road, 80650, Sri Lanka
name: Asanka Surf House & Restaurant With Pool

reviews.text:
Honestly one of the best hostels I’ve stayed in – not just in Sri Lanka, but in general.

From the moment you arrive, the vibe is just right. The hostel owner is insanely nice, super relaxed, always around, and genuinely cares that everyone has a good time. You immediately feel welcome, not like a guest, but like you’re just hanging out at a really well-run place.

The location is perfect. There’s this little shortcut where you cross a small river, and boom – you’re basically at the water in 3–4 minutes max. The area itself is amazing: calm, green, tropical, but still social. You can chill hard here, but if you’re in the mood to party, you absolutely can. It’s that perfect balance.

The pool is beautiful, with a stunning view over the water, especially around sunset. At night, the place looks insane – there’s this big palm tree that’s beautifully lit, a really cozy seating area, and just a super relaxed atmosphere. Perfect for beers, talks, or just doing nothing.

Speaking of beers: big cans for 700 – enough said 🍺

Rooms are super clean, beds are comfy, and the bathrooms are next-level clean. Like, genuinely impressive. You can tell the place is looked after constantly.

There’s a free billiard table, fully renovated and basically brand new, which is such a nice bonus. Internet is fast and stable, no issues at all – I could work, stream, whatever.

One thing I really loved: if you want music, the owner literally lets you play your own music on the speakers. Super easy, super chill, no weird rules. It’s your vibe.

Overall, I honestly can’t complain about a single thing.
Price–performance is insane. For what you get, this is hands down the best hostel I stayed at in Sri Lanka.

If you’re coming to this area and you don’t stay here, you’re doing it wrong.
100% recommend. Would come back anytime. ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Don’t stay here. I booked female dorm and they gave me my bed and the sheets were dirty from past guest so I asked them to give me clean sheets. They did not clean the floor, showers or toilets which were disgusting and people are living there for longer periods which is why the places is disgustingThe lockers was not working and there was random people getting in and out of our room bc they feel entitled to use all the space bc they were “living” there even tho it is not their room and they left all their belongings and were using the only lockers working. Really negative experience and would not stay here again.  The location is the only good about this place. So the good reviews they have is from people staying longer periods of time bc it just don’t make sense.

The best hostel in midigama! The hostel is very social and all of the staff is so sweet.
It’s very good located, close to the beach and very good surf spots. Prices are also more than fair!

We booked the place few days earlier and paid the advance as well. When we went there they said the place is overbooked. Really disappointed about the experience.

Owner refunded the advance and tried to find a place but we had to find a place by our own at the last moment.
Exactly what I was looking for. A nice relaxing stay with a short walk to the surf across the train tracks. A nice pool and a view of the ocean. Asanka and his family are super friendly

formatted_address: Akkara wissa Junction ,Ahangama Ampawila Rd, X9X6+VPM, Ahangama, Sri Lanka
name: Sisilasa Food Center

reviews.text: Oooo
Food is very tasty and service is great 😋 love in the place
Good service 🥰
Good place
Best service
Doesnt exist anymore

formatted_address: Diwara Niwasa, Mahavihara Rd, Ahangama 80650, Sri Lanka
name: Village Rice & Curry

reviews.text:
This lovely little restaurant is a true hidden gem. The hosts have created a beautiful and cozy spot right next to their home, with just a few tables, which makes the experience very personal and relaxed.

The food is freshly prepared and absolutely delicious, you can really taste the care and love that goes into every dish.

If you’re looking for a special experience and amazing local food, this is definitely the place to go. We highly recommend eating here!

A hidden gem on a quiet street. We felt like home. The food is very delicious autentic Sri Lankan cuisine and you can take as much as you want from the buffet. The staff are super kind. We’ve had an amazing experience!

Great find, very orthentic. Unbelievable value for money, we shared 2 chicken curries and 2 chicken kottus between 4 people, could have definitely just done the curries. Both delicious. Must go! The guys is super nice and helpful too. We will he back soon 🫶
Calm, cozy and clean place ❤️we absolutely loved the experience with local food. Hosts prepared everything fresh just for us and took into account our preferences
Really good food and atmosphere, very friendly couple who have a family restaurant. Was very surprised by the whole experience. Nice to visit and support locals !
Delicious home made rice and curry! Nice family! ❤️

We've been traveling in Sri Lanka for three weeks and have already tried quite a few curries, but by far the best we've had here! After dinner, we even got a tour of their garden, where they pick all their fresh ingredients.

We stayed around the corner from this homestay and restaurant and had a fantastic meal. The mother cooked us a delicious curry, everything fresh, and her son and husband chatted with us and made us feel at home. Truly the best dinner of our entire trip. Many thanks and good luck with your place 🙏🏼

Super go’ service.
Came at 8:00 PM, after a several-hour long downpour. I think they were prepared for no more people to come that day.
They asked if we were prepared for an hour to pass, as they had to start from scratch.
We ate on the terrace in their private home/garden. Really relaxed.
After 45 min. there was food, Rice and curry with a bottle of water and it tasted fantastic. Definitely a place I would recommend.
A wonderful family and very tasty, traditional dishes, cooked in their own kitchen. Highly recommended, if only to enjoy the peace and quiet and the plants and wildlife of the garden.

Very cute restaurant located in a cozy, hidden spot, peaceful and quiet. It’s a buffet-style meal with local dishes that aren’t too spicy, making it enjoyable for everyone. The portions are generous and offer great value for money. The staff keep everything well stocked and provide friendly, attentive service.

One of the most authentic places you can find in Ahangama. Small place that seats only 8 people. The family lives in the attached house and cooks fresh, tasty, Sri Lankan soul food!
Vegetarian only

Perera Kitchen is hands down one of the best hole-in-the-wall finds in Ahangama!!! No frills, just seriously good food 😋

The rice and curry spread was incredible! Dal curry, coconut sambal, papaya curry, winged beans, papadam… everything was fresh, flavorful, and cooked with heart. You can taste that it’s homemade.

And the best part? The whole meal was very affordable. For the quality and portion size, the value is unbeatable. We left completely full and honestly speechless!

If you’re looking for authentic, affordable Sri Lankan food that feels local and real, this is the spot!

Food was really delicious- service 10/10- such a lovely family 🫶🏻
Greetings from Germany
It was such a nice restaurant! Small, but so cozy and the nicest staff! Would recommend to everyone. Really good local food for such a good price!

Amazing food & service

The bowls were delicious

A little bit pricey for my taste especially the savoury bowls. Whereas the sweet bowls came with great portions of food.

Only thing I didn’t like is the atmosphere as its right next to the road so you hear all the cars noises & as it’s very small & they fit in there as many tables as possible to have more guests I assume, but in the end it felt tight for me.

I stumbled upon this place while traveling solo, and it honestly became one of my favorite finds on this trip. The vibe is so warm and welcoming. The kind of spot where you can sit alone and still feel completely at ease. The staff are super friendly and genuine, always smiling and checking in without being over the top. The food was amazing.  Fresh, flavorful, and clearly made with love (you can taste it!).
What I loved most is how relaxed everything felt. It’s the perfect place to take a break, read a book, or just people watch with a good coffee in hand. You can feel that easy, coastal energy all around. Good music, happy people, and such a peaceful atmosphere.
If you’re traveling alone, don’t think twice, come here. You’ll leave feeling lighter, full, and probably with a few new friends.

We had smoothie bowls and a savory bowl with hummus, all were delicious. The smoothie bowls were smaller than in other places we have been to, but therefore actually the right size for us to not be overstuffed. The matcha was also tasty and they have oat and coconut milk as milk alternatives.
Ask the smoothie bowls without granola to make them gluten free.

The best breakfast with the best smiles. Delicious food and coffee with lots of vegan options, great place to sit and relax with the best breakfast bowls I’ve eaten in a long time. Thank you for doing everything right and for making my morning every morning!

Great and amazing menu. The food was so good. We loved it here.

The location itself might be small and next to the road. The prices are a bit too high but you’d get great food in return. There is also a small shop included but that was not our thing. The staff is super friendly, great English and we’re helping us perfect.

Also; thank you for helping us to facilitate with our family. You have chooses yourself to put the herbs on the side. Thank you! This is how service should be.

We love your Banana bread 😍🫶🏼

Must go!!!!

formatted_address: Central, Dharmarama Road, Ahangama 80650, Sri Lanka
name: The Benison Restaurant

reviews.text:
We had the most wonderful stay. The owner was absolutely fantastic and constantly made sure we were comfortable and happy. He helped us with even the smallest things and truly went above and beyond.

The surroundings are breathtaking. A beautiful room with an outdoor shower, surrounded by huge green trees, plants, birdsong, and little squirrels. The sweetest and most friendly monkeys, squirrels, and peacocks roam around freely. The jungle truly meets luxury here. There is honestly no need to visit Yala Park when you have all this wildlife right in the backyard🤩🐒

Everything was nice and clean. The two young men who take care of the cleaning are incredibly kind and do a great job.

The food was amazing, and the two sweetest girls in the restaurant provided excellent service with warm smiles.

The Benison Restaurant is amazing and beautiful place. The atmosphere is elegant yet relaxed, and you immediately feel well taken care of. Im not really into Sri Lankan food, but the curry here is absolutely incredible. So good I forgot to take a photo😄

We will definitely come back!

I had breakfast at Benison and it was a wonderful experience. The food was fresh, flavorful, and beautifully presented. The breakfast options were well-prepared and satisfying, making it the perfect start to the day.

The staff were friendly, attentive, and made sure everything was just right. The atmosphere was calm and comfortable, which made the whole dining experience even more enjoyable.

Highly recommended for anyone looking for a great breakfast spot! 😊

We stayed at the new accommodation and absolutely loved it. The place is beautifully designed like a small resort, surrounded by lots of greenery and a lovely pool. You can hear birds all around and even watch monkeys nearby, which makes the atmosphere really special. The rooms are all new, modern, and very comfortable. The restaurant offers delicious local dishes, and the staff is kind and welcoming. We had a wonderful stay and would definitely come back :)

Hidden gem in Ahangama! We stayed for 2 nights and wish we had longer. Great room with lots of wildlife by the swimming pool. The food in the restaurant was brilliant, we breakfast and lunch twice. The staff are very kind and helpful. Highly recommend!

This is the perfect place to come and relax, have a great cup of coffee or a cold fresh juice, escaping the very busy Ahangama town and only a five minutes drive away... We have been a couple of times for brunch which has been very good!! The service was impeccable! From the moment we walked in, the service was outstanding. We were greeted warmly and looking forward to visit again soon!!!

We were probably among the longest-staying guests at this hotel, and from the very first moment we felt completely comfortable and welcome. Ana and Carlos made sure that everything was always handled perfectly. You can really feel how much they care about their guests and the place itself.

The breakfast every morning was incredible and truly made our day. Starting with fresh fruits and high-quality ingredients, it gave us so much energy. They were also very flexible — whenever we wanted to have breakfast a bit later or needed something specific (like special milk), they were always happy to accommodate us.

The room is beautifully and stylishly decorated. The bed was extremely comfortable, and we always slept very well. Whenever we had a request — fresh towels, more soap, or anything else — it was immediately taken care of.

The Wi-Fi had a few minor issues from time to time, but honestly, sometimes it’s nice to be a little offline.

We also had the chance to try their sushi, which we absolutely loved!

We will be coming back to Ahangama soon, and we will definitely book this hotel again for a few nights. We truly enjoyed everything and can highly recommend staying here.

The location is very calm and central. The pool area is very beautiful. The owners are friendly and lovely persons. Staff is super good also. The room is perfect, with space, the best mattress and pillows, super comfortable. And I asked for dinner in my room and they served me the best ceviche ever.The best villa in ahangama.
The hotel is amazing! But what makes it a great stay are the hosts. Ana and Carlos, thank you for being warm and hospitable. Can’t recommend it enough :)

I had a wonderful stay here for 4 days and couldn’t recommend this place more. The villa is beautifully designed, with great attention to detail, and feels calm and welcoming from the moment you arrive. Breakfasts were excellent 👌

What really makes this place special is the hosts. They are genuinely kind, attentive and always willing to help, making you feel truly welcome.

I recommend this place 100%.

Stayed one night at Together and everything was perfect. The hotel is new and it looks amazing. We arrived early and because the room was ready they allowed us to check in early. The hosts and the staff were very kind.
Definitely a recommended place if you want to stay within walking distance of all places in Ahangama

OMG best french toast wow. Best breakfast I’ve had in Sri Lanka yet. The smoothie was delicious, we had the ‘Island Yogurt Swirl’ one. The service was great, we weren’t waiting too long and it was a lovely chill vibe to start the morning and super close to the beach! My friend loved her coffee too. 10/10 recommend

I ordered the tuna bowl and it was absolutely delicious. The tuna tasted very fresh and well-prepared, and all the ingredients complemented each other perfectly. Overall, all the food felt fresh and high quality. The environment is very cozy and inviting, making it a great place to relax and enjoy a meal. I would definitely come back again.

Absolutely loved the experience at Makai Cafe! Kalum and Milinda were fantastic super friendly, attentive, and welcoming. They served me a smoothie that was incredibly fresh, delicious, and perfectly made. The cozy, relaxed atmosphere made it even better. Amazing service and great vibes overall. Definitely one of the best spots in Ahangama. can’t wait to come back! 🌴🥤

Absolutely delicious! 🌟
Fresh, beautifully presented, and packed with flavor. The poke bowl was perfectly balanced with vibrant ingredients and rich sauces, while the dessert was light, sweet, and indulgent without being overwhelming. Every bite felt thoughtfully prepared. Highly recommended for anyone who loves quality food and great presentation!
Best lunch i had só far, really big portions and so fresh and tastefull! The waiter was extremly kind and helpfull. Love this place! 🙏🤩
Really delicious food, freshly prepared... The little boy serving was the cutest. Mango & passionfruit smoothie was perfectly thick. It was so good that we ordered a second one. Thank you.

Okay my friend recommend. I was greater at the lane by two kids on bicycles who saw I was a little lost. They shouted Rural House is the best. Truth… it is. But don’t expect a run of the mill tourist trap. It’s a family backyard eatery and the cooks are Mom and Grandma 👩  👵 . Okay enough, this place is a dream for those with soul.

I love finding these small places with authentic local food. And this one was amazing!! I got the first dish on the menu and it was full of flavour and I loved every bite. But the best part was the cute and super attentive little waiter. I will defin be back!

What an amazing little find. Just a house with a couple of tables outside. Nithuja was the little guy who looked after us, he is full of personality and you can tell he loves having tourists visit to practice his English. The food was amazing if I could give more stars I would, you certainly won’t go hungry either as the portion sizes are massive. If you’re looking for traditional Sri Lankan food served in a local home then look no further, probably the best meal I have had so far in Sri Lanka. Thank you for making us so welcome in your home.

The best local food in town! I ordered Kottu and was incredibly tasty. Also, I felt so welcomed by the family - they even gave me to try waraka for free. I waited a bit for my food but the place is so calm that was a great space for myself.

name: Green Bamboo Shade rice and curry

reviews.text:
Chatu and the whole family have a special place in my heart ❤️
The cooking class with Chatu is highly recommended—you learn so much that you can truly bring home with you. Especially her energy is something I’m grateful to carry with me as a core memory.
The food is sooooo good. The most fresh, varied, and personal cooking class, with all the spices you can dream of. Green Bamboo literally has every spice used in the Sri Lankan kitchen, so you get the full experience of the incredible depth and richness of Sri Lankan cuisine.
Since I live so nearby, I’m here almost every day now (not kidding!) and I’ll be back as soon as I return to Ahangama ❤️
Thank you, Chatu, Amma, Tata, and the rest of the family, for being my home away from home here!

Highly recommend if you want to get away from the craziness in Ahangama. The food is made completely fresh, v authentic Sri Lankan cuisine. The staff are incredibly sweet and attentive. We were joined by the owners cat for lunch (coconut roti and dhal). A must visit in Ahangama, wish we’d tried the curry!!

Good prices and good food, half of the food was cold but it was fine. We got chicken rice and curry. There is a language barrier and a little slow service. Free dessert was one piece of watermelon each. The music was loud. Can’t complain because of the prices, would recommend.

100% recommended! 🥳 Meeting Chathu and her family and getting to know the amazingly delicious Srilankan cuisine is truly a lifetime experience! Felt like home!! 🥰 In our 3 week Sri Lanka trip the time spent in Green Bamboo was definitely a core memory for us! ✨

We had a really lovely dinner here. From the moment we arrived the staff were so friendly and accommodating and gave some great recommendations. I’d highly recommend getting one of the 5 curry dishes, you get a large plate of various different curries, rice and popadoms which were all delicious! Really good value for money as well and a perfect spot if you’re looking for a more relaxed meal away from the main road.

If you’re in Ahangama, you have to eat here! We’ve tried every cafe in town over the last few months, and this is the best for brunch. The food is unique—especially the prawn sandwich with its rich sauce and the best syrniki around.
The vibe is very 'Berlin loft' meets tropical garden. It's one of the few places that stays cool and comfortable during the midday heat. We also loved watching the black monkeys play in the trees nearby. A total gem!

One of the best spots for authentic specialty coffee. The space is cozy, surrounded by lush greenery, and run by a friendly team that genuinely cares about your coffee experience. Highly recommended for anyone looking for a great cup of coffee and a peaceful pause.
My favourite coffee in Ahangama! Also tried the banana oat meal today and it was delish. I love the vibe of this place, so aesthetic and super peaceful. The staff are so friendly too!

A lovely, quiet place away from the road. It even makes you want to speak almost in a whisper — the atmosphere is friendly and calm, with no unnecessary rush or queues.

The food is good — nothing extraordinary, but everything is fresh: the ciabatta was soft, the hummus very smooth and delicate, and the coffee was nice. The waiting time was about 15–20 minutes.

The staff are very polite and welcoming. Overall, we had a really pleasant experience. We recommend it 🥰

Flat white Coffee was okay, had some better in Sri Lanka. The alternative milk was way to expensive and they only have oat milk as an option. The magic coffee was really good. The syrnik was also really tasty. Just a bit overpriced for what you get to be honest.

formatted_address: Behind the police station, Ahangama 80650, Sri Lanka
name: Harvest Moon Cafe and Restaurant

reviews.text: A truly wonderful local food spot! The service was incredibly warm and welcoming—it honestly felt like being at home. The food was absolutely delicious, with flavors that were perfectly balanced. I’ll definitely be coming back again.

Very nice place with a relaxed atmosphere.
The food is tasty and well prepared, with good portions.
Friendly family
Would definitely come back.

Super lovely family and deli coconut roti !!
It’s always nice to come back (just plan ahead some waiting time.. you can order in advance :)

Amazing food with generous portions for a really fair price. It's a lovely family run place and they're all super nice and welcoming. Will definitely go again and chose it over the overpriced main street places any time!

A truly wonderful restaurant that I’ve visited many times and absolutely love. The food is incredibly good, honestly, some of the best rice and curry in Ahangama. The place is always lively, with lots of children creating an amazing atmosphere, we dance with them and enjoy great conversations, which makes every visit special. The two hosts are exceptionally friendly and welcoming. Located just behind the railway tracks, this is a place I can highly recommend, and we will definitely keep coming back.

formatted_address: Pokuna Road, Piyadegama, Ahangama 80650, Sri Lanka
name: SĀMA Ahangama

reviews.text:
We had an amazing stay at Sama Ahangama! Honestly, everything was perfect, the staff, the room, the food, everything exceeded our expectations.

Jason, the manager, went above and beyond to handle everything seamlessly and make our stay effortless. A special shoutout to Suraj, Nick, and Jaeren for their warmth and incredible hospitality, you could really feel their care and attention in every detail.

The food and cocktails were so good we didn’t even eat anywhere else. The Sri Lankan dinner they prepared was a highlight, and the breakfast was easily the best we’ve ever had on a vacation. We also loved being able to curate our meals exactly to our taste, such a thoughtful touch that made the experience feel even more personal.

Sama is truly a gem in Ahangama, and we already know we’ll be back soon. Cannot recommend it enough.

This was my second time staying at Sāma, a beautiful haven just a few steps away from the beaches and main street of Ahangama. The atmosphere is serene and peaceful, making it the perfect place to unwind.

The pool is stunning, and the entire property is beautifully and thoughtfully decorated, with attention to detail evident in every aspect of the hotel. I also love how they support the local community through the materials and products they use — it adds so much meaning to the experience.

The staff are friendly and always willing to help, adding a warm and welcoming touch that makes the stay even more special.

The food is incredibly creative, beautifully presented, and most importantly, absolutely delicious. The cocktails are just as impressive and pair perfectly with the meals.

Sama continues to be a standout destination, and I can’t wait to visit again.

We didn’t stay in the rooms but ate in the beautiful restaurant. This is a hidden gem just off the main road.
The food was exceptional. No kidding! Really top London fare with knowledgeable staff who gave wine recommendations which worked.
Five stars for food. Five stars for service ( lovely staff!)
And as many stars as I could possibly give for value for money! The prices were incredibly reasonable for such high quality food!

I had a really really pleasant time at Sama, from the service, to the room and the amazing food!!! 😍😋

The staff is very very attentive, and make sure you are comfortable. For example I was seating in the evening at the pool and someone came to put an incense stick for mosquitoes. Small detail that make the difference.

The food is really good, tasty and beautiful to watch. I recommend 100% the jackfruit lasagna, my gooood 🤤🤤🤤. And also the French fries are amazing, like (better) than home.

And finally, the room is gorgeous, well equipped, comfortable bed. And delicacy waiting for you with your name, as I said, nothing is missing here

Thank you so much 🙏🏽
I’ll be back for sure 🥰

We had dinner here while in ahangama, and it was the best meal we had! Wonderful food and great service. Our young man server was very attentive.

Great cocktails too go with the great food!the food is full of flavour and unlike anything else we had so far. Great prices too!

We got;
Chicken tacos
Tuna crudo
Gnocchi
Fried chicken
And triple cooked fries.

And we got to be the first to try a new cocktail recipe they are creating. 5/5 loved it. 😊

formatted_address: Ambagahawatta, Digaradda, X9H9+7QV, Ahangama, Sri Lanka
name: Green Blend

reviews.text: Amazing food I eat ahangama 🥰🥰🥰🥰🥰🥰🥰🥰🥰🥰🥰

I am very happy that I got to enjoy a unique meal. Thank you for the great service and the good food. The friendliness is excellent. I highly recommend it to all of you. Go and enjoy that lovely and tasty place...

Honestly - come here - this is absolute sensational curry and rice!!! Everything is cooked and prepared freshly on order. Each dish is a tasty flavor bomb, the variety is insane and the price is so low.
Great curry :)
Recently opened family run restaurant in the hood. Rich flavors and smooth taste for a great value of money. Highly recommend!
New family-run restaurant with good value for money. We enjoyed our delicious Kottu and Coconut Roti with Chicken Curry.
Very clean, cozy, it's insanely delicious to lick your fingers! They made a compliment and treated me to cheesecake. I recommend it. We'll definitely come back again

Really nothing special.

The whole place has a kinda sad vibe to it. We arrived & there was no one yet all the menus were thrown around on a table, to tell how messy & not looked after the place is.

The server that attended us was nice & that’s where the positive things i have to say about this place finish.

The food was truly average. I ordered their special plate. The chicken didn’t look fresh at all, it looked like they bought the chicken fried & kept it in the freezer. The beans were from a HEINZ box you can also get at the supermarket & the price to quantity really seemed like a joke.

I understand that the area can be a bit more expensive but it is at least normally justified by the quality of the food. Here i didn’t felt like it at all.
Their quesadilla are truly amazing. They have an incredible team of staff. We highly recommend their food. We wish them the best. Amigos kitchen

Good drinks, better food, and the best service.

A big plate of chicken kottu and an ice cold beer we’re very refreshing after a day at the beach!

Dinner and drinks for two was a bargain. Will be back soon!
The food is very delicious. The restaurant is new but very well kept. It's called Amigos Kitchen. I recommend it as the best place for food.
Food amazing, service incredible and the place was so vibrant. Recommended!

Good food
Nice staff
Clean toilet
Nice decoration
Good americano
Visa master is ok
Great food and service! Plus payment with card or cash
Very tasty food and coffee

We ordered through WhatsApp and they were so helpful and easy! The food was so delicious and healthy and fresh. We’d definitely go back!!! And they give you a delicious welcome drink on arrival. Staff were so friendly too. Highly recommend

formatted_address: No 5 Galle Road, Ahangama 80650, Sri Lanka
name: Soko Ahangama

reviews.text: Fantastic experience from start to finish. The staff were welcoming, professional, and genuinely kind. A special mention to Tharindu, who handled customers exceptionally well and provided outstanding customer service. The atmosphere was cozy and comfortable, making it perfect for both casual meals and special occasions. The food was delicious and well portioned, and everything arrived at the perfect temperature. It’s clear this place is well managed and truly values its customers.

We had a wonderful dining experience. The service was great, and the staff really took good care of us. We enjoyed some drinks, and the food was absolutely delicious. We’ll be coming back soon. Highly recommended for Sri Lankans and foreigners alike!

Great food and excellent customer service!

I had a wonderful experience at Soko Restaurant in Ahangama. The food was delicious, well-prepared, and full of flavor. Every dish was fresh and beautifully presented.

What truly stood out was the customer service – the staff were friendly, attentive, and always ready to help with a smile. The atmosphere was calm and welcoming, making it a perfect place to relax and enjoy a good meal.

Highly recommended for anyone looking for tasty food and great service in Ahangama!

I had a great experience at Soko Ahangama. The food was really tasty and the cocktails were excellent. The whole place has a good vibe, relaxed, stylish, and perfect for an evening out. They also had beautiful live music with a piano and violin duet, which created a really nice atmosphere. The staff were very friendly and made me feel welcome from the moment I walked in. Overall, a lovely spot in Ahangama. Definitely worth a visit!

We had such a lovely time at Soco Ahangama! 🌴✨

My daughter ordered the chocolate milkshake, and it was absolutely perfect — rich, creamy, and full of real chocolate flavor. She loved every sip! 🍫🥤

The brownies were simply wonderful — warm, soft, and beautifully indulgent. Every bite was pure happiness.

The atmosphere was relaxed and welcoming, making it a perfect place to sit back, enjoy great desserts, and spend quality family time.

Highly recommended if you’re in Ahangama and looking for delicious treats and a cozy vibe. We’ll definitely be back! 💛

The property itself is absolutely beautiful and very clean, the staff is lovely but unfortunately, our experience was ruined by the owner’s behavior. We booked directly with him for 7 nights and he even offered us a very good discount. After checking in at evening, we discovered there was no hot water. When we addressed this, the owner said that there is no hot water at all in the accommodation. Nobody told us about it before. He was dismissive and just said that no one else complains about it. For 60€ a night in your accommodation, hot water should be a standard or at least mentioned during a direct booking if not available. We decided to stay 1 night and check out the next morning. Although he initially agreed to a full refund if we checked out, he suddendly changed his mind the next morning. He tried to charge us 50% of the total 7-day stay because otherwise, he said it‘s bad for his business. Personally, we would never choose an accommodation without hot water because for us it’s just simply very important. He accused us of lying about our reasons for leaving and claimed we only do this because the room is "too expensive" for us. The owner didn’t even took our concerns serious and made us feel like we are the problem. After a long and very unpleasant argument with him, we finally got our money back but the lack of professionalism and the disrespect we faced was unacceptable. It’s a shame because the room was great but I can not recommend a place where guests are treated this way. It’s our second time in sri lanka but our first time experiencing this behavior in an accommodation.  Save yourself the trouble and be careful if you value transparent communication, honesty and trustworthiness.

Also please be aware: on booking.com still exists a fake/scam of the real Sankhara accommodation.  The owner knows but it’s important to mention here too!

The rooms are new, clean and very comfortable. Location is amazing, I would walk to the main bars even though I had a Tuk Tuk. Having a balcony is the cherry on top.
Highly recommended.

I loved my stay at Sankara so much that I decided to cancel my other booking and stay for longer. The rooms are stunning, the owner is great and the location couldn't be better. I will definitely be back.

Everything was just amazing – from the location and the stunning rooms to the outstanding service. The owner is incredibly kind, speaks excellent English, and is always willing to help with anything you need. The rooms are brand new, beautifully designed, and impeccably clean, with great attention to detail. I highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a high-quality stay and anunforgettable experience
I didn’t stay but they have a lovely restaurant, well priced, good food and good service

formatted_address: Gajanayaka waththa,piyadigama west gajanayaka waththa, Ahangama 80650, Sri Lanka
name: Yum Pizza

reviews.text: Excellent pizza - thin crust, crispy, wood fire pizza. Yummy ketchup sauce. Good quality ingredients, fresh taste. My son had Margherita pizza from there multiple times in our trip.
Delicious and affordable pizza. The medium is 9inch and the large is 12inch. Lovely setting and friendly team.
Very good quality overall, can't get any better in Sri Lanka. Good pizza and Greek Salad. Fast Service and Decent Prices
Such a beautiful evening, a cozy atmosphere, and friendly staff. But the highlight is the delicious wood-fired pizza. Thank you for having us. Simon

Yum Pizza indeed!

Had an excellent experience at Yum Pizza with my friends.
The excellent food, reasonable price, good service and the peaceful ambience was the cherry on top.

If you are looking for a peaceful place with reasonable prices to hangout with friends or family, this is definitely a highly recommended place.

Located in the main road, in Ahangama, this is definitely easy to locate. There was less parking space around, but the excellent state of food and services covered up that.

Overall, it was a nice experience with excellent food.

Such a nice place! Delicious food and the best smoothie bowl in Ahangama. The coffee is really nice and they have the best oat milk. On good days they can also do very special latte art (if you ask for it). 😁 Have been several times and the staff was always attentive.

First time I’ve gone out after having my baby, and this little dinner felt so refreshing. The place was calm and cozy, just what I needed. The food was genuinely delicious. Cauliflower bites with the perfect seasoning, fresh and colourful tacos, and a chilled glass of wine that felt like a small celebration. Everything was simple, thoughtful, and really well done. Such a nice way to step out again… I’ll definitely be back ♥️

Great food, and I love the new rooftop terrace—you can even spot a few surfers in the distance.

The tamarind cauliflower bites and juices were my favorite, though honestly everything we tried was delicious. Each dish has its own distinct flavor, and everything tastes incredibly fresh. It’s on the pricier side, but completely worth it. Definitely will stop by again!

The food is divine! Highly recommend. Its super clean in the restaurant and the food is super delicious. They have gluten free and vegan options. I got the crispy tofu burger - it was so yummy and I got the snickers banana bread for dessert and omg I went straight to heaven and it came with vegan coconut ice cream which was out of this world. They also have one of the best clothe shops in weligama in my opinion. Staff are so kind, warm and friendly. It's got chill vibes. The music is at a nice calm volume and its just overall super sweet, cosy and pretty.

We tried their choco cashew butter jar, and honestly, it’s the best I’ve ever had. Smooth, rich, and beautifully sweet — truly exceptional. The service was fantastic as well!

Overall, a great spot with a lovely vibe — calm music, a cool atmosphere, and definitely worth recommending.
Yummy foods. Friendly service , feel like a home, ❤️

Good place
Very good Food🍔🥪🍟🌮

Nice place.
Very Good Good 👍 👍 👍 🥪🥪🥪🍔🍔🍔🍔🍔🍔🍔
Good Service
The days curry was delicious and good price. Vibe was also great
delicious food

We are not staying here, we only came for dinner and had a fab time. Newly opened, the food and service were excellent. Great view over the sea, chilled vibes, just a nice place to be. The Cashrew Chicken was banging!!! Definitely recommend this place

The place has such a warm, inviting vibe with a lovely atmosphere. The food was outstanding—beautifully presented, full of flavor, and truly delicious. The coffee was excellent too. The staff were exceptionally friendly and professional, which made the whole experience even more enjoyable. I highly recommend checking this place out.

Absolutely amazing place! Every single dish we tried was super delicious, full of flavor, and beautifully prepared.
The atmosphere is lovely and welcoming, and the staff are friendly and attentive, which makes the whole experience even better. This is one of those places you keep thinking about after you leave and definitely want to come back to.
Highly recommended to anyone who loves really good food — a true gem!

I visited this restaurant during Christmas, and it was absolutely lovely. The place is so cozy and has a nice atmosphere. The food was amazing,delicious and very well presented,and the coffee was excellent as well. The staff were incredibly friendly and professional, which made the experience even better. I 100% recommend visiting this place.

Great beachside restaurant!  The location is perfect, right in front of the beach, and the atmosphere is relaxed and enjoyable.
The menu is good with plenty of tasty options, and everything we had was really nice. Service was friendly and quick, and the staff made us feel very welcome. Go for the tuna bowl!

A great place to chill, enjoy good food, and watch the waves. Would definitely recommend!

Absolutely fantastic restaurant! The food was incredibly delicious, fresh, and full of authentic Sri Lankan flavor. The prices were very reasonable, making the whole experience even better. The staff was friendly and attentive, and the atmosphere felt warm and welcoming. They truly deserve a great rating — highly recommended!

We were looking for local authentic Sri Lankan cuisine and Baboo has it! We opted for the buffet food, which allows you to put together a vegetarian dish. One can order meat, chicken or fish separately and it will be cooked on the spot and added to your buffe. That was for dinner, we will be back to try their breakfast

We visited  mirissa for long weekend and on the way to thalpe beach we had lunch here and the food was so good.authentic srilankan food..All the curries tasted so good specially the polas curry and batumoju.The price was reasonable..The atmosphere was great.I would definitely come with my family again
The people who served us had great hospitality. Very nice people.❤️❤️
I would highly recommend this place for anyone in ahangama

Lovely spot, super cozy and the staff was just great people! I had the veggie burger which was nice, and loved the little side salad. I will come back for their buffet which looked amazing and for a great price as well.

Our go to restaurant in Ahangama.

+++ rice and curry buffet (aubergine and sambol are >>>)
+++ tuna kottu 10/10
+++ classic Sri Lankan breakfast
+++ Baboo can even make you some nice pasta
+++ vibe & people

Tahini & Friends is such a wonderful place🙏
I came here for a yoga session and absolutely loved the peaceful atmosphere practicing with the ocean right in front of me felt truly special.
After yoga, I ordered the shakshuka, which was incredibly delicious and full of rich flavor.

The beautiful sea view makes you want to stay longer. I sat there reading my book, enjoying the ocean breeze, and it honestly felt like a cozy little sanctuary.
The staff were friendly, the vibes were calm, and the whole place felt warm and welcoming.
Highly recommend it to anyone looking for great food, good energy, and a relaxing time by the ocean

We enjoyed our stay here. The location is very convenient, about a 15-minute walk to Kabalana Beach. The room was clean and modern, and the shala with direct beach access is truly amazing.

That said, we do feel the place is overprice (it was the most expensive accommodation of our entire trip). The room is quite small, and while the breakfast is nice, it’s not as complete as those we had at other places (note that fruit and coffee is not included, for example). The yoga classes are also not included, which would have been a great addition given that there are only two rooms (a max of 4 guests) and yoga is one of the main selling points.

On a positive note, there was a jam session one evening, which was cosy and fun.

I had brunch at the restaurant and have no experience with the rooms.
The place is well located directly at the waterfront with a great view. It's decorated in oriental style and doubles as a yoga shalla in the mornings.
The food was okay but not for the upmarket price. Others places have definitely more to offer even for less.
The hummus was recognizable as such.
The staff isnsuper friendly.

Amazing Food and Atmosphere. I would say that I have been already in 3 days few places to eat and this One I enjoyed the food because It was fresh not very oily. In Sri Lanka they use lots of oil and the food here was very fresh and healthy food, even the fried chips and the bread/pitta. Also the staff and people were very friendly and kind.

Only thing I was no very comfortable was the toilet... It was full of water all over ... However I do 💯 recommend this place.

Had a lovely stay in one of the two rooms at Tahini. The view from the balcony was great to spot the surf on the few local breaks accessible on foot and the owner has a few (used) performance board for rental. Everyone there is kind and helpful, and F&B is equally enjoyable. Nice community around this place, cheers

Fab Sri Lankan food, off the beaten track (7 min Tuk Tuk from main ahangama) definitely from the heart authentic family kitchen business. Very relaxed atmosphere with beautiful plants everywhere and some chill doggos. The rice and curry is consistently delicious and fresh and offers nice variety within the meal. My favourite part was the yellow Dahl made with split peas - it can only be described as soul food. The juices they serve complement the food well. Worth a trip for some peaceful and nourishing energy ☺️
Had a lovely lunch here! Food was delicious and portions were definitely big enough to share. Service was friendly and atmosphere was relaxing!
This place is fantastic. We came for dinner and it was super calm, far from the busy main road. The service was really nice and food was delicious. Will definitely come back.
I love Kottu (a sri lankan dish with roti) and they did it really well! Nice smaller place a bit from the beach so it was more quiet and calm.

Very nice place. Just a short drive off the main road but definitely worth it. Hidden gem.
Cosy atmosphere and delicious food.

We had a wonderful experience at this restaurant in the Ahangama area. The place is very clean and well maintained, which we really appreciated. The food was fresh, delicious, and beautifully served.

The prices are very reasonable for the quality you receive. Everything tasted amazing, and the atmosphere was relaxed and welcoming.

We truly enjoyed our visit and would definitely recommend this place to anyone staying in Ahangama. We’ll be happy to come back again!

BEST meals we had during our visit to Sri Lanka
Stumbled across this place near our hotel and I’m so glad we did, the staff were super friendly and the food was even better. Well presented and with the high quality ingredients  the flavours were spot on. PS we are here multiple times so consistent too.

The place is really beautiful. It was very quiet when I went but the food, service and everything was fantastic. I even ordered another meal to take away to eat the next day. I was also working a bit on my laptop and the wifi was excellent. The real highlight though really was the 4 month old puppy that I got to play with the whole time!
Had a delicious meal here. I had the prawn spaghetti it was delicious, super creamy and the perfect amount of garlic. The view of the ocean is so nice. Not busy, fast and great service.

Ok, so this one of the best places I ate in Sri Lanka and I have been here a few times, it’s new and the chef is really good!! Highly recommend the tuna steak, mullet fish (fillet!) and the chicken burger

Really nice villa by the water. Owner / Management are really responsive and helpful. Rooms are spotless, really good working ac. We extended our stay 2 times! Surf spot just at the front. Walking distance to restaurants and shops.

Nice low -key villa with som Great little garden. Piante ,the chef, is great and makes the place even better! We had 14 days with a toddler, and will absolutely reccomend this to any family. The villa itself is Not perfect, but has modest comfort and is kept clean everyday. Minus: the bed could be softer and the shower could have some more power. Plus: the Staff and the view, + really friendly neighbours

Great place.
Nice environment next to beach.  Good hospitality.
Beautiful location, supporting staff
ok

A hidden gem just off the main road in Ahangama. Lovely atmosphere
Love the simplicity of the menu, curry and rice, if you’re after chips you’re in the wrong place!
We had the Veg curry and rice and the chicken curry and rice, food was lovely and very reasonably priced.

The best Sri Lankan food we had in Ahangama! My fiancée and I walked in without expectations. She was looking for something truly local, and this place delivered exactly that.

The short drive through the greenery already puts you in the right frame of mind. The setting is quiet, natural, and unpretentious.

As an Indian, I was attentive to the spice balance and depth of flavor. The food was precise, well thought out, and deeply comforting without being heavy. The pineapple juice deserves a special mention, remarkably fresh and easily one of the best I’ve had.

This is the kind of place that lets the food speak for itself. When I return to Sri Lanka, Manori’s Kitchen will be on the list.

Genuinely the most delicious traditional curry I have had in my one month in Sri Lanka. Manori and his family work super hard and make sure every table gets their food and drinks in a timely manner no matter how busy they are. Be prepared to wait for a table if you don’t call ahead to book as it’s often full - but it’s worth the wait!

Tucked away in a calm, unhurried corner far from the city’s noise, Manori’s Kitchen feels like a hidden gem. The restaurant sits right beside their home, creating the warm, intimate feeling of dining at a friend’s place — where every dish comes straight from the family kitchen to your table.

What truly makes this place stand out is the beautiful simplicity of the food. It’s comforting, soulful, and utterly delicious — the kind of flavours that feel honest and homegrown, hitting every spot just right.

If you’re ever in Ahangama, this is one place I’d wholeheartedly recommend. A humble, heartwarming dining experience you won’t forget.

I come here almost every night: best rice and curry I have ever had!
Sometimes I miss the warmness and friendliness of the Sri Lankan family places here, but I think that is because the staff gets really busy at the crowded times.
Other than that: amazing place!!

First thing  and honestly the only unforgettable thing is the location.The breathtaking views of Ahangama Beach completely steal the show. No debate this is easily one of the best spots in the area purely for the scenery.Now let’s talk about the rest.Food Average at best. Affordable, yes but lacking depth and flavour. Nothing that excites your palate. Drinks are decent, nothing spectacular.
Service 🚦Classic down south attitude. No warm welcome. Not a single genuine smile. It almost feels like they’re questioning why you dared to walk in. The arrogance isn’t selective either locals and tourists get the same cold treatment.Come for the view.
Lower your expectations for everything else🙃
Spent the whole day here and it was perfect. The food is amazing, the cocktails are spot on, and the vibe is so chill. But the real highlight? The sunset. Honestly one of the best views around

The place is great for an outdoor dining experience. Located right by the ocean, with great views of the coast and even better sunset. Food was great and service was fantastic. Staff always on point and helpful.
Will definitely check it out again.
Menu is very simple and clean, which makes it easy to make the right choice!
The tuna steak never fails but the octopus is delicious as well.
Our favourite restaurant in Ahangama. We visited several times during our stay. Excellent food at fair prices, located directly by the sea. The rice and curry is our absolute favourite!

The food and view is great. I had a great time. Until I realised I was overcharged and it kind of ruined it for me. They didn’t let me see the details but only the total (5423 LKR) which I thought was a bit high. When I checked after the prices on the menu again, I realised they charged me 26% more than I should have paid (4290 LKR)… not very professional
The smash burger satisfied my burger craving & the guys working there are so nice! Highly recommend

Two youngsters making one of the best burgers I ever had in the kitchen made of container was not on my Sri Lanka bingo card, but here we are. The beef burger melted in my mouth and it was delicious, amazing quality and taste 👏🏻

Had the chance to try out all the ohh Mami burgers
I can say it’s the baste in ahangama👏🏻 would recommend this to anyone for sure. Quality and quantity both are just perfect 🔥
Great smash burgers and crispy fries. The real thing. They take credit cards too. Highly recommend. Delicious!
Really nice burgers, Prashith makes the best burgers in the town. Really nice guy. Best burger chef in Ahangama

A very sweet older lady who creates delicious food for a very small price. You never quite know when the stand will be open, but whenever it is, it’s absolutely worth stopping by.

If you want to try some authentic local food instead of the many fancy cafés around, this little spot is a real recommendation.
Perfect and easy after surf-breakfast! Hoppers are very tasty, people are super friendly and it’s real Sri Lankan :)
Nice sri lankan hoppers, quick service, freshly made.
Crispy egg hoppers made to order, really nice. Seasoned with salt and pepper

formatted_address: ODARA FOOD & RESTAURANTS, Matara Rd, Ahangama 80650, Sri Lanka
name: Odara Foods & Restaurant

reviews.text:
Very underrated place. Food is amazing, portions are crazy big and prizes crazy low. 800 LKR for fried rice with a smal portion good for two people is a steal!!
Good for cheap and tasty dinner!
Visuales this local cafe on the way to matara. It’s a basic restaurant and they serve lunch n snacks. Be ware of the coffee it’s quite huge glass. Very kind staff.

✍️We visited Odara Foods & Restaurant in Ahangama and got two mixed kottu as takeaway 🍱. Each was priced at Rs. 1800💰, and the portion size was decent for the price.

The taste was okay — not exceptional, but fine for a quick meal 👍. The restaurant also has a dine-in area 🍽️, which looked clean and well maintained.

Overall, a fair option if you're in the area and want a quick takeaway or casual meal 🚗💨. Nothing too special, but it serves the purpose.
The best rice & curry spot in Ahangama! Been eating from here for awhile. Its amazing how many ways they do vegetables & the offerings on a daily basis.

the portions are generous. ordered fried rice. rice was fresh, warm and flavored but the chicken was very dry and old. no energy or life left innit. charged me for the takeaway container and then got home and got food poisoning. takeaway probably better option as atmosphere was strange. good sambal. will i be back? unsure. wanted to support local food but not if it isnt quality or nice service

This is truly paradise. Beautiful rooms in what feels like the jungle, but such an easy walk to Ahamgama main area and beach. Champi was such a great host. The breakfast was the best food I've had in Sri Lanka. I will be coming back again and again. The rooms were beautiful, comfortable beds and super soft sheets and pillows. Was so cool learning about cinnamon.

Amazing Experience!

This was one of the most unique stays of my life. You are practically living in a treehouse, surrounded by nature—cinnamon trees, coconut trees, monkeys, and other wildlife. The design of the tree house is very nice with big space, comes with air condition and a comfortable bed. The open-air bathroom is also a very special and memorable experience.

A big highlight was the host and his family, who were incredibly kind and welcoming. Each day they prepare amazing and delicious local breakfast. The host also took time to explaine the whole process of how cinnamon is made.

Just keep in mind that this type of stay is not for everyone—you really need to understand that you are fully immersed in nature (e.g. animal noises, more mosquitoes etc)

Overall highly recommended.

Absolute gem - if you’re looking for a quiet base in Ahangama, you should definitely consider Cinnamon Paradise.

The chalets are very well done, comfortable and clean. Morning (outdoor) shower with monkeys swinging nearby is a memorable experience. Of course being surrounded by nature means animals can get noisy at night and there’s more mosquitos, but the whole place felt overall very peaceful and we had good rest.

But the absolute highlight is the amazing family in whose care you’ll be - breakfast from the lady of the house is varied and delicious, the owners can arrange anything (laundry, scooter) and they try to meet your wishes and needs. I felt their heart is in running this small paradise.

Thank you!

I loved this beautiful spot nestled behind Ahangama. The owners run a cinnamon farm but have built a few cabins on the property. The cabins are clean, big enough for a couple, with a awesome shower that feels like you are standing in warm rain, there's a light smell of cinnamon everywhere, the breakfast is good and there is a lot of charming wildlife critters running around including the squirrels which are funny and this was possibly the best nights sleep i had in Sri Lanka. The only thing you have to factor in is that it's a few minutes drive and 15 minutes walk from the beach/ahangama town. This really isnt a problem though as tuk tuks are 400-1500 rupee depending on where you go or the walk to town is nice where you can get a tuk on to anywhere for really cheap.

I can’t say enough good things about this place, it was absolutely incredible! Nestled right in the middle of a cinnamon plantation, you’re fully immersed in nature, yet only a few minutes by scooter from the heart of Ahangama. The rooms are fantastic: cozy, spotless, with super comfortable beds, and the bathroom is just amazing! But the real highlight is the wonderful people who run the place. Champika and his family were unbelievably kind and welcoming, helping us with everything and making us feel at home from the very first moment. Their breakfasts are to die for, and they always took the time to teach us about the local culture and share stories with us. Cinnamon Paradise truly made our week in Ahangama unforgettable

The Gas Point is a great spot to relax, eat fresh seafood and take in the fantastic views. The restaurant has a lovely vibe and the staff are very friendly and attentive. The food is excellent and specific fresh fish requests can usually be made a day in advance.
The location is perfect to watching the surfers go out, or catching the sunset behind the stilt fishermen.
amazing food and such a lovely staff🤩 this restaurant is very underrated, but believe me, as soon as you step in, you will get an amazing meals ❤️
The food is delicious. The staff is very nice. Down South Sea View is the best place. Highly recommended.
Really nice staff, very service minded. The food and drinks was also good. The whole vibe on The gas point Ahangama was soo good.
Really chill layed back vibes, breathtaking view and really good food, super fresh calamari

formatted_address: No 110, 04 Matara Rd, Ahangama 80650, Sri Lanka
name: Echo Beach Lounge

reviews.text:
Beach front Lounge with access to the beach. A bit rocky but swimmable. They have changing rooms and a shower as well.
The prices are reasonable but I hope they expand the food menu.
Good coffee. And the beverage menu had a lot of options.
Friendly and attentive staff.

Would definitely recommend this place for a chill afternoon beach session.

A wonderful new place with a great atmosphere 🤍
The service is excellent, the staff are very attentive, kind, and welcoming, which makes the experience even better
The food is delicious, and the location is beautiful and relaxing
Definitely a place you want to come back to!

If you’d like to watch the sunset, this is a great place to do it ☀️

Amazing and Beautiful. Go there as long as it is not to famous.

First you walk through a mini jungle with light bulbs everywhere. Especially during evening and night it is super beautiful.

Then you come to a beautifully designed open space. You have the option to either sit at the coast line and watch the sunset or sit down at a desk for a proper meal. I recommend to first watch the sunset at the shore and then switch to the desk to have dinner. With the comfortable music in the background it is an overall great atmosphere at this place.

The service is great and the people nice. The drinks are freshly made and taste very well. The food selection is not too much and not too less. Both meals we had were having an interesting and special taste with them. Personal favorite were the chips with hummus. :)
All our orders came in a reasonable time.

Normally I do not write reviews. But here I wanted to :)

Definetely a recommendation.
This place just opened and it has everything you need. Amazing ocean views, original menu, reasonable prices and super friendly staff. Will definately be back!

Had an incredible experience at this place. The location is stunning – it’s right on the beach, and the vibe is super relaxed, making it easy to just sit back and enjoy the moment.

The staff were super friendly and welcoming, which made the whole experience even more enjoyable. The service was smooth, fast, and very professional.

The food and drinks were of great quality, fresh, and well-presented. It’s clear that they care about consistency and customer experience.

This is the perfect spot for a sunset chill, dinner with friends, or just enjoying good music and beach vibes.
A very nice place: tasty food and drinks, excellent ocean view and friendly staff. Recommended!
Awesome place to relax. Amazing customer service and great food.

We found this place by chance and ended up staying the whole day. It felt like having a private beach just for ourselves. The staff went above and beyond to make everything perfect, and the food was delicious. Highly recommended if you want to enjoy a peaceful beach and a great bar without the crowds.
Went randomly but one of the most beautiful place the customer service great the ambience super cool drinks food and the beach view acces super

Absolutely loved our visit to Flamingo Beach Restaurant, Ahangama! The beachfront location is stunning with a very relaxed, peaceful vibe. The food was fresh, delicious, and beautifully presented, and the drinks were equally refreshing. What really stood out was the warm and friendly service — the staff made us feel genuinely welcome and well looked after. A perfect spot to enjoy a meal by the ocean. Highly recommended, and we’ll definitely be back!

formatted_address: X9C8+J3H Diamond palm beach hotel, Ahangama, Sri Lanka
name: Dreamsea Restaurant

reviews.text:
Cappuccino was poor taste and long to wait.
Some menu items were not available.
Music was too loud to speak.
Very relaxed Location. We stayed here the whole day at the pool. Amazing food platter. Stayed after sun set for dinner. Delicious and good price.

Twenty minutes after we chose a table ourselves, no one brought us a menu.
We helped ourselves, which was fine.
But even after that, no one came to pick up our order.
There's no sign indicating self-service.
Half the menu is in a pile.
The coffee is so-so.
You sit there, and no one cares.
The place is generally nice, but the pool is like a puddle. It's unclear how clean the water can stay there with so much water and so many people. The music is too loud.
We ordered coffee at the bar.
We waited half an hour.
When they were making it, they spooned pre-ground coffee into the holder.
The taste was just as awful.
I don't recommend it.

The avocado sandwich with cheese is an outrage. The bread was covered with about 1mm of avocado, practically nothing, and the cheese was sloppily slapped on. Truly disappointing. On top of that, I waited a really long time for it.

I got the chicken fried rice, it was delicious! I also tried the chicken rotti and vegetable rotti, and both were really tasty. I tried the chicken kottu too, and it was so good!😋😋 They open in the evening from around 7:30 pm until midnight.

We were charged 5000 saying extra night rate for 1 kottu and 5 egg hoppers, clearly which is not the price. And despite telling them this is not the right rate we had to pay it as we had already had our order. A full scam!
Chicken rice was amazing. Open late

We were taken here by a tuk tuk driver randomly to “stop for a smoke”- and he encouraged us to buy something to eat from here and the staff completely ripped us off. They hugely overcharged vs normal roti menu pricing and wouldn’t let us leave until we had paid an extortionate amount. The tuk tuk driver who must had been in cahoots  with the restaurant was also wildly inappropriate

I'd give it zero stars if I could. Extremely unhygienic and disgusting!!! The water, which should have cost 130 LKR, was sold to us for 200 LKR. The water bottles were slimy and oily from the cooking oil used in the place. Worst of all: the water tasted like old, rancid chicken fat. I almost threw up. A complete disaster!

formatted_address: In front of the odara food, Ahangama 80650, Sri Lanka
name: CHILLORA

reviews.text: Best Burger in the whole area! The quality of the ingredients is really good, the hygiene standard high, the service great and the prices unbeatable! We‘ve been here 3 times in the last couple of days and it won’t be the last time for sure. BIG RECOMMENDATION 🤎🍔
Great burgers and wrap good portion. Sweet staff and great atmosphere if you don’t mind sound of tuk tuks on the way. Definitely fun way to have a good burger. Nasir is very reasonably priced!

Ok guys it’s opposite the petrol station and it packs a punch for flavor and price wow. We take the chicken and beef and we’ve come multiple times and it’s always so good. Burgers include salad burger sauce homemade and gurkins AND cheese

Fantastic small burger stand. I have been there multiple times. By far the best burger I’ve had in Sri Lanka. The chicken is battered and cooked perfectly. The pickles are homemade and are amazing. The guy running it is very nice. It’s also very reasonably priced at 1,000 Rs.
Unreal chicken burger!!! Street food vibes. So glad my friend recommended

I was there twice. I wasn't super impressed the first time, but it was alright. I was really disappointed the second time around. First time they failed to write down the order correctly and forgot drinks for two people, including me (there were seven of us). I ordered a tuna steak, and they made me a well-done one without asking what I wanted. The second time, we wanted to take our food to go. I checked out the pictures online, and the grilled chicken looked good on their Instagram. But instead of a few proper chicken breasts, I got three tiny pieces of chicken on a plate (I ordered a takeaway!). And they still charged 10% service for this.

The food is fine, but the portions are tiny, so it's overpriced for what you get. The wait time here is also pretty long. A nice view doesn't make up for the lousy service. There are other great spots on the beach with great food and better vibes. I don't think this one is worth it.

The Bus Stop Ahangama is easily one of the best places to grab a meal in the area. What makes it stand out is the combination of great food, friendly service, and a laid-back vibe. Their burgers are a must-try—fresh, flavorful, and cooked to perfection. The rice and curry is another highlight, offering rich, authentic flavours that instantly make you feel at home.
Whether you're a local or a traveler passing through, this spot delivers a consistently enjoyable dining experience. A great place to relax, eat well, and enjoy the charm of Ahangama. Definitely worth a visit!

We came for our final night in Ahangama. I think the rain may have deterred others as we were the only ones in the large restaurant.

Undeterred, we ordered food and a couple of cold beers.

A chicken and rice curry for me and an egg fried rice for Mrs C.

The chicken curry dish was one of the best I've had in Sri Lanka. So full of flavour and a huge portion 😋

The egg fried rice was tasty but we have been spoiled by years of Thai egg fried rice.

The staff were so friendly I highly recommend you add Bus Stop to your places to eat in Ahangama.

‎We arrived at this restaurant for dinner at around 5:30 PM. The staff here welcomed us very friendly. We got to see a sunset view that we had never seen before. After that, we ordered cocktails and food, the cocktails we got to drink were very delicious and the food was also very tasty and attractive. Also, the staff here are very friendly, they always came to us and looked after our shortcomings and took care of us with love. This was the best restaurant we went to on our trip to Sri Lanka.
‎

The atmosphere was beautiful and staff friendly and
approachable.Beer was cold and the food fresh and delicious. The fish was slightly over done but the flavours were top shelf, I got the feeling it would only get better. Places like this need support because the local owner has genuine passion and it really shows.
Delicious Burger & Submarines
So so tasty! Very good prices too

A lovely Indian restaurant right on the beach in Kabalana. The place is spacious and comfortable, with chill Indian music that really adds to the vibe. The food is tasty and full of bold spices, rich in flavor but not spicy-hot. Service was a bit slow, but overall it’s a great spot to relax, enjoy the view, and soak up the atmosphere

From the moment we enter, this restaurant feels like a complete Indian experience💫every corner beautifully reflects Indian style and culture.The beachfront setting adds an incredible sense of relaxation that’s honestly beyond words.Watching the sunset from here creates a truly picturesque and unforgettable view.The food is authentic and delicious,and even the serving style highlights traditional Indian hospitality.The staff are extremely friendly, and the customer service is top-notch, making you feel genuinely welcomed.

We had a wonderful time and I’m so happy we chose this place.Highly recommend..

Nice Indian food. We had Thalis which were both very good and had lots of different curries on them. We had a couple of starters but they were only average unfortunately. Price wise its slightly on the more expensive sinde but it still felt reasonable. It took a little while for us to order our food but generally the service was good 😊

We’ve already been here twice and absolutely love it. The food is incredibly delicious, and the service is amazing — the waiter even remembered us and what we ordered, which made us feel very welcome. The pani puri and dahi puri were outstanding, and the iced chai was so good. We’ll definitely be back again!

The most amazing place we have eaten in Southern Sri Lanka. Great (Indian) food with very nice cocktails, very friendly staff but the view of the sea and atmosphere are otherworldly. We watched the sunset with the sea lapping just 5m away. Fantastic! Next door to great ice cream place too!

formatted_address: X99C+R8H, Mahavihara Rd, Ahangama, Sri Lanka
name: The Krish Ahangama

reviews.text:
Delicious, authentic local food!
A small, humble restaurant run by a very friendly Sri Lankan owner who opened the place just few weeks ago. Everything here is fresh, genuine, and full of traditional Sri Lankan flavors. A perfect spot if you’re looking for a true local culinary experience made with heart. Highly recommended!!

Very kind local owner! He is renovating the place with a lot of love. I just walked in to have some lunch and got amazing rice and curry and a smoothie. He also packed the rest for me to take away. Would 100% recommend :) good luck with your restaurant!

Krish is very welcoming, kind and helpful! We ate a traditional breakfast here and he made us a vegan one, as we wished, and he even got us helapa!! We didn’t know what he would serve us, but that was the whole fun and it was delicious! It was an authentic experience and we loved it🤗

That place is magical.
The food was so deliciou,, that was a totally different that my usual meal, but definitely loved it. The hosts are really great, amazing, pure people that are just opened it. Definitely amazing, and the dessert was super interesting as well.
The house is old but they are renovating it and next time when we come to visit them I hope to be fully done.
Great job dear friends!
You won't regret, thank me later.🤤🤤🤤
We went there for breakfast and were very happy - the service was very kind and welcoming and the food was delicious. Waldi beautiful rural area to sit outside!

formatted_address: 92, Galle Road, Matara Rd, Ahangama 80650, Sri Lanka
name: Dreamsea Surf Camp Ahangama

reviews.text:
Dream Sea Surf Camp Sri Lanka is a hidden beachfront paradise. Perfectly located right in front of the ocean, it offers breathtaking sea views and an unforgettable tropical atmosphere.
The rooms are stylish, comfortable, and designed for pure relaxation while listening to the sound of the waves. The restaurant serves fresh and delicious food, and dining with the panoramic view of the Indian Ocean makes the experience truly special.
The combination of luxury comfort, warm hospitality, and the incredible beach location makes Dream Sea Surf Camp a perfect destination for surfers, travelers, and anyone looking for a peaceful escape in Sri Lanka.
A beautiful place where ocean, comfort, and unforgettable memories come together.
Highly recommended! 🌊✨🏝️

The location is absolutely perfect, and the camp itself is beautiful and thoughtfully designed. The people here are incredibly kind, welcoming, and always willing to help with anything. I had such a great surfing experience,, supportive instructors, great vibes, and waves that helped me improve every day. I’m really grateful for my time here and would highly recommend Dreamsea Sri Lanka to anyone looking for an unforgettable surf trip.

I had unfortunately needed to cancel my trip due to an emergency. The team was fantastic and handled the situation with exceptional professionalism and understanding.

They confirmed they will credit back the amount for the nights i had booked. good customer-first mindset and long-term relationship approach, which is rare and very much appreciated.

I’m genuinely looking forward to go to Ahangama and experience the full stay at Dream Sea since the team truly cares about its guests.

Dreamsea Ahangama is a fantastic place! The rooms are beautiful and very clean, with daily housekeeping and large lockable closets for your belongings. The location of the Camp couldn’t be better, and the whole place has a relaxed but high-quality feel to it. The air conditioning is a lifesaver for getting your stuff dry eventually.

The service team is warm and welcoming, the food is delicious, and the daily dinners after sunset are always a highlight to end the day together. The pool area is great for unwinding after surf sessions, and all rental equipment is available and in very good condition. There are also plenty of activities beyond lessons and free surf, like yoga sessions, which add a really nice balance to the whole experience. On top of that, the community you find here makes the experience even more special.

As incredible as the camp is, the instructor was a big part of why I chose to come.

One and a half years ago, I randomly chose a surf camp and having Victor as my instructor turned out to be an absolute stroke of luck.

What makes him exceptional isn’t just how good a surfer he is, but how committed he is as a teacher. His goal is never to make you dependent on him. From the very beginning, he focuses on teaching you how to read the ocean, make your own decisions, and eventually paddle out with confidence on your own. His priority is that you leave stronger and more independent than when you arrived.

He takes an incredible amount of time to coach each person individually. He quickly understands your strengths, spots your weak points, and adapts his approach accordingly. Sometimes that means encouragement, sometimes it means a push. Quite literally into the wave or mentally when you’re hesitating and overthinking.

I’ve just spent my third week learning with him, this time during one of his retreats, and it was simply incredible. It’s honestly hard to put into words how special that experience was. The atmosphere he creates, the way he brings people together, and the kind of people it attracts made it so much more than just a week of surfing.

But above all, what stands out most is his heart. Victor genuinely cares. He teaches with respect, patience, and a deep commitment to your progress. And despite taking the craft very seriously, he never takes himself too seriously. There’s always humor in the lineup, even on tough days.

If you’re looking for someone who truly wants you to succeed beyond the lesson you won’t find a better instructor.

highly recommend dreamsea ahangama! i did the weekly package and had the best time. surf instructors Victor and Leo were both incredible and i improved my surf skills a lot thanks to their help. the staff is super friendly (shoutout Ravi!), and vibes were great throughout the week. also the breakfast is the best i've ever had at any surf camp i have stayed at. i stayed in a female dorm, rooms are clean and have high standard. overall - had the best time at dreamsea and would def go again!

We went to La Bella for some snacks and drinks and had a really nice time. The ambience was beautiful, and the staff were very attentive and friendly. A special mention to Raga, who served us,  he was very warm and welcoming. We truly enjoyed our visit and would definitely come back again.

The place itself is nice, but we were really disappointed with the food. The price does not match the quality at all.

The watermelon and feta salad was a 1/10. It was supposed to be refreshing, but the cheese tasted like it had been sitting out all day in +25°C weather, and the watermelon wasn’t fresh or cold. That’s exactly what people expect when ordering this kind of salad, and it completely missed the point.

The oysters were okay, but nothing special. The cauliflower main dish was served cold, which is unacceptable. Overall, the food did not match the photos shown here.

The wine pour was also disappointing, definitely not 150 ml, more like 100 ml.

We felt very disappointed and overcharged. It’s a beautiful place, but only for the view. We definitely won’t be coming back.

If you are looking for amazing food, great cocktails and very kind and caring staff this is your place to be! ☺️ we would definitely come back and recommend you to come too. The views are spectacular and atmosphere as well.
