An excellent restaurant with a warm and lively team! The meals are delicious, well-prepared, and made with fresh seafood.
Enjoy the great atmosphere by playing a game of pool with the La Belle team, or a match of ping-pong by the water. End the day with a campfire right on the beach, feet in the sand, with a view of the ocean.
A wonderful team and a truly memorable experience!
A very cozy place next to the beach. Friendly staff and the service was great. We had pasta, fish and a chicken burger. Very delicious! I really recommend this place.
Best shawarma in shri lanka
Best late night munch

formatted_address: No 76 in front of Commercial Bank ATM, Ahangama 80600, Sri Lanka
name: Cactus

reviews.text: Well, you definitely pay for the view here. Food is good but not outstanding. The cheese cakes were pretty awful to be honest. Went twice and it’s good enough to fill you up. The chicken brioche was lacking balance, it was just fried chicken, no umami, no sweetness. The avo & eggs were lacking saltiness, the additional bacon was pretty chewy. The Fuel Have smoothie I really loved though! Overall the drinks are better than the food.

I had an amazing food experience here. I think it’s my favorite place in Ahangama and I was coming back all the time there during my holiday. The breakfast and brunch were absolutely delicious. I had Rhubarb Frenchie, Lankan Benny, Avo & Eggas and everything was fresh and flavorful. Also loved the Mimosa and Pink Cool Down juice. The staff is very friendly I they also prepared a take away for me when I needed. The interior is super cool, giving off such good vibes, and the views are just stunning. Perfect spot to relax, enjoy a great meal, and soak in the atmosphere. Highly recommend!

This cafe is beautiful like all the others in ahangama. The food was good we took a fried chicken frenzy and veg focaccia sandwich. Drinks - strawberry iced matcha and pink power.
View are great. Staff is sweet and helpful. They even helped us book a cab to the right airport.
The only thing we dint like was they take cash only.

The food was very tasty, the location is great (directly at the beach) and the waiters were helpful and fast.
The only downside is, that you have a 2h limit on the bean bags and have to consume at least 5k LKR per person. Compared to other places there directly at the beach that didn't have that policy, it feels a bit like a rip off.
Gluten free options available (e g. The greak bowl).

A lively beachfront spot. We waited a few minutes for a table, but it was worth it. The food was excellent, with moderate portion sizes. I highly recommend the rhubarb French toast.

Some tables have a minimum spend of LKR 5,000 per person and a two-hour limit. It’s not cheap and feels very Western, but the quality makes it worthwhile.

Walked past on a few occasions and finally decided to give it a go!
Very happy with the decision to do so as probably had one of the best jackfruit curries in the area!
Really tasty, generous portions and delicious!
The burger was a bit confusing! We choose a tuna burger (like to share our food when going out) yet the 2 small slices of fried tuna were a bit too dry and made burger a bit dry. Would’ve expected a nice, generous grilled tuna steak which would’ve made it what was advertised! Luckily we had a delicious tuna ceviche’s as a started so we ended up making our own burger out of the 2 dishes :)!
Came out great :)
Nevertheless, overall service was excellent with staff very attentive and friendly. Food came quickly out of the kitchen and hot, as expected.
The pool table is also a nice touch that gives you the opportunity to have a go against your bestie. Atmosphere was great on arrival with great views of the sunset over the Indian Ocean.
As the night time started to fall over the horizon, the music from the surrounding venues began to flow through and can be a bit annoying…
With all the above in mind, will definitely be looking forward to our return to try something else from their menu
Well done to the staff 🥂

Mavi- The hidden star.
The best of the best place we found during our stroll through ahangama.
It's unassuming but man this place is a vibe.
The food,their drinks and their ever smiling service. All easy on pockets. They have a pool table to chill.
Their tuna burger is the best among the places we visited there. Seafood was fresh and brimming with quality
Suggestion: Don't miss their vegan offering - the cashew Curry . It will blow your for sure even if you are non vegetarian. Wish this place and team gets more love. Can't wait to visit this place again..

Absolute hidden gem. This place has it all. Sunsets, food, pool table and just a nice space to chill. Spent so much time here whilst in Ahangama mainly due to the staff treating you like family and the food tasting amazing (probably tried every dish they do) easily up there with the best on a months long trip in sri lanka. Can not recommend this place enough, incredible place.

My partner and I went to Mavi rooftop for some lunch and what a pleasant surprise, it’s definitely a hidden gem as it wasn’t busy like some of the surrounding restaurants. I got the fisherman’s salad and it was so delicious and tasted really fresh! The staff were really lovely and we were able to play pool on what seemed like a new table for free.
Would highly recommend, think it would be particularly lovely at sunset as it has a great view of the sea!

It’s a great hotel to take chill along with your food. The food is enjoyable and not disturbing at all. In the evening, it’s a super place to relax, enjoy your meal, and cheers with your food while soaking in the peaceful vibe.

Medusa Hotel offers a different vibe, situated right in the centre of Ahangama town! Everything is within easy reach. A nice and cosy place with a lovely view of the beach! Easy access to the beach if you book a ground floor room. The beds are comfortable, and all the amenities are available if you want to cook something! I didn't meet the owner, but he/she regularly contacted us and looked after us via WhatsApp, even offering dinner as a kind gesture. We couldn't take up the offer, but we truly appreciated the thought. Finally, the price is a little above average for this type of room, but considering the season, that might be acceptable. The owners should pay more attention to the colour coating — it would make this apartment more attractive and give it a newer look.

We paid USD 422.40 for two nights at Medusa and left early because the room was not fit for accommodation.

There was no hot water with usable pressure, excessive noise, and we did not sleep at all. These are not “preferences” — they are basic hospitality standards. At this price point, the ability to shower properly and sleep should be a given.

Management acknowledged the water issue but refused to take responsibility for the impact on our stay. Instead of refunding the unused night, they repeatedly hid behind “policy” and attempted to push us into alternative accommodation at another property or accept a token 20% refund, neither of which addressed the fact that the room we paid for was unusable.

What made this experience worse was how the situation was handled. Despite early communication and a calm, reasonable request for a refund for the unused night only, management showed no willingness to resolve the issue fairly. The attitude was rigid, dismissive, and entirely one-sided.

This stay occurred over Christmas and on my wife’s birthday, which made the lack of care and accountability even more disappointing.

If you’re considering staying here, be aware:
•	The rooms are significantly overpriced for what is delivered
•	Basic issues are deflected rather than resolved
•	If something goes wrong, you should not expect fair treatment

There are far better options in the area that offer better value, better service, and far more integrity. We will not return, and I would strongly advise others to book elsewhere.

This hotel is a complete nightmare. They took full payment upfront , yet still refused to honor the booking properly. The photos online are a total scam—nothing like reality. The room was poorly maintained, dirty, and had no hot water.

There is no parking, and the place is extremely noisy, making it impossible to rest. It’s clear that guest comfort and honesty are not priorities here.

Being charged in advance and then treated poorly is unacceptable. This is unprofessional, misleading, And a worst management on top
of everything and simply not worth a single penny. Stay far away.

We booked for two days but as soon as we arrived we got to know nothing in the photos or videos in website or social media matches. We tried to cancel the booking for the next day but they refused for cancellation.

Although it was booked for two days we stayed in another resort this is a complete waste of money. . Save your money, save your time, and save your sanity

The location is excellent, but it really depends on what you’re looking for. If you want total calm and silence, this might not be the place.
If you want direct beach access, cafés nearby and to feel the life of the town around you, it’s incredible. It was perfect for us, although we understand that some lower reviews may come from people who are not used to staying in lively towns in Southeast Asia.

100% recommend

We honestly believe some of the lower reviews come from people who might not realise the property is right in the heart of the village. If you're looking for something completely remote, this might not be your place. But for us, it was perfect, clean, beautifully kept, with direct access to the beach, and full of local charm that comes because it’s in the village, not despite it.

Waking up and seeing the ocean from the bed was incredible. We’ll definitely be back.

My boyfriend and I attended the Soul and Surf Sri Lanka retreat and it was absolutely brilliant from start to finish. The level of care and attention from Justin and the surf team Ashan, Hollie, Miles, Sangeeth, Pubudu and Sanju was exceptional. You can really feel the passion that runs through the whole team. As it was my first time surfing, I felt incredibly safe and supported in the water, which made the experience even more enjoyable.

The yoga was also fantastic. Lara and Rosie led beautiful sessions that balanced the surfing schedule perfectly and gave us space to stretch, recover and slow down.

The food was delicious and thoughtfully catered to different dietary requirements, which we really appreciated. The scenery is unreal and it feels like a real haven tucked away in the busy energy of Ahangama.

Justin, the surf coach, deserves a special mention. His enthusiasm, care and deep passion for surfing are infectious. He is an incredible team leader, extremely knowledgeable, and truly dedicated to making sure everyone has the best experience possible.

We honestly could not fault anything. It was such a special retreat and we left feeling inspired, rested and excited to keep surfing.

I was really looking forward to my trip at Soul & Surf as it came highly recommended by friends. I chose this camp because I wanted to improve my surfing and experience different breaks, and it also happened to fall on my birthday week, so I was especially excited about combining surfing and yoga overlooking the ocean.

Overall, I had a fantastic experience. The first couple of days felt a little lower in energy following a large event over the weekend (which they had kindly given us notice about). The Sri Lankan surf instructors were exceptional; calm, encouraging, attentive in the water and genuinely invested in helping each of us progress.

I personally found the head coach’s communication style challenging at times. We did have an opportunity to discuss this, which helped. That said, it was clear he was committed to pushing the group and invested a lot of energy into coaching. His love for the ocean is really infectious and he chose great subjects for our theory.

The group dynamic was wonderful. I was lucky to share the week with some brilliant people, and I loved being in the water together every day. The yoga was also excellent. Rosy and Lara held space beautifully and really understood the emotional side of surfing and growth, which added depth to the experience.

I can really recommend this place to everyone who’s looking for a fully organized surf and yoga trip in Sri Lanka.

Location: I mean this is a prime location right at the beach. The facilities are not super modern but it somehow just adds to the overall chill atmosphere. Views - especially from the yoga shala are breathtaking. Big plus: they have their own - almost private surf spot: The Cove which is a true gem 💎

Surfing: Every day started at 6:15am with a morning surf session - followed by a video analysis after breakfast. We had a beginner and intermediate group going out to different spots. Loved our surf coaches - especially Justin and Sangeeth.

Yoga: Daily yoga sessions to stretch out those sore muscles were super helpful - Rosi did a wonderful job…and again: the views from the rooftop shala were so unique

Food: three meals a day - all super delicious. From modern cuisine to local curry and rice - everything was really tasty. The bar and kitchen team around Janith was super attentive and friendly.

Team: This is probably the best thing about this place: you can really feel that the team has a really strong foundation. Every single one of them - from the people managing the place, the surf and yoga instructors, the bar and kitchen staff, those doing pictures and videos - everyone always made sure we had the best time.

A really special place!

I had an amazing time at Soul & Surf- so good I extended to stay longer! The surf instructors were fantastic and I learned so much from the video analysis and theory lessons with Justin. I really appreciated the holistic approach to teaching surfing that Justin takes and I walked away with a much greater appreciation for what it means to be a surfer.

The daily yoga was fantastic and I loved how the classes were tailored to how we were feeling each day.

The food and location were amazing, but most importantly everyone who works at Soul & Surf is so lovely which makes for a really special vibe. I hope to make it back someday soon!

I attended the surf retreat in the first week of December, it was on overall 10/10 experience. The place is located by the ocean, everything is super clean, staff and the team is extremely professional from the beginning till the end. Everything is very well planned. Food is incredible. Surf lessons are well planned and coaches are really good.

We surfed 2 times a day coached by a very experienced team. I cannot emphasize enough how great is Justin as a coach. He has changed my perception to surfing forever positively.

Soul & Surf was overall a great decision, the place felt like home. I would definitely recommend to everyone who is visiting Sri Lanka to attend the retreat.

Rollingpin is a beautiful, locally owned bakery tucked away from the hustle of Ahangama. We rocked up at 6:10am and the owners were so welcoming, showed us around the bakery whilst they were heating the coffee machine up. We had banana bread (delicious!) and two really well made cappuccino’s. Highly recommend 🧡

We heard a lot about this place and just came there today the first time. The service is not the best, the girl is not really speaking with the guests and also it took a long time to receive the coffee.
All the tables have been not cleaned, and many flies have been here around, it was really disturbing while sitting there.
The cheesecake is really tasty but the chocolate nut cake was too much chocolate and we felt after not good in our stomach.
I think the bread and other stuff would be really good. But for today we didn’t have been happy with our visit there.

I tried the vegetable bagel and the sandwich there, and both were amazing! The bagel is my absolute favourite. I also had some banana bread and a croissant (which was still warm 🥹). And last but not least, they serve great coffee with oat milk(!!!).
My absolute heaven while sitting in a green backyard right next to the monkeys.

You can buy a whole banana bread at this place for 1800 rupees. Most cafes buy banana bread here and then sell it for 800 rupees a piece. They take orders in advance or you come to the place and if they have it they will give it to you. They take cards. Thank you for the amazing banana bread. We were here about 8 times during our stay✨🫶🏻💛
Overall great bread and sweets! But orders took some time and were not served warm. Would happily order bread and sweets for take away from here in the future.

Good matcha but a little greedy.
Loyalty card has mor than 10 slots its even more than starbucks.
At $12 Aud for a coffee it’s in the top 3 most expensive coffees in the world & Unfortunately just not worth the money! burnt the beans, don’t waste your money.
Honestly. The best coffee in the town, if not the coast. Small, quaint spot with banging coffee and a talented barista. Everything a Coffee Snob desires. Straight coffee, no BS.
Awesome coffee and super good service by shano, definitely recommend!!
Really great matcha!

formatted_address: opposite Ahangama Bus Station, Matara Rd, Ahangama 80650, Sri Lanka
name: Focus Hub Co-Working & Cafe Ahangama

reviews.text:
The BEST place for work. Truly. It has it all:
1. Quiet
2. Good comfy seating with many options
3. Good prices for tasty food and coffee/teas
4. Very friendly staff and very helpful with everything. Good english as well.
5. Focus room and 2 boots to have calls from.

We stayed in Ahangama literally just for this place, for whole month! Even tho we like Weligama more, it does not have any good place to work! We tried a lot really. Safe yourself time and just come here. Youre welcome in advance 😉

Comfortable place to work. Battery backups of WiFi just in case but didn’t experience any outages. Super nice staff, tasty smoothie and comfortable seating area. Not crowded which was a plus as you could take calls in the common room. Parking for cars right in front of building. Notably you get free access to an hour in a private booth with a day pass.

Very nice place to work and eat. They have a diverse menu serving many food options. From pancakes, avocado toast, poached eggs, currys and even very tasty vegan burgers. Great place to work and spend the day.

Also equiped with battery and fiber in case of power cuts.

Place very quite and good atmosphere for focused work with comfortable seating of many kinds.
Food was very good, freshly made, great portions and fair prices! Coworking space is quiet, internet high speed and owner is kind, accommodating and super helpful for whatever you need.

I have worked here for 3 weeks and I have truly enjoyed it. The silence, the Skype rooms and the wonderful service made it perfect for me to focus on my work. And the coffee was really good as well ;)

formatted_address: 2nd lane Munidasa Rd, Ahangama 80650, Sri Lanka
name: Lumora Cafe

reviews.text: Lovely cafe in a peaceful setting. The staff and food were great 😊

The food was more then amazing, we had the loaded fries with chicken, which was boneless and very tasty, good some good aioli dips and tomato and onion, also the passion fruit Mint Smoothie and Shakshuka which was awesome!!
And the prices are very good as well

We stopped by and got inform this place is new!
Buy this staff is well experienced.

Good food varieties and very good service.
We will come back during our stay!

Perfect brunchplace for the whole family.

Avocado toast is the bomb here.

🍀
The food and drinks were fresh and delicious, and the presentation was impressive. Everything felt clean and well-maintained.

Lovely people, cooking great food for you! Food was that good, we came back twice in one evening. Would definitely recommend if you are fancying local food. Also open at night!! Perfect after a night out ;)

We were completely ripped off – they charged a much higher price than usual. Since we hadn’t agreed on anything beforehand and they didn’t have a menu, there was nothing we could do. It’s best to just not go there.
Such a nice place! They are so kind, prices are fair and the food is unreal! Fully recommend it 🙏🏽

Can't judge on the food. Tried to buy egghoppers there. They wanted twice the normal price.
This place is ugly and dirty and charges double. No way!
The best egg hoppers I’ve had in Sri Lanka

formatted_address: Infront of police, Ahangama 80650, Sri Lanka
name: Barista Ahangama

reviews.text:
Barista Ahangama ☕️
Delicious food and very friendly customer service.
I highly recommend everyone to come and taste their coffee and sandwiches — we tried them today and they were truly the best!
Lovely vibe 🤍✨

I highly recommend this bar/restaurant.
The food and service quality was truly exceptional, I can't wait to come back.
We had a Soda & some sandwiches here and i can‘t complain at all. Very nice staff, looks very clean and the prices are fair, not like other cafes in that area. We‘ll visit again!

Was disappointed after visiting this place. It’s a coffee place but coffee didn’t taste good. Was happy to see  coconut coffee in the menu, but it was not good. Cheesecake was too sweet and I’m not sure it’s fresh. In addition it was a bit expensive than other places.
Space is very small, inside 3-4 tables and AC, outside are more tables but it’s very hot and noisy near the road. I didn’t understand why they used plastic plants for decoration, when Sri Lankan is a country with high biodiversity and everything is growing really fast.

5 star only for stuff who were very friendly and welcoming.

Excellent service with friendly and attentive staff who make you feel welcome from the moment you arrive. The food is fresh, well prepared, and full of great flavor, with a nice variety to choose from. The coffee is rich, smooth, and perfectly brewed every time. A great place to relax and enjoy quality food and coffee. Highly recommended! ☕✨

UFO Ahangama✨
Went for brunch and absolutely loved the place! Super ambience and stunning architecture, such a chill vibe all around. Coffee is top notch and the waffles were just perfect. The menu looks really cool .

The view is one of the best spots to have your morning coffee. 🌿☕️
And I know it’s random, but I’ve gotta say it…
I love the sink!!😂🤣🫠

Definitely a spot I’ll be coming back to!

The place is relatively new as far as I am concerned. Has a stunning view of the ocean (no steps to the beach, like the others). (More chill than Cactus and doesnt charge extra for the sea view seats like Cactus, which is srsly weird). If you are lucky to get a spot, do check out the furniture, a piece of art, all of them. The shy sink that is a true work of craftmanship and the adjacent tables and seats near the bar, all made of concrete. I had a lavendrt latte the barista recommended - he was right to do so - and they served it with a large glass of water as they should (though not many places do it here). I’d hate for them to be hyped like the others but they deserve it.

Service and atmosphere are really good. I honestly wanted to like this place, especially since several people I know recommended it. But after two visits having one cold brew and one hot Americano, the coffee was consistently far too diluted. It almost doesn’t taste like coffee anymore. Considering they’re by far the most expensive coffee spot in Ahangama, it’s disappointing.

Also, they sell beans but can’t grind them to your preferred setting, which is surprising for a specialty café.

Season by season, having a sip by the shoreline at UFO is an absolute favourite. Samuel and the team are super friendly and are always bringing that authentic stoke to us all as customers.

It's only appropriate that their coffees, hot or cold, are as quality as their energy. Lavender is my go-to and it's a great midday refreshment.

Thanks for making the south so friendly legends!

Recently, I visited this café with two friends. We ordered three drinks — I specifically asked for a cold cacao, but I was served a hot one instead. When I politely informed the staff about the mistake, I overheard one of them saying , “just ask her to drink it,” which was quite disappointing to hear as a customer.
Eventually, the drink was blended with ice, but unfortunately it did not have any flavour at all. I even tried adding sugar syrup, but it didn’t improve the taste. In the end, I left the drink almost untouched.
The other two drinks we ordered were good, and the overall ambiance of the place was nice. However, what stood out to me was the lack of follow-up. Since my drink was left full, it would have been thoughtful if someone had checked in or offered to remake it properly.
I hope this feedback helps improve customer service and attention to detail, as small things like this can make a big difference in the overall experience.

formatted_address: Chameleon ahangama, central, galle road, Ahangama 80650, Sri Lanka
name: Chameleon Ahangama

reviews.text:
Amazing coffee !! Got it with coconut milk.
It’s very good quality and the prices are not crazy as in other places, for not so good quality. Really recommend it if you want real, good coffee
Also had a toast with veggies, feta and poached egg. Portions are very good!
Also, I’ve been trying a lot of smoothie bowls here, and this one and absolutely one of my tops. I was able to add a protein scoop in it, perfect !!
The owners are super kind and easy to talk to 🌞

Really recommending the place!
Great service with friendly staff. It’s nice and cool inside with a lovely atmosphere. Coffee is top tier

Honestly, the best coffee we had in Ahangama. Everyone working there is in such a lovely space! The smoothie bowl was outstanding 🤍 You can really feel and taste that quality is very important to the team!!

What a great new neighborhood spot! I tried their cappuccino and eggs benny. The cappuccino really hit the spot - looks like they use a premium European machine 🤌And even better, they absolutely nailed the Eggs Benedict. Definitely not used to getting such delicacies in this part of the world…and the mushrooms were such a yummy touch. Thank you all for the work you put it to make this place and menu so special!

A nice place to sit and people watch outside the big window. I got one of the breakfasts (toast with vegetables) and the serving was huge, which I was not expecting considering other western places will charge a lot for one slice of toast. It was tasty but so much tomato (would be awesome if it was more eggplant or mushrooms etc) so maybe I won’t get again, but the service here was wonderful and the vibe is good. With complimentary cold water served :)

An absolutely outstanding experience from start to finish. The location is a dream, and the atmosphere is just as impressive. The open kitchen adds a great touch and creates a lively yet relaxed vibe.

The service was excellent throughout the evening. friendly, attentive, and professional, making us feel very well taken care of.

The food was exceptional. We had the yellowfin tuna, tuna ceviche, crispy potatoes, the burger, and a few other small dishes; every single one was superb.

The only small downside, and really the only thing that slightly contrasted with an otherwise perfect evening, were the flooded restrooms. Aside from that issue, everything was fantastic.

A place we would absolutely recommend and happily return to.

We came to Ceylon Sliders on Saturday for the party for dinner with our Sri Lankan friends who came from overseas. We traveled all the way from Colombo, and the restaurant was completely full. However, The lady in the white shirt and brown pants was so obliging. She asked us to relax at the beach while she arranged a table for us, and within just 10 minutes, she got us seated.

This is the kind of hospitality our country needs. Her smile and excellent service will definitely bring us back. Thanks to her, our friends now have wonderful memories of Ceylon Sliders.
Great food directly at the beach. We had different types of bowls and they were all tasty. Gluten free options available as well as vegan ones. Service was helpful and fast.

Cocktails were exceptional! The thai basil one was really good and interesting. Great atmosphere and live music, but the service was pretty slow and ignorant sadly. We ordered focaccia that we waited over 45min, it eas very tasty but still. But we got a little discount for it.

If you want a burger or fish and chips, this is simply the answer.
It looks like just a casual shop café from the outside, but the food is seriously good.
It’s always lively and packed, which I think makes people underestimate the food.
Service can be slow and paying can be chaotic when it’s busy, but that’s how good the food is.
During our two-week stay, this was the place we came back to the most.

My favorite place to sit with a coffee and watch the ocean. Sometimes when waves are not so big, you can swim. And there is even shower here to wash up after the ocean.
The serve local coffee. I liked cortado. Unfortunately they don’t make v60.
All cakes are super delicious and worth a try!
And one great advantage - there is AC inside!

Amazing cafe with an ocean view 🌊
Had my coffee and a banana muffin while literally looking at the ocean, pure happiness. The vibe is super chill, perfect for slowing down and just enjoying the moment.

Also, Raveen might be the friendliest staff member ever so warm, welcoming, and genuinely kind. You instantly feel at home.

Definitely a place I’d come back to again and again.
Always love coming here. Love the mugs they serve the coffee in as well as the sweet treats they have! Raveen was super friendly and helpful!

I stayed in Ahangama for a week and every morning I enjoyed coming to Kaffi to chill, relax and go for a swim. It’s such a cute space with a really laid back atmosphere. It’s the coziest morning in Ahangama and the staff is super kind. Coffee is wonderful and they have lots of yummy treats. Can’t wait to come back again soon!

Such a nice vibe in this place. Not to mention the coffee and matcha. The view is stunning with a wave right in front to watch. Paradise!
They have now opened a place right next door with more consistent food to compliment their menu and they share the same owner and terrace, so even better now!.
The toilet was locked when we went which was a shame as we had to go due to not being able to use the toilet. They did not give us any explanation, just no toilet now sorry. So we ended up just having a quick coffee and leaving

I’m so glad I stumbled upon this local place because it is truly a little gem. I kept coming back for lunch, breakfast, and their sri lankan coffee. It’s peaceful, read your book, go for a swim, the family and their place makes you feel at home. The curry is tasty and affordable for the quantity you get. Tried the roti which nicely seasoned (a bit spicy but that’s how the locals do it!) I also recommend the coconut cake, it’s delicious!

A little away from Ahangama beach, this restaurant has very delicious food. A restaurant where you can have a delicious meal at a table by the beach. The owners of the restaurant are very friendly and very accommodating. We bought rice and curry from here. One rice and curry plate is Rs.350. Very calm place to relax and enjoy your meal. And highly recommended ❤

This was such a beautiful experience. A lovely family that was so heartfelt caring and welcoming, offering authentic and simply great food.

The Dhal, Curry with chicken on the bone, sambal were all so well seasoned, also great chili oil with it.

You wouldn’t expect how romantically you are seated in their backyard right next to the sea.

We will definitely be back, thank you.

Lovely little restaurant run by a lovely lady who will tell you what is available, we had a banana and chocolate rotti and it was so good. It has lovely outside space looking on to a small bay.
Very authentic and a relaxing feel to the restaurant. Nice to go to somewhere rustic and authentic in Ahangama.

A little local spot nested in between all the cafes that have popped up here. Access to the most beautiful beach cove that is amazing for swimming. I had a coconut and they made me a vegan plate of food at my request 🙏🏼

After we saw some pictures of the Marshmellow Café on Google Maps, we wanted to check it out. During our visit, we ordered a bowl, the mexican-/chicken-bread and some coffee. The food tasted good, but a little bit more seasoning would have been great. The tonic coffee was amazing. The matcha with coconut milk was off (probably the milk). After talking to a staff member, we got a new one - free of charge. The whole crew was very kind. Besides the food and drinks, the atmosphere was stunning. The direct beach front can‘t get any better and the interior is very nice as well. Overall a good café.

the best surf cafe in the area, and best one I’ve seen while 2 months traveling Lanka. food is really tasty, big portions, coffee 🤌👌. and the kindest, so friendly staff, Nethmi is the cuteeest! 🌸 and I fell in love with interior and playlists here, all details are perfect. I will miss this place and this vibe

We had breakfast at marshmellows Café 3 times, they have a very tasty avocado toast selection. I can highly recommend the avocado toast with tofu! Only the Americano was way too hot and didn't taste good. The iced coffees were good though. The Location is really cute.

The hot and cold coffee variations are diverse and very carefully prepared.  The food is delicious, beautifully presented, and always generous in quantity. If you like fish,  try the fresh tuna: fresh and tender (avocado toast tuna or poke bowl tuna). There are also many vegetarian and vegan options. We also ate the best brownies here and the carrot cake is delicious too. The café right on the beach is beautifully decorated, the seating is very comfortable, and you can linger here for a long time (just not during peak hours, when it can be fully booked or you may have to wait a few minutes to get a seat). There are lots of wonderful books about surfing that you can look at and read. The view is breathtaking, and you can't hear any noise from the busy road (Galle - Matara). You can hear the sound of the waves. You can enjoy the sunset with a drink and simply relax. But the very best thing, and the reason for this review, is the service. So incredibly friendly and warm! One of my favorite cafés on the south coast!

Gorgeous little pre/post surf spot. Popular and good vibes. Food is yum if you’re not seeking traditional Sri Lankan. And the coffee is pretty bloody alright too. Always pumping good playlists and really welcoming staff like all Sri Lankan people, super warm.

formatted_address: No. 4 & 5, Railway Station Road Ahangama, Galle 80650, Sri Lanka
name: Living Room Concept Store & Coffee Shop

reviews.text:
Excellent location for digital nomads! Great spot for meetings, reliable wifi, and a comfortable work vibe. The coffee genuinely surprised me (in a good way), and the Triple Chocolate Cookie is heaven-sent!

‼️That said, I’ve now found hair in my cookie twice. The first time, I took a photo of the cookie before eating. After I started eating it, I noticed a hair partially stuck in the cookie with some of it visible. I let it go at the time, assuming it was a one-off. Only recently, when I checked the photo again, I realized the hair had actually been visible in the picture as well.

Unfortunately, it happened again on my most recent visit.

It’s disappointing because the place has so much potential, but food hygiene is non-negotiable. I hope management reviews food-handling practices (perhaps hair coverings in the prep area) so this doesn’t continue, because otherwise, this would easily be one of my favorite work cafes!

What a wonderful vibe. Managed to catch a little work & reading session here whilst the space was super quiet. Everything is new, so it’s super fresh, I think the space opened just recently.

The Americano had such a great flavour, and the freshness of the space really supported great mental work flow too. What a little find!

What was also lovely is to see ‘different pieces’ being sold here that I haven’t seen in other boutique shops before, made for an interesting browse!
Best clothing shop in ahangama! It’s in center. Well designed clothes, upcycled bags and many more:) the coffee is very good and the cookies are woww:) Go check because it’s like a real living room:)
A stunning cafe shop , the staff is pleasant, the coffee is excellent and the cookies and cakes are very delicious. And of course the clothes are beautiful and of excellent quality.

Loved it so muchh! a perfect spot to relax, grab a coffee, and enjoy a cozy afternoon right in the center of Ahangama.

Also i bought this perfect sweatsuit 👙 you should definitely go check out this shop!

Wow what an amazing meal, so refreshing to see somewhere with a whole different menu compared to the other restaurants in town. The service was also fantastic and also great to see there is a new place to watch sport, the drinks were so cheap as well!!

Generous serving of Mongolian fried rice… so good! And look at that chili! Lovely staff, great atmosphere, and they even play the cricket game live. They also seem to have the biggest beer selection I’ve seen in the area.

Honestly good food, everything is neat and clean. Even the kitchen is an open plan so you can see the chefs getting your food ready. And the staff is spectacular. They’ve opened just a couple of days ago. Wishing them all the best and keep up the great work.
Cafe Ivy offers a relaxing and inviting atmosphere. 🍃The food was tasty, and the staff were polite and welcoming.✨ It’s a perfect place to sit back and enjoy a peaceful moment. Highly recommended.❤️

Cafe Ivy is such a lovely place with a calm and cozy atmosphere. The food was delicious and the staff were very friendly and welcoming. Perfect spot to relax and enjoy quality time. Highly recommended..🍃

Went for Brunch with some friends.. The food and drinks are amazing!! I had the Tuna bowl (The tuna is prepared more towards the rare side which i loved! but if you prefer it fully vooked let the staff know when you order it..)..and the cocktails are great I love the Jalapeño Smash..
location is great too.. amazing little cove with blue water and great sunsets

My friends and I loved Soul & Surf Canteen! The views are unmatched and it was so nice to get refreshing drinks and dip in the water in between. We ordered the mango lassi and iced coconut blend; they were great. Would recommend!

Soul & Surf Canteen has a relaxed, laid-back atmosphere with a surf vibe. The view of the ocean makes the whole place feel calm and inviting. The music was good and added to the overall mood, making it easy to linger and enjoy the moment.

The staff were friendly and welcoming, which matched the warm atmosphere. The food was delicious and felt fresh. The crispy cauliflower was especially interesting — a bit different, but full of flavor.

Overall, it’s a great spot to unwind, enjoy good music, and have a tasty meal right by the ocean.

I absolutely adore this spot! Have been eating here often while staying one month in ahangama and I probably tried most of the things from the menu 😅
It’s not just great, fresh food, amazing view but also very unique design and choice of music. This place has a very special vibe - the one you can’t really find nowhere else. And pictures doesn’t show how good it is. Thank you guys for such an amazing job!

This is a beautiful spot with direct access to a very secluded bit of the beach. You can swim out to surf or just swim in the water.

The food menu was very limited.

The service was unfortunately quite poor. We had ordered 2 mains and a small plate but this was mixed up by the staff. Appreciate this can happen but the staff didn’t know how to handle this situation where we were expected to pay for the mistake made on their part.

formatted_address: Mahavidana Gedara, Dharmarama Road Ahangama, Ahangama 80650, Sri Lanka
name: The Kip

reviews.text:
The best breakfast in the south of Sri Lanka!

We came here eight times for breakfast, and every single visit was a pleasure. The location is beautiful, and the staff is always incredibly friendly. You are welcomed with a warm smile every time, which makes the experience even more special.

The quality of the food is outstanding, and everything we tried tasted amazing. Of course, you can find cheaper places, but the quality here is truly excellent and you can definitely taste the difference.
We did not stay at the hotel, so this review only refers to the café/restaurant.
The food is clearly prepared with a lot of care and love. The menu offers a great selection of different dishes not just the usual standard options, but really interesting and delicious choices.
We can highly recommend The Kip to anyone visiting Sri Lanka. It’s definitely a place you should try! 😊

After spending a month in Ahangama, it’s safe to say that The Kip is truly a special gem in town. Not only for its atmosphere, but especially for its incredible food.

Every single dish from the tapas-style menu was like a small poem on a plate. Perfectly balanced, creative, and full of flavor, each bite felt thoughtfully composed & beautifully executed. No matter what we ordered, everything was exceptional.

What made our experience even more memorable was the outstanding service. We would especially like to highlight our wonderful waitress, Malki. She was incredibly attentive, seemed to anticipate our wishes before we even voiced them, and made us feel completely welcome. No question was ever too much, no request too small. Any employer should consider themselves truly lucky to have such a dedicated, warm, and ambitious team member. Malki made our visits feel personal and genuinely special.

Omg - this was absolutely fantastic.i have been 4 times now! My favourite breakfast in Sri Lanka, absolutely cannot miss going here. The seating area is lovely and the staff couldn’t have been more attentive and helpful.

All of the food was lovely, the concept itself is great. The halloumi was great, the Asian fusion breakfast burger was my absolute favourite. The mushrooms were a huge hit too.
Coffee and matcha was also extremely good.

1000/10 ⭐️⭐️⭐️

Wanted to share a review specifically about the restaurant at this beautiful property. I came at the start of my holiday and a month later at the end of my holiday and both experiences were consistent with top notch service, friendly smiles and high quality food/drinks. I LOVE how beautiful and calm the space is, how relaxed it feels, the subtle but good music in the background, how clean everything is. The staff are all amazing and you can genuinely tell they care. Special mention to the wonderful lady with the glasses (didn’t catch her name) but she has such a warm presence. The barista behind the bar makes exceptional coffee and matcha, have had both and was thoroughly impressed with the quality of beans/ceremonial matcha. Last but definitely not least, the FOOD. So much flavour, such creative dishes, and we love the options! Thank you for being a stand out cafe in the busy Ahangama area.

To me, one of the most rewarding experiences is F I N D I N G, when you aren‘t searching. A lot of humanity‘s great discoveries are a product of serendipity (e.g., penicillin).

While The Kip does not resemble the relevance of a compound such as penicillin, it does, however, constitute a remarkable discovery for my personal trip to Sri Lanka.

Without any expectations, I encountered the best breakfast on the island, making me already come back for another breakfast today. The menu‘s idea of small breakfast tapas is something I haven‘t seen in many places yet. All dishes I could try tasted great and nourished and strengthened my physical structure.

The cappuccino, my favorite beverage in the world, made it onto the podium as well. The venue is wonderful, green and peaceful,  designed in minimalistic, aesthetic ways.

The thing I will remember most though is the service personnel. All staff members were genuinely kind, helpful and embracing. I enjoy connecting with locals the most when travelling, and The Kip also scored highly in that regard.

Overall, The Kip is more than a breakfast spot: It‘s a hidden champion in the art of hospitality.

Such an amazing Hostel, beautiful and clean rooms, super close to the town and the beach, yet quietly placed. Many activities are organized by the super friendly staff, they made me immediately feel welcome in the Omnia Family.
The hostel is surrounded by a lovely garden and also features a cozy café with delicious food!
Definitely will come back :)

This is definitely the best hostel I've stayed in in Sri Lanka. It's clean, the beds are comfortable, it's beautiful, and super pleasant. I’ve loved the vibe !
Jason and Akila are the best hosts I've ever had; they welcomed us like family. They're kind, friendly, and hilarious.
The family dinners (the food is reaaally good), the ping-pong tournament, and the party we all had together will stay with me for a long time!
Thanks, guys! 🩵

Highly recommended!!!
This is definitely the definition of "home away from home". feels completely like a family, the entire staff is always smiling, and helps with everything you need! Excellent location, close to everything you need, the beach, restaurants, and shops, but still in a quiet place. Everything is always clean and tidy, and there is a daily program that you can join. The family dinner was the best i had, in Sri Lanka!!!! I met great people, that become good friends. This is exactly the place you want to come back to!!! Thank you very much for everything.❤️🙏

In my 3.5 weeks in Sri Lanka, this is the absolute best hostel I stayed in. What makes this place stand out is the owner Akila and Jayson at the reception. the whole staff is amazing and kind. Unlimited cold water, delicious food & coffee from the cafe managed by Avi! The social space is really nice. The hostel is social and I met some great people :) if I’m back in Sri Lanka, I’ll definitely come stay here!

Best hostel in Sri Lanka!! It's a new project from an amazing local guy made with good taste and love. All the staff is incredible, they are always smiling and making you feel like home. They've create a great atmosphere with good common areas and a very nice cafeteria that invite you to chill and also to make new friends. The rooms are clean and the breakfast is incredible, the best I've ever had in a hostel (it's very complete and tasty, the avocado toast is another world). Thank you for everything Omnia family I would definitely come back soon :)
Checked out Negombo Surf Co today! They had a lot of cool stuff and I picked up a stylish sterling silver necklace. The owner was super lovely too ☺️

Awesome little shop in Ahangama! Super chill vibes, great selection of boards, and the friendliest staff around. Whether you’re a pro or just starting out, they’ve got you covered. Plus, they’re always happy to share tips on the best local surf spots. A must visit for any surfer passing through!
The best shop for unique locally designed t shirts!
Top quality clothes produced locally at good prices. Check them out when you’re in the area.

I had an amazing experience at Negombo Surf Co in Ahangama! They offer a fantastic range of Sri Lankan-made t-shirts and surf-style clothing. The staff are incredibly personable and friendly, making my shopping experience truly enjoyable. If you're in the area, be sure to check them out for high-quality, locally crafted surf apparel.

We had a nice time at Loose keys Ahangama, Really Good Quality Coffee and Nice Brownies 🥰
Not only one during our whole stay Ahangama we never miss out this experience in every morning.
And the Barista Tharushika is presenting everything nicely. Doing well 😍
Keep doing well
Definitely coming back again once we are in Ahangama.
I ordered an oat milk cappuccino and it was delicious! The staff were so friendly and kind, making the whole visit a really lovely experience.
Really nice Coffee & good vibes ☀️
Loose Keys is amazing! Their matcha is perfectly creamy and their sweets are absolute heaven. The perfect spot for a cozy treat!🍵
Great little café!

I found myself returning to this place several times—not only for the delicious food but especially for the warm and inviting atmosphere. The staff is exceptionally friendly and attentive, which makes every visit feel welcoming and relaxed.
The view of the Animals Surf Spot is absolutely stunning and adds something truly special to the experience. Whether it’s a morning coffee, a glass of wine with cheese, some snacks or a full dinner, this spot is perfect at any time of day.
I’m already looking forward to returning the next time I’m in Ahangama.

Firstly: NO WIFI, CASH ONLY
Apart from that the place is very cute, by the beach, there are a few sockets to charge. Apparently they close at 4pm (not the 3:30pm that it says on here). Reopen at 5pm for dinner.

Tried the coco smoothie bowl and it was so good!! You can taste the dark chocolate. Highly recommended trying it!

Nice cafe to chill and get some work done on your laptop, but you gotta use your own hotspot.. 🥲 hence the 4 stars.

Service was not bad the girl in the front couldn't understand what I was saying do I had to repeat a few times..

The food here was lovely. Really delicious. It felt authentic french with local ingredients.
The service was also good l however this place is CASH ONLY. Would have been really helpful if there was a sign or we were informed that its cash only before hand.
Otherwise really good restaurant with great vibes.

We ordered mushroom cream pasta. The portion size was great. It was tasty but a bit bland for our taste. They don't serve bread with pasta but served it on request without extra charge. Wish they had more options for vegetarians.

I’m giving 5 stars because we went to get some cakes there and tarts that we ordered were delicious. However I don’t understand the concept of this place as the menu is bizarre. It’s French cuisines however there are some pastas and fries on the menu. That’s it. This place has so much potential though as the location is amazing.

We’ve been coming to this place for the second year
The food is always incredibly delicious with a great variety of options
Guys are friendly, happy to give recommendations and take your taste preferences into account when preparing the dishes
We visited at a quiet time with no other guests, and they even offered to turn on our music

Had a really nice brunch of toast, avocado, scrambled eggs and tomato here. The setting is comfortable and cosy. Not many authentic options on the menu but if you want a good western style breakfast I would certainly recommend it here.

I’ve been coming to this café in Ahangama regularly, and it’s easily one of my favorite spots in the area! The atmosphere is cozy and relaxed, perfect for enjoying a meal or just hanging out. I highly recommend exploring the menu – everything I’ve tried has been absolutely delicious. My personal favorites are the French toast, chicken sandwich, and chicken bowl. Each dish is full of flavor, fresh, and beautifully presented. Whether you’re looking for breakfast or lunch, this place never disappoints! Definitely a must-visit.

Most biggest and tasty cappuccino on down south. Also available on an oats and coconut milk! Highly recommended!

Thank you guys!

I really enjoyed this meal. The chicken sandwich was fresh and satisfying, the chicken was well-fried and the bread and greens were fresh and it was light but satisfying. I especially liked it.The Napoleon cake was soft, flaky, smooth, with a creamy filling - not too sweet, well balanced. Everything was neatly packaged, and tasted fresh.
Ordered one piece of cake take away. It’s tasty.
Cake shop
The samosas were good! 👍

I didn't have the chance to stay in any of their rooms but I have dined at their cafe multiple times. Firstly the vibe here is so peaceful and the music catches the essence of the place perfectly. A chill spot to have some good food and coffee. Food is tasty, with nice portion sizes, the Zopf & Co was out of this world. The coffee is also superb,  plus points for locally sourced beans. The staff are also super friendly and helpful. Tara was a treat, and such a bubbly person, it made the experience even better. Definitely going to come back when I need a chill wind down.

Stayed here for 3 nights, peaceful stay with great staff that make it welcoming at any time of the day. Breakfast and coffee is an absolute must. They also helped us to set our laundry and scooter rental. Come here if you have the chance and enjoy the relaxed atmósfera!

The staff is extremely noisy. It's a quiet, peaceful place—and you come here to enjoy the silence. And the guests are quiet. But the staff... constantly talks very loudly their local language, both around the guests and at the bar. It's impossible to just relax and enjoy the place. It's like I'm in a market, not a good caffe.

Serendipity truly lives up to its name — the room was beautifully designed, with elegant décor and surrounded by calming nature that made the whole stay feel special. The aesthetics of the place are wonderful, and the lady host deserves all the appreciation for her kindness, warm support, and excellent communication. She really made us feel at home. However, the experience would be even better with more attentive and hospitable men staff to match the charm of the property. Overall, a lovely stay with lots of potential to become exceptional. One of a kind places in Ahangama

My favorite place in Ahangama!! I loved the cosy room, yoga place in the back and the garden with all the dogs around. Felt really safe with security at night! The staff is super kind and the food amazing, I will definitely come back!

formatted_address: super market Ahangama සුපර් මාර්කට් අහංගම, A2, Ahangama, Sri Lanka
name: Mr. Paan

reviews.text:
The owner lady was so warm and welcoming to help us out the right food for the snack.

We liked the snack and we took some paan bread and loaf of bread to India.

Whoever wants bake items should definitely go visit here.
Love coming here for a Nescafé (in a paper cup) and muffin. Amazing customer service by the women working and delicious sandwiches homemade. Highly recommend coming here!

formatted_address: A2 Southern Bch Rd, Ahangama, Sri Lanka
name: Samba Ahangama

reviews.text:
We are incredibly happy with our stay!!!☺️

A huge shoutout to the staff who truly made the whole experience. They were extremely helpful with guidance, tips, and advice about the area, and were always there whenever we needed anything. We genuinely felt taken care of throughout our stay.

The atmosphere at the hotel was very safe and relaxed. From the very first moment, we felt welcome, and the staff were always warm, friendly, and pleasant. Even the other guests were kind, social, and easy to talk to, which made the whole stay even more enjoyable.

When we ”accidentally” got badly sunburned, the staff immediately helped us by providing aloe vera leaves so we could soothe our skin. Such a thoughtful and kind gesture!

What really shows their outstanding level of service was when one staff member was called in in the middle of the night to help us remove a cockroach from our room. It was handled quickly, professionally, and calmly truly impressive service.

We can warmly recommend this hotel ❤️

Best regards,
Julia and Daniella

We visited Samba before we left Sri Lanka and had an overall fantastic experience. The ambiance of the place is absolutely stunning!! The architecture is unique and adds a special touch to the dining atmosphere. The attention to detail in both design and presentation is evident as soon as you walk in.

As for the food, it was not only delicious but also beautifully presented, making every dish feel like a work of art. From start to finish, the flavors were spot-on, and each plate was as visually appealing as it was tasty.

The staff deserves a mention as well..! They were incredibly attentive and friendly, checking in regularly to ensure we had everything we needed and that we were enjoying our meal. It's clear they prioritize customer satisfaction which made us very impressed.

However, there was a small hiccup during our visit. A woman who seemed to be part of the staff cleared our plates without asking if we were finished, which felt a bit awkward. It’s always nice to be asked before someone removes your plate, especially when you're not quite done. That was the only downside to an otherwise perfect experience.

Overall, this place is definitely worth visiting, and We'll be back for sure!

I had a very pleasant one-night stay at Samba Ahangama. The location is extremely convenient if you’re planning to explore the Ahangama area, with easy access to nearby beaches, cafés, and attractions.
The staff truly stood out they were warm, friendly, and very supportive throughout our stay. I’ve seen there are some concerns about locals being treated differently at certain hotels, but that was absolutely not the case here at Samba. We were the only locals staying that day, and the service we received was excellent and professional in every way.
The room was clean, spacious, and well maintained, making the stay very comfortable. The food was another highlight delicious, well prepared, and definitely worth the price.
Overall, Samba Ahangama offers great value, genuine hospitality, and a comfortable stay. I would happily recommend it to both local and international travelers.

Akila the manager was super helpful and friendly when he helped me with a place to stay when I needed a landing pad on the fly! The rest of the staff was wonderful too and always trying to do what they could to accommodate needs. Rooms are clean, beds comfortable, and the air conditioning is the best I’ve had on my trip in Sri Lanka. Recommend it!

We had a great stay in Samba Ahangama. Its very clean and comfortable. It was a chill vibe. We felt very safe, also during the night. The rooms were nice, super clean and with AC and van. But my highlight was the staff: They were sooo friendly and nice. For our friend they organized a little birthday surprise, that was soooo wonderful! Thanks to everyone for making our time here so special.

Absolutely one of the best restaurants in Sri Lanka! Delicious food at great prices, huge portions, friendly staff, and a cozy atmosphere. I stayed in Ahangama for 4 days and went to Hungry Puppet every day. Highly recommend!
Wonderful experience, pocket friendly!! We ordered a chocolate milkshake, coffee milkshake, bacon omlette and string hoppers! Just costed us 400 per person. Tasty and reasonable. An amazing cafe

This place is 11/10! Fantastic food for VERY low prices. We were here for breakfest and came same day for lunch and everything was perfect. Very kind staff is always smiling and the place has a cosy atmosphere. This place is worth visiting even from Weligama.

The best cappuccino on the coast. We kept coming back for it every day. English breakfast is a really good deal, avocado toasts are delicious, generous portion of waffles, ramen is really tasty as well. Nice ambiance, cute spot.

Little longer wait time for food, but it’s worth it. It’s so cheap too.

A must place to stop! Away from the chaos of the road, it’s a perfect place to enjoy an amazing breakfast. Unbelievably cheap but great quality local food plus a large variety of other choices. The staff is very kind and the service is excellent. Will come back for sure :)
Delicious sandwich. We tried with tuna and kitchen. A lot of filling inside, vegetables. Only thing bread could be more crunchy, but the rest is good! Thank you!
Absolutely delicious sandwiches. The prawns and pineapple to die for.
Amazing sandwiches! I had the one with pesto and tofu and it tasted delicious!!
One of the best sandwich places I’ve tried. The sandwiches are very juicy, flavorful, and freshly prepared. Great taste and great quality!
Cool new spot in ahangama! Sandwich was great and price super fair for ahangama ♥️

While riding from Galle to Mirissa, decided to take a break and found this air-conditioned cafe which has wifi and numerous power points. Have a cappuccino and it is one of the best coffee I have in Sri Lanka. Highly recommended.
Coffee is really good and the team is lovely. WiFi is great and you can easily catch up with some work while enjoying a coffee. You can pay card and prices are affordable.

Amazing coffee, easily among the best I’ve had in Sri Lanka. The cake was incredibly tasty, and the whole place has a relaxed surfy, chill atmosphere. Super friendly staff and a really nice spot to hang out and enjoy great coffee.
I had Machiato, espresso and a banana bread and I have to say its Great coffee and an amazing cakes!!! Highly recommend

Ice coffee was fantastic, definitely one of better ones at Sri Lanka.
I also ordered carrot cake but unfortunately I was disappointed - the cream was weird and overall the cake was too sweet

Kal-O is an absolute gem in Ahangama! If you’re into clean, healthy eating, this is the spot. Everything on the menu is fresh, flavorful, and made with high quality ingredients. The protein shakes are next level, and their Ceylon tea is a must try. The space has a chill, modern vibe that makes you want to hang out all day. Super friendly staff and great service too. Definitely a go-to for anyone looking for healthy food on the south coast!

If you're ever in Ahangama, Sri Lanka, do yourself a favor and visit Kal-O! I had the pleasure of trying their Dat-Sun bowl today, and it was an absolute game-changer. The yellowfin tuna was hands down the best I’ve ever had—perfectly cooked rare and a generous portion too. The wasabi-soy dressing was bursting with flavour; I honestly wanted to lick my bowl clean. If you're craving healthy, feel-good food, this is the place to be. I’ll definitely be back and highly recommend it to anyone who wants to eat delicious, nutritious meals. 10/10!

This is the best chicken breast you can get in Ahangama. The salad is fresh, and all the ingredients are top quality. It comes with delicious homemade dressings. Definitely one of those places that will leave you satisfied.

Great place for healthy and delicious food! Good seating and great WiFi. Had a yummy bowl and a strawberry & banana shake. Highly recommend this place in Ahangama. The owner is really nice and so are the people working there.

Such a nice hidden place for Bowl Lovers. Quick service, good portions, beauty atmosphere.

I will definitely come back!

formatted_address: Aranwala Junction, Matara Rd, Ahangama 80600, Sri Lanka
name: Hakuna Matata

reviews.text:
Accidentally found this place and we were so glad! Staff were so lovely and it was Sri Lankan run. The food and drinks were delicious - we got the chef specials.
Theres beanbags and tables on sand so the atmosphere was so relaxing and pretty. Already planning to return asap!

One of the most stunning beach restaurants and don't even get me started on the food.

As vegans we always do a little happy dance when we find a place that actually makes vegan food, not just takes ingredients out to make it into one.

I had the veggie & tofu curry and by far one of the best meals I had in Sri Lanka so far. You can tell it's been made with love and attention so - thank you for making our evening!

Stunning location and great ambience. We enjoyed cocktails made by Chanuka and they were delicious! Some of the best cocktails we’ve had. Highly recommend this stunning bar, we just wish we went here sooner!

A lovely place with excellent service 🙏🏻🤍

The staff are friendly and always check if everything is okay
The food is also very tasty (this is our second year coming here, and the variety of dishes is a big plus)
Great selection of drinks and a wide variety of juice flavors

One of the best places to eat in Sri Lanka
Amazing vibe here! Staff was lovely and attentive! I have the tuna steak and it was probably the best tuna I have had in a long time! I highly recommend this place for vibey evening dinner! 🫶
Doesn’t exist

A really lovely cafe with great vibes. The food was absolutely perfect and the coffee was beautifully done, especially at very reasonable rates.
What stood out most was the staff friendly, attentive and quick without ever feeling rushed. A great place where you genuinely feel welcome.

Will definitely come back ❤️

Nice & cozy place by the beach.

The staff is friendly & attentive.

We enjoyed the food as well. A bit expensive for my taste, but the location is definitely a factor, as you’re right on the beach & it’s quiet enough.

There is an ice bath but we didn’t try it.
I love this place. Everything on the menu is good. + very nice spot for a coffee in the morning in front of this small private beach.
The best place in town for coffee and rest. Shaded beautiful sea view area and wonderful food and coffee. So peaceful away from touristy part of town. Highly recommend

I came here twice for breakfast and it’s absolutely beautiful! The cappuccino with oat milk from Kavindu is the best one I’ve had in Sri Lanka. Also the food is incredible and atmosphere really welcoming and calm. Highly recommend!

Super close to the beach but in the jungle making it a quiet reprieve from all the noise of the waves, the road, the train. It’s my little oasis of peace and quiet. And the food is super tasty and light! And the coffee excellent. 🫶
Great food, good service and super nice & relaxing chill backyard atmosphere. Perfect for breakfast or lunch. I really loved it here!!
Amazing food and atmosphere. Feels like you’re really at your own home, comfortable and relaxed. The food is super healthy and nutritious, great value and good portions. Highly recommend 🙏🏼

Wish I had visit this place before (and not just on my last day).
Nice friendly atmosphere, great ambience in a beautiful garden and great menu.
I only had coffee as I just had breakfast before. Hopefully I can visit another time.

Delicious food and a nutritionally balanced menu where you can customize your choices to suit your preferences. Excellent coffee, incredibly friendly staff, and a beautifully minimalist interior. Highly recommended!

PS: Don’t be misled by the name – it’s not a place for “Barbies,” and the interior isn’t pink. I assume the name comes from the original pink building. It’s actually a stylish, peaceful, and minimalist spot with a fantastic offer.

formatted_address: Sri Visudhdharama road , Mahawaththa ,Aranwala, Ahangama, Sri Lanka
name: Bumba cafe

reviews.text: Very good food, and highly recommended 👌

Best food I had in Srilanka
Clean and so friendly
I came back with 10 friends and all were so happy
We had chicken and 6-7 vegetable dishes
Very tasty food, clean place and great service
Great good very tasty and the service is perfect

The loveliest and caring family!!
Coconut roti is a dream and made with love.
Chutney and curry also fantastic.
Love love for this hidden gem
The food is great! Amazing bowls and bao buns. Also all king of juices are great mixed and protein shakes are simply perfect! 10/10
Stumbled across this place while looking for a breakfast spot. The service was amazing and the food was delicious. Bonus points for the latte art and presentation of the food! Definitely recommend!

The food was delicious, with fresh products and quality products, the plate well presented.

Everything was vegan, even the sauces and drinks !

There a lot of choice : starters, mains, desserts, cocktails without alcool and vegan …

The portions were very generous.

The bohemian decoration was very pretty.

The service was very very fast and the waiters very friendly and attentive !

The restaurant is well located.

I would definitely come back !

It is without a doubt one of the best restaurants I have been to with my sister ! 😊
4.5⭐️Nice breakfast spot but size of coffee could be bigger given the price!

SqueezeMe is a truly unique place where quality, freshness, and style come together beautifully. Their vegan foods and wagon fruits are always top grade full of flavour fresh, and made with real care. The clothing collection is just as impressive, offering modern, high quality pieces that stand out from the rest.
What makes SqueezeMe even more special is the team. The staff are warm, helpful, and always ready to give the best service. The calm and friendly environment makes every visit feel refreshing and comfortable.
SqueezeMe is not just a shop  it s an experience. Fresh food, premium clothing, and amazing service all in one place. Truly the best, truly unique. 🌿✨
Nice sun set

formatted_address: Thalduwa, no 341/A Thalduwa Road, Ahangama 80650, Sri Lanka
name: Yin Yang Ahangama

reviews.text: Absolutely loved this place.  We didn’t eat here but we took the evening boat trip and had a wonderful time.  Loved the vibe there. Highly recommend.

We took a river tour with Dama (I’m sorry if I write your name wrong) and it was one of the highlights of our trip 🌿🚣‍♂️. From the moment we arrived, we were greeted with genuine warmth and hospitality 🐕😊. The owners are incredibly kind and deeply committed to protecting and respecting nature, which made the whole experience even more meaningful 💚.

The tour itself was peaceful and beautiful. As we traveled along the river, Dama shared his knowledge of the local ecosystem — pointing out native fruits, trees, and wildlife with care and enthusiasm 🍃🥥🦇 You can tell he truly loves what he does and takes pride in sharing it with others.

This isn’t just a tour — it’s an opportunity to connect with nature and with people who are truly passionate about preserving it. I can't recommend it enough!

Thank you for your kindness
Flower (Fleur) 🌺 and Kelsey

We had a boat trip which was super nice and calm. Tour guide/ owner told us much about local birds and animals, he is very friendly and cares about wild animals a lot.  Towards the end of a trip we saw huge bats, then it got dark and fireflies were everywhere. We got back and very atmospheric dinner was waiting for us. Food was home made and delicious. Super nice place to visit, thank you guys, ස්තුතියි
We had the best boat experience with the sunset tour 🤩 pure nature, fun guide and mesmerising views.

The tour was with a couple of others at 5pm for sunset, lots of bats and other wildlife. It's a very slowed down calming tour. The guides point out interesting birds but due to language barrier aren't able to give much information. The vibe is great tho and I highly recommend it! Didn't have food there so can't say anything about that.

name: Maria Bonita Sri Lanka Café & Casa

reviews.text: Went here for breakfast on our last day in Ahangama and it was amazing, service was fab the general manger really looked after us. We had a selection of breakfast food and every bite was amazing. Little touches like free filtered water, good coffee and a nice chilled vibe too. Worth stopping by for breakfast or decent coffee. Thank you

Maria Bonita truly has our hearts ❤️

It’s one of the most beautiful, aesthetic, and amazing places we’ve ever stayed at. Located right across the ocean, it offers aesthetically designed, cozy rooms with beautiful detailing that make you feel right at home.

And of course — the MARIA BONITA CAFE!
If you know your food and coffee ☕️, this café will absolutely surprise you with its exceptional flavors.
Trust me, their “Express Yourself Coffee” and “Beetroot Hummus Toast” are worth every single sip and bite ❤️

For anyone traveling 🧳 and looking for a stay — this is the place to be!

It’s worth every penny you spend.
A big shoutout to the lovely staff and host Christina — the most welcoming and caring person you’ll meet. The service here is unmatched, and the whole vibe is so positive and heartwarming.

Located right on the main street of Ahangama, everything is nearby, making it super easy (and fun!) to explore.
✨ If you’re heading to AHANGAMA, make sure to visit Maria Bonita and try their amazing food — you won’t regret it! ✨

The owner is the sweetest Spanish woman! Food is pretty good, big portions and matcha is the best in town! We tried the Japanese pancakes and avocado toast. I feel like the pancakes could be a bit more fluffy knowing that this is the signature difference between just pancakes and Japanese one.

Lunch was amazing and so pretty… teriyaki tuna poke bowl. Shout out also for the pineapple ginger presse… 10x better that the watered down juice we had In Ahangama centre earlier. Impeccable service. 100% recommend

Beautiful Rooms & Wonderful Café!

This spot is a gem.

I love hanging out there in the café, the brunch options are incredibly tasty and it’s so peaceful there.

The accomodation is beautiful and has a special vibe - I love it!

Highly recommend for brunch and/or for accomodation!

formatted_address: Follow the white rabbit, Matara Rd, Ahangama 80650, Sri Lanka
name: The cake boxxx

reviews.text:
All I did was ask for a birthday cake for my girlfriend, simply requested a cake that had a silly goose who’s also a princess (to match her personality haha) and wow delivered to perfection :D To top it off it was an awesome carrot cake!
Highly recommend them for custom orders!

We ordered cake on the party and it was done in a terrible way. After our complaint the employee of this cafe (his name is Ashton), ignoring us and even not trying to say sorry for this horrible experience. So I suggest to avoid this place in any possible way.

I came to the cakebox to pick up my carrot birthday cake!
The icing was beautiful and the decoration on top were gorgeous!
The taste of the carrot cake was fantastic and we all enjoyed the cake a lot!
It is a wonderful place to have your cakes made, the amazing cakes that this place offers is just "out-of-the-cake-boxx", I would say!
Didi you are doing a great job and thank you for all your dedication to make such wonderful creations!
The best place in Ahangama to have brunch and also to treat yourself with some delicious cakes and drinks.. Highly recommended and their service is amazing. Friendly staff and cozy environment.

I found this place through instagram to see if they could make our wedding cake and I’m so glad I did! The cake was soo delicious and looked absolutely amazing! All our guests raved about how yummy the cake was and there wasn’t a single slice left over! The staff were so friendly and accommodating. I’m so glad they were able to be part of our wedding day and make us the cake of our dreams! I would recommend this place to anyone looking for a sweet treat or creating a masterpiece cake for a special event! Thank you again so much!

formatted_address: Thuduwa waththa, Thalduwa Road, Ahangama, Sri Lanka
name: Hungry Balance Restaurant

reviews.text: A lovely couple-run restaurant with great food and a warm, pleasant ambience. Everything was excellent. They’re happy to cook exactly the way we ask, and every food we tried was delicious. Truly a wonderful  experience.

We had several lovely meals with Nalaka and his family as we stayed at Villa Kingfort. The breakfasts were great with good coffee, eggs, toast, and lots of fresh fruit. We had their Tom Yum soup on several occasions and it was delicious. The curry and chop suey were also excellent. One evening Nalaka prepared a sizzling whole fish and a plate of prawns that were excellent. Would highly recommend a visit if you’re in the area. They treat you like family!

Highly recommend!!! The food, the service, the atmosphere, everything was wonderful. The couple that runs the restaurant are so dedicated to quality service and were willing to work with my dietary restrictions with ease.

I ordered the veggie fried rice which was so good and such a great portion size with a delicious juice and fruit platter
Amazing food. The owners are very kind and humble people. Cute vibe and also accommodated our food preference. Must visit.

We went for my husbands birthday breakfast and it was excellent. Everything is really fresh, my husband said it was his favourite Sri Lankan breakfast so far! The garden is beautiful, so relaxed and green! It's definitely worth a trip inland for. And our kids ended up playing cricket with the owners boy, such a lovely experience. We will be back!

Amazing a location to check the sunset out with a beer or cocktail. My partner had cocktails and it wasn’t up to standard for the price they quote but still I understand it’s all good the staff was friendly and attentive. My biggest concern was when I was to pay the bill the guy at the counter said I have to pay a extra 3% additional to the bill where it’s completely illegal in Sri Lanka to charge a sir charge. I demanded for a bill which states the 3% being added but the guy at the counter denied my request. Please be aware no such payment could be made and it totally against the law.

We stayed for 3 nights here and I wished we stayed longer. This was the highlight of our trip to Srilanka. The staff is so friendly, the food is delicious, the drinks are amazing and the views are mind blowing. This is also the best sunset spot in the city. And we loved Ahangama. There is a small beach behind the hotel, it's just next door so it's easily accessible. Although it's a really small beach, it's beautiful. There are lots of restaurants nearby and the hotel restaurant is really good.

I can't say this enough, if you get a chance to stay, just go for it! You won't regret it.

I came here many times during my stay, and it quickly became one of my favorite places. They make incredible cocktails - especially the Devils Wave. The fries are amazing, the burger is delicious, and the whole place has a fantastic atmosphere.

It’s absolutely beautiful for sunset, but also perfect during the day for a coffee or a fruit salad with curd. The setting is stunning, the vibe is great, and I recommend it 100%.

Amazing place in Ahangama! The location is unbeatable right by the ocean and close to everything you need. The garden is beautiful and creates such a peaceful atmosphere.

There’s also a great snorkeling spot right in front of the hotel, which made the stay even more special.

Highly recommend for anyone visiting Ahangama ,I would definitely come back!

The Lighthouse in Ahangama was a truly wholesome and heartwarming stay. From the moment we arrived, Malik made us feel genuinely welcome, always checking in with care and attention whenever we saw him.

Tariq was incredibly friendly and easy to talk to, and meeting his lovely family added such a warm and personal touch to the experience. Every member of the staff was kind, welcoming, and made us feel completely at ease.

The stay was comfortable, the food was delicious, and everything flowed effortlessly. What I loved the most was the overall good vibes. Calm, warmth, and a sense of being somewhere special that stays with you even after you leave.

formatted_address: welikanda Matara Rd, Ahangama 80650, Sri Lanka
name: Follow The White Rabbit – Restaurant & Bar

reviews.text:
Such a nice spot near the sea. Good place to chill with a coffee and food.
They have brunches and even vegan desserts.
Stuff is welcoming and friendly. Owned by locals.
Inside you can find a shop with postcards, souvenirs.
Nice sunset view.
They also have backyard which is cozy too. And many parking area.

Great for a morning coffee!
Probably also great for lunch, dinner or cocktails but I only had a coffee yet.
They offer vegan and gluten free cakes.
Unfortunately not sugar free.
