The coffee had a reasonable price unlike many other places where they charge European prices.
Staff was welcoming and friendly.
Really nice place. I love the wooden blue tables and the real cups (not glasses) for coffee.

The staff were lovely here and the view was absolutely incredible, so nice to sit right above the ocean while eating dinner but unfortunately the meal really let it down for me.. I ordered an octopus salad with lime and orange dressing (which was recommended to me by one of the staff). The wait wasn’t actually too long but when it arrived the octopus was so chewy I genuinely couldn’t swallow it. Spat half of it out and ended up sending it back because I was not enjoying it at all. The lovely staff offered to remove it from the bill and they were accepting of my reasoning on why I didn’t like it. My friend ordered the paneer burger she said it was ok but nothing special. The staff are great and the location is beautiful but maybe needs to be a few changes to the food. Otherwise nice experience.
What a great place. Staff are extremely welcoming, the toasts and the coffee are nice. And the view, oh the view. Surf spot just in front you to look over. I spend a whole day here
A small cosy deck right by the ocean! Tasty drink, friendly staff, and yummy food! And not to forget, they have one of the best smoothie bowls I’ve had in Sri Lanka :)

name: Mudra Herbal Spices and Tea Shop

reviews.text:
A lovely shop run by an even lovelier family. Extremely welcoming and happy to explain all of their different teas and products to you. A nice variety of teas, some natural, traditional medicines/balms/oils, and cosmetic products. They served us a tea in their beautiful garden.
I am not familiar with normal prices of tea, but each bag worked out to be around $8-10 I think. Didn’t seem too bad to me for high quality, locally sourced tea.
A beautiful drive out of the craziness of Ahangama main road. Nice informational pages about each tea’s profile and a chance to see and smell each tea too.

What a gem! Mudra is run by the most warm and generous family — they immediately made me feel welcome, inviting me to sit outside with a freshly brewed tea while we chatted.

The space itself is beautiful and peaceful, exactly the kind of place you want to linger.
They carry a wonderful selection of teas, herbal oils, and other local products, and everything is clearly labeled with thoughtful English explanations so you can actually understand what you’re buying and how to use it. You can tell they’ve put real care into making the experience accessible for visitors.

If you’re in Ahangama, make time to stop by — not just to shop, but to enjoy the warmth of the people behind it. One of those special encounters that stays with you 🙏

Drove up to this very cute shop today and met the most lovely family who runs the place. They sell a lot of good organic products, essential oils and tea, and the surroundings are beautiful. Worth a trip!

They have such a great selection of teas, spices, and spa products. The couple who runs the shop takes the time to explain each product to help you find exactly what you’re looking for. Definitely worth the trip.

Had a really great time! The shop is really nice and they have a lot of good tea and spices. Got to taste some really good tea while monkeys were climbing the trees that surrounding the shop! Highly recommend!

Amazing small little place to eat homemade local food and have some nice ayurvedic tea.
The hospitality and warmth of the owner is amazing. A small heaven just couple of minutes away from the main road and crowdy places in Ahangama.
Thank you and wish you all the best 🙏

Its such a lovely place!!!
The Family is growing healthy herbs in their garden.

Highly recommended 🙃

Very lovely little cafe! The lady who runs it is so friendly and was so happy to have us. I didn’t take photos of the food but it was delicious! There was a whole menu of teas as well and we had butterfly pea flower one and coriander one which were very nice and made from fresh flowers and herbs from the garden. Such a nice experience thank you ☺️

Such a lovely café! The owner is so sweet and welcoming — she talks to you like you’re family 🥹💛
I tried the Sri Lankan pancake, the regular pancake, iced latte, and a fresh mango juice… ALL of them were so good. Totally recommend!

And honestly, the sweetest thing ever: I asked her if she could make me pasta (even though it’s not on the menu), and she made the best pasta in the world. 🥰🍝

This place feels like home. Cutest family ever ❤️

We decided to came here to avoid tourist places overpriced.
The owner welcome was super friendly and warmth.
We order scrambled eggs out of the menu and she didn’t have any problem.
We also bought some clothes that she show us  gently.
Everything was perfect.
Thank you!!!

formatted_address: Goviyapana, Jayasumanarama Rd, Ahangama 80650, Sri Lanka
name: Roaming Retreat Hostel & Villa

reviews.text:
Roaming Retreat is without a doubt the best hostel I have ever stayed at. Me and my friend stayed for a month and its been amazing⭐️
Starting with the hostel itself, the location is perfect cause its close to everything but still in a quiet side street. The design is so chic. Dorms are 10/10, very spacious, clean, good privacy, no complaints. Had one night in the private rooms and that was sooo lovely!
Loved the included breakfast.
There was a yoga teacher so we got free yoga in the morning which was amazing - shoutout Samie and Lilian!
What makes the hostel stand out is the social part of it and the staff. I made so many great friends from being part of all the social activities hosted by RR, like Rice and curry buffet night, taco night, boat party, pre parties with pool and karaoke and going out to dance together 🥂
A special thanks to Savi, who made our trip so special! He will help you with anything, knows everyone and is the funniest guy ever!
And Avi and the rest of the crew, thanks and we will see you again!🧡🌞

I spent 14 nights at Roaming Retreat Hostel & Villa and absolutely loved my time there. I was looking for a place in Ahangama that is close to everything, yet still calm and peaceful, visually beautiful, and suitable for working remotely: Roaming Retreat delivered on all of it.

The space is thoughtfully designed and has a great atmosphere. The breakfast is delicious, the vibe is genuinely welcoming, and the team goes above and beyond to help and support wherever they can.

I met some truly wonderful people during my stay and felt very comfortable from the beginning. This place quickly felt like a little home, and I truly loved every moment of my time there. I would 100% stay here again and highly recommend it.

This was by far the best hostel I ever stayed in. So clean so modern and very aesthetic. The staff was beyond friendly and the owner was very very nice and super helpful and friendly. Prices were very reasonable. The included breakfast was also super amazing. Can’t recommend enough!!!

This is by far the best hostel I have ever stayed in. The dorms were incredibly comfortable, everything was perfect. Each bed had shelves, a 120-cm mattress, curtains, adjustable lighting, and three different types of pillows.

In the dorm there were two showers, and the door was so well insulated that you couldn’t hear anything at all from the bathroom.

Breakfast was great, the location was ideal, and the whole place was beautiful. I also visited the future private rooms, and they are going to be exceptional. And the rooftop, with the future Pilates class area, is going to be amazing as well. I highly recommend this place.

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Amazing stay at Roaming Retreat Hostel & Villa!
I had a really great experience here. The place is clean, comfortable, and well maintained, with a very relaxed and welcoming vibe. The staff were super friendly and always helpful, which made the stay even better. The rooms and common areas are nice, and it’s a perfect spot to chill and meet people. Definitely great value for money. Highly recommended, and I’d love to stay here again!

formatted_address: Ticket To Ride Surf House, Matara Rd, Ahangama 80650, Sri Lanka
name: Life's Good Cafe

reviews.text: I’ve visited Life’s Good Café so many times, and somehow the food just keeps getting better with every visit! Truly one of the best spots for incredible food, refreshing drinks, and the absolute best vibes. It’s a must-stop for us every time we come to Ahangama! The staff and the management of the establishment is top class as well!⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

I’ve been here multiple times and i absolutely love it! The food is amazing i would recommend the dubble crispy chicken burger! The staff is very nice and the vibe is amazing. It’s the best cafe in Ahangama🙏
Absolutely recommend this place. Super chill, extremely nice staff and best coffee. Usually went for a flat white or cappuccino. Food also 10/10 literally with all I have tried out of the menu.

The café was amazing! The food was absolutely incredible — full of flavor and beautifully presented. The portions were large and definitely worth the price. A great place to enjoy a satisfying meal and great vibes overall

Came here looking for a burger and boy did they deliver. The double chicken burger here is on another level!

Great staff as well and good vibes with lots happening around the cafe and surf house.

formatted_address: No 5, Jayasumanarama road, Punchi palutagahawatta, Goviyapana, Ahangama 80650, Sri Lanka
name: zupiri cafe - Ahangama

formatted_address: Eramudugaha Watta, Goviyapana, Ahangama 80650, Sri Lanka
name: Sundays Cafe & Restaurant

reviews.text:
Sundays instantly became my favourite cafe in Ahangama and I loved everything about it.

I’ve tried different drinks and food options (eggs, sandwiches, bowls, smoothies, banana breads) and everything was delicious. Their coffee in general and Masala Chai are really amazing. Also they offer milk alternatives and iced versions of their drinks.

Besides the high quality of the food and drinks, I loved the very chilled vibe of the whole place with a nice interior, great music in the background and a surprisingly calm garden in the back where you can relax. The staff is extremely nice and very helpful, so you feel welcomed and comfortable at all times.

So I would highly recommend it to anyone and I will be back for sure.

I arrived in Ahangama three weeks ago, and from the very first moment I stepped into Sundays, I kept coming back every single morning.
The staff are absolutely amazing—there's such a warm atmosphere and good energy, making it the perfect place to just come and relax.
I’ve tried almost every dish on the menu, and everything is simply delicious. Personally, my favorite is the Peanut Butter Bowl. Also, the coffee and matcha are incredible.
Out of all the places in Ahangama, this cafe was the hardest one to say goodbye to.
Love this place! Super chilled laid back vibe. The staff are so friendly! On new years day they even wrote 2026 in my coffee!!!! The smoothie bowl is insane - so peanut buttery! My fav!

Wanted to try something a bit out of the buzz of the main town. Really happy I discovered this little gem, cool vibes and great music. My flat white was perfect and the kimchi rice bowl honestly delicious. I like the artsy vibe and would love to come to a jam session x brunch, sounds very cool.

Wish I could give this place a 6 star rating. Best cafe, so spacious, relaxed, and clean. Both the coffee and food are amazing. Pictures is the scrambled eggs on sourdough with an extra egg. I come here every morning. Definitely a gem in the area, never too busy.

We had a great experience with Ticket to Ride! As a beginner surfer, my goal from the whole week was to just get up on the board and ride one wave. I managed to get up on the board on day 1, and caught some green waves by the third day. Such an awesome experience! I was nervous about being in the water, but the coaches were wonderful and made me feel super safe. We were at Kabalana beach which was great for beginners. The video analysis even for beginners was super helpful. My partner is an intermediate surfer and he also had a great experience and learned a lot. The food, community, and location were great too. Their rooms were booked, and we ended up staying at The Well, which we loved. The yoga is held there so it was super convenient and nice to have our own private spot, pool, etc.

I had two great private lessons with Magnus. He was a very good instructor who immediately gauged my surfing level and what I was aiming to improve. Before the lesson in the water we had some theory on a whiteboard, which was good to know what to focus on. In the water, the lesson was both lot of fun and instructive. Lastly, the video analysis was really a game changer and it was incredibly useful to spot my mistakes and areas of improvement.

I think the lessons at ticket to ride are of very high quality. The slightly higher price tag is very much worth it if you are serious about improving your surfing.
I will be back :)

My partner and I booked a one-week Sunday to Friday course (we did not book with a room) with Ticket to Ride in April of 2025 and had an amazing time. I really like the fact that the day involves two surf sessions and one video analysis (the morning session). The high-level instruction, attention, and encouragement by all of the surf instructors to push yourself really makes a difference. I was able to see progress in just one week. We highly recommend the school.

If you want to take your surfing to the next level, this is the place!

Super good instructors and daily video analysis really help improve your surfing.

The personnel is super nice and creates a fantastic atmosphere!

I can highly recommend this place to anyone looking to improve their surfing and have a good time.

I had both a week course and a private lesson. This is my second time here. I love how focused and trained they are. You are going to be in good hands even as a beginner, and if you are advanced Im sure the video sessions will give you an insight into your bad habits and you’ll get exactly those tips that will help your surfing.

formatted_address: Uyana Bandarawatta, A2, Unawatuna, Sri Lanka
name: WB Villa

reviews.text: It's a hidden gem in a mass tourist area. The rooms are nice with ancient Italian architecture. The warm hospitality by the staff along with the connectivity to talpe beach is cherry on top. You can expect to see turtles early morning closer to beach. Overall nice experience.

Great place with limited rooms and hence the guests is limited to less than 10 at a time making the place quiet and peaceful. Has a private beach.

The rooms don’t have a beach view and the breakfast is too basic limited to toasts, serials, juice or tea.

The staffs are super friendly and the deck to the beach access is great as well.

Wonderful relaxing stay, staff were very attentive. Nothing was too much trouble. The food was outstanding, so we were not tempted to eat anywhere else. Lovely to be right on the beach and to be able to swim with turtles right there in the water.  Great place for snorkelling. Close to the markets and local sights: Galle, Koggal lake, Weligama and Mirissa.

We were blessed to find this gem of a villa after finding out the hotel we booked was closed for business. Took a chance on WB Villas and the region and we felt we won the lotto with this relaxed and beautifully presented villas.  Where do you start with the amazing food, service, beach , rooms ,flora and fauna. Came saw and will return 💯. Keep up the amazing work team WB Don't forget to say hi to Rosie and Michael your aquatic hosts. 🐢🐢

Absolutely amazing! I have revisited this place. I met guests who were returning to this place for a number of years. Restaurant is definitely worth considering!  My praise goes to staff who is very attentive!

What an incredible restaurant!! I visited here last night and the food was out of this world. I had the steak and it was cooked to perfection. The staff could not have been more helpful and attentive and the setting was just magical. I can not recommend this restaurant enough-a must visit if you are in the Galle area. I have already booked for a return visit!

This is a nice little restaurant where you can taste the best steak in Galle. This is a newly opened restaurant. The food was amazing and the service was excellent.

You can have meals while you are enjoying a nice Indiana ocean and non-tropical waves. The steak house opens only for dinner. If you are looking for a nice dinner in Galle, this is the place.

Further, this place will be ideal for small birthday parties and small celebrations too.

Good luck, guys, see you all next year.

We had an amazing evening at this beautiful place. The food was mouthwatering and the service was outstanding.

Very friendly and attentive staff. Hat off to Chef Sumith.

We will definitely come back to this nice little place.

This is the most wonderful place you can stay on the south coast of Sri Lanka ! The place is located on a beautiful beach where you can swim and chill! The rooms have a beautiful view, are very nice and clean. But the most special part of this accommodation is the family, all the family members are so lovely and let you feel as part of their family. Never experienced such a hospitality somewhere else! Very real and authentic. I will definitely come back.

It was very good and very filling. The prices are more expensive than anywhere else but I think it is reserved for a specific clientele. We feel a real training in table service and a real desire to serve Western dishes prepared with quality. The place is very pretty and well located because this small coastal village will surely experience a big boom. The owner let us choose the music for the evening, it was a nice touch!

formatted_address: Bakmegahawatta, 36/1 Temple Road, Talpe 80615, Sri Lanka
name: Kat's Coffee

reviews.text: We had a great walk, away from the main road, from Mihiripenna to Kat’s Coffee. We had been meaning to get here all week due to the good reviews. We were not disappointed. Our coffees were very good indeed, and the cake was excellent. It is a lovely calm spot, and we relaxed with a crossword before heading off for our evening meal. A really lovely place to visit!

The food is incredible.
We tried both the flat pizza (which is not really a pizza, but a German dish) and it was  delicious.
We also had the most incredible porridge with fresh fruit and gods bless them soy milk which is super hard to find!
Beware that it takes some time for them to prepare what you order, but that’s because everything is made on request so that makes sense and a little wait in the beautiful garden is no bother at all.
The place is a hidden gem and a must see if you are around!

The best flat white I had during my trip to Sri Lanka!
Kats coffee is not a cat cafe, but they have cats, many of them…. And occasional visiting monkeys.
They have managed to make this business feel like you’re visiting someone’s home, very welcoming and laid back. Will always visit whenever we’re in the area, thoroughly recommend!!

During my trip to Talpe, I had the pleasure of visiting Kat's Coffee for breakfast, and it turned out to be a delightful experience. This charming café not only offers a vegetarian menu but serves delicious food that left a lasting impression on my taste buds.

The coffee at Kat's Coffee is truly exceptional, and their flat whites are particularly noteworthy. The rich and smooth flavors of their coffee made for a perfect start to my day. It's evident that the baristas take great pride in their craft, as each cup is expertly prepared and consistently delicious.

Adding to the appeal of Kat's Coffee is the presence of resident cats. These adorable feline companions create a unique and cozy ambience, making the café feel even more inviting. It was a joy to sip my coffee while enjoying the company of these friendly and furry residents.

While all the food options at Kat's Coffee are vegetarian, I was pleasantly surprised by the wide variety and deliciousness of their offerings. From flavorful breakfast dishes to satisfying options for every palate, they certainly know how to make vegetarian food shine. Every bite was a delight, and I appreciated their commitment to providing tasty meat-free alternatives.

The staff at Kat's Coffee were friendly and attentive, ensuring a pleasant dining experience. The service was prompt, and they made sure that all my needs were met with a smile. Their hospitality added an extra layer of warmth to the overall visit.

In conclusion, if you're looking for a memorable breakfast spot in Talpe, Kat's Coffee is a must-visit. Their delicious vegetarian food, excellent coffee (especially the flat whites), and the company of the resident cats create an ambiance that is truly special. Don't miss the opportunity to indulge in a delightful breakfast experience at this charming café.

Beautiful cafe with sofas to lounge about and books to read. The cats in the cafe give it a very homely feel. The latte we had was really creamy and we'll prepared. The cakes though were a little too sweet for our taste. A little on the pricier side. Parking for about two cars available. They have a decently clean unisex washroom. Handmade bags, notebooks, postcards and greeting cards are also available here

formatted_address: Hediwatha Matara Road, "Wilde Ananas", Habaraduwa 80630, Sri Lanka
name: Haus am Meer "Wilde Ananas"

reviews.text: What a beautiful gem. We wanted to stay for one night, but fall in love with this place and stayed 3 nights. You are warmly greeted by the owner Kerstin and her staff with a cold drink. When you enter the hotel, you just see the ocean right in front of you, with a small privat beach; just heavenly. The home made food is amazing. Here you will find peace and tranquility. We highly can recommend this place.
Good place. Need to be developed.

After a varied 5-day tour including the usual sights (this was also organized through the hotel/Neel, with a guide and driver – highly recommended!), we arrived at the Hotel Wilde Ananas in the afternoon. We thoroughly enjoyed our week there! It's a secluded stretch of beach, and you can easily walk or jog along the sand towards Koggala (except at high tide). The waves vary depending on the season; during our stay (end of April), the area directly in front of the hotel was excellent for bodysurfing and surfing – certainly the best spot on the entire beach (there's a strong shore break in some places in front of Koggala). There were a few stray dogs on the beach (as is common in Sri Lanka), but they were all peaceful. The small, German-run hotel isn't the newest, but everything was spotlessly clean and well-maintained. The excellent food (we had half-board, with curries, fish, lentils, vegetables, and salad – all fresh) was served on the veranda overlooking the sea. The whole team was incredibly friendly and helpful, they happily accommodated our food requests (fresh coconut!), and the chef showed us lots of plants and herbs on tuk-tuk tours. A small batik workshop in Habaraduwa (behind the airfield) is also highly recommended – they have beautiful pieces. Ayurvedic massages can be arranged at the hotel upon request – highly recommended! Galle is also definitely worth a (tuk-tuk) trip. And on our last evening, a 1-meter-long turtle came ashore right next to the hotel to lay its eggs. All in all, a truly relaxing and varied holiday with excellent value for money – highly recommended!

We spent two weeks at Wild Pineapple and were absolutely thrilled. The location right on the Pacific Ocean, on a long, tranquil beach, was fantastic. The food was wonderfully delicious, healthy, fresh, and partly Ayurvedic, all prepared individually for us by the friendly kitchen team.

Fresh flowers adorned the breakfast table every day, and in the evenings, Ajid, who guards the hotel at night, brought us a handful of jasmine.

The entire team always greeted us with a smile and were incredibly attentive. Neel is a wonderful organizer; he arranged a five-day, customized tour of the country for us. It was fantastic and very interesting.

We especially enjoyed the excursions with Chalinda and Charid into the interior to Lake Koggala, into the rainforest, to a farmer's garden, and to the vegetable market, where we shopped together and enjoyed the delicious produce in the evenings. Sanuca, with his calm demeanor, arranged delicious coconuts for us. Kerstin even helped charge my phone and gave us tips for excursions. Sujith's excellent Ayurvedic massages at the guesthouse are also highly recommended.

Thanks to the entire friendly team for every smile and their contribution to our unforgettable holiday.

This is a hidden gem for those seeking peace and quiet, and you can easily get everywhere by tuk-tuk or bus if you prefer a bit more hustle and bustle.

We arrived as guests and left as friends...
From the very first day, we felt extremely comfortable and were noticeably welcomed. Kerstin and her team always made us feel "at home." No wonder many guests have now become regulars.
It's not a given that guests discuss the contents of their meals or go shopping together at the market. Everyone speaks good German, is helpful, and extremely friendly. The location right by the sea is unbeatable. The house has only 8 rooms, ensuring that you're not just a number among many. And Chalinda is not only the best tuktuk driver in town, but also cooks divinely.
Highly recommended – and the island too :-)

We had a wonderful stay at this villa with my family for 2 nights. The room was spacious, excellent, and very clean. The bathrooms were really big and well maintained.
The food was absolutely delicious and very tasty. One of the highlights was the massive swimming pool with a stunning view of the beach — truly beautiful and relaxing.
A special mention to the staff: the manager, Suresh, was exceptional. He was available throughout our stay and always greeted us with a warm smile. Prabath was also wonderful, very friendly, and provided excellent service.

Can’t recommend this place enough, it truly is a slice of heaven.
You simply won't be disappointed and is a perfect place to unwind .
The pool is magical to be so close to the sea the suite we had had a huge drop in bath , which you could hear the sea while you relax, just wow. The staff couldn't do enough for us with a bell on the wall for butler service,  ,the resort even has two water turtles that sit in the fish pond keeping an eye on everyone :) Just a magical place where you can just imagine the rich and famous take themselves away too, the photos, how stunning they are, don’t do it justice until you’ve been!
Beautiful place, nicely decorated, good breakfast. Can’t complain about road noise as the waves were louder, which is pretty nice.
This spot of Paradise in Sri Lanka is the most tranquil places to relax and unwind. From the idilic setting to the most tentative staff offering the most wonderful food. What more can you ask!
A small, quiet hotel with large and beautiful rooms. A big downside, however, is the lack of a beach that allows for ocean swimming

I had an extremely disappointing experience at this restaurant. The food was subpar and lacked flavor. The place was not clean, and there was a noticeable unpleasant odor. To make matters worse, the service was poor and unprofessional. I wouldn't recommend this restaurant to anyone.
Very good food. I ordered
This place is very bad. Noisy Beth drunken people at nights.
Good place to have a beer.

reviews.text: Great juice. Clean and made of fresh fruits. Would be better if there is a bit of a price range from low to high.
Cozy little beach strech with a juce bar. Good for swiming and relaxing. Sometimes you can see sea turtles.

The pineapple juice was really good because he mixed it with lemon also it was so great decorated. And I met Lily one of a few turtles that are around here. Thanks for the experience, I truly appreciate it! ☺️
A very nice bar right on the beach. Seating and lounging options in the shade. Relaxing music. Delicious juice for 800-1000 rupees. You're paying for the ambiance, too.
Right on a stunning stretch of beach. Fresh juices, incredibly delicious rotisserie. What more could you want? 5 stars.

reviews.text:
Fantastic balcony in a roof top, very quiet and relaxing space.

Good food.

I stopoed driving on the road to eat something, and I enjoyed a lot!!

Thanks!
The worst restaurant in the area we've been to so far. Chicken bones left on top.
Highly recommended  , very good customer care
Worst food we ate in Srilanka. Terrible ice tea, taste like plastic... The cat liked the tuna though... Definitely not recommending this place.
Not tasty

We had 3 rice and curry meals at The Thalpe Restaurant a small, cozy place with amazing food. Everything was full of flavour and cooked perfectly. Special thanks to Akash for the warm hospitality and top-quality food. Highly recommended if you’re around Thalpe!

I had the fried rice and lime juice—both were delicious and tasted authentic with no artificial flavors. Everything felt fresh and homemade. Plus, the prices were very affordable. Great value for good food!
Tried their seafood fried rice and chicken noodles and both dishes were delicious. Had that authentic Sri Lankan flavor in every bite. Portion size is very good and price is also reasonable.
An awesome small restaurant from lovely guys. The food was greate and the portions where huge! Would definitely recommend!

We visited two times on the same day.

For lunch we shared a fried rice and it was okej, but nothing special.

We came back for dinner because nearly everything was closed due to New years. And I have no idea what happened.. We shared a kottu and it was okey, my son had chicken curry but after 10 min we had to ask for the rice. We asked for the rice again before it arrived… And after that we were served the bottle of water, when the plates were nearly empty.

Ayye seemed very stressed, but it was only us and one small family in the restaurant. Feels like the restaurant has potential though!

Such a lovely little spot! We had mixed rice, a chicken burger 🍔 with perfectly crispy French fries, and a refreshing watermelon juice 🍹 Everything was tasty and satisfying. The place is small but clean and neat, with a cozy vibe. The staff were amazing — always smiling, polite, and very welcoming. Great food at a good price. Definitely worth visiting again! ♥️

Lovely new restaurant right by Thalpe Beach. I stopped here after visiting the natural rock pools and had a great experience.
The owner is very kind and welcoming and made me feel comfortable right away. I had a tropical bowl and a chicken fried rice, both were freshly prepared and very tasty.
The place itself is also really nicely designed with a stylish and cozy interior. You can tell it's a new place and that they care about the atmosphere.
Definitely a nice spot to eat if you’re spending time at the Thalpe natural pools or walking along the beach.
Lovely place run by a family duo. Good food, reasonably priced and relaxed atmosphere
Nice place with tasty food and friendly people. Highly recommend! Thank you guys
Love this restaurant ! Best smoothie bowl in Sri Lanka

Magnificent food, super polite service, pleasant music and atmosphere! All food is made with love and detailed care! We tried to remember if we have found anything more tasty here! We recommend this place 100%
We had fresh, delicious fish here. I highly recommend the mixed grilled fish, it was excellent. The place is clean, local, and has a pleasant atmosphere. I strongly recommend it
Excellent restaurant with delicious food and lovely staff. I highly recommend it!
Very kind and the food is excellent.

Welcoming place and vibes,  the owners are super friendly and accommodating. The food is super tasty and fresh. Couldn't stop myself from eating some before taking the pictures  because everything looked (and was)  so delicious. Highly recommend to anyone that wants to enjoy a incredible good meal. Hopefully will be back soon.

We had an amazing crab, lobster and prawns - freshly collected from the ocean right when we came to the restaurant. It is a perfect family restaurant, the owners are so kind are happy to provide you the best seafood experience!
Best prawns we’ve ever had!

Food looks very delicious.
Will test it very soon.
Best food 👌

From the outside, this place looks completely unassuming, you could easily drive past it without noticing. We actually only planned to stop for a quick bite on our way somewhere else. Instead, we ended up staying for several hours.

The restaurant opens up to an absolutely beautiful, quiet beach with extremely blue water. After eating, we couldn’t resist going for a swim because the sea looked so inviting. While we were in the water, we even saw several sea turtles swimming past us.

The food was outstanding, genuinely some of the best we’ve had during our trip. The deviled prawns were exceptional and the homemade iced tea was incredible and easily the best we’ve had here.

A special mention goes to the ladies serving us - they were incredibly kind, warm, and attentive. Their hospitality made the whole experience even more memorable.

Had a wonderful experience here! The staff were extremely polite and friendly, the pristine blue beach view was breathtaking, and the traditional Sri Lankan food was outstanding. Special shoutout to the egg hoppers—absolutely delicious and unforgettable.

We were passing this place when the heavy rain started, so we decided to stop for lunch, and we weren’t disappointed for sure! The lady who owns the place has a fantastic personality, she is a pure fire! She cooked us some of the best rice and curry we’ve ever tried and also an italian-style octopus that was delicious! We ended up chatting over the coffee and she told us many things about herself and her life. We were happy that the rain started when we were passing by at the end. This is a gem! 💎❤️

Absolutely beautiful little restaurant. The owner is the cook & she did an amazing job.
Octopus was not on the menu, but was caught fresh out front of the restaurant today. Do yourself a favour & come support this lovely lady. There are also 5 rooms available for accommodation.

Absolute perfection! The meal was sooo delicious I licked my plate clean - freshly caught squid with potato, garlic, parsley and olive oil. I requested a passion fruit lassi (not on menu) and was serve one of the best i've had during my time in Sri Lanka (a definite must have). The whole dining experience was one of the very best I have had - the warm and friendly service was delightful and the view was second to none. I would highly recommend coming here for a meal - one you will truly enjoy. Thank you Turtle Beach Restaurant for providing such an awesome service! BTW - they have adjoining accommodation with direct access to a private beach - i will definitely be staying here in my next trip to Sri Lanka🥰

We stayed for 3 nights. What I loved most was the family's hospitality. Chaminda and Brianca are a super friendly couple, and so is their daughter, Pumudi. We felt right at home the whole time. We would have loved to stay longer, but we want to see more of Sri Lanka. The breakfasts were amazing and very generous, and we even had a delicious shrimp dish with amazing spices for dinner there once! On our first day, they welcomed us with a delicious mango juice!
The house has a large garden with lots of tropical trees, and it's absolutely beautiful. The room was large, spacious, and very clean. Everything was truly amazing. The beach is just a few meters away, where you can see tons of turtles and nature, and you don't need to give money to the people on the beach if they offer to show you the turtles. You can easily see them yourself while swimming.
If I were to return, I would definitely stay here again. Chaminda also offers to take you wherever you want to go for a very reasonable price. They also offer laundry service. We'll miss you!

If you want to feel at home, relaxed, and listening to birdsong in a beautiful garden, this is the place for you.
A family atmosphere with exquisite food, friendly service, and unbeatable prices.
Just two minutes from Turtle Beach, protected forest areas, and centers where cinnamon making is a truly immersive experience.
I want to express my gratitude and all my love to Brianka, her husband, and their lovely daughter for making us feel like one of their own. One hundred percent recommended.

Located near beaches where you can swim with turtles, local cinnamon farms, and Lake Kogala, where you can enjoy a boat trip and see all kinds of birds and crocodiles.

The hotel has a large garden, encouraging interaction with other guests. The owners, Chaminda and Brianca, along with their daughter Pumudi, make you feel like family and provide you with all the information you need.
We stayed for five days and wouldn't have left if we hadn't booked another hotel for the following days. If I return to Sri Lanka, I wouldn't hesitate to stay there again.

The food here is the best we have eaten in Sri lanka.

With generations cooking together to bring the best authentic Sri lanka food you will not be disaspointed!

The Daal curry its outstanding, as was the chicken and mushroom curry. Beetroot curry incredible and the home made pickle so tasty,

We can not recommend this place more!

My wife and I also had the joy of doing a cooking class with the school - it was a lovely day, would eat here every night if possible!

We came last night, unfortunately we hadn’t made time for a cooking lesson but we will next time. Luckily we did make time for dinner.  Absolutely amazing place, the best food we’ve had in Sri Lanka in a magical setting. A truly family run restaurant, just incredibly special. We’ll be back, hidden gem doesn’t even do it justice. Thank you so much.

A great restaurant! Family run, authentic and delicious. The food was freshly made by a lovely family - we enjoyed the curry and rice which was definitely one of the best we have had so far in Sri Lanka. Good portion sizes too.

The restaurant is tucked away up Palutugaha Road, look out for the sign then cross over the field to find the restaurant.

They do cooking classes here which sound great, sadly we did not have time to do one. We did however buy their own cookbook to try some of the dishes at home!
Amazing place - must go to! Delicious authentic food, restaurant is family run and staff are very kind. We had curries and rice - one of the best Sri Lankan meals we have had. Highly recommend.

Great find, albeit tucked away (photo of map showing location attached!) off the main road by Junction 127!!!! Family run restaurant serving honest, homemade Sri Lankan food.  The owners are lovely and welcoming and the food is cooked freshly when ordered ~ slight wait time but very much worth it. We had a fish & chicken Sri Lankan curry with all the accompanying dishes and a couple of lime juices for a very reasonable price.  Thank you….

My favourite place and the best food we had in Sri Lanka. We came here in the afternoon, warmly welcomed with coconuts, the best sun beds, great food and the most stunning view! Will definitely come back ✨

This is a rare gem - a tiny little beach bar snuck in between the main road and the sea. It’s a million miles away from the big hotels and it’s a rare slice of real Sri Lanka. The guy here is lovely and whilst so many places have become expensive tourist traps this is firmly rooted in true Sri Lankan hospitality - only tell your best of friends

tiny hidden haven.
really friendly staff.

Stones throw from beach with  authentic private beach hut/ cabanna on beach. The beach is beautiful

Delicious home cooked food

reviews.text:
We had a wonderful experience at this villa. The property was spotless, beautifully designed, and very well maintained. The rooms were spacious and comfortable, and the outdoor area was perfect for relaxing. The pool was clean and a great place to unwind.

The location was ideal—peaceful and private, yet close enough to shops and restaurants. The host was extremely welcoming, responsive, and helpful throughout our stay, making everything smooth and stress-free.

We truly enjoyed every moment and would highly recommend this villa to anyone looking for a relaxing and luxurious getaway. We would definitely love to come back!

We had such a lovely stay at Noa Sands Talpe and their sister villa Aires Island. The place is absolutely beautiful, calm, and peaceful perfect for a relaxing escape.

The food was really good, and the customer service was exceptional. The staff were so helpful, warm, and genuinely lovely throughout our stay.

What made it extra special was how they arranged a cute surprise birthday celebration for us on such short notice. They handled our sudden request so beautifully, and it meant so much.

Definitely a place worth visiting again. Highly recommended for anyone looking for a quiet, relaxing stay with amazing hospitality. 🤍

We had a fantastic experience at Noa Sands Beach Hotel for our first night in Talpe. The location is absolutely perfect — right in front of the beach with a peaceful and relaxing atmosphere. Waking up to the sound of the waves was truly refreshing.

The rooms were clean, comfortable, and well-maintained. The staff was very friendly, supportive, and always ready to help with a smile. Their hospitality made us feel welcome from the moment we arrived.

The beach view and sunset were unforgettable. It was a great place to start our down south trip. I highly recommend this hotel for couples, friends, or anyone looking for a calm beachfront stay in Talpe.

Thank you for the lovely experience — we hope to visit again!

This place is a gem and I sense that it will get busier as more people find out about it. They've only been open 6 months. The beachfront location is fabulous and although the beach is not necessarily advisable for swimming, overlooking the sea from the row of sun loungers or the tables is really incredible. Around sun set, sea turtles can be seen feeding on the sea grass as they swim by, which is a beautiful natural thing compared to Wijaya beach, just a few minutes away, where the turtles are cordoned off in the sea and tourists literally pick them up to be photographe as the latest Instagram post, which is sickening to see. The staff here are so lovely, friendly and accommodating, especially Chataranga, he's a credit to them. The food is great and the coffee amazing!! The accommodation is in shipping containers, which is novel, if not a little tight for space but really clean and great for the price. Personally I'm a bit claustrophobic, so found it a bit too small but that's just me. I would honestly recommend this place 100% for location, staff friendliness, cleanliness, simple good food and price. I'm coming back next year and sense this will get busier as word gets out.

Had a truly unique and refreshing experience at Noa Sands Hotel & Restaurant. The food was absolutely delicious, fresh, and beautifully presented. What made it even more special was the amazing service – the staff were warm, attentive, and genuinely caring throughout our stay.
The room concept built using used shipping containers is incredibly creative and eco-friendly. It gives the place a modern, artistic touch while blending beautifully with nature. It’s not your typical luxury hotel experience — and that’s exactly what makes it special. It’s perfect for those who love new concepts, simple comforts, and meaningful stays rather than expecting a traditional five-star setup.
If you’re a nature lover or someone who enjoys breathtaking sunsets and peaceful surroundings, this is definitely the place for you. Highly recommended for travelers who are always looking for new and unique experiences.
A big thank you to the wonderful owners for creating such a special place and for their warm hospitality. We truly enjoyed every moment! 🌅🌿

reviews.text:
Great little spot, with lots of seating.
Reasonable pricing.
Our train was delayed for an hour, so I popped across for breakfast.
Avo and poached egg on toast and tea were great.
Staff super friendly

18 sanniya provided a very tasty snack lunch of fish tacos. Beautiful spot with comfortable bean bags and swings  to relax and watch the sea including fishermen casting nets. Rashen gave great friendly service and I fell in love with the resident dog Sunny . I would think you would see beautiful sunsets here and the whole design is very stylish, with traditional masks on wall with history. Please visit this gem of a venue.

Superb service and beautiful setting with a private beach front to spend some quality time with friends and loved ones in peace.

Their talented chef was kind enough to prepare a special dish for some friends who were vegetarian since there was not much for them on the menu.. Would be great if you could add some more options for persons like them.

Nice atmosphere with the beach front and breez.beautifully done bean bag layout. Small boutique type new property (felt its still in d process of getting things sorted)Was there for brunch and ordered some breakfast dishes but didnt get d exact  items which was mentioned (carbs) neither was it mentioned by the staff or apologized for it as I ordered the dish especially because of the bread.

A lovely casual bar and eatery outdoors, overlooking the Indian Ocean. Comfortable, laidback atmosphere, good service and yummy food from Pasindu and Harsha.  Just perfect for lunch with a few cocktails or beers or the best lime soda tasted to date!

We had such a wonderful experience at Post 127 Cafe in Talpe! This charming spot perfectly blends a cosy café, stylish restaurant, and relaxed boutique-hotel vibe all in one.
From the moment we arrived, the team made us feel genuinely welcome — the service was warm, attentive, and clearly driven by pride in what they serve. The menu offered a delicious selection of freshly prepared dishes alongside excellent coffee. Everything we tried was full of flavour and beautifully presented, and you can really tell that quality ingredients and care go into every item.
Whether you’re stopping by for breakfast, settling in with a coffee, or enjoying a relaxed meal later in the day, this place truly ticks all the boxes. The atmosphere is calm and inviting, making it perfect for a casual catch-up, a solo coffee break, or even some remote working — the free Wi-Fi was a great bonus.
We loved every moment and can’t wait to return the next time we’re in the area. Highly recommended! ☕✨

Such a lovely restaurant. We went there for lunch. Very relaxed, away from bussy roads but only 2 mins walk from the main road. Perfect location and nice vibe. It's more of lifestyle cafe. Super fast WiFi and get to do some work while enjoying their Caramel Iced Late. I really enjoyed their Tuna Stake with mashed potatoes. Staff were super friendly. I really recommend for a fully relaxed place to have some nice food.

We stayed at the hotel and ate breakfast,  lunch and dinner here. It was always very delicious and flexible for more vegetarian options. There are quite a few food options (local and international). Very quiet and chilled atmosphere. Can highly recommend this place!! Thank you!

We stayed at the Southern Heritage and had great time at the Post 127. The stuff were super nice people, the food was delicious, the atmosphere was quiet and peaceful! Special thanks to Afkar, Dilhare and Randika (sorry if I misspelled) Good luck and more visitors to come and enjoy their vacation at your place. By the way it’s also a good choice for working there too

Uber Eats completely messed up my order and refused to refund my money — basically thieves! 😡 But the owner of this cafe was incredibly kind and professional. He contacted me and personally delivered the correct food to my door to fix Uber's mistake.
I have never seen such amazing service. Don't trust the delivery apps, but definitely trust this place! The owner is a man of his word. 5/5 stars for the restaurant! The absolute best Srilankan food in Talpe. This is very cost effective, clean and delicious curry Rice in Talpe unlike all the other restuarants which are charging 3 times the regular rates. Both take away and dine in available.  The lady who owns the shop is very polite and charges fair prices.  The shop closes at 3 pm so only available for breakfast and lunch.

I wish I could give them a 6th star for their honesty and fair prices.

Best take away breakfast and lunch in my opinion ...homemade and delicious 😋 from 8 am till 2pm every day vegetarian tasty food 5⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
U can also buy some beautiful art from the talented daughter 👍🏽👏🏼🎨🖼️

Awesome traditional authentically delicious Sri Lankan food at a great price. Don’t go to the top off restaurants that are taking advantage of the tourists. Come here for great food and save your money.
Very delicious and tasty Sri Lankan food. Large portions and you don’t have to wait long. Would definitely recommend.

Amazing place with terrific food! Portions are big, prices are low. I am ordering food takeaway for me and my friends almost every day. But hurry up to order, because the food is very fresh the amount of it is limited. By 14:00 the may have nothing left

reviews.text:
Amazing place offering great food with a stunning view of the ocean. We’ve visited often during our stay.

Variety of cuisines, Sri Lankan, Thai, Italian - all is cooked and served on a really good level.
Pizza is cooked in a real wood-burning oven. Which is the right way to cook 🍕

Outstanding desserts and Coconut mousse which just blown my mind. Really well done.

As an additional benefits for the main course you also get:
