- if you have small kids, they can play in a sand while you are enjoying yourself food. Toys are there

We enjoyed a lot. Thank you! All the best ❤️

They accept both cards and cash.
Prices are reasonable

If there were more stars I would’ve given them to this place!! The nicest we visited during our stay in Sri Lanka. Nice food and drinks. But the best was the atmosphere here. I felt like being on a set of some romantic Hollywood movie. I rarely give such a good review. This place has earned it. (Only the Shanti sauce was not great, tasted like a diluted sweet chilli sauce). The pizza was phenomenal though. Better than in Italy to be honest!

Very delicious food, good atmostphere, nice views and very good service. We got the octopus and the curry and both were delicious. The banana frité was also spectacular! I do recommend this place, it is a bit pricy to be honest but the quality price is decent.

Enjoyed this place a lot! Food is tasty and the menu has different options to choose from. The staff speaks English, is polite and very welcoming. To our pleasant surprise food was served quite fast as well, which was not our general experience in other places in Sri Lanka. One member of the staff even followed us on scooter to return the cap we forgot. The view and atmosphere in general is also amazing!

The restaurant is located by the side of the main road, with direct access to the beach. Beautiful location, well maintained.
We were in a group of more than 10 adults, and the staff accommodated us quickly providing tables nearest to the beach.
We ordered seafood pizza, creamy pasta both chicken & seafood, tuna tartare, chicken panini, yellow rice with calamari and tamarind passion splash.
Food and drinks were tasty, enjoyed by all. Will be back for more.
Parking is available for a few vehicles in the adjoining land.

"Sea brew beach restaurant"

Good food, great vibes, ocean breeze… and turtles! 🐢✨ Watching turtles swim by while enjoying a meal made this place extra special... 😍

Absolutely loved our experience at this beachside spot! From the moment we sat down with the sound of waves in the background, everything felt perfect. We tried the grilled fish and fresh seafood curry — both were flavorful and cooked just right. The view of the ocean made every bite better, and the breeze kept it cool even midday. Our server was friendly and attentive, always checking in without rushing us. Prices were fair for the portion sizes, and the casual, relaxed atmosphere made it a great place to linger after our meal. Highly recommend for anyone looking for delicious food with an unforgettable sea view.. ♥️
Great spot for a refreshing drink and amazing coastal views. The aesthetic is perfect for photos, and the vibe is super relaxed. A must visit if you’re in the area!

Absolutely loved the food, it was very tasty and full of flavor. The service was excellent, and the staff were friendly and attentive throughout. The overall experience was enjoyable and satisfying. Highly recommended and will definitely visit again.
Staff is really nice and very welcoming. You can tell they put a lot of effort into their restaurant! View is also great!
Nice beach and nice mocktails really good place in thalpe♥️

This might be my new favorit place for local food in the area.
The food is amazing. Some dishes they cook over wood fire and it gives an amazing taste to the food.
They don‘t use chemicals to spice the food either!
The view is 10/10!
While eating you can watch so many turtles in the dreamy blue colored ocean.
10/10 recommended.
They even gave me a free coconut and a banana with fresh honey from the jungle.
Here they won‘t overcharge you.
Happy that there is still places like this on the southcoast.

Very delicious and fresh food, the vegetable rice and curry is amazing and this for only 500 rupees. The owner family is just lovely, always happy. You can also just stop for a fresh king coconut and watch the beautiful sunset. We come back, thank youuuu :)
Best coconut roti ever!! They offer rice&curry and handmade fresh coconut roti. Place is beautiful and family is amazing. If you wanna taste real Sri Lanka local food - this is the place.
food is good portion for us. i had fish with rice. for 2 dish and 2 huge coconut we paid 2500. we had dinner. the owner is very friendly. only got a but scared of the dogs.
We had a lovely vegetable curry and rice at this unassuming little roadside cafe with a lovely sea view. Great flavours, local’s prices and fast, friendly service

formatted_address: No.78 Lansiya waththa, Talpe, Sri Lanka
name: Gami Gedara Restaurant

reviews.text: One of the best Sri Lankan rice and curry experiences! Authentic flavours, great portions, and amazing taste. A must-try for anyone who loves proper Sri Lankan food in Habaraduwa near Thalpe. Highly recommended …

10/10!! Came here for dinner and had the best time. The food is incredible tasty. It’s a calm place tun by locals that feels like a hidden gem. I can highly recommend the cheese kothu and deviled chicken.
The curry in Curry Lodge is very delicious. We had 4 types of curry with plain rice and everything was very tasty. The service is fast and very friendly. We will definitely come back again.

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
This place truly exceeded our expectations. The environment was clean, well-maintained, and peaceful throughout. It was evident that great care had been taken to ensure cleanliness in every corner. The food was served in a very hygienic and organized manner, and the taste was equally satisfying. We had a pleasant experience and truly appreciated the attention to detail. Highly recommended for anyone looking for a clean and well-managed place!
Amazing authentic sri lankan food freshly cooked.  We enjoyed our lemon rice and the vegetable coco curry very much

formatted_address: No 846/B, Matara Road Thalpe, Unawatuna 80600, Sri Lanka
name: Rangana Hotel

reviews.text: really good place! you can seat just in front of the ocean, tasty food, great service, reasonable prices (6000 for the dinner - 4 persons)
Excellent local food, nice staff
Excellent local food, nice staff
Good resturant and room
Best Hotel in Thalpe

formatted_address: X7XG+988, Matara Rd, Unawatuna, Sri Lanka
name: Golden restaurant & juice bar

reviews.text: Good food and good service best place in thalpe
Very tasty the buffet just for 300ruppees the best, friendly staff and good atmosphere, I'll come back for sure. :)
Good taste❤️good place❤️ everything❤️golden juice bar & restaurant❤️
Best place..100%
Good 😀

formatted_address: X7XG+98F, Matara Rd, Talpe, Sri Lanka
name: Randeepa hotel

reviews.text: Amazing restaurant run by a lovely lady and her family. Unique atmosphere as you are sitting very close to the ocean. The meals are delicious, especially the fresh fish, lobster and octopus that we had, as well as many kinds of curries while we stayed there.

super fantastic place, this is another ...wow. people were very cleaned kind. Service can recommend super...food fantastic ...
its feel like home. BCs they very close to us. so, i had a great time with them. Thank you very much for turtle beach team.

Such a hidden gem! ❤️ You might pass it unnoticed but that kind of places are the best! Run by such a lovely lady, who even helped us to find a house! Food was delicious, super fresh and tasty. We had full fish and, rice and curry and fish curry. The location is golden, you have little hidden beach, and you basically eat next to the ocean. Definitely check this place out!
Beautiful place - on the beach, great menu and saw some sea turtles casually!

Lovely and friendly service. The fish was beautifully cooked and the accompanying “sauce” complimented brilliantly.
Sometimes it pays to just wander down the beach and see what you will find. Such a shame it is our last day!!

A wonderful beach restaurant with an amazing atmosphere. The service was excellent, everyone was incredibly kind and helpful. The food was fresh, high quality, and beautifully prepared. On top of that, the view of the sea and the sunset was absolutely stunning. A place we would happily come back to

Lovely restaurant by the ocean off the main road! The views are stunning and you could also have a swim here. We ordered the fried rice, calamari and the butterflied prawns - found the seafood to be incredibly fresh.

It is a must visit place:

1) The food is outstanding. We ordered Chicken Kottu which was really comforting

2) The sunsets are outright gorgeous

3) I forgot carrying my wallet at our AirBnB, and the owner Mr.Ravi was extremely considerate about the situation and allowed us to go back and fetch it. Doesn’t mean anyone should try to pull this off. Please be considerate and kind to the team ;)

Found this cafe by chance, not knowing what a gem it would be. The food is outrageously good and the best part is you can spot wild turtles…. A must visit if you want to skip the scores of beaches promoting hand-fed turtles.

The beach is a beautiful turquoise and swimable too with good waves!

We had an absolutely wonderful time at Tuna Beach Club. The owner and the entire staff are incredibly warm and welcoming, making the atmosphere feel special from the moment you arrive. The place is beautifully maintained and spotless, with a perfect shaded area that was ideal for our children.
​The beach itself is small but truly magical—perfect for those who want to avoid commercial, overcrowded beaches. The ocean is wild here with big waves that are great fun to play in, and the sand is beautiful. A real highlight was seeing sea turtles right there; it’s a natural paradise!
​The whole club was totally renovated about a month ago, and it’s phenomenal. The food was another highlight; everything was extremely fresh and delicious. We had the octopus and calamari, and both were outstanding. If you’re looking for a peaceful, clean, and friendly spot away from the crowds, this is it!

formatted_address: No 637 Lansiya watta, තල්පෙ 80615, Sri Lanka
name: Persian Kitchen (BBQ)

reviews.text: Dropped in for a quiet date night and was blown away by the food! The prawns are a MUST try and the beef is soft, succulent, and perfectly cooked. The saffron ice cream was the perfect end to our meal. Great ambiance and service was phenomenal, highly recommend!

Fabulous! When you visit Unawatuna and have had you fill of curry and pasta, this is the place to go, great service from friendly waiters, great ambience with muted levels of music and the food is amazing. We have never had BBQ on this level before. Already booked to return! Definitely worth a visit (booking advised)

Persian Kitchen is hands down one of my favorite restaurants in Sri Lanka. The food is outstanding, with consistently top-quality ingredients and flavors. I’ve been coming here for years, and the quality has never once changed. The owners are incredibly warm and welcoming, making every visit feel special. Truly a must-go spot for anyone who loves great food and genuine hospitality.

We absolutely adore Persian Kitchen! Our family - my husband and our two kids (2 and 5 years) are always so excited to visit. The food is wonderful - the meat is superbly cooked. The olive oil used is succulent- the restaurant itself has a very ‘Sunday’ family feel atmosphere with gorgeous music and the setting is always perfect. Thank you Persian kitchen! As we came today and have fallen in love for the 10th time -

Amazing food and great vibes. The beef was insanely tender, literally melting in the mouth. Had a homemade ayran which was super fresh, plus really good oysters with their own chili sauce. Ginger beer on the side was a perfect match.

The owner is super friendly (Wajda fan :) and the service was excellent. You can tell they really care about what they do. Definitely worth a visit.
It's really great, if you can say something like this in Habaraduwa, we're proud to be here. It's really great, brother, let's play a game.🫶💗
I ordered deviled seafood. It was not tasty at all! Also the portion was small. Nobody speaks English there too.
Amazing place I had ever gone, affordable price, delicious foods, and very comfortable nature view, and everything works well, also very fast delivery.

Best place habaraduwa.
Very kindly staff and food
Lovely family run restaurant. They go out of their way to make your experience a good one. Worth a visit...support local!
Amazing place, super chill and the food it’s incredible.
Great food; both the traditional nasi, the cuttlefish and spaghetti aglio olio were very good and fresh. Big portion sizes.

✍️Visited The FOOD CART by Jani (📍located close to Habaraduwa, Galle District) and ordered their Cheek Chicken Pasta 🍝 and Cheese Chicken Kottu 🍛. The taste was okay and filling — ideal for a casual, quick bite.

The place is a bit small, so it’s more suited for takeaways 🥡 or short stops. Service was polite and reasonably quick.

If you're passing through Habaraduwa and craving a budget-friendly, simple meal, this spot is a decent option to check out.

Amazing food for the BEST portion prices and quick service too.
Definitely coming here again whenever I get to Thalpe

We took food for Takeaway.
Chicken Burger, Chicken Wrap, two different kinds of Pasta. The food was extremely tasty and still warm even if we only eat 30min later.
The submarine is exceptional as well as the Pasta.

Only the burger would need some more sauce or less dry chicken.

formatted_address: A2 Matara Road, Hadiwaththa, Habaraduwa 80630, Sri Lanka
name: Chai Cafe

reviews.text: Superb Place✌️

A true hidden gem in Habaraduwa! The chai is perfectly spiced — rich, aromatic, and served piping hot. Pair it with their fresh pol roti and you have the most satisfying Sri Lankan breakfast combo. Simple place, big heart.
Super tasty pol sambol with hot roasted bread and delicious chai! Loved the great service by the two young members. Great!

Amazing experience at Chai Cafe! The masala chai was rich, flavorful, and perfectly made. Cozy atmosphere, friendly staff, and great service. A perfect place to relax with friends and enjoy fresh tea and snacks. Highly recommended for every chai lover! ☕✨

Very possibly my favourite hotel in the world! What an amazing find. A friendly intimate boutique hotel on the most pristine stretch of white sand beach. The staff are so friendly and accommodating. Nothing is too much trouble. We had a noise fro our ceiling fan and within minutes a man arrived at our room to fix it . The same was true for the laundry request which was speedy and great value. The food is spectacular. I ate the best piece of belly pork I have ever had. And as for the massage from Sumudu at the sister hotel - this was truly blissful and utterly world class. As KK
hotel manager said to us - service is in their blood and I agree . Sri Lanka and KK has blown us away with their kind friendly and attentive welcome. It’s just become our favourite holiday place in the world!

We recently spent 4 nights at KK Beach relaxing after our tour of Sri Lanka. The manager and his staff were really friendly. We would like to mention Kasun who looked after us at the pool, making sure our beds were in the right place and popping up to provide extra towels whenever we needed them. Always happy and very efficient.
Prior to arriving we hadn’t really thought about the ability to visit the sister hotel - Kahanda Kanda. We went there several times via their free transfer for both lunch and dinner. A lovely contrast in the jungle from a beach base. The owner George has a great team and he made sure to chat to all the guests. Best bit - watching Crazy Rich Asians one evening.

A hidden piece of paradise just a short car journey from Galle.

Located on the beach this is a quality boutique hotel with a small number of rooms and suites. We were fortunate to have Penthouse Suite 5.

Beautifully decorated with a large bedroom, separate sitting room an bathroom. Silence, except when the patio doors are open, when the only sound is the ocean, literally yards away.

All rooms have fantastic views out over the swimming pool and ocean.

There is direct access to the beach. Soft white sand with virtually no-one on it.

This is the perfect place to relax and unwind.

Service is outstanding but not  intrusive.

The food very good, and a mix of Sri Lankan dishes with a few European options if required.

Decent drinks menu, with wine options at reasonable prices.

The staff are all very polite, and cannot help enough.

If you visit KK Beach you will not be disappointed

Leaving KK Beach today was genuinely emotional — I was in tears because I simply didn’t want to go. This place is pure magic.

From the moment we arrived, everything was perfect. The food is absolutely exceptional — fresh, creative, and bursting with flavour. The staff are some of the warmest and most caring people I’ve ever met; they look after you at every step without ever being intrusive. The atmosphere is effortlessly chic yet incredibly relaxed, making it impossible not to feel at home.

Every detail here shows how much they care — not just about the property, but about their guests. It’s rare to find a place where everything comes together so beautifully: the people, the food, the vibe, the view.

This isn’t just a hotel. It’s a place that makes you feel truly seen, welcomed, and cared for. I can’t wait to come back. ❤️

A beautiful boutique gem right on the beachfront – the KK Collection never disappoints. We were warmly welcomed at KK Beach and checked into a spacious sea-view suite with modern interior design and a serene atmosphere.

The pool was perfect for refreshing morning swims, and the stylish sunbeds made it easy to relax and unwind. From the property, there’s a short climb down to the beach, where you can enjoy long, peaceful walks along the shore.

The staff were exceptionally friendly and attentive throughout our stay. Breakfast was à la carte, featuring generous fresh fruit platters, and the coconut pancakes were an absolute highlight – a must-try!

We can wholeheartedly recommend KK Beach as a pristine, relaxing, and high-quality beach getaway.
Super service team.
Delicious food and excellent friendly service.

A good restaurant on the hotel premises.

The menu has very few items, and the prices are above average.

We ordered two pastas (with tomato and cream sauces for 1800 rupees each, and two coconuts for 200 rupees each). The food was prepared quickly, and surprisingly, the portions were large and quite tasty!

The service was excellent, and the staff was friendly.

The premises are very clean and cozy, and there are very few customers, which is also a bonus.

We definitely want to return.
Not a bad restaurant! The price and quality are in line.

Let's start with the fact that getting into the restaurant from the street isn't easy. There's no sign from the street or entrance, and the security guards only decided among themselves whether to let us in. Essentially, the hotel restaurant isn't welcoming such guests; it's open only to hotel guests. The atmosphere is cozy, but nothing more, and the price tag is twice as high. It didn't live up to expectations.

We had the best stay at this boutique hotel! The staff are so kind and lovely! We spent 3 nights here and we were able to relax and enjoy our time. The room was very clean and spacious and the pool was fabulous! We will definitely be staying here if and when we come back to Sri Lanka

Serenity Boutique is one of the most peaceful hotels I’ve stayed at. The atmosphere is wonderfully quiet and relaxing, yet it’s not far from the lively part of Unawatuna, so you can easily enjoy both nature and city life.

🌿 Location & atmosphere
Surrounded by nature, the hotel feels like a hidden retreat. The calm and silence are truly special — perfect if you want to disconnect and rest.

🏊 Swimming pool
The pool is beautiful and unique, blending perfectly with the natural surroundings. It’s a great place to relax at any time of the day.

🍳 Food & breakfast
The breakfast is excellent, fresh, and very well prepared. The food overall is delicious, with great quality and taste.

🤍 Staff & service
The staff is very young, friendly, and enthusiastic, always smiling and ready to help. Their positive energy really adds to the experience.

💰 Prices
Prices are very fair and affordable, especially considering the quality of the accommodation, food, and service.

Overall it was a quiet, calm and great experience but the things that ruined the entire experience was FOOD, FOOD and FOOD.
The hotel is beautiful and good. Staff is helpful, overall amenities were good too.
Location is a bit weird. Although I liked the location but a place like Unawatuna where people come for the beach it is known for it's great Southern coast, a hotel in the middle of a jungle 4-5kms away from beach is quite awful. Had it been a place somewhere else then I would have said the location is awesome as it is far from the city and between quiet, serene farms.
There aren't any restaurant nearby the hotel as this is quite aloof from the city and the only option you have is yonordet food from the hotel which is ridiculous.

Serenity Boutique Hotel is truly an oasis of peace hidden in the middle of the jungle. The swimming pool is absolutely beautiful, surrounded by lush nature, creating a calm and relaxing atmosphere.
The rooms are large and spacious, with high-quality furniture and excellent comfort. One thing that really stood out was the hot water with strong pressure — something quite rare to find in Sri Lanka.
The staff is exceptional. Every time we needed something, they were there to help with kindness and professionalism, always making us feel welcome and taken care of.
I wholeheartedly recommend Serenity Boutique Hotel to anyone looking for tranquility, comfort, and genuine hospitality

This was such a fantastic stay. The perfect end to our 3 week trip in Sri Lanka. The rooms are so beautiful and clean and the pool is great. The staff were so kind and helpful at all times. Keshan looked after us so well, nothing we asked was too much. He is brilliant at his job, the best in Sri Lanka 🇱🇰

name: Serenity Boutique Restaurant (Special Sri Lankan Rice And Curry Daily)

reviews.text: Food was delicious! As you can see the portion size is generous. This was the rice and curry for one person. It’s reasonably priced too.

Very calm and pleasant place.Rooms were spacious ,comfortable and clean..Staff was friendly and very helpful. Superb service, of course beyond our expectations .Food was delicious..👍Had a wonderful experience and will definitly visit again...

The nicest boutique hotel we have ever stayed in Sri Lanka. The rooms were large, spacious  and very clean. The restaurant was well equipped with modern utensils The food given by the hotel is nutritious and very tasty. We recommend this hotel to every guest in the world to have their vacations in a meaningful luxurious way.
-Cliiford Jayawardana & family.
Great deal for the money, nice and well trained staff with delicious food. Serene view with the pool is a great mixture of calmness.
Excellent place. Delicious food. Good hospitality. Feel like to go again for a gathering

gorgeous little family run place right on the beach - we had dinner here on our first night here and came back for breakfast a couple of days later.

both times we basically had the place to ourselves - no idea why it was so quiet as the food was absolutely delicious and it felt like the best spot in town to watch the sunset.

A hidden gem! 🌟
Amazing spot right on the beach with just a few tables, so it’s never crowded. The food is incredible—fresh fish, shrimps, and homemade fries, all super fresh and local. The owner was so friendly, and you can tell it’s a family-run place. The only thing to note is that you need to be patient, as there is usually a bit of a wait for the food to arrive.

An authentic Sri Lankan experience in a family restaurant where simpleness makes it perfect. We had a fresh fish cooked perfectly with rice, salad & chips. Nothing fancy but I can assure you this is the best value for money in Galle.
Very small shack - but fresh food and great service . No road sign - u need to enter thru a bar next door

What a little gem, outside of all the crowded area’s you’ll find this perfect little spot.

Without massive amounts of tables you’ll do without the lack of attention and mass service.
It’s personal food at its best, the menu is simple but the flavors are very intricate and rich. While I’ve been so far away from home, this place reminded me that it actually isn’t so far away. I thoroughly enjoyed their Sri Lankan dishes and authentic flavors; I’ll be sure to come here again during my next visit.

Thanks a lot 🙏

formatted_address: 273F+XJG King and queen, Talpe, Sri Lanka
name: King and Queen

formatted_address: paragan village, no.11, Talpe 80615, Sri Lanka
name: King and Queen Cantina Talpe

reviews.text:
Went here for lunch with a group of over 20 friends. There was plenty of seating available and a nice outdoor garden area as well.

We ordered the Seafood Shovel Rice and Fried Rice, the food was really good, nothing to complain about.

The place also has a beautiful, clean pool that perfectly complements the relaxing atmosphere.

Highly recommend this spot for a laid-back lunch or even a few drinks with friends. Great food, space, and vibes overall!

Had an amazing experience at King and Queen Cantina in Thalpe! The service was excellent from start to finish, and the food was absolutely delicious. Loved the added perks pool access and a relaxing kayak boat ride that made the day even more memorable. Grateful for the warm hospitality and great service throughout.
Highly recommended for anyone looking for fun, comfort, and good vibes!

“Very nice place, very clean, beautiful, and peaceful. Lovely canals, squirrels running around. The staff are very friendly and welcoming. When we were there, there were no people at all — strange that people prefer crowded conveyor-belt places instead of real, calm Sri Lankan life, where you can truly feel nature and peace. I definitely recommend it!!! Food prices compared to restaurants by the beach are much cheaper!”

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
A hidden gem in Talpe!

King and Queen Cantina offers a very calm and peaceful environment, perfectly tucked away from the busy town. Prices are quite reasonable compared to other nearby places, and the portions of food are generous with great taste. The service is friendly and attentive, making the whole experience even better.

One of the highlights is the pool access — they even have day packages if you just want to relax and enjoy the facilities. Overall, it’s an excellent spot for good food, relaxation, and value for money. Highly recommended!
Very nice place with tasty food And super friendly Staff. We highly recommend coming here 😀

Delicious food with generous portions and exceptional service. The staff are incredibly friendly, polite, and welcoming. The beach view adds a perfect touch to the whole experience. Overall, I absolutely loved this place and would highly recommend it ✨❤️

The best food in the entire neighbourhood and the best view!
We loved this place so much that we came for lunch and dinner every single day during our whole stay. The food is delicious, the atmosphere is perfect, and the view is unbeatable.
Also, the owner is incredibly nice and kind🥰🫶
Highly recommend to anyone visiting Talpe!

A really great beach side restaurant. Incredibly friendly staff and good service. Lovely to hear the sea while eating our dinner. We had the fish curry which was amazing, fresh and really tasty. Good selection of fair priced drinks. If staying longer we would definitely go again.

A nice place to hang up with your friends in an evening, watching sunset and the waves, may be holding on to a drink.
Atmosphere is stunning. Easily accessible. I rated 4/5 cz they can improve the services and atmosphere and make it even better and more attractive!

We went to the A Bar today (3 Oct) for lunch. Atmosphere looked really nice and we liked what they have done with the space as this is a beach front property.
We ordered panko crusted prawns 🍤 and a smoky black pork for lunch. The panko crusted prawns were okay but we were not happy with how the smoky black pork tasted and we also felt like it lacked flavour too.
When we wanted to order some mocktails the waiter said that they don’t do mocktails and all they have is coke and sprite only, but on the menu it says that they are serving mocktails also. We were not sure whether the waiter said this out of laziness or because whether they actually didn’t have it.
Overall, atmosphere of the bar looks nicer but I don’t think that the quality of the food and the service is worth the price.
Very kind and good food directly at an empty beach
Delicious sea foods . Loves it 😍❤️
best pancakes

A place with a cozy vibe & friendly atmosphere.. located in Mihiripenna , facing main road. This place has a beautiful view of the beach and private entrance too. Prices are reasonable, highly appreciate the hospitality specially for the locals and recommended!!
A very beautiful cafe right on the ocean. Beautiful views, delicious food, and friendly service. A great place to relax and enjoy the atmosphere.

formatted_address: X8V4+F26, Matara Rd, Habaraduwa, Sri Lanka
name: Police Inspectors' Mess Galle

reviews.text: Good Place for relax and take a bite. But only available for Inspectors of Police and their families. You can get a nice view of Habaraduwa beach also.
Too much stupid rules. Can not relax with the environment due to restrictions
Only for Police officers
Yes, its ok, (2021)

name: The Dutch, Restaurant and Lounge by Tabula Rasa Resort & Spa

reviews.text:
We stayed at Tabula Rasa and loved the Dutch restaurant, where we had breakfast every morning and enjoyed many evening meals with our toddler. The traditional Sri Lankan curry and prawn coconut curry were outstanding, some of the freshest and best prawns we’ve had on our trip.

The staff were incredibly kind and attentive to our two-year-old, always going the extra mile to make her feel special with her favourite foods and friendly interactions. This made our stay even more memorable in such a peaceful, mostly adult hotel.

We especially recommend the Sri Lankan breakfast,  the coconut roti and hoppers were the highlight of our holiday! The avocado toast was also delicious. Our only small suggestion is to add homemade granola and authentic Greek yogurt to the western breakfast options.

A huge thank you to Tiran, Sahan, Bodana, Mahesh, and Akila for their exceptional service & cooking they truly made our stay magical. We can’t wait to come back!

One of the best spots in the South! We visited the Dutch Restaurant last weekend and were absolutely impressed. The food was outstanding — fresh, full of flavour, and beautifully presented. The view overlooking the ocean added so much charm to the whole experience; it’s the perfect place to unwind and enjoy a meal.

The staff were incredibly friendly and attentive, making us feel right at home from the moment we arrived. The atmosphere was calm and relaxing — ideal for both couples and families.

We’ll definitely be going back again soon! Highly recommend this place to anyone visiting the South — it’s a must-try restaurant that perfectly combines great food, great views, and warm hospitality.

My partner and I had a wonderful evening at The Dutch Restaurant, and it was truly one of the highlights of our stay. The seafood was exceptionally fresh—each dish tasted beautifully prepared and full of flavor, making it clear that quality ingredients are a top priority here.

The staff were another standout. Everyone we interacted with was polite, warm, and genuinely attentive without being intrusive, which made the entire experience feel relaxed and welcoming.

What we enjoyed most was the calm, soothing ambiance. After spending time at the spa at Tabula Resort, the restaurant felt like the perfect continuation of that sense of relaxation. The peaceful atmosphere made it ideal for unwinding and enjoying a leisurely meal together.

We both thoroughly enjoyed our evening, from start to finish. The food was so impressive that we’ve already decided we’ll be returning to try the lunch menu on our next visit. Highly recommended for anyone looking for great food, excellent service, and a tranquil dining experience.

The Dutch Restaurant and Lounge at delivers a perfect blend of stunning setting, exquisite flavors, and impeccable service, making it a must-visit destination on the South for anyone looking to indulge in a memorable dining experience.

We had a really warm welcome from the head waiter Tiran, he also helped us to choose our first sri lankan food😇The barman called Sahan made the best cocktails 🍸 The restaurant itself is located on a hill, just 5 min ride from the main road with a scooter - you’ll have a really good hide-away feeling☺️
Nice people, amazing food
Good
We ordered seafood rice and fish noodles. Large, delicious portions. We loved it.
Tasty and cheap
The food was delicious.

Stumbled upon this little cafe near our hotel, and so glad we did! The staff were warm and welcoming, made proper coffee, fresh juice and a delicious breakfast. It was so good we nearly forgot to take a photo 😅  Tropical Smoothie Bowl and Bananan Nutella Pancakes. Definitely worth a visit if you need a good coffee to get you going. We'll definitely be back.

reviews.text:
I visited this restaurant again after many years, and it brought back so many childhood memories. Back then, there weren’t many restaurants in this area, and Sahana Restaurant was one of the biggest and most popular places around. I’m happy to see that it is still well maintained even today.
The place feels just like it did years ago. It’s a great spot for families because children have space to play. One thing I really love is the beautiful access to the beach, which is nicely arranged. Enjoying some tasty food while looking at the sea view makes the experience even better.
Good place to have a snack. Close to karapitiya hospital. Little expensive compared to other places. But food is served in proper manner.
Very good food, freshly made and amazing staff! And an amazing view!

Sahana Restaurant enjoys a beautiful location with great potential. Sadly, our experience was let down by the service.

Positives
- Scenic setting that creates a pleasant atmosphere.
- The restaurant itself has the charm to attract many visitors.

Concerns
- Staff were highly unprofessional, unfriendly, and at times outright rude.
- Customer service was extremely poor, leaving us disappointed despite the lovely surroundings.
- Basic hospitality standards were missing, which overshadowed the restaurant’s natural appeal.

Recommendation
The owners must urgently address staff training, professionalism, and attitude. A restaurant in such a prime location deserves service that matches its beauty. Until these issues are resolved, the charm of Sahana Restaurant is lost in the frustration of dealing with poor customer service.

We visited this busy restaurant for lunch and decided to try their fried rice. The portion size was quite large, making it a hearty meal for one person. The dish was served with fried chicken, a boiled egg, chili paste, and mango chutney, adding a nice variety of flavors to the plate.

While the taste was decent, the portion was a bit too much for me to finish. The service was good, with the staff being attentive and efficient despite the crowd. The ambiance was average, as the restaurant was quite crowded, which made the dining experience a little less relaxing.

Overall, if you’re looking for a place that offers generous portions at a reasonable price, this could be a good option, but be prepared for a busy atmosphere during peak hours.

reviews.text:
We decided to give this caterer a chance for our baby’s 1st birthday event after checking their Google reviews. We discussed everything with the owner more than a month in advance. We clearly confirmed catering for 80 pax with 6 curries, egg rice, welcome drinks, desserts, two stewards, and buffet opening at 7.00 PM.

The experience unfortunately did not go as agreed.

They arrived late and the buffet was not ready even by 8.00 PM, which resulted in guests waiting. They came prepared with only around 50 plates for an 80-pax function, and we had to provide additional plates from our home to manage the situation.
Food was not consistently refilled  especially the chicken. Before serving approximately 65 guests, the food was finished. The owner informed us he would return within 10 minutes with additional food but came back after about 35 minutes.
Ice cream quantity was also limited, and we had to arrange additional supplies ourselves. Some agreed menu items were also not available as discussed.
Although the food taste was good, the quantity planning, timing, and overall coordination did not meet expectations for an event of this size.
We paid the remaining balance after the event as agreed, despite the challenges faced.
I am writing this review a few days after the event, as several guests later shared their concerns regarding the catering experience.
Sharing this so others can make an informed decision when planning important functions.

reviews.text: Previously, I ordered from this place through Uber Eats, but today I decided to dine in. I had the creamy cheese pasta, and it was so delicious and super creamy. Lahiru trained under a French chef and has a perfect understanding of the right ingredients, preparation and presentation of delicious healthy food. A wide menu ranging from healthy muesli bowl, omelettes through to local dishes such as kottu (with a healthy oat chicken option - delicious on my third visit!) via rice dishes and pasta. The healthy chicken sandwich looks interesting. All served by the smiling helpful Dushan and Chamika in a cool green garden with a swimming pool. Unique in Galle - try it!

The food was well packed, arrived hot, and the portions were good. As the shop name suggests, the food is made healthy — you can really feel and taste it. However, the nasi goreng tasted more like mixed fried rice rather than traditional nasi goreng. The watalappan was fresh, creamy, and really delicious. They also included a small free cookie, which was a nice touch.

A hidden gem for health-conscious food lovers! All the foods here is flavorful, perfectly cooked, and packed with nutrients. The combination of grains adds a satisfying texture and pairs well with fresh, wholesome side dishes. Great portions, clean ingredients, and friendly service make this spot a go-to for a guilt-free, delicious meal.

🤩 Healthy Eats is a total winner! From the moment I stepped inside, the pristine, well-kept atmosphere was noticeable. But the real star is the food—it's genuinely delicious and bursting with flavor. What truly elevated the experience, though, was the service; the staff were incredibly friendly, polite, and attentive. reviews.text:
We came for what turned out to be quite a leisurely meal and ordered a few things to mixed success. The sizzling pork you wrap in leaves was by far the best. We'd order that again in a heartbeat. The korean chicken was nice and crunchy but was very sweet without much other flavour. The seafood pancake was very tasty. Generous amounts of seafood and a good dipping sauce however the batter could have been cooked a bit longer. The staff were very friendly and asked how spicy we wanted the food so I'm sure you could ask them to cook the pancake batter extra well. Their kimchi is also really good.

5 stars for the sizzling pork.

We had the chance to enjoy a Korean meal around Galle and it was a great experience. The owner was extremely friendly and welcoming, which made the visit even more pleasant. The food was very delicious and reasonably priced. Although the place is a bit small, but that doesn’t take away from the experience. If you’re looking to enjoy authentic and tasty Korean food, this is definitely a nice place to visit.

It was very simple, the ramen I ordered was noodles with scallions and eggs and was spicy, while I expect more from ramen.
But the rice we ordered was good but the menu said it came with meat, which was not pure meat and had some things mixed in.
The staff was great and the atmosphere was average.

I haven’t had authentic Korean food in almost 15 years. Having exhausted Sri Lankan food and tired of western food, it was time to mix things up a bit. It’s a family run restaurant on the busy main coast road in Galle that is very busy. At 6 pm, all the family are there and they’re very happy and entertaining.

Sudath the owner is very informative and fluent in Korean, he spent ten years there so is very knowledgeable and passionate about his restaurant. Looking for inspiration and wanting something I hadn’t tried before, I ordered Maeun - Tang (local spicy fish stew.) It was cooked on a gas stove in a small wok with Korean vegetables, spices and is similar to a broth.

Small trays of Korean vegetables, garlic, sauces and other ingredients were brought to me. Several which I was oblivious to. In 15-20 mins the fish was ready. It was served with a bowl of egg rice. The stew was tasty even though the meal was enough for two people. The fish ( boll ) was challenging as it was very boney and spoilt the enjoyment. You’re forever taking bones from your mouth. The fish wasn’t that tasty if I’m honest.

I didn’t enjoy the meal at all. That’s not to say the meal was below par, it just wasn’t to my liking. I will return and choose something more familiar but still wanting a Korean meal of some description. The menu has an excellent selection. The ambiance is very homely and welcoming. I just chose a meal that wasn’t for me. You win some, you lose some.

I was sceptical at first, but I was so wrong. Their Korean dishes are so tasty, among the best I've tried. Portion was good as well, totally worth the money. Not so spicy as I expected. Only if it's mentioned spicy, it'll be spicy. The lady was so nice as well. Highly recommended.

We did not have time to eat with them, but we wish that we had as the pictures and videos of the food look amazing! Everything is fresh, we would highly recommend! Nayana also cut us up some coconut to try as we had never tried it before, which was really kind.
Very cute little cafe tge owner decorated themself. Such a friendly atmosphere and good food with fair prices. Loved it and defenetly would go again🥰

formatted_address: 26V3+3FX, Bope Cross Rd, Galle, Sri Lanka
name: Ak's Palace

reviews.text: My car My petrol.

formatted_address: 251/29A, Bandrawatta, Kapparatota, Weligama, Weligama 81700, Sri Lanka
name: We Are Surfers hotel

reviews.text:
We absolutely loved our stay at We Are Surfers Hotel.
From the very first day, the place felt special.

The location is perfect — tucked away from the chaos of Weligama and Mirissa, yet still close enough to walk into town whenever you want. It gives you the best of both worlds: peace, nature, and easy access to everything.

The hostel has its own private beach, and honestly, it’s even more beautiful than the main beaches. It’s an incredible spot for snorkeling, advanced surfing, or simply relaxing by the ocean with no crowds around.

The food is amazing — fresh, nourishing, and made with so much care. And the team is truly incredible: always smiling, genuinely kind, super friendly, and ready to help with anything you need. If you want to go somewhere, they can easily arrange a tuk tuk or any transport for you.

It’s the perfect place to slow down, reconnect with nature, and feel at home while traveling.
We would come back in a heartbeat. 🌊✨

Had an incredible stay at We are Surfers! The first thing you notice is the fantastic view—it’s easily one of the best spots in Weligama to wake up to. The staff were so welcoming and friendly, making us feel right at home from the moment we arrived. The best part? The pricing is unbeatable for the quality you get. The beds are very comfortable, and the food was delicious. If you're looking for a great vibe that doesn't break the bank, this is it. Highly recommend!

Stayed at We Are Surfers Surf Camp – a really cool place with a great team and a chill atmosphere for travelers. Great place to surf, relax, and feel at home near the sea.

Experience Rooftop Restaurant is a must-go, guys! Awesome Sri Lankan rice & curry with a nice view from the rooftop. Simple, genuine, and super tasty!

Beautiful facility, absolutely delighted by the friendly and super helpful staff:

1) They helped us plan our airport pickup and drop from Colombo Airport, all very hassle-free

2) Very good meal options for the breakfast, their coffee is amazing

3) Rooms were clean and clean towels. Rooms were equiped with all basic necessities.

4) They helped us arrange a Scooty for rent for hassle free commute within Wiligama- Mirissa. They even gave us free Ponchos along with the Scooty, which was VERY helpful.

5) Room cleaning was on point, did a great job.

6) They have a private beach type setup, great for morning swim, yoga, stroll etc.

Stayed for a few days and loved the atmosphere — cozy rooms, great location, and very relaxed.

But the highlight of my trip ended up being The Reef Weligama right next door. Their rice and curry is on another level. Real Sri Lankan flavors, super fresh. Highly recommend stopping by!

formatted_address: No 9 New Galle Road Rest House Junction, Weligama 81700, Sri Lanka
name: Ceylon Sliders

reviews.text:
Cafe review:

This place is so good! They open at 7 for breakfast, which is earlier than most places. The avo toast was honestly the best I think I’ve ever had. Soft and durable bread with pomegranate and pumpkin seeds and balsamic/oil drizzle. Really perfect touches. Coffee is very nice. Service was perfect. It’s kinda pricey but you for sure get what you pay for.

We stayed at the hotel for a week and absolutely loved it. The room was spacious, comfortable, and had everything we needed.

The food at the restaurant was among the best we’ve had in this country. We ended up having lunch or dinner there almost every day because it was hard to find another place that matched its quality, from the freshness of the ingredients, the presentation, to the generous portions. Everything is genuinely fresh, and the bread is homemade and top-notch.

We were mostly looked after by Chanaka (who we now proudly call a friend). He was incredibly attentive, kind, and his excellent English made everything even smoother.

The hotel has a wonderful vibe overall. You can tell the staff truly enjoys what they do, and that creates a great atmosphere for everyone.

The rooftop is fantastic, stunning views, great food and drinks, and it quickly became our go-to spot every night.

We totally recommend this place and are definitely keeping it on our list for a future visit. We’ll be back for sure!

Love this restaurant. Food is delicious and healthy. Staff is super nice. Love this place for a day lunch preferably. The night rooftop is very chill vibes and can be cool as well.
Well done Ceylon Sliders for being exceptional in the Weligama location.

We stayed here for six nights. Positives: kind, personal, great service by the staff, and really yummy food in the restaurant. Cons: right on the main road so there is a huge amount of sound from the road, quite far away from the main ‘happenings’ and surfing beaches. Really, really expensive compared to almost anywhere else for the exact same services/meals.

A cozy and modern hotel with two spacious rooms, each with its own balcony. The espresso machine makes breakfast especially enjoyable. In the evenings, you can enjoy great drinks on the rooftop terrace. The staff is very friendly and accommodating. They even parked our scooter in the courtyard each evening. Thanks to the hotel's security, someone was on-site 24/7.

We stayed for a total of six nights and thoroughly enjoyed our stay. Many thanks to the fantastic team!

I really liked staying here for a week and after a week of social hostels, I just needed some time by myself.

Super convenient to have a restaurant downstairs and the seating is really nice as well. The food is nice as well. The owner is really lovely and accommodated me last minute and is really nice throughout my stay. As a solo female, I felt really safe and the staff is also very lovely.

Overall, super happy with my stay!

After trying many restaurants in the area i found this place reasonable good quality/price! Difficult to find this in Weligama! You can find banana roti and juices for a reasonable prices! Im repeating my visit.
Owner from Sri Lanka is really welcoming.
Service, food, location, place for work. Its really good

The room and bathroom were nothing to write home about, although the bed did provide a nice mosquito net.  But the service provided, and the central (literally) location, were excellent.

Each person has their own taste in music, but I loved the mix of songs played at the patio, reflecting the owner, Asiri’s (Aa-siri), collection of music over the years, including his 13 years living all over Europe.

—————
The ‘best’ chocolate-banana pancakes I have ever had, anywhere in the world.

Reason:
a) The base was a crêpe pancake, and the two buttermilk pancakes on top had chocolate mixed into the batter.  All were made to perfection.
b) Each layer on top of each of the three pancakes had slices of banana, a few bits from a chocolate bar (not the sugary chocolate chips), and a very light drizzle of chocolate syrup.
c) The maple syrup drizzled on top was just enough.
d) It was moist and delicious!
e) The presentation was excellent.

Our first time to Sri Lanka we discovered this hidden gem of a restaurant whilst staying in Weligama . And what can I say. The biggest choice of the most amazing food , there is nothing we have eaten here that has fallen short of perfection . Ranging from Kottu and curries - to salads and Poke bowls - you will not be disappointed. Namal and Anura were the sweetest , kindest attentive waiters and we enjoyed every single visit.

If you’re craving chocolate banana roti after 10 pm, this is the place to go. The mango juice was one of the best we’ve had - super fruity and full of flavor. The atmosphere at night is incredibly cozy and inviting, especially with all the beautiful lights.

formatted_address: 34 Weligama By Pass Rd, Weligama 81700, Sri Lanka
name: Stay Ceylon

reviews.text:
An exceptional stay from start to finish! One of my favorite hotels we stayed in during a 14-day trip through Sri Lanka.

Excellent attention to detail, staff that went above and beyond from the reception (very kind) to the housekeeping (spotless cleaning!), delicious breakfast, and rooms with beautiful modern beachy decor.

The location is beachfront, balconies overlooking the ocean, great lighting in rooms, coconut water upon arrival… I could go on!

We felt so relaxed and comfortable here. Would love to come back.

I came for food, and the meals were absolutely delicious. The quality, taste, and presentation were all excellent.

While I was there, I asked about the hotel rooms, and Rashmi and Raini, the receptionists, were incredibly helpful and kind. They took the time to explain everything about Sri Lanka and the Weligama area. Their warm and friendly attitude really made my visit special.

I only had two days in Sri Lanka, but after their advice and recommendations, I truly wished I could stay longer. Unfortunately, I had to catch my flight.

I will definitely visit again in the future. Thank you Rashmi, Raini, and the whole team for the wonderful experience!

We had a meal here and it was an amazing experience. The place has amazing decor and vibe. The place is very welcoming. The location is very convenient, being right infront of Weligama beach. The staff are very kind and helpful. We overstayed after our meal due to some emergency, and the staff let us stay till our work was done. This shows the amount of respect they have for their customers. The wifi speed here is commendable. Highly recommend this place to all. If I visit Sri Lanka again, I am definitely coming here.

We ate at the restaurant twice, once for lunch and once for dinner. The service was excellent and the food was also very tasty. It offers a wide range of dishes, from local specialties to burgers and pizza. The cocktails at the bar are also very tasty! We can't rate the hotel itself, but if it's as good as the restaurant, it's highly recommended.

Outstanding service, impeccable housekeeping (the best I’ve ever experienced) and some of the friendliest staff I’ve ever encountered — they truly made the experience. The rooms were clean, fresh, and beautifully maintained, breakfast was perfect, and the location is ideal. Highly recommended and I would absolutely stay here again. Bring earplugs though it’s on a main road so can be noisy but not enough to put us off.

formatted_address: 291 Weligama By Pass Rd, Weligama 81700, Sri Lanka
name: Elsewhere Surf Camps in Weligama, Sri Lanka

reviews.text:
Absolutely loved our stay! The location is just perfect — getting the surfboard to the beach was super easy and convenient. We visited as a couple and were completely new to surfing, but the instructors were incredibly experienced and patient. They taught us great techniques, and we were able to stand on the board by our second day itself!

We truly enjoyed the vibe of the hostel — relaxed, friendly, and welcoming. The room was clean, and the gym was always neat and well-maintained, which we really appreciated.

Breakfast deserves a special mention — the presentation, the colours, and the variety were all absolutely on point. Everything was beautifully plated and thoughtfully served.

We loved every bit of our stay and would highly recommend it!

I stayed at Elsewhere Weligama for 7 nights and cannot recommend it enough!

I had the most amazing time and met so many people who I continued to travel with. The surfing was great, I loved the schedule and having the option for an afternoon surf.

Hamish, Baba and Zoe were amazing instructors and gave great tips and advice to progress.

I highly recommend staying for at least 4 or 5 nights to get the full experience!

Thanks for an awesome time my friends x

I ended up staying nearly two weeks at Elsewhere because I just kept extending 😅 such a fun, social surf camp with great facilities and the loveliest staff.

The surf lessons were so good - Zoe especially is an amazing coach. She’s super knowledgeable and genuinely so keen to help you improve, which makes such a difference.

They also offer daily yoga classes led by the amazing Xenia which are sooo relaxing and perfect after a morning surf - exactly what your body needs.

Food’s included and honestly so good. I loved the mix of Sri Lankan and western dishes - best of both worlds.

They organise different activities every night too, so there’s always something going on. And special shoutout to Pasha, the BEST social host, who made me feel so welcome from day one. Her karaoke performance of Unwritten? Elite.

As a level Zero newcomer , I am quite pleased with how welcoming and accommodating to my learning needs this surf camp has been. The food ; impeccable, the people are beautiful , the surf has been the most fun I had my entire travels. It was the challenge I needed and many had the opportunity to excel which was nice to see. Great location to explore local restaurants massages also !

This camp was amazing. I improved my surfing a lot thanks to the really devoted instructors that were so nice, especially Baba who helped me a lot at the start of the week and Zef who helped me at the end. I came here to focus on surfing and do work in the evenings. Since It’s a party hostel I was aware that it could be a challenge to stay focused but it really wasn’t. There’s a room on the first floor that is far from the noise of the rooftop where I could comfortably sit working. Also, when a staff member(Clara) saw me sitting alone all focused, she asked me very compassionately if I was alright. These small acts of caring about the guests was something that all of the staff showed, e.g. Ki (social staff), Xenia (yoga teacher) and Zoe (surf instructor) to name a few.

No matter what your goal is when you come here, you’ll be met by great people and have a amazing time.
Food is absolutely mind blowing! We came here twice during our 3 nights stay in weligama! You should come here and try them out! Ask for extra spicy if you prefer spicy food.

An outstanding dining experience from start to finish. The curry dishes were absolutely excellent – the prawns were perfectly cooked, full of flavor, and beautifully spiced. The vegetarian curries were just as impressive, rich, balanced, and truly sensational in taste. You can really tell that great care is taken with ingredients and preparation. Highly recommended for anyone who appreciates high-quality curry and authentic flavors.
Absolutely delicious food and drinks, great friendly service and good prices! We have been a few times and each time it’s been great. The devilled prawns are 👌🏽 👌🏽

This place deserves a review

By far the best food we have had in SL over the last 4 days.

Legitimately spicy, flavourful and well portioned.

The chilli potatoes are a must have!!!

Best food by far in Weligama and Mirissa areas from what we've tested. Well priced too. Plenty of meat in every dish, unlike other restaurants who give you 2 small pieces of meat and 1kg of rice and vegetables.

One of a Restaurant opened 24 hours in Weligama, foods are average in taste but prices are little high compared to other places in Weligama due to the located place. Mainly targeted foreigners but most of the times locals having meals.
Price on bottle was different to what I was asked to pay, do not trust
This is the best place! They are the sweetest people and they make everything from scratch. The rotti is to die for!🌟
This place is over priced and not good quality. There are so many better places in Weligama than here.
Its sooo tasty and has open for really long time :)))

formatted_address: 540 Weligama By Pass Rd, Weligama 81700, Sri Lanka
name: Hangtime Hostel

reviews.text: Best place ever! I’m a coffee snob and Hangtime serves the best coffee in Weligama! With the best views of the whole bay. Unlike other places they don’t try to kick you out immediately after so you can enjoy your coffee in peace while watching the surfers. I have been there so many times and the food is consistently delicious and very good portions. Has a good variety of delicious dishes to choose from and very fast service considering all the places in Sri Lanka. Had a really nice chat with the manager Don who was very welcoming and helpful. One of the best features they offer is they have a wide variety of board games, post card and entertainment and very relaxed environment. They also have a very nice co-working space downstairs when i need some quiet time as well. Cant recommend this place enough.

Every once in a while you run into a Sri Lankan business that treats non-whites/locals differently than white people.  This is one of those places.  My parents are from Sri Lanka, I was born and raised in Chicago.    I am very proud of my Sri Lankan background.  I just had an insanely good massage and was walking back to my place at 1pm. Perfect time for a healthy smoothy.   I’ve been coming to Weligama to surf for the last 5 years and never had problems.  I climbed the 5 flights of stairs so excited for a healthy drink(s) and the view.  There were plenty of seats available for me to watch the ocean and have a smoothy. I pick one and stand at the register with a 5000 rupee note and the menu.  I silently watch them take white tourists orders and their money, ask politely if I can place and order, ignored.   More whites are served before me.   I tell the people taking orders that they must be ripping off white people and making so much money that Sri Lankan/brown peoples business isn’t needed.   I leave and tell the two people at the front door what happened and walk away.   Not going back and telling every Sri Lankan I know that visits from overseas to stay away from this racist establishment.  I did get my smoothy from another place very close by.  I never raised my voice and was polite. I’m here to get away from my corporate job and unwind. Gotta go for my 3pm surf, I’ve still got 10 more days here.   I have plenty of friends in town and love meeting new people no matter their color.  The joys of travel!  My estimate is they just lost at least 5 smoothy sales plus the food I/we would have spent there and a positive review.  2 stars for the nice view.

The place is right next to the beach, you'll get amazing views of the beach from there rooftop cafe. The drinks I had here was not very good though. But a lot of people come and work! Perhaps the next time I visit, I'll again go and sit and work from here. The music and there playlist is amazing though and the place has a very relaxed vibe overall

Me and my boyfriend stayed in a private double room which was spacious, tidy and simple. Hangtime hostel is perfectly located in Weligama surrounded by plenty of good places to go out with a good surfboard rental and large food truck right opposite. You can be from hotel to sand in 5 steps. The cafe at the top has a great view of the sea and some good options for food with a nice chill out space on the floor below. Didn’t go to any yoga or open mic night they hosted but overyall a very low key hostel with no major social events but nice and relaxing😊

Came to this hostel one night for their famous burger and it really hit the spot. So yummy with great rooftop views overlooking the water. We wanted to get a beer but they didn't serve alcohol so we had a king coconut instead!

formatted_address: Weligama By Pass Rd, Sri Lanka
name: Catamaran Restaurant

reviews.text:
Not sure if all these negative reviews are fake, but we had a lovely meal - delicious fish curry, kottu, our boys wanted a burger and chips. We are it all enjoyed. The juices were delicious. The price was fair. The service was friendly, happy and honest.

They told us the restaurant frontage has been taken down by the government to clean the access to the beach, but the food truck and table and chairs setting suited us just fine. Thank you

I went today after very long time .I went before 2 years. This place is amazing as always. I really love with this place. Food is awesome 👏 place bit changed but quality of food is best as always ❤️ very friendly service.highly recommended to everyone 🥰

Had a great diner at Catamaran, we were together and shared the cashew kottu and mushroom kottu. Both really delicious, and the staff is super friendly and happy to help :) At first I was confused but they were twin brothers, couldnt keep them from eachother😂 Thanks a lot for the food!

We enjoyed the food so much that we came back the next evening 🤭 Very friendly staff, great food and good portions 👍🏻 If you are in hurry then you should go somewhere else.
The location on the beach is very cozy and private. We can recommend this restaurant with a good conscience!
My favorite was Cashew Nut Kottu and Avocado Salad 😋

Can't beat the location, overlooking a popular surf point and lovely stretch of beach. Friendly staff and tasty food, good portions. Plenty of seating inside the restaurant and on the beach. Always visit for a strong cup of local coffee and the view.
Sumith was a hard-working soul and has left the place in the capable hands of his daughter and family. They continue to do a good job in their landmark truck.

formatted_address: XCGP+JCW, Gangarama Cross Rd, Weligama, Sri Lanka
name: Luvi Lucas River Side

reviews.text: We planned to stay here for 1 night and so far we are on night #4. The room is comfortable and big, we have an amazing balcony that we love to do yoga and read on. Great for couples, solo travellers and small families. The view to the river is magical, only a 5 minute walk to the town/beach yet it is so quiet and calm here. The owners are the kindest people ever, we really feel at home! And the food is the best we have had in Sri Lanka so far. Great prices - we overall highly recommend this accomodation!

A wonderful homestay with a host who really stands out. He was warm, thoughtful and made sure I had everything I needed. It felt like staying with someone who truly enjoys welcoming travellers. The room was clean and comfortable, and the whole place has a relaxed, friendly vibe.
A very positive stay – easy to recommend.

Stayed here for a few nights.
Lovely family.  Very easy going and pleasant people.  Nice breakfast. Clean rooms! The place is just a couple of minutes walk to the beach and town center.  But,  still remains very silent. Thank you so much for your hospitality. You are a lovely family.  Wish you all the best!!!🐶🥰

This has been our absolute favorite stay in Sri Lanka. The host family went above and beyond to take care of us, making us feel truly at home. At times, it felt as though we were part of their family. The rooms were spotless, and the property features a charming floating deck overlooking the river, where you can enjoy breakfast or dinner with a stunning view. We even spotted a huge crocodile from there! The lady who lives there also created beautiful hand-crafted souvenirs for us to take home for our friends. We would highly recommend this place 10/10, and look forward to returning someday!

I stayed here for 6 nights, and would thoroughly recommend! It is so quiet and peaceful, which is rare in Weligama. The family who run it are so sweet and look after you. The rooms have AC and a fan, really good wifi, it just ticks all the boxes and is a very easy stay.

We visited Big Fish Restaurant for dinner on our first night and ended up coming back several times because the food was that good. The Barramundi and Mahi-Mahi were memorable, though they could have used a touch more of the bold flavors typically associated with Sri Lanka. The lobster bisque soup was excellent, and the service throughout was top-notch.

The manager was warm and welcoming, even offering a complimentary dessert for my son, which was a lovely touch. Prices are on the higher side, and you can find good seafood for less along the coast, but the overall experience still made it worth the visit.

Ambience was very good but food was ok . I was expecting to have ramen but that was not an option . We mainly had their veg food sushi- noodles (Japanese) and raw mango salad was amazing - must try . They had a very good drink selection - smoked drink was something interesting . Not a lot of baby food selection - they gave us white rice and mashed potatoes . When you order they give freshly baked break ( toasted ) with melted cheese and side of olive oil complementary - which was very much appreciated and tasty

Great atmosphere.
They have fresh catch to choose from.
They started us off with a grenadine shooter.
I ordered a tiramisu martini and It was Top Tier!!
They offered a selection of some nice warm bread.
We got the Blue swimmer crab in a curry base - Delicious.
And the Mexican roll - also delicious.
However the wasabi served with it didn’t feel authentic but that’s okay.
The service was great.
Must go - It’ll make for a beautiful date night.

Big Fish at the Weligama Bay Marriott Resort & Spa offers a fine dining experience that emphasizes the freshness of Sri Lanka’s seafood. Located on the mezzanine level, the restaurant is open daily for dinner from 7 PM to 10 PM on weekdays and until midnight on weekends, making it a perfect spot for a romantic evening or a special family dinner.
Ambiance and Service
The ambiance at Big Fish is upscale yet inviting, featuring both indoor and al fresco seating that allows diners to enjoy stunning views of Weligama Bay. The staff is noted for their friendly and attentive service, enhancing the overall dining experience. Guests have reported positive interactions with the staff, who are eager to ensure satisfaction throughout the meal.
Menu Highlights
The menu showcases a variety of seafood dishes, with an emphasis on local catch prepared in innovative ways. Signature offerings include fresh fish grilled to perfection, seafood platters, and various international dishes that complement the seafood theme. Diners can expect high-quality ingredients and beautifully presented plates that make for a memorable culinary experience

We came here because we were craving steak in Sri Lanka and it was the only place we could find some. The menu is pricey but the atmosphere and service make up for it - plus the novelty of finally having the steak we craved. Great vibe overlooking the beach and pool and impeccable service. The steak was very fatty, but tasty and tender.

This was one of the best experiences I had in Sri Lanka! Shan lives in his 300 year old family home which is beautifully kept with a traditional kitchen and he uses techniques and recipes passed down the family. You learn so much about traditional Ayurvedic cooking as well as the health and lifestyle qualities. I was lucky to be the only person however classes are always kept small. Ingredients are grown in his garden and the food is just incredible! An absolute must if you're in the area :)

Delicious and authentic food. I joined Shan for a cooking class and I totally loved it. He is a very friendly and warm person. He shared not just knowledge about Sri Lankan traditional food, but also lots of tips to live healthier and happier.

This is definitely a must whether you are vegan or not.

I had the most beautiful experience visiting Shans place, where he cooks authentic, home-made Sri Lankan food with so much love and passion. Shan is such a bubbly and kind  person, and makes you feel so welcome.

What makes this experience so special is that many of the ingredients come straight from his own garden. His dishes are absolutely amazing. I was so impressed that I visited Shan  just before heading to the airport, and I even packed some of his food in my suitcase to bring back for friends and family.

Such a great cooking class! The food we made was the best I've had in Sri Lanka, so from a taste perspective this class can't be missed. Shan is so insightful about the different ingredients, so this was very much a cooking and nutritional lesson. The session passes on the knowledge he inherited from his grandmother and his passion for food and natural medicines. Thank you so much Shan!

If you like Sri Lankan food this is a must! Shan grows and makes almost everything himself, and once you cook with him you can see the difference it makes. He explained all of the health benefits of different types of food, and the history of Sri Lankan cooking. It was by far the most delicious meal we have had in Sri Lanka and we also learnt a lot. And he has cookbooks so you can take the recipes home with you. To top it off, it’s in the house of his great grandparents which has stood for 260 years and he still has the old style kitchen.

name: Kuma Surf Camp Weligama, Sri Lanka

reviews.text:
An unforgettable experience at Kumas Surf Camp!

Our time at Kumas Surf Camp was truly exceptional and something we will cherish forever. From the very first day, it felt less like a surf camp and more like being part of a big family.

The surf instructors were absolutely amazing – professional, patient, and genuinely passionate about surfing. They made sure everyone felt comfortable in the water while still having a lot of fun.

Some of the biggest highlights were the bonfire Night and the unforgettable river safari – experiences that made our stay even more special and unique.

We didn’t just learn how to surf; we made friends for life and shared moments we’ll never forget. We would wholeheartedly recommend Kumas Surf Camp to anyone looking for an extraordinary time, great vibes, and an authentic surf experience. 🌊🔥

Greetings and ♾️ Love from
Cali, isi & Lilly💖

I loved my time with the instructors!! They were very respectful and informative. It was my first time ever touching a surfboard but due to their teaching style and their empty spot, I was very comfortable with falling and getting up again. There were no rocks or corals and the instructors were always there to help when the current was strong. I never expected to be able to catch my own green waves within a week of surfing but everyday was an experience and nothing was repetitive. I would 100% recommend this school for beginners, intermediate, and professionals.
One of the best surf schools in Weligama where you will find a great group of instructors, everyone is very friendly, I highly recommend it.

Very good surf school, reasonable prices, good boards. Sudu is a very good teacher, we came here thinking we would stand up on a board at best but after an hour we were paddeling our selves and catching big waves.

Great surf school with very welcoming and friendly staff, skilled teachers.

I was getting several lessons with Madhu on softboard, which helped me to improve my balance a lot and at the last day Kuma teached me himself on the hard board.

I tried surfing before more than once and tried hard board before, too, but this was the first time when I was able to catch waves successfully on hard board and felt really confident.

Highly recommend if you want to learn and improve your technique as well as actually enjoy the process.

Thank you, guys, for the great time!

formatted_address: Weligama By Pass Rd, Weligama 81700, Sri Lanka
name: Sithmal Restaurant & Homestay

reviews.text: My favourite local spot for breakfast and lunch!! There’s always a great assortment of foods to choose from the buffet and the staff are wonderful. I always go back on my trips to Sri Lanka!!

I had a great experience at Sithmal Restaurant in Weligama. The service was excellent—friendly, attentive, and welcoming, which made the visit even more enjoyable. The atmosphere felt warm and comfortable, perfect for a relaxing meal. The food was fresh and tasty,

Overall, Sithmal Restaurant is a lovely spot in Weligama if you’re looking for good food and great service. Definitely worth a visit!

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Excellent Food & Outstanding Service
This restaurant serves some of the best rice and curry I’ve had. The food is fresh, flavorful, and perfectly balanced, with a great variety of curries that truly reflect authentic taste. Every dish is well-prepared, rich in spices, and served in generous portions.
The service is outstanding — the staff are friendly, polite, and very attentive, making sure everything is comfortable from start to finish. Orders are served promptly, and the atmosphere feels warm and welcoming.
Overall, a fantastic dining experience with delicious food and excellent service. Highly recommended, and I will definitely visit again! 😍

Very simple and good place with tasty rice/potato and curry food. This is the second time I come here and everything is perfect.

First you take a plate, choose food (only vegetables or some meat), then you eat and only then you pay. Very cheap with ability to get what you want from the variety of available food.

I tried to record a video but since this was a lunch time then there was no meet or chicken at all 😁. So I’ll show empty bowls only with no food inside.

Fantastic proper Sri Lankan food.
Breakfast and lunch. Great prices.
Very tasty. Rashmee and family are wonderful people. Couldn’t recommend this place more.
Mark from UK

Incredible seafood in Weligama!

Beautiful spot with a stunning sea view overlooking Weligama and Mirissa Bay.
Easily the freshest and tastiest seafood I’ve had in the entire South. The service is incredibly kind and welcoming.

Absolutely recommend this place!

Really pretty location.
Food is probably the best we had in Sri Lanka. The Tuna steak is an absolute must eat

Amazing food! Just sad we waited 50 minutes. Great location and atmosphere
Small portions of the food as well

Been here a couple of times the last years and this place never disappoints! WONDERFUL! The food is amazing and not even to talk about the parties, wow, wow and again wow. The vibe tiki bar offers is something different. Saw a review regarding security and I can tell you, security here is the best I’ve seen in south Sri Lanka. Never felt more safe in a fun environment, if you are near here and it’s a Friday, DONT MISS OUT!!!
Beautiful cliff of the ocean views. Breezy to stay cool and minimal mosquitoes. Drinks were good. The food we had was good but took over 2 hours to bring the appetizer to the table.

formatted_address: Latheena Resort, Mirissa, POLWATHUMODARA, PELENA, Weligama 81700, Sri Lanka
name: Fujisan Restaurant

reviews.text: What can I say - but excellent spot on food everytime all the time! We ordered all over the menu and were not disappointed with any of the selection. Service is extremely fast! Food delish! Coffee great! Juices was abit watered down had it twice - but otherwise went back twice and would do ten more times!
I didn't try any other restaurant in the area because there's no need. The menu offers 200 different meals - delicious, big, yummy!!! The service is great! And their fruit juices are 👌👌👌.

Amazing! We ate here basically every night during our stay in the area. We were sceptical at first because they offer so many different types of cuisines which is usually a bad sign, but each dish was delicious! From seafood over burger to pasta, everything was really good. Especially, the prawns and calamari are amazing! The restaurant is directly at the beach where you can also nicely watch the sunset and they have a lot of very cute but not intrusive dogs around.
So I would definitely recommend!

We stayed at the hotel next door and we went to Fujisan for 5 dinners. The prices are affordable and portions are really big. The food is not out of this world, bit it is fine, especially given the price. I recommend tiger prawns and butterfish the most. On the photo, you can see a seafood platter for 4 people.

A nice little restaurant situated on the beach. Staff were friendly and welcoming- the restaurant was always pretty packed  throughout the day. The menu had a vast amount of dishes ranging from sushi to pizza. We ended up eating here on 3 different occasions and all dishes were plentiful and delicious.

formatted_address: KGD Stores, Awariyawatta Kapparatota, XC59+79C, Weligama 81740, Sri Lanka
name: Kavija Restaurant weligama

reviews.text:
This local restaurant is definitely a must try in Weligama!

I had such a great chicken Kottu, sooo delicious and made on the spot with fresh ingredients.

The owner, Mrs Tushari, is the sweetest person ever, super nice and kind.

Prices are fair and I loved the family atmosphere of the restaurant.

100% recommended ❤️
Super cute little restaurant. The owners are super friendly and serve you the food out of their own kitchen. It's a great place to stop for a quick lunch or some dinner.

We had a wonderful experience at this restaurant. We were treated very kindly by a lovely family who made us feel truly welcome from the moment we arrived. The food was absolutely delicious, full of flavor and clearly made with care. A great place with a warm atmosphere highly recommended!

Wonderful! The rice and chicken curry was excellent.

I would happily enjoy this again and highly recommend it to anyone who loves an authentic Sri Lankan meal.

Amazing potatoe soup!! The coconut rotti is the best I've had on the island!
Great portion sizes!
Will be coming back

formatted_address: Colombo - Galle - Hambantota - Wellawaya Rd, Weligama 81700, Sri Lanka
