name: Easy Life Happy Home &cafe

reviews.text:
Very friendly and carring host with a lovely family. Although we did not stay here, we came here to eat 5 days in a row for all of our meals.
The host is an extraordinary good chef. The food was always really good, always freshly made and with a good value for money. If you don't like spicy, he will make the food 0% spicy. The fresh juces are also really good. We will defenetliy visit again and stay at his place.
We thank you Neranjan and your family for the great time we had.

We stayed in Weligama and ate every night at Easy Life Happy Home cafe. They are a very welcoming family, making us feel very special. The food was very top quality always cooked to order. We were invited in to the kitchen, so compiled a short clip of what we saw for you. (I will now try to work out how to post the video).  Yo will not be disappointed, if you choose to eat here.

Family stay with local family. They cook  well. The place is very close to the spacious calm beach at Weligama. A surfers paradise.The rooms are clean and worth a few days relaxed stay. I ll come again

Highly recommended! The price is reasonable, the room very clean but most of all the young couple who owns the place and their family are so nice and accommodating and will make you feel at home. And the breakfast is delicious.

Beautiful family home.
Mother makes yummy srilanka curry!! You can enjoy the time with family:D We had a great time there. Thank you very much!

A very nice and clean house. The house is run by a couple who take excellent care of their guests. Always obliging and super nice, they help with the planning and give tips.
The house is located in a side street right next to the coastal road and with a tuktuk or scooter you can be at any hotspot (surfing, cafes, bars etc.) in just a few minutes.
Scooters can be hired directly on site.
There is also the option of having breakfast/dinner at the hotel. We tried both and had delicious local dishes at a good price.
Highly recommended and if we come to Weligama again, we will go here.

Castle Bay Resort has become my second home in Sri Lanka. The family that owns it took care of me as if I was their daughter. They are amazing people! The hotel itself is the best place you can find for this price. The rooms are nice, clean and comfortable with spacious common balconies. Breakfast is in big portions. Located in a quiet street close to the beach. I absolutely recommend!

Beautiful rooms with extremely kind hosts. The couple who ran this place are very helpful and sweet. Great location near Weligama, Ahangama, and Mirissa Beach. Local food spots less than five minutes by walk.

We booked this place and told the host our arrival time many times. They suddenly canceled our reservation without telling us.
We arrived at midnight with luggage from Airport, in the rain, and the host ignored all our calls. No answer at all.

We had nowhere to go. My wife and I ended up sleeping on the street until morning cold, scared, and humiliated.

This host is greedy, unprofessional, and doesn’t care about guests. They probably took a better booking and left us stranded.
Never book here. You could easily end up in the same dangerous situation. Choose any other place.

0 stars if possible. Avoid at all costs!

If you wanna feel the hospitality in Sri Lanka and Weligama!
That’s the place. As a solo traveler I felt having my second parents in Sri Lanka!

Mama and Papa will take care of you, worry about you and treat you as their son/daughter!!

I will definitely be back Mama & Papa 🥰!!

formatted_address: No 145 Station Rd, Weligama, Sri Lanka
name: Janaranjana Hotel

reviews.text: No jacket, backpack, or helmet is allowed in the store, and the angry security guard is very strict about this... Also, the store is so dirty inside. It really needs a deep clean. If buying dairy products, be aware that they might not be suitable for consuption anymore. I bought feta cheese and it was rotten.

My TRAVEL philosophy: pack your weary clothes and discard them after use while travelling. then buy new local stuff to avoid the trouble of laundry . Plus, the new stuff is becoming a useful souvenir 😎
Nothing fancy to buy here but you can renew most of your stuff for less than US$5 a piece.
The most awful place. It is not shopping mall, it’s smth you find nothing

Good place to buy daily needs,clothes.
There is a vegitable & fruit & food and bevarages also

A great place to get kitchen essentials and groceries. Some things are very reasonable and some things are overpriced. It's ok. The only negative thing would be the cashiers behavior. They are very slow and lazy people who do not know the value of time. Friendly service is a must to keep your customers coming back. Especially the behavior of the little girls here is hateful. It is their responsibility to provide proper service to the customer and they do not perform it well at all.

If you’re looking for a little break from curry this is your place (although they actually do a banging curry too)! The burgers are massive and fully loaded, wraps are really flavourful and quesadillas are nice and crispy! The milkshakes are pretty outrageous if you fancy treating yourself - I recommend the spiced banana one 😋

We ordered via Uber Eats. The portions were tiny and not edible :( Paninis just white toast with some additions slapped on and tasted gross. Mac and cheese also not so good. Portions small. Also they missed the preparation window so we waited almost 2 hours. Not to mention not cheap compared to other places.

The photos on Google Maps look amazing but definitely do not recommend this place via uber.

Absolutely DELICIOUS burger and fries!!! Big portion, something I miss sometimes in Weligama. Excellent quality, fresh, very well seasoned and great local business! Congrats to them I will definitely come again and again!!!

Came here for a really quick meal so we could eat before catching the train. They were really nice and whipped us some fried rice really fast and even let us take away the rest at the end when we had to run to the train station. Highly recommend! Delicious fried rice
Jays Cafe makes better burgers than anywhere in the USA!! 🇺🇸 soooo good we came back 2 days in a row! Thanks 🙏 we will be back again.
The best bakery in town. Ask for Coconut hoppers. They are sold out every morning, but the seller has always deposited some for me without being asked. So delicious!!
Very tasty food and super friendly people. We had the tandoori chicken and butter chicken masala. Both are recommended. The naan bread is freshly prepared, is nice and crispy and tastes excellent!

Even though the place itself on the outside looks odd too me for an Indian restaurant the food was amazing. My husband and I had chicken tikka masala, garlic nann and rice and it was delicious ☺️ if you crave Indian food a lovely place for it

Highly recommend.tasty foods.masha allah .very helpful owner and customised our order according to our requirements and reasonable price.we ordered our every meals with them during our tour at ahangama/weligama.
ordered food. some was warm. but chicken was dead cold. they do do not even bother to warm it up. onion salad was just plain onions. lol.
We had lunch here. The food was delicious and generous portions at a very reasonable price. The service was very friendly. Constant flow of costumers while we were there, which is always a good sign.
Hidden gem, has a small entry way. Food is good, but the place itself is a bit stuffy. There’s outside seating right by the railroad. Curry rice buffet, cheap prices
Best local food place in Weligama. And lovely people. 500 for a rice and curry.
Recommended to me be a local surfer and it did not disappoint!

Hidden gem serving Sri Lankan cuisine. Best Pol roti I had. Surprised that people don’t know this place.

P.s - local prices for food.

Food was amazing, portion are really big and affordable. Everything is freshly made and you can feel it. Its local place and its wonderful in this super touristic area (at least for me). Staf is super kind and take care of me during the whole time asking if i need sth etc.
I will be back for sure!

Amazing spot, not the tourist trap you see everywhere where u pay 1200 rupees for lunch.

Incredible service, u can ask for not spicy, I lost my water bottle here and they kept it for 2 days. Big portions, you eat side by side with locals.
Keep up the good work!

Amazing authentic sri lankan food, fast and friendly service and local prices! Everything is on point here. Try their hopper and tea - its amazing. Dont be scared, GO & enjoy authentic food and  vibes!

(However if you want AC and food made for western flavour palette - maybe go somewhere else and pay five times the price ;)

The best spot in Weligama. This place has been here since 1978 and I can see why. Best curry, and the staff were quick to top up  veggies and paratha when we started running low. Portions are huge for the price. Including drinks was about 800 rupee each. Highly recommend

I have no idea if the food is any good.  Having met a waiter of absolutely stunning rudeness, I paid for the bottled water I asked for, and walked out. I promised the staff to never enter their restaurant again and that I would be posting a negative review.  Negative 5 stars on service and atmosphere, though plus 1 star for lukewarm water that is otherwise as good of a bottle of water as money can buy.  I'm now dining enjoyably at Shan Star.  I suggest you do the same.

Unbelievably good food it was some of the best we've had so far. Every dish was delicious from the devil chicken to the masala dosa and the vegetable thali. Accompanied with incredibly friendly and welcoming service. Can't recommend this place enough!
The staff is so kind and funny. Delicious food. For sure a recommend if you’re in weligama!!
Very nice spot with delicious food! Majid was so helpful and  recommended some great dishes from the menu and also shared some tips about the island. Great service and prices!

Great place for dosas. As an Indian I recommend this place for South Indian food. The butter chicken was a lil too sweet and naan was more like a bread/bun if you are into it.

Overall really great service and sweetest staff.
Nice restaurant with amazing food. It didn’t take long and the staff is really sweet, especially our waiter Maajith - thank you!
Good

formatted_address: No. 261 Main Street, Weligama 81700, Sri Lanka
name: La Felina Cafe and Restaurants

reviews.text: New & modern restaurant. Food was good. Not too many vegetarian options but they were flexible in creating some :)
The fish here was so yum and good portion, everything tastes good, very accommodating lovely staff.

Friendly staff and nice cool air conditioning. The food was delicious. Our group ordered several dishes, and the Chicken Kofta Wrap and the Hot Butter Seafood were especially tasty. The mango juice was served with chocolate syrup drizzled around the glass, which was a fun and unique touch.

Perfect place if you want to escape from the heat and the crowd + friendliest staff ever!
Their brownie is delicious 😋

Not there yet, I think the current reviews do not represent what you get. The place charges 2k+ for small non-quality dishes.
The wrap I got was tiny, the chicken inside wasn't super tasty, on the side a few fries of McDonald's quality (not real potatoes, but with a potatoe paste). In my opinion you can get way better food in Sri Lanka for halve the price.
The people managing the place are nice and willing to help and improve.

formatted_address: XCGH+F74, Samaraweera Pl, Weligama, Sri Lanka
name: Zam Zam Restaurant

reviews.text:
I got a half-portion of fried rice, which was really tasty and kinda filling due to the portion size, despite the fact there’s no protein in vegeteraian option. It would definitely be the best one if mixed with some tofu or soy meat, so please consider this as an option for vegans 🌱

Another thing is they wrap every plate with plastic bags, which is not good at all for both environment and our health. Other similar places in the area I used to visit don’t do anything like this, so it seems like a pretty weird experience which stands between Zam Zam’s top notch food and my willing to come back for it again 🥴

Please take action, give up using these bags and other single-use plastic waste like straws, and then it’ll definitely be an authentic and safe 5 star experience 🙏
A lovely local food spot in weligama :) cheap authentic food for a local price (~350lkr)with super welcoming people working and visiting here!

Small local restaurant with friendly staff that welcomed me inside. Their food is good and reasonable local prices. I had two roti with Dahl curry and a hot milk tea which was very delicious. 200 LKR total price. Highly recommended
we got two biryani’s for 3 usd and it was soooo delicious!!!
Very cozy and welcoming place. There are often queues, but a bad place wouldn’t attract so many people. I really love the rice and curry, and the rotti.

formatted_address: No 580,wanigasiri mawatha kudalumulla, Weligama, Sri Lanka
name: See you foods

formatted_address: Layback Surf Camp Rooftop, 247 Main Street, Weligama 81700, Sri Lanka
name: Layback Rooftop Café, Restaurant & Bar (part of Layback surf camp)

reviews.text:
I’ve been with Layback for a week of surfing and Yoga and the food at the café was definitely a highlight at my stay! From coffee to drinks, breakfast, lunch and dinner - everything is made with an eye for detail and tastes (and looks) amazing! Also the experience with the team members working there is amazing 🥰 everybody is Super friendly, professional and has a great guest approach.
I highly recommend going there!

One of my favorite places to visit in Weligama. Let’s start from designe, I love all this details. And rooftop with heart breaking views, especially in sunset time. About food, that’s looks same absolutely amazing way how does it tastes. I like service, polite and super friendly staff. Always nice to have some enjoyable time here ✨

Absolutely excellent! The food is outstanding and the service is clearly above average. What makes it even better is that the team genuinely cares about maintaining this high level of quality, which really shows. The only small challenge can be finding parking, as the place is often busy — but it’s well worth it.
Tip: head up to the rooftop terrace on the very top floor for a nearly private atmosphere and a wonderful dining experience.

The food at Layback Rooftop is really, really good. Most of the dishes are Western. Everything feels fresh, colourful, and beautifully presented. It’s also very vegan-friendly. The atmosphere is relaxed and the staff are incredibly friendly, attentive, and genuinely welcoming. Overall, it’s the kind of place where you just feel good and want to stay a little longer.

The Layback Rooftop Cafe is a fantastic place with delicious food, great vibe, and super service. I spent many long mornings here enjoying an indulgent breakfast, reading and reflecting, and sipping on some great coffee and shakes. Definitely a must-visit if you are in Weligama.

As a vegetarian I found lots of great options for flavourful and delicious veggie dishes. My faves: Layback brunch bowl, Cauliflower bites, Island burger, watermelon coconut juice.

formatted_address: No : 03 Samaraweera Pl, Weligama 81700, Sri Lanka
name: AVM cream house

reviews.text: I highly recommend the juices as they are very thick and refreshing. Parking was a nightmare.  Also, they get busy in the night and as a result I had to wait almost 30min to get my order. If you pay by credit card,  they charge an additional 3%. Bathrooms are clean. If you order juice, make sure to say if you don't want ice cream in it.

We were looking for halal food and found this place and had dinner and it was delicious the chicken pasta was absolutely delicious and the shawarma was good too but it's like a sandwich not a real shawarma, the soursop juice was great, the prices are reasonable and the portions are big you must visit.

I went with my friend for late lunch. We sat on the third floor with an open-air balcony. The fried rice (550 rupees) was yummy and the half portion was large enough to share between the two. I also had salad (300 rupees) but no dressing... it just came with a bit of mayonnaise. They run out of coke, but went to buy a bottle from a shop across the street. The restaurant had so many fresh juices that more than half of their menu was just that! I’d like to try dates-based smoothies next time. Very convenient location, just a minute walk from the bus terminal.

MUST HAVE PLACE IN WELIGAMA!

Thank you for the best fruit salad in our life.
Just to represent how much we loved i upload all the pictures we made during our stay!

We have not seen much travellers here but we are so glad we found this place. Really satisfied.
People are kind and the service is extremly fast.

The menu is huge. You can have like every combination of juices and shakes.
Unfortunately the chocolate Milchshake was more like a drinking chocolate. Wouldn't order that again.

formatted_address: No 239/5 Mains street, Weligama, Sri Lanka
name: SABABA RESTAURANT WELIGAMA

reviews.text: good food and good people
Beautiful people is really good I really enjoyed the food thank you so much I’m looking forward to seeing you guys thanks again SABABA RESTAURANT EWELIGAMA

I had such a great experience at Sababa in Weligama! As an Israeli, it was honestly so nice to find authentic Israeli food so far from home. Everything we ordered was fresh, flavorful, and felt really homemade.

The atmosphere is super relaxed and welcoming, and the staff were friendly and kind. It’s the perfect spot to chill, especially after a day at the beach.

If you’re craving Israeli food in Sri Lanka, this place is definitely worth a visit. Highly recommend!
Fantastic food and excellent customer service! Every dish was full of flavor and beautifully presented. The staff were very welcoming and attentive. I’ll definitely be coming back again!

First of all, congratulations on reopening the restaurant with a fresh new look!

We bought chicken kottu for takeaway, but it was too spicy and didn’t taste good. There was very little chicken, and it wasn’t mixed properly. There were no vegetables either. It seemed like the kottu wasn’t properly mixed on the griddle.

As you have reopened the restaurant with a new look, we hope you will maintain the same tasty food and quality consistency, as we are regular customers.

Very bad,
my partner went to buy chicken kottu.
I only eat the dough, it's not good and the chicken is literally found in crumbs here and there.
Important that they charge 1300 rupees, for what? Dough?

It's not even worth half of that money, without saying that you can find cheaper ones where they do it much better and don't save on meat.

Never again!

The place is apparently clean but have limited place to sit.
They make nice grilled chicken which is yummy but sad part is you have to buy full and when alone it's very hard to finish full.
I requested several times but they insisted me to buy full. The other dishes are prepared nicely.

They have an absolutely divine roast chicken which they serve either devilled or just plain roast with some slices of onions on the side. You can accompany it with a hefty potion of seafood fried rice.

A definite local spot to hit up after a surf to fuel up.

They have diffrent price for tourists - they take more than double price .
We came to get simple roti and paid - 450 for one.

formatted_address: Weligama Bus Stand, Weligama 81700, Sri Lanka
name: Sampath Rotti Shop

reviews.text: We ordered food at night to Thalaramba, and it was perfect. They delivered it warm and super tasty. Its best place to eat good food with normal price
Coconut roti right on my doorstep
This is the best rotti shop in Weligama. Tomato, cheese and egg so delicious! My recommendation
Best late-night fast food on the city. Great value for money.
Delicious cheap tasty quick roti❤️

Hmmm. It’s a strange one here. TBH it’s pretty much all foreign tourists coming in but I got some strange stares off the till person who struggled to smile and understand basic English. Service couldn’t be any slower if they tried. I’ve never seen a worker so un motivated to work and get the food out in a timely manner. Fast food with a smile it is not! Menu is hard to work out. No burger meals. You have to order everything separately. Chicken patty was luke warm but the burger was soft. Surprised that the chips were warm and not cold. Not sure if I would return. Till person looked at me as if I had arrived from mars when I asked about the menu! 🤣

I don’t know why, but the instead of kfc-style basket, we received poorly fitted chicken very very big pieces. This pieces contained bones and gristles. Also no interesting sauces here. Extra mayo portion for 100rp. was ridiculously small

I recently ordered a Cheese Double Decker Burger from the KFC Weligama branch through Uber Eats, and the quality was extremely disappointing. The burger tasted off, the preparation seemed careless, and the overall quality was far below what I normally expect from KFC.
I’ve been a loyal KFC customer for years, so this experience was really unexpected. It feels like the food preparation standards at this branch need serious improvement.
I hope this can be looked into, as customers rely on consistent quality when ordering through Uber Eats. I would appreciate your assistance in resolving this issue.
Thank you.

We bought 2 burgers – Crispy Chicken and Pepsi combo. The chicken tasted yummy, just as good as other KFC outlets, and the staff were friendly with a calm, not crowded environment.

However, the burger bun quality was poor, and overall the burger was quite average except for the chicken. The chicken itself was great, but the bun and other ingredients definitely need improvement to match the usual KFC standard.

Would recommend for the chicken, but hope they improve the burgers.

I come here very often for dinner, and they always cook delicious vegan burgers and amazing French fries. The staff is very nice, the cafe is always clean and cozy, I really like the stylish design of the cafe 🥰

Realy nice Food!
Fast and Yummy!
Recommendations!
Good place in area

My experience at Jonee Bakers Weligama for a rice and curry parcel was deeply frustrating and felt like a blatant rip-off.I requested a vegetable rice and curry parcel take-away. Despite seeing what I assumed were fresh curries on display, the server never mentioned that nearly all the popular curries were finished. They didn't ask what I wanted; instead, they aggressively and quickly scooped up the absolute dregs and leftovers from the bottom of the containers.

What I was forced to take was:TheDhal, Soya Meat,Breadfruit Curry the literal rest of the Cucumber Salad.

The way the order was rushed, I had no time to protest or ask for alternatives. I was essentially forced to take these unwanted scraps because they had nothing else available. To then charge the full price of 430RS for this pathetic collection of leftovers is outrageous and an insult to the customer!

I paid for a fresh meal but received the day's waste. This is dishonest and terrible customer service. Customers must be informed when only the leftovers remain! I felt completely cheated. Avoid their rice and curry parcels, especially later in the day, unless you enjoy paying premium prices for their rubbish.

I had a wonderful experience at Jonee Regale City Restaurant, Weligama! The ambiance is cozy and inviting, perfect for both family meals and casual dining. The staff were extremely friendly and attentive, making us feel very welcome.

The food was absolutely delicious — fresh, flavorful, and beautifully presented. I especially enjoyed their [mention any signature dish if you tried it, e.g., seafood platter or local curry]. Portions were generous, and the prices were very reasonable for the quality.

Overall, I highly recommend Jonee Regale City Restaurant to anyone visiting Weligama. I’ll definitely be coming back!

Johnee Regal City is one of the most popular shopping destinations in Weligama for clothing and fashion. It is a multi-story department store that offers a wide range of apparel for men, women, and children. As a resident of Weligama, I often visit this place because it provides a variety of trendy designs at very affordable prices. Whether you are looking for casual wear, formal attire, or traditional Sri Lankan outfits, they have a great selection to choose from.

The store is well-organized with different sections for each category, making the shopping experience very convenient. The staff is friendly and always ready to help you find the right size or style. During festive seasons, the store gets very busy, which shows its popularity among the locals. They also have a section for accessories, bags, and shoes, making it a one-stop shop for a complete fashion makeover. For students in Grade 11 or young professionals who want to look sharp without spending too much, Johnee Regal City is a fantastic choice. It’s a great example of a local business providing excellent value and service to the community.

Low star for the service because the first time was there they brought us rice instead of noodles ordered. But as we waited already and were hungry so we keep this as it is.

Standard portions are big, the one on picture is of larger size that is quite enough for two people. May be even for three 😁.

Food is tasty and fresh cooked.

I just return back from hirikatiya to weligama yesterday and felt bit hungry and got myself a chicken fried rice from this jonee restaurent . Out of all the restaurents in weligama this is the one that i had the worst experiance in both customer care and food quality. The fried rice was overcooked ,rice grains were all stuck together and mushed like rice sticky milk rice rather than fried rice. Though i orfered a chicken fried rice there were only 3 tiny shreads of chicken not even pieces SHREADS ! WHAT A SCAM. also the cashier was rude. Overall i dont recomend this place

I am shocked that someone can cook this bad. I had the avocado rotti. The rotti was old, the avocado black and for some reason they covered the whole thing in honey... The store was not clean and there was a weird smell.

Giant roti with loads of filling!!! One was enough to fill you up completely, and they were relatively inexpensive (Rs 300 Banana). Absolutely delicious! The kottu and fried rice that the other guests were having also looked very tasty and were very large portions (Rs 450 Egg Kottu/Rice).
It's delicious and you can really enjoy the local atmosphere.

formatted_address: 209 , New Galle road , Paranakade, Weligama, Sri Lanka
name: Sunset Bar

formatted_address: XCGH+R7P, ගාලු පාර, Weligama 81700, Sri Lanka
name: Devil's Travel and Tour

reviews.text: Had egg koththu and bought some paratha roti from 6upon6. The food was fresh, tasty, and very affordable. I liked the open kitchen concept..it feels clean and transparent. Overall, a nice place for a quick and satisfying meal. Recommended!

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
a real local gem

Hands down the best local food I’ve eaten so far in Sri Lanka. The quality is outstanding, everything tastes fresh, authentic, and clearly cooked with care. On top of that, the prices here are cheaper than the nearby tourist areas, which makes it even better value for money.

My friends and I ended up eating here three days in a row — that alone says everything. If you’re in the area and want real Sri Lankan food without tourist prices, this is the place to go. Highly recommended.

I'm upset why I didn't find this place sooner, the food was really delicious, with a lot of portions and very reasonable prices(for this area) . The staff was very friendly and it was a great experience.
Thank you so much 🥰
Very tasty food for a fair price. They ask how spicy and adjust accordingly. The staff is very friendly.

This is the best 👌 kotto I tried
The food is great and very delicious 😋
Best halal food in Weligama
Absolutely delicious food!! The chef was super friendly, big portions, good prices. We had a nice talk and watched the owner prepare our food. Our favourite place so far! I would recommend.

One of the best places I ate at in Weligama. This is where the locals eat, which already tells you a lot.
The place looks very simple, just a small hut, but the food is absolutely amazing. They serve some of the best kottu I had in Weligama.
If you want authentic local food, this is definitely a place you should try 🤩

Wow kottu is in here very tasty one of my friend bought me a takeaway kottu and it was amazing. Then i needed to find the restaurant and here we goo.. kottu is exactly same in taste 🤤🤤🤤 this restaurant will be one of my favorite one. Thank you❤️

Chicken Kottu porcija L
1100 Rs

A good portion of meat inside, salty, nice and a good portion, they squeeze the portion when they wrap it but there is a lot of it.

I asked for boneless chicken, but they still gave me with bones and skin, it's not very pleasant when you constantly have to take the rubber skin and bones out of your mouth, which you bite into and accidentally swallow.

The only thing I have to admit is that another place still wins with a richer taste
By far the best kottu I found in Sri Lanka, so fresh and delicious. Lovely owners too!
Nice place to have rice and curry. Traditional Sinhala food, Food is good enough for the value, you can dine in with a nice Beach view, parking options available, easy access,
Good local food, people, view, music and prices!! Vegetarian super friendly! What else you’d want...? We found our canteen in Weligama

Rice with small stones are very tasty, you can get a very fantastic experience 😂😂😂😂😂

We are surprised

Came here for breakfast this morning. Nice to have a different style of breakfast in Sri Lanka with waffles. A great choice between sweet and savoury. Being a stereotypical Brit I went for bacon and egg waffles. Yum yum.

Absolute little paradise of a cafe!! 🤩 you wouldn’t know what’s beauty and peace is hiding behind when entering from a busy street. Great atmosphere and most importantly the food is delicious 😋!!! Staff is very welcoming and attentive. Turmeric/coconut drink was stunning… we had tofu tacos and tofu shakshuka with the most delish coconut roti !!! Highly recommend this place when visiting Weligama.
Gorgeous food! Off the beaten track 😊reasonable prices for high quality western brunch. The rustic building is very cool in a jungle style setting.

Amazing cafe place! The atmosphere it’s amazing like the food and service.
We had smoothie bowl and matcha + coffee so yummy.
They even offer for free water and mosquitoes repellent!

We love this cafe, and the food and atmosphere keeps us coming back. Chamara and his family are super sweet and make us feel so welcomed every time we’re here. Not to mention the delicious smoothie bowls (try the choco bowl!) and tasty coffee’s. Highly recommend!

I had the fruity smoothie bowl and an iced Americano. Both were very tasty and reasonably priced. They also gave me a free bottle of water. The staff are very friendly and the location is really nice. I would definitely come back :)
Amazing chai and delicious food! The flavors were perfect. Highly recommend this place and perfect spot for chai lovers.Fresh, tasty food and super friendly service!

Outstanding Experience at Unique Chai – A Hidden Gem in Weligama
As European travellers, we honestly did not expect to find this level of quality in Sri Lanka — but Unique Chai completely exceeded all expectations.
From the moment we arrived, the service was exceptional: warm, attentive, and genuinely welcoming. You feel instantly comfortable, as if the staff truly care about your experience rather than just serving you.
The coffee and tea were outstanding — expertly made, rich in flavour, and easily comparable to (if not better than) some of the best cafés we’ve visited in Europe. The chai is truly special and lives up to the name.
And the desserts… absolutely extraordinary. Fresh, beautifully presented, and perfectly balanced — not overly sweet, just pure quality.
Unique Chai is not just a café; it’s an experience. It’s rare to find such high standards of service, drinks, and desserts all in one place. If you’re in Weligama, this is an absolute must-visit. We will definitely return and highly recommend it to anyone visiting Sri Lanka.
One of the most interesting finds in Weligama. It’s more geared toward locals, but the desserts and tea are unbelievably good. Highly recommended!
Loved this night-time spot! The food was delicious, the chai was perfect, and the bubble mojito was absolutely refreshing and unforgettable. Great vibes, great taste — definitely a must-try!
Really good food and portions are generous. We’ve been twice and the second time we shared a small fried rice which was more than enough. Owners are nice and prices are super affordable

The best local food! We came here almost every day of our month long trip for lunch. We were recommended by our surf guide and it was truly the best recommendation of our trip. The rice & curry is so delicious and flavorful, we chose which sides we wanted and it’s nice that the sides change daily. The roti and samosas are also really tasty. Don’t sleep on the chocolate banana hopper. The portions are large and the price is low. The auntie in the back is the sweetest and the place is just super welcoming although the interior is pretty simple.
Nice small restaurant, we always come back for vegetable rice and curry (350 LKR) during lunch, it’s delicious! Spicy just enough for foreigners even though it’s already prepared :)

Great little local food place. Delicious.

Had the hoppers with sambal and chicken curry gravy. Staff were friendly and helpful. Glass bottles of sprite and coke also.
I went back here several days in a row to try as many items on the menu as i could. All fresh and very tasty. Very good prices

formatted_address: No: 16 Samaraweera Pl, Weligama 81700, Sri Lanka
name: Cafe Yalu

formatted_address: 223/1 Weligama By Pass Rd, Weligama 81700, Sri Lanka
name: PLAN B Weligama

reviews.text:
Where should I start?
The food is simply amazing!
Would recommend the mahi mahi + risotto , the hoppers , the udon noodles , …
Coffees are super good.

Amazing service , the staff is so attentive and lovely.

The co working space has really good internet. It’s a good place to work in general.
I would recommend to build a room for important work calls , as it can get a bit noisy.

But other than that, wonderful place.

In my opinion, this place feels a bit overrated. The presentation is beautiful and the dishes look very aesthetic, but there are some issues with the taste.

For example, my egg dish was unexpectedly sweet — it felt as if it had been cooked on the same pan where sweet roti is prepared. That significantly affected the overall impression.

The coffee was also disappointing. It wasn’t so much weak as it was watery and lacking depth and richness. I tried different beans they offer, but in both cases the flavor left much to be desired. There are definitely other places on the island serving much better coffee.

The service also left an unpleasant impression. The administrator, Kevin, was unfriendly and communicated in a rather arrogant manner. The atmosphere of hospitality was not really there.

Overall, the place looks nice visually, but I expected more balanced flavors and a warmer service experience.

You should definitely go here for breakfast or lunch!

We went for brunch and ordered the couscous harissa with chicken/paneer, an iced coffee, flatwhite and sunrise smoothie.

All of was delicious and freshly made. Portions were good. The staff was very friendly and helpful.

The atmosphere is great as there is a relaxed vibe in the small courtyard. The tables are in the shade and there are some fans blowing which made the temperature pleasant.

The prices are a little bit higher than some other places (2000-3000lkr or 5-8 eur for a meal), but the food, service and location make it worth it.

Toilets were modern and clean.

absolutely LOVED the place! it’s a co-working place as well as a restaurant & cafe. incredible food, everything we ordered was sensational. we got the mahi mahi which was so tender and lovely. the coco curry, lanka classic and chicken panini was also incredible. highly recommend this place! the service is exceptional and everyone’s so friendly. super cool vibes + yum espresso martini ❤️

I LOVE this place!

The waiters are kind and attentive, the food is amazing! Our fav is the Udon pasta with tofu, but anything else we tried was also amazing!

Good music, nice environment and attracts nice customers.

I really recommend! ❤️🤗

formatted_address: XCFH+2VH, Weligama By Pass Rd, Weligama, Sri Lanka
name: Gold Coast Resort

reviews.text:
Dirty, dilapidated and rude!
This place really ruined my vacation, I have never encountered such rudeness as in the hostel Gold Beach Resort Villa.
It's really terrible!
I think the hostess of this Ramani hostel needs psychiatric treatment.
She constantly yells, even when you sleep in the morning, you hear her yelling into the phone, in the evening she swears with the guests!
But she does not take care of her hostel, so there are cobwebs in every corner of the hostel, the toilets in the rooms do not know disinfection and stink, all the dishes are old and shabby, and the yard is flooded with water when it rains and you need a boat or rubber boots if you want to go out on walk.
The owners of this hostel have ruined my experience in Sri Lanka!
I do not recommend this place!

Worst guesthouse in Weligama!
This is the worst guesthouse I have ever stayed in.
Its owners, husband Chandra and wife Ramini, are professional scammers, they lure guests to their place by promising a good price for accommodation, and then they want to receive additional payment for everything: for electricity, for gas, for the Internet.
They lie about everything, constantly changing the terms of the lease.
They are absolutely immoral and poorly educated, they can come and start yelling when you eat.
And they yell that your light or fan is on.
The common area of the guesthouse is poorly cleaned and very dirty.
When it rains, the guest house is flooded and you have to walk on the water to get home.
And worst of all, the owners of the guesthouse stole my canister of gas, which I bought for cooking.
Avoid this guesthouse, never stay there!

Actually this review is for the Restaurant in front of the Gold Coast called Jayalath Restaurant...Facing the main Road and Weligama Bay.... Probably the same owners...Lovely food, the best in weligama Bay...try the fried prawn or the amazing nasigeoreng rice with
Pineapple... Food is always good and above standard, value for money, and excellent service.
My number 1 choise of all hosts ever! Good rooms, near beach, this is the best place in all weligama and all sri lanka!
Is wonderful place with amazing host and trully worm atmosphare .I recomende to everyone. Big thanks for host 😀😍😘

Had a wonderful experience at Red Apple Restaurant in Weligama! The food was absolutely delicious and freshly prepared. The seafood was especially tasty and full of flavor.

The staff were very friendly, attentive, and made us feel welcome from the moment we arrived. The service was quick, and the atmosphere was relaxed and comfortable.

If you are visiting Weligama and looking for good food with great service, I highly recommend Red Apple Restaurant. Definitely worth a visit!

Red Apple in Weligama is a well-known spot for those looking for mobile phones, accessories, and tech gadgets. Given my interest in technology and my dream of becoming a tech leader, I find this store very interesting to visit. They offer a variety of smartphones from top brands, along with a wide range of accessories like headphones, chargers, and protective cases.

The store is modern and the staff is quite knowledgeable about the latest mobile tech trends. They are very helpful in explaining the differences between various models and finding a device that fits your budget and needs. For a student who relies on a smartphone for learning and staying connected, having a reliable local store like Red Apple is very useful. They also provide repair services, which is a big plus. The pricing is competitive, and they often have the latest gadgets soon after they are released. If you are in Weligama and need a quick tech upgrade or a new accessory for your device, Red Apple is a reliable and trendy place to go!

they’re right in the water, central location, the food is amazing and the staff are super super kind. they’ve got good english so it’s easy to order and ask questions. my buddy and i came here all the time during a couple weeks in weligama. would absolutely recommend!! reasonably priced too, they’ve got it all

It is truly a place that serves the best food in the Weligama area. The price-effectiveness of the food, the quantity and taste, and the cleanliness of the place add to the value of this place. The owner is very friendly and helpful. I definitely recommend it.
The best mango smoothie bowl I have ever had!! Super great location and friendly staff. And a great mix of local/western food. 10/10 would come back again!

formatted_address: Number One Fish Point, New Galle Road, Weligama, Sri Lanka
name: Number One Fish Point

reviews.text: It's a street restaurant by the sea. Very fresh seafood with reasonable & affordable prices, you could have your meal on the beach enjoying the views. And they also offer vegetables & juice & beers...

Food heaven! I have been in Sri Lanka for 3 weeks and I live in London. I eat a lot of curries! The crab curry here is one of the best I have ever had. It's fresh, full of flavour and perfectly spiced. Absolutely delicious food! I will be back!

Today I tried out this cool new seafood restaurant where you get to pick your own fish and tell them how you want it cooked. It was awesome!

I chose a fish and squids. I asked them to fry the fish real crispy because I love the skin, tail, and head that way. The squids I wanted grilled, both of them with lots of garlic and chili, but no curry leaves. When they brought me my food, it was like heaven on a plate.

Let me tell you, I travelled a world and this dinner was the best I've ever had in my life! The taste, how it felt, and all the spices were exactly what I imagined when I ordered. They also had a cool vibe by the sea with great house music playing.

This place is like a paradise for your mouth, eyes, and ears. I can't wait to go back. If you're into amazing food, you've got to check it out! ❤️🐟🐠🍤

Great location on the beach with the fishing boats delivering the daily catch. Very friendly staff, wanting to impress. Relaxed but good food.   We had delicious chicken noodles and juices for lunch: couldn’t be better!

Great service, also the spicing of the fish was really good, tip would be to ask them to cook the octopus a bit shorter so it doesn’t get rubbery, furthermore a good experience. Very friendly staff, also great view of the sea.

formatted_address: XCCH+P7V, Bypass Beach Road, Weligama 81700, Sri Lanka
name: Sithum Fish Point

reviews.text: Tasty food! Ate calmari both times, and it was delicious every time! The guy is super firendly and helps to select you best option! I suggest to come here just before getting dark, so you can see place in light and night! ✌️

THE BEST seafood! I came here with my dad and was a little skeptical at first but im soooo glad we sat in. The staff is super kind. And the main point, the food, is so amazing, i would come here every day if i could. Im very big on seafood and everything we ate was so tasty and well made, it couldnt have been better in a 5 star restaurant. We got a seafood platter for 2 and the portion was huge honestly. Very much recommend the place, food, and everything here.

Holidaying in Galle. Couldn't get fresh seafood in Galle. On way to our whale watching your we "discovered" Weligama where tere were stalls or selling fresh seafood.

Worth a try, we thought. And went drive all the way back from Galle.
Sithum Fish Point did the trick. We ordered Sea Bass and prawns. Totally fresh and delicious.
It was worth the drive from Galle to Weligama.

Next visit to Sri Lanka we'll be staying in or around Weligama. Great beach as well
Probably the best prepared seafood we ever tried. We had a lunch here 3 days in a row. Taken together with a view to Weligama's bay, it is one of our best experiences in Sri Lanka.

Absolutely loved our experience here! The food, ambience, and service were all excellent, truly great value for money. The staff were so friendly and even served us freshly oven-baked roast paan, which was a lovely touch.

The location right by the beach makes it the perfect spot to relax and spend time with family and friends. You can enjoy a refreshing dip in the sea, a chilled beer, and delicious fresh seafood dishes all in one place.

We especially loved the Deviled Prawns and Cuttlefish Curry, which were both outstanding, along with the fish dishes we ordered. The best part is you get to pick your own fresh fish, and the cook takes care of the rest - perfection!

Highly recommended for anyone looking for great food and a laid back beachside vibe

This is more than a restaurant. This is a wonderful family who has blessed people with their home cooking. By far the best Sri Lankan food my partner and I had during our month here. So much so we ate here twice in our three days in Weligama.

Had the veggie kottu, chicken fried rice and devilled chicken the first time and then mixed kottu, devilled chicken and rice+curry the second time. Not only that but the owner Mr Pradeep, his sister and his son were kind enough to show me how to cook the whole second meal. Can personally vouch it’s all made from scratch. You’d truly be a fool not to eat here!

I think it was too expensive — 4300 for the seafood plate. I only took a small bite of the tuna. The shrimps were not peeled at all and still had the gut. However, the egg kottu was very good, so I gave 3 stars.
Simple, honest local restaurant. Nicely decoratedMade welcome and enjoyed a good feta salad. Pricing suitable. Recommended.

My boyfriend suggested the restaurant. I was a bit skeptical, because the building itself isn’t to pretty. But don’t judge a book by its cover. The food was freshly prepared and very tasty. We will eat their again :)  we had to wait for the meals a bit longer then in other restaurants, which is long for European standards. But we already expected that after reading other reviews and didn’t mind.
Got egg kottu for takeaway and it was incredible! Also a very reasonable price, we’ll be back :)
Amazing fruit juice with a ball of ice cream inside for the same price! The owner is so friendly and she also sold me for so cheap some fantastic avocados from her trees.

This place should receive an award from Sri Lankan government as the best juice spot nationwide.

Don't let the interior scare you away.
They serve the best juices we ever tasted.
We visit this place every day and plan on doing so until we leave Sri Lanka.

Must be on your list if you like fresh juices!
Tasty fresh fruit juice and salad. Good place. You can drink here and take away. 👌👌
First time here for fruit salad with icecream on recommendation 🙃 you should go for it as well for only 400Rs. 🎉
It’s very sweet and cool juice!
Good foods
Good

Great ice coffee!
Great Dodoel (yummy sticky toffee type cake made with coconut, cardamon, treacle and jaggery) which I didn't think I was going to like, but loved it.
Real people.
The cafe is run by a super friendly and nice uncle! Had a yummy mango lassi and delicious vegetable rolls!

We love this cafe
We had the sour sop and woodapple juice, they're amazing 😀
Very nice little cafe next to the train station. Sunny was so nice getting us some amazing smoothies and iced coffees. We’ll be back soon!
It gives me only 300 for papaya juice and remake it when I said there’s too much sugar

formatted_address: no 15, 4 Samaraweera Pl, Weligama 81700, Sri Lanka
name: Cafe AMORE

reviews.text: Great café. The food is delicious, very simple and clean ingredients. Honest and generous staff, and great value for money. Would recommend this cafe for locals and tourists in Weligama.
Great food, wonderful people and atmosphere! The burger was so delicious, and Mathisha is the best!

Amazing smoothie bowl!! The juiciest mango on the island. Will be returning for the smoothies!!

Great view for people watching and nice and quiet with AC

Loving the smoothies there!
Best cafe in the area!
Good coffee. Iced coffee really nice. They borrowed me a phone charger 🥰🥰The only thing is they could have more syrups flavours to choose.

formatted_address: 217 By Pass Road, Weligama 81700, Sri Lanka
name: RIZZIE'S Cafe weligama

reviews.text: You should definitely stop by Rizzie’s Cafe before or after your surf session! The coffee is amazing and the staff is the friendliest I met in Weligama 🤩
Great place for a coffee - barista is professionell and the smoothies are really nice

The food is very delicious and is home cooked, definitely worth it!! The Café Just opened and you can tell that a lot of heart and soul went in this project so give it a try! You feel very well taking care of
Best pineapple milkshake,  no water, no sugar.  I recommend it.
Here I drank the best milkshake in my life. Very fresh, delicious and cool. The prices are good. The atmosphere is very friendly. The coffee is also very good and professional.
Good place to have quick bites and tea or coffee. Enjoyed having nestea.  It would be great if the management cleans all the wall mounted fans.  Airflow would improve.

Even though the branch is located in a high tourist-attraction area and a very busy location, it is surrounded by stray dogs that often bark at people and even chase some customers. This creates an unpleasant and unsafe environment for visitors. I believe this matter should be addressed by the Weligama Pradeshiya Sabha immediately.

Excellent local cafe with a great selection of pastries and decent Nescafé coffee. Came here twice and great friendly service with a smile both times.  Very reasonably priced for good quality. Popular with both locals and tourists.  Indoor and outdoor tables well-situated for people watching at a busy junction 😊

A lovely experience at P & S! Truly appreciate the energy and friendliness of the staff — they were attentive and welcoming. The food was fresh, tasty, and consistently high in quality. Great service, great vibes. Keep up the good work!
The pros are the low prices on the baked goods. The cons are a bit racist. You stand in line, and everything's fine. But if a Sri Lankan comes up behind you, they start serving him and ignore you.

Highly recommend this place! Why not 5 stars? There is a reason for it.

The location is amazing but not located super easy. But that is what it is.

You are treated by a friendly crew. We received the menu and I was surprised; well done by not making it too big and too many options. It’s a nice overview of great food. But please; get items in stock. This seems an overall problem at many restaurants.

There is a little shop with nice clothes.

The vibe is great, thank you! Please improve the bathroom. This is really dirty.

Overall, a good breakfast and coffee at flow café in Weligama. We had the Sri Lankan breakfast and a smoothie bowl.

The coconut roti and the dhal were good, so was the onion sambal. Portions of this plate were quite big. The smoothie also was quite good, with a good amount of mangoes and banana.

The flat white was tasty and served quickly.

A fantastic breakfast spot with a super cappuccino and an amazing granola bowl, as well as delicious avocado toast. The staff is very friendly and welcoming, creating a relaxed and cool atmosphere. A big plus is that they open as early as 6:30 a.m., which is perfect for early risers or before work. Highly recommended for a great start to the day!

I stayed in Weligama for a month, and this place quickly became my go-to spot for morning coffee — almost every single day. It turned into a little ritual: arriving early, right when they opened, and being so warmly welcomed by the two lovely ladies.
Winoda, thank you for your kindness and your smile every single morning!
Amazing little hide out! Just loved comming here, and both the food & coffee are great! Especially the friendly staff, Vinoda, made the visit feel very welcomming! Will def come back!

formatted_address: Near XC9X+V89 Rangani's coconuts, Matara, Weligama, Sri Lanka
name: Rangani's coconuts

reviews.text:
We had breakfast at Moochies Café and absolutely loved it. The outdoor area is so lovely and relaxing — the perfect spot to unwind in Weligama.
The food was amazing. The avocado toast with tofu was fresh and full of flavour, the surfers hash was delicious and the choc butter smoothie bowl was incredible (and a very generous portion!).
The matcha and coffees were excellent too. It was so good that we came back a second time during our short stay in Weligama.
Highly recommend 😄

Everything we’ve eaten and drank here has been wonderful! Best coffee we’ve had in Sri Lanka and love the boost juice - so refreshing. The surfer’s hash, banana bread, tacos, chicken burger and mahi mahi dishes were perfect. Anju’s service was amazing and the team are really friendly.

As a bonus, there is a really nice clothes and accessories shop on site - bought a top and necklace which I love.

They had live music on last night which was really lovely.

Definitely visit if in Weligama! Very near the beach so good for brunch, lunch or dinner if you’re surfing 😊 🏄‍♀️

I ate here several times on my trip. Everything was so tasty. The mahi dish wow, the beet burger and the tofu burger were delicious! The service always so welcoming and friendly. I ate solo mostly. Once I took my laptop in the morning and had the avocado eggs brunch - they have a real special touch here with the food. So much flavour. Thank you for the great experience, and shout out to Sasa who was always so accommodating and helpful.

Food is amazing, with many components made in-house. Staff is incredibly friendly and dedicated, with a special mention for Ajey who was infinitely courteous.

Service fee is not included whilst we personally feel it should be to support the staff in their sheer dedication to make everyone feel looked after. So when you visit: be kind and leave a tip :)

We came here for a morning bunch and we had the best avo toast of our lives! Also the banana bread with a scoop of vegan coconut ice cream was delicious.

We came back for dinner and we can confirm the food in this restaurant is simply amazing! Super tasty chicken burger and incredible shrimp tacos (the smocked shrimps were just amazing).

100% recommended, a must try in Weligama. We definitely come back!

formatted_address: NO 43/B Samaraweera Pl, Weligama 81700, Sri Lanka
name: Caffena - Weligama

reviews.text: This place is soo cute!! This is the perfect place if you have to make calls online and work in peace and quiet.  The food was very tasty and price is totally ok. The owners super helpful and kind. Definitely coming again!!!

Caffena is the best cafe in Weligama! The food is incredibly delicious, and the atmosphere is just wonderful. There were no soups on the menu, but we asked, and they made us an amazing vegetable soup - so tasty and rich! The service is top-notch, and the staff is always ready to help. Highly recommend this place to anyone looking for great food and a cozy spot to relax!

We had a super nice breakfast post surf at Caffena!
The food was prepared with care and the entire family is very lovely!
They also have home stay above their house which I’ve been staying at and have felt amazingly comfortable!
The location close to the beach is hard to match!

You should definitely come by when you’re in weligama 🫶🏽
Such a lovely spot! It was so good i came two days in a row. Perfect place to relax and the passion fruit drink is delicious!
Highly recommend this coffee shop. Delicious food, excellent service. Perfect spot for a relaxing and tasty meal♥️.

Stopped for breakfast time in this nice and relaxing place in front of the beach.
Had and avocado bagel and a chicken muffin with iced coffee.
Delicious , 5+ for chicken muffin

Amazing place! Everything is delicious!
The atmosphere, style, and staff are wonderful.
I want to try everything here 😁

The plce is awesome and cool atmosphere there are many specialty coffees it was best coffe i had in this area . Friendly  staff and good service and they are so helpfull . The menu has many good dishes .it was very hard to choose what i want when i go there. All dishes are looks good and price is solid..highly recommended in weligama. We are coffee and bar  😉
A chic atmosphere, friendly staff, delicious food, great drinks, wild parties and a good mood can be found in this place.
Great signature cocktails and foods. Definitely will be back again 🌊 lovely place and friendly staff ✨🥰

formatted_address: Weligama old road, Weligama 81700, Sri Lanka
name: MACO Weligama

reviews.text: We had a great breakfast. The coffee tasted excellent and arrived quickly. The music was a bit loud, but you could still have a conversation. The portion size was very good. I would come back again.

We would recommend this place. Apparently they are new in town but the food tasts like they know what they are doing. All the flavours go well with each other. Definitely  try their coffee too. They use really good beans. very tasty and unique in srilanka

I had a  great experience here. Ordered a cappuccino and peanut butter toast. Both came really fast even though the cafe was busy. The coffee was very nice and the food tasted and looked like a piece of art. Its a hidden gem in Weligama.

A great place with the best specialty coffee in Weligama.

Minimalist yet stylish interior, very pleasant atmosphere, and friendly staff.

I ordered a latte, cheese omelette and cheese sandwich - it was so delicious.

Perfect for a leisurely breakfast after a morning surf. Highly recommended!

Love this place so much! The pizzas and pasta are the best I’ve had in Sri Lanka so far 🤤 such a nice chilled vibe with a view of the ocean and they even had a little market on Sundays with a live singer after so you can enjoy music while you eat. 100% recommend this place for breakfast, brunch and dinner. Favourites are the garlic chicken pizza, carbonara, bagels and matcha lattes! If you want something alcoholic then piña colada is delicious 😋

formatted_address: 67/2 Buhari masjidh mw, Galbokka Rd, Weligama, Sri Lanka
name: Munsif 's home

formatted_address: No51 Samaraweera Pl, Weligama 81700, Sri Lanka
name: Elements Sri Lanka

reviews.text: Excellent latte (coming from a coffee snob), the matcha was really good but does not come with any sweetener, food was really good. Definitely give it a try.
Enjoyed one of the best coffees we have had on their lovely roof top. Quick service and reasonably priced.
Best coffee in Weligama! Strong and inexpensive. Nicest staff as well. Went there every single morning for a week 😍

Out of the vivid selection of coffee available at “Elements Cafe Weligama” coffee that I tried were really good and I can assure that this is the “best coffee in Weligama”. Great service and the atmosphere suits as well! Really Impressed…!

The Americano was really good — real coffee! I asked for sugar, and they served me a cup of liquid sugar on the side so I could add as much as I wanted. Great service, and they greeted us with big smiles. It’s a cozy place to chill on a hot day!

formatted_address: No 52/B Samaraweera Pl, Weligama 81700, Sri Lanka
name: Island Friends Cafe | Vegan & Vegetarian Restaurant Weligama

reviews.text:
Tried the Lentil love bowl (swapped eggs for tofu 🤗) absolutely delicious, loved it very much, wholesome food made with love 🥣
The atmosphere is also lovely, they have a yoga shala at the back (Movement of joy) join for classes or just hang out, won’t regret it ❣️

The staff are extremely friendly. I really enjoyed a delicious breakfast and fresh juices. I also appreciated being able to use the time between yoga classes for my meditation. I can highly recommend this place the atmosphere is truly special and very pleasant.
Food is so delicious, fresh and portions are huge! Highly recommend this vegan spot! Also coffee is great, sourced from a farm in Sri Lanka🫶✨️
Lovely granola bowl for breakfast. Friendly service. Yoga classes look good but sadly I didn’t have time for one.
I had a Bowl and it was extremely delicious and filling :)

Best Masala Chai in Weligama!
200 one cup its homemade and it tastes delicious just like in India!

The family that runs the little shop its super sweet welcoming with an amassi energy for all their customers !

The best chai in sri lanka!!
Good place and ppl 🤍
with all kinds of delicious drinks.
Very good shop for tea and drink! Also they sell herbal powders. I had the best masala chai there! Lovely lady who runs it!

Best masala chai (tea) in Weligama! I grew up in Qatar where drinking it was a national pastime  (we have a huge Sri Lankan and Indian population). It took me back to my youth, so delicious and cozy. Thank you , Sudesh!
This is the best chai in Sri Lanka. They make their own mixtures and also sell them at reasonable rates. They have coconuts too. Really friendly and Definitely worth the stop

formatted_address: Next to Cargills Food City, 287, Weligama 81700, Sri Lanka
name: Happy Hammocks

reviews.text: I stayed in both Hiriketiya and Weligama at Happy Hammocks for majority of my trip in srilanka. I couldn’t stop extending because the hostel, the people, the owners, the activities, the locations and the common areas were way too good to leave. If you want to meet the most amazing people and chill or party happy hammocks is the perfect place for it. The rooms were so comfy DOUBLE CURTAIN which is unreal and A KITCHEN I could actually cook the food I wanted and it made my experience feel more like I was at home. Both hostels have social reps that are super friendly and fun to be around and they make the hostel so much more special. ALSO both are walking distance to the beach and restaurants. I genuinely have nothing bad to say and I can assure you I will be back again 🫶🫶🫶🏝️🏝️

Happy hammocks is the place to be and stay for a while.  It is a safe and clean place with a friendly and fun vibe.  The staff n hosts are warm and friendly  welcoming an easy comfort for the traveler. Happy Hammocks offers fun events including family dinners and group rides to party dance places and is very close to the beach with a discount for new surfers looking to rent a board or hire surf instructors.  Come here -enjoy yourself, the staff and other guests that may become part of your traveler family.  If you want to get close to sea turtles hire the joyous Hiru from the information board.

Happy Hammocks was one of the chillest hostels I’ve stayed in. Casual dinners, optional nightly activities, and a genuinely welcoming, family-style vibe that makes it easy for solo travellers to connect. Limiting big groups really helps keep it that way.

The social hosts, managers, and staff were fantastic and made everyone feel included. The group chat stayed active, people teamed up for surf lessons and meals, and there was always something going on without any pressure to join. One night we missed the bar after trivia and ended up with an impromptu guitar singalong by the fire — such a good memory.

It’s social but not a party hostel. Parties are nearby if you want them, but music at the hostel usually stops around 10pm so you can still sleep.

Practical things were great too. I could extend my stay and keep the same bed. Towels and padlocks were available with a deposit, and the curtains fully covered the bunks which was amazing for privacy. Bedding is just a thin sheet and showers weren't hot, but that’s pretty standard in Sri Lanka.

Staff helped with changing big notes, arranging fairly priced tuks, and giving great food recommendations. Also — excellent coffee.

Location is ideal. The beach is 1–2 minutes walk away for surfing or relaxing, a little quieter than the main area but still only about 4 minutes walk to more action. Supermarket, ATM, bottle shop, and lots of restaurants are all very close.

Definitely social, very relaxed, and easy to feel at home.

It was my first hostel in Weligama and I absolutely loved it. It’s such a social hostel with loads of activities and great hosts! The free drinking water as well as the communal kitchen area are great and the bed was comfy :) thanks for the nice stay!

I had an amazing time at this hostel! The place has a really good vibe — relaxed, friendly, and social, without being too loud. The staff are super kind and always ready to help with anything. The rooms and common areas are clean and comfortable, and the kitchen/bar area makes it easy to meet other travelers.
The location is great too, close to the beach and everything you need. It honestly felt like a small family — I ended up staying longer than I planned. Definitely one of the best hostels I’ve stayed in during my trip.

We ate here 3 times and it was always so delicious!
Keep in mind that the place is super small! 9 seats or so. But the portions and the hospitality is gigantic!
The burgers are huge and I recommend their yellow smoothie bowl.

This is a family business, all the siblings were cooking and working, this was really nice, they were really kind. This is a cute place, they make everything so that you feel good.
The food was very tasty and the beverages very fresh.
I highly recommend this place. The food is much better and also cheaper than the touristic places.

Decent place to get food, the shrimp wrappers were really good. The Keith burger had thin crusted chicken patties, well fried, I think with some battered mushroom and egg, tomato lettuce, mustard and this other tasty aioli sauce. We also got a fried fish, about 3kg, ~$9-10

Post surf pit stop for Sri Lankan breakfast, really nice fresh coconut rotti and the curry had a good level of spice and warm/smokey type flavour, yummy. Mango juice had ice cream which was a nice surprise! Ice coffee good and not too milky.
Service was great, Thisara and family are very attentive.
It is next to a busy road, but still feels relaxed. The small size makes it best for single or twos, maybe three. 😎

Cutesy cafe in Weligama! Little space but can accommodate dining solo to medium-sized group! Food is a bit pricy but similar to all other cafes in town. But serving is huge and for small stomach like me, I wasnt able to finish the kottu 😅 will recommend for chill and nice staff there!

formatted_address: 475/2, Matara Road, Palana, Weligama 81700, Sri Lanka
name: KOPI

reviews.text: Amazing breakfast place in Weligama. We loved the food. We loved the coffee. We loved the girls and their friendly service. We loved the cafe, the peaceful ambience. We loved their own mugs, plates and pottery so much we visited their pottery shop next door and purchased some lovely items to take home.

Small cafe good for solo and couple (seats outside) and small group (seats inside)! Tried the matcha which tasted relatively better than other matcha I tried in Weligama. But it is a bit pricey for small glass for 1100 rs. Updated menu shared.

Women owned café.

They believe that when women see other women thriving, it inspires them to dream bigger, and I agree.
Their smiles really inspire. And the coffee is as it should be.
My advice is that you seat inside so that you can smell the fresh beans when they're getting grinded (best smell ever).
You can pay by card. Card payment accepted.
High speed Free Wi-Fi.
Pottery making classes offered. All their crockery is homemade in their pottery studio.
And what a cute smiling cup of coffee I got with homemade oat milk.

Service charges are added on top. But you'll be supporting a locally, women - owned business.

Such a cute place! I got a cappuccino and the oatmeal and wow, the oats were incredible. Super generous portion - so filling! I couldn’t even finish them. Love all the pottery they serve the food in and the staff were super friendly.

Nice place. Service was really slow but the coffee was great. I didn’t really like my Turkish eggs but maybe I ordered the wrong thing. Toilet needs cleaning big time but the garden where you eat is really private and well maintained and has a nice vibe.

Nono’s has quickly become my go-to spot for coffee & breakkie in Weligama. They have so many vegan and even gluten-free options, which is so hard to find around here.

The gluten-free bread is super yummy and the toppings so creative! Rustica bread is my most favorite one, so hearty and filling, I strongly recommend trying that one out :)

Everything is home made here which you can feel, they even make their own vegan cream cheese from tofu😍 Cakes are also worth-mentioning, especially the chickpea brownie is to die for! Oh, and plant milks available as well (soya & coconut) for a very reasonable price!

Cute small place full of love for their craft + female run, so extra points for that as well 😊
Highly recommended if you are in Weligama and looking for a cozy, less touristy spot to enjoy a really good cup of coffee!

Super cute café! Vegan and Vegetarian friendly :) The bread was really delicious and fresh. The bowl was also very good. Especially that it’s not served in a coconut shell like in many other cafés, which does make it a bit smaller sometimes, but served in a pottery bowl. The coffee was very delicious as well. The prices are great and the Service is welcoming. Would definitely come back!

Went to Nono's and felt in love with all the stunning food, coffee and atmosphere! You should definitely try the amazing breads! So delicious. It's so special and unique in Weligama and I'm happy to come for my daily soulfood ✨🌞
I came to this place every day during my stay in Weligama! The owners are extremely friendly and kind. The food is absolutely delicious, and the prices are very reasonable. Highly recommended!

Absolutely delicious. You can really feel everything is made with soul and care. The spreads have unexpected, beautiful flavor combinations — each one is a joy. The bread is incredible, pure pleasure in every bite, and the coffee is outstanding.
Cozy, warm, and made even better by Ira the cat and Fina the dog 🐱🐶

A place you’ll want to come back to.

Lovely place! We spend there about a week and enjoyed every day. The location is great, the rooms have everything we need (ventilator, AC, privat bathroom…) and Veronika is a great host. Thanks for all the recommendations! ☺️☺️

And by the way the breakfast is amazing, love the loaded breads 😍

amazing stay at this beach villa in Weligama! The location is perfect—just a few steps from the beach, with stunning ocean views and the relaxing sound of waves all day. The rooms were clean, comfortable, and well-maintained, and the common areas had a great vibe for meeting other travelers. We recommend for all our clients
A cozy hostel at a great location right next to the beach and the main road. Nono is an amazing host. And the pets are so so cute. Highly recommend.

Great hostel right by the beach / center of town but tucked away on a quiet street . I stayed for almost a month in a private room and it was very comfortable , quiet and spacious . Veronica is so attentive and such a great host. The coffee is amazing and they also have the sweetest little puppy! Can’t wait to stay again .

The perfect hostel if you’re looking for a place to feel like home and make your own space. It’s a relaxed vibe, with a communal kitchen to cook (if you wanted), fridge, and a little porch to sit out on with bean bags. Weronkia who runs the place is absolutely lovely and makes it homely, with the best coffee you’ll find on the island. They also offer surfing and yoga packages. I ended up staying here for a week!

The location is perfect, less than 5 mins walk from the main surf beach, and right on the edge of town! The rooms are modern, spacious, AC and comfortable. Stay here if you’re looking for wholesome, and want to feel like the space is yours.

formatted_address: No.55/12 ,By Pass Road, Main Street, Weligama 87100, Sri Lanka
name: Barista Bay Weligama

reviews.text: Love love love barista bay! The coffee from here is amazing and the man who runs it is so lovely! Can highly recommend the Spanish latte iced! Has a lovely roof terrace to enjoy them on or seeing out the front! Also able to get take away or have in! Would highly recommend for your morning coffee ☕️

Such a cool little specialty coffee spot in Sri Lanka! They actually do proper pour‑over and filtered coffee here, which is still pretty hard to find on the island. The barista really cares about the beans and the brewing, and you can taste it in the cup – clean, aromatic and super satisfying. The vibe is relaxed and friendly, a great place to slow down for a bit and enjoy a really good coffee.

I came here everyday for iced coffee during my week in Weligama, and the coffee is the best I had in Sri Lanka and the owner is really friendly, I loved visiting! Its located down a small road but definitely worth stopping by in the morning or after the beach! Thank you so much for your coffee!

Came to this coffee spot after seeing amazing reviews after craving good quality coffee. Follow the signs to find this hidden gem (right off the main road). Best coffee we’ve had on this island. Highly recommend the iced caramel salt latte. Great service too! Obsessed!

I fell in love with his coffee!♥️
During our 8 days stay in Weligama, we came here atleast 6 times.

He is preparing the coffee as you like it
- Medium roasted beans
- Dark roasted beans
Exactly how you like it!

The onwer is super friendly & i would  suggest to everyone to come here!

formatted_address: No.28 first cross road palana, Weligama 81700, Sri Lanka
name: Restaurant weligama

reviews.text: I ordered cinnamon tea and it was disgusting. The tea tasted completely off. I paid 600LKR and it was not worth it at all.

We went there with a group of 4 person, I ate the fish pasta, which was the best I had in Sri Lanka, I really recommend it, the sauce and fish was amazing. We had 2 tuna bowl, which were also very taste but a little sweet, with lots of mango. While ordering I told the waiter I was really hungry, therefore he made my portion extra bigger and recommended to get the fish pasta. The chicken kothu was a giant portion too. Unfortunately I forgot to take pictures as I was too hungry to wait for all the food arriving 😅 definitly recommend this place!

Edit: we went there another time and ordered the fish pasta again, it was amazing again!
We enjoyed a lovely dinner in this little restaurant. It is family owned and we experienced a welcoming customer service and delicious food. Can highly recommend having dinner here 😊
Amazing food, Big dishes and very nice and welcoming people! Truly recommended

Loved the food here! I had a smoothie bowl and it was sooo rich of flavour and nice with this hot weather!
Would recommend coming here!

formatted_address: no 28,first cross road palana, Weligama 81700, Sri Lanka
name: MEYOLA RESTAURANT & BAR

reviews.text: Great little restaurant with very friendly staff. Tacos were great and kottu was up there. A little hidden gem off the Main Street. Would visit again. Arrack Attack cocktail was a good one.

I took the devilled prawn dish and it was amazing, super tasty and really generous portion! It is a family business and the mom cooked the dishes, it is really good food and good price.
My husband took the typical Sri Lanka curry dish. He said he wanted a bit spicy but it was really too much! If you like just a bit spicy, say no spicy because it will be anyway, like everywhere in Sri Lanka.
The staff is really nice and friendly. We had a great evening.
Also the cocktails were good and fresh, I took the passion fruit mojito and my husband the watermelon mule.

What a find! A really delicious local spot - get the Sri Lankan curry plate and it comes with 5 different veggie sides / sauces. We split that and a devilled prawn dish which was so tasty. Deceptively simple outside: friendly staff, such good value food, cold beers, good tunes (wall to wall Biggie Smalls). Don’t miss it.
I wanted to avoid western food and try local cuisine. The Sri Lankan curry was extremely nice and full of flavour. The portion is big I left very full. I would go again 👍🏻

A great find on our first day in Weligama.

We wanted to avoid the many places selling what we can eat at home. Such as all the usual western food.

A delicious chicken kottu for me and a vegetable kottu for Mrs C.

Complemented with an ice cold Lion.

Recommended.

formatted_address: No 28 first cross road Pelana, beach, Weligama 81700, Sri Lanka
name: The Picnic restaurant

reviews.text: We had dinner at Picnic with my friend — it was a great experience! I tried the shrimp bowl, and the portion was generous with a beautiful presentation. The ingredients were fresh and absolutely delicious. The atmosphere is cozy and comfortable, a place you truly want to come back to. Definitely recommend 🌿

We went 2 times to this restaurant in our trip to Sri Lanka. Both times we eat the mushroom burger that was amazing. Also we eat creamy pasta with vegetables and their curry was great as well. The guys are super professional and nice. If you are looking for a great meal and a outstanding service this is your place.
GREAT place. Food is really delicious and pretty good portions (as seen on the picture this only 1 dish). Prparation is fast. And the staff is always super friendly. Would recommend.
Good place. Food is really tasty + always beautifully prepared. Staff ist super friendly. And they are pretty fast :)

The Picnic Restaurant is an absolute gem. The crab curry here is simply unforgettable — rich, flavorful, and perfectly cooked. You can taste the freshness in every bite. The service is warm, attentive, and genuinely welcoming, and the atmosphere makes you want to stay longer than you planned. A perfect place to relax, enjoy amazing food, and soak in the vibe. Highly recommended!

quite possibly one of the worst hostels i've ever stayed in, only saving grace is generally nice staff (except one who was kind of rude)/ rooftop/ location. this is as bare bones as it gets, rooms are boiling (no aircon) and it's extremely loud all night as on a main road, bed is uncomfortable - not even a blanket/ throw on the beds just a pillow and mattress, lockers are not remotely secure, shower situation is bizarre and no hot water (note: the aircon and hot water is stated in advance so im not complaining about them individually but rather painting a picture of the hostel in its entirety). All in all just a bit of a dump but guess you get what you paid for.

I was there earlier this year. My chain was stolen and there were only 3 other guests in the hotel at that time and they all were at the beach. So the Staff must have stolen it. When I asked them they didn’t know a thing. There was also a certain employee who wanted to sell me overpriced dr0gs and he kept pressing me to buy it so I left earlier than I wanted to. Only go there if you have no other solution….
Also very loud music every Monday night.
Would not recommend.
