Horrible hostel. The vibe and the premises are absolutely crap. No way to properly chill anywhere or socialize in a way that is not buying super expensive alcohol. Smelly rooms, unhelpful staff. It's only 2 dollars cheaper than other hostels around, but you end up paying that difference with your soul. I wish I could go back in time and choose a different place.
Clean rooms , great location . Beach is about a 6 minute walk. Friendly staff. Would definitely come back especially for the fabulous Monday night party😎

Location is good with the main beach being a 5 min walk away, lots of restaurants and within walking distance from both the train and bus station. Beds are comfortable, no ac in the rooms so keep that in mind when booking it can be very warm in the rooms at night. They also host a party on mondays so there is music until about 1:30 or 2am. If you are looking for a good nights sleep maybe book elsewhere for Monday nights. Overall a good hostel to stay in and will stay again if I am ever back in Weligama!

formatted_address: No 429 New Galle Rd, Weligama, Sri Lanka
name: Surf's Up Hotel

reviews.text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Surf’s Up Hotel Restaurant is an absolute gem. The seafood is fresh, flavorful, and incredibly delicious, with a unique Sri Lankan and Russian twist that really makes the dishes stand out. Every bite was absolutely yummy.🥂🫶🏽🌸
On top of that, the people working there are so sweet, welcoming, and genuinely helpful, which makes the whole experience even better. Highly recommended if you love great seafood and a warm atmosphere 🌊🍤

Absolutely amazing restaurant! The food is incredible, the smoked tuna is out of this world, and the beetroot hummus is fantastic. They also serve genuinely great coffee, which is rare to find in Sri Lanka.

The atmosphere is lovely, the music is perfect, and the staff are incredibly attentive. Fast, reliable Wi-Fi too. Overall, an outstanding place highly recommend!

⭐ 5/5 Surf’s Up Sri Lanka – Weligama

I had a great experience here! The place is easy to find, and the staff are super friendly and helpful. They offer board rentals, surf lessons, and guiding for all levels. The instructors seem experienced and make you feel confident in the water. A relaxed vibe, good service, and a perfect spot for anyone wanting to learn or enjoy surfing in Weligama. Highly recommended!

I didn’t stay at the hotel but I came to the restaurant to get some russian food, and it was amazing. The food was good, a lot of variety, and the service is great. Plus the location is right next to the beach so its perfect for after surf. I recommend.

This restaurant truly stands out with both its cuisine and the quality of its service. The flavor of the dishes and the quality of the ingredients are immediately noticeable. The service team is extremely polite, attentive, and efficient. The atmosphere is both elegant and comfortable.Especially thanks to Sergei.

Absolutely loved my visit to Coff’n Kulfi!
The kulfi was rich and full of authentic flavor truly one of the best I’ve tried. Their coffee was aromatic and smooth, and the prices are super affordable too. A cozy spot with a nice variety of coffees, kulfis, and other beverages to choose from. Definitely a must-try place in Weligama for dessert and coffee lovers! ☕🍦✨

Really nice little spot! The coffee was great and the kulfi was super tasty. The place has a chill vibe and the staff were friendly too. Perfect for a quick break or to hang out for a bit. Definitely worth stopping by if you’re in Weligama!

Coffee n Kulfi serves the best kulfi in the city! My personal favorite is the pistachio kulfi rich, creamy, and full of flavor. They also offer a variety of coffee options, and the masala milk coffee is a must try. Everything is priced reasonably, and the quality is consistently excellent.

We visit almost daily the tea and biryani tea are amazing too. A perfect spot for delicious treats and warm drinks. Highly recommended!

Amazing Masala Coffee for just LKR 180 and black coffee for LKR 100. They have a milk coffee variety too. Kulfi is next level with its rich flavors and all sorts of varieties like Almond, Strawberry, Pistachio, Cookie and cream and many more.

A must try place in Weligama.
Fantastic place in Weligama. The coffee is delicious and the owner is a very good man. He's preparing fantastic coffee and he and his friends also helped me to find some coffee plantations.

formatted_address: Weligama By Pass Rd, Weligama 81700, Sri Lanka
name: Lof Weligama

reviews.text: Awesome seafood pasta. Very friendly
Good place.
Great place & the food is amazing❤️
Great little cafe   With friendly staff. Iced  coffee was extra cold and not sweet ! Love the glass straws.
Really nice staff, good food and nice Place to sit.

Fantastic paninis and juice. Good portion sizes and very well priced. Can order, go for surf, come back and sit down and then they bring over.
They also have great surf camp next door (turning point) and restaurant across the road

formatted_address: 540 Weligama By Pass Rd, Weligama 81700, Sri Lanka
name: Hangtime Rooftop Restaurant

reviews.text:
I visited this restaurant for both breakfast and dinner, and I absolutely loved the experience. The atmosphere is cozy and relaxing, making it a perfect spot to enjoy a meal.

For breakfast, we had the Banana Pancakes and Shakshuka, both of which were amazing. I also have to mention the espresso , it was so good that I ended up having two in a row

For dinner, we tried the Chicken Parmigiana and Smash Cheeseburger. The Chicken Parmigiana was excellent, while the Smash Cheeseburger was a bit disappointing (I think they might have forgotten the cheese), but it didn’t take away from the overall experience.

I also have to highlight their juices,they are huge and incredibly tasty. Overall, this place is fantastic, and I would definitely come back again

Was so good, I went here three days in a row. Breakfast/brunch food was all amazing, the service was spectacular and the place is beautiful. The coffee is also fantastic, they really know their stuff! The hash browns with eggs were a standout, highly recommend. Quite affordable prices as well.

Very good food, nice view and a friendly atmosphere. The prices are also fair and more affordable than in other places. It does not affect the food quality. They also except payment by card without a fee. Definitely recommend. Be mindful that around 9 it gets busier

A wonderful dining experience with a relaxed and welcoming atmosphere. The food was excellent, and the service was attentive and professional. The restaurant is located on the third floor of the building, so guests will need to use the stairs to access it. Overall, a highly recommended place for a pleasant meal.

The best place for food we found in Weligama! 🌴✨ Amazing atmosphere, super friendly staff 😊 and absolutely delicious food 🍽️🤍 Everything was fresh, full of flavor, and made with care. Such a cozy and welcoming place — we loved it and will definitely come back! 🙌💛

formatted_address: Kanakamage Watha, Weligama By Pass Rd, Weligama 81700, Sri Lanka
name: Café Samaya Restaurant

reviews.text: We really enjoyed our visit! The food was delicious, the staff was friendly and attentive, and the atmosphere was warm and welcoming. Definitely recommend this place and would love to come back again!
We had a wonderful dining experience at this restaurant. The food was delicious, and the staff were exceptionally kind and professional.

One of the best restaurants I have ever eaten at in my life.
The food quality is outstanding, with exceptional ingredients, authentic flavors, and great attention to detail, all offered with an excellent value for money.

A special thanks to Srimal and Sameera, who served us with incredible kindness, warmth, and professionalism. Both are extremely friendly, welcoming, and genuinely kind, making the entire experience even more special.

A truly memorable dining experience. Highly recommended.
Absolutely deserving of 5 stars ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Cafe Samaya is a truly beautiful place.
Great location, amazing food, and a warm, welcoming team that makes you feel at home.
Everything is clean, well-organized, and very aesthetic, you can feel the care in every detail.
The food is fresh, delicious, and full of flavor.
A wonderful spot to relax, enjoy great meals, and soak in a really pleasant atmosphere.
Highly recommended!

the atmosphere here is so lovely and everyone is friendly. stopped in for a drink and this place is the perfect location right across the street from the beach. nadishka the bartender made me the signature cocktail which was stunning and so great. will come back again!

formatted_address: Weligama By Pass Rd, Weligama, Sri Lanka
name: Starbeans Ceylon Weligama

reviews.text: We came early to Weligama to enjoy the beach and first had breakfast there. It was so good that we came back for lunch. The atmosphere is nice, the staff friendly and service good. Everything we ordered was delicious ! Granola, pancakes and crepes for breakfast with juice and onion soup, calzone and chicken avocado wrap. We recommend all those dishes !! What a nice place to eat at 😋
Nice place with cool second floor and a chill zone on it. Menu with reasonable prices. I've tested Tom yum soup and tuna salad it was quite good. Everything was good!
Good service , delicious foods good beach view....love it...
Nice and tasty, they have a good coffee and great variety of food.

Nice and cozy place, delicious food, reasonable prices, great service. They accept cards, which is uncommon for restaurants here in Sri Lanka. Go to the second floor to enjoy sea view, while you're waiting for your good. Strongly recommend, it's definitely worth to visit.

formatted_address: XCFP+42Q, Weligama By Pass Rd, Weligama, Sri Lanka
name: Bays Coffee and Cream

reviews.text: AMAZING coffee, came back everyday! The workers are so nice as well. Great spot!

Best coffee since coming to Sri Lanka three weeks ago, I am shamelessly a coffee snob.
In 8 months of travelling I have sought out the best coffee wherever I am, and I would rank this number 2 in the countless coffees Ive had (Bali included).

It seems to be quite common to have one shot wonders in Sri Lanka, so this being what tasted like a double shot to me got its place on my favourite coffee spot list.
It also seems common that coffee shops especially in this country state it is a flat white, when its not its usually a one shot 'milky drink', this is not the case for Bays coffee and cream, this has that iconic flat white taste, hence why its 2nd on my list!

To make it more perfect it had cinnamon available which I like to sprinkle on mine occasionally when I am feeling dangerous! lol!
After obviously taking the insta pic of the beautiful coffee art she does. Check those out on her instagram, bays.sl.
She has her insta tag on her little cute table she has with some local books giving it that coffee bookshop vibe that I love.

It has everything you could want including a perfect view looking out to Weligama beach, watching the surfers therefore giving it a nice edge on the other ones.
Best coffee after a surf sess 🤌, look for her along the beach road with a cute green van
Absolutely fantastic coffee, great views of the beach while watching the surf! The owner is happy with smiles can’t recommend this enough!!

Fantastic coffee considering it was made in the back of a van. Reasonably priced and the staff are very friendly. The best thing for after a session of surfing. Will definitely be a regular spot for me

The atmosphere is super welcoming small, warm, relaxed vibe with friendly staff. Everything felt genuine and made with care.

Food was spot on, prices were fair, and the whole experience was just really enjoyable. If you’re craving great shawarma or an amazing cup of chai, this place is a must visit!
Highly recommend we’ll definitely be coming back! ❤️

A cool spot for tasty fast food at very reasonable prices. The masala chai is super strong and easily the best I’ve had. Burgers, submarines, and sandwiches are all fresh and delicious. Run by a young guy, and it’s no surprise most youngsters are already hooked on his food. Definitely worth a visit! The menu I’ve posted may be bit older by the time you read..

Masala Chai and Cardamom chai. tastes great! next time i’m coming for the shawarma and chicken wings. We came late and they had food available even then. sadly had already eaten or we would try. Phone number is at the bottom of the menu. SUPER affordable prices :)

Daddy’s Chai Shop is the perfect place for every tea lover! The chai is strong, flavorful, and always fresh – just the way it should be. The atmosphere is warm and welcoming, and the staff make you feel right at home. Whether it’s your morning boost or an evening hangout with friends, Daddy’s Chai Shop never fails to deliver the best chai experience. Highly recommended!

first came here just to try their chai, and it instantly became one of the best chai I've had in Weligama. After that visit, I became a regular customer😄 Not only the chai, but their shawarma, submarines, chicken wings, and cheese balls are absolutely delicious Everything tastes amazing and the quality is excellent. The staff are very friendly and bring good vibes every day, which makes the place even better🫶🏻 Honestly, 5 stars are not enough for this place. Highly recommended!🖤
Forever love this shop☕️❤️

formatted_address: 13 Galle Road, Main Street, Weligama 81700, Sri Lanka
name: Nutry Cafe

reviews.text: Had a really nice experience here. The chocolate brownie was rich and delicious, and the cortado was perfectly balanced and smooth. Loved the beach vibe of the café — very relaxing with a great view. A perfect spot to chill and enjoy good coffee. Will definitely visit again!

Absolutely love Nutry Cafe! It’s quieter than other spots in Weligama if you need to get some work done, with lovely sea views. The iced coffees and lemonades are wonderful, and I’m a big fan of their build-your-own poke bowls. Overall great atmosphere with very welcoming staff. Highly recommend!

I am so stoked this little cafe exists! On this side of Weligama the food selection is a bit sparse and I have visited Nutry nearly every day, sometimes multiple times and day. Their smoothie bowls are delicious (made with frozen fruit, not made with ice/water). The staff are absolutely wonderful and the food comes out quite quickly in comparison to every other restaurant I have eaten at in Weligama. They report they are going to experiment with opening for dinner too and I hope I am here for when this happens!! Thank you Nutry 🩵💙

Really nice Café with a nice balcony with ocean view. We had coffee, drinks and the Turkish eggs and it was delicious. We will definitely come back in the next days.  The staff was also really friendly.

Such a great café, with some of the kindest, most attentive, and polite staff around.

Both the coffee and the matcha latte were really good, and the flourless chocolate pancakes were exactly what we were craving after a surf — a sweet treat that still feels reasonably healthy.

The atmosphere is calm and relaxed, and a really nice break from the bustle of Weligama, with plenty of space to sit and unwind among the palm trees.

We’ll definitely be back!

reviews.text: BEST coffee I had in years!!! name: Co - Living Memories Hotel, hostel and restaurant

reviews.text:
Wonderful place! I originally planned to stay for just one week, but ended up staying for three.
During the first week, I stayed in a room without a street-facing window, which was perfect for getting a good night’s sleep — no noise and no early sunlight. For the next two weeks, I moved to a room with a window facing a school. It can be a bit lively in the mornings, but it’s actually great if you’d like to wake up earlier and start your day!
Breakfast is included (I’ve attached some photos). There are also cozy common areas on every floor where you can relax or meet other guests. The cleanliness is excellent — and for anyone wondering, yes, they even wash the mosquito nets on the beds haha
The place is run by such kind and welcoming people who are always happy to help. Thank you for everything — I will definitely come back again!

We stayed 3 weeks and felt just at home.
Location is great not in a too touristy area. Shamila and her brothers are so nice and helpful. The breakfast are awesome and the place is super clean. Would come back 100% !!

Amazing stay at Memories!

Lovely room, big bed and first hot shower we’ve had in weeks.

Family run hostel and we felt part of the family too. They are great!! Breakfast is lovely

Dimuth is the best host, he is honest and very accomodating. He always looks after us, helps us with suggestions of restaurants etc.

The food and drinks here are also delicious. Honestly eat here, it's the best.

Cannot recommend enough. Amazing value and the best vibes

Money was stolen from my luggage — €150 and $250
disappeared from a locked glass case. When I discovered it, I screamed and knocked for help for 15 minutes but no one came, and repeated calls to the police went unanswered. I eventually found a staff member pretending to sleep; the managers stalled, laughed in my face, tried to make me accept only part of the money, and returned less than was taken. The balcony door in my room couldn't be fully locked, there were no security cameras on the third floor, and I felt terrified and completely unsafe staying there overnight.

We had a great stay with Freedom Surf and would definitely come back for our next trip!

This is a family run operation and they are just the sweetest, very available to help with whatever we needed including arranging drivers and tours. We came expecting more of a surf camp vibe; it definitely is more of a homestay which was very pleasant, although seems like they are expanding their property and maybe trying to invite more surfers to stay.

The property is off the main road in Weligama and backs up to the river so it’s nice and quiet. The breakfast options are all great, and only a 10 minute walk from Freedom Surf school. Lots of great restaurants and cafes nearby too.

Really exceptional place. One of the best we’ve stayed at while traveling, we liked it so much we extended our time here. Wonderful family. The Sri Lankan breakfast is amazing. We also had great experiences surfing with Freedom Surf, great instruction and great value. Would really highly recommend.

I booked a surf & relax package with private surf lessons, room and breakfast included. The family who runs the place is really friendly and I felt welcome from the first minute. I also took a cooking class and had the most delicious rice & curry. The surf school is only a short walk away, the rooms are clean and the outside area is very well taken care of. I especially enjoyed the peace and quiet at the riverside, after surfing. They also have a generator, so you don’t have tor worry about the power cuts. Overall it’s good value for the money and I totally recommend staying and surfing here.
Loved to stay here years ago and had a great surf time 😊😊💪

Best surf camp in Weligama! The atmosphere and the family will sure makes you feel at home. The rooms are really comfortable, the guests were really nice and the surf camp is the best one of the city! Definitely a wise choice!

name: Java Lounge -Weligama Beach

reviews.text:
That’s place looking cozy, and comfortable, especially seats with view on ocean. Loved it. Also a nice service, friendly team BUT what about food : I took a croissant with salmon and cream cheese - as you could see that’s even doesn’t looked delicious and taste was not really good : salmon was too salty and there was almost no cream cheese, it why croisant was dry.

Maybe something different from menu taste better, but my experience was disappointing. In other ways - I liked this place
I can't comment on the food but the iced coffee was good. Nice views over the ocean from upstairs and very chill laid back vibe where I watched the sun set. Friendly service.

The Java Lounge in Weligama is an exceptionally beautiful place, both in terms of its ambiance and surroundings. The customer service is outstanding—staff members are consistently kind, respectful, and attentive, making every visit a pleasant experience. The food is delicious and of high quality, which further adds to the overall excellence of the lounge.

What truly stands out is the professionalism and warmth of the employees, which I consider one of the greatest strengths of this place. Because of this, The Java Lounge has become one of my favorite places to visit and a perfect spot to relax and relieve stress. I am genuinely happy with my experiences here and highly recommend it to anyone looking for a great place to unwind in Weligama. ✨🥰

Although today I ordered takeaway, this marks my sixth experience enjoying a meal at the lounge itself—each visit consistently exceeding expectations. ✨

Needed to find a cute cafe to get some work done with good coffee! This was the perfect find! I got an iced white mocha and chocolate croissant! Both were so delicious the croissant was the perfect amount of chocolate and the drink was a great flavor and tasty whipped cream! I’ve found it hard to find white mocha around Sri Lanka and this was exactly what i wanted! Great work space with free wi-fi and beach view! Love the open concept and the staff was so friendly!(:

Fantastic location to enjoy a coffee and snack in the morning. The ocean breeze upstairs was amazing. I was the only one there @8am do l had the whole place to myself. Friendly service, great coffee and the ham/cheese croissant was a real treat

formatted_address: XCGP+JCW, Gangarama Cross Rd, Weligama, Sri Lanka
name: Floating Boat restaurant

reviews.text:
A true hidden gem on the Polwatta River – Authentic & Magical!
We discovered The Floating Restaurant by chance and loved it so much that we came back two days in a row! The setting is incredibly unique: you sit right on a floating raft on the water. It’s so serene to look out over the Polwatta Ganga, and if you’re lucky, you can spot monitor lizards or even crocodiles swimming by.
It is a family-run business where the mother does the cooking, and you can really taste the love in the authentic cuisine. The fruit is super fresh with a great daily selection. I highly recommend the omelet—it was perfectly spiced and delicious. The tea and Turkish coffee were also spot on.
(See photo: The Pineapple Smoothie Bowl is a must-try! You can even order it with some yogurt on the side.)
If you are looking for an authentic experience away from the crowds, this is the place. They deserve to be famous!
A super delicious breakfast, prepared with love. The bowl is especially recommended. You sit on a raft by the water. We went there several times.

We stopped by this incredibly atmospheric place just for a coffee, and its vibe completely captivated us from the very first moment. Inside, cheerful people were playing games and chatting, while amazingly good music was playing (Spotify: Monoplay Radio), instantly setting the mood.
The beach is just across the road, so you can easily pop in from the shore during the day for a coffee or a quick bite.
We ended up coming back several times over the following days, and what really stood out to me was the service: every single time we were treated with exceptional kindness. Sri Lankans are generally very friendly people, but here they were even a little kinder than usual.
I wholeheartedly recommend this place at any time of day.

I don't understand these enthusiastic reviews and I don't share them. They took a very long time to prepare the food, the dishes were brought almost cold, the tuna and squid seemed to have been boiled rather than fried, not tasty, there were a lot of flies.

I went there with my family. We only ordered drinks, but they were served very quickly and were nicely prepared. The staff were very friendly, and the café had a very aesthetic atmosphere. My Matcha Latte was Great!

Fun late-night vibes for a drink, food, or playing pool, lots of local surf crowd hanging out. I came on a night when they had live music and they were serving their full menu until late (I’m guessing they always do but can’t guarantee). I ordered the tuna steak, which came with two perfectly cooked generously portioned pieces of fish, with a salad; super tasty and filling. All around nice experience, super laid back.

Absolutely loved this place!
​
Delicious tuna, shrimp, great cocktails, excellent service, and very tasty shisha, with a cozy atmosphere that makes it easy to relax and enjoy the evening.
​
Great for any group size and easy to visit without a reservation – highly recommended

formatted_address: XCFQ+G3H, Matara Rd, Weligama, Sri Lanka
name: Mates Coffee Club

reviews.text:
Super quick and awesome good. Was in early about 9am and no wait. Coffee was good and good even better.
Tomato oats with prawns something never had before and was delicious, chicken sandwich is top notch.
Nice place! We tried the chicken sandwich — it was delicious. The cold bumble coffee was also quite good. I’ll definitely come back to try the pastries.

Mates is located close to our apartment, which is why we initially went there just for a quick coffee. Little did we know we’d be getting some of the best espresso and drinks in Weligama. Their non-coffee menu is especially impressive, featuring everything from color-changing tea to fermented pineapple drinks and coconut-based beverages. They also offer passion coffee (coffee with passion fruit), which we tried and loved here for the first time ever.
The barista is phenomenal, the staff is friendly and highly competent, and they’re always happy to give advice. The Russian owner also brings his DNA into the experience, so you can enjoy some Russian dishes as well. Make sure to stop by for coffee or tea — totally worth it.
The best chicken sandwich ever! All the meals are great and tasty. Highly recommend! Also it is windy inside thus it won’t be too hot to dine in
Don't miss this place, the chicken sandwich and tomato oat porridge is the most tasty meal that we ate in Mirissa!
